33350.text: First discovered by Rheinland Imperial Navy surveyors in 556 AS, the Wexler Anomaly has long been an object of scientific curiosity. Military scientists initially speculated that the anomaly was somehow linked to the unusually stable pair of Jump Holes orbiting it, however the research program was abandoned and largely forgotten in the turmoil following the 80-Years War. The area surrounding the anomaly was classified by Chancellor Niemann in 797 AS, and remains of interest to the MND to this day.

33352.text:
INFUSED AZURITE

Experiments in the early 820s revealed that processed Azurite Gas was an ideal hybridisation interface between alien and human technology. To achieve this, the Gas must be carefully refined through complicated and expensive plasma ‘infusions’. Azurite is of extreme interest to the Houses, which are driven by the fear of their peers obtaining a technological advantage. The Core happily exploits this lucrative market by unscrupulously selling to the highest bidder.

33354.text:
XENO EXCAVATIONS

Those prospecting the ruined alien structures in low orbit of Planet Knossos will often scoop up entire cargo holds of promising looking rubble, hoping to retrieve caches of live Xeno Relics. These Excavations are then broken open and manually sifted through, to separate valuable Relics from fragmented Low-Grade Artifacts and other detritus. This work is extremely hazardous, as many Excavations contain radioactive or toxic materials, or life-threatening unstable Artifacts.

The Folkvangr is a heavily modified Prison Liner operated by the MND. Housing scientific and engineering crews, the vessel is typically deployed to undertake highly sensitive and complex on-site salvage missions. The Folkvangr has been moored to the wreckage of the Kolleda as the MND urgently attempt to salvage any surviving technology aboard, and establish why the detonation occurred.

33359.text: The Remscheid was commissioned in 799 AS and saw service in Kusari as a part of the Rheinland Northern Fleet. The cruiser is officially listed as having deserted. The Remscheid is suspected to have carried out a string of transport massacres across Rheinland and the Omegas over the following decades, fuelling urban legends of Colony War-era ghost ships. In 834 AS, a large Wild force launched an assault on the nearby Battleship Kolleda. The Remscheid was ultimately destroyed in the fighting by Rheinland Military bombers.

33361.text: Baldur was an elite MND agent, renowned for killing dozens of alien ships across the Omegas in the aftermath of the Colony Wars. During a patrol with junior agent Frigg, the pair pursued two infected pilots deep into the Suhl Anomaly. Following a reckless maneuver, Frigg was consumed by the Anomaly’s hazards, leaving Baldur to fend off the Wild pilots on his own. He knocked one assailant into the Suhl’s teeth using a mine. His ship was damaged in the process, with the agent choosing to ram his last opponent to ensure their destruction.

33363.text: Frigg was a junior MND agent who foolishly chased two infected pilots into the Suhl Anomaly. Frigg fell victim to the anomaly only moments after engaging with the alien pilots.

The Hildesheim is currently deployed to protect the Folkvangr's ongoing forensic investigation, and deter persistent Wild raids.

First deployed in 826 AS, it remains unclear to what extent the technology is meaningfully affecting the underlying Jump Hole, if at all.

Wexler Outpost was constructed in 806 AS to study the nearby anomaly. MND scientists believe the anomaly is somehow linked to the unusually stable pair of Jump Holes orbiting it, potentially acting as a form of magnetic and gravimetric anchor. While the anomaly has been characterized by its remarkable stability, significant aberrations in its energy field were recorded in 818 AS, 820 AS, and again in 831 AS. Wexler Outpost is currently manned by a minimal crew responsible for maintaining onboard instruments.

33376.text: The remains of an infested Valkyrie codenamed Huldra. Piloted by a former Rheinland Military test pilot who was shot down during the Purge of Thuringia, and subsequently captured by the Wild. Since then, the Huldra has lured overzealous MND pilots patrolling Thuringia into traps, leading to their capture and infestation. The Huldra’s final attempt was met with fatal consequences when attempting to set an ambush for an MND veteran named Baldur.

33378.text: The remains of an infested Valkyrie codenamed Fafnir. Believed to have been piloted by one of the first infectees, the Fafnir accompanied the Rheinland Survey team that awakened the Nomads on Planet Pygar in 795 AS. Fanfir’s activities came to an abrupt end when it and the Huldra attempted to lure two MND pilots into the Suhl Anomaly. After taking heavy damage from a mine, the ship span away into the Anomaly’s fatal hazards.

Saalburg Station was established by the LWB in 814 AS. It was used to stage raids on Daumann Fertilizer shipments to Stuttgart, and Synth Foods exports to Kusari. A Corsair invasion force occupied the station in 824 AS, and quickly put it to use as a mustering ground for further pushes into Rheinland. Aware that they did not have the strength to dislodge the Corsairs, the LWB sold the station’s location to the Rheinland Military. Unwilling to allow the Corsairs to gain a permanent foothold within Rheinland, the Military launched an operation to destroy the base later the same year. The force dispatched from the Battleship Koblenz would receive unexpected assistance from the Bundschuh, LWB and Red Hessians, all seemingly united in their hatred for the Edge World pirates.

33396.text: [827 AS] Plasmaball finals canceled over disorder

33397.text: BAHRENFELD CITY -- 827 AS -- System authorities have canceled the Plasmaball Finals between the Glasgow Ghosts and Hamburg Juggernauts. Mobs affiliated with opposing Imperial and Reformist political blocs have violently clashed across Hamburg in recent weeks, following an attack on Imperial celebrity Fredrick von Albrecht. The Federal Police fear the unruly plasmaball tournament may provide a platform for further escalation. Crowd control police have been deployed around the Championship Stadium as armed rioters protesting the cancellation set fire to vehicles and looted nearby properties.

33399.text: PLANET HAMBURG -- 827 AS -- Disorder in Bahrenfeld City has continued to spread. Federal Police have declared a state of emergency as seditious Imperial militias begin to direct the mobs against planetary authorities. In several Quarters attacks have been launched against Federal buildings, with the mayor of Rotherbaum being kidnapped. Municipal authorities have requested immediate Military assistance to execute arrest warrants against local Imperial leaders. The Carrier Soltau refused the request and moved into Hamburg orbit, while ordering RFP ships to stand down and return to Lübeck Border Station.

33401.text: SPRAGUE -- 827 AS -- The Glasgow Ghosts have been stranded on Planet Hamburg after the Plasmaball Finals were canceled. The team of ex-Leeds residents soared to superstardom after making it to the finals in a stunning underdog upset. Hamburg authorities axed the rowdy event over fears that it could exacerbate the disorder already ripping through Rheinland cities. Team captain Greg Brown said the players were safe, but all transit off-planet had been restricted. Sprague viceroy Dame Dixon has urged the Bretonian government to intervene and “bring our boys home”.

33403.text: This container appears to have been discretely fastened to some nearby wreckage. Local ion trails suggest Corsairs and Unioners frequent the area.

33404.text: The Federal Police think there's a smuggling ring working out of the Hausenfeld. They don't have the resources to deal with it, but you could check it out. I'll upload all of the info into your Neural Net

33405.text: Good luck, don't get yourself killed.

33407.text: The Soleil was among the first EFL supply transports dispatched to Rheinland for the landmark Frankfurt to Sigma-15 Jump Gate construction project. The Soleil and its escorts vanished in 825 AS after communications were abruptly lost on the final leg of its journey. The Soleil’s airlocks are open, but there are no signs of combat damage or forced entry. The cargo of EFL Blue Packs is missing, and all onboard data has been forensically purged.

33410.text: The Memmingen is a heavy supply ship affiliated with the Bundschuh movement. For many political prisoners rescued by Bundschuh activists, the Memmingen represents the best hope for escape, and a new life outside Rheinland’s borders. The supplies it brings back from groups like the Junkers and Zoners continue to keep the movement in fighting form. This Pilgrim Liner’s origins are unclear, however its utility to the Bundschuh is not.

33412.text: The Ansbach was a Imperialist heavy supply transport that participated in the Rheinland Civil War. It was ambushed and destroyed by a Federalist strike squadron in 828 AS. The ship was shunted away from the Trade Lane and ongoing battle when its reactor exploded. The Ansbach has since fallen into Frankfurt's star and is now beginning to break apart and melt.

33414.text: The Kastner was a Federalist fighter launched from the Carrier Saar. Lieutenant Paul Weissmuller was recorded as missing in action after fighting in the rearguard to cover the Saar's initial escape from New Berlin. The Kastner appears to have escaped into the Westerwald Nebula before succumbing to damage.

33416.text: The Schwab was a notorious Imperial raider that fought in the Rheinland Civil War. While the pilot's identity is unknown, the Schwab was renown for its daring strikes on Federalist positions across Munich, scoring over 10 fighter kills. Weapons damage indicates that the Schwab was caught by Bundschuh fighters while returning from from a sortie.

33418.text: The Cazadora was a Corsair fighter flown by novice Alcia Castaneda. She had been escorting a supply convoy to the frontlines of Dresden. The convoy was ambushed and destroyed by the Bundschuh, with the Cazadora left in place as a grim warning to other Corsairs.

33420.text: The Pellucid is registered to the award winning investigative journalist Ute Gloeckner. The Starflyer has been extensively modified with custom sensor packages designed to provide long-range visual capture and telemetry. The ship's data banks have been removed. Gloeckner was reported missing in late 833 AS.

33422.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

The Halle Debris field is a dark reminder of the Rheinland Civil War that was fought from 827 to 828 AS. Halle was formed from the wreckage of a number of different battles between Federalist and Imperial forces. In an attempt at reconciliation, ALG was offered a generous contract for battlefield cleanup across Frankfurt. While some initial progress has been made in decontaminating Halle, the process is complicated by the nearby Westerwald which ALG is unwilling to enter, as well as frequent Unioner attacks.

33424.text: An ALG staging ground for salvage operations in the Halle Debris Field. Due to frequent Unioner attacks, ALG has deployed some rudimentary defences. Junkers can occasionally be found bartering salvage here from the particularly dangerous wrecks within the Westerwald.

33426.text: The Geier has been a familiar sight at Kreuzberg Depot for centuries, prowling Rheinland's scrap fields and staking claims to only the most choice of derelicts. Having worked the Yanagi cleanup job for decades, the Junker Mehler Clan have built up a wealth of knowledge on stripping blown Rheinland Military reactors. With the smoke now settling after the Rheinland Civil War, the Geier's crew look forward to propserous -- albeit illegal -- salvaging for years to come.

33427.text: FULDA -- 801 -- With the disappearance of Chancellor Niemann and the installation of the Liberty-backed Provisional Rheinland Government, an immediate cessation of all hostilities has been ordered. Rheinland forces have begun withdrawals on all fronts. Reports from Kusari have confirmed that the Northern Expeditionary Fleet has retreated from Honshu, however it has not returned to Rheinland or recognised the authority of the PRG. Government sources believe the fleet may have deserted, with Rheinland's remaining loyalist security forces being ordered to high-alert as a precaution against pro-Niemann coup attempts.

33429.text: PLANET HAMBURG -- 801 -- As Rheinland reels in the aftermath of the Colony Wars, Republican Shipping has announced the closure of its executive offices in Hamburg. The shipbuilding and haulage giant has long been one of the planet's largest employers, sparking alarm that Republican could be planning further rounds of layoffs. Republican sources advised that they were simply insulating themselves from Hamburg's increasingly dire economic forecasts, and investing more heavily into their Ingolstadt facilities in Munich. Pre-war projections had expected local unemployment to fall to 26％ by 805 AS, although this trend is now expected to reverse.

33430.text: [801 AS] Kusari Imposes Embargo on Rheinland

33432.text: POTSDAM -- 801 -- The Provisional Rheinland Government has begun immediate demilitarization. PRG representatives advised this was an absolute necessity to prevent Rheinland’s imminent financial collapse, and head off direct military intervention by both Bretonia and Liberty. It is expected that these cuts will reduce the Rheinland Military’s headcount by over 80％, leaving tens of thousands unemployed. This will reduce the force to levels last seen in 794 AS, prior to Chancellor Niemann’s build-up program. Already huge formations of capital ships have been mothballed in orbit of Potsdam, awaiting shipyard space for deconstruction.

33434.text: NEW BERLIN -- 801 -- As the smoke clears following the cessation of hostilities, citizens across the Colonies have two simple questions: what happened, and why? As the Provisional Rheinland Government looks to answer those questions, it has become apparent that the House’s senior military leadership has vanished. According to anonymous sources, the whereabouts of the Military High Command is unknown, with numerous Admirals vanishing along with their flagships. Federal Police have posted wanted bulletins for the missing officers, with Liberty offering substantial bounties for their capture.

33435.text: [801 AS] Chancellor Steller Elected to Office

33436.text: NEW BERLIN -- 802 -- Following emergency elections, the Provisional Rheinland Government has been dissolved and Chancellor Alfred Steller voted into office. Steller has vowed to return Rheinland to a state of normalcy, and undo the damage inflicted by the traitor Niemann and his enablers. Steller has promised to uphold the Provisional Government's policy of demilitarization, and has committed to make ammends with Kusari and the other Houses for the unprovoked aggression of the Colony Wars. President Jacobi offered her congratulations and Liberty's support to Chancellor Stellar's new administration.

33437.text: NEW BERLIN -- 802 -- Chancellor Steller has announced the formation of the Marinenachrichtendienst, an autonomous taskforce with a mandate to investigate all echelons of the Rheinland Military. Steller has decried his predecessor, Niemann, as a traitor whose insane wars of aggression were enabled by an insidious rot at the highest levels of civil and military leadership. In a fiery speech, Steller ordered the MND to 'root out' these 'war criminals' and bring them to justice. Rheinland officials are believed to have declined Liberty's offer of LSF assistance with the investigation, describing it as an 'internal security matter'

33438.text: [802 AS] Rheinland Chancellor Ally Against Nomads

33439.text: OSIRIS -- 802 -- Agents have made contact with the newly elected Rheinland government, and appraised them of the Nomad threat. The new Chancellor has agreed that publicizing the nature of the threat would cause uncontrollable panic, and promised to commit significant resources to rooting out any remaining infiltrators. Bundschuh intelligence reports that the Nomad thralls responsible for invading Kusari have retreated to Thuringia, a secretive 80-Years War stronghold. We have deployed the Osiris to investigate, and will be cooperating with the MND, a newly formed military taskforce that has been ordered by the Chancellor to lead Rheinland’s response.

33441.text: HUDSON -- 803 -- The Hudson border world between Liberty and Rheinland is a dangerous and lawless place. Liberty has long had an interest in annexing the system, having previously commissioned terraforming surveys of Planet Atka. In 800 AS, Rheinland had come close to selling its consent for the move, until Chancellor Niemann abruptly withdrew from negotiations. Liberty has since requested renewed talks, but the recently elected Chancellor Steller declined, saying that he would not make territorial concessions "in a time of crisis.” Despite this, Liberty appears unwilling to abandon its ambitions in the region.

33443.text: BONN STATION -- 803 -- Interspace today officially confirmed that Rheinland's economy has entered a sharp recession. This is largely a consequence of the devastating Colony Wars, Kusari's trade boycott, and the gradual tapering of the 'lifeline' loans Liberty had used to sustain the Provisional Rheinland Government. Anonymous government sources also commented that audits were revealing a pattern of 'inexplicable financial sabotage' by the previous administration. Chancellor Steller has announced a raft of measures intended to address the economic crisis, including renewed negotiations with Kusari and targeted state investments.

33444.text: [804 AS] Progress Made in Purge of Thuringia

33445.text: WEIMAR -- 803 -- Order agents with MND support have defeated the Nomad thralls in Weimar orbit. The Osiris will secure the area, as the bulk of the missing Northern Fleet remains elsewhere; no sightings of the battleships that withdrew from Honshu have been reported. Hostiles still hold positions on Weimar in old Imperial bunkers, with breaching actions revealing extensive traps and ambush points. Already we have discovered significant excavations that are not recorded in Rheinland archives. It’s unclear what the Nomads were trying to uncover. Infected forces continue to launch raids from the nebula, and seem intent on regaining the planet.

33447.text: BADEN BADEN -- 803 -- Police sources have confirmed that CEO Wolfgang Daumann has been killed in an apparent terrorist attack. Daumann had been a vocal supporter of Chancellor Niemann’s remilitarisation drive, overseeing the construction of the new fleet. Surprisingly, Daumann also lent DHC specialists to Alster Shipyard across the late 790s, allowing the civilian facility to contribute to military contracts. Daumann went into seclusion three years ago, with his office citing ‘health concerns’. Federal Police say initial evidence points to Bundschuh involvement in the killing.

33449.text: BADEN BADEN -- 803 -- Our forces today struck another blow against the Nomad infiltration of Rheinland. We had long suspected that their thralls were not limited to senior government and military officials, but extended to corporate facilitators too. Exhaustive investigations traced CEO Wolfgang Daumann to an isolated compound on Baden Baden. Our strike team successfully infiltrated the facility, confirming Daumann's infection. Shortly before the team was wiped out, Commander Dietrich detonated a bomb, destroying all present. These heroes of Rheinland will be forever remembered for their sacrifice.

33450.text: [804] Treaty of Honshu Eases Colony War Wounds

33451.text: HONSHU -- 804 -- Dignitaries from Rheinland and Kusari today ratified the Second Treaty of Honshu, officially normalizing relations between the two Houses. Rheinland has formally accepted sole culpability for the Colony Wars and agreed to a 20 year reparations package. This includes preferential rates for Kusari corporations on military goods and resources needed to rebuild the Kusari Naval Forces, and financial compensation for the damages inflicted in Honshu and New Tokyo. Chancellor Steller offered his sincere condolences to Kusari over the war, and promised a brighter future of mutual prosperity.

33452.text: [804 AS] Leaked Documents Reveal War Profiteering

33453.text: NEW BERLIN -- 804 -- Daumann Heavy Construction and Republican Shipping have both come under fire after a cache of leaked documents revealed their profits from Colony War shipbuilding contracts. Chancellor Niemann’s unprecedented military buildup cost hundreds of billions of credits to surge production in both the Oder and Alster Shipyards. The documents released by Bundschuh activists revealed that both corporations reaped record-breaking profits for this work. Several Reichstag delegates have called for the corporations' executives to be investigated as war criminals and the public funds clawed back. Chancellor Steller’s office has reluctantly promised an inquest into the matter.

33455.text: HAMBURG -- 804 -- A petition has been filed with the Chancellor's office by the families of deceased Military personnel, claiming that dozens of Hamburg families have received next of kin notifications over recent months. Sabine Wirtz says, “the Ministry of Defense refuses to release my son’s body or tell me why he died. He was a soldier, not a pilot. He shouldn’t have been fighting.” A representative of the Chancellor passed on his condolences to the families, advising that the deaths were related to counter-terrorism operations against the Red Hessians. The families have vowed to take the matter to court unless the withheld bodies are released for proper burial.

33457.text: AUGSBURG -- 805 -- Industry Minister Niklas Konig today marked the completion of Munich's Augsburg Orbital Colony at a lavish opening ceremony. Hailing the pilot project as a symbol of Rheinland's ingenuity, he predicted a future where millions of citizens would live industrious lives in orbital habitats. Augsburg was originally scheduled for completion in 789 AS, but faced more than a decade of delays due to funding issues. Completed using state investment subsidies, critics have called the station a wasteful vanity project in a time of economic hardship. Owing to cost overruns, the price of apartments aboard is substantially higher than originally forecast.

33459.text: NEW TOKYO -- 801 -- A spokesman for Shogun Edo has confirmed that a full economic embargo of Rheinland will be imposed due to the outrages of the Colony Wars. Liberty has been quick to offer mediation between the two Houses, with the Provisional Rheinland Government offering a message of condolence to the Kusari people for the actions of the ousted previous administration. Despite this, Kusari has remained resolute that no normalization of relations will be contemplated until full reparations are made for the devastation and alleged war crimes perpetrated in Honshu and New Tokyo.

33460.text: [802 AS] New Taskforce Probes War Criminals

33462.text: HAMBURG -- 803 -- The aging Battleship Westfalen has received a reprieve after the Rheinland Military extended its service life by a further 10 years. Following demilitarization efforts and mass desertions, the Westfalen was once again left as Rheinland's sole active duty battleship. The 80-Years War survivor was not deployed during the Colony Wars over 'readiness' concerns, and now -- with the consent of the other Houses -- will continue in its role suppressing piracy throughout Hamburg. Military sources have cautioned that acute financial pressures and the Westfalen's degrading capabilities will  adversely affect coverage of the Liberty border worlds.

33464.text: NEW BERLIN -- 803 -- As Rheinland falls further into economic crisis, many face financial ruin. Desperation has driven political radicalism and crime. Where tens of thousands of Military personnel were laid off in the aftermath of the Colony Wars, huge numbers of trained pilots have found themselves unemployed. With local corporations no longer recruiting, some have turned to the Bounty Hunter’s Guild, however many have resorted to the Bundschuh, Red Hessians and Unioners. The RFP has already noted a sharp increase in criminal activity across Rheinland and the surrounding border worlds.

33465.text: [803 AS] Junkers Look Out For Their Own

33466.text: KREUZBERG -- 803 -- The clans of Kreuzberg have reported record breaking numbers looking to become Junkers as work dries up on Rheinland planets. When people can’t make ends meet the traditional way, they start to think about other opportunities. Jakob Mehler of the Mehler Clan commented, “outsiders might work with us or for us, but they ain’t us. If you’re not a Junker, you’re not part of the family.” The sentiment seems to be shared by the other Clans, who agree that the Junkers need to look out for their own first, especially when hard times are coming. For many unemployed Rheinlanders, that’s going to mean a cold shoulder in the Scrap fields.

33467.text: [802 AS] Friends or Threats In High Places?

33468.text: BRUCHSAL -- 802 -- We have learned that Herr Von Claussen has been appointed as the first director of the newly formed MND. The award of this senior federal rank has been met with trepidation by some, given Von Claussen’s intimate knowledge of Bundschuh operations and bases. Despite this, we would urge calm. Von Claussen is a hero of the Nomad War, and a friend in high places. The Bundschuh’s contribution to Rheinland’s survival is unlikely to ever be publicly recognised, however Von Claussen witnessed our sacrifice first hand. A federal director who supports our cause of a just and free Rheinland is an asset indeed.

33469.text: [803 AS] Progress Made in Purge of Thuringia

33470.text: WEIMAR -- 803 -- Order agents with MND support have defeated the Nomad thralls in Weimar orbit. The Osiris will secure the area, as the bulk of the missing Northern Fleet remains elsewhere; no sightings of the battleships that withdrew from Honshu have been reported. The Battlecruiser Chitose and its sister ships Niyodo and Misawa were deployed in 826 AS, narrowly missing service in the Saigon War. They were instead assigned to the Kansai Experimental Committee, where they were used as testbed platforms for various prototype technologies. The Chitose has moved on to Phase III field trials as a part of the Amanohashidate project, establishing a Jump Bridge to Tohoku.

33590.text: The Scharfschütze was piloted by Lieutenant Eric Werner, who was commissioned to the Battleship Schwerin in 834 AS. Apparently overwhelmed by the thrill of battle, Werner disobeyed orders to disengage from the enemy, pursuing a fleeing Corsair freighter into the Taunusfeld. It would seem the ship's name was applied ironically by his colleagues.

33592.text: These storage tanks appear to have been cobbled together from scavenged debris and ship components. Scans reveal that there are still traces of H-Fuel within, the tanks having only been recently drained. There is no sign of whatever had been mooring here, and any engine ion trails have long since dissipated.

33594.text: This sensor-warping particulate cloud is located deep within the Kielfeld. Superstitious Unioner smugglers named the cloud the Erlking's Lair, claiming something terrible resided within.

33596.text: The Zuverlässig was a Unioner smuggler. It vanished in 824 AS while carrying Alien Artifacts from Kreuzberg Depot. The cargo bay has been ransacked but the cargo left behind. The damage inflicted on the Zuverlässig's engines does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33598.text: The Schwein was a Unioner smuggler. It vanished in 824 AS while carrying Alien Artifacts collected from Frankfurt. The hull has been peeled open, and the cargo is missing. The damage inflicted on the Schwein does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33600.text: The Whirlwind was a Liberty Rogue smuggler. It vanished in 825 AS after departing from Wedel Mining Facility with a shipment of Alien Artifacts and Diamonds. The damage inflicted on the Whirlwind's engines does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33602.text: The Liebling was a Unioner smuggler. It vanished in 826 AS after fleeing into the Kielfeld to escape Red Hessian raiders. It is believed to have been carrying Alien Artifacts. The cargo bay has been ransacked but the cargo itself left behind. The damage inflicted on the Liebling's engines does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33604.text: The Straightshooter was a Houston Freelancer, piloted by "Honest" Hank Horton. It vanished in 826 AS after fleeing a Rheinland Military checkpoint at the Hudson Jump Gate. It is believed to have been carrying counterfeit Alien Artifacts. The damage inflicted on the Straightshooter's engines does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33606.text: The Von Albrecht was a bulk passenger ferry operated by Imperial Shipping. The liner was stranded in Hudson during the 831 AS Blackout Crisis. Cached communications confirm that the Von Albrecht reached the Hamburg Jump Gate, however it had had vanished with all hands by the time the network reactivated. The last known transmissions were a hijacking alert, followed several minutes later by a false alarm all-clear signal. The vessel has been broken into pieces and much of the reactor and engines torn out. The passengers and crew are missing.

33608.text: The Freibeuter was a Bounty Hunter, piloted by former Unioner Sandra Urner. The Freibeuter was notorious for preying on Unioner smugglers, hitting their Diamond and Artifact shipments between Veirlande and the Kielfeld. The fighter vanished in 828 AS, assumed to have been destroyed by pirates. The damage inflicted on the Freibeuter's engines does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33610.text: Crimson squadron was a veteran Unioner wing from Pacifica Base. They were last seen in 824 AS, investigating a sudden spike in missing smugglers around the Kielfeld. Crimson 4 appears to have been taken by surprise, destroyed with a full complement of unfired munitions. The inflicted damage does not conform to any known weapon profile.

33612.text: ARRANMORE -- 832 AS -- Ian Carew has died peacefully in his sleep, aged 99. As a teenager, Ian famously hijacked a Bowex freighter during the Founder's Day Revolt. Helping to establish Arranmore, Ian preferred simple custodial tasks at base, keeping morale high with his musical talent and jokes. His stories of the movement's earliest days were an inspiration to many, and will be remembered fondly. Over the decades, Ian saw his comrades-in-arms retired, killed or captured, but insisted he'd live on until "those BMM bastards are gone". Though blind and bound to his wheelchair for his final years, he did indeed survive to see our great victory in Dublin. With his passing, we will cherish the Founders' memories and honor their legacy as a new chapter of Molly history begins.

33614.text: The Kefalonia was a first generation Corsair battlecruiser, deployed from Tripoli Shipyard in 829 AS. Much of its early service was spent in the home defense fleet of Crete, securing Corsair interests across the Omicron region. In 833 AS, the Kefalonia was tasked with heading up the Freeport 9 garrison. The picket fleet was taken by surprise by the scale of the Outcast campaign later that year, which far exceeded the Corsairs’ complacent projections. It was ultimately destroyed by the Outcast Battlecruiser Augusta, which had used its Zoner militia allies as a sacrificial distraction to obtain an ideal firing position. The wreckage is too fragile to survive towing back to Tripoli, so is now being deconstructed by salvage crews working on site.

33616.text: This Imperator gunboat was assigned to the Battlecruiser Kefalonia as a part of the Freeport 9 garrison. Following the Kefalonia’s destruction during the early phases of the Outcast offensive of 833 AS, the Psili was reassigned to the command of the Battlecruiser Vis. The Psili has been equipped to target inbound munitions that could damage the Freeport’s sole remaining biodome.

33618.text: CORFU -- 834 -- With thousands killed and Freeport 9 devastated by conflict, the war in Omicron Theta has taken a darker turn. Seemingly drawn like sharks to blood, patrols have reported a sharp increase in Nomad attacks from the Amarus Nebula. Rheinland ships have also been sighted, allegedly attacking freighters near Planet Pygar before vanishing with cloaking devices. It is recommended that all Zoner tradesmen seek the protection of the Gran Canarian Fearless squadron and travel in convoys through the region. Ships traveling alone are now at extreme risk of attack.

33619.text: [834 AS] Growing Nomad Activity in Omicron Theta

33620.text: DABADORU -- 834 -- For many years, the Nomad presence in Omicron Theta has been minimal. Our agents have now observed a spike in aggression across the system, with coordinated offensives by the Nomads and their Wild thralls. While it is possible they are simply exploiting the chaos caused by the Corsairs’ occupation of Freeport 9, the timing cannot be a coincidence. It is surely linked to the devolving situation in Omega-58. We have deployed the Cruisers Mafdet and Khonsu to investigate immediately, as it is vital that we establish the alien motive for their renewed focus. Decisive action must be taken to curtail this threat before it can fester.

33622.text: The ISS Viernau is a Colossus class heavy transport operated by Imperial Shipping. It primarily travels internal routes between Frankfurt, New Berlin and Stuttgart, shuttling imported cargo from freight exchange points like Mainz and Freiburg.

33624.text: The KTS Shinchi is a Ryuujin class Kusari train operated by Kishiro Technologies. It primarily travels between Honshu and Frankfurt, carrying high value Optronics to Mainz Storage Facility. Imperial Shipping then distributes these imports to the factories of Altona Station, Hamburg.

33627.text: A large cluster of broken and mangled ships, seemingly dumped as failed experiments by the Wild of Kaarst Shipyard. Scans indicate that many of these ships contain twisted amalgamations of alien biomass and human technology. Faint lifesigns can be detected aboard some of these vessels, with the contents apparently clinging to life by absorbing the radiation that blankets the area. The few human scouts who have survived expeditions near The Midden reported an oppressive sensation of despair and horror.

33628.text: The Hausbruch is one of several Pilgrim Liners the Unioners maintain. They’re usually tasked with picking up salvage or disabled transports in Bering. Then, we’d either drag them back to Pacifica or field strip any useful parts. Ransoming captured transports and crew was always profitable work.

33629.text: For many years the Hamburg Unioners launched from Wedel Station, however that was destroyed when the Red Hessians betrayed us in '26. After that, we patched up Vierlande Prison, which lasted up until the Civil War ended and the Military pulled itself back together. Now we’re back on Wedel again.

33630.text: I'm a salvager based off the Hausbruch. Normally that involves working on Bering's Liberty Navy or Insurgency wrecks, but it also makes us well qualified to try and shore up Wedel Station. We’ve patched the holes in the hangar so a crew can work out of it, so we'll probably be heading back to Independent Worlds soon.

33631.text: We’re rebuilding Wedel Station as a forward staging post in Hamburg. We can launch attacks on Alster Shipyard from here, and repel Bundschuh and Hessian raids on our territory. The Hessians don’t like us because we’re happy to smuggle Artifacts and take Corsair credits. The Bundschuh are more complicated. We crossed swords during the Civil War, and they’ve held a grudge since.

33632.text: The Unioners received an amnesty when the Civil War ended. Nothing really changed for us though - Imperial Shipping wouldn’t recognize the Alster Union, and any other work we could do paid a fraction of smuggling and piracy profits. For a while the government paid us off to ‘keep the peace’ in Bering, but crime was easier and paid better. The movement was outlawed again within a year, but it was a great time while it lasted.

33633.text: Wedel is a sore point for many Unioners. It was lost after the attack on Vierlande, when the Hessians and Coalition stabbed us in the back during the Betrayal of ‘26. They killed everyone aboard, no survivors. Before, the Corsairs were occasional and uncomfortable business partners. After, they became allies against a common enemy.

33635.text: The Respite is an Order logistics ship, primarily used to deliver equipment and material to allied organizations. These ships are used to offset the burden on these groups of hosting Order agents and operations. The Respite is a common sight at Bruchsal Base, where it provides resources for the ongoing joint investigation in Thuringia.

33637.text: The result of various weapon trials and Military experiments, the Stedtfeld was first used as a test range during the 80-Years War. A significant debris field has accumulated in Eisenach's orbit from the many destroyed targets. The Wild frequently use the field as cover to launch raids on the Kolleda Wreck site.

33639.text:
CLASS: Altenburg
CREW: 0
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Battleship Regensburg was completed in 817 AS, the last of the Altenburg class. It was first deployed to garrison Munich in response to escalating Corsair and Unioner attacks. In 825 AS, an enormous Dark Matter cloud began to engulf the system -- chaos erupted following the decision to evacuate the region. The Regensburg's fleet was stretched to breaking point by coordinating martial law on Planet Nuremberg, and countering the slavers, pirates and looters that flocked to exploit the tragedy. The Regensburg worked closely with the MND to identify destroy trafficking gangs throughout this period.

Everything would change in 827 AS during the Rheinland Civil War. When a planned Imperial mutiny failed to overthrow the Regensburg’s officers, the survivors quickly declared their loyalty and Munich's remaining resources to the Federalist cause. Much of the war would be spent securing Federalist logistics against Imperial privateers, clashing with Unioners and the Battleship Kolleda’s squadrons. The Regensburg pushed forward into Frankfurt during the Federalist counter-offensive of 828 AS. It was destroyed during a flanking attack through the Westerwald that was intended to capture the New Berlin Jump Gate.

33640.text: Opening a corporate office on Holstein seemed like good business sense. Some of our best clients include Rheinland corporate and state actors. In reality however, this post has completely failed to live up to expectations - first the Saigon War and Civil War disrupted travel in the area, then the Omicron Rho project collapsed. The locals seem to be amused by this, and tell us Frankfurt is cursed. I’m beginning to believe them.

33641.text: The Core is a pioneer in exploiting Edge World resources. We have lucrative contracts to ship Iridium from the perilous deep Omicrons. Iridium has always been a valuable metal, harvested in trace amounts and at great expense. The rich deposits we control are revolutionizing armor alloy composites in the Houses... and making us incredibly wealthy. No other corporation has the firepower and skill to secure these goods.

33642.text: Iridium has been a massive boon to The Core, however it is not the only resource we import from the Edge Worlds. We have special agreements with several House intelligence agencies for the acquisition of other “interesting” goods. Rheinland in particular has been an excellent customer, with the MND being exceptionally accommodating... and financially generous, of course.

33644.text: For a one time investment of %d0 credits, you too can join The Core's corporate Platinum Affiliates Program. Terms and conditions apply, The Core accepts no responsibility or liabilities for reprisals by groups such as %F1 or %F2. This highly personalized offer is just for you, and your prosperous future! "Bringing the Edge Worlds to the Core of House civilization!"

33646.text:
CLASS: Resheph
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Order Recon Cruiser Mafdet originally deployed to Omicron Theta following reports of a sudden spike in Nomad activity. The vessel was staging from Corfu Station while investigating the western reaches of the system, where the Mafdet’s cutting edge sensors detected anomalies consistent with large scale cloak use.

Following the arrival of the Order Recon Cruiser Neith-II, the Mafdet returned to Fort Carthage for a much needed period of rest and refit. A new incremental sensor upgrade package is already in the process of being applied to the ship.

33648.text: The Boundless was a Fearless destroyer dispatched to Omicron Theta following the meeting of the Gran Canarian Conclave on the Corsair annexation of Freeport 9. While the Zoners could not come to a consensus on the correct course of action, a number of Fearless captains were hired to provide deterrence and convoy protection between Corfu and Omega-49. Believing the Outcasts would succeed in defeating the Corsairs during their attack of 833 AS, the destroyers Puana and Boundless abandoned their posts, and joined Zoner militants during the attack. The pair were ultimately sacrificed as bait by the Outcasts, who used them to lure the Battlecruiser Kefalonia out of formation. After an uneasy truce was agreed between the Corsairs and Zoners, both wrecks were towed to Corfu to be salvaged.

33650.text: The Puana was a Fearless destroyer dispatched to Omicron Theta following the meeting of the Gran Canarian Conclave on the Corsair annexation of Freeport 9. While the Zoners could not come to a consensus on the correct course of action, a number of Fearless captains were hired to provide deterrence and convoy protection between Corfu and Omega-49. Believing the Outcasts would succeed in defeating the Corsairs during their attack of 833 AS, the destroyers Puana and Boundless abandoned their posts, and joined Zoner militants during the attack. The pair were ultimately sacrificed as bait by the Outcasts, who used them to lure the Battlecruiser Kefalonia out of formation. After an uneasy truce was agreed between the Corsairs and Zoners, both wrecks were towed to Corfu to be salvaged.

33652.text: The destroyer Floriana was deployed from Valletta Shipyard in 833 AS to support the Outcast attack on Freeport 9. Boasting a wide array of sophisticated systems, the Floriana was intended to draw a line under the Maltese Slave Revolt and strike decisively at the enemies who had exploited it. During initial clashes around Freeport 9, the Floriana was severely damaged by the Battlecruiser Kefalonia. It was last seen retreating into the Amarus Cloud, on fire and venting atmosphere.

33654.text: The destroyer Ruiru was completed in 820 AS and deployed into The Core’s “acquisitions service” -- primarily carrying out smash-and-grab raids to steal valuable technology or Artifacts from groups across the Omicrons and Omegas. The Ruiru was briefly sighted near Freeport 9 during the initial phases of fighting in 833 AS, trailing the forlorn Outcast destroyer Floriana. The Ruiru appears to have badly misjudged its prey, itself falling victim the Floriana’s guns before it succumbed.

33655.text: Comrade, you will need cloak-bypass keys to attune the sensors of your ship to the signature of our installations. Install them

33656.text: Bring terror to the stars, and teach humanity to fear their light.

33658.text:
Edison AM-333 "Hegemon" Civilian Asteroid Miner

The venerable Hegemon has been in service for many decades with only minor changes to the design. Every few years, a new power core gets swapped in, the shield generators get upgraded, and the windows get polished, but otherwise the core elements have stayed the same since 720 AS. This is mostly because, until the development of the Annapurna, the Hegemon had no competition, due to its continuing good performance. The ship's sheer bulk makes it difficult to move, but is necessary to house the integrated mineral processing machinery. However, this is usually a worthwhile trade off, since factories will pay a premium for high-purity materials.

Universal Shipping imports Hegemon Miners from Kusari, primarily selling them to consortiums of Freelancers that flock to Erie to make their fortunes. The Hegemon represents the pinnacle of industry at a moderate price, for those aspiring to break into Pennsylvania's Hydrogen mining market.

33660.text:
CTE CT-53 "Heron" Civilian Train

As the spaces between bases increased and so did their commercial potential, these enormous transports were developed to carry larger loads. Tasked with the shipping of freight beyond the threads of civilization represented by the Trade Lanes the Heron class of transport, the first of the Train class, maintains fantastic maneuverability for a vessel of its size and amenity with an economy of movement and production.

Universal Shipping frequently sells off older Train class vessels while carrying out fleet refresh exercises. Freelancers looking for reliable shipping options can pick up a Train for $206,001 at Harrisburg Station.

33662.text:
Enterprise 44 "Mammoth" Liberty Civilian Transport

The Mammoth is a transport built in Liberty for dangerous and lengthy trading missions through the Independent Worlds and the Border Worlds. When pirate activity is on the rise, reinforced hull and advanced power array come in most handy for traders; the Mammoth offers both for a moderate price.

The Mammoth's rugged design and ease of maintenance makes it a popular starting option for Freelancers looking to enter the Liberty shipping market. One of the few transport hull types still produced within Liberty, Universal Shipping resells the Deep Space Engineering product for $101,001.

33665.text: The Zoners want to be left alone. Trespassers will be shot. Liberty tax agents will be shot again.

33667.text: This path of navigation buoys has been deployed to lead new prospectors to the Hydrogen mining zones of the Ralston Ice Field.

33670.text: The Valley Forge Flight School uses this area to carry out pilot training, including high speed maneuvers and simulated combat exercises.

33675.text:
Harmless training drones are provided for pilots to practice their combat maneuvers. To activate a training session, move within 500m of this dispenser and attack the drone.

While training, you should practice:
-Attacking (right mouse button).
-Thrusters (TAB)
-Engine kill (Z)
Strafing (WASD)
-Using Nanobots and Shield Batteries (G / F)
-Dropping mines (E)
-Deploying countermeasures (C).

33676.text: This buoy path leads to the Heavy Water mining zone in the Ralston Ice Field (sector 4G). Heavy Water mining is a boom industry for novice Freelancers trying to earn the credits needed to establish themselves in Sirius.

33677.text:
To mine in this zone, use the Loot filter on your ship's contacts window. Select one of the asteroids listed there.

- First shoot the asteroid with a Mining Array to remove the outer shell. The asteroid will "crack", expelling dust and gasses when the shell is breached.
- Next destroy the fractured rock shards with your weapons. Shards are especially vulnerable to explosives like missiles.
- Shards can be easily spotted by looking for fractures, or using the "Switch to Target" (wireframe) mode on your ship's contacts HUD.
- Shoot exposed ore nodes to drop valuable deposits which you can then tractor into your cargo hold.
- The asteroid core can be destroyed for extra resources; any remaining nodes will be lost at this point. The "Hegemon" Asteroid Miner specializes in extracting extra resources from this kind of brute force strip mining.

33685.text:
"Hey, you. Yeah, yous over there. Interspace don't like us Junkers hanging about here, see, but I gots a bit o' advice, juss 'tween you and me. This lil' loop here? It's for small-timers, corporate chumps, wee babbies who can't hack the big leagues."

"If yous wants to race, you gots to be willin' to shed blood to be the best. You wants to see some real racing? Head over to Allentown Base, orbiting Planet Sayre. Big gas giant, can't miss it. Tell em Rowdy Reg sent you over and they'll set you up at a real track."

"The survivors say there ain't nothin' like the Sayre Gauntlet in all o' Sirius".

33687.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Pocono Field is a particulate cloud filled with asteroids and subject to intense electrical activity that significantly hinders most scanners. The field contains the New York Jump Gate, a vital trade artery for all of Pennsylvania's imports and exports.

33707.text: The Kantoku was flown by Kusari Farmer’s Alliance commander Yuuki Osada. It was reported as lost in 834 AS. Damage patterns are indicative of the bomber’s mines detonating internally.

33709.text: The Shihyou was flown by senior Kusari Farmer’s Alliance commander Naoaki Kurita. It was reported as lost in 834 AS. Extensive damage has been inflicted to the ship’s engines and rear. Kurita does not appear to have had time to deploy Shield Batteries or Nanobots in response to the attack.

33711.text: The Heilbronn was a first generation Tirpitz battlecruiser that served in the Altenburg fleet. During the Rheinland Civil War, it acted as a guard ship at the Cologne Jump Gate to prevent Red Hessian incursions. As a result it was the first vessel on station when the Battleship Karlsruhe attempted a break-out during the Federalist Offensive of 827 AS. The Heilbronn and its escorts successfully pinned the Karlsruhe before it could escape into the Nordnebel, but was destroyed in the resulting fight.

33712.text:
Bochum Refinery was constructed by Kruger Minerals in early 824 AS to help legitimize Rheinland’s claim to Sigma-15, amid escalating tensions with the Gas Miners Guild. Built at great cost due to the need to ship materials from Frankfurt through deep space, Kruger was only willing to take on the project with significant subsidies and underwriting from the Rheinland government. Due to the extreme cost of long distance shipping, the station remained largely dormant until the completion of the Frankfurt Jump Gate the following year, leading some to label it the “Potemkin refinery”.

Bochum rapidly scaled up its operations after this, refining resources harvested from the Scharhorn Asteroid Field and fuel gasses extracted from the Nordsee. The destruction of gas miner Verlbert by the GMG paramilitary proved to be the spark that finally led to war. The refinery quickly shifted focus to H-Fuel production, with its miners operating under heavy Military escort to deter the continuous GMG attacks. It would not take long for Kusari to be dragged into the war too; Bochum was quickly identified as a front line fuel depot and a target of strategic value.

In late 825 AS, the Kusari Office of Intelligence launched simultaneous raids on targets across Sigma-15, dividing the local garrison’s forces. Exploiting this confusion, a captured Rheinland Military gunboat was set on autopilot towards the refinery, broadcasting a distress signal. Upon mooring, an antimatter warhead was detonated, consuming the station and killing all aboard. The loss of Bochum has spurred anti-Kusari sentiment in Rheinland and accusations of war crimes ever since.

33715.text: The Ōgama was flown by Kusari Farmer’s Alliance commander Kishin Oike. It was reported as lost in 834 AS. Damage patterns are indicative of one of the bomber’s torpedoes detonating internally.

33716.text: The wreckage of a fighter lost during the Rheinland Civil War's Battle of the Nordnebel. Due to the inflicted damage, it is not possible to tell whether the vessel belonged to the Imperial or Federalist fleet.

33721.text:
CLASS: Bustard
CREW: N/A
ARMAMENT: N/A

The Robert Peary was a long range construction ship operated by Deep Space Engineering (DSE). It was designed to securely carry the White Boxes and support ships needed to deploy Jump Gate infrastructure. The Bustard chassis was produced at Baltimore Shipyard in partnership with Ageira Technologies for grueling deep space cruises between star systems. In 834 AS, the Robert Peary and a specialist crew were requisitioned by the Liberty Security Force (LSF) to carry out an emergency reactivation of the jump connection between Ontario and California.

Under escort by the Battlecruiser Lehigh, the Robert Peary completed the 2 month trip from California and began patch repairs and White Box installation on the abandoned Jump Gate frame. Despite DSE's grave safety warnings, the LSF activated the Gate as soon as a minimal connection could be sustained. The Gate could only support brief jump tunnels at a low power intensity, limiting the traffic capable of transiting. Regardless, this allowed the LSF to establish a tenuous beachhead into Ontario for resupply and reinforcements.

Early the following year, the Jump Gate came under attack by waves of Xeno fighters who were loathe to allow Liberty to re-establish a permanent presence in the system. This attack was significantly larger than the LSF's most pessimistic assessments of Xeno capabilities, which had misjudged the movement's priorities and resolve. Despite suffering horrific casualties, the Xenos eventually broke through the Lehigh's perimeter and overran the Robert Peary, crippling it and leaving few survivors.

33723.text: The Jump Gate to Alberta was constructed in 816 AS. Alberta was later abandoned after being consumed by a vast dark matter storm in 827 AS. The Jump Gates to the system were stripped of any valuable technologies, and the superstructure abandoned to join the ever expanding Ontario debris field Liberty left in its wake.

33725.text:
Hamilton Station was an Ageira Technologies depot constructed in 809 AS to manage the development of Ontario's Jump Gate and later Trade Lanes. Adhering to the principle of "out of sight, out of mind", Hamilton was then used for many years as a delivery point for contaminated Ageira waste that was to be dumped in remote areas of the system. This included ruined components from discarded Ageira experiments at Pueblo Station, and the refuse from secretive projects that later took place in Alberta. Following the Gallic War, Ageira finally divested the station, selling it to Universal Shipping as a cargo transit point.

Unfortunately for Universal, Ontario operations began winding down shortly after, as wartime subsidies were cut and pirate attacks escalated. Before long, Liberty had concluded that the massive security costs associated with policing Ontario were not worth the marginal economic benefits. Hamilton was abandoned in 830 AS, shortly after Liberty declared its intent to formally withdraw from the system. Universal incurred significant losses from the investment, resulting in unsuccessful attempts to sue to the government for damages. Hamilton has now joined the vast fields of debris Liberty left in its wake.

33728.text: A Deep Space Engineering ice miner that was abandoned early in Ontario's development, after it became clear that operating costs and Xeno attacks would make further mining infeasible.

33730.text: This heavily retrofitted Prison Liner was dispatched by The Technocracy in 834 AS to investigate the anomaly on Planet Sudbury. The X15UZ appears to have been caught in the crossfire when hostilities erupted between the many groups trying to secure exclusive control over the desolate planet’s orbit.

33732.text: Like a great ocean of waste, the Ontario Debris Sea drowns the system under a tide of detritus. The South patch is largely made up of dumped waste from discarded experimental Jump Gate projects at Pueblo Station which Ageira considers to be "out of sight and out of mind". Much of the waste is heavily contaminated, and is now frequently used as cover by Junkers.

33735.text:
Construction on Hinsdale Refinery began in 834 AS. The facility provides Deep Space Engineering (DSE) with bulk Platinum refining capabilities, after substantial deposits were discovered in Galileo. These deposits were for years the subject of fierce legal battles between DSE, Kishiro and Samura who all claimed exclusive extraction rights.

Despite Liberty and Kusari courts separately banning exploitation while proceedings were ongoing, Hinsdale was commissioned with Liberty government funding. This was spurred by fears Kusari was sponsoring its own corporations to undermine the courts, by developing refinery capabilities at Fuchu Prison. As a result, Hinsdale also began to violate the court's orders, with DSE committing to retaliatory mining operations to assert its own rights in Galileo.

By 835 AS, Hisdale had been completed, with Manhattan's Supreme Court upholding DSE's exclusive extraction rights. Accordingly, the court issued an order for Kishiro, Samura and all other parties to vacate their claims. Liberty has since threatened to deploy the Navy to enforce the order, despite Kusari's courts refusing to recognize the ruling as legitimate.

33738.text: Blind Bert was a Xeno supply freighter that struck an asteroid known as "The Bastard" in 834 AS. Local Xenos had complained about the obstruction to Ramsey's commanders for many years, arguing the asteroid was a navigational hazard. No action was taken, and they were ordered to simply "fly around it". After the Bert was lost, several angry Xenos appropriated a large mining charge and blasted The Bastard apart -- all were harshly disciplined for wasting resources.

33740.text: The Battlecruiser Resolute was constructed to defend Bretonia during the Gallic War, seeing service in the Siege of London and the Leeds counter-attack in the aftermath. The vessel suffered serious battle damage while fighting Enclave forces in Edinburgh, returning to Portsmouth for repairs and refitting. As of 834 AS, it has been assigned to guard the shipyard while critical works are carried out to the Battleships Essex and Sommerset.

33741.text:
The former home of the Bretonian Armed Forces in Dublin, the Essex was the gatekeeper to New London. Boasting one of the most experienced crews in Bretonia, the fleet gained decades of experience fighting the Mollys before going on to play a decisive role during the Gallic War. The Essex and its fleet were instrumental during the Siege of New London, routing the Corsair Battleship Athos and causing the collapse of the Gallic Trinité flank.

In 831 AS, the Second Revolt broke out on Graves Station in Dublin. It quickly became apparent that the Mollys had instigated the mutiny, with their agents taking control of the base and broadcasting the execution of a number of high ranking BMM officials. Political pressure from New London following these broadcasts forced the Essex to deploy immediately to recapture the base, rather than waiting for reinforcements or further intelligence.

Avoiding the mistakes of the Battleship Hood 80 years earlier, the Essex took position at the edge of the Graves Gold Field, acting as a staging post for the boarding action. Bretonian forces quickly secured the space around Graves, allowing boarding freighters to deliver the Essex's Marines. The reason for a lack of resistance immediately became clear when the station was scuttled by pre-placed mining charges. Simultaneously, waves of Molly squadrons began closing on the Essex, in an attempt to pin it in place.

News of a separate assault on the Jump Gate revealed that this was little more than another diversion. When confirmation was received that a bomb had been detonated on the gate and its core was showing signs of destabilizing, a full evacuation order was issued. The Essex and its fleet successfully fought its way out of the system, inflicting heavy losses on its attackers. While the Essex successfully made the jump to New London, several of its escort cruisers were lost when the gate exploded.

The Essex was responsible for running patrols into the Cumbria Asteroid Field and enforcing the Dublin Blockade for several years, in a failed attempt to starve the Mollys into submission. In 834 AS, the battleship was recalled to Portsmouth Shipyard alongside the Battleship Sommerset for classified refits overseen by specialist Kusari contractors. It has recently returned to service in New London, although Bretonia remains tight-lipped about the nature of the upgrades installed.

33743.text: The Hashi Maru is a Kusari government vessel operated under contract by Kishiro Technologies. In 834 AS, it ferried specialist Kusari contractors and supplies to Portsmouth Shipyard in order to carry out classified refits on the Battleships Essex and Sommerset. Upon the completion of final refits in early 835 AS, the Hashi Maru followed the Dreadnought Somerset to the Dublin Staging Area, where it has been granted special dispensation to observe. The Hashi Maru was accompanied by a Kusari Office of Intelligence escort, who have continued to provide a local security.

33744.text:
CLASS: Invincible
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Somerset is the product of the Warwick Dreadnought program, which aimed to create a class capable of tackling Gallic Valors head-on. Ultimately, the Somerset was not completed until 827 AS, too late for the war it was designed for. The Somerset was eventually deployed to New London orbit to provide symbolic reassurance to the traumatized population, allowing more battle-tested garrison vessels to be released for the Invasion of Edinburgh.

Despite glossy Bretonian propaganda, the reality is that the prototype dreadnought was plagued by technical errors, cost overruns and performance concerns. These technical issues persisted through a major overhaul in 830 AS, leading Armed Forces engineers derisively referring to the ship as “Some Resets” due to frequent electrical failures. The Admiralty remains adamant that the dreadnought is performing adequately regardless.

In 834 AS, the vessel was recalled to Portsmouth Shipyard alongside the Battleship Essex, receiving classified refits overseen by specialist Kusari contractors. The Somerset's overhaul took considerably longer to complete than the Essex's, with military sources adamant that all teething issues have now been worked out.

33746.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are inconsistent with typical ranges associated with Jump Holes -- this tear in space appears to occupy the position of the Alien Jump Gate and Power Cell that triggered the Omega-58 calamity. The anomaly is now blasted by the concentrated energy of the system pulsar.

33747.text: A dormant Alien Jump Gate, being drained of power by collectors anchored to Kaarst Shipyard. It is believed that these Alien Gates were originally powered by the Daam-K'Vosh energy field that blankets all of Sirius. During their extended imprisonment in Omega-58, local Wild forces appear to have intentionally sabotaged these gates to sever their connection to this field. Instead, they have been modified to create a localized system power buffer, allowing energy fed into one gate to be extracted from another.

33756.text: This Liberty Separatist heavy fighter was lost in combat against the Liberty Navy during the Scouring of Bering. Heavy damage and a missing transponder makes it impossible to tell who the pilot of this vessel was or when precisely they were lost.

33758.text: This Hellfire Legion "Inquisitor" Gunboat was lost in combat against the Liberty Navy during the Scouring of Bering. Heavy damage and a missing transponder make it difficult to identify the original designation of this vessel. The wreck has already been scavenged of all sensitive components.

33759.text: This Liberty Separatist "Defiant" Gunboat was lost in combat against the Liberty Navy during the Scouring of Bering. Heavy damage and a missing transponder make it difficult to identify the original designation of this vessel. The wreck has already been scavenged of all sensitive components.

33762.text: This Liberty Separatist "Interdictor" Battlecruiser was lost in combat against the Liberty Navy during the Scouring of Bering. Heavy damage and a missing transponder make it difficult to identify the original designation of this vessel. The wreck has already been scavenged of all sensitive components.
