Heavy damage and a missing transponder make it difficult to identify the original designation of this vessel. The wreck has already been scavenged of all sensitive components.

33766.text: This Hellfire Legion "Judicator" Cruiser was lost in combat against the Liberty Navy during the Scouring of Bering. Heavy damage and a missing transponder make it difficult to identify the original designation of this vessel. The wreck has already been scavenged of all sensitive components.

33769.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

The Norton Debris Field initially developed during the Hudson War as a result of battles fought between the Liberty Navy and Rheinland Military around the Hamburg Jump Gate. When the Jump Gate was sabotaged in 819 AS, several Liberty battlegroups were destroyed, greatly contributing to the wreckage. The Liberty Separatists later established their headquarters using the dangerous field as cover, although this did not save them from the Scouring of Bering in 827 AS. Since then, Bristol Construction and Manufacturing have begun salvaging the field, under a contract issued by the Liberty government.

33771.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

The Anadyr Debris Field is the result of battles fought between the Liberty Navy and Rheinland Military during the Hudson War. Leaking reactor cores posed a severe challenge to salvage efforts, with works only recently being initiated by Bristol Construction and Manufacturing under a contract issued by the Liberty and Rheinland governments.

33773.text:
During the Hudson War, Liberty quickly gained the upper hand in battles across the Independent Worlds. By 819 AS, the situation had become untenable for Rheinland, with the Rheinland Military contemplating a fighting retreat to Hamburg. Regardless, Rheinland remained unwilling to capitulate -- they instead hoped to freeze the conflict as a negotiating tactic, knowing Liberty needed to redeploy forces to the far more pressing Gallic Invasion of Bretonia.

Liberty instead formulated a plan for an invasion of Hamburg, to deliver a "knock-out blow" that could end the war immediately. After the MND intercepted communications revealing this plan, Rheinland's government was thrown into a panic and began to draw up desperate contingency plans. As Liberty's expeditionary force attempted to jump through, Rheinland detonated charges on the Gate, annihilating the Carriers Roanoke and Weatherlight in the resulting calamity.

The delicate work to make the gate safe was severely impeded by ongoing Rheinland raids. In 822 AS, the safeguards suppressing several of the damaged components failed with Ageira warning they could collapse into a singularity. This spurred on a ceasefire that later resulted in the war's end through the Treaty of Atka. By 823 AS, Ageira and Deep Space Engineering had resolved the crisis and stripped all internal components from the superstructure. The Gate's broken hull was left abandoned in place.

33774.text:
CLASS: Altenburg
CREW: 0
ARMAMENT: N/A

The Battleship Westphalia was deployed in 817 AS as the Rheinland Military urgently expanded due to escalating tensions with Liberty. When a state of war was formally declared, the Westphalia and its newly constituted fleet were dispatched to Bering alongside the Battleship Westfalen. Due to severe shortages of experienced personnel, the Westphalia was primarily crewed by reservists who had been called up for wartime service. Despite this, the Westphalia performed surprisingly well, owing to many of these reservists having served during the Colony Wars, and previously fought the Liberty Navy in Bering.

Rheinland quickly found the strategic picture in Bering turning against them. After almost a year of intense fighting across the Tanner Asteroid Field, the Westphalia was pinned in an engagement with the Battleship Alma and the newly deployed Carrier Roanoke. Unable to escape the Roanoke’s squadrons, the Westphalia was overwhelmed and crippled by repeated bomber strikes. At the time, the Westphalia’s destruction represented the single greatest loss of life the Rheinland Military had suffered since the Colony Wars.

33776.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

This minefield was deployed by the Rheinland Military early in the Hudson War, in an attempt to ambush the numerically superior battlegroups of the Liberty Navy. The concealed mines scattered among the asteroids poses a serious navigational hazard to this day.

33778.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

This minefield was deployed by the Liberty Navy early in the Hudson War, in an attempt to secure one flank against the Rheinland Military's attacks on the Texas Jump Gate. The concealed mines scattered among the asteroids poses a serious navigational hazard to this day.

33780.text: Bristol Constructions and Manufacturing are currently carrying out salvage and recovery operations across Bering. The proximity to the nearby Alster Shipyards have made refitted Kaiser Mining Ships an ideal choice for the young company. After crews have swept the target hulk for bodies, the Kaisers begin shredding the hull and extracting any valuable components.

33782.text: The Liberty cruiser Aroostook was lost to concealed mines while advancing on Rheinland positions during the Hudson War. Rheinland Military bombers finished off the crippled vessel, with all hands lost. The hulk remains undisturbed due to its hazardous location.

33784.text: The remains of an asteroid miner that was destroyed after Omega-11 was temporarily abandoned in 822 AS. Due to the sudden increase in solar activity and the ferocity of these solar storms, Daumann was forced to leave behind much of its local mining machinery.

33786.text: This fighter belonged to the Rheinland Military commander and ace, Lara Wefel. Wefel is currently listed as missing in action, after she led the 4th Strike Flotilla on an assault into the Giftnebel in 832 AS. Wefel’s squadrons successfully crippled the infamous Hessian Fichtel Brigade before being forced to retreat. The Greifvogel was last seen fighting in the flotilla rearguard. Due to the Giftnebel’s corrosive conditions, escape pods are rarely successfully recovered.

33788.text: This fighter belonged to the Red Hessian brigade commander and ace, Franz Steiner. Steiner is currently listed as missing in action, after he led Vogtland’s Fichtel Brigade to repulse the Rheinland Military’s attack on the Giftnebel in 832 AS. The brigade took heavy losses during the initial battles, but succeeded in forcing the Military squadrons back. Due to the Giftnebel’s corrosive conditions, escape pods are rarely successfully recovered.

33789.text: This Rheinland fighter was a member of the 4th Strike Flotilla. This force carried out a reconnaissance in force of the Giftnebel in an attempt to locate the Red Hessians' headquarters. After suffering heavy casualties, the flotilla was forced to retreat.

33791.text: This debris field was created as a result of Rheinland’s invasion of Dresden in 832 AS. The Rheinland Military 4th Strike Flotilla carried out a reconnaissance-in-force of the Giftnebel to locate the Red Hessians’ headquarters and draw reinforcements away from the Battleship Strausberg’s attack to the south. The Flotilla was forced to turn back after suffering heavy casualties, leaving the Hessians badly bloodied in the process.

33792.text: This Red Hessian fighter was a member of the Fichtel Brigade. Composed mainly of recruits being trained for operations in Omega-5, the force was nearly wiped out in 832 AS while repelling an attack by the Rheinland Military's 4th Strike Flotilla.

33793.text: This Asteroid Miner was scuttled by Daumann when they withdrew from Dresden in 818 AS. It has been stripped of any useful remaining components.

33794.text: This Asteroid Miner was scuttled by Kruger when they withdrew from Dresden in 824 AS. It has been stripped of any useful remaining components.

33795.text: This Asteroid Miner was used by the Red Hessians to wring the last remaining resources from Dresden. It was likely destroyed in 832 AS by either the Rheinland Military or Corsairs.

33797.text:
Zwickau Depot was hastily constructed in 821 AS to provide a staging ground for attacks on the supply corridor between the New Berlin Jump Gate and Bautzen Station. It was then hoped that if operations became expensive enough, Rheinland would cut its losses and withdraw from the system. Zwickau also acted as a warehouse for surplus goods mined by the Red Hessians, which would be laundered by the Bundschuh to neutral contacts in the Sigmas. This arrangement raised revenue for both movements, and provided the Red Hessians with a more convenient source of H-Fuel than they were accustomed to.

In 824 AS, Corsair raiders from Frankfurt located the depot. Enraged by the Bundschuh’s participation in the Siege of Saalburg, they targeted Zwickau in retaliation. During the battle, the station exploded after a salvo of torpedoes struck a full fuel silo. The benefits of Zwickau provided the Red Hessians is likely why they allowed the Bundschuh to retain control of Bautzen Station when Kruger retreated later that year. In an ironic twist of fate, the Corsair Battlecruiser Penitence later took up position near the wreck in 834 AS, seeing it as a defensible location to fend off Red Hessian attacks.

33800.text: This Bundschuh fighter was a member of the Zwickau Cell. Many Bundschuh members were killed during a surprise Corsair raid on their home base in 824 AS, with the station exploding to a torpedo strike before Red Hessian reinforcements could arrive to assist.

33802.text: Corsairs began their attack on Dresden shortly after the Rheinland Battleship Strausberg's destruction in 832 AS. Their fighters have primarily focused on destroying Red Hessian supply ships and economic operations, however heavy fighting has seen many Corsairs killed.

33803.text: This Bundschuh fighter was a member of the Bautzen Cell. Many Bundschuh members were killed during the Rheinland Military invasion of 832 AS, after the Battleship Strausberg opened fire on Bautzen Station without provocation.

33805.text: This debris field was created as a result of Rheinland’s invasion of Dresden in 832 AS. The Battleship Strausberg attacked Bautzen without warning, butchering the Bundschuh crew. Broken ships and mangled station components now drift across this junction.

33807.text: This debris field was created as a result of a Corsair attack on Zwickau Depot in 824 AS. Broken ships and mangled station components now drift across the clearing.

33809.text: This Grendel frigate was spotted by Order forces as it accompanied a Wild convoy through Omicron Zeta. While the convoy was ultimately destroyed in the resulting firefight, the Cocytus appears to have slipped away in the confusion. The Order believe the vessels were carrying sensitive hybridized equipment, blending human and Nomad technologies. It is currently unclear what the objective of this convoy was, although the Order fears the Cocytus' escape may have dire consequences.

33811.text:
CLASS: Bismarck Unknown Modification
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Battleship Verthandi was constructed in 797 AS and formed an element of Rheinland’s Northern Fleet. The ship participated in Rheinland’s invasion of Kusari during the Colony Wars, culminating in the destruction of the KNF in New Tokyo. The Northern Fleet abruptly withdrew following the disappearance of Chancellor Niemann, and vanished into the Sigmas. The entire fleet is officially recorded as having deserted after refusing to acknowledge the orders of the emergency Rheinland Provisional Government.

The Wild of Kaarst Drydock intensified their activity to restore the heavily damaged battleship, and in 836 AS their labor finally bore fruit. The Battleship Verthandi is now in the final phase of fitting out. Wreathed in strange and alien weaponry and armor, the once-dead ship will soon be ready for her second maiden voyage.

33813.text: This Grendel frigate was spotted by Order forces as it accompanied a Wild convoy through Omicron Zeta. The Acheron was ultimately destroyed with the convoy in the resulting firefight. The Order believe the vessels were carrying sensitive hybridized equipment, blending human and Nomad technologies. It is currently unclear what the objective of this convoy was, as the cargo has been thoroughly ruined by the destruction.

33815.text: This Grendel frigate was spotted by Order forces as it accompanied a Wild convoy through Omicron Zeta. The Styx was ultimately destroyed with the convoy in the resulting firefight. The Order believe the vessels were carrying sensitive hybridized equipment, blending human and Nomad technologies. It is currently unclear what the objective of this convoy was, as the cargo has been thoroughly ruined by the destruction.

33817.text: This Grendel frigate was spotted by Order forces as it accompanied a Wild convoy through Omicron Zeta. The Lethe was ultimately destroyed with the convoy in the resulting firefight. The Order believe the vessels were carrying sensitive hybridized equipment, blending human and Nomad technologies. It is currently unclear what the objective of this convoy was, as the cargo has been thoroughly ruined by the destruction.

33819.text:
This hull profile closely matches the armored liner Mindelo, which vanished in Omicron Delta in 819 AS. It was produced at Livida Shipyard three years earlier for a consortium of Gran Canarian speculators, who invested their full net worth into the project. The Mindelo and its sister-ship Praia were configured as a mobile base for short-ranged mining fighters. The vessel’s extraordinary cost was a gamble on quickly securing and exploiting recently discovered Iridium deposits in Omicron Delta.

While the Mindelo did initially provide stunning returns, it was not to last. Resupply freighters dreaded runs to the remote carrier, after the crew gained a reputation for paranoia, short tempers and strange behavior. When the Carrier abruptly vanished, it issued no distress call and no debris or signs of combat were ever located. The Mindelo became little more than a ghost story aboard Freeport 11, used as a cautionary tale to scare recent arrivals. The owning consortium collapsed soon after the disappearance, crushed by their gamble’s debts.

Now sporting the transponder Tinsdal, the Bustard was next sighted at the head of a convoy of Wild ships in 834 AS. The Order believes the vessels were carrying sensitive Hybrid Equipment, blending human and Nomad technologies. It is currently unclear what the objective of this convoy was, although it’s possible the carrier’s heavy plating may have protected some of its cargo from destruction. Fierce fighting has already erupted between the Core, Order and Wild to secure the contents.

33820.text:
This Gaian Corvo scout ship has recently arrived from Dublin, where it was seemingly drawn to the bizarre phenomena developing around the destroyed New London Jump Gate. While it is unclear what the Gaians' interest there was, several Cambridge physics papers were published on the anomaly, analyzing suspiciously clear sensor readings.

The Rathlin's retreat was prompted by the Bretonian invasion of Dublin -- having captured unexpected sensor readings of the Battleship Somerset's Jump Drive in action, the Rathlin then slunk away through the Achill Minefield during a lull in the fighting.

33822.text:
The 5th Cruiser Flotilla consists of several Destroyer Squadrons that served under the Battlecruiser Adlington. The "Unfortunate 5th" suffered grievous casualties during the Gallic War -- they were decimated fighting a valiant rearguard action during the retreat from Leeds, and again during a heroic last stand at the Battle of Trafalgar. Each time the 5th was reformed by amalgamating survivors from other heavily depleted Flotillas.

The 5th was scheduled for modernization in 834 AS, however they were instead pushed into service for the Invasion of Dublin with a complement of aging Crecy hulls. When the Invasion finally occurred in 835 AS, the 5th led an assault towards the Founders Gold Field. They were the first Bretonian unit to encounter Molly fire ships, with the Battlecruiser Adlington destroyed in the encounter.

After an extensive period of repairs, the operational ships of the 5th were reinforced with a gunboat escort and ordered back into the fires of Dublin. Having weathered the initial storm, the Unfortunate 5th seeks to reclaim it's reputation and leads the assault against Founders Gold Field.

33824.text:
The 1st Cruiser Flotilla consists of several Destroyer Squadrons serving under the Battlecruiser Bracknell. The "Furious 1st" were among the most decorated formations of the Gallic War -- notable deployments included the Battle of Stokes, the Manchester Campaign, the Siege of New London and the Liberation of Leeds. Reassignment to the 1st is seen as a prestigious and career-enhancing posting by many Armed Forces officers.

The 1st are Bretonia's most modern formation, boasting a full complement of newly produced or refitted Agincourt destroyers. When the Invasion of Dublin finally occurred in 835 AS, the 1st were the lead element through the Essex's Drive Breach, securing the bridgehead for the Somerset's arrival. Resistance was first encountered during an attack towards the Achill Asteroid Field, where the Battlecruiser Bracknell was immobilized by a Molly suicide fire ship.

Despite suffering moderate casualties, the 1st scattered the Molly counter-attack to allow Royal Engineers to tow the Bracknell back to the Somerset bridgehead. The flotilla is now maintaining perimeter defense while the Bracknell is evaluated for the feasibility of patch repair and evacuation.

33927.text:
CLASS: Castle
AMENITIES: Full
CREW: 430

The Kildonan was originally an elite passenger liner that operated between Planet Leeds and New London, primarily carrying BMM executives and aristocrats. In 816 AS, she was pressed into service as an Armed Forces hospital ship for the front line triage of injured pilots and Marines. It continued in this role throughout the Gallic War, seeing deployments in Leeds, Newcastle and New London.

Following the war, the Bretonian government retained possession of the liner; the previous commercial operator had dissolved, with its beneficiaries being recorded as dead or missing on Planet Leeds. The Kildonan has been attached to the task-force during the Invasion of Dublin, indicating that the Armed Forces expect the fighting to be both bloody and protracted.

33931.text:
This formerly BMM-owned Hegemon Asteroid Miner was recorded as lost during the fall of Graves Station and resulting secession of Dublin. The Mollys have since repurposed many of these ships for their own ends. The mining ships Hope and Fortune were withdrawn to Arranmore Base in 834 AS amid fears of an imminent Bretonian invasion of Dublin. The pair were then worked on as an "insurance policy" by Mull Base's Hellburner Squadron, and converted into enormous armored bombs.

When Bretonia eventually attacked in 835 AS, the Fortune was dispatched towards the Bretonian offensive aiming for the Founders Gold Field. Concealed among a screen of fellow Asteroid Miners, the Fortune closed within range of the Bretonian Battlecruiser Adlington before detonating. Rigged as a fire ship, the Fortune's explosion destroyed the battlecruiser and threw the Bretonian advance into disarray. The crew launched the Miner's command module shortly before, and were rescued by Molly forces the following day.

33934.text:
Otherwise known as the "International Brigade", the Powrie formation is comprised of an assorted mix of forces who threw in their lot with the Molly cause, ahead of the Bretonian invasion of Dublin. Many of the units are allied auxiliaries or mercenaries, coordinated by local Molly leaders. Notable contributors include The Coalition, Militant factions from Gran Canaria who fear a resurgent Bretonia on their border, and even pirate mercenaries hired with Molly Gold through a deal brokered with the Ithaca Council.

In 835 AS, Bretonia launched its assault into the system. The Powrie Brigade were pushed forward to block the Bretonian advance towards the Founders Gold Field, buying time for the fire ship Fortune to close distance with the Battlecruiser Adlington. With the destruction of the Adlington, Powrie Brigade retreated, having suffered extreme casualties in the battle. Despite Coalition promises, reinforcements have been slow to arrive due to escalating situations in the Omegas. The Mollys have been forced to fill gaps with their own reserves.

Reinforced by a hastily repaired vessel, the Powrie Brigade has moved into position to counter the 5th Royal Cruiser Flotilla as they move to take control of Founders Field.

33936.text: The Slaugh Brigade is a recently assembled Molly formation, created following the liberation of Dublin. The group consists of the former garrison of Garvagh Station, and squadrons stripped from Molly bases across Bretonia. The Slaugh are responsible for countering local Corsair attacks and carrying out blockade-breaking operations to protect the smugglers that exchange Molly Gold for critical supplies. In 834 AS, the Brigade was placed under the command of the Destroyer Shillelagh and withdrawn to Arranmore for reinforcement, bracing for an imminent Bretonian invasion.

33937.text: This supply depot has been hastily assembled to receive supplies ahead of an anticipated Bretonian invasion of Dublin. The fixture is primarily used to receive Molly, Coalition, Red Hessian and Zoner transports through the newly discovered Omega passage. Regrettably, many ships have been lost attempting this crossing, as the Jump Hole is highly unstable.

33938.text: This supply depot has been hastily assembled to receive supplies ahead of an anticipated Bretonian invasion of Dublin. This fixture is primarily used to receive Molly, freelance and Junker transports running the Dublin Blockade from New London. Regrettably, many ships have been lost attempting this crossing, as Bretonian and Corsair patrols continue to tighten the noose.

33940.text: The Hellburners are a Molly support squadron from Mull. Due to the nature of their projects, they are forced to work in exclusion zones outside Molly installations. They have recently been assigned to Arranmore Base to assist with preparing defenses against an anticipated Bretonian invasion.

33941.text:
The Slaugh Brigade is a Molly formation, created following the liberation of Dublin. The group consists of the former garrison of Garvagh Station, and squadrons stripped from Molly bases across Bretonia. The Slaugh were responsible for countering local Corsair attacks and carrying out blockade-breaking operations to protect the smugglers that exchange Molly Gold for critical supplies. When Bretonia's invasion arrived in 835 AS, the Brigade launched a counter-assault towards the Achill Asteroid Field, under the command of the Destroyer Shillelagh.

Discovering the Bretonians had bypassed the Achill minefields, the Brigade engaged the First Royal Cruiser Flotilla, buying time for the arrival of Hegemon fire ships. The detonation of the Hegemon Hope inflicted heavy Bretonian casualties, preventing them from achieving their objective of cutting Molly supply lines. The Slaugh Brigade suffered heavy casualties in the battles, being forced to fight in open space. They are now reconstituting their strength near the Arranmore Asteroid Field, and preparing to react to further Bretonian offensives.

33942.text: Serial codes indicate that this Transport was originally assigned to BMM's Graves logistics fleet. Since reflagged as a Molly smuggler, the ship was destroyed in 834 AS. It is unclear whether it was intercepted by Corsairs or Bretonian blockade patrols. The Needle is believed to have been carrying Gold.

33944.text: The Temerarious was a BMM wildcat miner, tasked with sneaking into Dublin and extracting as much Gold as possible. The Clydesdale is believed to have filled its hold with Gold Ore before being detected by Mollys and fleeing back to New London. It met its end in Cumbria's gas pockets before Bretonian blockade forces could arrive to provide relief.

33945.text: This Bretonian Fighter was lost while attempting to enforce Bretonia's blockade on Dublin. It may have been destroyed by Corsair or Molly patrols.

33947.text: This Molly Fighter was lost in combat while attempting to breach the blockade on Dublin. It may have been destroyed by Bretonian or Corsair patrols.

33949.text: This Molly smuggler was lost while breaching the Dublin blockade. After evading Bretonian interceptors, the Firebrand's wing were intercepted by Corsair pirates. The attackers were all destroyed, but not before the freighter was crippled. It is believed Gold may still be aboard.

33950.text: This Corsair Fighter was lost in combat in New London, likely in relation to the ongoing fighting in Dublin. It may have been destroyed by Bretonian or Molly patrols.

33952.text: This Corsair armored transport was lost in the Southampton Debris Field in 833 AS. It is believed the Cueto was meeting a Junker contact to fence stolen Gold in exchange for supplies, when the group was ambushed and massacred by Molly fighters.

33954.text: The Junker freighter Pleonexia vanished in 833 AS, apparently gunned down by Mollys while bartering with Corsair Gold raiders. The wreck may still contain a salvageable cargo of Engine Components.

33956.text: The area between the Cumbria Asteroid Field and Southampton Debris Field is locally known as the Glenridding Gap. In recent years it has become a deadly flare-point for violence between Bretonian authorities and those attempting to breach the Dublin blockade.

33958.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<

Sometimes known as the "Graveyard of the Gallic Empire", Romsey is the result of almost a decade of work to make New London safe for navigation. As an imperfect solution, many of the most hazardous and radioactive wrecks were shunted to the Southampton Debris Field and dumped, pending berth space at the Belvedere breakers yards. Severe strain on Bretonian manpower means the hazardous zone is only sporadically patrolled -- Junker scavengers regularly pick through the remains.

33959.text: Operating from Belvedere Refinery, ALG has worked since 827 AS to clear battle debris around New London. Much of this operation initially involved corralling the hazardous debris littering Planet New London's orbit, with the largest and most intact wrecks being shunted into the Southampton Debris Field. In the years since, ALG has focused on breaking down the remaining scrap in the Murton Debris Field for resmelting at Belvedere, with completion expected by 839 AS.

33961.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATION HAZARD<<<

The Murton Debris Field is the grisly aftermath of the Gallic War's Siege of New London, widely believed to be the largest space battle in Sirian history. While the combined fleets of Bretonia and Liberty ultimately defeated the Gallic invasion, countless thousands were killed and New London itself subject to devastating orbital bombardment. ALG was contracted soon after the war to assist BMM with making the capital's orbit safe. Many wrecks were shunted to the Southampton Debris Field. ALG is contracted to break down Murton's scrap for shipment to Belvedere for resmelting. It estimates the debris will be substantially cleared by 839 AS.

33963.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATION HAZARD<<<

During the Gallic War, Kensington and Canterbury were frequent targets of the "Southampton Trinité" as a part of Gallia's "Starvation Strategy". Much of the Hounslow Debris Field was created during the Battle of Dover, in which the Gallic Battleship Beuvray suffered a massive reactor meltdown and exploded. Gateway and ALG have repeatedly petitioned for more funding to clear Hounslow, however the government has remained adamant that limited resources must prioritize the Murton Field. Official activity is limited to keeping the Trade Lanes clear, however Gaians frequently use the field as cover for their raids on Canterbury.

33965.text:
CLASS: Obstinate
CREW: N/A
ARMAMENT: N/A

The Vénissieux was a battlecruiser escort attached to the Beuvray fleet. In 825 AS, it participated in the New London Blitz, as the Gallic Royal Navy stormed the system from the Leeds Jump Hole. It later fought in the Battle of Dover, screening the Beuvray from the Gettysburg and MacDuff's own escort ships. Following the Beuvray's loss, the fleet was thrown into disarray.

Damaged and taking fire from the Battlecruisers Adlington and Bracknell, the Gallic capital ship fled into the Devon Asteroid Field. The ship never re-emerged, and was listed as missing in action. Examination of the wreck's hull damage indicates that the vessel may have been brought down by Gaian bombers after it became mired in an explosive gas pocket.

33967.text:
CLASS: Obstinate
CREW: N/A
ARMAMENT: N/A

The Vénissieux was a battlecruiser escort attached to the Beuvray fleet. In 825 AS, it participated in the New London Blitz, as the Gallic Royal Navy stormed the system from the Leeds Jump Hole. It later fought in the Battle of Dover, screening the Beuvray from the Ottawa and MacDuff's own escort ships. Following the Beuvray's loss, the fleet was thrown into disarray.

Damaged and taking fire from the London Interdictor Adlington, the Gallic capital ship fled into the Devon Asteroid Field. The ship never re-emerged, and was later listed as missing in action. Examination of the wreck's hull reveals damage patterns consistent with Gaian weapons, indicating it may have been brought down by bombers after it became lost in an explosive gas pocket.

33974.text: When Graves Station was destroyed and the Battleship Essex retreated, many BMM crews were left behind in their mining ships. Most of these crews later surrendered their equipment, willingly or otherwise. Barring some instances of sabotage or retrofits for other purposes, the Mollys have returned many of these ships to their work, bolstering their Gold production capacity.

33976.text: This asteroid miner was captured by the Mollys in 831 AS after the stranded BMM crew surrendered. Fearing an inevitable Bretonian counterattack, the Mollys executed several plans to fortify the system, including mining the Achill Asteroid Field with improvised bombs. The Mianadóir was destroyed by Corsairs in 834 AS while carrying out this work.

33978.text: The Ballycorus was a BMM asteroid miner that was marooned in Dublin when Bretonia withdrew from the system. Many mining ships quickly surrendered to the Mollys, however the crew of the Ballycorus refused and retreated deeper into the Gold field. After an extended standoff, the Mollys attempted to board the ship to prevent the crew from sabotaging it. After three attempts were repulsed, the ship was written off as a loss and destroyed.

33979.text:
CLASS: Wellesley
GRAVITY: No
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 0

Station Glorious was once a Bretonia Mining & Manufacturing outpost, seized by dissident miners during the Founders Day Revolt of 752 AS. A furious Armed Forces response followed, as Bretonian destroyers pursued the newly formed Mollys into what would later become known as the Hood Asteroid Field. In the Mollys' first major victory, the Destroyer Longfield was blown in half by a mining charge, establishing the movement as a credible threat. The Glorious was quickly abandoned by the Mollys in favor of more permanent arrangements elsewhere, however squatters took residence soon after.

The station changed hands several times over the decades, rotating between independent gangs and wildcat miners who later repressurized The Hood under the flag of the Independent Miners Guild. The Glorious came under attack by Rheinland raiders in 800 AS, during the chaos and confusion of the Colony Wars. Gutted by fire and explosions, the facility remained an abandoned husk until 831 AS. Since then, Corsairs have taken up position nearby and begun using the station's broken shell as a sheltered stockpile for imported supplies and stolen cargo.

33980.text: This Corsair Fighter was lost in combat in Dublin, likely at the hands of Molly patrols or their allies.

33981.text: This Molly Fighter was lost in combat in Dublin, likely at the hands of Corsair patrols.

33984.text: This piece of equipment appears to be part of a Hegemon air filtration unit. It seems to have been cut from its parent vessel and abandoned in the Arranmore Asteroid Field. It is stamped with the serial code GS&M340/A2.

33986.text:
This filter component bears tell-tale laser scorching patterns that likely indicate intentional damage by a handheld cutting tool. This damage would have caused the associated life support equipment to stop functioning effectively. It is stamped with the serial code GS&M340/A2.

Properties
Base Price: $10000
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 10

33988.text:
This memorial was constructed by the Mollys soon after the withdrawal of the Battleship Essex from Dublin. It is intended to commemorate all those who fought and died to secure Dublin's independence, as well as the countless miners killed through BMM's callousness and negligence.

The Graves miners' revolt of 831 AS is widely believed to have been caused by the death of the crew of the mining ship Glyndwr. Outrage at the apparent maintenance failure of its air filters was the final straw for many workers who were already furious about poor working conditions and unreasonable quotas.

Purportedly as a mark of respect to the crew, the Mollys disassembled the Glyndwr to create this monument, rather than pressing it back into service.

33990.text: The Rojo was a Coalition military fighter piloted by Commander Juan Costello. Costello was known for their brash flight style, often choosing to carry out scouting missions alone in the hope of catching enemies unaware. This approach seems to have fatally backfired, likely after encountering a wing of Bounty Hunters.

33991.text:
PASSENGERS (OMEGAS)

Passengers are civilians who have the money and courage for interstellar travels. These passengers departed from the Omega cluster to explore, travel back to the Houses, or attend vacation destinations. Groups of passengers are transported in bulky, modular Passenger Cabins containing accommodation and services.

33993.text:
CRIMINALS (RHEINLAND)

Rheinland's serious criminals are typically pressed into service in the mines of Sigma-15's Hammersee. Despite this, the RFP has made arrangements for the transfer abroad of particularly sensitive "politicals" who cannot be allowed to mix with the general prison population. Groups of Criminals are transported in bulky, modular cells containing security staff and isolation units.

Passengers are civilians who have the money and courage for interstellar travels. These passengers departed from the Omicron cluster to return from exploration or scientific pursuits, travel back to the Houses, or attend vacation destinations. Groups of passengers are transported in bulky, modular Passenger Cabins containing accommodation and services.

33996.mapped:
Construction on Hinsdale Refinery began in 834 AS. The facility provides Deep Space Engineering (DSE) with bulk Platinum refining capabilities, after substantial deposits were discovered in Galileo. These deposits were for years the subject of fierce legal battles between DSE, Kishiro and Samura who all claimed exclusive extraction rights.

Despite Liberty and Kusari courts separately banning exploitation while proceedings were ongoing, Hinsdale was commissioned with Liberty government funding. This was spurred by fears Kusari was sponsoring its own corporations to undermine the courts, by developing refinery capabilities at Fuchu Prison. As a result, Hinsdale also began to violate the court's orders, with DSE committing to retaliatory mining operations to assert its own rights in Galileo.

By 835 AS, Hisdale had been completed, with Manhattan's Supreme Court upholding DSE's exclusive extraction rights. Accordingly, the court issued an order for Kishiro, Samura and all other parties to vacate their claims. Liberty has since threatened to deploy the Navy to enforce the order, despite Kusari's courts refusing to recognize the ruling as legitimate.

34006.text: Cryer Pharmaceuticals has established its own mooring facility in orbit of Planet Harris, allowing them to segregate sensitive cargoes from other local traffic. Individuals looking to visit the Clisham Research Complex are instructed to wait at either Lewes or the mooring fixture, and await a Cryer-provided shuttle for transfer.

34013.text: All entities are to be stopped and challenged for identification. Upon identification, compliance droids will cross-reference entity authorization status with facility records. Unauthorized trespass is a capital offense. Compliance droids are empowered to wield lethal force on behalf of Cryer Pharmaceuticals through the Clisham Transfer Treaty of 834 AS.

34014.text: Criminal trespass may occur if an unauthorized entity infringes the 500 kilometer exclusion zone surrounding this facility. Unauthorized trespass is a capital offense. Compliance droids and the facility defense grid are empowered to wield lethal force on behalf of Cryer Pharmaceuticals through the Clisham Transfer Treaty of 834 AS.

34015.text: Compliance droids are a reliable and effective product of the Detroit Munitions corporation, a subsidiary of Ageira Technologies. To obtain the best results from your equipment, compliance droids should be paired with Deathware branded Light Arms. Detroit Needler Rifle injuries are rated as fatal 8 times out of 10 against unarmored targets.

34017.text: Liberty brokered the deal between Cryer and Bretonia. The land this facility is located on is exempt from Bretonian law: Cryer is the first and final authority here. Naturally, we had the best interests of our corporations in mind when arranging this. A proxy port in the Taus is also of critical interest to the LSF in this... trying time.

34018.text: The growing relationship between Bretonia and Kusari is a massive area of concern. We now know that Kusari has been using Bretonia as a guinea pig of sorts, to field trial highly illegal Jump Drives that were developed in breach of the Denver Convention. Bretonia has accrued a deep debt to Kusari, and Kusari is using that as a wedge to separate Bretonia from Liberty.

34019.text: One of the LSF’s Tau Station briefs is monitoring and curtailing the activities of the Outcasts and the proliferation of Cardamine. For obvious reasons, this issue is of extreme concern to Liberty’s leaders. We have invested heavily in Cryer’s work here -- and previously in the Sigmas -- to break the Outcasts’ particular monopolies.

34020.text: Given the unpleasantness with Atka, Cryer takes security very seriously. I supervise the compliance droids we use to patrol the spaceport, as it’s too cold outside to be comfortable for human officers. The droids are simplistic things, and we give them simplistic orders: challenge anything that moves, and kill anything without authorization to be here.

34021.text: There are two halves to this facility: research and manufacturing. We’re dedicated wholly to the development and production of Stabiline at Clisham. I can’t say I know precisely what they’re doing in the research wing, but our security teams are permanently on standby to provide a rapid response to any “incidents” that may arise down there.

34022.text: Bounty Hunters are a dangerous and untrustworthy lot. Most of them were criminals, and they’re not necessarily the reformed sort either. Despite this, the researchers insist on welcoming these walking security threats into the heart of our facility. The insatiable requirement for new “samples” makes my work infinitely harder.

34024.text: Alien Organisms are a key input for the production of Stabiline. Many of these are bulk sourced from the GMG on Planet Kurile for Harris’ terraforming project. We purchase imported stocks directly from Planetform. In association with Cambridge Research Institute’s hot labs, we also sponsor Zoner expeditions in Omicron Theta to locate novel strains which may improve our own processes.

34025.text: Research on Alien Organisms and Cardamine was instrumental to the development of Stabiline. For decades, Cryer has known that the two were related, because they both affect RNA and DNA molecules in the same way. The more difficult aspect is understanding how to control or emulate these complex interactions with the human body. We have made many breakthroughs studying Outcast samples, but it is slow going work.

34026.text:
CLASS: Corbett
DOCKING: RESTRICTED
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: CLASSIFIED

>>>HIGH SECURITY<<<

Traffic bound to the facility is advised to wait at the Clisham Mooring Fixture. A Cryer Pharmaceuticals shuttle will transport authorized persons to the site and transfer relevant cargo.
34026.mapped:
Clisham Research Complex is a secretive Cryer Pharmaceuticals facility located in a decommissioned terraforming camp on the northern pole of Planet Harris. Following the destruction of Atka Research Station, Cryer’s work on Stabiline was badly impacted. As production ground to a halt, contingency plans were immediately put into action, with Cryer evaluating several potential sites for a replacement before settling on Harris.

In a deal brokered by Liberty, Bretonia granted Cryer full autonomy over the site in exchange for wartime debt restructuring and promises of lucrative tariff earnings. Cryer has exploited the existing infrastructure and geothermal vents at the site to quickly establish a Stabiline factory, and an underground quarantine lab to continue their most sensitive research. A regional defense grid was set up in consultation with the Liberty Security Force to deter intruders or attackers.

Cryer has entered into partnerships with several House police forces, accepting burdensome Cardamine-addicted inmates or incarcerated Outcasts for rehabilitation. Bounties on captured Outcasts in the Tau region have tripled since Cryer’s arrival on Harris, attracting a surge of interest from Guild Hunters. As with Atka, dark rumors surround Cryer’s work at Clisham, although the Houses have so far turned a blind eye to the disappearance of “undesirables” who are sent there.

34029.text: Holo-Billboards are widely used for advertising and informational purposes. A lack of moving parts and the onboard solar arrays make them highly resilient, requiring little maintenance.

34031.text: The Shizuoka Maru is an armored container transport chartered by Samura Heavy Industries. The transport routinely shuttles between New Tokyo and Lewes Shipping Platform, carrying construction goods and specialist contractors bound for their factory sites on Harris. The Shizuoka Maru typically returns to Kusari carrying Niobium or Bretonian goods stocked on Lewes by Gateway Shipping.

34033.text: The Berwyn is an armored container transport chartered by the Independent Miner's Guild. The transport primarily carries Niobium and Gallic trade goods from Tau-23 to Lewes Shipping Platform or Holman Outpost, where they can be distributed by Gateway Shipping. The Berwyn typically returns to Java with Mining Machinery and other essential supplies.

34035.text: The Plenitude is an armored transport chartered by Synth Foods. The transport routinely shuttles between Planet Los Angeles and Lewes Shipping Platform, carrying Biodome Materials and specialist contractors bound for their seed sites on Harris. The Plenitude typically returns to Liberty carrying Niobium or Kusari goods stocked on Lewes by Gateway Shipping.

34037.text:
The minefield around Planet Harris was first laid in 812 AS, in the prelude to the Tau War between Bretonia and Kusari. Bretonia deployed the concealed mines over fears of an attack by the Kusari forces massing in Tau-29. They were used to great effect early in the conflict to break up formations of Kusari capital ships for ambush.

While the Bretonian use of concealed mines was widely criticized abroad as a breach of the Boorman Treaty, they contributed greatly to Harris remaining in Bretonian hands throughout the Tau War, and for several years of the Gallic Invasion. As of 829 AS, efforts began to clear the minefield of unexploded ordnance, however this is extremely slow going and dangerous work.

34038.text: [831 AS] Notorious journalist found dead on Denver

34039.text: DENVER -- 831 -- Paparazzi photographer Zev Tronstad has been found dead, 50 miles west of Baker City. Police sources revealed that Tronstad had died from a single gunshot wound, which the force were not treating as suspicious. Hal Harper -- Tronstad’s partner and agent -- filed a public complaint with Baker’s LPI Consumer Relations Board in response, saying “Zev wouldn’t have done this to himself. He was working an angle on Syracuse. The LPI need to start asking questions up there.” Cryer Pharmaceuticals dismissed the claim, saying Mr Tronstad had never visited their station. “We always know who’s visiting and what they’re really here for,” a Syracuse security officer noted.

34041.text: The Ungyo is a heavily armed Hogosha Transport that frequently travels under heavy escort through the Taus, carrying valuable cargoes of Kusari-produced Engine Components and Optronics. It procures Wildcat Gold from the Gaians of Sandur Base, then shipping it to Kabukicho Depot where it can be laundered onto the open market for later purchase by Kusari's keiretsu.

34042.text: Before choosing Harris for this site, we also seriously considered Junyo and Denver. Harris offers regulatory freedoms due to the location, and access to existing Alien Organism supply lines from the terraforming effort. Counter-intuitively, the level of Outcast activity in Tau-31 was a benefit too. Liberty was also extremely eager to intercede on our behalf with the Bretonians. Despite that, Junyo certainly would have been... intriguing.

34500.text: This wreck does not conform to any known commercial ship design. The hull is pitted by light plasma scoring, however the engines and core appear to have been ruptured by heavy weapons impacts. Scans indicate that the vessel interior contains large quantities of organic material, most of which has perished. Looping broadcasts are timestamped to early 834 AS.

34944.text: Cardamine affects human beings in many ways. Aside from its narcotic powers, it also has anti-aging benefits. We initially attempted to develop a product that would increase the human lifespan two-fold. Stabiline regrettably fell short of that goal, but the ability to suppress Cardamine withdrawals is already a monumental breakthrough. When we do eventually replicate anti-aging properties too, Cryer will multiply its profits overnight.

34945.text: The Outcasts have been exposed to Cardamine for centuries -- they are the key to fully understanding how the drug affects human beings. Obtaining Outcast samples has cost us millions of credits over the decades. Shortly after this facility came online, we also had the good fortune of acquiring a small group of captives the Outcasts had apparently held on a secretive home planet somewhere in the Edge Nebula. They will be a most valuable cohort for interrogation and comparative study!

34946.text: Cardamine addiction is a miserable affair, and quite fatal if withdrawals are allowed to progress. Stabiline is a revolutionary product for that reason, breaking the death-grip criminal cartels had over many ensnared addicts. Despite this, our research is fantastically expensive, and users must adhere strictly to our prescription plan to avoid... detrimental consequences. Accordingly, we advertise exclusively to an elite clientele who can afford to consistently pay what the product is obviously worth.

34948.text: Cryer pays top rate for captured Outcasts that are brought in alive. Bag one of those, and you’re set to kick back on Baden Baden for two or three months. Outcasts don’t go down easy though -- usually we try to catch their smugglers on the way in from Tau-29, and hope like hell they aren’t running with an escort. There’s a lot of Hunters heading this way as word spreads of what Cryer’s offering.

34949.text: From the moment you come over the horizon, you’ve got missile batteries locked onto you. Once you’ve landed, you’re covered by gun turrets and armed droids. I can understand the caution after what happened to Atka, but seeing the interior defenses set up to keep things in always sends a shiver down my spine. Hand over the prisoners, have a drink to wash away the memories, and get out, says I.

34950.text: Where Cryer’s price on Outcasts is so high, it’s not really worth our while to chase around after Gaians and the other scum you’ll find in Tau-31. Of course, that means we’re not carrying out so much “population control”, and the Gaians now seem to be regularly making a nuisance of themselves around Harris. It would be a shame if Planetform were forced to raise their bounties to compete...

34953.text:
GALLIC ENFER BLASTERS

A long design tradition has favored the use of energetic handheld lasers by Gallic armies. Utilizing Prometheum energy cells and cryogenic cooling, a range of lethal pistols, rifles and anti-armor weapons have been developed. The domestic distribution of these "Inferno Blasters" is tightly controlled by the Gallic Union, who are fiercely opposed to the concept of an armed populace.

Properties
Base Price: $30
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

34955.text:
BLACK MARKET BLASTERS

Enfer Blasters are a highly sought after prize on the Gallic black markets, particularly among the Brigands and Maquis. While the Gallic Union tightly controls their production and distribution, corruption throughout the military procurement process ensures well-connected -- often ex-police -- Brigands have a steady supply for sale and their own nefarious purposes.

Properties
Base Price: $75
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

34957.text:
WILDCAT GOLD

Wildcat Gold informally refers to Gold mined in the Dublin system following the destruction of Graves Station. Primarily sourced from Mollys and Corsairs, Wildcat Gold lacks the radioisotopic labeling recently used by BMM to establish the provenance of "legitimate" stocks. This Gold is highly sought after in less scrupulous industrial centers, and in black markets across Sirius as an untraceable store of value.

Properties
Base Price: $46
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

34959.text:
SLOG

Otherwise known as Carix, Slog is a cheap and addictive narcotic that is widely consumed by laborers. Created from common industrial solvents and a currently unidentified neurotoxin, Slog inhalation numbs pain, while suppressing appetite and heightened emotional states. It is not uncommon to find entire factory floors vacantly "Slogging" through their shifts on Sprague, self-medicating for the back-breaking work. Slog was quickly outlawed due to its detrimental impact on crime, health, and worker productivity.

Properties
Base Price: $75
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

The Aonyobo Annex is a restricted area of the Heaven's Gate fortress that is accessible only to the elite "Chochinbi" Special Operations Division. The division's activities are fiercely guarded secrets, with the unit being answerable only to the Lord Commander of the Kusari Office of Intelligence, and the Emperor himself.
34961.mapped:
Heaven's Gate was once one of the wonders of Kusari - a massive space fortress built to shelter the Emperor, laden with enough defenses to render any assault pointless. Aside from being a massive bastion, the Arch also holds some of Kusari's finest artistic designs, including the "Waterfall of Light".

After the coup of 330 AS, Heaven's Gate fell out of favor. Samura felt the Emperor would be a stronger figurehead if he was visible, so the throne remained on New Tokyo. Unwilling to let this marvel of Kusari culture decay, the Arch was kept operational, serving as an archive for Kusari's most guarded secrets and precious treasures.

The base was subverted during the Colony Wars, when Governor Tekagi, having met with Rheinland officials, was dominated by the Nomads. Tekagi was able to indoctrinate the fortress' guards, until its full staff and garrison fleet were under Nomad control as Thralls. The Blood Dragons learned of this subversion through their contacts with the Order, and were able to penetrate the base once during the Nomad Wars, stealing an important Artifact at the cost of a small fleet of their ships.

The Nomad presence was never fully eradicated; Shogun Edo appointed surviving infectees to command the newly created Kusari Office of Intelligence in the aftermath of the war. The organization has grown substantially since then, siting its headquarters aboard Heaven's Gate. To this day, the Infiltrators sequestered inside Aonyobo Annex continue to lead and misdirect the organization purportedly formed to exterminate them.

34963.text:
CLASS: Bandai
DOCKING: RESTRICTED
AMENITIES: Complete
CREW: CLASSIFIED

>>>HIGH SECURITY<<<
34963.mapped:
Ichigaya was first constructed in 805 AS by the fledgling Kusari Office of Intelligence. Despite operating from the nearby Heaven’s Arch, it was deemed inappropriate to excavate Ichigaya into the iconic rock due to its historic and cultural significance. Additionally, Shogun Edo ordered that the drydock not be directly visible from The Arch, in order to conserve the site’s serene dignity for future generations. As a result, Ichigaya was hidden away within a nearby rock fragment.

Ichigaya was originally designed as a small outpost to securely house, reverse-engineer and manufacture Cloaking Devices salvaged from wrecks of Rheinland’s Northern Fleet during the Colony Wars. Since then, the facility has gradually expanded over time and widened its scope to the reverse engineering of salvaged or stolen technologies in general. As Kansai’s field trials conclude, Ichigaya has begun the work to refit its factories for the anticipated production of Jump Drives.

The Chochinbi Division’s interception of Artifacts and Xeno Relics in the Sigmas and Omicrons have also yielded a number of startling acquisitions. While the KOI remain tight-lipped about what they found, Ichigaya was quickly put to work under the close supervision of the Special Operations Division, producing unsettling replicas of alien structures. These new experiments are of extreme concern to the Blood Dragons and Order, who have intensified their raids on the area in response.

34970.text:
MILITARY SURPLUS

Bretonia amassed the largest terrestrial military force in Sirius during the Gallic War. Once the Armed Forces demobilized and conscripts were released, vast reserves of weaponry and armor were left to molder in stockpiles. Desperate to raise revenue and cut storage costs, Bretonia has begun to sell off huge quantities of Surplus to other Houses, corporations and private security forces. Despite attempts to control exports, corruption and overstretched security has led to a proliferation of Bretonian arms onto the black markets.

Properties
Base Price: $300
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 10

34973.text:
A squadron of 5 Gendarmerie border control cruisers were posted throughout Ile-de-France in 750 AGS (834 AS), following unrest on Planet Marne about the Treaty of Oerlikon. Operating checkpoints to monitor for subversive elements entering the capital, the cruisers also sent an unsubtle message to the Gallic colonies that the flow of essential goods could be halted at the Grand Marechal's leisure.

Later that year, the Maquis launched their largest offensive since the Gallic Union's creation, symbolically targeting the checkpoints. When the Gendarmerie cruisers were struck and destroyed, Union officials hastily towed the wreckage to Rambouillet Shipyard for disposal. "Sensitivity screens" were erected to block public view of the work.

Local Navy commanders have advised that the cruisers were stood down because the "threat of sedition had been quashed".

34983.text: The Kiritsu was a Farmers Alliance armored transport captained by Kenichiro Segumo. In late 834 AS, the vessel was used to imprison the LWB activist Sabine Schröder, after she murdered an FA technician on Darmstadt. This arrest was the straw that broke the camel's back, with LWB fighters intercepting and disabling the transport to rescue Schröder before she could be extradited for judgment by Kagoshima's elders. The wreck is now frequented by LWB pilots who view it as a sort of monument to their movement's renewed independence, with some leaving memorials to the struggle against the FA aboard.

34985.text: The remnants of the passenger liner Nagapasa -- its engines have been destroyed. It was chartered by the IMG in 834 AS to rescue former slaves stranded on Freeport 10. The vessel was stopped by a Crayter Republic border inspection squadron and accused of violating the embargo of Languedoc. The Republic claims an officer was shot after boarding the vessel to conduct an inspection, resulting in the Nagapasa being attacked. The IMG strongly dispute this story and have launched their own investigation. Three crew members and seven passengers perished during the attack; the survivors were transported to Planet Yuma by Crayterian ships.

34988.text:
CLASS: Argus
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Momus was produced at Sabah Shipyard in 821 AS and saw extensive service in the Taus throughout the Gallic War. Since then, the vessel has completed several tours across Tau-23, 31 and 44, largely concerning itself with thwarting Gallic and Outcast influence in the area. This culminated in a raid on Omicron-Alpha at the height of the Maltese Slave Revolt.

The Momus then operated alongside the Java defense picket, largely against the IMG's will. In 834 AS, the Momus was ordered to depart the station by its outraged administrators, following a further breakdown in relations from the Liner Nagapasa's destruction. As a result, it returned to Tau-44 and underwent refits at Sulawesi Citadel.

The following year, the battlecruiser was dispatched to Inverness, to bolster the flagging security operation there. The battlegroup have been ordered to contain alien threats that have been detected nearby, while avoiding unnecessary entanglements with other local groups.

34990.text: The wreck of a Cyclone Heavy Transport, flagged to the Sirius Coalition. The Denebola was last sighted by Zoner patrols heading into Omega-49's Alegranza Cloud in 834 AS. The vessel appears to have lost all onboard power and struck a piece of debris, before being hit by heavy weapons fire.

34992.text: This remote survey drone has run out of power and stopped functioning. It appears to have wiped its own databanks shortly before shutting down. The internal circuitry bears the hallmarks of Liberty design.

34993.text: This remote survey drone was hit by heavy weapons fire and shattered. Some of the surviving components bear the hallmarks of Liberty design.

34994.text: This remote survey drone has run out of power and stopped functioning. It appears to have wiped its own databanks shortly before shutting down. The internal circuitry bears the hallmarks of Kusari design.

34995.text: This remote survey drone was hit by heavy weapons fire and shattered. Some of the surviving components bear the hallmarks of Rheinland design.

34996.text: This remote survey drone has run out of power and stopped functioning. It appears to have wiped its own databanks shortly before shutting down. The internal circuitry bears the hallmarks of Rheinland design.

34997.text: This remote survey drone was hit by heavy weapons fire and shattered. Some of the surviving components bear the hallmarks of Rheinland design.

34998.text: This remote survey drone is intently scanning the engine section of the IKN Niyodo. It does not respond to hails and is not running a transponder. Periodically it emits a pulse of energy, likely an encrypted comm-beam transmitting its findings to another unit sequestered somewhere in the system.

35003.text: The Eielson Strategic Reserve began construction in 834 AS to provide the Liberty Navy with an enhanced stockpile of H-Fuel. Once complete, the ESR is intended to allow military operations to continue in the event of serious inter-Colony economic disruption. Funding for construction was unlocked on an emergency basis through a sealed executive order issued by President Hawthorne.

35007.text: The J. Fendall is a Bretonian heavy patrol ship attached to the 9th Royal Cruiser Flotilla under the command of the Battlecruiser Livingston. The patrol group is primarily tasked with responding to raids on nearby BMM and Samura mining operations, and resisting Gallic influence as a tripwire force. The J Fendall has command responsibility for the small Bretonian garrison housed aboard Scalpay Outpost.

35010.text: The Lerna is a Crayter Military border enforcement vessel that has been attached to the Bretonian garrison at the Tau-31 Jump Gate. Crayter regularly runs patrols between its holdings in Coronado and Tau-44, generally aimed at rebuffing Outcast and Gallic expansion and protecting trade convoys. Bretonia's failure to properly garrison their Tau-23 beachhead is a topic of continual frustration for Crayter officers.

35012.text:
CLASS: Cochrane
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 260
35012.mapped:
During the war between Kusari and Gallia, Bretonia granted Kusari permission to transit military vessels through the technically neutral Tau-31. This allowed Kusari to rapidly capture the Gate terminal in Tau-23 before launching assaults into Languedoc itself. Before the war's end, Kusari entered into negotiations with Bretonia regarding the captured Gate's status.

In exchange for joint access to Tau-23's minerals in perpetuity, Kusari transferred control of the Gate to Bretonia. The Tadasu Agreement of 827 AS also saw both Houses commit to defend one another in the event of becoming subject to future Gallic aggression in their mutual Tau border.

Bretonia quickly contracted Ageira's services for the delicate task of keeping the Gallic gate operational. Using experience gained from dissecting abandoned Gallic infrastructure in Bretonia, Ageira cobbled together various workarounds to keep the Gate in one piece. Despite this, there are frequent outages and the extreme stress placed on the Gate's components is shortening the structure's operational lifespan significantly.

35013.text:
During the war between Kusari and Gallia, Bretonia granted Kusari permission to transit military vessels through the technically neutral Tau-31. This allowed Kusari to rapidly capture the Gate terminal in Tau-23 before launching assaults into Languedoc itself.
