Orbiting the nearby Fischer black hole whose immense gravitational field dominates the region, Freyja is a cracked planet slowly spiraling towards death. While not close enough to be in immediate danger of crossing the event horizon, Freyja’s orbit lies well within the black hole’s gravitational influence, making the planet's stability precarious. For ages, it held together battered by tidal forces and geological stress. That changed when a rogue asteroid, traveling at extreme velocity, collided with the planet’s surface. The impact destabilized Freyja's tectonic integrity and accelerated its descent into destruction.

The collision left a massive rupture across the equator, fracturing the crust and exposing parts of the planetary core. One hemisphere remains barely intact, its surface a scorched, shifting wasteland of collapsing ridges and deep, glowing fissures. The other hemisphere has shattered entirely, its fragments caught in slow, spiraling descent toward Fischer. A steady plume of molten material and charged gases now leaks from the core into the void, creating violent gravitational eddies and radiation fields that make approach nearly impossible. Ships venturing too close will be torn apart within seconds by a combination of intense heat, radiation, and unstable gravimetric forces.

Freyja is now considered a lost world - a doomed planet caught between two cataclysms: its own internal collapse and the pull of the black hole it cannot escape. Though long-range scans suggest the presence of rare minerals and unstable isotopes among the debris, no retrieval mission has returned, and most automated probes fail to transmit beyond the inner debris belt. It stands as a chilling reminder of how even distant proximity to a black hole can end a planet’s life in slow, violent motion.

40819.text:
DIAMETER: 2,800 km
MASS: 1,1 x 10e22 kg
TERRAIN: Ice
TEMPERATURE: -174℃ to 259℃
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 2.3 km/sec

One of the most remote planets in the colonies, Vanir is believed to have formed from the remnants of an ancient ice-rich body that strayed too close to Fischer millions of years ago. Rather than being torn apart by tidal forces, the object was captured into a distant orbit, where gravitational interactions with other debris in the system gradually shaped it into the small, irregular moon seen today. Its composition is dominated by frozen water, ammonia, and methane, with scattered deposits of silicate rock embedded within the ice. The lack of significant geological activity over eons has left Vanir’s surface largely unchanged, preserving ancient impact craters and ridges carved during its chaotic formation.

While visually striking against the backdrop of Fischer’s faint accretion glow, Vanir offers no practical value to humanity. Its extreme remoteness from navigable space, combined with the absence of rare minerals or exploitable resources, means it has never been the focus of serious colonization or mining efforts.

40821.text:
DIAMETER: 41000 km
MASS: 1,7 x 10e26 kg
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 29 km/sec

Planet Iduun is a moderately sized gas giant situated on the extreme outskirts of the Fischer system, so distant that it spends most of its orbit shrouded in near-total darkness. Thought to have formed in the cold outer reaches long before Fischer collapsed into a black hole, Iduun likely originated from the gradual accretion of hydrogen, helium, and trace methane in a region rich with volatile ices. Over millions of years, it settled into a stable but solitary orbit, far removed from the gravitational chaos of the system’s inner regions. The planet’s upper atmosphere, tinged a muted red by suspended tholins and other complex hydrocarbons, appears almost black to the naked eye under the dim, distorted light of Fischer’s distant accretion disk.

Though visually striking, Iduun holds little to no practical value to humanity. Its immense remoteness, combined with a complete lack of solid surface and minimal resource accessibility, makes it an unattractive target for exploration or exploitation. With surface winds estimated to exceed hundreds of kilometers per hour and temperatures dropping far below the freezing point of most known gases, it remains one of the most inhospitable and isolated planetary bodies in explored space.

40823.text: When we moved the Amarna into Colorado, someone on the comms deck thought it’s just a PR stunt. But it’s not. Our long-range arrays pick up signals the outposts can’t. A few days ago, we caught a tight-beam burst near Pueblo that wasn’t on any registry. I flagged it. Might be nothing, might be someone feeding intel across the border. Either way, this ship’s not here for show. We’re listening, and someone out there’s talking.

40824.text: People assume serving on a ship like this means cutting-edge warfare, high-adrenaline deployments. Truth is, most of my day is spent reconfiguring scan filters and recalibrating for micro-interference from trade traffic. That’s what ‘advanced systems’ actually mean. Higher expectations, less tolerance for noise. And when intelligence gives us a name or a ship to watch, we’d better be ready to spot it through a thousand signatures in real time. No margin for error.

40825.text: We’ve been rotating a lot of supply crates marked 'technical components' from Liberty’s high-clearance contractors lately - Cryer, Ageira, even some off-book transfers. Nothing illegal, not exactly, but no manifests attached either. When you see high-volume traffic like that moving through a ship on extended station duty, it usually means two things: someone up the chain is building something, and they don’t want it logged.

40827.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Block IIIb
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Battlecruiser Lehigh was deployed in 822 AS, shortly after the end of the Hudson War. Designed as an LSF deep space raider, its original mission brief had been to cross the vast spaces between Bering and Hamburg to disrupt commerce, applying pressure for Rheinland to accept peace terms. Instead, its first assignments included tours of Pennsylvania and later Kansas to suppress pirate and Hellfire Legion activity. It later participated in the Scouring of Bering, working with the Battleship Concord to rout the newly formed Liberty Insurgency.

During the Vespucci Campaign, the Lehigh gained a bloody reputation due to its actions in Magellan, where it blocked the retreat of defeated Insurgency survivors -- allegedly under standing orders to take no prisoners. The battlecruiser was then deployed to Colorado to guard the locked Kepler Jump Gate, although some allege the LSF was actually scouting paths through the system’s dark matter storm to find Jump Holes into Kusari. This tour came to an end in 834 AS, when LSF spy satellites detected a large hyperspace pulse in Ontario.

Due to its deep space capabilities, the Lehigh was dispatched to urgently investigate. The battlecruiser secured a defensive zone near Ontario’s abandoned Jump Gate, protecting the construction ship Robert Peary as it carried out emergency repairs. The Lehigh’s patrols later confirmed Planet Sudbury was source of the initial hyperspace reading, and later obtained scans of further pulses when an enormous beam was fired from the planet into deep space.

The Lehigh's deployment came to an ignoble end in 835 AS, when it was attacked by a massed swarm of Xeno fighters, led by the Liberty Rose -- later identified through hull scans as the lost Battleship Alabama. While the LSF task force inflicted brutal losses on the Xenos, the battlecruiser was eventually overwhelmed by weight of numbers and badly damaged. Forced to retreat back to California, the Lehigh underwent emergency repairs at Norfolk Shipyard and then more thorough work at Chadwick Station in 836 AS.

Lehigh was conducting her final fitting out at the time of Kusari's surprise attack on Norfolk shipyard. Her transfer to Chadwick Station spared her from her sisters' fate. The destruction at Norfolk lit a fire under her crew, who completed what work was left for her deployment within 48 hours of the news. For now, she has been assigned as the flagship of the Baltimore Shipyard Naval Garrison with the mission of ensuring a repeat of Norfolk is impossible.

40829.text: Comet Ymir is a volatile, rich celestial body locked in a high-velocity orbit around the Fischer black hole, its rapid trajectory shaped by both its low mass and close proximity to the singularity. Comprised primarily of frozen methane, ammonia, and carbon dioxide, alongside trace amounts of silicate dust and organic compounds, Ymir is thought to be a remnant from the system’s early formation. As it races along its elliptical path, the comet is predicted to spiral into the black hole's deadly accretion disk sometime in the next 100 years, vanishing forever.

40830.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large alien structure orbiting the Fischer-1171 singularity. From a distance, it appears as a vast, asymmetric construct of alien alloy and unknown crystalline elements, constantly surrounded by a shimmering, translucent energy bubble. Long-range scans reveal that the structure is locked in a fast orbit just outside the black hole’s most dangerous gravitational threshold, making any approach attempt extremely risky with current human technology. The slightest deviation in trajectory results in catastrophic loss to gravitational forces, and even unmanned probes are shredded or flung away before getting within visual resolution.

Its exact function is unknown, but its position and design have led some to speculate that it serves as a form of energy harvesting node, potentially drawing on the subtle emissions of Hawking radiation or other exotic phenomena around Fischer. What lies within the energy bubble is a complete mystery; the surface within is obscured by distortions and lensing effects caused by the bubble’s strange interaction with local space-time. While its purpose is debated, more superstitious voices among deep-space crews whisper that it could be a sentry, a beacon, or even a weapon left behind by the long-vanished Daam K’Vosh, silently watching those who dare to venture near the black hole.

40832.text:
Wreckage of the Berlin, a Rheinland vessel orbiting Planet Tangiers. The ship bears no visible signs of damage apart from minor wing abrasions, likely caused by small nearby asteroids. The Valkyrie appears to have undergone a minor engine modification, but without a detailed analysis, it is difficult to determine the exact nature of the changes.

Black box data identifies the ship as belonging to Konrad Schrödinger, an aspiring pilot in the Rheinland Military. His last recorded activities in the Military, however, date back years before his ship came to be here. The exact purpose of his journey, how he ended up in this location, and why his vessel now endlessly orbits a desolate planet all remain a mystery. A message can be read inside the black box: "...stay clear... anomalies...".

40834.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
This area has been marked as a live fire exercise zone under the authority of the Rheinland Military. Lethal force is authorized in this sector and will be used against any non-compliant vessels for the safety of personnel operating in the area.

40836.text: Scans have picked up an emergency transponder in this area emanating from the ALG Transport Stadlau, which recently went missing after departing Wichter Station. The crew's last transmission indicated the ship was being boarded by Corsair vessels.

40838.text: A Military reconnaissance patrol recently went missing in action while investigating reported Hessian activity. Their last report indicated they were being engaged by a large force and required substantial reinforcements.

40840.text: Red Hessian forces regularly challenge the Rheinland battlegroup tasked with blockading the system. Clashing amongst the charred wrecks of previous battles, the Hessians have attempted to probe the defences around the jump gate to little avail.

40842.text: The Rheinland Military has deployed counter-terrorism patrols to this sector in response to the assassination attempt on Kaiser Albrecht. With a broad mandate to root out enemies of the state, the Military has taken to detaining any ships suspected of criminal affiliation.

40844.text: Corsair vessels conduct frequent incursions into Rheinland from the Sigmas, plundering any ships they encounter. The Battleship Schwerin’s battlegroup has been tasked with managing this threat, and patrols routinely clash with the Edge World pirates.

40846.text: The Rheinland Military conducts regular perimeter patrols in the vicinity of the classified Sektor-9 zone. Though information is tightly regulated, it is alleged these patrols have extra-judiciously detained trespassers. The Military officially denies any wrongdoing.

40848.text: Local Zoners have put out an advisory that Outcast forces are using this area as a staging area for their operations in the system. Due to the proximity to their space, extreme aggression is considered likely against any ships found by Outcast patrols in this area.

40850.text: Zoner Militant groups have put out an open call requesting assistance against Corsair vessels in this sector. Their call to arms indicates this area is used as an experimental zone for the Corsairs' new weapons, far enough from home, but close enough for their enemies to see.

40852.text:
>>>EXTREME CAUTION<<<
Sensors are detecting a large object surrounded by several unknown energy signatures. Avoid at all costs.

40854.text: A local Zoner research team attempting to survey a nearby anomaly reported an attack by Nomad warforms lurking in the area. After reports of the incident were disseminated on board Freeport 11, local groups have moved in to investigate the area, prompting a violent confrontation between Omicron Delta’s local powers.

40856.text: In the chaotic collapse of Omicron Zeta, several Core units were cut off as the frontline dissolved. The surviving vessels have taken shelter in the debris field of a Zoner Colony Ship, fending off constant attacks as they attempt to organize a last-ditch breakout attempt.

40858.text: Rumours from local prospectors tell tales of phantom ships striking from the centre of the Ultrecht Cloud. Due to the extreme navigational danger the cloud poses, none of these reports have ever been verified, though the Core and Bounty Hunter’s Guild have advised their pilots to avoid the area nonetheless.

40860.text: The area around the wreck of the Corsair cruiser San Agustín marks the flashpoint of the ongoing war between the Red Hessians and Corsairs for control of Omega-47. Both sides have been locked in fierce fighting, with no end in sight despite the appalling casualties.

40862.text: The centre of the Hammen Hole sees the fiercest fighting in the multi-decade-long battle for the system. Corsair squadrons regularly clash with their Hessian rivals here, swallowing entire fighter wings in what veterans consider the bloodiest warzone in all of Sirius.

40864.text: This region has been marked as a hazard zone by local miners from both Rugen and Douglas Station, respectively. Violent attacks by Red Hessian vessels on mining crews who stray too close are commonplace, despite security measures.

40866.text: This area has become a staging ground for Bretonian patrols seeking to curb the extreme criminal activity centred around Planet Sprague. Reinforcements have recently been deployed in response to the poor performance of local Bretonian-sponsored militias.

40868.text: After it became clear the Cambridge Line was simply being bypassed, the Bretonian Armed Forces responded by deploying a contingent near the sealed Poole gate to head off the most obvious route around. While the operation has seen some success, ships continue to slip past in the vast void.

40870.text: As the frontier shifts from New London to Dublin due to Bretonia's recent invasion to retake the system, this battlezone next to the old collapsed New London jumpgate sees frequent three-way skirmishes between Bretonian patrols intent on maintaining their blockade on Dublin, Molly’s attempting to breach it, and the Corsairs raiding and pillaging anyone they find.

40872.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
On the verge of Bretonia's sphere of influence, this battlezone is a prime example of the never-ending war for the Newcastle turf. Local factions including law enforcement, bounty hunters, criminals, pirates, and even miners, all partake in their share of fighting.

40874.text: The Kusari Naval Forces maintain patrols in Shikoku. Though tensions with Liberty have challenged Kusari’s ability to maintain this operation, a sizeable force nonetheless remains on station.

40876.text: Outcast activity within Tau-29 remains constant, with smuggling convoys frequently operating in the system. Bretonian intelligence reports indicate Tau-29 is used as a route to enter both Kusari and Bretonia, though effective interdiction so far remains difficult.

40878.text: Sensors indicate a navigational signal is broadcasting in this area. The frequency is a close match for those used by the Gallic Navy, although no Gallic ships are officially reported to be operating in the area.

40880.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
This area has been marked as an exercise zone by the Gallic Navy. Any unauthorized vessels will be detained without exception, and lethal force is authorized against non-compliant ships.

40882.text: Scanners indicate an area south of Sudbury, serving as a battlezone of local factions fighting over access to the planet.

40884.text:
>>>VALLEY FORGE BOUNTY POSTING<<<
Navy patrol craft based on the Battleship Alma have crippled a Liberty Rogue “Scylla” Destroyer wanted for robbing a shipment along the New York-Planet Erie trade lane. It was last sighted in this sector, and a substantial reward has been posted by Interspace Commerce officials calling on able Freelancers to destroy the vessel and any escorting craft.

40886.text:
>>>VALLEY FORGE BOUNTY POSTING<<<
This sector is the last known location of a wing of Xeno fighters, led by an Inquisitor-class gunboat, wanted for the destruction of a Samura transport. Interspace Commerce officials on Valley Forge have authorized a substantial credit reward for the destruction of this ship and any Xeno craft found in the area. Threat assessments recommend a small group of fighters or a veteran Freelancer to carry out the mission.

40888.text:
>>>INTERSPACE COMMERCE TRAFFIC ADVISORY<<<
Interspace Commerce is advising all civilian vessels to avoid this area due to an ongoing skirmish between Liberty Navy and Erie Militant patrols. IC risk analysts also advise that gunboats have been sighted moving to the area, and that fighting will likely significant escalate without immediate intervention.

40890.text: The Liberty Navy maintains a contingent in Cortez tasked with protecting commerce heading to Planet Curacao and the Coronado system. Military exercises are a constant, as the Liberty Navy aims to maintain readiness levels across Liberty’s borders. This remote sector of Cortez provides the perfect grounds for naval maneuver drills.

40892.text: Attacks by the Liberty Rogues on Magellan shipping have recently ramped up, with several attacks originating from the southern half of the system. Cordova’s station administration has responded by placing bounties on all Rogue vessels in the system.

40894.text: A large convoy of Rogue ships was recently sighted heading towards the northern end of Magellan. It is believed the Rogues use the system as an artery to transit stolen cargo, black market firearms, and other illicit goods.

40896.text: In response to escalating tensions between Liberty and Kusari, the Liberty Navy has expanded its naval presence in Gallileo. Current reports suggest Liberty has set up forward operations in the southern end of the system, ready to challenge any opponents the House may face in the system.

40898.text: The northern end of the Hokkaido system is used as a staging ground by Blood Dragon forces. Interference from the gas clouds and radiation makes it difficult for Kusari forces to track their movements accurately, providing the perfect cover for their operations.

40900.text: The Tohoku system is believed to house several classified experiments, although the KOI and Kusari Government have refused to disclose any details. In addition to its duties garrisoning the ancient Heaven’s Gate fortress, the Kusari naval garrison is said to be tasked with testing experimental weaponry, some of which is rumoured to be of alien origins.

40902.text: Outcast traffic from the northern Omicrons is reported to pass through this area, frequently meeting resistance from GMG paramilitaries and Corsair raiders. Recently, unidentified fighters have also begun interfering in these engagements, adding to the confusion. Bounty brokers are calling for aid from any willing assets able to patrol the area.

40904.text: Clashes between Crayter and Outcast forces remain a common occurrence in the ruins of the Tau-44 system. While relations with the Republic are strained, the IMG have been known to intervene against the Outcasts, and there are even unconfirmed reports of Gallic vessels being sighted in the system.

40906.text: The wartorn hulks of the Flodden Debris Field are frequently scavenged by both Gaian and Royalist salvage crews, resulting in violent clashes when they encounter one another. These operations have also drawn the ire of the Bretonian garrison based on Perth, which has deployed patrols in response.

40908.text: Scanners are picking up a Corsair heavy squadron, likely making an early inqiury into the deep Omega systems.

40910.text: Reading...reading...unable to pick up a signal.

40912.text: Part of the routine daily patrols, the Liberty Police conduct raids on potential criminal shipments attempting to land on the planet. Approach the area with caution.

40914.text:
DIAMETER: 20000 km
MASS: 1,9 x 10e25 kg
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 19 km/sec

One of the smallest gas giants ever catalogued, Aesir is a striking world of swirling green and yellow bands, its atmosphere tinted by trace quantities of exotic hydrocarbons and ionized gases. Unlike most giants, Aesir never reached the critical mass needed to collapse into a true Jovian; astronomers speculate that its growth was stunted during formation by the gravitational turbulence of the nearby Fischer Black Hole, which stripped away vast amounts of primordial material before the planet could accrete fully.

Today, Aesir maintains a distant, stable orbit around Fischer, far enough to avoid immediate tidal disruption yet close enough to bear the scars of its chaotic infancy. Its unusual size and radiant hues make it a rare transitional object: too massive to be considered a super-Earth, too light to rival a full gas giant. For explorers, Aesir remains both a scientific curiosity and a reminder of the delicate balance between creation and destruction in unstable systems.

44202.text:
Adapted AI Weapon Type 1 Light

Adapted AI weapons are the latest weapon technology currently developed by Core based on knowledge and technology obtained from the planet Gammu. They have several advantages over normal human weapons - the most important being the same exotic form of energy projectile as true AI weapons. Type 1 is the first functional family of these weapons and they are similar in design and projectile appearance to tachyon weapons. These have further been adapted for use within a light fighter frame. An interesting feature of all adapted AI systems is the fact that they need to be reset to factory settings periodically to maintain full functionality. The cores of these pieces of technology are also known for creating seemingly random electric signals and noises.

44204.text:
Adapted AI Weapon Type 2 Light

Adapted AI weapons are the latest weapon technology currently developed by Core based on knowledge and technology obtained from the planet Gammu. They have several advantages over normal human weapons - the most important being the same exotic form of energy projectile as true AI weapons. Type 2 is the second family of these weapons and they are similar in design and projectile appearance to laser weapons. These have further been adapted for use within a light fighter frame. An interesting feature of all adapted AI systems is the fact that they need to be reset to factory settings periodically to maintain full functionality. The cores of these pieces of technology are also known for creating seemingly random electric signals and noises.

44206.text:
Adapted Light Nomad Blaster

This appears to be an attempt to jury-rig an adapted nomad weapon into an interceptor-sized frame. Order and Core scientists originally developed the experimental mountings that were capable of utilising the energy conversion units, however the poorly understood technology has since leaked onto the black markets and proliferated across Sirius.
