44209.text: A BMM-affiliated asteroid mining platform, chartered to mine out what remains of the Stokes field.

56004.text: [801 AS] Rheinland Expats Flock to Manhattan

56005.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nMANHATTAN -- Rheinland high society is on the move, and Manhattan is the destination of choice. With the economic woes that Rheinland has been experiencing in recent years, many of the colony's finest families are relocating to the center of Sirius. "I can live the life I wish to lead more easily here -- it's a shame, but true," said Gerhardt Schliefner, a newcomer from Stuttgart. Immigrants most commonly cited the uncontrolled crime wave in Rheinland as their primary reason for leaving.

56062.text: [801 AS] Rheinland Critical of Liberty Navy

56063.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nHOUSTON -- According to New Berlin, the crew aboard the battleship Mississippi is not doing an adequate job of protecting Rheinland ships passing through Texas. This statement was made after Republican Shipping lodged a complaint with the Rheinland government concerning the number of convoys that have fallen victim to Xenos, Rogues, and Outcasts in the system. Liberty asserts that its own ships are offered even less protection in the Hamburg system.

56103.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nBADEN-BADEN -- Orbital Spa and Cruise Line's luxury liner Baden-Baden is posting record losses this quarter. Orbital representatives are blaming the declining Rheinland economy for the unexpected revenue shortfall. "We have resorts throughout Sirius, but Baden-Baden is the only unprofitable facility," said Orbital's Executive Vice President of Operations, Bill Johnson. To make up for the losses there has been talk of shipping in Liberty econo-class tourists to the resort. Many Stuttgart citizens who believe that there is enough Liberty presence in the system already picketed the Orbital office on Monday.

56158.text: [801 AS] BMM Leaves a Bad Taste

56159.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nLEEDS -- BMM came under fire last week when it was discovered that the free food distributed to employees working on the planet is of substandard quality, normally used as livestock feed on Cambridge. Workers were further enraged when they heard this comment from a BMM executive, "We never thought it was an issue since most of our planetside labor lost their ability to taste and smell after the first year or two on Leeds."

56161.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nSETTLEMENT 483 -- The honeycombed surface just south of Mining Settlement 483 collapsed yesterday in what is believed to be one of the worst mineshaft cave-ins in Leeds' history. The residents of 483 were awakened near midnight by tremors and rumbling. "Next thing you know my entire living complex was falling. Most of my neighbors are dead," a dazed Giles Chamberlain reported from his hospital bed. Investigators have cited over-mining in the area as the cause.

56162.text: [801 AS] BMM Pressured to Clean up Dump

56163.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nSETTLEMENT 9171 -- The residents of Mining Settlement 9171 are lodging an official complaint with the Bretonian Government today. It was recently discovered that the newly established settlement is situated on a centuries old toxic waste dump. Already there are reports of widespread sickness and some deaths. BMM built 9171 when it was discovered that there were previously unexploited copper deposits far below the surface. "The reason nobody did any digging around here was because of the toxic waste dump. BMM just figured they wouldn't let that stop them anymore," stated Brian Roberts, a resident of 9171.

56165.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nLD-14 -- The security screening process that an individual must go through to work at the LD-14 MOX processing facility is rigorous, but recent events have shown that these measures may still be inadequate. Two Molly operatives where captured Wednesday as they attempted to transmit coded messages from a long-range mobile communicator aboard LD-14. Under interrogation the men reported that they had been coerced by Molly agents to transmit shipping schedules and cargo manifests. Both men have been detained on the battleship York until sentencing next week.

56166.text: [801 AS] Life Expectancy up in Leeds

56167.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nLEEDS -- The Royal Census Bureau reported that the average life expectancy of a Leeds resident has improved since the last census was tallied 20 years ago. A female on the planet can expect to live 1.2 years longer on average. The number also increased for residents within the system,, though less significantly, with a boost of .8 years. The Bureau attributes the better numbers to a stricter interpretation of the Laws of Labor Safety that were recently instituted by the Crown. The new average life span for a person on Leeds is 51, and for those in the system, 67.

56168.text: [801 AS] BMM has Eye on the Border Worlds

56169.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nSTOKES -- It is no secret that Leeds and the Stokes Field have almost been completely mined out. This is disturbing news for BMM officials who must begin to look elsewhere for the raw materials needed to fuel Bretonian industry. BMM executives have already begun searching for new sources of material and have met with some success in the Border Worlds. "Unfortunately, these systems beyond the edge of Bretonian rule are very dangerous to operate in, therefore incurring far greater security costs," said BMM representative Patrick Chamberlain.

56252.text: [801 AS] Crime Levels Similar in IW Systems

56253.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nBERING -- Both Rheinland and Liberty shippers have been looking for a means of safe passage between their two Houses for as long as anyone can remember, but there is no easy answer. Shipping has been increasing in Bering since the crime rates began to climb in Hudson, but according to IC statistics, one system is just as dangerous as the other. "Either way your shipments have the same likelihood of being pirated. -- it just becomes a matter of who you want your pirates to be," quipped Fred Masters, IC rate adjustor.

56262.text: [801 AS] BMM Battles for Survival in Tau-23

56263.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nTAU-23 -- The BMM mining operation in Tau-23 is under daily attack by Outcasts, according to a company spokesman in Leeds. The Beryllium mining operation continues to operate at 30 percent capacity, but the Trade Lane access route construction has fallen far behind schedule and is suffering mounting losses due to nonstop Outcast attacks. DSE personnel assigned to the project have threatened to walk off the job unless BMM can dramatically increase its security forces within the area. Anonymous sources within the company admit that the Bretonia military has so far refused requests for assistance.

56350.text: [801 AS] Dealing with the Federal Police

56351.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nYANAGI -- Rheinland Junkers are feeling the heat as Rheinland passes more rigorous inspection standards in an attempt to stop the flow of Cardamine into the colony. Junkers have been forced to design more imaginative ways to get the drug into Rheinland space. "The authorities are a bit short of cash right now, so we've been able to slip by quite a few State Police patrols with a little extra credits on hand. Usually it works, but sometimes it doesn't, so you have to be prepared to hit the afterburner" said Junker smuggler Sonja Kerns.

56352.text: [801 AS] Yearly Meeting to be Held at Yanagi

56353.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nYANAGI -- Every ten years the organization of men and women who call themselves Junkers comes together at one of the Junker bases; this time around Yanagi will host the event. It is a time for all Junkers to come together to trade wares, ideas, routes, and tales as they review the past decade. New leadership positions will be granted to replace comrades who are no longer with us. New blood will also be brought into the fold with our "Become a Junker" dinner held for Junker children coming of age.

56365.text: [[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]\n\nBARROW -- What's the best way to get rid of the corporates and the rich in New York? Cardamine. It must become every Xeno's goal to wrestle away control of the Cardamine from the Junkers in Liberty. If we could find a way to take over their supplies, we could use the drug to control the Manhattan addicts. This would put us in a much stronger financial position and give us the ability to upgrade our weapons and fleet. Then we could truly begin the revolution that would set the libertonian working class free from the bonds of corruption that restrict so many of us.

56479.text:
MALTA -- 827 AS -- Positive news from the Tau campaign have reached Malta's public news channels today. Don David of the Narvaez cartel's ambitious military plan to deal a final blow to the Crayterian menace in the Tau sector that has been plaguing smuggling operations is one step closer to completion. Released military reports state that the Basilica fleet has successfully reached Tau-44 by evading Bretonian defenses around planet Harris. Similarly the Captana fleet has entered the Crayterian stronghold from Tau-23 and dealt with the immediate defenses near the jump hole anomaly.

Even if spirits on Malta are high from the optimistic war reports, military strategists warn that while the operation has been a major success so far, the hardest part is yet to come in the following days. This warning has not stopped Cardamine smugglers as the encircling of Crayterian forces in Tau-44 has opened a new avenue for major profits in the Bretonian underground markets which had been much more difficult to exploit until recently. Jorge Garcia, a leading profits estimator comments with the following "With the current concerns regarding the Liberty drug trade it is for the best to pursue all possible alternatives and war torn Bretonia might prove to be just as lucrative if we seize the opportunity."

But while the Tau campaign sounds promising, an anonymous source has shared with us that the same could not be said about affairs in the Sigmas. With the bulk of our navy's might being focused in the Taus, battlecruiser Tercio and its strike wings in Sigma-17 have been forced to withdraw from the system after an unsuccessful attempt to destroy Cryer Pharmacuticals' research facility in the system. "What is important is that Tercio has not sustained serious damage in the offensive against Atka regardless of the unexpected complications that were met on the way." reassures us the anonymous source who did not disclose more than the fact they participated in the offensive themselves.

56481.text:
EDINBURGH -- 827 AS -- The Bretonian Fleets MacDuff, Grimsby and Ark Royal were recently deployed in what has become the largest military operation in Bretonia since the conclusion of the war with Gallia a full year ago. E-Day, as it is being referred to, is the simultaneous entry into Edinburgh via Dublin, Tau 31 and Leeds. It is understood that plans for the invasion have been long in the works, with reports from Gallia of Enclave fleet movements northward being the trigger for the operation being put into motion.

The initial confrontation would occur in the vicinity of the old Planetform base, Perth Station, renamed to Orthez by Gallia in the closing stages of the war. Gallic defenses were concentrated on the Leeds entry point, thought the most likely entry point for any invasion, and the Grimsby fleet would face the heaviest opposition. Enclave defense platforms, similar in design to the platforms that caused such havoc on the Liberty Navy Battleship Ottawa, caused devastating damage to the Battleship Bradford of the Grimsby formation while the rest of the fleet moved to render the defenses inoperable.

The MacDuff, arriving from Tau-31, rushed immediately to the aid of the Grimsby fleet, flanking the Enclave defenders, with the La Riche fleet taking the worst of the fighting for the Enclave. The third fleet, Ark Royal, would be the last to arrive in Edinburgh, being forced to take a conservative approach traversing Dublin, while also being delayed by action from the Sisterion Battlecruiser force. The eventual arrival of the Ark Royal signalled the end of the struggle for the Edinburgh breach point around Perth, as faced with overwhelming odds, the remaining defenders retreated to the second line of defenses around Gaia. La Riche was forced to conduct a rear-guard action that cost the fleet its remaining strength, while the Dax set up in defensive formation around Gaia. The Grimsby, facing the majority of the firepower of the Enclave fleet, coupled with the horrific effects of the defensive emplacements, did not see out the engagement, and surviving members of the fleet were merged into the MacDuff and Ark Royal fleets.

Reports from a BIS Agent speaking under promise of anonymity suggest Issoudun Shipyard and the Sealed Gate that once connected Leeds to Edinburgh, were both being evacuated from Edinburgh. Whether these actions are to protect proprietary technology or something more sinister is yet to be determined. Both were seen as relatively low profile targets, and left Edinburgh as the battle raged.

The Enclave continued to evacuate huge numbers of its population from Planet Gaia, an operation that had been ongoing since the capture of Quillan in Languedoc. Knowing the end was now near as Bretonia had managed to take a foothold in Edinburgh thanks to the sacrifice of the Grimsby, all efforts were being focused on the evacuation. The BAF began to set up siege lines to the east and west of the planet and began to pick at its defences, though further weapon platform emplacements made it implausible to rush in for a full attack. Initial reports suggest the Dax is readying to make its final retreat with the final convoy of Enclave citizens.

According to inside sources close to the Admiralty Board, there has been discussion about pulling both the Ark Royal and MacDuff out of Edinburgh following the operations completion owing to security concerns and the inability to maintain proper supply to Edinburgh without a jump-gate connection being re-established. This leaves the Edinburgh system in a state of lawlessness, and it is feared that the Mollys and other dissident groups will use the population of Gaia as a recruitment center for those who hold ill will towards Bretonia.

News of the relatively good progress made in the invasion has resulted in a sharp rise in the stock markets, as it is hoped that quelling the Enclave threat in Edinburgh will result in safer transit through Leeds, and even reclamation of LD-14 Uranium reserves, once thought hopeless due to the proximity to Edinburgh.

56482.text: [827 AS] Dark matter storm forces evacuation

56483.text:
FREEPORT 14 -- 827 AS -- The epicenter of the dark matter storm, Freeport 14, the last remaining station in Alberta, has been under lock-down since the storm engulfed the entirety of the system. Few vessels have been granted permission to access the station in hopes of reducing traffic, and the already heavy strain on the station's resources. The storm has been the cause of destruction of a number of stations within the system already, with Freeport 14 only standing strong due to the early preparation and structural reinforcements.

While the station seems to be in good health, a number of problems have since arisen, including the lack of medical supplies, a failing in waste management systems, a shortage of fresh water, and a lack of a steady supply of food. Several small scale evacuations have already taken place, with many having ignored the recommendation to leave before it is too late.

The Praia is on route, and a mandatory evacuation of the station is now underway. This evacuation fleet will be the last to reach Freeport 14 before the life support is shut down in an attempt to preserve resources in hopes the station can be salvaged. This evacuation is a last attempt to save as many lives as possible before the storm becomes too strong for even the most hardened vessels to pass through.

Onboard Freeport 14 is a picture of panic as the last preparations are taking place for the evacuation, with many remaining people being only told to take what they can carry to save space on the vessels coming to retrieve them. It is unsure where the remaining people from Freeport 14 will be relocated to, however rumor has it they will join up with a mobile Zoner colony until further arrangements can be made.

56485.text:
FRANKFURT -- 827 AS -- A week into the bitter Imperial offensive into Thuringia, the guns along the Thuringian front have fallen still. Along sector E6, a white cloudy haze of ash obscures a silent battlefield of wreckage, weapon emplacements, and two fleets frozen quietly in formation.

Sources indicate that the cessation of fighting occurred organically, after several heavy battlecruisers in the Kolleda battlegroup of the Imperial Fleet reportedly refused orders to advance - instead, broadcasting a general call to 'cease the futile bloodshed of fellow Rheinlanders.' When issued counter-offensive orders to exploit the gap in the Kolleda formation, Federalist battlegroup Bayern similarly rejected orders and maintained their defensive posture. Within hours, the rest of the Imperial and Federal fleets followed suit - in what many have begun calling, 'Der Weihnachtsfrieden.'

Following earlier preliminary reports of the armistice throughout the Rheinland colonies, renewed widespread protests have broken out on New Berlin, Hamburg, Holstein, Stuttgart, and Weimar, calling for an end to the now unpopular Civil War. In the previous months, many similar protests occurred on a smaller scale following unsubstantiated reports of Imperial and Federalist forces refusing to fight on the Frankfurt front - and the indication of wide-spread war weariness may have been the catalyst to the desperate renewed offensive on Thuringia.

Neither the Imperial nor the Federalist regimes have issued official statements on the matter as of yet, and it is unclear what this ceasefire means for the civil war - but Rheinland waits with bated breath for the hope of an end to the fighting by Christmas.

56492.text: [827 AS] OS&C Boasts Views Close to the Action

56493.text:
LUXURY LINER HAWAII -- 827 AS -- During the recent conflict in Sigma 17, many organizations offered travel advisories and warned travelers. Police from both Kusari and Rheinland went out of their way to warn travelers journeying into the Sigmas, But Orbital Spa and Cruise has framed it as a marketing opportunity, apparently seeing war enthusiasts and thrill seekers as one of its core demographics for tours of the Sigmas. Attached below is a broadcast from OS&C Events Coordinator Suwa Sago:

Ladies and gentlemen as you are all aware we have had a spectacular view of vintage Hispanic warfare this last week or so. Seldom will you see such a vicious display of skill and expertise when handling fighter craft as this anywhere in the colonies. We are pleased to be able to provide you with this experience from the safety and luxury of our fine Liner.

However we also feel obligated to keep you up to date on what is happening in the area and the conflict has started to show some results. We regret to inform you that Atka Research station was assaulted by the Outcasts and suffered some damage as a result. Fortunately for them, the Corsairs chased off their Outcast rivals in defense of the station, preventing worse damage from occurring. While we have been reassured no casualties occurred on the station, some injuries have been reported.

But rest assured honored guests, your Cryer stocks are still maintaining their value! Cryer Pharmaceuticals has utilized the chaos of the crossfire to secure a backup facility on Planet Honshu to safeguard their Stabiline research.

However, the repercussions of the fighting don't stop there. The Gas Miners Guild has warned us that due to the increased threat of Corsair raids and the Outcast forces seemingly coming to the Sigma-19 the Guild will not be able to make all their usual supply deliveries.

The Corsairs definitely seem to be tightening their hold on the Sigma-17 system wouldn't you say ladies and gentlemen!

Another possible reason for the decrease in Guild supplies might be the entrance of a new group in the area; The Golden Chrysanthemums. This organization has been deemed a terrorist group by the Kusari government, it consists of only women. While many of their motives are unknown, they are strong advocates of women's rights and are supposedly in league with the Outcasts.

Who knows? We may even see one or two of them onboard, giving you the one in a lifetime chance to meet with a pilot of such an exotic group in safe circumstances.

This also means that traveling through the system, and away from our comfortable liner, is particularly dangerous at the moment. Fortunately the Hawaii has all the comforts you could possibly need and supplies to last us for months. Should you wish to extend your stay with us, please contact the reception to make the arrangements at your earliest convenience.

We hope you enjoy your stay.

56494.text: [827 AS] Yamaguchi to join Languedoc Offensive

56495.text:
NEW TOKYO -- 827 AS -- Despite initial resistance in the parliament to further reduce the concentration of KNF forces in Kusari proper, the Shogunate of the Reformed Kusari Empire has ordered the Yamaguchi provisioned for deployment to Languedoc, to bolster the reconquest of Languedoc for a strike upon Fourchambault. The Yūkōkai continue to protest the deployment of the Yamaguchi, citing the growing risk of blood dragon incursion, and the looming threat of Libertonian sword rattling along the border in Shikoku, but Fleet Command has ordered constant sweeps of the Keiun by the Myoko, and deployed extra contingents of Kusari State Police to Otaru patrol the Hokkaido-Rishiri supply lines, with heavy reinforcements on call from Wakkanai and the Sado. Conservatives of the Kusari Justice Party have raised concerns about climbing social strife on Kyushu, but the Kyushu Governorate continues to call for local leaders to calm things peacefully.

The fleet is and its auxiliary are currently taking on tonnes of provision, munition, and materials of every description, an undertaking causing logistical and economic delays on Honshu and other sectors, due to the high usage of civilian transports by the Navy. Meanwhile, nearly every muster point has received a glut of volunteers. Yamaguchi Auxiliary vessels are moored across from Planet Honshu across the empire to Tsushima Depot in Kyushu, and many non-military priority shipments have been delayed, and civilian held ships are being commandeered off the civilian market to meet the orders of the Yamaguchi quartermasters. With such high demand, the Empire has once again bolstered its wartime economy.

Rumors about the Yamaguchi's volunteers have picked up on local networks, citing various odd behaviors one would not expect of a Naval enlistee or Officer. When asked for a comment, Yagamuchi Executive Officer Honjou Moriuji has stated: "I am not surprised by the level of rowdiness present in our recent conscripts. In fact, emotions are high across the fleet, given our upcoming deployment. It is perfectly reasonable to expect that men headed to war would act out, and with the huge number of ships docked, there's going to be the occasional outlier". He refused to comment on specific cases of surprisingly odd behavior, arguing that he could not speak about cases under investigation.

56496.text: [827 AS] CNS Emergency Broadcast: Kepler Closed

56497.text:
AMES -- 827 AS -- The researchers at the Dark Matter Observatory on Ames has verified a disturbing claim: The material of the dark matter cloud that enveloped Alberta has been trickling into Kepler through unstable jump holes between the two systems. This dark-matter siphon appears to be speeding up, dramatically expanding the volume of dark matter in Kepler. Scientists are scrambling to try and explain how this could have happened, let alone with so little notice.

Meanwhile Ageira has announced that due to the cost of operating in dark matter clouds, the company will be shutting down all maintenance for the Jump Gates and Trade Lanes of Kepler. The gates themselves are slated to be decommissioned to prevent any malfunctions as the gates deteriorate. Ageira PR Rep Natalie Riafsette references the company's own foresight: "If Ageira hadn't gone to the effort and cost of constructing a second lane connection through this unstable region of space, the connection between Liberty and Kusari would be severed for the foreseeable future."

The councils of Ames and its satellite communities, who have experience producing the protective hull plating that Freeport 14 uses to survive its local conditions, expect to weather the storm. They have floated a bond to fund expansions of their thinner hulls, and entered into a Kishiro backed public-private partnership that will occupy many of the offices and cargo-sections currently utilized by Liberty-Kusari traffic in a Kishiro led dark matter research lab.

For your safety, the Kusari State Police and the Liberty Police Inc have issued joint travel notices for anyone entering the system: "Extreme caution ought be used near Dark Matter storms and without without proper clearance ought venture into the storm."

56499.text: OREGON SURVEYOR -- 827 AS -- After losing a series of patrols in the deep reaches of Omicron Nu, the Liberty Security Force has announced it has identified the forces that have attacked them. This force has been outfitted with archaic vessels of Libertonian design, how these vessels were obtained, let alone kept functioning, is still being looked into. For now the Liberty Navy has advised all citizens that are cleared to enter the system to stay close to the Supergate where they can provide protection.\n\nThis hostile force does not seem to distinguish between civilian and military targets and seems to operate throughout the Omicron Nu system, with a higher frequency in the north, center and east parts of the system. This statement, combined with the latest announcement of the Liberty Government prohibiting the construction of modular bases within the system, has led many to believe the situation in the Omicron Nu system is more volatile then we are led to believe.

56501.text:
NEW LONDON -- 827 AS -- After much fierce deliberation within parliament, the High Court of Justice and the Admiralty have decreed the revocation of all letters of Marque as of October the 21st. In a statement by Muriel Mitchell, undersecretary to Admiral Archibald Morris, and spokesperson for the Admiralty, the Crown cited concerns regarding the dubious efficacy and mounting costs of maintaining an irregular and unregulated privateer force. Further comments hinted at additional measures to reallocate privateer-earmarked funds towards other initiatives more directly applied to the Armed Forces.

Although initial trials of the privateer program yielded considerable success in the early days of the Gallic wars, good will towards privateers within the Bretonian populace has waned considerably. Once considered bastions of citizen patriots, privateers now are seen as little more than violent profiteers and thugs.

In coordination with their initial decree of nullification, the Crown has also re-issued a blanket pardon for all privateers who disavow and revoke their pirate ways and disarm. The amnesty and rehabilitation initiative will begin as of today, September the 19 and end by October the 21st, 827 AS, after which, those who persist in piracy will be labeled traitors and punished accordingly.

While trouble is not expected in the transition, civilians are urged to avoid traveling through the Tau systems without sufficient escort in the interim.

56503.text: MALTA -- 827 AS -- Dons on Malta share concerns that Cardamine profits might have reached their zenith and that the next quarterly might be the first to register a decrease in market profit since years. "We are concerned with the future of the Liberty drug trade." says Jorge Garcia, a leading profits estimator, "With the bold attack against the Junkers many are concerned that the criminals that distribute it on Liberty's wealthy markets will not be able to reach the quarterly targets and many plantation growers are starting to worry for their investments." Whether Garcia's concern is well founded remains to be seen, but some of the Dons are already looking for a solution to this problem.\n\nOne such don, Don David of the Narvaez cartel finally received the blessing of the other major Dons to proceed with what could be described as one of the most ambitious military campaigns that Malta has ever seen. Over the past year Don David had been lobbying for a bigger military involvement in Malta's neighboring sectors, but his calls had met deaf ears until recently due to the inherit risks of this endeavor and the continuous growth of Malta's Cardamine market. "We need to secure the smuggling routes through the Taus and Sigmas if we want to ensure stable flow into the House systems." said Santiago Ramirez, a spokesperson for the Narvaez family. How exactly this will be achieved remains to be seen as Ramirez refused to comment further on the details of this operation. What is known though is that the Narvaez cartel has already approached master engineer Casse's academy to assist with refitting and preparing the Maltese fleet for a major combat offensive.

56505.text:
NORFOLK SHIPYARD -- 827 AS -- After seven months of deep-space cruise, the DSE vessel Oregon Surveyor has arrived in a previously unexplored Trinary-system and established jump stabilization that have enabled DSE to form a connection to the system via the Supergate they've recently constructed in Alaska, where a search is underway for the survivors of the Alberta-Poole Gate Fiasco of last year.

After the resounding failures of the Texas Incident and the more recent PROJECT COLD LAKE, Ageira claims that its faster than light experts have gone back to the drawing board and re-plotted the paths that Jump Gates take between stars. From the limited public explanations that Ageira has allowed in the last year, the company has suggested that the paths do not correlate to linear lines on a map, like we all see in astro-mapping displays. Given this information, it is not surprising, if a little dismaying, that the COLD LAKE fiasco leading to the loss of tens of thousands of Liberty Navy personnel may have put the Fairmont and Whitefield somewhere else.

Astronomy had previously only been able to identify the Stars of the system and the system's planets, gas giant Midway and rocky Marshall. The System is dominated by its three stars: A pair of close binary main sequence Yellow suns, orbited at far distance] by a Brown dwarf nearly massive enough to enter the main sequence. Planets Marshal and Midway orbit the primary stars, inside the arc swept clean by the Brown Dwarf. Midway, while rich in many lighter elements, and a reasonable candidate for H-Fuel mining, has thrown up test results indicating that its deeper layers seem to contain unnatural elements. Marshall is like many other rocky planets in Sirius, holding on to a thin atmosphere with an inactive nickel-iron geology. Any resources on Marshall can likely be found easier closer to home, while DSE would like to establish a surveying project to analyze Midway's possible value.

Surveys have also discovered heavy concentrations of minerals in the system's hot central asteroids, but public release of the contents and potential value of the system has yet to be published. This organization has made multiple requests for comment from the Liberty Navy, DSE, USI and Ageira regarding the redacted survey materials, but has yet to be able to find any credible sources willing to comment.

56507.text:
BATTLESHIP HOOD -- 827 AS -– The battlecruiser Blackrock, reinforced by the advance forces of the Ark Royal deployment to Dublin, set out to lure the Enclave Carillon detachment into open engagement clear of the asteroid fields of Dublin. The former GRI asset had been a thorn in the side of the locals for quite some time, murdering helpless miners in its numerous raids to undermine Bretonia's rebuilding efforts. But what appears to have started as a continuation of the ongoing war effort between Bretonia and the Gallic Royal Enclave in the Dublin system quickly turned up with results unexpected by either force.

Records from Battleship Hood's sensor array confirm that the Blackrock got the fight it wanted when the Enclave took the bait. As the Blackrock appeared to be calling in its wings from a patrol, the Carillon and her forces burst from the cover of the Hood Asteroid Field. The Blackrock wings, supplied with extra fuel, quickly broke from their formation and engaged the Carillon. The two fleets were evenly matched and battled ferociously, in a pattern that slowly drifted toward the Arranmore Asteroid Field as each side took severe losses. Neither side of the conflict appeared to expect a third party to get involved. The Molly destroyer Shillelagh capitalized on the chaos of battle. As the belligerents began to cross hidden mines, the Shillelagh deployed several bomber wings and its own deadly arsenal against them, slaughtering the weakened forces of each with vicious efficiency.

With both fleets sporting damage and its crews and pilots exhausted from their ongoing fight, the Molly attack was able to destroy both Battlecruisers, leaving the Molly forces as the victors in the battle. No escape pods have been found near the site of the battle, and rumors have it that the Mollys might have taken them hostage, while others seem to suggest they were picked up by allied ships that fled the scene. No ransom demands have been reported yet. The only thing we know for sure at this point is that the Mollys have broadcast a definitive statement today, from Molly provocateur Jimmy Higgins "Oy will make me message clear: Dublin is aour tir; aour land. Dinnae expect tae steal aour gol' ore or sumtin' wicked will happen. Long live deh Mollys!" Rest assured we have put our best translators on the job but if we had to wager a guess their statement came down to: Dublin is their turf and they intend to keep it that way regardless of what Bretonia or the Enclave may claim.

56512.text: [827 AS] Kusari invade the Gallic sector!

56513.text:
FREEPORT 6 -- 827 AS -- The Kusari Naval Forces have launched a surprise invasion of the Confederacy of Gallia, in a move that has shocked many. The Empire of Kusari pushed into the Taus and forcibly removed the Crayter Republic from the Tau-31 crossroads, it was expected that such action would cause a protracted diplomatic situation between the Crayter Republic and Kusari.

What stunned many is that the seizing of Tau-31 seems to have been a strategic reason prior to the invasion of Gallia, rather than to clamp down on the unlawful presence in the Tau region. Once Kusari had muscled itself into control of the junction, they quickly moved on to spearhead an attack against the Confederacy.

On the scene investigators have described what amounts to a rapid deployment of large military forces against the Gallic border defences. The Kusari Naval Force outnumbered their Gallic opposition and forcefully ejected them out of the border systems.

The core of the fighting is now centred in the Burgundy and Languedoc systems, the Kusari push has seen little in the way of attempting to fully secure the systems in the wake of their advance. With the Kusari Navy seeming to allow some freedom of travel for Gallic corporations in areas that have been occupied.

The Kusari state has publicly announced that their intentions are to bring to justice those within the Confederacy who are responsible for supporting the invasion of Sirius and the destruction of Leeds. And citing the need to remove the weapons of mass destruction before they could eventually be turned on Sirius once more.

The Confederacy has responded to the allegations stating that they harbour no such criminals, those responsible for the atrocities wrought on Leeds are no longer in Gallia; those who remained are either dead or imprisoned. The Confederacy went on to explain that all such weapons considered too inhumane to use have been removed from their respective vessels and only those found in the remnants of the Royal Fleet continue to use them.

56514.text: [827 AS] Kusari Naval Forces expertly remove intruders!

56515.text:
KYUSHU -- 827 AS -- Following reports of an illegal construction within the Kyushu System from an undisclosed source, the battleship Nagasaki deployed patrols to investigate what became known as a Sirius Coalition battle-cruiser attached to an under construction base.

Kusari Naval Forces were then quick to dispatch a battlegroup to deal with the threat, and a few days ago succeeded in the destruction of hostile forces. Captain Kato Masanori, issued a statement praising the conduct of his men during the assault. Noting that their determination and professionalism allowed for the swift removal of the Coalition forces.

Due to the unwelcome breach into Kusari's borders, the citizens of Kyushu were both shocked at the incident but grateful for the swift resolution. Politicians on Kyushu, have come out in droves asking how the Coalition managed to bypass patrols in the first place, Authorities in the Kusari Naval Forces say they suspect that the Blood Dragons performed a crucial role in aiding the foreign invasion into Kusari. Leading to many locals to condemn the criminal organisation more than it already is.

Captain Kato Sadakichi has however, assured the people of Kyushu that the Kusari Naval Forces have taken note of the breach, and will work three times as hard to ensure it does not happen again. He also promised to bring whatever Blood Dragon is responsible for the breach to justice.

56516.text: [827 AS] Alberta Dark Matter Storm Consumes System

56517.text:
FREEPORT 14 -- 827 AS -- The main body of the dark matter storm bearing down on the Alberta System is to arrive imminently, as forecasted by Ageira Technologies. Alberta has long been buffeted by the storm's advance waves, which brought disruption and destruction in their wake. Liberty has formally ordered its remaining citizens to evacuate, marking the end of the House's tumultuous presence in the system. The remote frontier region was originally settled by a group of Zoner colonists who founded Freeport 14 in 807 AS. The population of the system later expanded greatly in the wake of a DSE survey discovering valuable Platinum deposits, resulting in the construction of the Ontario Jump Gate, and the development of an Ageira research facility.

This marked a turn in the system's fortunes, with Liberty taking a more direct interest in the area in order to safeguard its economic and scientific interests. Despite this, the system has been persistently dogged by conflict, with the LPI's Red Deer station being destroyed during a pirate attack in 817 AS. The Liberty Rogues and Lane Hackers have remained a pervasive threat since, with the LPI largely withdrawing and ceding security patrols to Liberty Navy flights based from Fort Severn. The combination of soaring losses to piracy and the initial waves of the encroaching dark matter storm also resulted in the abandonment of Camrose Depot and DSE's mining ambitions in the area.

Securing Alberta has largely been a drain on Liberty's security budget, particularly during the years of the Gallic War when available resources were strained. It is widely believed that it was solely Ageira's influence and secretive local research programs that prevented a premature withdrawal from the system. With the early warning of the incoming storm, Ageira's staffing was gradually wound down, culminating in the deconstruction of the Ontario gate. A mere skeleton crew remains manning Leduc Station, overseeing critical salvage works.

The final transports are expected to depart for safety shortly, carrying the last consignments of Proprietary Ageira Hardware for redeployment at other corporate sites. Reports of heightened criminal activity have already been received throughout Alberta and Ontario, in what is suspected to be a final effort to profit from the evacuation. The surge in criminality has apparently been significantly assisted by the decommissioning of Fort Severn. Due to the impending arrival of the main storm surge, it is reported that Ageira has subcontracted to other Liberty corporations such as DSE and Universal to expedite the final evacuation stages.

Conversely, those Zoners who have elected to stay with their Freeport have remained defiant in spite of Liberty's order to withdraw. Many of the current residents sought Alberta out as an unclaimed frontier, fleeing from Liberty's encroachment on the Pennsylvania System. They perceive the oncoming storm as a return to an isolated and self-sufficient way of life. The Freeport has committed to riding the storm out, and is attempting to fit protective Dark Matter Shielding produced at Ames Research Station. Once immersed in the storm, the Zoners hope to subsist on locally produced stores with minimal external trade or interference. Liberty has cautioned that the Synth installed biodomes are unlikely to function as the sun further dims, and that emergency rescue services would not be offered once the main storm arrives.

56518.text: [827 AS] Cologne Falls to Hessian Invasion

56519.text:
COLOGNE -- 827 AS -- Rheinland's descent into civil war has impacted almost every aspect of life in the tumultuous House. No-where is this truer than the frontier system of Cologne, which has fallen to the forces of the Red Hessians. Cologne has long been subject to raids by Hessian and Unioner pirates, but the latest attacks represent a concentration of Hessian forces unprecedented since the Fall of Dresden in 818 AS. Reliable reports indicate that the Red Hessian battleship Kassel led the incursion into the system - its first sighting since the destruction of the Bretonian battleship Gwent earlier last year.

Raids on the Cologne system had up to this point been subdued by the large population of Bounty Hunters garrisoned on Tholey Station. Federal subsidies had encouraged large numbers of Guild pilots to head to the Cologne frontier in order to hunt pirates throughout the local region. This heavy reliance on the Guild had previously been criticised by as unreliable and inhumane by Rheinland's United Democratic Foundation political party, due to the Guild's penchant for killing rather than detaining "inconvenient" revolutionaries. Following recent elections and the formation of a more liberal ruling coalition, the Federal Government had committed to reviewing the system's security status.

With the outbreak of the Rheinland Civil War and intense fighting in Stuttgart, neither the Federal or Imperial militaries have had the resources to respond adequately to rapidly deteriorating situation in the system. It is believed that the Red Hessians exploited this fact by redeploying forces from all across the their Omega theatres of operations in order to launch the overwhelming strike. Tholey Station was abandoned by the Guild upon realising the scale of the force opposing them, prompting the undergunned Federal Police garrison to evacuate soon after. In the sporadic fighting that followed, Tholey Station amd Wuppertal Refinery were occupied and Olpe Border Station destroyed altogether.

The system's fall comes at a critical moment in time, with the completion of the Zurich Jump Gate occuring mere days before the offensive. Originally sponsored by the Gallic Crown, the trans-Zurich corridor was intended to act as a super-highway between southern Gallia and Rheinland's rich resources. This project was later enthusiastically supported by both the Gallic Confederacy and Federal Rheinland, with the intention of boosting economic cooperation and investment between the two Houses. While the Confederacy's political factions remain gridlocked on the issue of Rheinland's Civil War, it is clear that the fall of Cologne represents a severe blow to Gallic ambitions in southern Sirius. Trade within Zurich has consequently stalled to almost nothing, with heavy losses being incurred by EFL Oil and Machinery, who had invested heavily in its success.

Confederal forces have already been deployed to the Zurich system in order to safeguard critical Gallic infrastructure. Hessians in the Cologne system have been put on notice that any pilots approaching the Zurich Jump Gate will be fired upon without hesitation. The extension of CDF and Gallic Intelligence patrols into Cologne is likely to have a significant impact on local affairs. Rheinland officials have not yet commented on the Gallic incursion, but have blamed the Hessian's push into Cologne on the Federal government's "underfunding" of security forces in the area. Despite Imperial claims that the system will be reoccupied "promptly", the Hessians appear to be preparing to dig in for the long term, with landing sites being established on the Saarbrucken terraforming site. How this will impact their broader operations remains to be seen.

56521.text:
NEW BERLIN -- 827 AS -- With the sector watching on in shock, it has become apparent that a military-backed coup has successfully toppled the previous Federal Government of Rheinland. Following weeks of open conflict in orbit and across Rheinland's planets, a new status quo has emerged from the gunsmoke and blood. While clashes between Imperial and Federal formations and militias remain commonplace, the capitol buildings on New Berlin, Hamburg and Stuttgart have all raised the Imperial banner. Earlier today, the admirals of the Rheinland Military formally recognised the legitimacy of the Imperial civilian government and reaffirmed their commitment to a renewed Rheinland state and democracy.

While workplaces begin to reopen and a semblance of normalcy returns to the region's population centres, deep divisions remain apparent that are unlikely to be healed soon. Military and Police wrecks litter the Trade Lanes and orbital paths around Stuttgart, New Berlin and Frankfurt, providing stark testament to the ferocity of the ongoing fighting. The charred ruins of many of the Battleships Karlsruhe and Altenburg's support ships are emblematic of the deep fractures that split the Military once the Civil War began in earnest. Despite proclamations of victory, it is also clear that the fighting is far from over, with Frankfurt remaining a heavily contested system and access to Munich practically severed altogether.

In its maiden speech, the Imperial Government announced its intention to "restore the pride and dignity of Rheinland" through a number of measures intended to tackle the House's endemic political and corporate corruption. Most controversial was the declaration that the titles of Empire and Emperor would be restored, with the restoration of the royal line of Empress Freidmann to the throne. The spokesman on New Berlin described the Emperor's role as a 'constitutional safeguard' to protect Rheinland's culture and way of life, and promised new elections once Federalist 'violent radicals' had been brought to justice. The revival of the Empire has drawn furious condemnation from the exiled Chancellor Neumann, who decried the move as a "treasonous" return to the "aristocratic oligarchy that caused the Popular Revolution".

What the restoration of a Rheinland Empire will mean for neighbouring Houses also remains an open question. The Imperial Party had long campaigned on a populist platform of trade protectionism. This harkened back to the Old Empire's own policies, from which the party drew its name. This included strict prohibitions on foreign agricultural competition, and heavy restrictions on non-Rheinland corporations operating in New Berlin. While it is currently unclear to what extent the new government will enact these earlier promises, the Sirian financial markets have reacted with volatility to the uncertainty. Liberty has also issued a sharp warning cautioning against anticompetitive government interference in commercial affairs on Planet Stuttgart.

Following the escape of the majority of the Federal government from New Berlin during the earliest days of the revolution, a powerful opposition has begun to coalesce in the Thuringia System. Operating from the fortress-world of Weimar, the Federal Government has reiterated that it still remains Rheinland's legitimate government, and will continue to fight against those it considers to be violent usurpers. The Imperial government has also confirmed that it considers the Federalists to be criminals to be brought to justice. It appears unlikely that there will be any peaceful resolution or reconciliation to the ongoing conflict.

This ongoing diversion of resources from border security and policing has also resulted in an increase in pirate and terrorist activity across the region. Red Hessian forces have taken advantage of the chaos to evict the Bounty Hunter garrison of Cologne and seize the system for themselves. Confederal Gallic forces have deployed to the system in response.

56522.text: [827 AS] Rheinland Plunges into Civil War

56523.text:
NEW BERLIN -- 827 AS -- Following weeks of escalating political tensions and sporadic violence, Rheinland has plunged into civil war. After last month's federal elections, Chancellor Neumann successfully retained control of the government by entering into a minority coalition with the United Democratic Foundation. The radical reformist party secured a number of concessions and promises in exchange for their cooperation. Violent protests and counter-protests erupted across Planet New Berlin and Hamburg after officials mooted the legalisation of the Bundschuh movement as the coalition's first formal motion.

Federal authorities had been accused by the Rheinland Imperial Party of perpetrating a brutal crackdown in response, and repressing their supporters arbitrarily. Government representatives accused Imperialist activists of domestic terrorism in return, vowing a proportionate police response. This cycle of public disorder and reprisal has led to an escalating succession of violence, ultimately exploding into open civil war over the course of the day. Intercommunal conflict is now rife, having spread to all of Rheinland's major planets.

This has culminated in Imperial sympathising politicians and officers declaring that the current Federal government is illegitimate and instituting their own administration. This attempt to seize power has revealed stark divisions across all Federal agencies. Large numbers of Rheinland Military and Federal Police officers have pledged allegiance to the Imperial coup, with opposition from state intelligence agencies and a number of elite Military formations. It is known that the Federal Government and many senior officials were evacuated from New Berlin by intelligence personnel as Imperial militias closed in, and are now mustering in the Thuringia System.

It is believed that Imperial forces have largely secured Planet Hamburg as a base of operations, and are rapidly gaining ground on Planet New Berlin. Federalist objectives so far appear to focus on regrouping and consolidating after the shocking uprising, with their forces concentrating in Frankfurt, Stuttgart and Thuringia. Planet Stuttgart has also become a critical focus for both factions, with the Imperials aiming to prevent the Federalists from inflicting another embarrassing blow by evacuating senior government officials. Transports are being rushed to the breadbasket world in order to ship in weapons and secure valuable personnel. It is currently unclear how this situation will develop, with both sides reportedly firing on civilian vessels supporting the other's activities.

56525.text:
MINATO -- 827 AS -- Crayterian Defense Ministry spokesperson Lee Adams issued a statement earlier today regarding reports concerning the recent advance of the Outcast offensive into Crayter held space in the Taus.

"As of last night, we have recieved reports that the Captana and Basilica fleets have pushed into Tau 44, and have assembled in a threatening posture against our forces in the system. Although the Maltese have not issued any formal declaration of their intent, it is safe to assume that they mean to commit genocide against the Crayterian people. Tau 44 is our home. We have braved far worse and against far more dangerous enemies, and we have survived thus far - as we will continue to by our own strength."

Carrier Group Hades, consisting of the flagship of the Crayterian fleet and an additional two carriers, Zagreus and Macaria, will take a brave stand against the Outcast menace.

56528.text: [743 AGS] The Government wants to silence you!

56529.text:
BRUNOY -- 743 AGS -- Bonjour mes amis! I have interrupted this broadcast to bring you a special news bulletin that our government doesn't want you to know about! Did you know the former Council is backing the Hessians to block our trade to Rheinland? Oui oui! I saw it with my own deux eyes! A battleship entered the Aveyron Nebula just last Tuesday! What more evidence do you need?

Meanwhile the Royal Enclave has snuck the king back into power, ruling from the shadows with eyes glowing purple! He is possessed I tell you! And not only that, but the entire government is corrupt! "Reformation" Hah. You all better all be prepared my brothers and sisters, the worst is yet to come! We have to protect our loved ones!

Whatever you do, don't drink the wine from New Paris. They have laced it with microchips they will use to control your body. A little cooperation project of our 'beloved' government and Technocracy!

I hope you all enjoyed my little segment of truth, until we meet again!

Mak. E.

56551.text: STUTTGART -- 828 AS -- The enemies of Synth Foods in the Houses of Rheinland and Kusari have always had near identical motivations. Both wish to oust the Liberty corporation from what they perceive as their land, and it seems the groups have decided to act in concert to do just that. Attacks against the food giant's vessels have multiplied and are now being launched on an interhouse scale, likely in retaliation for Synth Foods' operations recovering in Rheinland while making inroads into the Kusari market too. It remains to be seen how this united Farmers Alliance will impact affairs on the wider stage, with the security forces of both Houses already strained by internal conflict and crime.

60208.text:
A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Valhalla Research (later renamed Ageira Technologies), these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation. 

Ageira licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system. 

WARNING: Do not approach a planet and attempt a landing without using the docking ring.

60210.text: A Jump Gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'Jump Gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'\n\nAgeira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.

60212.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings consistent with a 'jump hole'.

Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.

60214.text: A small base dedicated to the manufacture of goods.

60222.text: A medium sized base, usually a hub for goods and equipment traders.

60224.text: A station capable of mining valuable gases out of nebulae.

60226.text: Used for mining valuable minerals out of asteroid fields.

60228.text: A base built into a large ice asteroid.

60230.text: A base built into a large asteroid.

60232.text: An enormous structure used in the construction, maintenance and repair of large ships.

60234.text: Used for peering deeper into space, it has both scientific and military applications.

60236.text: A relay station for local and deep space communications.

60238.text: A unit used to capture space gasses and dust for later refinement.

60246.text: Trade lanes are used for superluminal travel within a system. Trade lanes must be entered from their origin point, usually located near key industrial, military, or civilian bases.\n\nThe first Trade Lane was established through a joint venture between the corporations now known as Deep Space Engineering and Ageira Technologies in the year 280 AS. By 350 AS, most of Liberty space was crisscrossed by Trade Lanes. Through financing from Interspace Commerce, the Trade Lane network was rapidly extended into the other colonies, helping to create a truly sector-wide economy. Trade lanes are the fastest and safest method of transporting goods and personnel within and between the colonies. Plans to expand the Trade Lanes to connect interests in the independent territories outside of the colonies are pending.

60252.text: Storage Tanks can contain fuel, water, or oxygen.

Commissioned in 739 AS, the Battleship Yukon has patrolled the California system for over eighty years. It was originally scheduled to be decommissioned in 805 AS had it not been for a successful campaign by the residents of Los Angeles that resulted in the Yukon being sent for a complete overhaul, extending its operational lifespan until 825 AS.

The Battleship has been an integral part of the Liberty Navy's efforts to keep the Lane Hackers and Liberty Rogues under some semblance of control within the system, with limited successes to date. Previously, patrols would start out at the Yukon's former position close to Los Angeles before heading into Magellan, Cortez, and occasionally Ontario, to assist traders and put down unruly pirates from the independent systems.

Due to increased Gallic activity within the Manchester and Magellan systems, the Yukon has been stationed outside of California for the first time. Near the independent world of Curacao, it serves as a patrol point and major command center for the combined forces of the treaty allies of the region, while retaining a vigilant watch over Bretonia's key arterial trade route.

65565.mapped:
The Jeju Mining Facility was constructed by the IMG in 827 AS, following the discovery of Euxenite and Gadolinite pockets on the moon Tango. Built after a period of turbulence with their other operations as a result of the Gallic War and the Aland Crisis, Jeju is considered a glimmer of hope for the IMG by many as Euxenite and Gadolinite are rich in traces of various valuable metals. Tango's pockets of these minerals proved to have an unusual high concentration of Scandium, a rare material in permanent demand as it is a crucial part for the manufacturing of laser crystals.

It is rumored that the base is frequented by unlawful elements looking to pick up supplies and trade. These rumors are based on the reputation of the Guild in Bretonia and Rheinland for off the record support of elements that can harm their competition, with Samura and GMS being their main competitors in Tottori and Tau-53.The undeveloped nature of Tottori allowed the IMG to stake their claim to mining operations locally, however the Kusari governments recent attempts to develop the system by connecting to Tottori and ultimately Kyushu are a business risk, and efforts to slow the progress of this development indirectly benefit the Guild. Another threat to IMG operations in Tottori is the presence of Farmers Alliance, who are notoriously hostile towards non-Kusari corporate interests, and ruthlessly attack Guild mining operations and trade convoys.

However, due to the high presence of the Farmer Alliance, who are notoriously hostile towards non-Kusari corporate interests, the IMG faces frequent, ruthless attacks on their mining operations and trade convoys. As a result of the Farmers attacks, the base is currently running at low capacity due as vital components of the station are still in need of being finalized and the establishing of mines on Tango processes slowly.

65581.mapped:
Built in 288 AS, shortly after the construction of the New Berlin to Dresden Jump Gate, Bautzen Station supports the Kruger Minerals mining operations in the Dresden system. Smaller than the rival Daumann facility at Leipzig, Kruger chose to focus solely on the extraction of Diamonds from the shifting clouds and rogue asteroids that populate Dresden, particularly in the Schwefelnebel. It is from here that the famous blue diamonds, also known as "Hessian Tears" originated, mined from the lava fields of Dresden by Kruger miners. The vast majority of the diamonds mined in Dresden are used in industrial drills, as their quality is usually not good enough for the luxury goods markets.

Bautzen has been in operation for more than five centuries, and the station has seen better times. Old infrastructure combined with a dwindling supply of diamonds in the Schwefelnebel lead many to believe that Kruger is planning to decommission the base within the next decade, or sooner if the risk posed by the Red Hessians becomes too great. The station has found a slight respite in late 817, as prospectors located an area in the southern end of the Schwefelwolke which still had a considerable amount of Diamonds. Bautzen's mining operations now focus on that area.

65583.mapped:
Leipzig Station used to be the main ore processing and smelting operation for Daumann Heavy Construction in Dresden. The station was seized by the Red Hessians in early 818, but not before Daumann had already moved the bulk of its industrial hardware to The Ring, where it was more secure. Daumann had been aware for centuries that the unforgiving environment of Dresden, along with the increasing Hessian raids against both the base and the ships moving cargo to and from it, as well as the ever-reducing yields from the mining operations, meant that it would not be costeffective to maintain Leipzig indefinitely.

When the Hessians boarded and seized control, they found an almost empty shell remaining. The massive foundries and nuclear furnaces were still there - too large to be moved, but the more delicate fabrication machinery used in the construction of High-Temperature Alloys were gone - leading many Hessians to suspect Daumann was aware of their intentions. Nevertheless, the Hessians have started to make good use of what part of the station remains. The Kierwolke provides a natural barrier against the massive Rheinland capital fleet, which seems more intent to defend Bautzen then to reclaim Leipzig.

Intending to expand the Kingdom's influence in the Dublin system, it was ambushed by Molly bombers and turned into little more than a hulk. Originally built in 744 AS, Graves Station is known as the single most lucrative mining operation in Bretonian space. Despite being within the bloodiest battleground Bretonia has ever engaged in combat in, Graves Station mines a substantial amount of gold from the nearby Graves Asteroid Field, the richest source of gold yet found in Sirius.

Despite being such a successful operation, Graves is more famous for it's history. Originally owned by Graves Mining Inc., the station was the site of the infamous Founder's Day Revolution, or, more commonly known as the birth date of the Molly Revolutionary organisation, when miners aboard the station rebelled against Lord Edmund Graves, the head of Graves Mining Inc., for the dismal wages and horrible conditions he forced his workers to endure.

After the revolt the government temporarily took control of the station to restore order, although these days it is again run by BMM and Lord Edmund's daughter, Selena Graves, is the current station commandant. She has spent a considerable amount of time and money to right the wrongs of her father and the miners are generally paid a generous wage for the dangers inherent in their work, though a contingent of BPA constables are permanently stationed on board to dissuade any future misconduct.

Originally constructed by DSE as a supply depot for the Chugoku jump gate project, this station was turned over to the Kusari State Police before the construction was even finished, to provide security from the near constant raids by Blood Dragons attempting to keep the gate from coming online. Even though the gate failed to properly target the Chugoku system, the Blood Dragons have made repeated attempts to destroy the gate.

Built under siege, Otaru Border Station became fully operational in 822 AS, and its role expanded from overseeing traffic at the Gate to broader defensive operations along the trade lanes. As suspicions between Kusari and Gallia rose along the Tau border, the base was improved again to better ward off any suprise attack, as well as the influx of foreign criminals which Kusari has seen cross their borders. Its improved armament is now thought to have lasting power in even the heaviest of combat and Blood Dragon raids on the station and the gate have been significantly reduced for the time being.

The Osaka Storage Facility was built in 350 AS by Samura Industries, and is the largest facility of its type in the Sirius sector. Originally, fuel shipments from the Crow Nebula were stored here for the Gas Miners Guild before being shipped across Sirius to various markets, but ever since the GMG-Kishiro alliance was signed, the amount of fuel stored at the facility has declined.

Security at the facility has always remained tight, especially in the light of recent attacks and infiltration attempts by the Blood Dragons. With the recently constructed trade lane to the Okinawa jump gate located at the planet Honshu bringing in more H-Fuel shipments, traffic past the station has decreased dramatically, leading some to speculate that Samura may be forced to sell the facility off to Kishiro or the GMG in the near future. Samura still makes use of the station however, storing and processing H-Fuel gases mined in Hokkaido before shipping them to Liberty or Rheinland.

Perpetually swathed in its trademark smog storms, planet Leeds is a vast metropolis of manufacturing facilities, smelters, processing plants and environmentally sealed apartment blocks. Centuries of industrial abuse aided and abetted by morally corrupt corporations, lack of official oversight and severe overpopulation have lead to the planet being the symbol of everything the Green Front, and their unlawful counterparts the Gaians, fight against.

The Leeds system was quickly recognised as the most resource rich system under Bretonian control during the House's formative years. Many new companies, including Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing, were given near carte blanche to develop the system as they saw fit, and many colonists were given extremely generous incentives in order to move to Leeds and serve as the workforce. The planetary population has since climbed steadily, and the last census of the Leeds system in 810 AS listed the planet as having over 2.2 billion inhabitants, making it arguably the most heavily populated planet in the Sirius sector. This number has since been decimated by repeated wars and the threat of invasion. An exact census has not been taken in over five years, but it is expected the planet houses no more than 500.000 people as of 818 AS, a number that is still rapidly declining.

Planet Leeds has suffered considerably from the continuous threat of hostile invasion. When it became clear that the Gallic Royal Navy would breach Leeds and lay siege to the planet, the ground contingent on Planet Leeds began fortifying themselves against an orbital assault. Using the deep mines and large subterranean industrial complexes which are practically impervious to orbital bombardment as shelters, the Armed Forces on Leeds and the Gallic Marines invading are both prepared for a long and bloody conflict in extremely hazardous conditions.

One of the frontrunners of the Toitsu class, the Hyono deployed from Kure Shipyard in 825 AS, shortly before the Saigon War with Rheinland. Following the destruction of Ibusuki Survey Platform in Sigma-21, the Hyono fleet was dispatched to aid the Gas Miners Guild against the Rheinland Military. While the ship's expanded hangar bays initially allowed generous strike wings to contest Planet Saigon, the tide dramatically turned with the arrival of Rheinland reinforcements. By exploiting Sigma-21's open space, the Bayern and Westfalen fleets forced their enemies to fight on unfavorable terms, inflicting heavy casualties. The Hyono was damaged during the 826 AS rout back to Honshu, where it regrouped to rally a defense.

Using the cover of Honshu's Hiryo Cloud, the Hyono and other KNF elements succeeded in holding the Rheinland fleets at bay, while severing their Sigma-21 supply lines. Following the war's end, the battleship was sent for extensive repairs and refits at Kure Shipyard. Its next assignment in 827 AS shocked Sirius, when a significant Kusari military buildup along the Tau borders was justified as a dispute with the Crayter Republic. While the KNF did then expel the Republic from Tau-31, this was a pretext for maneuvering their fleets closer to the Gallic border to launch a surprise invasion. As a result, Gallic Confederal forces were taken by surprise when the Hyono, Nagasaki, and Yamaguchi fleets swung north into Tau-23.

The Kusari fleet rapidly scattered the local Tau garrison and destroyed Cheronsee Outpost, to avoid a time-consuming boarding attempt. Breaching the Languedoc Jump Gate, the Hyono was met by the Battleship Cassard, which was heavily damaged and driven off. The Hyono then advanced with the Nagasaki alongside the Trade Lanes, and was responsible for disabling Nimes Station while the Nagasaki destroyed Quillan's spaceports. It later participated in the Battles of Ales, scuttling Fourchambalt Shipyard late in the year when the joint Confederal-Enclave counter-offensive was launched. The Hyono was eventually lost while retreating back towards the Taus, falling to the Warwolf cannon of the Enclave's Battleship Rocroi.

Liverpool Border Station was the command center for the Bretonia Police Authority in the Manchester System and had been tasked with suppressing the smugglers, pirates, and Lane Hackers who use the local ice fields for cover.

Following a demand by House Liberty, a sizable force of the Bretonian navy assigned to the system was deployed to assist Liberty in its efforts to tear the Insurgency out by the roots. This would leave Manchester quite vulnerable should an uptick in criminal activity occur, which it soon would.

With faith in the Government at an all time low, many of Bretonia's resident dissidents found their ranks swelling with people who would like to see the spineless reap their reward. Liverpool eventually fell prey to this wave of anger and dissatisfaction in the wake of the Vespucci slaughter. An event that has shaken public opinion and rattled parliament.

In the early years of the Kusari Shogunate, foreign immigration was strictly controlled and permanent foreign settlement on New Tokyo were strictly forbidden. While the Shogunate was unwilling to bend these rules, it still accommodated foreign business interests by constructing Roppongi Station in 318 AS. Roppongi quickly became home to large numbers of elite repatriates from New York and New London who had long term business interests in Kusari. Roppongi later became the focal point of the 521 AS Kusari-Rheinland Nationalization Crisis, when both Houses seized their Trade Lanes and Jump Gates, expelling Interspace Commerce in the process.

Interspace was permitted to return in the aftermath of the 80-Years War between Rheinland and the GMG, owing to financial transactions between Kusari and Liberty and quickly established several major offices on Roppongi. By the time of the short-lived Kusari Republic, many of the restrictions on foreign companies had been lifted in the interests of progress. Roppongi became a busy trade center and luxury concourse, bustling with corporations, local celebrities and thronging crowds of New Tokyo socialites. Most of the major houses maintained their Kusari embassies or consular services aboard.

In 832 AS, a nuclear dirty bomb was detonated in the station’s lower hangars. Although emergency bulkheads were able to prevent complete disintegration, the interior was heavily irradiated and swept by fires that smoldered for months after. The attack provoked immediate outrage from the other Houses due to the heavy loss of life, and the destruction of embassy facilities. Kusari now faces intense pressure to crack down on the Farmer’s Alliance, who claimed responsibility for the attack. As of 834 AS, Samura Heavy Industries is leading efforts to decontaminate and dismantle the station.

65758.text:
Ithaca Research Station was one of two government research stations that, as part of a generously funded scientific experiment, had been tasked since 711 AS with studying the Badlands. Although the details and findings of this experiment remain a closely guarded secret of Ageira Technologies to this day, several points of interest have nonetheless leaked to the public.

Ithaca and her smaller sister Benford had operated under classified conditions from the very beginning, and civilian traffic around both stations was strictly restricted. The focus of their research appeared to be the spatial anomalies occurring naturally in the Badlands, and the presence of an attached jump gate suggested that these findings and local conditions were being leveraged to extend the range of jump gates, without venturing into what are known as super gates.

Work on this jump gate appeared to have concluded in 761 AS, when the costs of running the experiment began to rise for unspecified reasons. The gate was deactivated as a result, but never dismantled, and later found a second life when a matching gate in Pennsylvania became operational. Research programmes continued at Ithaca and Benford for several more decades, before Ithaca was completely abandoned and stripped as part of austerity measures in 794 AS, and Benford was destroyed during a naval military operation in 800 AS, the details of which remain classified to this day.

The remains of both stations thus stand today as a reminder of an era of ambitious scientific projects, with budgets that the civilian scientific community of the present day can only dream of.

Ennibeck Spaceport is a large civilian installation in Omicron Delta built, owned and operated by Daumann Heavy Construction and it is located in close proximity to Nauru.

Ennibeck Spaceport's founding dates back to when the Core was looking for potential partners in their bid for the exploitation of rich Iridium deposits located within Omicron Delta and DHC was the only corporation willing and capable to invest vast resources into this joint venture.

The station itself is a marvel of Sirian engineering as it was pre-assembled in smaller pieces back in Rheinland and then moved under its own power to its current location for completion. It is also fitted with the most advanced technology to keep the station itself as self-reliant as possible in order to keep its running costs low.

Despite all of the technological solutions and careful business calculations, the Omicrons prove to be difficult territory for Daumann to operate in. Even all of the Core's security experiences and assets are not enough for the station and its administrations to make this joint venture profitable for Daumann. While the spaceport remains relatively safe due to its proximity to Planet Nauru, a large portion of incoming or departing DHC convoys are intercepted en-route by the various hostile and armed groups and factions. The onboard maintenance crew is also complaining that the station has been severely over-engineered, which prolongs and complicates the sourcing of any suitable spare parts deep within the Omicrons.

As all these costs, losses and complications are slowly adding up, the future of Ennibeck Spaceport is uncertain at best as its operation turns out to be a financial nightmare for DHC despite all of their efforts.
