CLASS: Cochrane
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 250
590110.mapped:
While Tau-31 was considered infeasible for development by Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing (BMM), the smaller Independent Miners Guild (IMG) -- was eager to exploit areas in which BMM feared to tread. The IMG repressurised an abandoned depot left over from the Trade Lane construction and began to harvest large quantities of pure Water and Oxygen ice in the system. Water and Oxygen were shipped to Harris to supply the vast requirements of the terraforming effort.

The invasion of Kusari, and later Gallia, ended this arrangement. During the Gallic Invasion, the station briefly became a gathering point for civilian refugees from Harris, until they could be smuggled away to Kusari. After the Crayter Republic routed the Royal Navy's garrison at New Tours in 826 AS, the Carrier Hades was stationed to keep watch at Holman. Relations between Crayter and the Guild collapsed when the IMG refused to lend Aland Shipyard to Bretonia during the most desperate stage of the war. The Republic intervened to assist Bretonia in the resulting struggle, resulting in bitter mutual suspicion ever since - an attitude exemplified by Holman's guards.

Since the end of the war and the return of Planet Harris to Bretonian control, Holman has resumed supplying the Planetform terraforming project with bulk Water and Oxygen deliveries. The removal of nearby Crayter Republic military checkpoints has also seen an air normalcy return to the station for the first time in nearly two decades. As a result, Holman has been scheduled for significant renovations, to undo decades of patch repairs and neglect.

590112.mapped: The Independent Miners Guild (IMG) established Falkland Base on an asteroid in the Tau-37 system soon after the construction of Freeport 10. Falkland has easy access to the rich deposits of Niobium in the system, a mineral rare enough to make the high-risk effort involved in mining and transporting it back to the colonies extremely profitable. However, Falkland and other IMG operations are subject to frequent attacks by the Outcasts, making life aboard the base a dangerous proposition at best. In the IMG, Falkland has a reputation of being an operation that attracts miners who enjoy to live on the edge. The miners who sign up on Falkland leave either rich, or dead.

590116.mapped:
Intended to replace older versions of the Overlord-class, the Arkansas was put into service as a state-of-the-art battleship, with crews of other warships eager to fly under its emblem.

With Liberty deploying its fleets elsewhere, the Arkansas was tasked with one seemingly simple task – securing the Texas penitentiary system. Beginning this new mission in 825 AS, it has since also been entrusted with sending patrols into the nearby frontier systems, thus continuing Liberty's traditional desire for expansion.

While the Navy has continued to provide patrols along important trade junctions, due to its proximity to Houston, the Arkansas also services wings of Bounty Hunter patrols returning from missions deeper into Texan space, acting as a brief refueling point before the fighters depart.

590118.mapped: This Junker base is rumoured to be the centre of slavery in Liberty, although little has been proven to date; shady shipments often depart to the southwest, that much is certain. Hidden deep within the North Dallas Debris Field, it is frequented by Liberty Rogues and Outcasts; this is the furthest south in Sirius that Outcasts will ever come. Disgruntled Xenos seeking to displace their Junker competitors in the cardamine trade launch sporadic attacks against Beaumont; though the occasional missile breaches the perimeter, no serious harm has yet been caused. Said cardamine often changes hands here; drug runners hailing from as far away as the Edge Worlds make port here to fuel Liberty's orange dream. The Beaumont bar is perhaps Liberty's most prime source of gossip and information; murderers lurk in the shadowy corners, ready to divest themselves of dark secrets, adventurers discuss their latest exploits, and the Junkers know everything there is to know, for a price.

590120.mapped:
Houston is an arid world whose population has slowly increased since settlement; these mostly consist of what Manhattanites would term "the economically undesirable", many of them former inmates of the orbiting prison stations. The cheap labour force has attracted a number of industries, however, including a major Deep Space Engineering manufacturing plant specializing in Nanocapacitor production.

Houston's biggest industry, however, is fuelled by Liberty's criminal element; the vast majority of Libertonian prisoners are housed in the system and prison gangs from the Huntsville and the Sugarland, as well as rehabilitated former inmates looking to go straight, power Texan industries.

Both the Liberty Police, Inc. and the Bounty Hunters Guild maintain their respective local headquarters on the planet; the Bounty Hunters Guild is thicker here than anywhere else in Sirius. After all, not only forcing prisoners to labour is profitable; capturing them is vital, too. Houston is most often "visited" by (former and current) Liberty Rogues and Xenos.

Apart from the prisoners and jailers, the Bounty Hunters Guild also maintains an onboard presence in the event of any unforeseen escape attempts. The prison features several small manufacturing plants operated by DSE, that rely heavily on manual labor - a resource the LPI have plenty of.

INMATES: 49740
590124.mapped: The prison station Sugarland, under the control of Liberty Police, Inc. (LPI), was built in 600 AS to handle the overflow from Huntsville. Sugarland is particularly hard time, as a smelter worked by prison labor operates around the clock to re-process scrap from the Texas and New York debris fields. Apart from the prison population, a large contingent of LPI officers, Bounty Hunters, and representatives of ALG Waste Disposal round out the personnel on board.

590125.text: The prison station Sugarland, under the control of Liberty Police, Inc. (LPI), was built in 600 AS to handle the overflow from Huntsville. Sugarland is particularly hard time, as a smelter worked by prison labor operates around the clock to re-process scrap from the Texas and New York debris fields. Apart from the prison population, a large contingent of LPI officers, Bounty Hunters, and representatives of ALG Waste Disposal round out the personnel on board.

590126.text:
CLASS: Honkyo
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: RESTRICTED
AMENITIES: Complete
CREW: CLASSIFIED

>>>HIGH SECURITY<<<
590126.mapped:
Heaven's Gate was once one of the wonders of Kusari - a massive space fortress built to shelter the Emperor, laden with enough defenses to render any assault pointless. Aside from being a massive bastion, the Arch also holds some of Kusari's finest artistic designs, including the "Waterfall of Light".

After the coup of 330 AS, Heaven's Gate fell out of favor. Samura felt the Emperor would be a stronger figurehead if he was visible, so the throne remained on New Tokyo. Unwilling to let this marvel of Kusari culture decay, the Arch was kept operational, serving as an archive for Kusari's most guarded secrets and precious treasures.

The base was loaned to Governor Tekagi during the Colony Wars, where it served as his personal retreat and command center for managing the Rheinland threat. Blood Dragon and Order terrorists were able to penetrate the base once during the War, stealing an important Artifact and murdering Tekagi in a cold-blooded political assassination.

In the aftermath of the Colony Wars, Shogun Edo decreed the creation of the Kusari Office of Intelligence (KOI), appointing several senior Lords and admirals as its first commanders. The KOI had a broad mandate to take necessary measures to eradicate dangerous foreign groups like The Order that reside beyond the reach of traditional Kusari forces. The organization has grown substantially since then, siting its headquarters aboard Heaven's Gate.

590127.text:
CLASS: Yosai
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 290
590127.mapped:
When the Order learned of the subversion taking place around the Heaven's Gate, they contacted the Blood Dragons to discuss an alliance to counter this threat to humanity. The Blood Dragons agreed to assist the Order, realising the threat to mankind and the danger to their own people if the Nomads would be successful in taking over the leaders of Kusari. With funding and supplies smuggled in by the Order, they constructed a small outpost in Tohoku, from which they could spy on Heaven's Gate. The base also played a brief role in the Nomad Wars, when it became a staging area for the Blood Dragons while they prepared for an infiltration of Heaven's Gate to retrieve an important artifact called the Proteus Tome.

Ryukyu still keeps watch over the goings-on at Heaven's Gate. The Order still has agents aboard the station who coordinate actions between the Blood Dragons and Order forces in the Omicrons. The base also repairs and resupplies supply ships moving between Chugoku and the research outpost in Okinawa if they have come under attack.

590128.text:
When the Order learned of the subversion taking place around the Heaven's Gate, they contacted the Blood Dragons to discuss an alliance to counter this threat to humanity. The Blood Dragons agreed to assist the Order, realising the threat to mankind and the danger to their own people if the Nomads would be successful in taking over the leaders of Kusari. With funding and supplies smuggled in by the Order, they constructed a small outpost in Tohoku, from which they could spy on Heaven's Gate. The base also played a brief role in the Nomad Wars, when it became a staging area for the Blood Dragons while they prepared for an infiltration of Heaven's Gate to retrieve an important artifact called the Proteus Tome.

Ryukyu still keeps watch over the goings-on at Heaven's Gate. The Order still has agents aboard the station who coordinate actions between the Blood Dragons and Order forces in the Omicrons. The base also repairs and resupplies supply ships moving between Chugoku and the research outpost in Okinawa if they have come under attack.

590129.text: A large field of ice asteroids, entirely depleted of any pure water ice by the failed Los Angeles terraforming operation. The Sierra Field has little value today except as cover for the Rogues -- pirates who attack shipments passing along the nearby Trade Lanes to and from Los Angeles.

590130.text: A nebula of ice crystals. Two Trade Lanes pass through the cloud, but the presence of the San Diego Border Station and frequent Navy patrols discourage attacks. Rogues, Lane Hackers, and Outcasts are the most commonly spotted criminals. Willard Research Station is located deep within the Tahoe cloud, but the exact nature of its research is classified by the Liberty Navy.

590131.text: A large field of ice asteroids -- though most of the pure water ice has already been consumed in the failed effort to terraform Los Angeles. The remainder of the field, however, provides cover for a wide range of criminal activities, including drug running and attacks against the nearby Trade Lane. Despite the best attempts by the Liberty Navy to capture those responsible, criminals who manage to escape into Whitney almost always elude pursuit.

590132.text: A medium-sized asteroid field notable for its large deposits of Beryllium. A branch of the Independent Miners Guild (IMG) based on the Cardiff Mining Facility had been working the field with lucrative results, despite occasional raids by Corsairs who have managed to circumvent the Cambridge Line, until the station was seized by Bretonian authorities following the IMG's declaration of hostilities over Aland Shipyard. BMM is currently in the process of restarting mining operations within the field.

590133.text: A thick cloud of small ice asteroids. The refractive nature of the cloud tends to confuse most scanners, providing excellent cover for Corsairs who launch raids across the Cambridge Line.

590134.text: A thick cloud of small ice asteroids. The refractive nature of the cloud tends to confuse most scanners, providing excellent cover for Corsairs who often launch attacks on the Trade Lane to the Omega-3 Jump Gate.

590135.text: A large rock asteroid field, used as cover by particularly bold Corsairs to attack traffic to and from the New London Gate. It contains no minerals of economic value.

590136.text: A large rock asteroid field. Initial surveys indicated no ore or other resources worth mining. Alamosa is a favorite refuge of Rogues and Lane Hackers attempting to escape capture by the Liberty Navy.

590137.text: A large rock asteroid field. Initial surveys indicated no ore or other resources worth mining. This field is often frequented by Rogues.

590138.text: Like most of the resources in Colorado, the famed Copperton Field has long since been exhausted. Trace amounts of copper remain. Xenos are active within the field.

590139.text: Once the major source of Silver for all of Liberty, the Silverton Field has been mined to rubble and dust. Within the field is the former site of an Ageira Technologies manufacturing facility, abandoned over a century ago in favor of Pueblo Station, it now houses a large contingent of Xenos. Trace amounts of Silver remain.

590140.text: A medium-sized field of ice asteroids. Most of the Rogue activity in the system seems centered here, though the Liberty Navy has yet to take any decisive action.

590141.text: A medium-sized cloud of ice crystals. Rogues frequently hide in the mists, awaiting luxury cargos and passengers from Liberty bound for the pleasure planet of Curacao.

590142.text: A medium-sized cloud of ice crystals. A popular hiding place for Rogues and Lane Hackers to attack Trade Lane traffic to and from Manchester.

590143.text: A field of Copper and Cobalt bearing asteroids. Daumann Heavy Construction used to heavily mine the resources present from their base on Leipzig Station. In its prime, this field produced the bulk of Copper and Cobalt in the Sirius Sector for centuries -- making it an irresistible target for Red Hessian pirates. By 818 AS, most economically viable deposits had been exhausted, leading Daumann to abandon Leipzig Station. Since then, Hessians have prospected the field to wring out the last remaining resources for their own use. These operations have been heavily disrupted by Rheinland Military and Corsair attacks since 832 AS.

590144.text: A field of lava asteroids. Unfortunately, the field is too close to the sun and consequently too molten for mining. Bautzen Station once sat at the edge of the field, until its destruction at the hands of the Rheinland Military in 832 AS.

590145.text:
>>>WARNING: SEVERE DANGER<<<
The cloud is a swirling mass of sulfuric acid and hydrogen sulfide that will corrode the Hull Panels of even an armored, shielded ship in a relatively short amount of time. Because of its toxic nature and intense Hessian presence, the cloud was never fully explored. Rheinland has long suspected the Red Hessians' headquarters is located within the cloud, launching an attack to locate it in 832 AS.

590146.text: A large sulfur cloud containing lava asteroids. In the past diamonds could often be found floating freely within the cloud and were collected by Kruger Minerals, who operated from nearby Bautzen Station. However, due to decreasing yields as time went on and an overwhelming increase in pirate activity, Kruger eventually had no choice but to abandon the system.

590147.text: A small field of lava asteroids that is heavily frequented by Red Hessians. Since the destruction of Leipzig Station, the field has mainly been used as a waypoint for smugglers.

590148.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
The Founder's Gold Field is the richest pocket of free-floating Gold in the Sirius Sector. It was once exclusively claimed by BMM, who ringed the area with a minefield to control all access. While the destruction of Graves Station largely halted BMM's operations, extremely dangerous wildcat mining continues.

NOTE: The Mollys claim control over Dublin; they will attack any outsiders who enter areas under their control.

590149.text:
Near the wreck of the Hood lies an asteroid field, already plundered of any Gold it may have once held. Currently the field is the site of an extremely hazardous race course that the jaded inhabitants of the Hood once liked to run when hopped up on the sunshine that passes for alcohol aboard the ship. Racing has largely halted following the Hood’s destruction, save by the Corsairs who now control the area.

NOTE: The Mollys claim control over Dublin; they will attack any outsiders who enter areas under their control.

590150.text:
A medium-sized asteroid field with Gold deposits, once worked by independent miners from the Hood who were generally unfriendly to anyone who might lay stake to their claims. Mining has largely ceased since the destruction of the Hood. Large numbers of Corsairs are present within the field.

NOTE: The Mollys claim control over Dublin; they will attack any outsiders who enter areas under their control.

590151.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
After the Founder's Day Revolt and the subsequent bloody reprisals by the Bretonian Armed Forces, the majority of the Mollys took refuge in this asteroid field, ringing the perimeter with a treacherous minefield. Deposits of Gold scattered throughout the field previously funded much of the Mollys' efforts.

NOTE: The Mollys claim control over Dublin; they will attack any outsiders who enter areas under their control.

590152.text: A large cloud of ice crystals, less stunning than the Islay Ice Cloud. Bounty Hunters have encountered former Bretonian Privateers who have turned to piracy here, leading to suspicions that they are operating out of a hideout or an unknown jump hole within the cloud.

590153.text: A beautiful cloud of ice crystals surrounding a field of ice asteroids, the Islay Ice Cloud is considered one of the wonders of Sirius. It is also home to a large contingent of Gaian eco-terrorists who frequently attack unprotected transports.

590154.text: A small ice asteroid field, home to the entry point to Leeds, it is a popular spot for raiders entering Bretonia looking for transports.

590155.text: A large field of rocky asteroids. The Taunusfeld was extensively mined during earlier centuries, however these operations were abandoned during the 80-Years War after much of Frankfurt's workforce was conscripted. The economic crash following the war ensured mining would never resume. The Rheinland Federal Police believe the Bundschuh originate from the field, though they have so far been unable to locate a base of operations. In recent years, Corsairs have also become a significant threat, launching attacks on nearby Trade Lanes from the field.

590156.text: A small ring of ice asteroids, captured in Heidelbergs massive gravity well.

590157.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized cloud of dark matter. Lane Hackers are believed to be taking advantage of the scanner-blocking properties of the cloud to attack traffic throughout the system; however, neither the Liberty nor the Kusari Navies have located their base of operations.

590158.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized cloud of dark matter. Scanners do not function within the confines of the cloud.

590159.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized cloud of dark matter. Because scanners do not function within the cloud, Rogues will often use it to escape pursuit by the military or Bounty Hunters after stealing cargo passing between Liberty and Kusari.

590160.text: A large rocky asteroid field. Preliminary surveys detected no mineral resources of value, with much of the field remaining uncharted. Travel advisories have been issued against travel into the field due to a large number of disappearances in the region.

590161.text: Medium rock asteroid field. The field has no legitimate commercial use, but it has become a haven for Unioner terrorists who commit frequent strikes against traffic around Altona Station and the adjoining Trade Lanes.

590162.text: A small rocky asteroid field, Sudheide was largely ignored due to its lack of meaningful resources until Vierlande Prison was constructed close by. "The Sud" was used by Red Hessians, Unioners, and even Bundschuh to attack prison convoys up until Vierlande Prison's destruction. Today, the field is frequented by smugglers, and pirates looking to hit the nearby Trade Lane.

590163.text: A gaseous cloud. Blood Dragons frequently use the cloud to launch attacks against the Trade Lanes in Hokkaido.

590164.text:
>>>WARNING: SEVERE DANGER<<<
A zone of intense radiation spewed from the active sun at the heart of the system. Instantly lethal to anyone unlucky enough to stumble into the zone unshielded, the radiation levels are high enough to degrade even active shielding over time. Most pilots cross the zone by pulling the "Kyofu Burn" -- shields on full, afterburners on max, follow the navigational buoys, and cross your fingers.

590165.text: A cloud that was only recently found to contain vast reserves of deuterium and helium. Samura, in an effort to gain some control over the H-Fuel market, has begun harvesting operations based at Sapporo Station in a pocket of the cloud near the New Tokyo Jump Gate. A regional cell of Golden Chrysanthemums has taken poorly to their presence.

590166.text: A gaseous cloud. A line of Trade Lanes cuts through the cloud leading the way through the lethally dangerous Kyofu -- and the Kyofu is not the only danger. In recent years the Kusari Naval Forces and Kusari Office of Intelligence have barred civilian access to the cloud, leading many to believe classified experiments are being conducted within. Blood Dragons frequently launch raids from within, targeting government convoys.

590167.text: A nebulous region at the periphery of the Crow Nebula. Outcasts frequently attack traffic along the Trade Lanes to and from the Sigma-19 Jump Gate.

590168.text: A wisp of the Crow Nebula. The presence of the Akita Border Station at the edge of the cloud has done little to discourage Corsair attacks on the Trade Lane leading to the Sigma-13 Jump Gate.

590169.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A cloud of gas that conceals the Kansai Research Center, the location of much of the joint research between Kishiro and the Kusari Naval Forces. While protected by a minefield and automated defense platforms, Kansai is still a frequent target of attacks by Blood Dragons.

590170.text: A large field of rock asteroids that was once mined by Deep Space Engineering. Liberty later abandoned these expensive operations in favor of importing cheaper minerals from Rheinland and Bretonia. A contingent of Xenos from the neighboring Texas System has settled somewhere in the field and make frequent raids on traffic passing through the system.

590171.text: A small field of rock asteroids. Both Xeno and Rogue attacks occur on the Trade Lanes along this field.

590172.text: A large field of rock asteroids. Rheinland authorities believe that Rogues are using the asteroids as cover for their various criminal activities and have increased Military patrols along the nearby Trade Lanes to discourage piracy. Despite recent requests from Liberty, Rheinland has shown little interest in sending patrols into the field to root the Rogues out.

590173.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A small cloud of dark matter. Scanners do not function within the confines of the cloud, making it a popular hiding place for Xenos who attack traffic from Kusari in an effort to drive the so-called "foreign" presence from Liberty.

590174.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
An outcropping of the larger "Kuryo anomaly," a large field of dark matter first charted by the great Kusari explorer Ichi Matsuo. Scanners do not function within the confines of the cloud.

590175.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized cloud of dark matter. Scanners do not function within the confines of the cloud.

590176.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large field of fine particulate matter. The Farmer's Alliance has claimed the field and is believed to take advantage of its scanner-scrambling properties as a means of discussing strategy away from prying eyes and ears.

590177.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large field of fine particulate matter. Scanners work poorly at best within the field, providing excellent concealment for Blood Dragon and Golden Chrysanthemum members to strike against Trade Lane traffic and other targets such as the Nansei Research Complex and Tsushima Depot. The Battleship Nagumo was recently stationed at the edge of the field to keep the Trade Lanes clear and protect the Tau-29 Jump Gate.

590178.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large Crow nebula cloud. Its poor visibility makes it ideal cover for terrorist groups such as the Blood Dragons and the Golden Chrysanthemums.

590179.text: A large cloud of smog that has coalesced over the centuries from the various industrial operations throughout Leeds. Gaians and Outcasts are often sighted within the cloud.

590180.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
This dense uranium asteroid field holds the LD-14 uranium processing center, responsible for producing the majority of MOX used by Bretonia and Kusari. The uranium found within this field is processed by the recently reconstructed LD-14 plant, in addition to imports from Sigma-59. Belvedere originally received uranium from the field but is now forced to rely on imports. The asteroid field and its pockets of radiation provide natural protection against attempts to raid the facility, but the high value of MOX fuel and the various uses for uranium make for a prime target for pirates and terrorists alike.

590181.text: A medium-size asteroid field rich in aluminum, titanium and niobium, Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing (BMM) historically worked the field with great success, smelting and refining raw materials obtained from the field at the massive Stokes smelting facility nearby. Mining operations were occupied by GMS during the war, but following the Glassing of Leeds the field fell silent. Considerable resources within the field remain, though with Stokes in ruins, any mined ore would have to be transported elsewhere.

590182.text: A large cloud of smog that has coalesced over the centuries from the various industrial operations throughout Leeds. The cloud provides cover for anyone looking to attack shipping within Leeds.

590183.text: An outcropping of the Barrier, a massive cloud of ice crystals. The scattering effect of the crystals provides excellent concealment for Lane Hackers to attack the traffic passing between Bretonia and Liberty. Liberty Navy patrols have been increased, but with little effect.

590184.text: A huge field of ice asteroids. Weddell is currently being mined for its abundant quantities of Water and Oxygen by members of Universal Shipping Inc. stationed aboard Cordova Shipping Platform.

590185.text: The Birmingham Ice Field contains large quantities of frozen Terraforming Gases and Hydrocarbons. The Hydrocarbons are processed into Polymers by the facilities aboard the Birmingham Station, owned and operated by Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing (BMM).

590186.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
There is only one safe route through the Newgate minefield, protected by automated defense platforms. Ships are advised to follow the navigational buoys and not to stray from the indicated course. Any ships that deviate from these directives will be considered hostile and fired upon immediately.

590187.text: A large field of ice asteroids. The North Sheffield Field has been a favorite haunt of Lane Hackers who find it a convenient location to lurk prior to attacking any of the several nearby Trade Lanes.

590188.text: A large field of ice asteroids. As the crackdown on Molly terrorists has continued and the population of nearby Newgate Prison swells with their numbers, the South Sheffield Field has been used by the Mollys as cover from which to stage prison breaks.

590189.text: A mined-out asteroid field. Its proximity to the Ring and Oder shipyards has made it a favorite hiding place for Bundschuh terrorists, while Unioners prefer to hit the Robotics convoys passing along the Trade Lane from the Kruger Minerals headquarters on Essen Station.

590190.text: A mined out asteroid field. Frequently used by Red Hessian pirates to attack Military and Police ships arriving at the nearby Dresden Jump Gate - or to make the occasional daring raid on the multitude of cargo ships docked at the Ring.

590191.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The New Berlin System was initially settled because of its abundant and easily accessible resources. But while the other asteroid fields in the area yielded their treasures with relative ease, the rich Ruhr Asteroid Field proved to be a treacherous terrain of toxic gases and radioactive pockets. The debris from many a destroyed ship still litters the area, providing ample fodder for local Junkers. Unioners and the LWB have also been known to take advantage of the natural cover provided by the field to attack nearby Trade Lanes.

590192.text: A mined-out asteroid field. Hessian pirates will often retreat into this field following attacks on the nearby Trade Lanes. Large numbers of Bundschuh terrorists also operate within the field, and frequently launch raids on Brandenburg Station.

590193.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A mined-out asteroid field. The Trade Lane connecting New London with the Cambridge Jump Gate was carefully surveyed prior to construction to ensure that it did not intersect any pockets of explosive gas remaining in the field.

590194.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The mining of the Cumbria field released large quantities of explosive gas trapped inside the asteroids, resulting in a number of fatalities over the centuries. The field no longer possesses any resources of note, but the explosive gas has since settled into a large pocket within a gravitational dead zone. Molly and Corsair vessels are frequently spotted in the field. Since the Bretonian withdrawal from Dublin, a strict blockade has been imposed on traffic into and out of the system. The blockade is enforced in the field by patrols from the Battleship Essex.

590195.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large asteroid field exhausted of all useful resources. Care should be taken, however, as the mining process created at least one large pocket of explosive gas within the field. Devon is frequently used as cover for Gaian attacks on the nearby Canterbury Station, where Planetform, Inc. is headquartered.

590196.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
One of the smaller asteroid fields in the system, mining of Somerset began soon after other asteroid fields in the system were depleted of resources; however, the large quantities of explosive gas within the Somerset asteroids quickly made any further mining impossible and the area was abandoned.

590197.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<

The Southampton Debris Field is a monument to government expediency, the product of centuries of ship construction without any form of government environmental oversight in an effort to expand the Bretonian space fleet as quickly as possible. The resulting eyesore, an ocean of scrap, is as emblematic of Bretonia as Southampton Shipyard itself once was. A large population of Junkers resides within the field -- despite the presence of dangerously radioactive areas around leaking engine cores. The construction of Belvedere Refinery and ALG's partnership with the Junkers represents the first serious attempt to tackle the debris field, and the large numbers of military wrecks dumped there in the years following the Gallic War. Recently, there has been a spike in Corsair and Molly patrols in the field.

590198.text: An asteroid field exhausted of useful resources shortly after the larger Kanto field was depleted. The field has no other features of interest, though reports of Blood Dragons in the area have become more frequent of late.

590199.text: An asteroid field mined out centuries before during the initial Kusari burst of expansion. The field is entirely deserted today except for Kabukicho Depot, where the Hogosha endeavor to "protect the anonymity of their clients." Police patrols have recently been increased as terrorist groups such as the Blood Dragons and Farmers Alliance have been using the field to launch strikes against targets uncomfortably close to New Tokyo itself.

590200.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Badlands is a particulate cloud filled with asteroids and subject to intense electrical activity that renders most scanners inoperable. Two government research stations, Bedford and Ithaca, were constructed here to study these unique environmental phenomena. However, the Badlands also provides a natural refuge for all types of criminal elements. The Battleship Missouri has since been deployed to protect Liberty interests in the area and deter pirate attacks against nearby Trade Lanes.

590201.text: An industrial dumping ground left over from early expansion efforts, it is now frequented by Junkers and Rogues.

590202.text: A floating junkyard, the byproduct of orbital development around Manhattan. Some criminal activity is present, chiefly drug runners and smugglers, along with itinerant Junkers who comb the field looking for scrap and parts.

590203.text: A cloud of abandoned ships, parts, and other scrap pulled into the planet Pittsburgh's gravity well from the Baltimore Shipyard over the centuries. The Pittsburgh Debris Field is frequently used as cover by Rogues who like to attack traffic in and out of Pittsburgh.

590204.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
All information concerning Zone 21 is CLASSIFIED by the Liberty Navy and the area protected by a minefield. Any unauthorized ships attempting to breach the Zone 21 minefield or enter Zone 21 itself will be nullified WITHOUT EXCEPTION OR EXEMPTION.

590205.text:
>>>WARNING: SEVERE DANGER<<<
"The Gap," a highly toxic field of solar radiation. Entering Abgrund is almost always fatal, and as such is avoided by all factions in the system -- legitimate, criminal, and otherwise.

590206.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A planetary fragment field with minimal background radiation. The last leg of a route leading to the Stuttgart Jump Gate has been cleared through the field, but it is often the most dangerous part of the journey due to constant attacks by Red Hessians.

590207.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A planetary fragment field with minimal background radiation. A route has been cleared through the asteroid field leading to Nordostriemen and the Stuttgart Jump Gate, using the asteroids as natural cover from the frequent radiation storms. Unfortunately, the asteroids also provide excellent cover for Red Hessian pirates to protect the often ill defended convoys of Diamonds leaving the system from Solarius Station.

590208.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A planetary fragment field with minimal background radiation. Red Hessians and Corsairs are occasionally sighted in the area.

590209.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A field of lava asteroids named after the great Rheinland explorer who initially surveyed the system at the cost of his own life. Thought to have once been a planet that was superheated to the point of destruction by the red giant at the heart of the system, the Van Rohe Belt contains a fortune in Diamonds. Unfortunately, the high radiation levels make mining the Belt a difficult and dangerous job for only the most daring -- or desperate -- of individuals, as the number of dead ships should attest.

590210.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A planetary fragment field with minimal background radiation. A substantial Red Hessian contingent is present here, and will often stage direct attacks on neighboring Solarius Station where the Daumann Heavy Construction mining crews return with their valuable cargos.

590211.text: A medium-sized field of ice asteroids. Freeport 1 is located near the inner edge of the field, and will sell its excess supplies to anyone without prejudice -- including Corsairs, who frequent the area.

590212.text: A medium-sized field of mixed carbonaceous and ice asteroids. The second Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing (BMM) Polymer production facility is located here on Douglas Station, though attacks by Corsairs have required BMM to substantially increase security.

590213.text:
GRAHAM ICE FIELD

A medium-sized cloud of ice asteroids. Corsairs can sometimes be spotted in the cloud on their way to attack transport ships on the Trade Lanes.

590214.text: A medium-sized field of mixed carbonaceous and ice asteroids. The Daumann Polymer and Hydrocarbon operation of Ruegen has been plagued by repeated Red Hessian attacks.

590215.text: A medium-sized field of ice asteroids. Often used as cover by Red Hessian pirates to attack Trade Lane traffic passing through the area.

590216.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
A large, relatively open area that has been the site of multiple battles between rival criminal organizations the Red Hessians and the Corsairs. Armed mines, disabled ships, and wreckage are scattered everywhere, the result of casualties on both sides -- or independent ships unlucky enough to stumble into the crossfire.

590217.text: A medium-sized pocket within the nebula. Reserves of free-floating Iron ore can be found within.

590218.text: SCANNING...... profiling indicates that there is a 78.3% probability that this field is the remains of the sleeper ship Hispania.

590219.text: A medium-sized field of fine particulate matter.

590220.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large Edge nebula in the east part of Omicron Alpha. Heavy Outcast presence is reported in the area.

590221.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
A small rock asteroid field containing the Corsairs' main shipyard Tripoli. Any unauthorized ship will be shot on sight.

590222.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
SCANNING......profiling indicates a massive nebula cloud, but tomographic imaging is unable to ascertain any details of its internal structure.

590223.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
Part of the Walker Nebula. Scans show a high concentration of lava asteroids.

590224.text: A large nebula. Initial surveys detected the presence of unidentified organic material.

590225.text: A medium-sized nebula. Initial surveys detected the presence of unidentified material.

590226.text: A medium-sized nebula. Initial surveys detected the presence of unidentified organic material.

590227.text: Possibly the remains of a planetary body or a wandering planetoid destroyed in some unknown astronomical cataclysm.

590228.text: The Keiun ("Beautiful") Cloud lives up to its name, and were it not for the presence of pirates, would probably be a major Kusari tourist attraction. Unfortunately, its proximity to the Jump Gate leading to Galileo makes it ideal cover for Independent World pirates wishing to interdict traffic to and from Deshima Station.

590229.text: The Saiun ("Painted") Cloud is a beautiful mass of multicolored gases. But despite its aesthetic pleasures, the cloud is seldom appreciated by the Kusari Navy, which must constantly repulse Blood Dragon attacks launched against the nearby Trade Lane linking the New Tokyo Jump Gate with Junyo. The Blood Dragons will sometimes even strike against Fuchu Prison in an effort to free their imprisoned brothers and sisters.

590230.text: The eponymous Shiun ("Violet") Cloud is a large mass of inert gas leftover from the formation of the solar system.

590231.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
An outcropping of the Edge Nebula, Kunashir is unique in that it conceals a planet within its foreboding depths: Kurile. Initially discovered by the Gas Miners Guild (GMG), it was abandoned due to its lack of useful resources and was later claimed by Samura. Samura initially engaged in a long-term research project to find commercial applications for Kurile's sole form of native life, which had already proven useful in Junyo's fish-farming operations. However, this plan fell apart when tensions between Samura and the GMG escalated, and the planet was subsequently conquered by the GMG. A strong Corsair presence continues to disrupt GMG efforts to further develop Kurile.

590232.text: A large field of fine particulate matter. Atka Station, an outpost of Cryer Pharmaceuticals, was constructed here to study the varieties of organic life found in the nebula.

590233.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized offshoot of the Edge Nebula that contains large fields of valuable gas resources. However, violent electrical storms and Outcast activity within the cloud have so far discouraged any large-scale gas mining by Kishiro or the Gas Miners Guild (GMG).

590234.text: A small field of fine particulate matter. Strange, flower-like formations -- the Gikka "dust blossoms" -- make it a popular day trip for tourists aboard the Luxury Liner Hawaii, and the threat of attack by Corsair pirates only adds to the thrill.

590235.text: A medium-sized arm of the Crow Nebula, famed throughout Sirius for its beautiful vistas. A significant amount of valuable gases and the close proximity of the Honshu Jump Gate has also made this an ideal location for the first official joint operation between Kishiro and the Gas Miners Guild (GMG) -- much to the dismay of Kishiro's chief corporate rival, Samura. The GMG gas miner Ogashawa hosts not only several Kishiro "expert advisors," but also acts as a base of operations for Kishiro's own activities within the cloud

590236.text: A stray wisp of the Walker Nebula. Red Hessians often use the cloud to organize attacks against traffic along the nearby Trade Lanes. Rheinland Police also believe that Farmers' Alliance terrorist activities originate from here, though they have so far been unable to locate their base of operations.

590237.text: A drift of the Walker Nebula. Red Hessians are often seen within the cloud. Hessian pilots typically stage raids on transports of food from Stuttgart, and tourist service liners heading to Baden-Baden.

590238.text: A medium-sized field of Ammonia and Methane. Samura constructed Shinkaku Station nearby, providing it with easy access to not only the Ammonia and Methane vital to their fertilizer production, but also Oxygen and Water from the other ice fields in close proximity. Samura has recently increased security to repulse attacks by the normally non-confrontational Outcasts.

590239.text: A large field of asteroids rich in hydrocarbons. After a Kusari research expedition stumbled onto the system and its abundant resources, a joint construction project between Bretonia and Kusari opened the system to exploitation. Kishiro immediately established Nago Station along the trade route to the Kyushu Jump Gate for the express purpose of mining the field and manufacturing Polymers, a vital component in their optical chips.

590240.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A medium-sized field of frozen oxygen. Highly combustible, pilots are cautioned to take care when navigating the field to avoid igniting an explosion. Despite the danger, substantial Outcast activity has been observed in the field.

590241.text: A medium-sized field of water ice. Freeport 6 is located in the heart of the field, along the leg of the Trade Lane leading to the Tau-31 Jump Gate. Open to anyone and everyone, Freeport 6 has become a frequent stop on cargo runs between Kusari and Bretonia.

590242.text:
The Bermejo Cloud is a medium-sized field composed mostly of water ice crystals, much of which is a fine snow-like dust. The high refractive nature of the ice is what provides the impressive and distinctive appearance of cloud from Freeport 10's viewing decks.

The Independent Miners Guild has attempted to survey the cloud for further resources, however there is a strong Outcast precence that has been frequently spotted entering and exiting the concealment of the cloud. This has so far discouraged further survey attempts.

590243.text: The Malvinas Cloud is a field of asteroids and dust which never formed into a planetary body. The Independent Miners Guild has long since set up operations in the area due to the valuable ores detected within many of the larger asteroids. Outcast patrols can occasionally be seen entering the cloud in an attempt to score a quick payday from the miners.

590244.text:
The Torres Field is a small field of frozen water and oxygen crystals. Unlike the nearby Bermejo Cloud, the Torres field does not possess the same refractive or concealing properties. While it is obvious that there was once some force that caused this field to form without merging with Bermejo or Malvinas, these forces have long dissipated.

During the early construction phase of Freeport 10, Zoners would harvest the crystals of the field in order to maintain their life support systems. While no longer required to maintain life on the Freeport, the field is still considered to be an emergency resource by the Zoners.

590245.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A small debris field whose proximity to the F-Zone defensive line makes it a frequent destination for prison work convoys, but also a favorite meeting place for Xenos and local Rogues despite the best efforts of the Liberty Navy to patrol the area.

Ross presents a unique opportunity for the Cambridge Research Institute to study planetary formation and extend their terraforming technology.

Deep sonar surveys have shown the presence of rare gases in vast frozen fields; however, they are located kilometers beneath the planet's surface making them impossible to collect. The largest shipyard in Bretonia orbits the planet, replacing the scuttled Southampton Shipyard in New London.

TEMPERATURE: -86°C to -32°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.22 km/sec

Ayr is an arid world with a thin atmosphere but an active volcanic system beneath its crust. Initial surveys showed that a considerable amount of water vapor, CO2, and other greenhouse gases remain locked in the polar ice caps, making Ayr a prime target for terraforming. Planetform, Inc. initiated first stage terraforming in 752 AS but the operation came to an abrupt halt as Gallic Navy forces invaded the system.

590252.text:
DIAMETER: 12,515 km
MASS: 5.96 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -34°C to 52°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.01 km/sec

Gaia is a tropical paradise -- a rich, green world the likes of which has not been found anywhere else in Sirius. Boasting unparalleled genetic treasures, its flora, fauna, and delicately balanced ecosystems are not yet fully understood. The University of Cambridge had for over a century operated a small research outpost on the planet, collating vast gene libraries of samples. Visits to Gaia were restricted in an attempt to prevent poaching, after rumors spread of the aphrodisiac properties of many creatures. The protection of Planet Gaia is one of the central causes of both the radical Gaian ecoterrorist movement and the Green Front lobbyist group.

In 819 AS, Edinburgh was occupied by the Gallic Royal Navy during their Invasion of Sirius. Gaia was initially ignored, used informally by Gallic officers for hunting expeditions and other frontline R&R activities. As the war progressed, Gallia's need for resources became more desperate. As a result, EFL Oil & Machinery established several mining colonies on Gaia across 825 AS, straining the uncomfortable truce with the Gaians to breaking point. During the Glassing of Leeds the following year, Gallic forces loyal to the missing King Charles began the mass relocation of Bretonian citizens to Edinburgh as a captive workforce. Gaia was appointed as the capital of the Gallic Enclave, a radical holdout of war criminals and monarchists who refused to recognize the legitimacy of the newly formed Gallic Confederacy.

Makeshift mining colonies exploded in size as they were flooded with Bretonian slaves, Enclave soldiers, and Gallic nobles fleeing the core systems. As the Enclave initiated slash and burn clearance to create living space, the Gaians enacted a sabotage campaign in an attempt to slow the rate of devastation. The Mollys also established covert cells on Gaia, smuggling weapons to serfs in the hope of instigating a Molly-led uprising against the Gallic occupiers. Matters came to a head with the Bretonian assault into Edinburgh in 827 AS, which saw most Enclave elements routed by the Bretonia Armed Forces. Despite this, Gaia itself and Bordeaux Orbital remained in the hands of the most extreme Royalist holdouts, who refused to surrender to the approaching fleet.

Scandal then rocked Bretonia when the Green Front leaked government cables labeled "uti possidetis" -- a plan to assault Gaia, eliminate the Royalist garrison, and take possession of the colonies. Before this plan could be enacted, Gaian saboteurs unleashed a virulent bioweapon on the Bordeaux Orbital, rapidly liquefying the Royalist crew. This horrifying fate was broadcast to the Bretonian fleet, alongside the stark warning that a failure to evacuate captive Bretonians would result in further bioweapons being unleashed on the Bretonian landing force. Caught between an outraged public and Gaian terrorism, the government conceded. While the Bordeaux Bioweapon remains deeply controversial, many Bretonians credit the Gaians with securing the rescue of Gaia's captives.

Those Royalists that did not fight to the death during the Bretonian bombardment and landing fled into Gaia's wilderness. In the years since Gaia's abandonment, these Royalist "wildmen" have poached Gaian Wildlife, both to feed Royalist forces in nearby systems, and to sell to sympathetic Gallic nobles for supplies. The Bretonian Intelligence Service runs regular missions to Gaia's surface to hunt down Royalist camps, often with the assistance of "local guides". Limited Cambridge expeditions have also been launched to Gaia in the war's aftermath. While the planet's scars are slowly healing, academics have described the damage to certain delicate ecosystems and species as "irreparable".

A frozen planet locked in a deep crust of ice. Scientists theorize that Wight might once have supported life until its atmosphere was ripped away during an ancient catastrophe. A rebuilt Birmingham Station orbits Wight, coordinating the Planetform study on the planet's feasibility as a terraforming candidate. Despite this, the funding of an expensive terraforming project is wildly unpopular with a Bretonian public that has already suffered severely from post-Gallic War austerity. Gaian eco-terrorists regularly attack the surveying efforts.

TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A

A large gas giant with only trace elements of useful resources. Canterbury Station and the Kensington Shipping Platform both orbit the planet, generating a considerable amount of traffic. Since the end of the Gallic War, considerable amounts of radioactive battle debris have fallen into the gas giant's atmosphere. Local companies have urged the Bretonian government to take immediate action before the wreckage forms a ring system that could imperil local shipping, however little has been done so far.

590311.text:
LIBERTY

LIBERTY HOUSE SYSTEM

Texas was charted in 54 AS by the LSEC Lewis & Clark. It was once a prosperous system, hosting much of Liberty's research into Jump Gate technology. After the devastating Dallas Incident of 500 AS, this bright future abruptly ended. Since then, Texas has languished in poverty. The system is now best known for the LPI's for-profit penitentiary factories, which also act as recruitment pipelines for the Liberty Rogues, Xenos and Bounty Hunters Guild. In recent years, those with the means to do so have migrated to Planet Erie in Pennsylvania.

Despite possessing a thin atmosphere, this planetoid is rendered uninhabitable by the choking, acrid dust that covers its surface -- in some places to a depth of several kilometers. All survey probes have either been swallowed by the dust oceans or ceased functioning shortly after planetfall, presumably due to the nearly microscopic dust particles working their way into the delicate electronics.

TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: 4°C to 39°C

>>>RESTRICTED<<<
An oddity in the annals of human exploration. While initial surveys indicated a seemingly idyllic world of thick forests and low fogs, the first expeditions to make planetfall quickly learned that an essential component of the planetary ecology was a fast-acting organic poison fatal to human beings. Every plant and animal examined on the planet contained this poison to one degree or another and any plans for settlement were quickly abandoned.

DIAMETER: 4,912 km
MASS: 2.010 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: -188°C to 513°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 3.27 km/sec

A hot, rocky, and heavy moon in a semi-inclined orbit above Malta, Vesuvius is the result of an approximately 30 million year old collision of two captured asteroids, that has been cooling off ever since. Said asteroids were likely destined to impact Malta, but said cataclysm was staved off when the two met, forming Malta's only natural satellite and "guardian angel" that has protected the world from collisions ever since.

Though portions of Vesuvius are still prominent volcanic features, there are a small number of shielded settlements in the form of research outposts on, and below the surface. An 816 census put the population of the moon at no more than 600, most of which are centered around the planet's lone spaceport near the equator.

590325.text: Asteroid miners are manned or automated ships that extract valuable mineral deposits from asteroid fields.

590326.text:
>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<
A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Ageira Technologies, these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.

Ageira Technologies licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.

590327.text: A hazard buoy, used to indicate a region of potential danger for ships and their crew.

590328.text:
A jump gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS. According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'jump gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'

Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.

590329.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.

590350.text:
Trade lanes are used for superluminal travel within a system. Trade lanes must be entered from their origin point, usually located near key industrial, military, or civilian bases.

The first trade lane was established through a joint venture between Deep Space Engineering and Ageira Technologies in the year 280 AS. By 350 AS, most of Liberty space was crisscrossed by trade lanes. Through financing from Interspace Commerce, the trade lane network was rapidly extended into the other colonies, helping to create a truly sector-wide economy. Trade lanes are the fastest and safest method of transporting goods and personnel within and between the colonies. Plans to expand the trade lanes to connect interests in the independent territories outside of the colonies are pending.

590351.text: The Tanner Belt entirely engulfs the Bering system. Despite intensive surveys by both Liberty and Rheinland mining corporations, no mineral deposits of economic value have ever been discovered within the barren rock asteroids of the vast field. Unioners and Xenos have been spotted within the system on a regular basis.

590352.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Omega-7 region of the Walker Nebula is rich in mineral resources. Explosive gas pockets are scattered through the cloud, making any travel away from Trade Lanes and known mining areas hazardous. Only recently settled, its rich deposits of Cobalt, Silver, and Copper are being exploited by the IMG, Daumann, and Kruger.

590353.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Omicron-Beta Edge Nebula is rich in Alien Organisms, present on the surface of most asteroids. Its high background radiation levels do not invite lingering, however. Exposure time in open space should be minimized. Due to the very high pirate activity in this system, caution is advised at all times.

590354.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Sigma-13 region of the Crow Nebula is rich in ionized Hydrogen, Helium, and Oxygen. Home territory of the GMG, the cloud contains the debris field remnants of the once-proud Rheinland Imperial fleet. Travel off of marked Trade Lanes is hazardous and not recommended due to numerous explosive Oxygen gas pockets. Pirate activity is also extremely high throughout the cloud.

590355.text: A large rock asteroid field containing rich deposits of Niobium and Beryllium, it is the focus of Border World mining operations by both the IMG and GMS. Outcast activity is very high in the system, leading authorities to believe that it is astride a key Outcast smuggling route.

590356.text: A vast field of water ice with some oxygen ice pockets, the Tau-31 field lies in the heart of the Barrier. The Planetform terraforming project is the most notable activity in the system, along with the Holman outpost, a key supply depot for the IMG and its operations further afield in Tau-23. Numerous wrecks litter the system, remnants from the recent battles fought between Bretonia, Kusari and Gallia.

590357.text:
>>>WARNING: HIGH RADIATION AREA<<<
The Omega-41 fragment field is all that remains of the system's planets following the planetary nova which occurred shortly before the arrival of humans in the Sirius sector.

590358.text:
CLASS: Unknown
CREW: Unknown
ARMAMENT: Unknown

The Osiris is the command ship for The Order. Its advanced technology -- including stealth capability -- has led to speculation that it was originally a Liberty military prototype before being stolen by the mysterious Orillion, leader of The Order.

590359.text:
DIAMETER: 13,100 km
MASS: 6.72 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Arctic
TEMPERATURE: -50°C to -10°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.02 km/sec

The frozen planet of Atka is currently being terraformed by Liberty, with the long-term objective of resettling manufacturing jobs and Houston undesirables into the Independent Worlds. From the first surveys in the 770s, the plan has been a controversial one. Despite decades of negotiations between Rheinland and Liberty on the matter, Rheinland never agreed to sell their consent for the move, insisting the system remain a neutral buffer.

In 816 AS, Liberty grew tired of this impasse, and unilaterally contracted Planetform to build Cold Bay Depot in orbit. Rheinland was outraged by the move, and ordered the station’s immediate deconstruction. This dispute escalated out of control, resulting in the Hudson War. The Treaty of Atka ended the conflict in 823 AS. Rheinland agreed to cede Atka to Liberty, and in exchange -- desperate to end the war and focus on the Gallic threat -- Liberty committed to underwrite 85% of the reconstruction costs for the Jump Gates to Hamburg, and assist with stabilizing Rheinland’s damaged economy.

Rheinland’s sanctions on Planetform have now been removed, allowing work to resume in earnest. The company believes that constructing orbital mirrors and releasing Terraforming Gasses into the atmosphere will increase the surface temperature by 30 degrees within a century. It is expected most of the surface will thaw, creating a temperate ocean world of scattered archipelagos.

590360.text:
DIAMETER: 4,972 km
MASS: 3.0 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 300°C to 500°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 6.75 km/sec

Named after the senior lieutenant on Von Rohe's fateful expedition, Schutz is a dying planet, slowly being melted by the swelling red giant sun at the system's center. One of only two planets still intact in the system, its surface is convulsed by numerous volcanos. It serves as a shield for the Solarius station, protecting it from the intense radiation emitted by the dying sun.
