590965.text:
DIAMETER: 10,870 km
MASS: 6.78 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 50°C to 1100°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 8.51 km/sec

Placed in the heart of Omega-97, Timbuktu is a world in constant turmoil. Its surface varies from regular rocks to molten rocks and turbulent volcanic eruptions. Born from a violent formation process within the thick nebula of the Deep Omegas, the planet was once a promising terrestrial body, rich in heavy elements and volatile compounds. However, gravitational interactions with a nearby rogue mass disrupted its internal balance, triggering runaway geological activity. Its mantle feeds a network of super-volcanoes that blot out the sky with fire and ash. Rivers of molten metal carve ever-shifting landscapes, while intense heat-driven windstorms, laden with sulfur and glass-like particulates, make any surface approach risky.

The planet’s composition is an unstable mix of iron-rich rock, silicates, and heavy trace elements, constantly recycled by its violent crust. Any water that may have existed was long since vaporized, its remnants lost to the turbulent nebula engulfing the system. The dense atmosphere is a toxic soup of carbon dioxide, sulfur dioxide, and trace hydrogen compounds, trapping heat and amplifying the planet’s destructive cycle. Long-range scans indicate deposits of rare minerals beneath the scorched surface, but no technology exists that could extract them without being torn apart by the planet’s own fury.

590967.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A vast, churning mass of dark brown and yellow dust, stretching across the Deep Omegas. A product of the nearby Fischer Singularity, the cloud is a violent outcropping of the black hole’s accretion disk—superheated plasma, irradiated dust, and volatile gases caught in a delicate balance between being devoured or flung back into deep space. Temperatures within the cloud fluctuate wildly, and pockets of intense radiation make long-term exposure lethal to both ships and sensors.

Electromagnetic interference scrambles most navigational systems, and gravitational distortions play havoc with even the best inertial dampeners. Some believe the cloud might be rich in exotic particles or rare isotopes cast off by the singularity, but no human faction is in a position to explore the area. Whatever the truth, the Nubian Cloud remains one of the many great unknowns of the Deep Omegas, waiting for a determined crew to make the first real attempt at charting its depths.

590968.text: A tip - do not stray off the path too much. It's dangerous, and the radiation can get you easily.

590969.text: Best of luck, pilot. The area isn't in any immediate danger from what I know, but you can never be too safe in these areas.

590971.text:
The Eidolon Star, under Captain Daron Kells, was the most lightly armed of the Zoner expedition 13 freighters but carried the largest complement of scientific personnel. Kells was younger than his peers, an academic-turned-explorer whose driving interest was the study of theoretical energy states near black holes. His ship carried custom gravimetric arrays intended to record distortions at unprecedented precision.

The vessel followed a separate course from the other two, orbiting closer to the singularity’s axis. Logs indicate that the crew detected signals consistent with artificial stabilization fields near the alien structure, suggesting the ruins may have been constructed to interact directly with the black hole. Before Kells could transmit a complete dataset, multiple anomalous entities converged on his trajectory.

The Eidolon Star’s final maneuver was a desperate descent toward a planet whose orbit was passing in the vicinity of the vessel, engines overdriven past safe limits. The ship was last tracked spiraling into the planet's gravity well, yet fragments of its beacon occasionally resurface - distorted, delayed, and carrying echoes of transmissions never recorded elsewhere explaining a potential new discovery.

590973.text:
The Argent Hawk was an Eagle very heavy fighter assigned as close escort to the Solstice Runner. Piloted by Commander Ryn Hale, a former House Navy defector turned Zoner mercenary, the ship was outfitted with reinforced reactor shielding and extended fuel cells to sustain long operations at the edge of the singularity. Hale’s role was both reconnaissance and protection, ensuring that the Solstice Runner had cover during its high-risk sensor passes near the alien structure.

Surviving fragments of encrypted comms suggest Hale was the first to visually acquire the hostile anomalies that later pursued both vessels. He reported “shapes moving without thrust, closing from every vector” moments before weapons systems went live. Hale’s combat log recorded bursts of fire into empty space, sensor returns phasing in and out as though the targets were never fully present.

The wreck was later found scattered in an elongated field near a gravitational anomaly in the form of a wormhole. The Eagle’s central fuselage was twisted beyond recognition. No ejection signal was detected, and Hale’s remains were never recovered.

590975.text:
The Sibirskaya Brisa was a Dromedary-class freighter under Coalition registry, captained by Anton Rykov, a grizzled transport pilot with years of service on contested frontiers. Though a civilian freighter by design, the vessel bore the signs of Coalition modification: heavier armor plating welded crudely along the hull, reinforced thrusters, and a jamming suite fitted into one of the cargo bays. Reports suggest the ship was ferrying supplies and possibly experimental equipment couriers when it entered Omega-2 under pursuit.

Local bounty hunter wings engaged the Brisa near the Omega-47 trade corridor. Rykov refused to yield, pushing the freighter at maximum thrust through the patrol net. The chase lasted hours, carrying both hunters and prey into increasingly sparse territory. When the freighter crossed the system’s outer edge, the bounty hunters broke off, unwilling to follow further into the Deep Omegas. The Brisa, however, did not stop.

Automated logs suggest the freighter drifted without corrective maneuvers for months, life support failing and fuel depleted. The wreck was eventually located embedded in a fractured asteroid field, hull breached by multiple impacts. No crew survived. Its lonely trajectory and final resting place remain a quiet testament to the stubborn refusal of its captain to be taken alive, even at the cost of wandering into regions from which no Coalition vessel has yet returned. With him, the new experimental weapon might be lost forever...

590976.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED*** DO NOT ATTEMPT TO USE THIS WORMHOLE UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCE
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a wormhole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes. This jump hole has been detected to be in a state of ultra violent turbulence. Any vessel entering it is likely to perish.

590978.text:
The Novembrist was the callsign of a lone bounty hunter operating in the deep southern sectors, known for pursuing contracts far beyond conventional patrol routes. Records link the pilot to multiple high-value captures across Bretonian and Border World space, though no confirmed identity was ever established. His vessel, a heavily customized Crusader, bore no insignia other than its codename painted in faded white along the hull. The ship’s last registered pursuit took him into the Cayman system, trailing a Red Hessian fugitive rumored to have sought passage deeper into the Omegas.

Navigation logs retrieved from the derelict indicate that The Novembrist maintained pursuit through the Red Western Nebula, where ion storms disrupt long-range sensors. The pilot’s commentary, stored in bursts of encrypted voice data, notes erratic gravitic fluctuations and a sudden signal spike ahead of the Hessian’s last known vector. Moments later, the fighter encountered an anomaly: a shifting, crimson distortion described by the hunter as “a hollow sun, beating in silence.” The Hessian’s trail vanished in that instant, leaving The Novembrist without bearings.

The wreck was later discovered adrift at low power near the nebula’s fringe. The hull showed no signs of combat, yet all systems had failed sequentially as if power had been siphoned away. The cockpit canopy was sealed, but no pilot was present inside. To this day, the Novembrist’s ship remains anchored in the nebula by weak gravitational pull, its beacon still faintly transmitting the last line of encrypted voice data; words fragmented beyond recognition, repeating in uneven intervals as if echoing from the anomaly itself.

Once renowned for its valiant fights against the Kusari Naval Forces and the Gallic Royal Navy in the Taus, Battleship Stirling survived many battles. However, its age soon began to show and the old Nessie class battleship was soon withdrawn from the front lines as the war went on, for fear of losing valuable resources in a war theatre where the Stirling would be hopelessly outclassed.

Having been tasked with minor defense missions for the last couple of months while undergoing a severe systemic refit, Battleship Stirling recently appeared in Omega-49 alongside with its escorts, to secure Bretonian interests in-system and to act as a stop-gap measure against the Corsair presence and that of other hostile factions present in Omega-49.

Constructed in 822 AS at Oder Shipyard for the Rheinland Federal Police, the liner Helsingborg was designed to address Vierlande Prison's growing need to transport prisoners across Rheinland. It fulfilled this role effectively until Vierlande's destruction in 829 AS. With its primary purpose gone and no demand for its services near Rheinland's other prison, Mecklenburg, the liner was sold to the Bounty Hunters Guild in early 830 AS.

Following the Skagen Agreement in 835 AS -- a mutual-aid contract between The Core and the Bounty Hunters Guild -- the Helsingborg found a new role as a mobile carrier for Bounty Hunters venturing into Omega-55. The promise of early retirement through lucrative bounties on local pirates, bolstered by a steady salary from The Core, has made the Helsingborg a well-guarded hub and a sought-after contract. It now serves as the Guild’s central headquarters in the deep Omegas.

591026.mapped:
The Battleship Harlow was launched in 817 AS, intended for service in the Tau War against Kusari. It instead found itself on the front lines of a new war against Gallia. When Leeds fell in 820 AS, the Harlow retreated to Newcastle, joining the Stirling and -- ironically -- Nagasaki fleets in defense of the system. This culminated in the Battle of Carlisle the following year, when a major Gallic offensive from the Taus was repulsed. The Harlow then participated in the Liberty-led Operation SAVIOR in 822 AS, which unsuccessfully launched a counterattack into Leeds. In retaliation, Gallia invaded Manchester and the Independent Worlds, enacting the so-called "Starvation Strategy". With the loss of the Battleship Gwent, Harlow was rushed to Manchester and ordered to protect the vital supply line to Liberty.

The Harlow fleet repeatedly sortied to protect beleaguered wartime convoys until 824 AS, when the Liberty Navy was defeated and pushed back to California. The next year, Harlow was ordered to coordinate with the Liberty Battleship Yukon to invade Cortez. This bid to re-open a desperately needed supply artery to New London was quickly complicated by the counterattack of Gallia's Betheny fleet. After months of inconclusive skirmishing, the Betheny divided its forces to feint an invasion of Manchester and lure the Harlow away. The Gallic fleet instead pounced on the elderly Yukon, intending to destroy the Allied fleets in detail. The delay in the Harlow's arrival led to the Yukon's loss, however the Betheny was ultimately destroyed and Cortez secured -- restoring a vital lifeline during the Siege of New London.

The close of the war saw the Harlow participate in the counterattack that broke the Gallic Royal Navy in Planet New London's orbit, and the resulting Allied Liberation of Leeds soon after. Upon the Gallic Enclave's defeat in late 827 AS, the Bretonian government ended conscription and released its reserves. The Harlow was selected for mothballing during the resulting force downsizing, and moved to storage at Scarborough Shipyard. It remained there until mid 835 AS, when it was reactivated as the restored Newcastle Great Fleet under Bretonian's "Northern Shield" initiative. Where most of the BAF's veterans are assigned to the Battleships Essex and Somerset for service in Dublin, the Harlow is currently operating as a training ship in an attempt to whip its novice crew into shape.

Foyle is an annex to Arranmore Base, and the main Molly ship production facility. It is responsible for producing everything from fighters to limited quantities of hand-built 'Freeman' gunboats and 'Scylla' destroyers.

Previously reliant on parts bartered from or laundered through the Battleship Hood, Foyle's crew now faces increasingly severe difficulties in sourcing the parts needed to maintain and reconstitute Molly forces.

The loss of the Hood, the imposition of Corsair and Bretonian blockades on the system, and the cut-throat business sense of Trafalgar's Junkers have all introduced significant complications to the shipyard's operation.

With the Corsair advance towards Dublin becoming an increasingly alarming issue amongst the Mollys, the need for a forward base to help curb Corsair ambitions became paramount. Every step the Corsairs took in Omega-49 pressured the Mollys into taking action, resulting in their decision to construct Garvagh Base as an answer to the issue.

At present, Garvagh services both Molly patrol wings and Coalition strike craft tasked with expunging the Corsair presence from the region. Molly forces farther out in the Omegas also use this facility as their base of operations or, if not, a key waypoint on the route back to Bretonia. Furthermore, it serves as an overflow smelting location for gold ore mined from Dublin, in order to help fuel the Mollys' separatist movement across Bretonia.

The Prox was the first battleship constructed by the Corsairs, launched from Tripoli in 811 AS. Based on an export schematic that had been reluctantly traded by The Order for resources and armed support, the Prox lacked many of the most sophisticated technologies that defined the original Osiris prototype. Despite this, the vessel was a fearsome combatant, first seeing battle to great effect during the Casablanca campaign against the Red Hessians.

The further proliferation of capital ship and bomber technologies by the late 810s left the Prox outdated and vulnerable, despite numerous expensive refits. The Prox's utility was further called into question by the launch of the Corsair-developed Murmillo class, with other early Osiris' such as the Delos being retrofitted to these new specifications.

While the Prox could not be fully retrofitted due to numerous flaws in its core design, it was substantially up-armored and up-gunned, at the expense of its propulsion systems. The Prox now rarely leaves Omicron Gamma, where it serves as both a last line of defense for Crete, and a training posting for young warriors seeking to crew the Empire's capital ships.

Noshima Freeport was constructed in 827 A.S. under the orders of Kazuki Watanabe, more widely known as the Peddler. Though Kusari's black markets had long been dominated by the Hogosha, the Peddler, his wealthy associates, and an unknown third-party investor saw an opening for a station open to anyone, and for anyone. To the Peddler's surprise, Hogosha, and Farmer's Alliance pilots quickly began making use of the station as well. Whether to reduce the attention their own bases draw or to monitor the competition, the result has been the same: Noshima has been allowed to continue its operations unimpeded.

In addition to an extensive market and other common but well-furnished amenities, Noshima is noted for its gambling den, with a range of games both traditional and modern. This has made Noshima a popular destination for criminals in need of some down time.

The Osaka Storage Facility, built in 350 A.S. by Samura Industries, was the largest facility of its type in the Sirius Sector. Originally, fuel shipments from the Crow Nebula were stored here for the Gas Miner Guild prior to being shipped across the Sirius sector. However, since the signing of the GMG - Kishiro alliance of 801 A.S., the amount of fuel stored drastically declined, with just a token amount of H-Fuel gases mined in Hokkaido being stored at Osaka.

In 822 A.S. Osaka was allegedly destroyed by a Blood Dragon raid, briefly after Samura signed a vastly overvalued insurance policy with Interspace Commence. The devastating attack occurred while the local defense contingent was conveniently absent on training exercises, causing rumors about insurance fraud to persist ever since.

In 829 A.S., with the abandonment of Tau-53 undergoing planning, Samura opted to invest into the bases reconstruction, with the integration of the Quantum Multiplexors production line into the new Osaka facility.

Rumours have circulated of GMS vessels being spotted within the field, leading some to believe Gallia has also become interested in mining the Raw Hydrocarbons inside.

591074.text: Within the Karafuto Ice Crystal Field, it would be easy for one to become enamored by the beauty of the dazzling ice crystals within. However, it is not a safe place for sight-seeing, as Outcasts are known to lurk within, searching for prey to plunder. As Karafuto is largely unexplored, and known to contain many hazardous gas pockets, it has been very difficult for local law enforcement to crack on the criminal activity in the field. Traders are advised to keep clear.

591075.text: Although a number of the asteroids contain traces of iron, the vast majority are devoid of any real resources and no active mining operations exist within the field. Sightings of Hogosha vessels are occasionally reported throughout the field.

591077.text:
The Karatsu Cloud is often perceived by all who know of its existence to be a hauntingly beautiful cloud of swirling gases and fine particles of dust that catch and refract the light filtering through the cloud from the Green Dwarf star at the heart of the system.

Scanners are severely restricted within the cloud due to the nature of the gases and dust particles present, and the Golden Chrysanthemum are known to inhabit the cloud. It is believed that they have a base within Karatsu, although they zealously guard it with heavy patrols and it has never been reliably confirmed.

591079.text: Discovered in 812 AS by the Gas Miners Guild exploration vessel Kinai Maru, the Mintaka Hydrogen Field appears to be one of the largest and most dense hydrogen fields ever discovered. The GMG were quick to move in and establish Fujisawa Mining Facility, and it has rapidly become one of the largest mining facilities operated by the Guild. Caution is to be advised within the field as pockets of explosive gas in some areas present navigational hazards to the unwary.

591081.text: The Kofu Dust Cloud is something of a misnomer, given that it is in fact a cloud of nebulous gases that restricts sensor usage to short ranges. The fine particles of dust that pervade the cloud are responsible for the scanner malfunctions and few ships venture within to explore, especially given the huge Blood Dragon presence within the cloud. It is suspected that the Blood Dragons are hiding something in the Kofu Cloud, but nothing has ever been substantiated.

591083.text:
DIAMETER: 12,803 km
MASS: 6.27 x 10e23 kg
TERRAIN: Arctic
TEMPERATURE: -54°C to 11°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.08 km/sec
591083.mapped:
Miura is an arctic planet with massive pure water glaciers and vast oceans, most of which are permanently frozen over. Only in sporadic locations where geothermal activity forces heat to the surface does surface water stay liquid. These narrow areas are oases of life on the planet, where algae, invertebrates and even primitive fish-like lifeforms have evolved. The harsh arctic climate has caused no life to evolve outside of the oceans - there are no plants or land animals in Miura's natural ecology. Despite this, the planet does possess a breathable atmosphere, provided the air is heated before being inhaled.

Initial studies suggested the climate could be adjusted, given enough resources and technology. When the survey of the system was completed, Kusari was content for the Gas Miners Guild to contract Planetform in exchange for de facto control of the system, and terraforming was begun in earnest. Construction of the Fujisawa and Isehara facilities started not soon afterwards with the planet providing a central location to store equipment and house GMG personnel.

The terraforming project on Miura is aimed at raising the planet's average temperature by at least 20 degrees. The efforts are expected to turn the planet into an oceanic world, not unlike Honshu, over the course of the next century by releasing greenhouse gases. This would cause sea levels to rise accordingly however, and the settlements on the planet are located on a large continent expected to remain above sea level, where a single large mining colony that mines a sizable amounts of Uranium-rich ore has been established. The Isehara refinery in orbit refines Uranium - one of the active components in MOX fuel - from raw Uranium shuttled from the surface. This greatly helps towards the massive funding required for the project and allows traders to haul Uranium to Bretonian MOX fuel refineries, and pick up much needed terraforming gases on the return trip.

In order to reduce labor costs and the risk to their own people, the GMG has contracts with several police forces, offering the Miura mines as a "correctional" facility for prisoners sentenced to hard labor. The Kusari State Police and Liberty Police Inc. both make use of Miura in this fashion, mainly sending convicted terrorists in the hope they will never return. For the GMG, the prisoners have been a source of cheap labor, although their efficiency leaves a lot to be desired. The GMG have also refused to accept suspected Blood Dragon or Golden Chrysanthemum convicts, citing it does not want to give these groups more reason to attack the Miura facilities. Between the prison population, the terraforming teams and various civilian settlements on Miura, the planet now has a population of roughly 220,000 people, a number that is expected to steadily increase as the climate improves.

After the successful acquisition of Planet Kurile, Planetform has begun to apply the native Alien Organisms to planet Miura, accelerating the terraforming of the frigid world. The introduction of Kurile's organisms has already sped up the process, with two large gaps in Miura's frigid oceans thawing in early 825 AS. Planetform expects this accelerated change of the climate to advance the project by several decades, with a projected completion date around 890 AS.

591086.text:
DIAMETER: 11,249 km
MASS: 6.13 x 10e23 kg
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -79°C to 92°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.83 km/sec

An arid planet with a thin, choking atmosphere, it was surveyed shortly after Miura, initially by the original Blood Dragon explorers, and later by the GMG vessel Kinai Maru. Despite an atmosphere breathable by humans, though barely, the planet lies on the very edge of the Green Dwarf star's corona. The day-side facing the sun is scorching hot, with temperatures exceeding 90 degrees Celsius, while the night-side falls to a frigid -80 Celsius.

Deep scans of the planet have revealed gold and boron in some amounts, and there are a few life forms living deep underground, away from the searing heat and freezing cold of the surface, although the few Blood Dragon and Kishiro scientific landings onto the night side to investigate have revealed that they are not much more advanced than basic arthropods and invertebrates.

It is unlikely that any serious attempt will be made to terraform, colonize or otherwise extract resources from Niiza, as the costs and dangers involved, particularly due to the proximity to the sun, make it prohibitively expensive and difficult. Neither Kishiro nor the Gas Miners Guild have so far shown any interest in pursuing operations on the planet, although the scientific community that is actually aware of the existence of this planet do occasionally make landings on the surface. Both Kishiro and the GMG have, so far, conveniently ignored excursions by Blood Dragon scientists to this planet and seem content to maintain the unofficial status quo.

591088.text:
CLASS: Suika
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 660
591088.mapped:
Isehara finished construction in 763 AS, four months after the settling of Planet Miura was started. Isehara was originally used to handle the flow of goods to and from the planet, including the Uranium shipments that frequently made their way up from planet-side and the transports full of prisoners to work in the mines. It has since become the base of operations for the terraforming project designed to make the planet more hospitable to human life. The station is administered by Kishiro, but also has a Planetform advisory team aboard.

The station itself has a considerable Gas Miners Guild (GMG) paramilitary security detachment aboard. The GMG considers Sigma-59 their sovereign space, and as such has assumed responsibility for civilian security in the system. With the completion of Planet Miura's docking ring in 818 AS, Isehara no longer needed to harbor supplies for the planet. It has instead become a major orbital refinery for Uranium that is exported to Bretonia.

591091.text:
CLASS: Arakachi
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 210
591091.mapped:
After having learned of their rival Kishiro's plans in conjunction with the Gas Miners Guild for the Okinawa system in early 758 AS, Samura Industries decided that it could risk somewhat more indirect intervention to destroy or at least delay the plans of its rivals. To this end, it has enlisted the aid of the Hogosha, insisting that they build an outpost to keep an eye on developments within the system, and disrupt them wherever possible. The Hogosha readily agreed, having no love for Kishiro or the Gas Miners Guild in particular and secretly began construction on Kamakura base within the Hasuda Asteroid Field. Construction was completed in late 805 AS, despite several delays and near discovery of the base by Golden Chrysanthemum and GMG patrols.

The Hogosha launch frequent raids against the operations near Miura from Kamakura, but most of these are meant to disturb the smooth operation. The base has also become an important waystation for Corsair and Hogosha smugglers bringing artifacts into Kusari.

591094.text:
CLASS: Meiji
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
591094.mapped:
The Battleship Himeji, commanded by Chujo Michio Raikatugi, was originally stationed outside Heaven's Gate - an ancient Imperial fortress in the Tohoku system that Governor Tekagi had subverted for his own purposes. The Himeji served alongside a guard fleet led by the Battleships Ishioka, Musashi and Sennan. In 800 AS at the peak of the Nomad War, the Blood Dragons led an attack on the fortress resulting in the Nomad-infested Tekagi's death.

The Matsuda was one of the casualties of this battle. A Blood Dragon bomber wing struck the ship while others distracted its escort fleet. Two torpedoes struck the bridge, killing the entire bridge crew instantly. A third torpedo struck the engine, exploiting a critical design flaw in the Meiji class, and the subsequent explosion crippled the ship. Its crew was forced to abandon ship and seek refuge on Heaven's Gate.

The abandoned ship drifted into an asteroid field, and was assumed destroyed by both the Kusari and Nomad forces it had been a part of. Eventually, Golden Chrysanthemum (GC) smugglers encountered the reasonably intact wreck by chance in 810 AS After a more thorough inspection, the GC decided it was worth the expense of salvaging the ship, and with the assistance of their Blood Dragon allies, managed to repair the engines to the point that it could safely jump.

The ship was brought into Okinawa where it was partially restored over the course of five years, until it could make the journey to Sigma 19 to receive more extensive repairs from the Chrysanthemum's Hispanian allies. Upon its restoration, The Sisterhood re-christened the ship "Battleship Matsuda", in honour of Yuyu Matsuda, founder of the Golden Chrysanthemum movement.

With its sub-light engines fully repaired in mid-825 AS, the Matsuda was able to move back into Kusari, positioning itself in the Seiran Cloud to strike at convoys along the trade artery between New Tokyo and Planet Kyushu. While the Matsuda's engines are fully operational, the ship's weapons systems and sensor suite are highly outdated, making a direct confrontation with a modern day Toitsu class or even a well maintained Meiji a serious concern. For this reason, patrols are frequently dispatched to ensure the Matsuda has ample time to flee if ever discovered.

591098.text:
CLASS: Kitamura
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 1530
591098.mapped:
Constructed in 762 AS by the Gas Miners Guild after the discovery of vast untapped hydrogen reserves in the Mintaka Hydrogen Field, Fujisawa has grown to become one of the largest bases in operation by the GMG, supplying H-Fuel to various markets across Sirius and assisting Isehara with raw materials needed for its terraforming projects. The project was not without danger however, as the Mintaka field contains dangerous pockets of explosive gases.

Fujisawa is also serving as a way station, repair depot and barracks for the security forces that are heavily present in the system due to the sensitivity of the project being undertaken by the Gas Miners Guild and its corporate ally, Kishiro. Both Kishiro and the GMG have invested enormous sums of money into the joint project, with the Guild providing both raw materials and the security muscle necessary to protect their interests.

With the ever increasing attacks against Gas Miner Ogashawa in Sigma 19 by the Corsairs, Outcasts and even Samura's mercenaries, the Hogosha, the GMG hope that Fujisawa and the Planet Miura terraforming project will help revive their and Kishiro's fortunes in Kusari and the Sigmas, both economically and politically, allowing them to pull out of the Omicrons somewhat and come to some form of unofficial agreement with the Outcasts to lessen the pressure exerted on them by the incessant assaults.

591101.text:
CLASS: Hideyoshi
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 380
591101.mapped:
Built in 692 AS, four years after the Okinawa system was discovered by Blood Dragon scouts, the Sendai Research Complex was originally designed to house weapon and ship research for the Blood Dragons in an uncharted system, to maintain security and secrecy. Sendai focuses mainly on reverse engineering and adapting smuggled and stolen technologies, acquired by various means. The Nodachi bomber and Kagutsuchi were among the ships designed here, although the latter required the assistance of their Order allies.

Sendai has been an important xenoarcheological laboratory as well in more recent years. When in the months leading up to the Nomad War, house governments banned civilian possession of alien artifacts, such research was forced underground. It was during this time that the Order and Blood Dragons became allied, and many notable Kusari xeno-scientists who went to ground, joining the Dragons. Sendai continues this research to this day, receiving captured cargo from Hogosha artifact smugglers and studying them for any activity or information.

591106.text:
CLASS: Akebono
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 420
591106.mapped:
After the discovery of the Okinawa system, Kishiro and the GMG required a considerable amount of money to quickly begin the construction of the system's infrastructure. Unfortunately, the only corporation both willing and able to underwrite the project was Interspace Commerce, who agreed to insure and finance it in exchange for 5% of the H-Fuel profits from Isehara, and the ability to purchase goods from Isehara and Miura at cost. To facilitate trade, Interspace would also be allowed to establish a base in orbit of the planet. The GMG grudgingly agreed, and construction started on Furyoku Station at the same time as Fujisawa Mining Facility was assembled. The station was eventually completed in early 773 AS, despite a number of sabotage incidences that were believed to be the work of Hogosha agents.

The base handles a large portion of the traffic moving in and out of Okinawa, and the GMG often stores a large amount of H-Fuel reserves at Furyoku. During the construction of Miura's orbital facilities the Hogosha frequently disrupted operations by launching small raids against the bases, but these have become more and more sporadic now that the facilities are operational.

591110.text: The wreck of a Golden Chrysanthemum fighter piloted by Sakura Kikui. It was destroyed in combat against the Hogosha while scouting in the Hasuda Asteroid Field. The fighter's weapons array is still partially intact, though its pilot was sucked into space through the shattered cockpit.

591111.text: The wreck of a Golden Chrysanthemum fighter destroyed in combat against the Hogosha while scouting in the Hasuda Asteroid Field. The fighter's weapons array is still partially intact, though its pilot was sucked into space through the shattered cockpit.

591115.text: The wreck of the Bounty Hunter fighter Razor, piloted by Luke 'Cool Hand' Grafton, which was destroyed by Blood Dragon ships while searching for their hidden research facility. It is not known whether Luke survived, though if he did he would now be in the custody of the Blood Dragons, but there may still be equipment that can be salvaged.

591117.text: Drawn by the hopes of discovering the suspected Blood Dragon base within the Kofu Dust Cloud, this Collector ran afoul of a Blood Dragon patrol. Though the pilot perished, there may yet be recoverable equipment.

591121.text:
CLASS: Seba
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 280
591121.mapped:
The dust clouds of Kyushu have long been rife with revolutionary elements, but with the losses suffered by the Kusari Naval Forces in the Taus and later in the Civil War, the Kusari State Police found itself unable to properly patrol the border from Planet Kyushu.

Constructed in 825 AS., Fukuoka Border Station supports a strike wing from the Yamaguchi Battlefleet and several patrol wings. It stands vigil over the Trade Lanes, and keeps a wary eye on the Ohka Dust Field as a keystone in the Police's anti-smuggling and counter-revolutionary operations.

As of 833 AS, the Border Station and its crew are being overstrained. With the Kyushu relief effort well underway, Fukuoka's patrol wings have had their primary focus shifted towards providing escort to any vessel that is entering or leaving Kyushu's atmosphere, and to a lesser extent assisting with the procuration of emergency supplies to aid the now-impoverished populace of the planet.

With the southern side of the system now scarcely-guarded, pirate activity within the Ohka Dust Field has increased exponentially since the relief efforts began, and raids upon the Tau-29 Jump Gate and the Border Station itself are proving challenging to repel. Tsushima Depot's Security Teams are often dispatched to offer aid in the quelling of all hostile incursions upon the Border Station in lieu of any other alternatives.

591125.text: A barycenter is the center of mass between two or more objects and the point around which they orbit.

591126.text: A medium-sized field of large space debris remaining after construction of the Dijon Station. This area was also used to dump debris remaining after other Burgundy base construction sites. Junkers have made an attempt to clear outer parts of the field, but after the start of Second Gallic Civil War it became obvious that this operation won't reach completion anytime soon.

591128.text: This debris ring was formed from the centuries-long negligence of both Planet Marne and Chalons-en-Champagne Station who had no concern about space-littering. While the planet favored their scrap to be afloat in space rather than laying on the surface, Chalons would discard material deemed unsalvageable in close proximity as well. Today, Marne is encircled by the very same debris, shaped and accumulated due to the planet's gravitational well. Tentative debates regarding a clean-up operation have been advertised by Marne's government, but no action has been taken as of yet.

591131.text:
CLASS: Bakumatsu
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
591131.mapped:
The Battleship Sado was among the second generation of the Bakumatsu class, deployed in 815 AS as a response to Rheinland's renewed battleship program. The class was criticized for a lack of innovation in its design, which Samura had produced as a conservative modernization on the much older Meiji class.

The Sado spent much of its early service in Tohoku, attached to the Kusari Office of Intelligence headquarters at Heaven's Gate. While stationed there, it was primarily responsible for deterring Blood Dragon raids by patrolling the system and neighboring Hokkaido. In 825 AS, the majority of the Sado's fleet was stripped for service in the rapidly escalating Saigon War. The Blood Dragons quickly exploited this weakness, launching a large raid on Heaven's Gate and assassinating a senior Chochinbi commander.

The Sado suffered heavy damage during the attack. It was replaced by the Battleship Hakodate, then withdrawn to Kure Shipyard for repairs. After nearly a decade in mothball, the Sado finally received a rushed modernization package and was pushed back into service in early 835 AS. Relieving the Battleship Hamamatsu, the Sado now garrisons Honshu, protecting the strategically vital Kansai Research Institute and Yukawa Shipyard.

After nearly a decade in mothball, the Sado finally received a rushed modernization package and was pushed back into service in early 835 AS. Relieving the Battleship Hamamatsu, the Sado now garrisons Honshu, protecting the strategically vital Kansai Research Institute and Yukawa Shipyard.

591135.mapped:
Built in 802 AS, Kure shipyard is the latest acquisition of the Naval Forces. The destruction of the Kusari fleet at the hand of Rheinland during the Nomad War forced Kusari to rapidly rebuild their forces. The capacity of Yokohama and Yukawa combined was not enough, so the Naval Forces had Samura build a third, purely military yard with only a single purpose: The construction and maintenance of Kusari warships.

Kure has played a major role in rebuilding Kusari's mighty fleet. When Bretonia forced Kusari to show its military prowess in the Tau borderworlds, many of the ships built at Kure performed admirably. But as history repeated itself during the Gallic invasion, Kure finds itself once again in the role of rebuilding the Kusari capital fleet. While costly, this means that in the coming decade, Kusari is likely to have some of the most modern warships in Sirius.

591139.mapped:
The Tsukishima Liner Yards were a joint venture between Interspace Commerce and the Renzu Corporation -- a small yet prominent Kusari shipbuilding company. Renzu were founded in 639 AS, producing luxury hover-skiffs on Planet New Tokyo. The group's breakout into space vessels came in 802 AS, with the release of the Sutinga fighter -- their attempt to exploit the enormous demand for security ships across Kusari and the Sigmas in the aftermath of the Colony Wars. Renzu's luxury pedigree and the modest success of the Sutinga was sufficient to catch the attention of Interspace Commerce. Renzu pitched an ambitious and capital-intensive expansion plan -- the construction of a small shipyard for the development of a new class of luxurious liner. Rather than outsourcing to existing shipyards, Renzu proposed developing their own facility in Shikoku, in the style of Kusari's vertically integrated keiretsu.

This, they claimed, would merge the efficient production techniques and technologies of Kusari with cheap labor and luxury interiors imported from Liberty. Interspace agreed to the plan, investing hundreds of millions of credits into the corporation in exchange for a controlling stake. Tsukishima was completed in 813 AS, and immediately began prototyping the Shukensha liner. At this point, the Sutinga was divested, as Interspace believed the somewhat budget ship was becoming a brand risk ahead of the Shukensha's launch. Renzu instead pivoted, using the Sutinga's chassis to craft the Tsuyo and Shihai as a premium offering which was marketed to celebrity pilots and senior corporate executives. The ships quickly found favor within Interspace, and were distributed for sale throughout the Colonies aboard Interspace stations. The first generation of Shukensha liners likewise found significant early success, with early adopters including Orbital Spa & Cruise and the Hogosha.

Renzu continued to achieve steady but modest sales over the following decades, filling periods of slack capacity with the renovation of foreign liners for Kusari clients. This typically involved refitting the interiors of Oasis and Enterprise Liners with a more traditional aesthetic. This came to an abrupt end with the outbreak of war between Kusari and Liberty in 836 AS. Kusari Marines boarded the station and served a notice of nationalization on its administrators, offering Renzu a nominal rental value for the duration of the conflict. Liberty citizens serving aboard at the time were temporarily detained and transferred to Deshima Station. Kishiro technicians have since taken over operations, and begun work converting the facility into a forward repair yard to triage the inevitable flood of damaged Naval Forces capital ships.

Cold Lake was once a medium sized nebula and asteroid field located in the remote reaches of Alberta. Despite initial hopes for valuable harvestable gases, DSE probes later determined that the concentrations were too diffused for economical collection. The area saw a heavy Liberty presence after the construction of Leduc Station, which ended when a Dark Matter storm fully consumed the system in 827 AS. The nebula has since been scattered by the storm's intense gravitational forces.

591154.mapped:
Cordova Shipping platform was built on the location of Freeport 4 after the destroyed station's wreckage was cleared away. The shipping platform represents a coup for its new owners, Universal Shipping, after the Liberty government auctioned development rights to the site. Universal won out over competitor Bowex after the Liberty Government used wartime debts as leverage to force Bretonia to withdraw Bowex's bid.

The base serves as a major transfer point for goods moving between Bretonia and Liberty. In 835 AS, Cordova was chosen as the handover point for Liberty capital ships returning from Bretonian control after the Gallic War-era Lend-Lease scheme was terminated. As a result, a significant number of Armed Forces and Liberty Navy crews are temporarily housed aboard.

591159.mapped:
After the supergate failure lost two Liberty Navy battlegroups in early 826, a team of Ageira Technologies hyperspace-specialists sought out a means to trace the wayward warships. What ensued were months of performing trial-and-error experiments to triangulate systems that might have been along the gate's path from Alberta to Poole. By the end of the year, they had pinpointed a candidate.

While this research was ongoing, other departments of Ageira worked with DSE, Synth, and Interspace to develop a new survey ship. Utilizing the frame of an L-585-C Oasis class liner, DSE outfitted a ship for years long deep space travel, containing those parts needed to complete a return gate, a state of the art Synthfoods ecosystem for the crew, and a bespoke stellar survey science suite designed for the voyage by Agiera.

The ship was christened the Oregon, and after completing shakedown, it launched from Alaska in January of 827 AS headed towards the Omicron Nu system across interstellar space. The Oregon is responsible for the charting of the system, and still is conducting research as to what went wrong with the catastrophic Supergate jump that cost thousands of lives.

591164.text: A beautiful dust field filtering the shimmering light of Sigma-21's twin suns through its expanse, the Annamese field lies at the heart of the system. Devoid of appreciable resources or even much strategic value, the field is little more than another scenic backdrop of the Sigmas.

591166.text: The Mekong Cloud is a large outcropping of the Crow Nebula, unnoteworthy in color, density, or composition. Deeper inside the cloud, strange and possibly hazardous EM readings have been detected, causing many a pilot to turn back. Those who venture deeper in often do not return, or experience strange hallucinations, sometimes requiring treatment in psychiatric facilities.

591168.text:
A small but dense field of ice crystals laced with Niobium and trace amounts of Rhenium. Due to the juxtaposition of the Sigma-59 and Sigma-17 jump points, the cloud is of great strategic importance to both the Gas Miners Guild and Samura, as the struggle between the two continues.

Despite its Niobium reserves, no major powers in the area have much shown interest in exploiting them yet, primarily due to higher priorities within the region and its contested nature.

Saigon is a temperate planet with an arid and potentially arable landmass that has become the latest point of contention in the Crow Nebula. With characteristics that rival those of Kusari and Rheinland worlds in terms of value, Saigon has also attracted the attention of the nearby GMG and various corporate entities. Despite a brief skirmish between Kusari and Rheinland over ownership of the planet, no organization has yet been successful in establishing control of it. Both Kusari and Rheinland are keen to cut each other's colonization efforts, so it is likely that the spotlight will instead fall on smaller organizations like the GMG as the first to make use of the world.

591175.mapped:
Chesapeake Research Facility is a research station sequestered away in the most remote regions of Alaska. It consists of a research wing with the highest security facilities Liberty has to offer, including biological and chemical laboratories with complete atmospheric and physical isolation systems. Every single project within the facility is classified to some degree. Even the shipments to and from the facility utilize containers similar to Ageira's white boxes to prevent unauthorized scanning or access.

The facility also has a small but highly advanced drydock attached that fits LSF assets with advanced equipment. It is used by the LSF to manufacture specialized equipment, and the facility is equipped with a wide range of automated machinery to increase productivity without requiring too many workers. It's also designed to customize ships for specific missions - advanced sensors for reconnaissance, extra fuel pods for long range missions or a low-emission power core for stealth running.

Ibusuki was an astronomical survey facility orbiting Planet Saigon. It was built after several months of diplomatic talks between Kusari and the Gas Miners' Guild, and intended to be operated by a joint administrative delegation of the GMG and Kishiro Technologies. Before its completion, Rheinland launched an assault on Ibusuki and its accompanying survey vessel in 825 AS, resulting in their destruction.

At the time of its demise, the facility was being toured by a high-ranking Kishiro executive with connections to the Kusari government, Akemi Yamashita. Her death, and the deaths of twenty-six other Kusari citizens, sparked the beginning of the conflict between Rheinland and Kusari.

591187.mapped:
Nauru is a warm desert world with a thin atmosphere, originally surveyed by Corsairs. Similarly to other celestial bodies in the Omicron Delta system, this moon also possesses significant deposits of Iridium.

It was not these deposits that caught humanity's eyes, however, as ruined artificial structures have been located, scattered across the surface. Even though Nauru was controlled by the Corsairs, these ruins have been surveyed by the numerous Zoner and independent scientific expeditions conducted around 815 AS, though they were not able to find many similarities with the Daam K'Vosh ruins found elsewhere. Further studies were not able to find more answers as the weathered state of these alien structures left very little to be studied or even pillaged for the artefact trade.

When the Core managed to capture Yaren Base in 818 AS after the Corsairs mostly abandoned Omicron Delta, they were also able to take control over Nauru and its surface. They immediately launched efforts in colonizing Nauru and exploiting its natural riches for themselves. The Core's expectations have been foiled as Nauru's thin and unbreathable atmosphere proved to be a hindrance for any large scale resettlements as all habitats would have to be sheltered from an otherwise hostile environment. However, they have contracted several corporations to overcome these shortcomings as fast as possible, though the general hostility of the Omicrons has proven to be a limiting factor for these operations. Despite requesting Ageira to build a docking ring, the project was deemed too risky to approve until the area, as well as the path between Delta and the civilized world, become safe enough to justify such an expense.

Currently, Nauru's population is situated mostly within sheltered or underground self-sufficient settlements and the majority of its population is involved in the ever expanding mining operations on the surface. While there is a low number of more habitable settlements for a self-sustainable population, they are mostly in their initial phases and Nauru is expected to become a fully functional minor colony within a century if everything continues according to plan.

In 828 AS, a large underground alien complex was uncovered during a mining operation expansion. It is rumored that this complex is more intact than others already explored as the Core was busy shipping its most talented xenoarchaeologist to the site, along with several military experts, to explore these ruins. While it has been confirmed that these ruins are not of Daam K'Vosh origin, there has been talk and speculation that they are remarkably similar to the artificial structures found on the planet Gammu.

Freeport 4 was formerly an abandoned Bretonian station that was later repopulated by unemployed miners hailing from New London. The group eventually found gainful employment with the Independent Miners Guild (IMG) and opened the station to all, declaring it a Freeport. The Guild primarily operated by mining the ice of the Barrier and selling Water to California, in addition to a steady trade repairing commercial transports damaged by asteroids or pirate raids.

During the First Gallic War, Gallia's objective of severing the supply lines between Bretonia and Liberty meant large scale attacks were frequent. In 821 AS, Liberty seized the Freeport as a Naval staging point to protect allied convoys, promising the IMG that it would be returned after the threat had passed. In 824 AS, the GRN's invasion of Magellan began in earnest, and the remaining civilian population was fully evacuated. While the Allied garrison repulsed the invasion's initial waves, Gallic raids into California successfully destroyed San Diego Border Station and threatened to encircle and cut Freeport 4 off from resupply.

When the Battleship Carcassonne's final assault came, the Liberty Navy was forced to abandon the position as untenable. The survivors broke through the encirclement and regrouped in California and Cortez. In the years following the war, DSE shunted the Freeport's buckled ruins into the Weddell Ice Field to clear the trade lane junction. The IMG remain aggrieved that they were never adequately compensated for the station's loss, and were effectively excluded from bidding for the construction of a replacement.

591193.text:
CLASS: Tantalus
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Restricted
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 610
INMATES: 6740
591193.mapped:
Formerly the Attica Supermax, now dubiously rechristened as the Ultramax by its new pack of animals, this former prison ship has seen a dizzying array of ill-advised structural revisions to serve the needs of pirates and smugglers looking to plague Colorado in the absence of any major Liberty Navy deterrence.

A long-term Lane Hacker infiltration of the key prison officials was commenced some time over the past few years, carefully cultivated to secure the ultimate end of springing some key collaborators free of their confinement. This would ultimately come to a head in 829 A.S. Where a total breakdown of all security protocols resulted in the deaths of any and all legitimate authorities onboard. A key problem remained in the fact that the Hackers' getaway crew was also slaughtered under the impression that they were members of the LPI. Desperate for alternatives, the Hacker in charge of the operation appears to have successfully manipulated the Xenos into believing that the breakout was one of their own design, spurred on by an obscure cell dedicated to freeing long imprisoned compatriots.

The reality is that the dissidents had been played for fools, a fact that is now touted and will likely continue to be for the next several generations. This says nothing of Attica's own great escape however, as the prison ship was sent adrift by what seems like the detonation of its own minefield in close proximity, and capital class point defense fire. It was eventually rediscovered by the Rogues once it had collided with a rock and been brought to a halt in the Cheyenne field.

Feeling that styling a former prison into a den of plundered goods and cutthroats was a "helluva" great idea, the station's new management also accordingly rebranded the base, if only slightly, to reflect its questionably elevated status.

This hazardous backdrop now serves as the venue of choice for local criminals to sort out personal grievances away from the eyes of the law, and without interference, colloquially called a gladiatorial pit as a result of this newfound purpose.

CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
591198.mapped:
Ordered in 825 AS to serve during the Gallic War, the Ohio's construction was beset by significant delays due to technical complications with the new design. As a result, it narrowly missed deployment with the Whitefield fleet that was lost in the Poole Supergate Disaster. Instead, it saw brief service as part of the California garrison, and was present for the surrender of the Gallic Royal Navy's Battleship Carcassonne.

Following the war, Liberty had intended to begin phasing out older battleships in favor of Atlantis carriers, however the requirements of the 827 - 830 AS Insurgency Campaign delayed these plans. Ohio participated in the invasions of the Kansas and Vespucci systems, providing fighter and bomber screens to the advancing fleet. Ohio's squadrons most notably dispatched the Insurgency Battlecruiser Triton, and were later responsible for destroying all remaining military targets and infrastructure on Planet Veracruz.

As footage of Vespucci campaign slowly spread, the Ohio gained a fearsome reputation. It is now frequently seen as a symbol as Liberty's ruthless application of force to secure its political goals. From 830 AS, the Ohio was re-positioned to Colorado as a Naval patrol base, replacing the mothballed Battleship Rio Grande. As of early 835 AS, it has amassed a large fleet that is currently engaged in military readiness drills near the Galileo Jump Gate.

Ordered in 825 AS to serve during the Gallic War, the Ohio's construction was beset by significant delays due to technical complications with the new design. As a result, it narrowly missed deployment with the Whitefield fleet that was lost in the Poole Supergate Disaster. Instead, it saw brief service as part of the California garrison, and was present for the surrender of the Gallic Royal Navy's Battleship Carcassonne.

Following the war, Liberty had intended to begin phasing out older battleships in favor of Atlantis carriers, however the requirements of the 827 - 830 AS Insurgency Campaign delayed these plans. Ohio participated in the invasions of the Kansas and Vespucci systems, providing fighter and bomber screens to the advancing fleet. Ohio's squadrons most notably dispatched the Insurgency Battlecruiser Triton, and were later responsible for destroying all remaining military targets and infrastructure on Planet Veracruz.

As footage of Vespucci campaign slowly spread, the Ohio gained a fearsome reputation. It is now frequently seen as a symbol as Liberty's ruthless application of force to secure its political goals. From 830 AS, the Ohio was re-positioned to Colorado as a Naval patrol base, replacing the mothballed Battleship Rio Grande. As of early 835 AS, it has amassed a large fleet that is currently engaged in military readiness drills near the Galileo Jump Gate.

591203.mapped:
The corporate headquarters of Liberty Police, Inc., One Police Plaza serves as the administrative and logistical backbone for all LPI operations within the Colorado system and Liberty at-large. Overflowing with offices, impound lots, executive board rooms, and Sunbucks franchises, the Plaza is perhaps the greatest representation of the Liberty Police yet devised. What that distinction ultimately means, however, depends on who you ask.

Billed not long after the Colony Wars as a “consolidation” measure that would help to centralize LPI branch offices and lead to a more efficient police force, the Plaza instead became an incredibly divisive project fraught with cost overruns, Lane Hacker interference, and political brinkmanship. Accusations of corruption and political favoritism assigning the construction work to shell companies proved difficult to dismiss when the construction entered its tenth year with only a skeletal framework to show for it.

When construction finally finished in 821 A.S, newly transferred officers and clerks were met with an overbuilt nightmare of an interior: corridors that went nowhere, banks of elevators for sections with posted crew counts in the single digits, and a full-size terrarium exclusively for members of LPI’s corporate board. Despite this, One Police Plaza seemingly manages to serve as an effective headquarters for the corporate police agency, with plenty of space for expansion as the LPI’s list of duties grow ever larger, and Liberty’s enemies grow ever bolder.

Wichita is almost fully covered by a vast ocean, containing primitive life forms ranging from single-celled organisms to fish-like creatures. Libertonian scientists were once preparing an expedition to survey the world, but the Republic forbade them to do so in light of the Commonwealth's presence within the Kansas system.

What is known about Wichita is that its islands are dotted with many small, abandoned settlements from various groups that attempted to lay claim to the wilderness of the Kansas system, though none never succeeded. Wichita's gravity rests at 0.8 g's, or 80% of the standard gravity typically tolerated by the human body. While this makes entry and escape from the planet's orbit easy to achieve, it poses several problems for long term settlement.

In addition, nearly all of Wichita's islands are submerged at different points throughout the year due to the eccentric orbit of Colby, Wichita's only moon. This would require any permanent installation on the planet to be fully waterproofed and capable of operating submerged for at least a week at a time until the sea level returns to normal.

591240.text:
Liberty's Supergate program was resurrected in 823 AS, as Project COLD LAKE in Alberta. This was triggered by the Gallic Royal Navy's so-called "Starvation Strategy", which aimed to force Bretonia's surrender through the blockade of Cortez and Magellan, severing the supply lines to Liberty. A typical Jump Gate can only be deployed at permeable sites where pre-existing gravimetric and magnetic perturbations in hyperspace bleed through into realspace. Supergates instead pioneered a method of "hyperspace boring", gouging artificial breach points and jump tunnels between terminals that could be constructed at arbitrary locations.

Managed from Leduc Station, Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering constructed paired gate terminals in Alberta and Poole, opening a secured route for military reinforcements and logistics headed to Bretonia. Estimated to be the single most expensive project in Liberty's history, the COLD LAKE Supergates were successfully completed in 826 AS. This bypassed the Gallic blockade of the Independent Worlds, preventing Bretonia's imminent collapse during the Siege of New London. Despite extreme security precautions, the Poole Supergate terminal was sabotaged by Gallic Royal Intelligence soon after. This resulted in the devastating loss of the transiting Fairmont and Whitefield battlegroups.

Rather than attempting to rebuild a sibling terminal, the Alberta Supergate was prepped for deconstruction and evacuation. The encroaching Alberta Dark Matter storm was significantly more severe than forecast, leading to Liberty issuing an withdrawal order for the entire system. After all sensitive components were removed, the Supergate's grand superstructure was abandoned and left behind. Perhaps due to a strange interaction with the storm, anomalies regularly appear within its frame -- possibly triggered by the perforated boundary to hyperspace left behind through Supergate aperture generation.

591244.mapped:
During the Hudson War, the Liberty Navy drove Rheinland from the Independent Worlds, occupying the systems between 819 - 822 AS. During this period, unlawful activity across both systems was heavily suppressed, owing to aggressive patrols and the collapse of trade between the two Houses. Following the war’s end, the Independent Worlds military presence drastically shrank as Liberty redeployed the vast majority of its garrison to the Gallic front in Bretonia. The reconstruction of Hudson’s Hamburg Jump Gate later saw trade resume, and with it the piracy that has long characterized the region.

The Treaty of Atka divided Hudson into two spheres of influence, with both Houses agreeing to exclusively patrol their own sides. A neutral buffer was established at the Atka Trade Lane junction to reduce friction between the Houses. By mutual agreement, the Bounty Hunters Guild were invited to establish a station in the demilitarized zone, providing a safe harbor for passing transports, and a flexible force that could pursue criminals fleeing from one security zone into the other. Bounties across Hudson are funded by local corporations, with Planetform in particular bankrolling lucrative contracts on Xeno fighters who regularly attack the Atka project.

Syracuse Station was completed in 828 AS, serving as Cryer Pharmaceuticals' corporate headquarters, an orbital lab and luxury genespa. Constructed in partnership with Orbital Spa and Cruise experience consultants, Syracuse now attracts a privileged clientele from among Liberty's wealthiest and most influential power brokers. The facility offers a resort-like setting for locally-produced treatments that are tailored to the individual's genome, ranging from rehab to genetic alterations.

Security aboard Syracuse is taken very seriously, with Denver authorities issuing a special dispensation for a restricted zone and private security grid around the facility. Cryer advises that vessels may approach by appointment only, while all visitors are meticulously screened for weapons or recording devices. Cryer maintains that these measures are necessary for the protection and privacy of their executives and clients, particularly in light of the destruction of Atka Research Station.

Planet Steinfurt is a large planet in the Cologne system that closely orbits the system's young sun. Originally surveyed by Daumann across the 750s, it was initially thought that the planet lacked economically viable mineable resources. Frequent asteroid strikes were noted in later surveys, however the planet's high gravity and inhospitable conditions effectively ended any considerations of settled or automated mining colonies. Expeditions instead turned to the asteroid fields near the system's edges.

The planet was largely forgotten until 803 AS, when Kruger -- desperate expand its mining revenue -- launched their own surveys. Unlike Daumann, they focused on Steinfurt's orbit rather than the planet itself. The expedition found that the frequent meteorite impacts had thrown large chunks of rock and metal into orbit, scattering minerals throughout the chaotic ring system. Daumann had dismissed filter-mining this ring as cost prohibitive, however Kruger believed the operation to be viable using processing techniques developed at Mannheim Station.

A resource extraction project was established soon after, with ALG providing financing in exchange for a share of the profits. Unfortunately this arrangement did not last long, collapsing along with the two corporations' partnership in 806 AS. Kruger resumed operations in 823 AS as a hedge against the failure of its Dresden holdings, however extraction ended once more with the Hessian invasion of Cologne 4 years later. Kruger has yet to muster the capital for a third attempt at mining Steinfurt's ring.

591266.mapped:
Wuppertal Refinery is a Toxic Waste processor and MOX plant that serves as a strategic waystation on the route between Rheinland and Gallia. Established in 804 AS during Kruger's financial crisis, the project was initially funded by ALG and operated jointly by both corporations. The initial plan to exploit the resource-rich debris surrounding planet Steinfurt was a significant step towards challenging Daumann's monopolistic hold on Rheinland's industry. Despite this, the explosive failure of the planned ALG-Kruger merger in 806 AS saw this cooperation collapse into a complicated legal battle which ultimately saw Kruger ousted from the station.

Wuppertal was not an immediate target during the Rheinland Civil War. Instead, its remote location left the station defenseless during the Red Hessians conquest of Cologne. Wuppertal was evacuated without resistance but suffered significant damage due to an unexplained act of sabotage, likely carried out by anti-Hessian employees attempting to prevent the capture of the valuable fuel plant. During the Hessian occupation of the system, the station was briefly taken over by a group of Junkers. Nevertheless, the Hessians allowed a small number of ALG specialists to remain, ensuring the safety of the refinery's hazardous nuclear reactors.

After the war and the newly reunified Rheinland Federal Empire's offensive into the system, the Junkers were ousted, and repair work began -- concluding in early 829. Since then, the station has resumed the manufacturing of HazMat Containers, while enriching recycled fuels with Uranium procured through the Gas Miner's Guild in the Sigmas. Since the signing of the Treaty of Oerlikon, Wuppertal has also become an increasingly important waypoint for traffic travelling the hazardous Alsace Passage between Rheinland and Gallia. The Battleship Altenburg has taken up position nearby to guard the nuclear refinery -- and keep a close eye on ALG's activities.

591271.mapped:
Heisenberg Research Station was originally founded in 761 AS as a Rheinland observatory dedicated to the study of solar bodies in the fringes of the Walker Nebula. The base operated until 769 AS, when budget cuts resulted in the station being abandoned and the Federal Observatory Service dissolved. Powered down and abandoned for the next 40 years, Heisenberg fell into steady disrepair before eventually being repressurized by a group of squatters during the chaos following the Colony Wars.

With most of its research equipment still intact, the station quickly became a small hub for smugglers, explorers and scientists alike. Free of the restrictions of formal House academia, Heisenberg gained a reputation for being a politically neutral place for the great minds -- or exiled radicals -- of science to converge and discuss unconventional findings, most notably on the Jump Gate 'Blackout'. Practical, applied sciences have also resulted in a prominent engine tuning and experimentation scene congregating aboard.

The experimental engine test track outside the base has since become an attraction in its own right, drawing in racers and gamblers from across the surrounding region. These rougher clientele do not see eye to eye with academic residents, resulting in frequent disagreements. Lucrative gambling revenue has also attracted the attention of the Unioners and Gallic Brigands, who both intend to take a cut from any such operation in their territory.

591275.mapped:
The Schwarzwald was a Red Hessian cruiser, sold to the LWB as it reached the end of its service life. After the Hessians completed hand-over training, the LWB positioned the vessel in Cologne. It initially served as a heavy raider, using nearby Jump Holes to attack targets in Hamburg and Stuttgart. It also frequently attacked ALG vessels traveling from Wuppertal Refinery, partially in an attempt to steal MOX reactor fuel, but also in protest of the corporation’s sale of Terraforming Gasses to Synth Foods on Planet Stuttgart.

When the LWB dramatically collapsed in 824 AS, the crew of the Schwarzwald were largely insulated from the chaos and infighting. Being moored at Krefeld Base at the time, they quickly threw in their lot with the Unioners, who agreed to supply the ship in exchange for a cut of all cargo and profits from their raiding. The Schwarzwald later fought alongside the irregular forces of the Imperial cause during the Civil War, primarily harassing scouts from the Federalist Battleship Karlsruhe.

When the Farmers’ Alliance spread to Rheinland by incorporating furious ex-Imperial Stuttgart veterans, the Schwarzwald was quick to return to its roots. This angered the Unioners, who saw the departure as a theft of their property. It quickly became apparent that all was not well in the revived movement, as the Alliance had dramatically different priorities to the LWB and Rheinland farmers. This came to a boil in 834 AS, when the Greifswald and Schwarzwald coordinated to expel the FA and reassert their independence. The cruiser now stalks Cologne, hunting Gallic agricultural shipments.

591278.mapped:
Krefeld is a Unioner controlled base within Cologne's shroud of the Norddrauwolke. First built to guard the a nearby jumphole, the collapse of the jump connection turned the base into a port of exchange for Hessian and Unioner diamond smugglers. With the steady decay of Unioner - Hessian relations, Krefeld came to mark the historic border between Unioner and Hessian zones of control with Krefeld guarding the gateway to Hamburg - the heart of Unioner territory.

Krefeld is the site of the first true test of Unioner Hessian relations. In 826 AS, a contingent of Hessians boarded Krefeld at gunpoint, claiming to be hunting political dissidents. Instead, the Hessians shot several Corsair traders aboard the station, in what the Unioners and the Hessians call the 'Krefeld Massacre'. The Unioners of Krefeld have been skirmishing against the Red Hessians ever since. It is thought that the Krefeld Unioners are particularly aggressive towards the Hessians, due to their own troubled history. Krefeld based forces are often sent south to fight the Hessians around Saarbrucken.
