Erfurt is a fiery and turbulent gas giant. Its dense atmosphere of ammonia, methane and hydrogen is being stripped away by Thuringia’s star, leaving a long gaseous trail in its wake. Erfurt's dark atmosphere absorbs huge quantities of energy from the star, creating spectacular plasma storms of enormous size.

591285.text:
DIAMETER: 4,034 km
MASS: 2.75 x 10e22 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: -71°C to -30°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 4.19 km/sec

Badenburg is a hostile and airless moon. Crushed by tidal forces exerted by Planet Erfurt, its countless volcanoes ceaselessly spew lava across the surface.

591287.text:
DIAMETER: 7,728 km.
MASS: 4.62 x 10e16 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: 735°C to 1,260°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 8.30 km/sec

Eisenach is a lifeless, rocky desert. Some areas of the planet are contaminated, the result of orbital bombardment and numerous weapon tests conducted by the Imperial Navy. Eisenach was used for hostile environment survival training by both the MND and RM until 823 AS, when operations were suspended.

591289.text:
DIAMETER: 14,214 km.
MASS: 6.00 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -46°C to 5°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.99 km/sec

A dark world with a toxic atmosphere and many active volcanoes, Oberhof's most notable surface features include burning sulfur geysers that spout fountains of "blue lava." The planet's rocky landscapes are rich in deposits of various metals. Abandoned industrial equipment on the surface dates back to the 80-Years War, when the Imperial Navy had unsuccessfully attempted to tap Oberhof's economic potential. These efforts were expensive and ultimately unsuccessful due to difficult planetary conditions.

591293.text:
DIAMETER: 26,563 km
MASS: 9.99 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 325°C to 421°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 18.12 km/sec

Planet Artern is a scorching hot, caustic world with a thick carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide atmosphere. The temperatures combined with fierce volcanic activity have caused the planet to be known as the "Witches' Cauldron". Sandstorms can last for months at a time, whirling toxic particles high into the atmosphere. The surface is littered with waste from Heldrungen Prison's operations, and wreckage from its destruction.

591295.text:
DIAMETER: 5,326 km.
MASS: 2.75 x 10e22 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: -111°C to -21°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 4.51 km/sec

This is a barren dwarf moon with no atmosphere, pockmarked by asteroid impact craters. It is the most massive of Weimar's moons, which may be due to a large iron-nickel core. Sulza appears to have a solid core, as scans for thermal signatures and surface changes have revealed no evidence of active volcanism.

591297.text:
DIAMETER: 6,204 km.
MASS: 2.75 x 10e21 kg.
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: -120°C to -28°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 4.01 km/sec

Apolda is a small ice moon with a thin atmosphere orbiting Planet Weimar. Its surface is covered in huge cracks that reveal subterranean ice deposits. Apolda is the largest and brightest object in Weimar's orbit and its trailing ice fragments form a small ring whose shards sparkle in Weimar's night sky. Long abandoned industrial machinery litters the surface, dating back to the 80-Years War.

591299.text:
DIAMETER: 6,485 km.
MASS: 4.73 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: 735°C to 1,260°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.04 km/sec

Planet Gotha was a barren and rocky world, with a thin atmosphere of carbon dioxide and nitrogen. Overlooked as unremarkable, Gotha received little attention until 820 AS, when it was ripped apart by a cataclysmic explosion that ejected huge quantities of debris towards Thuringia’s star. Much of this debris is expected to fall into a stable orbit around the star, contributing to the Gotha Fragment Belt. High-velocity fragments flung into the wider system now pose an ongoing hazard to both traffic and installations.

Further exploration of Gotha's remains was initially heavily impeded by the molten surface, intense radiation and chaotic debris fields. The cause of the Gotha explosion is officially listed as unknown. The incident would likely have been entirely concealed by Rheinland authorities were it not for a hyperspace ‘ripple’ that was detected as far away as the Cologne system. In late 833 AS, a large electromagnetic disturbance was detected near Valhalla Shipyard and within Gotha's exposed core.

By 834 AS, the MND had concluded that this anomaly was the formation of a gravimetric breach -- a Jump Hole. Despite frequent raids by both the Bundschuh and Wild, the MND has attempted to maintain a perimeter over the site while conducting probe exploration of the Jump Hole.

591301.text:
CLASS: Koppel
GRAVITY: No
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 0

Meningen was an MND installation located deep within a stable pocket of the Suhl. Built in 818 AS, the automated installation was designed to gather data on the Suhl in the hope of creating weapons that could provide an advantage in the Hudson War against Liberty. The Suhl’s hostile environment prohibited a permanent crew, with researchers shuttled in to oversee particularly sensitive experiments.

From 820 AS, Meningen’s primary focus shifted to stopping or slowing the Suhl’s expansion. While these efforts initially bore no results, growth abruptly stopped in 833 AS during a gravitron field experiment. Shortly after, Meningen came under attack by Scorpion Drones and the Battleship Fenrir. The MND concluded that experiment must have been a success, and remotely scuttled the station to prevent the Wild from obtaining the specialist equipment and crew aboard.

591303.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
The Hohenfeld nebula veils the entire north of the Thuringia system. The nebula contains crystalline structures which are believed to be the fossilised remains of extinct breeds of Alien Organisms. These structures remain the subject of research for possible military, industrial, or terraforming applications. Access to the Thuringia system is restricted, and the nebula is consequently heavily patrolled by the MND from their checkpoint at Fort Sommerda.

591305.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A chaotic mass of planetary fragments, dust and radioactive debris. Created by a cataclysmic explosion under the surface of Planet Gotha in 820 AS, the molten ejecta was launched towards Thuringia’s star. While much of this material is expected to eventually settle into a stable orbit, high velocity asteroids are now a substantial hazard system-wide. Proposals to survey the fragment field for accessible resources were delayed by the extremely hazardous and changeable conditions, and then later canceled due to the Rheinland Civil War. The MND has applied a travel restriction to the area, limiting access to just authorised research vessels.

591307.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
The Salzungegraben is a sensor dampening nebula, containing the carcasses of countless Imperial Navy vessels from the 80-Years War. These ships were intact enough to be towed back to Rheinland, but too expensive to return to service. Instead they were broken up for parts at Valhalla Shipyard, with useful components being transported back to the industrial war machine in New Berlin. In 823 AS the MND applied a strict quarantine over the field, claiming that an industrial accident had contaminated the shipyard within. Since then, dangerous Wilde terrorists have been spotted launching vicious raids from the area.

591309.text:
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED AREA<<<
A high-security minefield guarding the passage to Frankfurt, deep in the Hohenfeld nebula. The mines were originally hastily laid by the Rheinland Northern Fleet in 800 AS, and show irregularities and gaps in their distribution. Later mine clearance work opened three main passages for transit which remain in use to this day.

591311.text:
DIAMETER: 13,004 km.
MASS: 6.00 x 10e19 kg.
TERRAIN: Arctic
TEMPERATURE: -117°C to -32°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.78 km/sec

Ilmenau is a frigid arctic world with a dense atmosphere. The surface pressure is high enough for enormous lakes of carbon dioxide and ammonia to form, slowly evaporating during the day and condensing into rain during the night. Deposits of Hydrocarbons and metals are believed to be trapped in the permafrost, although the expansion of the Suhl Anomaly has made any attempt at commercial exploitation impossible. The Anomaly's gravitational effects have begun to buckle Ilmenau's crust, blasting molten lava high into the atmosphere.

591313.text: The remains of the personal fighter of Admiral Karl Speer of the Rheinland Military. He fought in several battles against Liberty, the Hessians and Corsairs with great success, until the Suhl Anomaly sealed his fate. Due to the dangers posed by entering the Anomaly, the Military has made no attempts to salvage the wreck as of yet.

591315.text: The legendary Von Preußen, a reconnaissance cruiser of the Imperial Navy that discovered Thuringia in 587 AS and became trapped within the Suhl Expanse in the same year. No attempts to salvage the wreck have been attempted so far. A relic of Imperial Rheinland shipbuilding, the Museum of New Berlin would pay handsomely for the Von Preußen's recovery.

591317.text: The wreckage of an Oder-class gunboat of the MND, trapped within the Suhl anomaly.

591319.text: The hulk of the Red Hessian cruiser Marienburg, captured by the MND, partially dismantled and then subjected to various experimental weapons tests with the intention of locating structural weaknesses. The vessel was last seen entering the Westerwald in Frankfurt.

591321.text: The wreck of a ship piloted by Natalie Koch, a xenoarchaeologist of the MND who disappeared in the year 808 AS. Unaware of the danger posed by the Suhl Expanse, she entered the anomaly for the one and only time. Scans indicate that she had Artifacts on board.

591323.text: An elite prototype fighter of the MND that was reported as lost in 824 AS, cause of destruction unknown. Its frame is unusually warped and partially molten, making reactivation impossible. The equipment on board appears to be notably more advanced than standard Rheinland technology.

591325.text: An elite prototype fighter of the MND that was reported as lost in 824 AS, cause of destruction unknown. Its frame is unusually warped and partially molten, making reactivation impossible. The equipment on board appears to be notably more advanced than standard Rheinland technology.

591327.text: The vessel of Klaus Spielberg, a civilian who got lost in Thuringia and was gunned down by a military patrol while attempting to escape.

591329.text: The wreck of a fighter belonging to ex-Liberty Navy marine and daredevil Johnathan Whitmore. He was searching for new adventures and stumbled into Thuringia by accident. His ship was heavily damaged by a military patrol shortly afterwards. The wreck has been disposed here. The pilot is missing.

591331.text: The vessel of Olaf Thörnblad, an ex-member of the Rheinland Military and alleged informant for the LSF. According to official reports, he disappeared within the Omegas in 817 AS. The pilot is missing.

591333.text: A jettisoned cargo pod marked with biohazard warnings and the inscription: "For disposal."

591335.text: A lost cargo pod, marked with the inscription: "Property of the Rheinland Government." Its contents are unknown.

591337.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
>>>WARNING: RESTRICTED SPACE<<<
The Suhl Anomaly is a field of extreme electromagnetic and gravitational hazards. The Anomaly is believed to be the source of Thuringia’s system-wide sensor and communication distortion effect and has been a site of military and scientific interest since the 80-Years War. Gravitational shear events and quantum hazards pose an extreme danger within the Suhl, with these anomalies destroying any ships straying from the marked passages.

The Suhl began to expand in 820 AS, with the rate of expansion accelerating in 831 AS. The MND dedicated considerable resources to finding a means to prevent further expansion, with little initial effect. In late 833 AS, a large electromagnetic disturbance was detected near Valhalla Shipyard and within the field, with expansion halting shortly after. Wild patrols now frequently operate within the Anomaly, having quickly overrun the MND’s safe zones.

591341.text:
CLASS: Von Claussen
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: Unknown
591341.mapped:
The Bundschuh are believed to have been the first to discover Sigma-15, after stumbling into the system through the Frankfurt Jump Hole in the early 810s. The following decade saw the arrival of Rheinland surveyors, prompting the Bundschuh to abandon their temporary camps on Hammersee after they attracted corporate attention. Bielefeld was originally a Kruger gas miner, intended to harvest the Nordsee Cloud’s valuable gasses during the Saigon War. The unprofitable miner was abandoned on the war’s end, with the Bundschuh occupying it as a supply depot in early 827 AS.

Bielefeld’s transports currently source fuel and materiel from Freeport 8, Newport Station and even sympathetic sources within Kusari and the GMG -- Bundschuh agents hailing from the station also often use the nearby Luxury Liner Hawaii to discreetly meet potential financiers and influential supporters. As the movement’s requirements expand, the Bundschuh have attempted to initiate gas mining of their own, however a lack of experience and industrial machinery have significantly impaired operations.

In recent years, Bielefeld has become increasingly important as a front line against the Corsairs. This came to a head in 832 AS, as the Corsair Northern Fleet poured into the system to muster for an invasion of Rheinland. Despite urgent warnings issued by the Bundschuh, the Hessians were unable to respond, being fully occupied with the Rheinland Military’s offensive in Dresden. While Bundschuh fighters have neither the strength or numbers to face the Corsairs directly, they have wrecked a devastating toll on the invasion force’s supply lines, preventing them from bringing their full strength to bear on Frankfurt and Dresden.

TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 18.01 km/sec

Juist is a gas giant composed primarily of hydrogen. Considered to be of little economic value due to the nearby abundance of the Crow Nebula, all the giant offers is a scenic view for travelers heading towards Hammersee or Freeport 8. The Rheinland Military frequently carry out training exercises and weapons tests on Juist's far side.
591344.mapped: Juist is a gas giant composed primarily of hydrogen and offers only a scenic view to the colonists and prisoners of Hammersee. Although it has no economic value, Juist's orbit provides a safe haven for operations on its moon and shields it from the dangerous radiation of the system's star.

591345.text: Juist is a gas giant composed primarily of hydrogen and offers only a scenic view to the colonists and prisoners of Hammersee. Although it has no economic value, Juist's orbit provides a safe haven for operations on its moon and shields it from the dangerous radiation of the system's star.

591348.text:
DIAMETER: 6,415 km
MASS: 4.73 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Mountainous
TEMPERATURE: -54°C to 128°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.04 km/sec
591348.mapped:
Hammersee is an uninviting moon of Planet Juist. It is volcanic, dry and dusty -- daytime temperatures scorch the surface, before plunging far below freezing at night. When Daumann deep space explorers first arrived in 820 AS, they found a number of primitive survey probes scattered across the surface, confirming they were not the moon’s first visitors. Charting of the subterranean lava tubes revealed rich mineral deposits and signs of previous habitation, spurring rumors of a very literal Bundschuh “underground”. Seeing the potential of a mining colony, Daumann set up a small outpost, while lobbyists persuaded New Berlin to invest in a Jump Gate connection from Frankfurt.

By 825 AS, the Gate connection was completed -- Daumann aggressively promoted the Hammersee colony to refugees fleeing the Munich Disaster, hoping to recoup some of their own losses from the evacuation. Unfortunately, the marketing failed to capture the harsh reality of living in Hammersee’s mines. The Saigon War further worsened the situation as supply shipments were targeted by the GMG and Kusari Office of Intelligence. By the end of the year, almost all of Hammersee's initial settlers had fled, and the colony was deep in debt. Facing spiraling costs, Daumann turned over the moon's infrastructure to the Rheinland government for a nominal $1 sale.

For the duration of the Rheinland Civil War, the Hammersee project remained largely dormant -- save for periodic use as a staging post by the Battleship Kolleda. Following the Holstein Accords, the unified Federal Empire entered into a joint agreement with Kruger Minerals for the development of Hammersee, providing inmate labor from the orbiting Mecklenburg Prison. Thanks to their captive workforces, Hammersee’s refineries produce significant quantities of valuable metals for export back to Rheinland. Hammersee’s deadly mines are among the most dreaded destinations for Rheinland's dissidents and criminals.

Norderney is a little more than an inhospitable planetoid located close to the system's star. It is believed to have a silicate surface that has been "torn" from the planetside to its low orbit, a change that is visible in the form of clouds in its outer orbit.

591353.text:

MASS: 7.73 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: -229°C to -30°C

Planet Baltrum is a large, airless planet with a highly eccentric orbit. When early Rheinland surveys revealed no immediately accessible resources, further exploration was abandoned. ALG Waste Disposal later constructed Wichter Station in orbit.

591359.text:
CLASS: Tantalus
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Restricted
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 1230
INMATES: 19740
591359.mapped:
Mecklenburg is Rheinland's largest prison complex, designed using the lessons learned from the destruction of Vierlande Prison. Initially constructed in 824 AS as a Military outpost to secure Rheinland’s claim over Sigma-15, the station was significantly renovated and expanded as an orbital prison after the Rheinland Civil War. It now holds over ten thousand prisoners, including murderers, pirates and political dissidents. Mecklenburg oversees the operation of the Hammersee penal colony, coordinating inmate transfers and work orders. There is a substantial Kruger Minerals presence aboard, as the corporation works closely with the Federal Police as an industrial consultant for resource extraction and labor management.

The prison is equipped with extensive armor and weaponry to deter raids, in addition to a significant Police defense squadron. Despite this, the facility and its supply convoys come under frequent attack by Corsairs, Bundschuh and occasionally the GMG, all seeking to free captured comrades before they are consigned to Hammersee’s mines. Securing the hazardous route from Frankfurt has imposed a significant drain on Fulda’s resources, with emergency support frequently needing to be scrambled from the nearby Battleship Schwerin. Despite these challenges, Mecklenburg generates a significant profit from metals exports, albeit at a terrible cost to the prisoners within.

591362.text:
CLASS: Kolleda
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

Construction of the Battleship Kolleda first began in 819 AS, alongside the Battleship Schwerin. Originally intended for service in the war against Liberty, neither ship would be completed in time to see combat. Entering service in 823 AS, the Kolleda was first deployed to oversee repairs on the destroyed Hamburg Jump Gate in Hudson. Following this tour, the Kolleda was retasked to Thuringia as the centerpiece of a new officer training school operated in partnership with the MND. Despite the Kolleda Academy’s overall success, conflict between veteran Colony War-era instructors and the MND made the posting an unpopular one.

When the Saigon War erupted between Rheinland, Kusari and the GMG in 825 AS, the Kolleda formed the speartip of the Military’s response, distinguishing itself as one of the conflict’s deadliest combatants. The Kolleda’s crew were reprimanded several times for prioritizing brutal attacks on the GMG -- who they blamed for the fall of the Rheinland Empire -- rather than following assigned orders. After the Sigma Treaty established a ceasefire, the Kolleda controversially refused to withdraw to Frankfurt. This is commonly seen as the first overt step towards the Rheinland Civil War, as Military leaders began to openly defy the civilian government.

During the Civil War, the Kolleda unsurprisingly fought for the Imperial cause. It launched raids into Federalist Munich from its position in the Sigmas, primarily targeting civilian and logistics infrastructure. Post-war service saw the Kolleda suppressing the re-outlawed Unioners in Hamburg, before being mothballed in 830 AS on budgetary grounds. This decision was highly controversial, with accusations of political revenge being leveled against ex-Federalist decisionmakers. The battleship was slowly dismantled over the following years, until in 834 AS it was abruptly towed from its moorings for ‘special assignment’ with the MND.
591362.mapped:
Beginning service only in 810 AS, after several major delays caused by raids upon its construction docks, the Kolleda was utilized mainly as a training academy for recruits and officers alike.

The ship's first deployment came after the conclusion of conflict with Liberty, when it was tasked with guarding the Hamburg Jump Gate in the Hudson system after it had malfunctioned. Though successful in this first mission, it became obvious that the crew's training was going to waste patrolling this region.

After finishing this first tour of duty, the Kolleda was turned once again into a training vessel, at that time within the Thuringia system. Training aboard the battleship went at a rapid pace, with officers questioning the programmes. Still, the Military pushed for the expansion of Kolleda's academy with its relocation to Stuttgart, where it remained until the outbreak of the Rheinland Civil War.

Seeing little action during the years of internal turmoil, in 830, the Rheinland Military decided to begin a slow dismantling process of the ship, in part due to the high cost of maintaining such a large fleet and to preserve parts for other warships.

CLASS: Nordsee
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 240
591369.mapped:
Wildau Station was completed in 826 AS as a planned replacement for the aging Brandenburg Border Station. The massive command center caused scandal from the outset, as project delays led to construction costs ballooning out of control. Additionally, the facility’s complicated, over-engineered design resulted in shocking operating costs, with opposition politicians derisively referring to it as the ‘White Elephant of New Berlin’. Wildau’s problems were further compounded by the political deadlock in the Reichstag, which saw efforts to finally decommission Brandenburg scuppered by unrelated partisan disputes.

Wildau was partially garrisoned by the Imperial Military during the Civil War, acting as an off-world tribunal for prosecuting prisoners of war, far from the fighting on Planet New Berlin. Following the Holstein Accords, the Rheinland Consensus Government urgently needed to make savings. Faced with the choice of divesting Wildau or Brandenburg, Wildau’s obscene operating costs made it the natural choice to cut. Despite this, more than a year later, the Rheinland Government had still failed to identify any domestic buyer interested in purchasing it.

A solution presented itself in 831 AS as Rheinland and Gallia began negotiating the Treaty of Oerlikon. Rheinland accepted a lucrative offer from EFL for a 30 year lease. Daumann were employed to begin refitting the station as a Gallic fuel hub, with the formal hand-over and Promethene distribution commencing in 834 AS. Where Gallic companies are unwelcome on Bonn Station, several have established offices on Wildau as a de facto consulate.

DIAMETER: 6,987 km.
MASS: 10.98 x 10e21 kg.
TERRAIN: Terrestrial.
TEMPERATURE: 12°C to 70°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 13.45 km/sec
591372.mapped:
Planet Weimar is a world of vast swamps and towering, craggy mountain ranges. It was first discovered by Rheinland explorers in 530 AS, who noted an unusual algae biosphere, and an unpleasantly thin, hot and humid atmosphere. Weimar was initially considered as a potential colony site, however these plans were scuppered by its sensor-absorbing characteristics and hazardous conditions. The Imperial Navy launched further expeditions to Weimar in the 550s, classifying the system and planet as sites of potential military interest. These early Naval facilities were bored into the mountainsides, revealing the strange crystalline deposits responsible for the jamming effects. During the 80-Years War, Weimar’s outposts were significantly expanded.

These bunkers provided the Imperial Navy with a secluded forward base to coordinate the disastrous war effort, far from political accountability. The collapse of Rheinland’s economy at the war’s end saw Thuringia abandoned for the next 90 years. Chancellor Niemann’s remilitarization program of 797 AS saw Weimar reoccupied by his personal troops, with details of their activities expunged from Rheinland’s databases. Following Niemann's disappearance, the Northern Fleet that later became known as The Wild retreated to Thuringia. The Order and MND subsequently fought a bloody campaign to purge the system of Wild influence between 802 and 806 AS. Marines clearing Weimar discovered a nightmarish warren of newly excavated tunnels riddled with traps and fanatical defenders.

Once the last Wild holdouts were eliminated, the MND were granted exclusive jurisdiction over the planet to investigate the excavations. They discovered sprawling alien ruins, and vaults seemingly ransacked and recently emptied. Further exploitation of these ruins was halted in 820 AS however, following the 'Gotha Incident'. Weimar’s situation changed radically in 827 AS with the outbreak of the Rheinland Civil War, becoming the capital of the Federalist government in exile for the duration of the conflict. In the aftermath, the MND has continued to use the planet as a highly autonomous research and command center, and has once again heavily restricted outside access, despite the misgivings of the new Rheinland Consensus Government.

591376.text:
>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<
This orbital device assists inbound ships, directing them to a safe approach vector when entering the atmosphere and providing additional acceleration when taking off from the surface. Its specifications only permit it to work with small craft.

Left to develop without access to the exclusive Ageira Technologies invention, the Coalition has sought to produce their own version of the docking ring for centuries. Their scientists studied surface-level scans of functioning docking rings and schematics provided by defecting Ageira employees, but were never able to fully unlock Ageira's secrets for themselves.

Eventually, the Coalition took what they learned and adapted it into this design, which is markedly less efficient and is missing many features compared to the original. While a major bottleneck on the Coalition's planetary exploitation efforts, these rings serve their intended purpose, allowing the Coalition to tentatively expand their hold on planets.

591378.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
Located at the edge of the Crow Nebula, the Nordsee Cloud severely dampens sensors. Large numbers of Corsairs and Bundschuh operate throughout the field, in addition to GMG paramilitary patrols. Fuel rich deposits within the cloud initially attracted the attention of Kruger Minerals, however Rheinland agreed to end all gas mining in the Nordsee during peace negotiations after the Saigon War.

591380.text:
CLASS: Grunstein
GRAVITY: None
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 0, Formerly 360

Voelklingen Station began life as a Red Hessian survey station before being turned over to the LWB in 822 AS It was carved from a massive chunk of rock that is thought to have once belonged the Weilsberg Asteroid Field, but has since broken away.
With Omega-54 considered "well-hidden" and already heavily defended by the Hessians, the LWB decided to base the production facilities of their own custom line of snubcraft in the system, close to both Hessian and Coalition engineers who could aid in maintenance and production as needed.

In late 824 AS the LWB began to crumble from within. The various bases and outposts of the movement suddenly found themselves without leadership or direction, leaving their respective crews to decide where their futures lie. The inhabitants of a few bases managed to reach an agreement among themselves, joining old friends or choosing to continue the fight under the Gaian banner. The crew of Voelklingen however, could not come to an agreement. Torn between whom they should join, the station's populace succumbed to infighting and ultimately became scattered.

A number of the Voelklingen crew chose to align themselves with the Gaian movement in Stuttgart and left to join their ranks while others joined the forces with the Hessians or Coalition, one handful of former LWB struck out to find their fortunes as pirates. Voelklingen itself was left abandoned after the exodus, eventually being destroyed by a reactor breach several weeks later. Now all that remains is an empty husk gradually being pulled into the atmosphere by the gravity of planet Odense.

591382.text:
The newest project of the Core, Bora Bora, is an under-construction depot considered one of the most ambitious endeavors in the remote border worlds. The Core, struck by a crisis following the collapse of Omicron Rho's connections, needed a quick solution to establish new trade routes toward the Houses. The only viable path for this was through Omicron Delta, Kappa, Theta, Sigma-17, Sigma-19, and from there into Kusari or Rheinland.

The project is financed by Kusari, Liberty, Rheinland, Bretonia, the Gas Miners Guild, and the Core itself. Recognizing the critical importance of maintaining the Core's influence in the Omicrons, all involved parties swiftly allocated resources to Sigma-17 as soon as the first convoys were organized.

The timing of this project comes as no surprise. Following Atka's destruction by the Outcasts, the Houses feared that Sigma-17 could become a major choke point, potentially cutting the Core off from the rest of Sirius. To prevent this, the Core, in cooperation with Interspace Commerce, convened an emergency meeting on Newark Station with representatives from all sponsoring factions. They successfully persuaded all sides, emphasizing the Core’s vital contributions to technological advancements—thus, the Bora Bora project was set into motion.

591384.text:
CLASS: Oasis
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 120
591384.mapped:
Constructed in 834 AS at Yukawa Shipyard, Prison Liner Fiji was purchased by the Core to expand its operations in the Sigmas as part of a direct effort to secure trade routes between the eastern Omicrons and the rest of civilization.

The Fiji was stationed in the heart of the Sigma-17 trade corridor, where it is expected to remain until the new base, Bora Bora, is fully established. However, the dangers of Sigma-17 should not be underestimated. The wrecks of Freeport 7 and Atka serve as grim reminders to the local population that the laws of House space do not extend into the remote border worlds.

CREW: 410
591387.mapped:
Located not far from Freistadt, Elbe Station was constructed in 823 AS as a Border World command center for the Rheinland Federal Police. This decision was made after the diplomatically controversial deployment of the Battleship Schwerin was ended. The Federal Republic had long argued that a permanent police presence did not infringe the Boorman Treaty’s prohibition on the militarization of border systems. Initially there was uncertainty as to whether Elbe would be able to protect the highly dangerous border system, but considerable investment in construction upgrades and special heavily-armed Police squadrons created similar capabilities (and operating expenses) to Wildau Station.

Beyond protecting Omega-7's Trade Lanes and mining interests, rumors abound that Elbe was intended to monitor the IMG, amid government paranoia of another “Hessian sweep” similar to the fall of Dresden. These suspicions were further stoked when the Red Hessians were spotted fighting Bretonia alongside the Guild during the 826 AS Aland Crisis. During the Rheinland Civil War, Elbe initially remained neutral until the Battleship Altenburg arrived. Upon mooring, it arrested “disloyal” officers who would not pledge their service to the Empire, and replaced them with approved Imperial customs officials.

In the aftermath of that conflict, Elbe has continued to police Omega-7, although it is increasingly facing staff shortages due to funding gaps and recruitment difficulties. The RFP have urgently called for New Berlin to address the issue, however the system budget has yet to be increased. This has already resulted in a marked increase in Trade Lane attacks, and violent mining disputes.

591390.text:
Bearing chassis number HFBC-JDC-HX003, The Warspite is a Judicator class battlecruiser, a design that had its inception during Reynard Joyeuse' tenure as Lord Commander. The design however underwent many alterations before it reached the production stage, years later. Being one of the first Judicator spaceframes to be laid down at Fort Leniex, it was quickly adopted as a mobile, hard hitting platform due to its unique configuration of close point defense alongside a long range weapon system, foregoing part of its fighter berth facilities in return.

Not long after the Gaians made their presence known in Vespucci, reconnaissance wings detected readings consistent with Bretonian engine emissions deep inside the Veracruz Ice Field. Command ordered the Warspite to do a recon in force, not recognizing the strength of the enemy forces lying in wait. In what was witnessed by the ship's surviving crew, the Gaians executed a surprise attack with a mix of heavy fighters and bombers on the Warspite, using the density of the ice field to their advantage. Within the first two minutes of the engagement the Warspite's FCS and communications systems were crippled, and it was unable to return fire or radio for help as the Gaians slowly chipped away at its thick but helpless hulk.

Defenseless and unable to withdraw, the Warspite's commanding officer gave the order to scuttle the ship, purging its databanks and setting the Warspite's reactor to go critical. It became readily apparent to the Gaian forces who boarded the ship shortly afterwards that the self destruct sequence had failed, with the blame ironically placed on an overly safe reactor design with a state of the art coolant system and multiple redundant failsafes.

The gutted Warspite, now adrift around the hidden Atacama base, serves as a testament of to Gaian success in establishing their operations in Vespucci, but also as a reminder that the Insurgency is still a force the Gaians cannot yet match on the open field.

591392.text:
CLASS: Ramshackle
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: Unknown
591392.mapped:
Bornholm began its life as a Pilgrim Liner bearing the same name. Acquired by captain Johan Lehmann during Rheinland's post-Colony War collapse, he initially struggled to find work for his vessel and crew. After approaching the Junkers of Kreuzberg about employment, he was rebuffed -- during hard times, Junkers look after their own first. Instead, he set off for the dangerous Border Worlds, pursuing a rumor sold by a destitute ex-Military officer. He claimed a secret expedition had vanished shortly before the war began, while retrieving some immensely valuable object from a distant Omega system. Seeking Chancellor Niemann's lost treasures, the Bornholm eventually arrived in Omega-55 around 807 AS.

The liner found the system desolate but littered with mysterious military debris. Despite several successful expeditions shipping valuable salvage back to Rheinland, Lehmann did not have the labor to fully exploit his find. Reaching out to the Junkers again, he attracted many of the most adventurous of Yanagi Depot's salvagers, convincing them to stake claims in distant Omega-55. By 814 AS, the Bornholm had stopped making journeys back to Rheinland with spoils, instead adopting a permanent orbit around Planet Rugen. As time went on, wrecked station modules, derelict ships and other salvaged material were grafted to the immobilized Bornholm to create extended storage bays, improvised smelters and degenerate clubs.

Despite their earlier cold shoulder, the Junkers have since adopted Lehmann and his bizarre station as one of their own. This has helped smooth over relations with the Corsairs and Hessians, who often visit for supplies and entertainment. Many are drawn to "The Pit", a ramshackle arena that is notorious for death matches that are streamed across the Colonies -- many involving unwilling captives. "Mad" Lehmann has no intention of returning to Rheinland, having fully embraced the cruel freedoms of the lawless frontier. While Bornholm's Junkers ask their guests to sheathe their blades and holster their blasters, the stench of blood is ever present throughout the hulk's gloomy halls.

TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -14°C to 71°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 8.15 km/sec

Saarbrucken was surveyed by Daumann explorers in the 8th century. The scorching climate is one of extremes, featuring endless deserts of boiling orange-brown sands. Forests of spongy plants resiliently cling to sparse mountain outcroppings and the shores of salty sub-tropical lakes. These inhospitable, barely tolerable conditions deterred Rheinland’s corporations from establishing permanent bases, however the planet was cataloged as a potential terraforming candidate.

When the Red Hessians attempted to establish mining colonies in 827 AS, they were the first to discover a particularly violent species of giant desert worm. These enormous creatures feed on mineral resources and are endemic to the deserts, reacting with immediate hostility to colonies within their territorial range. This unwelcome discovery played a large part in the Hessians' motivation for evacuating the planet when the Rheinland Military launched its campaign to recapture Cologne the following year.

The Rheinland Federal Empire remains disinterested in shouldering the immense cost of a terraforming project, particularly in light of Saarbrucken’s “worm problem”. Regardless, Planetform Inc has expressed an interest in extracting these sand worms for research, amid speculation that they may be responsible for producing the planet’s breathable atmosphere. Rheinland has yet to grant any permits for exploratory works, likely over resentments about the Bretonian company’s role in the Hudson War.

A large sized gas giant located in the Cologne system. Violent electrical storms, which interferes with scanning equipment, can be seen plaguing the upper atmosphere of the purple planet. Due to this interference, the exact composition of the gas giant is currently not known.

CLASS: Unknown
GRAVITY: None
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: None
CREW: 0

The Escher Station - named after the Rheinland freelancer who found the hull, is an anomaly at the edge of the desolate Zurich system. The few archeologists and salvagers who have visited the wreck date the station as approximately two hundred years old. The station was, at one point, quite large, but no neural records have been found in the hull other than a large cargo of robotics. The strucutre follows conventional modular archictectures, but contains a mixture of Sirian and Gallic components - despite being built long before the majority of Sirius knew of Gallia's existence. With the discovery of the Zurich hole, Escher is an occasional curiosity to Unioners, Corse and Freelance explorers who pass through the connection. No attempts to repressurise the station has ever been made, and none of the station's computer cores are intact enough to trace the station's origins.

The only functional components of the hulk are some curiously well-preserved robotics in the nearby cargopods, that have drifted away from the station with time and decay.

591406.text: Part of a Bretonian attack group acting under orders passed down from the highest offices of the state. These ships were instructed to secure a beachhead within the Insurgent stronghold of Vespucci, expecting to corner the defenders of the system in a well struck pincer maneuver, the vanguard instead found itself pushing through a bottleneck represented by a minefield and a consolidated defensive force on its own. Outnumbered and boxed into an unfavorable position, an order to retreat was issued, evidently to little avail.

591409.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Mk IIb
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
591409.mapped:
The Tuscaloosa launched from Norfolk Shipyard in 818 AS, and saw early service in Bering during the Hudson War. During Rheinland’s retreat from the system, Tuscaloosa suffered structural damage to the bow from an enemy torpedo strike, requiring lengthy field repairs. In 824 AS, Tuscaloosa was redeployed to Ontario, to maintain order in the aftermath of the Toronto Massacre. After the victorious conclusion of the Gallic War, Liberty’s need to subsidize industrial efforts in Ontario came to an end -- the system was unceremoniously abandoned after an extended draw-down of law enforcement patrols. Tuscaloosa and its associated strike group were finally withdrawn from the system in 829 AS, returning to Norfolk Shipyard for long overdue modernization upgrades.

This resulted in the ship receiving a new assignment as a deep space training ship, teaching crews the inter-system strike operations that had characterized the later stages of the Hudson War. In part due to the ship’s long range configuration, it was requisitioned by the LSF in 834 AS, and hastily kitted out with additional reconnaissance equipment for deployment to Inverness. Acting in cooperation with the Crayter Republic, the taskforce probed rumors of alien warform sightings in the area. This resulted in attacks by suspected alien thralls -- codenamed “Wendigos” -- and eventual hostile contact with Jump Drive-equipped alien entities in 835 AS. At this revelation, the Tuscaloosa was withdrawn from Inverness, and the system designated for quarantine. After refueling in California, the Tuscaloosa was urgently returned to Ontario to secure the orbit of Planet Sudbury.

Tuscaloosa reached Sudbury orbit just before the Xenos launched a suicidal wave assault on the California Jump Gate and Battlecruiser Lehigh. Unable to return in time to assist, the Tuscaloosa was ordered back to Sudbury, with a mission to investigate the alien structure at Site Alpha, and either bring it within Liberty’s control or deny it to Liberty's enemies. After the California Jump Gate was scuttled to prevent a meltdown, the Tuscaloosa was stranded. Despite little progress having been made, supplies began to run low in early 836 AS. As a result, the Tuscaloosa used excavated boreholes to bury its magazines underneath the alien shield, rigging the munitions to detonate if ships landed nearby. It then departed the system on an interstellar cruise towards Colorado.

Tuscaloosa arrived in Liberty space mere days after Kusari's surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard, and the subsequent outbreak of the Liberty-Kusari War. What was to be a much needed homecoming for the ship's crew was limited to a single day of leave before resupply operations commenced. The Tuscaloosa is now preparing for another grueling assignment that is likely to take Tuscaloosa far behind enemy lines.

GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Limited
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: Unknown
591412.mapped:
Fort Leniex was originally excavated in 817 AS as the headquarters and main shipyard of the Hellfire Legion. Leniex was consistently expanded over the course of many years, housing a large portion of the Legion's senior officers and producing the majority of the movement's post-defection warships. Following the deployment of the first Arbiter class battleships in 819 AS, the LSF issued an enormous bounty for information regarding the location of Legion shipyard facilities. Access to Leniex was tightly restricted, with the facility heavily guarded through both internal security features and a significant garrison fleet -- its location was one of the Legion's most closely guarded secrets.

By the time the Liberty Commonwealth was founded in 822 AS, Leniex's military officers were accustomed to exercising unilateral authority over their own forces. This resulted in friction with civilian officials who frequently imposed themselves on the Legion's activities in the name of democratic oversight. This came to a head in 827 AS with the Scouring of Bering and the formation of the Liberty Insurgency. As the Insurgency launched a military coup against the Commonwealth it saw as ineffective, Leniex sent its garrison to subdue Planet Veracruz and establish a military governor. The Fort was then formally appointed as the Insurgency's military capital and tasked with coordinating the defense against Liberty's ongoing campaign.

By early 829 AS, the Liberty Navy's offensive had driven the Insurgency out of Pennsylvania, broken through the defenses in Kansas and pushed on into Vespucci. As Liberty laid siege to Planet Veracruz, supplies at Leniex ran desperately low. Commanders acknowledged the situation was hopeless and ordered Leniex be scuttled, and the surviving combatants scatter. It was agreed that a last stand would inevitably see the station discovered, compromising secrets about the Insurgency's informants, suppliers, partners and even families. Charges detonated across the complex destroyed databanks, gutted the interior and shattered two of the three drydocks.

While many of the Insurgency's survivors fled abroad or to other organizations, others fell into despair, wallowing aboard Freeport 14 and other remote stations. Exploiting this vulnerability, the Vagrants acquired these individuals through manipulative siren songs of redemption or revenge, expanding their Thrall network into Liberty. In this way, the Wendigos first became aware of Leniex, with attempts to partially restore the complex beginning in late 834 AS. The much-diminished facility is now known as Leniex Outpost, serving as the nerve center for the Infiltrators that steer the Wendigo's Thralls, and the primary site for Vagrant experimentation on their own strains of hybridized technologies.

By early 829 AS, the Liberty Navy's offensive had driven the Insurgency out of Pennsylvania, broken through the defenses in Kansas and pushed on into Vespucci. As Liberty laid siege to Planet Veracruz, supplies at Leniex ran desperately low. Commanders acknowledged the situation was hopeless and ordered Leniex be scuttled, and the surviving combatants scatter. It was agreed that a last stand would inevitably see the station discovered, compromising secrets about the Insurgency's informants, suppliers, partners and even families. Charges detonated across the complex destroyed databanks, gutted the interior and shattered two of the three drydocks.

While many of the Insurgency's survivors fled abroad or to other organizations, others fell into despair, wallowing aboard Freeport 14 and other remote stations. Exploiting this vulnerability, the Vagrants acquired these individuals through manipulative siren songs of redemption or revenge, expanding their Thrall network into Liberty. In this way, the Wendigos first became aware of Leniex, with attempts to partially restore the complex beginning in late 834 AS. The much-diminished facility is now known as Leniex Outpost, serving as the nerve center for the Infiltrators that steer the Wendigo's Thralls, and the primary site for Vagrant experimentation on their own strains of hybridized technologies.

591415.text:
The ice asteroids of Sonora were originally part of the Barrier, pulled into the gravity well of the Vespucci system over time. In the waning years of the Commonwealth, substantial deposits of silver have been discovered at the northwestern edge of the field, leading to speculation that this field intersected with another belt at some point. No outstanding mining operations have been assembled in the field, however, largely due to the local Gaian garrison targeting Commonwealth, and later Insurgency, operations across Vespucci.

After the defeat of the Insurgency in 829 AS, the activity within the field dropped sharply, with little more than an occasional scavenger or a Gaian scout disturbing the desolate system.

A large ice asteroid field that once formed part of the Sonora Ice Field. The Tijuana Ice Field remains a serious navigation hazard, primarily due to the unexploded mines from Liberty Insurgency defenses that have since dispersed from a lack of maintenance. Despite the destruction of the Insurgency, pirates, terrorists and smugglers still frequent the field.

591419.text:
CLASS: Arbiter
CREW: 0.
ARMAMENT: N/A

Battleship Fate's Hand was built at Fort Leniex in 819 AS, the first Arbiter battleship produced by the Hellfire Legion. Much of its service was spent as a patrol base in the Liberty Independent Worlds, striking targets of opportunity while conserving scarce fuel and munitions. In 827 AS, it led the Hellfire Legion relief force during the Scouring of Bering, shoring up the desperate rearguard action that allowed for the evacuation of the Liberty Separatists from Marshall Station. Despite suffering crippling damage during an exchange with the Battleship Concord's fleet, the mighty ship's fighter screen enabled it to disengage and limp away to West Dallas Debris Field in Texas.

The Fate's Hand spent several months hiding in a low-power state, while improvised repairs were carried out to its gutted engines to ensure it would survive another Jump Hole transit. The desolate hulk was then towed back to Vespucci for full inspection, where it was quickly established that the damage was too severe for a full repair to be practical. Instead, the vessel's hull was patched so it could serve at Fort Leniex as a defense battery and training post for green crews. Though capable of limited movement using maneuvering thrusters, the battleship was unable to carry out front line duties or extended journeys.

By the time Liberty breached Vespucci in 829 AS, the Insurgency's military forces were all but spent. Plans were initially drawn up to sacrifice the Fate's Hand in an attempt to break the siege on Veracruz, however the proposal was soon vetoed as a futile loss of life that would likely reveal Leniex's location. When the Separatists' surviving commanders accepted that Vespucci was lost and scuttled the Fort, the Fate's Hand was stripped of sensitive equipment alongside it and likewise sabotaged. Since then, the wreckage has been picked over by Wendigo scavengers, who have stripped many of its hull panels for repair materials.

591421.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
A large rocky asteroid field located in the Vespucci system. The metallic dust within the cloud has a significant dampening effect, rendering ship sensors largely ineffective. Some speculate abandoned Liberty Insurgency assets may be hidden in the field following their defeat by the Liberty Navy in 829 AS. Few prospectors or scavengers return from expeditions to locate this rumored treasure, amid reports of unknown, hostile vessels prowling the depths.

591423.text:
CLASS: Ranseur
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
The Dreadnought Ravager began its service as the Outcast battleship MNS Ampoliros. In the earliest days of the Hellfire Legion's uprising, military commanders identified a pressing need to replace or supplement their limited supply of capital class hardware if they were to continue resisting Liberty effectively. This requirement would eventually result in the development of the Arbiter class battleship. Prior to this, the Legion's admirals sought assistance from foreign powers to bolster their own capabilities.

The only such endeavour to bear fruit was a negotiation with the Outcasts brokered by the Lane Hackers. Seeing the value in a local insurgency disrupting Liberty's authorities, the Toruella Cartel agreed to the sale of a prototype Ranseur hull. Upon receipt of the Ampoliros, the Legion's engineers were aghast to discover that they had been sold an ancient and obselete hulk that had been stripped of its most sensitive and useful components. Despite the Legion's complaints, the Outcasts advised they had upheld exactly the bargain they had agreed to - a prototype first generation battleship.

The newly christened Ravager was plagued by mechanical issues that prevented its front line deployment, resulting in a permanent assignment to Vespucci as a traffic checkpoint. Most of its officers dealt closely with Commonwealth officials during this period, creating strong loyalties to the separatist state. With the formation of the Insurgency in 827 AS, the Ravager quickly declared in favour of the civilian government. It was destroyed soon after the arrival of the joint Insurgent Fleet following the shattering of Willard Research Station. The wreck remains unsalvaged as a reminder of the Commonwealth's dissolution.

Marshall Station was the headquarters of the Liberty Separatists, a military rebellion formed from rogue Liberty Navy and LSF elements. Marshall Station was assembled in secrecy in 825 AS, and was used to service Separatist capital ships for operations against Liberty. Marshall Station's concealed location was identified by LSF operatives in early 827 AS, with the Battleship Concord mustering in Texas with its support fleet soon after.

In mid-827 AS Liberty initiated the Scouring of Bering, a brutal operation to root out and destroy the pirates of Freeport 2 and the insurrectionists aboard Marshall Station. Separatist scouts quickly spotted the fleets on a heading towards Bering, triggering an emergency evacuation. The Vespucci Commonwealth ordered the Hellfire Legion to immediately withdraw from the Marshall garrison and avoid the fight, a move that would have resulted in the Separatists' complete destruction.

Refusing these orders in an act of mutiny, a joint Separatist and Hellfire Legion attack group intercepted the Concord fleet to buy time for Marshall's evacuation. While this desperate rearguard action was successful, it came at a terrible cost, with much of the garrison fleet's senior leadership being annihilated. Liberty eventually broke through the Marshall picket line, with siege cruisers venting the once-proud Separatist bastion with sustained fire.

The grievous losses suffered by the Hellfire Legion and Separatists forced their merger, resulting in the Liberty Insurgency. The Insurgency went on to attack and liquidate the Vespucci Commonwealth civilian government they felt had betrayed them.

TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 15°C to 76°C

The Planet Iridescencia, named after the optical phenomenon "Iridescence" in which hue changes with the angle from which a surface is viewed, is a good example of how something which appears to be beautiful and simple at first can be deadly up close. No surveys of the surface have been taken, due to the extremely hostile conditions on the planet. The atmosphere is toxic, with massive volcanoes billowing up a mixture of sulphuric vapors and ash. These create violent lightning storms and intense showers of acidic rain which consume most man-made materials in minutes. While this can be a beautiful sight to behold from orbit, any pilot who foolishly ventures too deep into the planet's gravity well is fated never to return.

CLASS: Makeshift
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 4K
591438.mapped:
Barrier Gate is one of the few privately owned space stations in Sirius. Freelance explorer George Tinsley made a name for himself in underworld circles when he discovered the "Barrier Pass" in 801 AS. This shortcut between Tau and Liberty space completely bypassed Bretonia, promising to revolutionize the movement of contraband across the region. Knowing full well that his secret would not remain that way for long, Tinsley called in favors and invested his entire fortune into excavating a rock on the edge of the Barrier Ice Field. When the hired Independent Miners Guild (IMG) workers were finished, Tinsley began to discretely advertise the new passage to Liberty Rogue contacts, in the hope of reaching the Outcast cartels.

Tinsley now serves as the owner-administrator -- or some would say mob boss -- of Barrier Gate, which has grown steadily over the decades. The station is frequented by a motley assortment of pirates, freelancers, smugglers and Bounty Hunters, along with more disreputable elements among the IMG and Crayter Republic. Most of the station's revenue is made by taking a small cut from facilitated cargo transactions, and servicing the various needs and requirements of its guests. As Tinsley planned, Barrier Gate eventually became a place where the Outcasts could exchange Cardamine with the criminals of Liberty, producing astounding profits and making him the wealthiest man in the Independent Worlds.

This plan was not without its problems -- Tinsley is constantly fighting off subtle plots by the Rogues, Junkers and the Outcasts themselves, all who covet Barrier Gate's strategic location. As a result, the elderly kingpin has employed a well-paid army of mercenaries who are fiercely loyal to him alone. The arrival of the Crayter Republic to Coronado in 818 AS presented the station with a further quandary, as heightened military patrols threatened local smuggling. While it was initially feared that the Republic would attempt to shut the Gate down, this has so far failed to happen. Republic officials have conspicuously turned a blind eye, while Tinsley himself has been spotted hosting lavish and well attended parties on Planet Yuma.

The first Crayterian outpost in Coronado, Sabah Shipyard was hastily constructed in 817 AS. Initially based on the blueprints of Singapore Shipyard, it was originally constructed with components salvaged from Tau-44 during the Republic's evacuation of that system. It provided a basic platform for facilitating the desperate colonization of Planet Yuma, as well as coordinating the temporary resettlement of the remaining Crayterian population onto Pecos. Soon after, it was further expanded to service ships of all sizes.

As the Crayter Republic's primary shipyard, Sabah is one of the busiest ports in the region. From the first drydock's completion, Sabah has operated at full capacity, repairing and producing fighters, capital ships and civilian support vessels for the refugee Republic. With the end of the Gallic War in 827 AS, the Crayter Republic finally felt secure enough to scale back military production so Sabah's facilities could be renovated, and its industrial output pivoted to accelerating Yuma's development.

While formerly the shipyard served as the prime platform for the colonization of Yuma and the resettlement of the civilian population, it now functions as the Republic's center of industry, and all civilian traffic headed to or from a Crayterian base in the system checks in with Sabah. The shipyard suffered moderate damage during the Jericho Incident in 835 AS, and operated as the central rescue point for ships disabled during the emergency. In late 835 AS, Sabah was temporarily closed to the public while a "critical project" was ongoing.

Salina is a large Hydrogen-Helium gas giant. It has unusually large amounts of nitrogen in the upper atmosphere, which glow purple when ionized by the solar wind. Salina is currently orbited by 5 large moons which are suspected to have once been independent planets which have been pulled into the gas giant's massive gravity well.

Oraibi is a terrestrial planet with a thin atmosphere composed of nitrogen and krypton. Its frigid surface is composed of vast Copper deposits covered by layers of sodium oxide dust. Because of noxious surface gases, it is curently too expensive for IMG to invest in mining operations.

591448.text:

MASS: 4.90 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Frozen
TEMPERATURE: -64°C to 4°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 7.27 km/sec
591448.mapped:
Pecos is a large moon composed of rock and ice, with a 37-year orbital cycle of freezing and thawing caused by Planet Salina's intense tidal forces. The Independent Miners Guild (IMG) established a small mining colony in 802 AS, shortly before Barrier Gate opened. The IMG discovered large deposits of Copper deep within the icy crust, which was extracted in spartan subterranean mining colonies. Since then, local mining has gradually declined in favour of orbital operations in the Sierra Vista Nebula. Despite this, Pecos remains an important refining centre, processing harvested Copper Ore and Hydrogen. Traditionally the Guild has shipped Pecos' exports to Tau-31 or Manchester for distribution by Gateway Shipping.

In 817 AS, after the Gallic conquest of Tau-44, the Crayter Republic leased large tracts of land from the IMG to temporarily house their fleeing civilian population. The moon is entirely unsuitable for agriculture or large-scale settlement, and the refugee population could only be sustained through a constant stream of expensive imports from Liberty. Prior to the Crayterian arrival, there were rarely more than a few hundred residents at any time. The relationship between the refugees and heavily outnumbered Miners became strained and suspicious following the annexation of Aland Shipyard in 826 AS, in which the Crayter Republic had supported the Bretonian action.

As the colonization of Yuma progressed, the population of Pecos dwindled, with the last Crayter representatives being expelled by 834 AS. As the last refugee habitat became an abandoned ghost town, the local population returned back to the low hundreds. The following year, Pecos was hit by an energy blast from the Jericho Incident. Fortunately, the moon's orbital period ensured Planet Salina bore the brunt of the impact, while the underground mining colonies were further insulated from the residue blast. Despite this, significant damage has been caused to local electronics. The IMG have resolved to persevere and continue work, despite Jericho's proximity and the risk of further incidents.

591450.text: A small, airless planetoid that coalesced from a ring of dust and ice crystals. Fuchu Planetoid is orbited by the Prison Station which it gives its namesake. The planetoid's low gravity makes it a cheap source of water for the orbiting facilities. It is rumoured that particularly sadistic guards used to drop groups of rival organizations on the surface in spacesuits, and force them to battle it out among one another, though the source of these rumours is suspect at best.

TERRAIN: Barren

Jericho is a barren, rocky moon with no atmosphere. Visual scans indicate that there is ancient wreckage located near one of the moon's poles, however the space surrounding Jericho is heavily radiated and produces strong electromagnetic interference that has prevented detailed analysis and exploration of the surface. Since 835 AS, the moon has been encased in a powerful shield, which has so far been impervious to the Crayter Republic's weapons.

The Crayter Republic established a quarantine cordon around Jericho in 821 AS, with weapon platforms and warning beacons deployed to deter visitors. The CR are believed to have carried out joint research projects with "qualified experts" that allegedly include The Order, however no findings have been published. Limited excavations were conducted, however probes rapidly burn out due to the extreme radioactive conditions.

In 834 AS, an LSF detachment deployed to the Jericho quarantine to carry out their own studies, despite Crayter's objections. The IMG also issued a public demand that the Republic dismantle the Jericho quarantine, claiming it infringed their territorial rights emanating from Pecos' orbit. The Guild believed the Jericho radiation belt was caused by Uranium deposits, which they asserted exclusive rights to exploit.

The following year, this assumption proved to be catastrophically incorrect, when Jericho was struck by an energetic beam from deep space. Following this impact, the moon emitted a highly damaging secondary energy pulse -- previously undetected underground alien ruins reactivated, and ziggurat-like structures pushed to the surface. These structures appear to be maintaining the moon's shield.

Socorro is a moon of the Planet Salina, mainly composed of Iron with deposits of Nickel and an atmosphere of carbon-dioxide and argon. Being tidally locked to Salina, the two hemispheres of the moon experience very different day night cylces. The Salina side of the moon has a day of dim twilight when passing the sun facing side of Salina, a pair of periods of both Salina light and Sunlight in its morning and evening, and a noon of darkness while it basks in the infrared glow of Gas Giant Salina, while the other side experiences a fairly standard day/night cycle of only four and a half standard days each day and each night.

Given the relative youth of the Coronado star and the significant gravity well of Tova, the atmosphere loss must have occurred very quickly, possibly the result of an extremely cataclysmic event.

Goddess Geode is an ultra rare carbon type planet. The entire surface of the planet is composed of crystals and light silicate dust. It has an atmosphere composed of carbon dioxide and sodium. Select regions of the planet can support human life due to the introduction of "Scrubbies", an alien organism native to the Baffin system.
Under the planet's surface is an intricate network of giant crystal filled caves and tunnels. Many of the resident Zoners consider the planet to be entirely hollow, scientists however remain skeptical because the laws of planetary formation demand that the planet have a solid core of Iron or similar material. The debate between these groups will continue until the underground caverns have been completely mapped.

The Pueblo Bonito temple was placed in orbit near Eris to provide an exclusive place for the Sect's meditation, worship, and secret Initiation Rites.

As planetoids of equal mass, Hodge and Podge share a violent orbit with each other. Every few years the planets will draw so close that they will literally tear pieces from each other, before rapidly repelling each other once again.
Scientists are torn on whether or not this pattern can continue indefinitely, or if these two worlds will eventualy destroy each other. The relation between these two worlds is very similar to the relation of the two sides of the "Scared Chao", a Sacred symbol of the Sect's "Catma".

591490.mapped:
Supply Station Neckar was constructed in 825 AS, orbiting Planet Stuttgart near Aalen. Neckar was deployed as a private mooring fixture for Synth Foods, allowing their transports to circumvent Stuttgart mooring queues and fees. In this capacity, Neckar acts as a convenient orbital warehouse for imported necessities, as well as a hub for stockpiling Synth Paste for export across Rheinland and Kusari.

Since 828 AS, Neckar and inbound Synth transports have come under furious attack by Farmers’ Alliance terrorists. Despite the proximity of the Battleship Westfalen, the Military is often slow to respond to these attacks. Synth has accordingly increased its bounties for kills on Alliance ships, leading to a large garrison of Bounty Hunters taking up position aboard.

591495.mapped:
Renowned as the largest Liberty Rogue installation in Sirius, Attica Station is a place of debauchery and sin, with some of Liberty's most notorious and violent criminals residing here. Contrary to most Junker bases, who put great effort into ensuring a non-violent environment to protect everyone's private business, the denizens of Attica Station long since abandoned hope that any precautions against people's lesser urges would bear fruit.

Content with merely guarding the vital areas of Attica which are mostly related to the production of pirate vessels, the rest of the station has entered a quasi-stalemate between rivalling gangs under the patronage of a warlord. With only occasional, conveniently accidental deaths between the gangs, business aboard the station is able to function, with the local warlords sharing the fruits of their dominance over the station with one another, as none have managed to assert themselves as the overlord of all Liberty Rogues yet.

Belmont Yard is a ramshackle assemblage bolted to the sprawling bulk of Padua Base, and is the source of the fearsome "Scylla" destroyer. While its parent base is frequently wracked by gang wars and feuds, Belmont is run by a cartel of Rogue engineers and technicians who observe a disinterested neutrality. This is intended to avoid negative impacts on shipbuilding, however, bickering aboard Padua over construction slots often delay Belmont's ship queues and divert supplies for weeks on end.
591497.mapped:
The latest extension module of Attica Station, commonly referred to as Belmont Yard, represents the increasing degree of internal organisation and influx of resources for the ever growing Liberty Rogues. As opposed to the rest of Attica – which is caught in a never-ending control feud between several gangs and their Warlords – the Belmont Yard is a designated neutral zone, free of any particular gang's control. Too valuable to be caught in the internal power struggles, this extension was provided a unitary purpose; to serve as the center stage for the manufacturing and upkeep of their trademark "Scylla" class cruisers.

However, disputes aboard Attica between the Warlords are fairly common, and wrestling over construction and upkeep slots often delay Belmont's ship queue for weeks on end.

591499.mapped:
Valravn Citadel is a large space station orbiting the ice planet Elgin in the Inverness system, and is the most important space station of the Technocrats. The foundations of Valravn were laid in 825 AS, and the station has been expanded gradually into its current form, with a focus on making the station as self-sufficient, sustainable, and secure as possible -- both against threats coming from outside and from within the station itself.

The original purpose of the Citadel was to serve as a central hub for the fledgling Technocrat society. However, with subsequent expansions, many research and production facilities, a complex for amenities, and even a dry dock for repair and maintenance of Technocrat spacecraft were added. Since the incorporation of the Gammu "refugees" among the Technocrats as of 832 AS, Valravn now also serves as their new home base -- a function made possible primarily due to reserve computing power allowing the Citadel's network to serve as a limited replacement of the lost Planet Gammu's infrastructure for the surviving AIs.

Following the collapse of the gravitational anomaly connecting Inverness to Vespucci, Valravn Citadel found itself in a challenging supply situation, having lost one of their covert supply routes from the Borderworlds and beyond. This supply complication became even more pronounced when the survivors from Gammu arrived at the Citadel. The station had to be quickly modified to accommodate the machine intelligences' computing needs, which led to a significant portion of the facilities and services onboard becoming either unavailable or subject to rationing due to these adjustments.

Although the Technocrat administration managed to quell unrest aboard the Citadel, preventing any serious internal disturbance, it is now clear that the limits of the Citadel's original design in terms of sustainability have been reached.

591532.mapped:
Yuma is a lush world that, at first, seems ideal for human population; with its vast seas, temperate islands, and a wide equatorial band of humid tropical terrain, it seems to practically beg for human inhabitants. Since its discovery in 640 AS by Zoner explorers, there have been nearly a dozen attempts at colonization, all of which (save the most recent) failed. The overly-aggressive native flora is capable of re-growing in cleared land at astonishing speeds and chokes out synthetic crops with ease; as such, early attempts at colonization failed because they lacked strong supply lines from off-world.

In 817 AS, Deep Space Engineering surveyors based their ship, the Armstrong, in orbit of the planet. When DSE revealed their discovery of the planet to the Libertonian public, intense bidding for rights on Yuma ensued, and the resultant capital gave DSE the funds necessary to initiate construction of a docking ring.

However, the Armstrong came under increasingly frequent and organized attacks from pirates in the system. Dozens of survey probes sent throughout the system were destroyed, and it soon became clear to the Armstrong's crew that they were not welcome in the system. Pirates, utilizing more advanced weaponry than previous raids, managed to destroy the Armstrong in a single concentrated assault, with all DSE crew onboard lost, and the docking ring not quite complete.

The Crayter Republic entered the system shortly after the Armstrong met its demise. Seeing an opportunity to ensure a strong claim to at least half of Coronado, the refugee Crayterians constructed Sabah Shipyard in orbit of the planet. In conjunction with Liberty and with clandestine financial backing from the Independent Miners Guild, the Crayterians have nearly finished the docking ring's construction, and, thanks to a discriminating campaign of eliminating the native flora in conjunction with Planetform Inc., have established several successful colonies on the planet's surface.

The largest settlement on Yuma is the capital city of New Thessalonica, which is home to over three million souls. New Thessalonica, as well as a handful of smaller settlements, represent a new class of "floating cities" built atop Yuma's various oceans. These cities have been kept well-fed in the process of establishing sustainable agriculture thanks to the Republic's extensive agreements with Synth Foods.

In total, Yuma's total population sits comfortably at just barely under five million, with the majority being citizens of the Crayter Republic. Crayterians from their home sector form a plurality of their citizenry, with a large portion of others having their roots in the IMG, and many freed former slaves who have been naturalized. Additionally, the non-citizen part of this planet's population is made up primarily of refugees from Bretonia with some Libertonian entrepeneurs looking to sell supplies to the nation which has finally secured itself a real home.

591537.mapped:
Initially constructed as a survey outpost by the Independent Miners Guild, it was transferred to Crayter control when operations did not yield the expected results.

The Crayter Republic redeveloped the structure into a space fortress, which eventually became known as Sulawesi Citadel. When the Gallic Royal Navy invaded, the station was evacuated by the Crayter Republic to Coronado. The Gallic occupation made the citadel their primary base of operations.

In the liberation of Tau-44, both CR and Council launched an assault to retake the citadel. They were able to take over essential positions, before being confronted by the remaining defenders that resisted for 24-hours. The fierce fighting ended when the commanding officer of the Royalists fell, and the rest had no choice but to join the Council.

Sulawesi Citadel was quickly refortified by the Crayterians, but normal operations will take longer to rehabilitate.

591543.mapped:
Minato Harbour was built by the Crayter Republic as a logistics hub to facilitate a future colonization of Borneo. It served as an orbital port for Borneo, housed government institutions, and sheltered a large part of the Crayter population.

The station was occupied by the Gallic Royal Navy when they breached into Tau-44. During this time, Gallic research teams evaluated the potential of Borneo, who later concluded it wasn't beneficial to invest in. In the years between 822-824 AS, the Council and Crayter Republic fought back for the system's control, and by early 824 AS, the Gallic Navy withdrew from the system entirely. The harbour suffered major structural damage in battle.

At the moment, the Crayterians are uncertain if to repair the station. The lengthy supply lines to Coronado, combined with the necessity to avoid GRN controlled space - makes for a challenging task.

591546.mapped:
Discovered in 810 AS, Borneo is a frigid world of dotted land masses and sparse coastlines. Its oceans contain a diverse array of fauna that serves as a base for simple organisms that make up the local ecology, all of which is highly toxic to humans. Large forests of trees similar to Earth aspen and fir sweep across islands on the planet's equator, providing a breathable atmosphere. Despite the harsh environment, the planet is indeed capable of supporting human settlement without the need for large-scale terraforming, though dependence upon biodome produced food and limited exposed ground limits the islands to small colonies.

The Crayter Republic intended to settle the planet, building Minato Harbour in orbit to handle supplies and colonists bound for the surface. However, colonisation was interrupted by the invasion of the Gallic Royal Navy in its early stages, forcing a planetary evacuation. The Gallic forces showed no interest in restarting the colonization efforts and dispatched a single research team to study the ecology.

This team was quickly withdrawn by the Gallic Royal Navy following the defection of Oblique in 824 AS. When a combination of Council and Crayter Military forces recaptured Minato, they discovered the settlements had been utterly neglected during the Gallic occupation, the structures battered to a ruinous state by the harsh and unforgiving environment, adding considerable cost to the already sizable sum needed to restart colonization.

Palawan has the same geological structure as Malacca's rocky core, as if they were once one. Planet Mindanao is a true miracle for scientists. But like every rose, this stellar body has thorns. Huge uranium deposits are present inside the planet's crust, and severe radiation that penetrates all types of shields makes approaching Mindanao very dangerous. Attempts by the Independent Miners Guild to establish planetside automated mining facilities all ended in failure. The remnants of a destroyed research station orbit the planet, a casualty of the Gallic invasion into the system.
