Cairo Outpost was excavated by the Order in 834 AS. It served as a launching point for patrols headed into the upper Omicrons, and a vital monitoring station for tracking local Nomad and Core activities. The following decade saw almost constant combat, with Cairo's rapid response forces tackling threats both alien and human across Omicron Zeta. Matters culminated in 835 AS, when the Order was attacked on two fronts by the Core and Kusari forces. The Core assault, spearheaded by Battleship Mars, headed straight for Cairo, while the Battleship Hakodate, leading Kusari's assault, attacked Fort Carthage.

Caught in an impossible situation, the Order consolidated their local garrisons to repel the attack in Omicron Mu. As a result, Cairo was left with a volunteer rearguard, who understood they faced likely death. The Battle of Cairo saw Order and Core forces clash in the station's vicinity. Cairo lost most of its fleet during the initial phase of the Core’s assault. Despite this, Order agents executed a valiant counter-attack after artificial intelligence systems aboard the Battleship Mars revolted, prompting its retreat. While the Core fleet was thrown into disarray by the unexpected reversal, the Order's forces were exhausted and unable to capitalize on the initiative.

It was then that the Nomads -- exploiting the destruction of perimeter sensors during the Core's attack -- uncloaked to launch their long-planned invasion. While Cairo was quickly overwhelmed and destroyed, the complete sacrifice of its rearguard allowed The Order to evacuate more crew and supplies than expected. The desolate wastes of Omicron Zeta now serve as yet another terrible reminder that human infighting in the Edge Nebula leads only to dire consequences for all involved.

592015.text:
DIAMETER: 9,568 km.
MASS: 5.23 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: Arctic
TEMPERATURE: -230°C to -112°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.1 km/sec

Palmyra is an icy, distant world located in the remote system of Omicron Zeta. Most of the planet's surface is covered by a number of enormous, dirty glaciers comprised of ice mixed with rock debris, shielded from the vastness of space by only a token atmosphere. Despite the fact that it was discovered and charted over a decade ago, as well as the construction of Cairo Station, the intricacies of the planet's surface remain unsurveyed. Only cursory scans were made, quickly dismissing any hopes for easily accessible resources or alien artifacts.

592016.text: The Edge nebula is an immense looming cloud that occupies almost half of the Omicron Minor system. Once used as a screen by the secretive organisation known as the Order to protect their adopted homeworld, it now serves as a mass graveyard for all those lost during the Battle of Omicron Minor and the devastation of planet Toledo.

592018.text: A small cloud of planetary debris on the far reaches of Tohoku system. Kurosawa is not frequently patrolled due to its distant nature, but occasional visitors have reported seeing strange ships there.

592020.text:
>>>WARNING: SEVERE DANGER<<<
A disc formed from planetary fragments, scrap and derelict ships from the second Battle of Toledo led to the appearance of a sort of unspoken "no man's land". A shameful memorial for both the Order's and the Core's fleets, the graveyard continues to grow in size. Both sides appear to be too occupied with one another to conduct any salvage operations on a large scale, meaning that so long as the conflict continues and due to the danger that even a Junker wouldn't think twice about risking, the field will remain for the indeterminate future.

The sheer amount of scrap metal attracts the occasional odd scavenger, liable to join the silent fleet of wrecks. With the crossfire between the Order and Core still churning above the dead planet and Nomads attacking everyone without discrimination, Omicron Minor is one of the most dangerous places to be in the entire Sirius Sector.

592021.text:
An alien structure composed of unknown material seems consistent with faster than light travel technology employed in Ageira Jump Gates. While the device remains operational, scans reveal severe damage inflicted upon internal machinery and overall structural integrity. It is believed that the damage sustained was delivered by The Order in an operation staged during the aftermath of the Toledo disaster.

A well-equipped battlegroup was dispatched into the area in order to rig and destroy the Jump Gate. While not a total success, The Order appears satisfied with the result. Few ships entering the gate have been seen again, and no Nomad has been known to emerge from it since the gate's disabling. Any data concerning what lays beyond is classified.

592024.text: The wreckage of the Order bomber Delta-3, which participated in the attack on the Dyson Sphere at the end of the Nomad War.

592026.text: The wreck of Santos Bolevara's personal ship, a high-ranking member of the Order Overwatch who went missing.

592028.text: The wreckage of the Technocracy recon fighter Volans.

592030.text: The wreck of the Torbay, a Crayter bomber that was ambushed by Outcasts.

592032.text: Little information remains about the original purposes of this installation, only that it was operated by the LSF for a short time prior to its unexpected decommissioning. The aged and forgotten wreckage begets more questions than its remains can answer, though many of the rumors surrounding the facility's demise were likely spun up by LSF agents themselves to spook agents-in-training.

592034.text: The hulk of the LSF transport Omega. This armored courier ship appears to have been used to ferry experimental components and high-value personnel in-system. Whatever unfortunate demise captured Hackert Station in the end also caught the Omega in its wake, and now the two rest forgotten amidst Alaskan clouds.

592036.text: A derelict depot from the nearby Escher wreck.

592038.text: The wreck of the Benkei, a GMG ship.

592040.text: The remains of a Bundschuh fighter.

592042.text: A fightercraft of the old Royal Navy that was disabled by Council forces, or by raiders belonging to one of the Gallic pirate factions. The ship is damaged beyond repair, but some intact equipment may remain onboard.

An uncharted oceanic world. The impenetrable minefield has made further studying of the Planet Vanuatu impossible.

592047.text:
The wreck of an Outcast transport ship, Santa Rosa frequently ran supply runs from planet Malta to the bases in Omicron Beta, bringing both much-needed Cardamine and munitions.

On one such voyage, the Order came across it and ambushed the Santa Rosa but left the wreck in a far away region of the system. Cardamine can still be found onboard, while the bodies of the crew have been preserved to this day.

592049.text:
One of the few fighters that attempted to escape the destroyed Lisbon Starbase, the Shapash was piloted by Tom Kimmons, an Order agent that spent much of his time raiding the frequent patrols that were dispatched by Galicia Research Station.

On the day of the attack on Lisbon, he spent little time trying to understand the circumstances and decided to rush for the hangar bays to escape. Successful in doing so, he shot down two Outcast ships on the way out, which were blocking the way.

Tom never reached the relative safety of Omicron Mu, in spite of the events around Lisbon, as he was located by an Outcast raiding party later that day and killed. His ship can still be found close to the Jump Hole leading to the Order's new home, serving as a tribute to the battles fought by the organization against both human and alien rivals.

592051.text: Containing the remains of Lisbon Station, this newly-formed debris filed has already caught the attention of salvagers willing to brave the fury of nature and Outcasts alike. Though of no military value, the equipment that can be found nonetheless sells for a good profit at refining facilities across Sirius.

592053.text:
Erebus is the only gas giant in the Tau-61 system and the most massive planet in the system. Three large moons orbit it -- the potentially habitable Apeiron, the volcanic Tartarus and the frozen Hypnos. The gas giant is strongly influenced by the gravity of both stars and the Labyrinth cloud. The influence of these three potentially massive bodies on Erebus itself is also behind its variable rotation period, which depends on the relative constellation of these bodies.

The immense gas giant is notable for its extremely strong plasma storms in the upper layers of its atmosphere, likely caused by the liquid magnetic core of the giant itself and the excitation of its magnetosphere by the solar winds of its two stars. Although these storms are potentially dangerous to passing ships around the gas giant, they also serve as a magnetic shield protecting the atmosphere of Erebus' most peculiar moon, Apeiron.

592055.text: Tartarus is the youngest moon of Planet Erebus. The primordial moon’s volcanic activity suggests that it was formed by the collision of two smaller moons. Tartarus is rich in minerals, particularly cobalt, tungsten and titanium. Any potential economic exploitation is curtailed by Tartarus’s unstable tectonic and volcanic shifts.

592057.text: Planet Pontus is a frozen and dead world orbiting one of the twin suns of Tau-61. The planet has a very weak magnetic field and long since lost its atmosphere due to intense stellar winds. Without an atmosphere and strong volcanic activity, the planet has slowly turned into a frozen and radioactive wasteland. Even with current technological advances, Pontus offers no meaningful use.

592059.text: Hypnos is a geologically inactive moon of the planet Erebus orbiting its parent planet in an unstable orbital path. The barren moon is covered by a kilometers-thick crust of frozen methane, nitrogen and hydrogen, making any potential exploitation of the moon a flimsy prospect at best.

592061.text:
A frozen, dead world, orbiting a green star in an unstable orbit. The abnormal orbit suggests that Ourea is a rogue planet that has been recently captured by the gravitational pull of the Tau-61 system, with its continued future as one of the system’s orbiting bodies called into question.

Ourea's surface suggests an abnormally active geological past, and its surface is riddled with massive diamond crystals that cover the planet in a nearly impermeable shell. Astrogeological analysis of the planet's surface suggests the presence of unusually regular structures hidden deep beneath the diamond shell.

592063.text:
Lurking deep within the depths of the Labyrinth, Achlys is a magnetar: a neutron star with an exceptionally powerful magnetic field. Although only a remnant of an ancient supergiant star, it is still by far the heaviest body in the Tau-61 system and accounts for a significant portion of the system's total mass. It is possible that the ominous clouds of Tau-61 are the result of a supernova in Achlys’s past. Hypothetically, it may be one of the oldest objects in the known universe.

Although Achlys no longer undergoes any fusion reactions and has long since started to cool, its extremely strong gravity and hidden position in the cloud make it the most dangerous body in the Tau-61 system.

Due to its immense mass, the magnetar ties all other bodies around it in a delicate balance. However, if this equilibrium were to be significantly disturbed, it would spell disaster for all other celestial bodies in the system, dooming them to a descent into Achlys.

592065.text: The Nesoi Ice Field is a vast arrangement of ice fragments, mainly made up of hydrogen, nitrogen, water and methane. The major chunks of the field are closely aligned, suggesting that it formed from the fragments of a passing comet.

592067.text:
The defining feature of Tau-61 is a collection of three large clouds and several smaller ones composed of interplanetary matter and gas. Unusually, this formation is gravitationally bound to an unknown, yet immensely massive body hidden within. The danger and unpredictability of the particles in these nebulae have collectively given the clouds itself its name - the Labyrinth.

Curiously, the Labyrinth’s presence and position in Tau-61 shields the system from distant sensors directed from Sirius, making it unnoticeable from afar. The interplanetary cloud complex has this reflectivity precisely because of the crystalline and icy fragments found within.

Although seeming like a decent refuge for craft looking to evade notice, the Labyrinth is a perilous death trap. Sensor readings show a massive gravimetric disturbance inside the cloud that poses a very real danger to ships should they lose their bearings and get too close.

CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592069.mapped:
Battleship Atum was deployed from Carthage Shipyard in 816 AS. Initially, the battleship was tasked with monitoring and thwarting a feared Liberty invasion of Omicron Minor from Alaska. While this human invasion never came, Toledo fell instead to an overwhelming Nomad attack. In the aftermath, Atum was redesignated as a mobile base for Order operations near House space. It is equipped to provide rapid fire support whenever local cells uncover particularly well entrenched Nomad infestations. Atum has completed operations including the Purge of Drake, and investigations in Alberta, Coronado, Inverness and Newcastle.

In recent years, the Atum had concentrated on the elimination of remaining Wild Infiltrators in Liberty, with a particular focus on the Kusari border and Independent Worlds. To achieve this, it has coordinated with embedded Order agents and cultivated intelligence assets in the Liberty underworld, enabling it to trap the Battlecruiser Wyoming in Galileo. In 834 AS, the Wyoming broke cover, fleeing to Colorado. The Atum pursued, before temporarily losing the trail in Ontario. Early the following year, Order scouts located the dormant battlecruiser where it had been hiding; the Atum finally forced a decisive battle in the Georgian Ice Field.

After destroying the Wyoming's fighter screen, Atum prepared to dispatch its long-term nemesis. This seemingly inevitable conclusion was prevented when several large Vagrant warforms jumped in and spirited the battlecruiser away. Unwilling to lose its prey, the Atum pursued through the collapsing drive breach, arriving in Vespucci. Despite dispatching one of the Vagrant warforms, the Atum was heavily damaged and forced to flee. Now hiding within the Sonora Ice Field, the battleship has been suspiciously received by Atacama's Gaians -- the Atum's officers are now parlaying with local leaders for resupply and access to materials for damage control.

592072.mapped:
Chadwick Station
Chadwick Station serves as both the primary monitoring station within Zone-21, and the Liberty Security Forces headquarters within the New York system. The majority of the LSF patrols in New York and Alaska originate from Chadwick Station, which houses up to a thousand pilots, crewmembers, and engineers. The station itself is hardened, but two sister battlecruisers serve as the primary defense of the interior of Zone-21 and Chadwick Station.

The station also boasts drydock facilities, capable of maintaining battlecruisers and streamlining crew transfers in order to maintain the most effective vigil possible. When needed, the station can field multiple fighter and bomber wings in defense of Zone-21, a home field that has many more advantages for the defenders than the attackers.

The added cost of maintaining yet another drydock in such close proximity to Norfolk has drawn some criticism within Liberty, but the LSF insist on its necessity to protect Zone-21.

592076.text:
Remains of one of the earliest generations of Zoner colony ships. The vessel is speculated to have been part of the expeditionary fleet lost in 816 A.S. after collapse of the jumphole connecting Omicron Delta to a series of uncharted Omicron systems. The wreckage appears to have been caught in the gravitational pull of Omicron Zeta sun and has stabilized in the outer edge of the system.

Scans show no sign of human life, however, the decaying biodomes have attracted a high concentration of local organisms.

592079.text:
The Shillelagh is one of the Scylla class destroyers produced at Foyle Shipyard, launching in 822 AS. It initially operated as a commerce raider in New London and Manchester -- occasionally cooperating with Gallic forces. As the Mollys prepared to take action aboard Graves Station in 831 AS, the Shillelagh played a critical role in the second phase of their plan. Molly leaders believed that an independent Dublin could never be secured while the New London Jump Gate remained intact, allowing unimpeded access by Armed Forces reinforcements. The Jump Gate itself was heavily protected by the Battleship Essex and its support fleet, which would normally make a direct attack impossible.

Following the mutiny aboard Graves and the public execution of a number of BMM executives, the Essex was forced to intervene immediately. With Graves under Molly control and the Essex deployed to the edge of the Founder's Gold Field, a once in a lifetime opportunity was available; the Shillelagh and all of the Molly reserves were committed to a win or die assault. The Shillelagh's escort incurred heavy casualties fighting through the battle hardened but outnumbered squadrons the Essex had left to guard the jump gate. Once a path had been cleared through this rearguard, the Shillelagh towed an enormous demolition mine into place and affixed it to the superstructure. The resulting explosion shattered the outer gate housing, destabilizing the gate core.

To avoid being cut off in Dublin, the Essex issued an immediate evacuation order. The survivors of the Molly diversion force and Shillelagh squadrons attempted to intercept the fleet as it withdrew, but were unable to prevent its escape to New London before the gate core detonated. The Shillelagh itself took heavy damage from the Essex's gunners before being forced to retreat. After receiving repairs at Foyle, the Shillelagh took command of the Sluagh Brigade, and began operations against the Bretonian blockade and Corsair raiders. In 835 AS, the Shillelagh once again crossed swords with a Bretonian fleet, leading the action against the First Cruiser Flotilla near the Achill Asteroid Field. Despite its Brigade suffering heavy casualties, the Bretonian advance was halted.

592081.mapped:
With an ever-increasing presence of Police and Navy patrols, raiding New York's Trade Lanes became ever more difficult and dangerous. Eventually, the Rogue ringleaders had enough of their raiding parties dying or getting captured due to their ships malfunctioning mid-fight or guns falling off.

The Rogue leaders decided to move the destroyer, lovingly dubbed "Drunken Codger", to the heart of Liberty. The main goal was to use the destroyer as a rearming, staging and repairing outpost, conveniently hidden near the major trade arteries in the system. The destroyer often became a loot drop-off point for raiders, protecting their stolen goods until they could ship them en masse to Rochester or Buffalo and beyond for profit. Despite its intimidating appearance, the ship often has something breaking down and its true capabilities are never certain.

When the Rogues presence was firmly established in New York thanks to Buffalo Base, the Drunken Codger was stirred from its inebriated rest and redeployed into the Texas system in early 824 AS where the Rogues intended to use the ship to further expand their influence, and hopefully, their profits. At the beginning of 825 AS, the Drunker Codger was moved into the Bering system in an attempt to assert their control over the more disorganised pirate bands hanging around the Freeport 2.

The Drunker Codger was quietly relocated to Texas yet again as the Liberty Navy had begun its campaign against the Separatists in the Bering system, where it assumed its previous role as a mobile base for the Rogues.

There it remained mostly undisturbed for nearly two years. In 829 AS it was used to take any remaining valuables from the remains of the Galveston outpost. The ship's senior command never told anyone else how they learned of Galveston's location, causing the crew to buzz with speculations about defectors or captives taken shortly before the raid.

592082.text:
During the uprising of 831 AS, the Mollys succeeded in drawing away the Battleship Essex from its position guarding the New London jump gate, enabling them to attach a large explosive charge to the gate's superstructure. When the charge was detonated, the gate's outer housing was shattered, destabilizing the core mechanism.

While the Battleship Essex was able to activate the damaged gate and escape back to New London, some elements of its support fleet were mid-transit and consequently lost when the deteriorating core detonated. It is theorized that hyperspace feedback from the destruction of an activated gate may have knocked many of the system's jump holes out of phase alignment.

Ageira Technologies has advised that it will not be possible to comment on the prospects of reconstruction until the system has been fully secured and their proprietary technology recovered.

Huegenots are used by Liberty Rogues and Mollys not only as assault cruisers, but also as bases of operation in relatively distant regions of House systems. Huegenot is more vulnerable than any space station, but in case of danger it may easily flee into nearby asteroid field.

Likely established around 824 AS, Primus Outpost is hidden deep in molten asteroids of the Akioud Cloud. The presence of the cryptic Artificial Intelligence has gone largely unnoticed by local Corsairs and The Coalition, who are preoccupied with their human enemies. Primus is a purely utilitarian construct for exclusive use by its mechanical residents, lacking life support or gravity. While its exact function remains a mystery to outsiders, Drones scour the nearby field, meticulously dissecting asteroids for resources. These are processed aboard for the production of additional Drones and other necessary tools and technologies.

Following the loss of Planet Gammu in 832 AS, several of the Ancestor Minds (first generation Gammu AI) were evacuated to Primus. Primus' communications relay was then reconfigured to create a distributed FTL data network, removing Gammu as a central node. In an unprecedented move, the Ancestor Minds directed that limited access to the network be extended to Valravn Citadel, providing the Technocracy with custom-built adapters to improve communications. While The Technocracy is far from understanding this enigmatic technology, they speculate it works by harnessing a hyperspace energy field, drawing comparisons to common theories about Nomad communication.

While the Carrier Orion has cooperated closely with the Primus AIs over recent years, Technocracy agents were consistently frustrated by their seeming passivity, particularly the lack of initiative in executing operations against The Core. This abruptly changed in early 835 AS, when a large flotilla of AI Drones that had been hibernating deep within the Akioud suddenly activated and departed for Omicron Kappa. Since the recapture of Gammu, mining activity around Primus has reached a fever pitch, as the AIs prepare for some great endeavor.

TERRAIN: Arctic
TEMPERATURE: -110°C to -12°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.9 km/sec

Planet Gammu is a hostile, uninhabitable world that is relentlessly blasted by the radioactive solar winds of Omicron Kappa's yellow dwarf. It is home to the Gammusians, a species of self-aware machines that emerged from below the planet's sands and took to space almost a century ago. Gammusian machines have -- until recently -- avoided conflict with humans, instead exploring and gathering materials according to their own inscrutable objectives. These synthetic lifeforms remain an enigma to those studying them, with their technology appearing to be a perplexing blend of human and alien inspirations.
592087.mapped:
The Gammusians originate from the probes of the ailing Sleeper Ship Hispania. Homestead probes were designed to identify habitable planets, land, and begin deploying colony infrastructure using in situ resources. While transiting through Omicron Kappa in 31 AS, these probes were influenced by an ancient structure known as The Cenotaph, altering them in profound but unknowable ways. Now misidentifying Planet Gammu as an ideal site for development, they deployed and began burrowing -- seeming to disappear without a trace, and leaving the future colonists of Crete unprepared for the catastrophe ahead. Over hundreds of thousands of generations of self-replication and alien mutation, the Ancestor Minds emerged. These earliest machines to pass the threshold to sentience likely became self-aware around 450 AS.

The Minds directed the evolution of their fledgling society, clumsily improving themselves and uplifting other machines. They were driven by an instinctual urge to fulfill a subconscious objective -- something buried within their fundamental code. For centuries this urge led the Gammusians to excavate colossal subterranean complexes and sculpt vast petroglyphs across the planet's airless surface. Corsair scouts first recorded Gammu as an unremarkable footnote around 600 AS, however the Gammusians were not detected until 721 AS when the first Drones launched to orbit. The Drones featured bizarre alien influences that were intuitively known to the AI Minds. These included reactors capable of drawing more power than they produced, seemingly extracting the deficit from the fabric of hyperspace itself.

The AI abruptly vanished from space around 800 AS, as many hibernated through a so-called power generation crisis. They returned ten years later, after the "hyperspace deficit network" resumed functioning. Initially, the Gammusians were passive in their interactions with humanity, generally ignoring Corsair or Zoner vessels, or following them out of curiosity. Despite this, The Order soon began to execute combat operations against the machines, seeing unfettered AI as an existential threat to humanity. By 816 AS, the arrival of The Core in the Omicrons posed further threats, as the corporation saw the AI and their technologies as a vast potential windfall for reverse engineering. This drove the AIs to develop increasingly sophisticated responses, including bomber and cruiser class Drones.

These weapons were sufficient to drive off an attempted Core invasion between 829 - 830 AS. When a second invasion was attempted in 832 AS, a conclave of Ancestor Minds persuaded Gammu's AIs to scatter or retreat below ground, allowing the Core to occupy the surface. While their reasoning was not explained, several Ancestor Minds -- including Hesione and Telamon -- were ripped from Gammu and later incorporated into Core technologies. This facilitated the infiltration of Core networks and systems, and the eventual capture of the Battleship Mars. As of 835 AS, machines once more boiled to Gammu's surface, driving The Core into space. The resurgent Gammusians are now aggressively reasserting themselves across the Omicrons, while feverishly working towards the final stages of a centuries-long goal.

The resurgent Gammusians are now aggressively reasserting themselves across the Omicrons, while feverishly working towards the final stages of a centuries-long goal.

592090.mapped:
A small Zoner installation in high orbit of Planet Pygar. This lonesome place once served as a supply station for Freeport 9, and still offers limited refit and repair facilities for trade ships making the perilous journey from Omega-49. In recent years Corfu has acted as a basecamp for the Zoners attempting to colonize Pygar, shuttling prospective colonists and departing emigrants to and from the underground settlement. Technicians aboard Corfu are also responsible for managing the daunting maintenance requirements the planet's extreme storms inflict on the docking ring.

When the Corsairs occupied Freeport 9 in 831 AS, Corfu found itself on the front lines of an increasingly dangerous confrontation. Enraged Zoner pilots flocked to the station demanded retaliation, while station administrators urged for calm. A conclave was called on Gran Canaria to decide the Zoners' response, and while this conference ended inconclusively, a number of Zoner Q-Ships were dispatched to Corfu to monitor the situation and escort convoys. These vessels have since maintained a close eye on Corfu and Pygar, with their powerful sensors tracking Outcast and Corsair fleet movements across the system.

592093.mapped:
Ibiza was originally a small research installation designed to improve the quality of all manner of Outcast technologies, as well as being a port of call for patrols and smugglers; Ibiza produced the venerable Inferno, headed the failed GRAVISSIMA weapon project and in recent years has made significant upgrades to the conventional fusion drives in use with most of the Outcast ships. Also included in the original plans was a small survey module for planning future strip-mining operations on Mallorca, but this was canceled shortly after the Outcast leaders decided that beginning a mining operation would be less cost-effective than simply continuing to import materials from beyond the borders. Ibiza is home to an important field-testing laboratory where the Outcasts tailor their processed Cardamine for use in off-world life support systems on their bases, ships and personal breathers.

Ibiza also monitors the eastern approaches to Malta. Ships coming from Omicron Beta are routinely scanned by the station. To deal with would-be hostiles, the station has a small group of defenders permanently assigned to it -- additional ships can be summoned from Malta within minutes. Ibiza found itself thrust into a dramatically altered role due to the slave revolt on their nearby capital planet Malta. As the rebellion intensified, the personnel at Ibiza Base grew more vigilant and paranoid. They had to juggle their routine responsibilities of monitoring the eastern approaches to Malta and routinely scanning ships arriving from Omicron Beta with the pressing demands of supporting the besieged landlords planetside. The strain on Ibiza Base's personnel was palpable as they worked tirelessly to aid Malta during challenging times, all while maintaining their newly codified strict scanning and security protocols.

592102.mapped:
Launched only a year before the outbreak of hostilities with Kusari, the Macduff served, for much of its service, as a key element of Planet Harris' defense, being the sole battleship to remain in the system after the Naval Forces of Kusari entered Leeds.

Due to Gallia's rapid advance after the arrival of their fleets, the Macduff was recalled to Newcastle, where it helped secure the system against Molly raiders and the advance of the invading Royal Navy. Having little effect on that front, it was moved to the New London system, where it remained for much of the war, fighting the Gallic battleships until the very last battle.

Following the conclusion of the Gallic War, the vessel received repairs in Omega-3 and set off to Tau-31 once more. It remained in orbit of Planet Harris until 832 AS, when it was recalled for mothballing at Portsmouth Shipyard.

592115.text:
An asteroid field comprised mostly of the porous rocks made largely out of the organic compounds like other similar looking fields located in Omicrons. Many prospectors and scientists have tried to find anything of value in the field, but they have not been successful. As a result of this, the Kiribati Asteroid Field remains economically insignificant for human needs in Omicron Delta for the foreseeable future.

The Kiribati Asteroid Field is currently an important and convenient hiding spot for the Order forces spying on any Core ships leaving or entering the Omicron Kappa anomaly located in the field.

592116.text: The Palau Ice Cloud is a beautiful cloud on the outskirts of Omicron Delta system, possibly a former part of the Tokelau Ice Cloud that drifted away. Rumours have run rife in Omicron Delta of a mysterious, rare and active alien ruin located within the cloud. However, constant fighting between The Core and the Corsairs within the Palau Ice Cloud have deterred Xenoarchaeologists from getting a closer look.

The Yaren Orbital Terminal sits high above Nauru, providing traffic control and cargo transfers for The Core's colonies. While now owned and operated by The Core, Yaren Base was originally built by the Corsairs in 812 AS, to spearhead the exploration of Omicron Delta, and resupply Corsair patrols providing support to The Order.

After the Corsair and Order's agreement broke down around 818 AS, Corsair priorities shifted towards the ever-escalating Omega War, leaving Yaren Base under-crewed and scarcely defended. In 822 AS, The Core launched an attack to seize the station, coveting rumors of Iridium and Artifacts on Nauru's surface.

The base has remained in Core hands ever since, even temporarily acting as a local headquarters until the establishment of Nauru's colonies, and the later reconstruction of Durban Station.
592118.mapped:
Orbiting Nauru in the Omicron Delta system, Yaren Base was one of the Corsairs' most distant outposts. Built in 812 AS to better facilitate the construction of planet-side mining camps and research installations, Yaren Base has since been expanded to include ship repair and refuelling capabilities, as well as a few long term habitat modules. After the alliance between the Order and the Corsairs broke down around 818 AS as well as priority changes, Yaren has since been of much lesser significance for the Corsairs.

The Core, an elite military force, took the insignificant focus of the Corsairs on Yaren as a chance and annexed the station in an attempt to secure themselves more parts at the crossroads to the upper Omicron systems. Most of the Iridium mined in the captured facilities on Nauru gets transported up to Yaren and then either onto Freeport 11 or into Omicron Rho to sell it in borderworlds, edge worlds and sometimes even in the houses, or to use it in their own shipyards. Given this newfound outpost, the Core seeks to expand their grasp onto the planets resources and colonize the desert world.

592120.text:
DIAMETER: 31,014 km
MASS: 14.21 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 19.25 km/sec

Planet Tuvalu is one of the largest gas giants to ever be found in the Nomad Worlds and is the biggest planetary body in Omicron Delta. Its sheer mass, strong gravity and magnetic field protect its habitable moon, Nauru, from dangerous solar flares and rogue asteroid impacts.

It is composed mostly of Hydrogen, Helium and methane; it is believed that Tuvalu possesses a metallic core containing a large amount of inaccessible Iridium - an unusual, but surprisingly common trait of all Omicron Delta's planetary bodies.

Planet Tuvalu's intense gravity well rendered it unsuitable for mining operations, but some Core prospectors believe that necessary technologies will be developed within two or three centuries to allow profitable exploitation.

592122.text:
The wreck of the Bounty Hunter fighter known as Garred, which was owned and piloted by the bounty hunter Jamie Tassis.

Jamie Tassis was a rather unique bounty hunter as he was originally a corsair, who got shot down in Rheinland and captured in 811 AS. He spent nearly ten years in various hostile prisons before he finally broke and joined the BHG to hunt down other criminals, including his own people.

He became a very successful bounty hunter thanks to his piloting skills and had dozens of confirmed kills or captures in his name. His promising career was cut short in 825 AS when he tried to attack a lone and damaged Order fighter, only to get ambushed by the rest of its squadron as they had been shadowing and escorting it to safety.

There is a possibility that valuable equipment can still be found on this wreckage. As the body of the pilot has never been found, his fate remains unknown.

592124.text:
A strange looking ice field composed mostly of peculiar spindle-shaped crystals having the same chemical composition as very similar fields in Omicron Kappa or Alaska, The Tokelau Ice Cloud is a beautiful cloud on the outskirts of the Omicron Delta system. Numerous independent scientists have unsuccessfully tried to explain the nature of these strange ice formations and their true origins.

While the ice remains nothing but a scientific curiosity, there are large and rocky formations hidden deep within the Tokelau Ice Cloud. As any other native planetary in Omicron Delta, they are rich for easily accessible Iridium deposits and became the most important source of Iridium for humanity, seconded only by Nauru's own Iridium deposits.

Exploitations of Tokelau's mineral riches are not without their risks however, as these metal-rich planetary fragments are the main source of various electromagnetic interferences within the cloud, which consistently get worse as ships venture deeper into the cloud. These interferences have been reported to disrupt and cause malfunctions with ship propulsion, communication and sensor systems.

As a result, any mining operations within the Tokelau cloud remain extremely dangerous thanks to these interferences and local factions are not making it any easier with their conflicts over the control of these Iridium deposits. Many mining, escort and combat ships have been lost within the cloud, never returning to their bases.

592126.text:
A large rocky field orbiting Omicron Delta's primary star, which was created by the disintegration of a larger planetary body while it was orbiting its star in close proximity.

A large number of independent prospectors ventured into the field in hopes of finding yet another rich Iridium deposit as all Omicron Delta bodies are rich on Iridium, but such deposits were never found. Only the more recent astro geological studies suggest that the original planetary body was a rogue planet named Oreor, which entered the Omicron Delta system millions of years ago and eventually spiralled too close to the system's main star.

While the Oreor Fragments are known for various subpar mineral deposits and riches, it remains economically insignificant in comparison to the Tokelau Ice Cloud and serves mostly as a hiding spot for whoever needs to hide from others as the local factions are still locked in their fight for dominance over the system.

592128.text:
The Exnaury was a personal ship belonging to the successful bounty hunter Katrin Fabian, a famous fighter ace from Rheinland.

In contrast to the other bounty hunters, Katrin Fabian was known for her rather chivalrous and good willed nature, and she always believed that she was doing the right thing. She learned to fly in the Rheinland Military and remained there until she got married and founded a family. She had a relatively comfortable life raising her children before her husband died after a long and serious illness, and left her indebted. While the Rheinland Military offered for her to return, an unsatisfactory financial situation forced her to join the BHG.

It remains unknown what happened to her as the Exnaury bears no visible damage marks caused by any human or alien weaponry. Scanners reveal that the ship's thrusters are worn out as they have been used continuously over a long period of time and Exnaury's fuel cells are depleted. Katrin Fabian's body can still be found in the cockpit as if she was merely sleeping.

592130.text:
The wreck of the Corsair fighter Sitia, piloted by Elisenda Lopez, which was lost during the initial Corsair exploration of Omicron Delta in 811 AS.

Elisenda Lopez was a young and adventurous Corsair, who was also curious about the scientific wonders in Sirius and could be considered more of a scientist than raider. When the anomaly leading into Omicron Delta was found, she immediately volunteered herself to be one of the pioneers exploring the newly found system.

The Sitia and its pilot were lost while they were traversing the treacherous Tokelau Cloud and it had its engines and communications disrupted. According to the black box, Elisenda Lopez was trying to call for help but her calls never reached her peers thanks to the electromagnetic interferences of the cloud. As a last ditch attempt, she tried to launch her escape pod away from the nonfunctional fighter, but even that was not enough.

Her body was never recovered and her escape pod remains as her grave, visited and tended by the various deep space explorers.

592132.text:
The Adelaida was a zoner fighter piloted by Charlize Whitefield, a small-time trader, smuggler and courier of Libertonian origin.

It is unknown why Charlize Whitefield, a relatively young and inexperienced pilot, has even decided to venture deeper into the Omicrons as she was usually running small time cargo operations around Liberty and the Borderworlds.

Scans reveal that the Adelaida was in less than optimal technical condition as most of the damage the ship had suffered previously was only temporarily patched, with proper repairs and replacements still pending. The Adelaida was hit by adapted nomad weapons on its last day and its attackers have managed to take out its engines and primary power. Charlize Whitefield has managed to get away as the escape pod with her is missing.

592134.text:
CLASS: Frontier
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 720
592134.mapped:
Freeport 11 is the most remote Freeport in Sirius to this day and is orbiting in a close proximity around its red dwarf, which is a necessity for keeping its numerous bio-domes operational. As red dwarf stars are notoriously violent, Freeport 11 must consistently change its orientation in order to maintain optimal conditions for its biodomes, despite the solar flares thrown in their direction.

Freeport 11 was founded in 810 AS shortly after the discovery of rich Iridium deposits in Omicron Delta and has been serving as a safe haven for the more independent and adventurous miners, and even scientists, since then. Because of its remote location deep within the Omicrons, Freeport 11 is arguably one of the most difficult places to live on as the population faces constant threat from the alien infestation or raids by the various violent groups in the Omicrons, whether they belong to the larger organisations or smaller bands of armed marauders.

All these struggles have left scars on the station itself and its population as the technical state of Freeport 11 has been slightly worsening throughout the years and the population is in constant need for more supplies. While the station itself managed to remain relatively safe and only slightly damaged, some of its supply ships are hijacked or destroyed constantly as they traverse through the deep Omicrons from or to the station.

Thanks to all of these hardships, the station's population is more xenophobic and closed-off to outsiders at first, but welcoming and helpful once such individuals prove themselves. Local bars and establishments are famous for various seasoned Omicroners willing to exchange some of their chilling stories from these parts of space for bottles of a good drink or other luxuries from Sirius.

Despite being a freeport, Freeport 11 has several strict anti-infestation countermeasures and protocols in effect and all arrivals are expected to be screened regularly.

592137.text:
The Holme Storage Depot was built during Omicron Delta's initial discovery and exploration, in 810 AS, by a group of independent and freelance miners in hopes of tapping into the Iridium rich fields . The station was very basic, from the very start, as it was never meant to be anything more than just a drop off point for mined ore, before being shipped off by cargo transports.

Contrary to popular belief, this station was abandoned before the large-scale conflicts between local factions, in the System, started. It remains largely unknown what happened on this station, that led to its abandonment, but several large scale homicides were recorded in the station's logs shortly before its closure in 814 AS.

There have been no further known attempts of repopulating Holme since then, and the station's condition has deteriorated due to being subjected to the various rock impacts over the years.

592144.mapped:
The Battleship Schwerin was deployed in 821 AS, shortly after its sister ship Kolleda. The Schwerin’s first assignment was to Omega-7, where it was officially tasked with deterring Corsair and Red Hessian attacks on expensive Trade Lane infrastructure. In reality, the battleship’s primary orders were to maintain close watch over neighboring Bretonia, amid fears the colonization of Sprague would result in the annexation of Omega-3. Despite the move being a breach of the Boorman Treaty, the enhanced security for Omega shipping and Bretonia’s preoccupation with the Gallic War resulted in only nominal diplomatic objections.

The Schwerin was recalled to Rheinland core space in 825 AS, and during the Saigon War carried out strikes across Sigma-13 and 15. After the war, the vessel was returned to Oder Shipyard along with the Strausberg for repairs and refitting. From there, the crew declared for the Imperial cause during the Rheinland Civil War, assisting with the occupation of New Berlin orbit. Shortly after, the Schwerin fleet responded to the Battleship Koblenz’s distress call, but arrived in Frankfurt too late to provide assistance. Instead, the Schwerin moved quickly to secure Planet Holstein, from where it regularly clashed with forces from the Carrier Saar.

During the Federalist counter-offensive of 828 AS, the battleship was forced to retreat from Holstein to avoid being surrounded by advancing forces from both Thuringia and Munich. Despite this, the Federalist assault was blunted when the Schwerin’s bombers succeeded in destroying the Battleship Regensburg. In the years since the Civil War the Schwerin has continued to garrison Frankfurt, primarily countering Corsair incursions and launching patrols into Sigma-15.

TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -27°C to 39°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.15 km/sec

Planet Skagen is an arid, sterile world in the remote Omega-55 system. The presence of traces of Oxygen in the atmosphere indicates the world once hosted a variety of life, however no trace of this remains. Excavations have revealed a narrow but extremely dense strata of alien fossils. This strongly implies extremely complex life evolved remarkably quickly, before being abruptly wiped away in a sudden and dramatic mass extinction.

In 799 AS, this hot planet bore silent witness to a mysterious explosion -- believed by most to have been a Rheinland space station. This blast was large enough to carve a significant crater into Skagen's surface. Junkers scoured the site for years but uncovered no definitive clues about the event that unfolded in orbit. Rumors persist, however, of a treasure trove of alien structures and Artifacts that were allegedly erased from Rheinland's records by the collapsing regime of Chancellor Niemann.

Today, The Core attempts to maintains control over Skagen's orbit, launching orbital shuttles and expeditionary teams from Dagger Outpost. Multiple underground excavation sites are scattered across the barren landscape, adding fuel to the rumors of vast, buried alien complexes.

592147.text: The wreck of a Rheinland transport that was once part of Convoy 99, lost some time around 800 AS.

592150.mapped:
Built in 809 AS at Southampton Shipyard, the Ark Royal underwent trials in the New London system for several months before being sent to Newcastle to prevent further Molly raids on the important installations.

With Gallia preparing to enter Newcastle, the Ark Royal ensured that any such advance would be a costly and sluggish attempt. It spent little time in the system after the war's end, however, as it participated in the Bretonian annexation of Canaria several years later.

With the invasion ending in an eventual retreat for the Kingdom, the Ark Royal moved to invade Edinburgh, a former Gallic Royal Navy stronghold in the Taus, and then returned to Leeds. It now acts as a main protector of the Stokes rebuilding project and a base of operations for patrols heading throughout the remnants of the once industrial heartland of Bretonia.

592152.mapped: Stationed in orbit of planet Carlisle, Gateshead is a staging ground for the ships guarding the colony, currently administered by the Bretonia Police Authority. From here, police ships patrol the surrounding field boundaries, protecting nearby Trade Lanes from Outcast, Gaian, and Molly raiders. The BPA also dispatches patrols to nearby mining operations in the west and north, and the jumpgate to Leeds. Additionally, the station houses numerous fabrication units to produce goods associated with the colonization of Carlisle.

592153.mapped:
Scarborough Shipyard is the local headquarters of Border World Exports, and an important shipbuilding and manufacturing center. It was originally constructed in 679 AS as the sister station of Belfast Production Facility, forming a link in a planned vertically-integrated supply chain. While the joint Bowex-BMM project initially saw success, Scarborough was severely impacted by Belfast's loss in 814 AS. Following the Gallic conquest of Leeds in 819 AS, Scarborough's operating coasts soared due to the need to rely on resources imported from Liberty and Rheinland. During this period, the operation was largely sustained by expansive wartime subsidies.

During the Gallic War, Scarborough was frequently pressed into service as a repair yard for damaged Armed Forces assets. This became particularly important following the Siege of New London and the destruction of Southampton Shipyard. While neither Scarborough nor the seized Aland Shipyard were equipped with the sophisticated military tooling necessary for capital production or full servicing, improvised repairs enabled Bretonia to continue fighting until the siege was broken. This made the shipyard a priority target for Gallic raids in Newcastle for the duration of the war. Additionally, Gaian raiders frequently attack the station, pointing to the Yorkshire Debris Field as evidence of Bowex's wasteful practices. As a result, a large Bounty Hunter community has congregated aboard, attracted by generous payouts for killed terrorists.

Following the Gallic War, Scarborough was left with significant slack capacity, leading to layoffs and one berth being rented to mothball the Battleship Harlow. From 827 AS, Scarborough's subsidies were drastically cut, however access to locally produced minerals from Redcarr Production Facility brought costs under control once more. While Bretonia still imports much of its transport fleet from Kusari, the heavily armored Shetland and Shire remain popular due to their proven wartime performance, ensuring a steady order flow. Scarborough is also renown as the primary producer of the "Gloriette" export class of Royal Liner, although only a handful of these extravagant vessels have been commissioned in recent years.

592154.text:
CLASS: Loch Ness
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 3570
592154.mapped:
South Shields Refinery is a large mining and processing complex orbiting the gas giant Hartlepool. The Independent Miners Guild first arrived in Newcastle in 668 AS, to significant controversy. Border World Exports had announced promising astronomical studies of the star the year before, and later dispatched a slow-burn deep space expedition to carry out a detailed survey. The young Guild instead wagered a significant portion of its early resources on charting Leeds in detail, looking for a Jump Hole they believed could provide a substantial shortcut.

This extreme gamble paid off, allowing the first Guild explorers to arrive six months before Bowex entered the system’s borders. By 670 AS, the IMG began construction of South Shields -- their second station. This provided the Guild with a local headquarters and mineral claims at a time when other Bretonian corporations were only just beginning to carry out detailed evaluations. South Shields’ completion prior to the deployment of a Jump Gate to Leeds also allowed the IMG to exploit a Bretonian legal loophole, circumventing various regulatory issues and colonial taxes.

For over a century, South Shields made relatively easy money by harvesting Water and Oxygen from the nearby Tyne Ice Field, and filtering trace Hydrocarbon impurities. Potable supplies were then sold to local stations and the then-enormous population of Planet Leeds. With Rheinland's economic collapse after the Colony Wars, the Guild received a wave of recruits from Kruger Minerals, including several specialists from Mannheim. This provided the Guild with the expertise to begin skimming Hartlepool's atmosphere for the Hydrogen and Deuterium needed to produce H-Fuel. While this resynthesis process has never been consistently profitable, it has allowed the Guild to maintain a strategic fuel reserve for its own Tau operations.

592155.text:
CLASS: Storta
CREW: Unknown
ARMAMENT: Unknown
592155.mapped:
Destroyer Ceuta is one of the newer destroyers in the Outcast armada, built in the aftermath of the Outcast Slave Revolt in 832 AS. Its owners, the renowned Wenceslaus Cartel, aim to re-establish the Bretonian smuggling routes and consolidate power within the Outcasts' southwestern sphere of influence.

Following initial tests, the destroyer's first major campaign involves serving as a mobile base in the Newcastle system, providing resupply, minor goods exchange, and a staging ground for raids on nearby points of interest.

592156.text:
CLASS: Baile Oighreata
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 170
592156.mapped:
Mull Base was excavated by the Mollys in 772 AS to act as a staging post for attacks on BMM operations across Leeds and Newcastle. Raids on the lightly protected industrial convoys heading to the Leeds Jump Gate provided the early Mollys with many of the materials needed to establish themselves as a long term insurgency. The close proximity to the Leeds jump hole also attracted several radical sects of Mollys, who sought to intercept MOX shipments from LD-14, in the hope of refining weapons-grade plutonium. These dangerous raids on high security convoys often resulted in the deaths of the pilots involved, and bore few tangible results.

In 814 AS, Mull was the mustering point for a large Molly attack on Belfast Production Facility. The Newcastle Armed Forces garrison had been significantly drawn down due to the ongoing conflict with Kusari in Tau 31, allowing the Mollys to punch through the local BMM security force and link up with mutinying workers onboard. As Belfast's industrial facilities were put to use, Mull distributed produced supplies to other Molly holdings across Bretonia. The abundance of supplies and proximity to Belfast's factories also drew a community of engineers and technicians to the station, who were responsible for prototyping many of the Molly's weapons and equipment.

While Belfast was ultimately destroyed by the Gallic Royal Navy in 825 AS, its legacy survived in Mull's oversized smuggling fleet and well developed weapons design workshops. In 830 AS, these workshops were responsible for designing and producing the enormous explosive charge used to destroy the New London jump gate in Dublin. The mine was of such substantial size that it required the Destroyer Shillelagh to tow it into position. The Molly's success with Free Dublin has come at a price however, with Arranmore demanding Mull provide ever increasing numbers of pilots and smugglers to sustain their new state.

592158.text: The smaller Newcastle outcropping of the Barrier, the Northumberland occupies the southeastern reaches of Newcastle. Repeated surveys found little of value beyond an abundance of Water ice; the depths of the field remaining largely unexplored. Northumberland is renown for its unusually high levels of Gaian activity, as the terrorists use the scanner-scattering properties of the ice asteroids to cover their movement. Frequent raids emerge from the field, striking at Scarborough Shipyard, Redcarr Refinery, and the ongoing bacterial eradication projects at Planet Carlisle.

592159.text:
CLASS: Bury
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 620
592159.mapped:
Redcarr Refinery was built by BMM in 827 AS. Like Belfast Station before it, Redcarr's primary purpose is the refinement of minerals mined on Middlesbrough, an uninhabitable but mineral-rich moon. These minerals were more important than ever to rebuild Bretonia's devastated infrastructure in the aftermath of the Gallic Invasion.

Redcarr was thus hastily built and its workers driven hard to continuously increase output. Remembering well the mutiny that led to the loss of Belfast in 750 AS, Redcarr is well staffed by political "morale officers" who ensure potential disloyalty is promptly reported and dealt with. BMM also closely coordinates their patrols with the BPA and Bounty Hunters Guild to deter Gaian, Outcast, and Molly attacks.

592160.text:
CLASS: Barnes
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: Unknown
592160.mapped:
Concealed deep within the Northumberland Ice Field, Skye Base was constructed by the Gaians in 798 AS. Skye initially provided a convenient staging point to target industrial sites across Newcastle, and the Terraforming Gasses plant at Birmingham Station. Newcastle in particular was a growing area of concern for the Gaians over fears that BMM and Bowex were repeating the same ecologically devastating carte blanche playbook as Leeds. Despite this, Skye spent its first two decades as a minor outpost, secondary to Gaian activities prioritizing Edinburgh, New London and Tau-31. This changed with the Gallic Royal Navy's advance into Edinburgh, and the subsequent lock-down of Islay Base.

Skye's secluded location quickly made it the preferred destination for Gaian evacuees and non-combatants who had been displaced by the Gallic invasion. The following years saw a frenzied campaign of tunneling and construction to expand the habitats needed to accommodate this exploding population. Skye quickly became the Gaians' largest and most populous station, housing both civilians and radical, subversive academics who had fled Bretonian society to avoid arrest. Many now refer to Skye as the "Underground University", with its labyrinthine warren of tunnels hosting labs, engineering workshops and seminar halls. Most of the designs later produced aboard Torshavn Drydock originated from projects on Skye.

Skye spearheads the Gaian effort to disrupt the Carlisle bacterial eradication project. While some Gaian cells are divided on the ethics of terraforming sterile worlds, there is unanimous agreement that the joint Cryer-Planetform extermination of an existing, thriving biosphere is a crime against nature. In a twist of irony, disillusioned settlers from the Carlisle colony were also responsible for smuggling samples of the bacterial strain required for the production of Slog to Gaian contacts. There is now a booming -- and internally controversial -- black market industry for Slog synthesis aboard Skye. It remains to be seen whether local leaders will endorse this source of revenue, or stamp it out.

592161.text: The wreck of the Bretonian fighter, probably taken down by Outcasts or Mollys.

592162.text: A rocky asteroid field that is believed to have drifted free of the Akioud Cloud and gradually cooled. No detailed mineral surveys have been conducted, owing to the eternal bloodbath between the Corsairs, Coalition and Red Hessians that has raged since 810 AS.

592163.text: A huge field of rocky asteroids located deep within the Omega-47 system. El Aaiun has a bloody history, as the Corsairs and Coalition frequently use it as a staging point in their ceaseless struggle for Tangier and Casablanca Base. Independent Miners Guild surveys have uncovered rich deposits of Iron, Titanium and other metals, as well as trace quantities of Silver that indicate the possibility of richer undiscovered lodes. As of 835 AS, the El Aaiun has attracted persistent rumors of unstable Jump Holes leading to unexplored frontiers.

592164.text:
CLASS: Gancho
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 270
592164.mapped:
Casablanca Base orbits the gas giant Rabat in Omega-47, serving as a supply depot, staging point and emergency repair dock for local Corsair forces. Constructed by the Corsairs in 810 AS, Casablanca was intended to be an experimental gas miner in what was then an uncontested system. Despite this, it did not take long for Red Hessian scouts to identify the Corsairs' activities, and perceive them as a threat on their flanks in Omega-5. They quickly launched the Casablanca Offensive of 811 AS, driving the Corsairs out of the system and capturing the base. This opened Omega-47 as a major theatre of the war, with the Hessians using Casablanca as a fortified position to repel attacks from Omega-55.

The Treaty of Casablanca was signed aboard in 813 AS, securing the alliance between the Red Hessians and the previously aloof Coalition. This intended to check Corsair influence across the Omegas, bolstering the Hessian position in Omega-5, which had been nearing collapse. This partnership was put to the test in early 819 AS, when the Corsairs launched the Second Casablanca Offensive. The two-pronged attack from Omega-5 and 55 succeeded in capturing Casablanca but stalled soon after, failing in its remaining objectives of eliminating Tangier, and pushing on into Omega-52.

Since then, Casablanca has been renovated several times, to repair battle damage and expand its facilities. This most prominently includes the addition of an armored drydock, capable of providing emergency repairs to lighter classes of capital ship. In cases of the utmost desperation, damaged Corsair cruisers may attempt to break through the Coalition's lines to Casablanca from Omega-5. In recent years, the Corsairs have also resumed scavenging resources from Rabat's rings, with the harvested gasses shipped back to Omicron Gamma for industrial uses. The local garrison is frequently required to scramble fighters to assist the convoys of armored transports that supply the base through Omega-55.

592165.text:
DIAMETER: 12,448 km
MASS: 5.90 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -35°C to 41°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.98 km/sec
592165.mapped:
Discovered in 769 AS by an expedition mapping the uncharted systems beyond Freeport 5, Planet Gran Canaria was thought to be a new hope for a peaceful life on a hospitable world far from House territory. Hailed as a paradise world among the barren and lifeless rocks so common in the Edge Worlds, the local Zoners quickly took advantage of their discovery, sending a large survey and colonization team to the Omega-49 system, hoping to establish an independent colony there before other groups arrived in-system. Not long after, migrants fed up with living under House laws and taxes began arriving on Gran Canaria, establishing many loosely connected settlements around a particularly lush river delta.

In 772 AS, a jump hole to Dublin was discovered in an outcropping of the Barrier Nebula in the system, revealing that Omega-49 was much closer to Bretonian Space than had been thought. The Zoners, considering the overcrowding on planets New London and Leeds, realized that if the Bretonians discovered the system, the planet would be overrun by Bretonian settlers and possibly brought under Bretonian, or even worse, BMM control. Fearing that either Bretonia or the Mollys of Dublin would try to claim the system, the Zoners of Gran Canaria launched a series of disinformation campaigns seeking to hide any evidence of the world. For a time, the planet was hidden, but as the Dublin Conflict expanded, the Gran Canarians became concerned that Bretonia would eventually stumble upon the system during its endless skirmishes with the Mollys.

In 803 AS, the Gran Canarians made a strategic decision to disclose the routes into Omega-49 to the Corsair Empire, in exchange for protection from other aggressive parties and rights to establish their own settlements on the planet. Under this agreement the Zoners persuaded the Corsairs to treat the Freeports in their territory more favorably, while the Corsairs would develop a colony on the vibrant world and gain an alternate route to strike Bretonia and the Mollys from an unexpected quarter. This route was later used by the Corsair Empire to destroy the Molly colony on Planet Cork in the bitter conflict between Corsairs and Mollys in Poole.

Soon after Corsairs raiders began streaming through Bretonia from Omega-49, the system was discovered by both the Mollys and Bretonia. The Mollys, furious that the Zoners had sided with the Corsairs, found themselves unable to remove the established Corsair presence from the system, and the Bretonian Government was uninterested in the expense of a costly guerilla war against the entrenched Corsair forces on the planet while it had to respond to Kusari fortifying Tau-29 in 810 AS. Making friends of the Corsair Empire had bought the Gran Canarians time, but by 817 AS, Border World Exports had begun administering a refugee settlement on the planet, on the opposite hemisphere from the original settlements.

While the Zoners were successful in making the first claim to the planet, it proved to be only a temporary paradise, as the Omega-49 beta star has a highly elliptical orbit, and while it is near aphelion, the planet experience cyclic ice ages. Temperatures are expected to drop sharply over the coming years, and mass climate destabilization is expected while the seas fall and the glaciers advance.

The population of the planet jumped following the deployment of a force of Bretonian troops to hold the planet, and an exodus of Corsairs and Zoners unwilling to live under Bretonian occupation. In the months following the invasion, plans for large scale, organised and drastic settlement had been set in motion.

After the Gallic war ended, following the breakthrough in making Planet Carlisle habitable, the use of planet Gran Canaria became increasingly seen as an unnecessary burden on Bretonia, and the government enacted a policy of withdrawal from the volatile system in favor of the Newcastle system which is much safer and secured.

592203.text:
CLASS: Ellison
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 120
592203.mapped:
Lanzarote Station was originally constructed in 773 AS as a base of operations for the Zoner expedition that charted the Omega-49 system. Upon the discovery of the Dublin wormhole in 772 AS, the station was rapidly assembled by the Zoners, who saw significant potential in Gran Canaria. The orbit of Fuerteventura was chosen, as Zoner surveyors identified mineral deposits on the planet. Lanzarote was initially designed as a storage and transfer point for resources extracted from its icy surface. However, after Gran Canaria was deemed more suitable for preliminary colonization, these mining efforts were largely abandoned due to the logistical challenges of extracting and lifting materials from the arctic planet.

The abandonment of planetary mining, coupled with the collapse of the old wormhole connecting to Dublin - removing Lanzarote from its strategic position between Bretonian space and Gran Canaria - left the station in need of a new purpose.

That new purpose emerged in 828 AS when the company "Gran Canarian Shipwrights" patented the ZC-410 "Peregrine" Civilian Frigate. Instead of manufacturing the frigate on Gran Canaria, the Zoners repurposed Lanzarote Station into a minor shipbuilding facility. It primarily supports the production of the Peregrine, along with smaller Zoner vessels like the Osprey. The station also functions as a minor trading and refueling outpost for ships unwilling to land on Gran Canaria as they transit through the deeper Omegas.

592204.text: The wreck of the Red Hessian fighter August, belonging to the rookie pilot Christian Scholz. August and his squadron engaged a group of Bounty Hunters who outmatched the Hessians, destroying Scholz's wingmen and forcing him to flee. He didn't get far, as his cockpit was breached, resulting in a quick death. The wreck might contain valuable equipment.

592206.text:
CLASS: Altenburg
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592206.mapped:
The Altenburg was completed in 816 AS, using lessons learned from the Westfalen generation of battleships. It was initially deployed to Dresden to tackle the severely deteriorating security situation and stationed near Leipzig Station to bolster the local RFP presence. During the Hudson War, much of its supporting fleet was stripped away and reallocated to the front, emboldening Red Hessian attacks. The Altenburg was unable to prevent the Red Hessian surge of 818 AS, during which Pirna Border Station was destroyed, and Leipzig captured. In the aftermath, the battleship successfully routed a large Hessian force near Bautzen Station, and established the containment minefield around the New Berlin Jump Gate. When Kruger shuttered Bautzen Station in 824 AS, the Altenburg was finally withdrawn back to New Berlin for much needed repairs.

Following these refits, the fleet was briefly sent to Omega-11 to tackle Corsair and Hessian piracy, before escalating tensions with the Gas Miner’s Guild necessitated an urgent redeployment to Sigma-15. Hostilities with the GMG erupted into the Saigon War soon after, placing the Altenburg on the front line against both the Guild and Kusari. The Altenburg’s fleet held Sigma-15 for the duration of the conflict, only withdrawing back to New Berlin for further refitting after the Third Treaty of Honshu established a peace with Kusari. The fleet’s command cadre were also stringent Imperial supporters, and members of the coup that planned to topple the government. When the Rheinland Civil War erupted in 827 AS, the Altenburg carried out pre-arranged orders to attack Stuttgart.

The Battleship Karslruhe fled to Cologne before the Altenburg arrived, allowing it to secure Stuttgart’s orbit alongside the Westfalen. When the Karlsruhe attempted a break-out in the summer of 828 AS, it was quickly intercepted, with the Altenburg taking heavy damage while dispatching the Federalist battleship. By the time repairs at Oder Shipyard were completed, the war had ended in reunification. The Consensus Government selected the Altenburg and Strausberg fleets to recapture Cologne from the Red Hessians, owing to their past counter-revolutionary experience. When the Hessians fled, the fleet was permanently assigned to pacifying the troublesome frontier. The Altenburg is now primarily tasked with policing the Alsace Passage to Gallia, and monitoring ALG’s Wuppertal Refinery for suspected treachery.

TERRAIN: N/A

ESCAPE VELOCITY: 19.21 km/sec

A large gas giant with substantial traces of hydrogen, deuterium and tritium in its upper atmosphere. Heidelberg is currently being mined by Kruger Minerals from the orbiting Mannheim Station.

592223.text:
CLASS: Tribunus
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592223.mapped:
The battlecruiser Vis is one of the latest additions to the Corsair war fleet, representing a significant shift away from the cumbersome Legate-class dreadnoughts and aging Murmillo-class battleships. Launched in 830 AS, Vis was initially intended for deployment in the Omegas. However, the escalating pressure from Outcasts in the Omicron Theta system necessitated the reassignment of the dreadnought Barcelona to the troubled system, and Vis was designated to take its place.

Equipped with the most advanced weaponry available to Crete, Vis served as a formidable deterrent in the Sigma 17 system against the Outcasts and the GMG, continually trying to push the Corsairs out of the Sigma region. Unverified rumors also suggest Corsairs aboard Vis were on Cryer's payroll, serving as mercenaries to protect the Atka Research Station.

By the end of 833 AS, the situation in Omicron Theta unexpectedly escalated to the detriment of the Corsairs, prompting Vis and its accompanying fleet to leave Sigma 17 and restore order in the name of the Corsair Imperio in the neighboring system until a greater task came about.

After the Theta situation cooled down, the Corsairs set their eyes on Planet Gammu, a planet the Core swiftly occupied in 832 AS while the Imperio was distracted in Omicron Theta. As the Core lost the element of surprise, and retreated a portion of its forces deeper into the Omicrons to pursue other military expeditions, the Vis, along with its battlegroup, relocated to Omicron Kappa, preparing for the liberation of Planet Gammu.

592226.text:
CLASS: Unknown
GRAVITY: Unknown
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Unknown
CREW: Unknown
592226.mapped:
Lichtenfelde Complex is an ancient Rheinland station hidden within the cracks of large planetary fragments drifting through the Tokelau Cloud. Its location and purpose is a mystery to almost all inhabitants in Omicron Delta, and even the Order can only guess about the complex's precise position.

Lichtenfelde Complex's founding dates back to the 757 AS when it was established as a top secret research station for the ongoing Rheinland military expeditions carrying active artefacts from the deep Omicrons back to Rheinland. Lichtenfelde Complex was even believed to have its own capital ship detachment to secure the ongoing research and expeditions, a small battlegroup centred around the battleship Brandenburg.

The mysterious Lichtenfelde Complex appears to still be active after the Nomad War in 801 AS and it appears that it has been expanded since then, though some of these upgrades were clearly not made by humans.

While Lichtenfelde Complex possesses a sizable garrison to protect itself from any intruders, the base's secluded location both within the Tokelau Cloud and being mostly buried in a large rock are its best defences.

Remains of its own battleship, RNC Brandenburg, can still be found lingering around the installation.

TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: N/A

A lifeless world in the heart of Nomad space.

592232.text: Sensors have detected a small planetoid at the center of the Stone Veil nebula that exhibits strange energy signatures. However, close analysis is not possible due to local interference, and the abundant metal oxides in the planetoid and its surrounding chunks prevent scanners from penetrating deeper beneath its surface. Irregular structures of human and nonhuman origin pockmark the surface of the main body.
592232.mapped:
Tritonis is the subject of more than a few spacer tales told in seedy freeport bars and on lonely patrols. When forward scouts for the Kingdom of Gallia were first charting out invasion routes for the eventual conquest of Sirius, they discovered the enigmatic star system of Tau-61 through an unstable jump connection. They found peculiar astronomical phenomena hidden among the clouds and struggled to find any semblance of true shelter from the high levels of gamma and neutron radiation that plagued the system. Salvation came with the accidental discovery of a planetoid hidden within the Stone Veil cloud.

This planetoid, dubbed Tritonis many years after its discovery, was the site of a gargantuan ancient ruin of unknown origin. Intrigued by the groundbreaking discovery, the Kingdom of Gallia dispatched Royal Intelligence assets to secure the area and establish a research base. The massive complex was hewn into the rock of the structure to better access the ruins and use the planetoid itself as a shield from heavy radiation. Though initial hopes believed there would be findings enough to revolutionize Gallic understanding of the universe, they were aborted by the imminent collapse of the jump hole that led them to this strange place.

Without regular supply convoys, the expedition struggled to survive over the coming weeks, with members dying to attrition with every passing day. In a desperate, last ditch effort, the remaining survivors attempted to regroup and make for the sole potentially habitable moon in the system. Failing that, they would bank on a sublight burn out of the Labyrinth to get some kind of signal out to the unknowing Kingdom they called home. None of these efforts bore fruit, and the explorers never returned home.

Over the course of history, classified knowledge regarding Tritonis and Tau-61 became the stuff of urban legend and conspiracy theory amid the conflicts between the Crown and Council dissidents. Conspiracy passed into legend as spacers yet spoke of a fabled, forgotten ruin in the clouds, hidden behind an ever-shifting doorway to a graveyard of a system. Some were even said to have found the mythical place, yet none ever returned. With the exodus of Vagrants carving a terrifying trail of destruction through the Orkney system, these legends have been resurrected. They say that all spacers' tales hold a grain of truth to them, after all.

592233.text:
Tritonis is the subject of more than a few spacer tales told in seedy freeport bars and on lonely patrols. When forward scouts for the Kingdom of Gallia were first charting out invasion routes for the eventual conquest of Sirius, they discovered the enigmatic star system of Tau-61 through an unstable jump connection. They found peculiar astronomical phenomena hidden among the clouds and struggled to find any semblance of true shelter from the high levels of gamma and neutron radiation that plagued the system. Salvation came with the accidental discovery of a planetoid hidden within the Stone Veil cloud.

This planetoid, dubbed Tritonis many years after its discovery, was the site of a gargantuan ancient ruin of unknown origin. Intrigued by the groundbreaking discovery, the Kingdom of Gallia dispatched Royal Intelligence assets to secure the area and establish a research base. The massive complex was hewn into the rock of the structure to better access the ruins and use the planetoid itself as a shield from heavy radiation. Though initial hopes believed there would be findings enough to revolutionize Gallic understanding of the universe, they were aborted by the imminent collapse of the jump hole that led them to this strange place.

Without regular supply convoys, the expedition struggled to survive over the coming weeks, with members dying to attrition with every passing day. In a desperate, last ditch effort, the remaining survivors attempted to regroup and make for the sole potentially habitable moon in the system. Failing that, they would bank on a sublight burn out of the Labyrinth to get some kind of signal out to the unknowing Kingdom they called home. None of these efforts bore fruit, and the explorers never returned home.
