592235.text: A large ice asteroid visible on sensors. Although preliminary spectrographic scanners are capable of detecting non-negligible trace amounts of metallic elements in the ice itself, economic exploitation is unlikely.
592235.mapped:
To call Fort Tegea spartan would be an understatement. Hastily established as a listening post and forward base by Vagrant infectees to watch over the Orkney jump hole, the station itself has minimal life support and weaponry and relies on concealment to avoid trouble. Tegea struggles with a high casualty rate due to attrition from ambient radiation, supply issues, and faulty equipment.

With the current inability to sustain a stable food supply in Tau-61, Fort Tegea has yet another important mission: Sending escort ships for much-needed supply convoys and raiders to surrounding systems.

592238.text:
Schatten Experimental Shipyard provides a practical workspace for the experiments carried out aboard the Research Facility, with notable examples including the initial prototyping of Rheinland warships such as the Elbe and Tirpitz classes. Its secluded location protects Rheinland's developments from prying eyes, both foreign and domestic.

For the duration of the Rheinland Civil War, Schatten’s research projects were suspended, with the station instead operating as a front-line Federalist repair yard. While normal operations have now resumed, much of Schatten’s current work involves analyzing the ruined hulks of Civil War battle losses to devise improvements to ship survivability and lethality.

592240.text: In 806 AS Richard Winston Tobias, Esq., bet Edison Trent half a million credits that he would come all the way from Leeds to Toledo in a Clydesdale freighter - alone and without escort. The freighter of choice was Islington, heavily modified ship that belonged to Tobias for years. Surprisingly, the Islington survived the long journey to Omicron Minor, and Tobias was very near to reaching his goal. However, not far from Toledo the ship was damaged by a small asteroid. Tobias survived and called for help; luckily enough, an Order patrol was nearby and rescued him shortly before Nomads arrived at the scene. Trent was reluctant to pay, but finally agreed in exchange for a promise that Tobias would never never leave Bretonia alone again.

592245.mapped:
The Nagasaki was constructed in 799 AS, shortly before the Colony Wars. It conducted several operations against the Rheinland Military in Honshu and New Tokyo, but was eventually crippled during the Battle of Fuji. After receiving extensive repairs in the war's aftermath, the Nagasaki was transferred to Kyushu where it conducted counter-terrorism patrols across the system and into the Taus. In the closing months of 813 AS, rising tensions with Bretonia over ownership of the region's Niobium deposits culminated in the Tau War. The Nagasaki spearheaded the expeditionary force, which succeeded in pushing Bretonia from the Taus and breaching Leeds in 816 AS.

In 818 AS, the 8 Day War saw the Gallic Royal Navy overwhelm and destroy all KNF forces in the Taus, stranding forward expeditionary elements within Bretonia. Forced to seek amnesty with their former foes, the Nagasaki was adopted as the flagship of Jien Kogen, the Kusari Emperor-in-Exile. It led the Kusari Exiles in a guerrilla campaign across the Taus to break Gallic influence, topple the Kusari Republic, and restore the imperial throne. The Kusari Civil War formally began with the invasion of Tau-29 in 822 AS, and Kyushu the following year. This culminated with the Nagasaki's destruction of the Battleship Nagumo, with a negotiated peace being agreed soon after.

During the Reformed Kusari Empire’s invasion of Gallia in 827 AS, Nagasaki punched through Crayter Republic forces in Tau-31, before pivoting and invading Tau-23 and Languedoc. The vessel was noted for its bombardment of Planet Quillan, and the destruction of the Enclave Battleship Rocroi. The vessel suffered heavy damage during the rout from Languedoc, limping back to Kusari with damage to its engines and reactors. Following the war, the Nagasaki was confined to Kure Shipyard, later receiving extensive repairs and modernization when funds became available. Since the completion of these works in 835 AS, the battleship has relieved the venerable Myoko, and now vigilantly guards the Shikoku border.

592249.text:
The remains of a Sabre-class fighter that still bears the golden cross of Malta on its hull. The Spectral Falcon's propulsion and maneuvering system is badly damaged, making it safe to assume that the pilot lost control of his own ship due to wandering too close to Achlys.

The identity of the pilot remains unknown, but all weapons, ship's recorders, and the escape pod have been artfully removed from the ship. The ultimate fate of the pilot and missing equipment remains a mystery.

592251.text:
The pilot of this small and nimble freighter, Charlie Swift, hailed from Liberty. She worked with the Hessians and was known for her vocal opposition to the Bounty Hunters, who put a hefty bounty on her head.

Sensor analysis indicates that her ship was severely damaged, and two of its three fuel tanks were hit. Although her final moments are speculative, Charlie probably lost her bearings in the north cloud of the Omega-55 system and ran out of fuel. Her desiccated remains are still present in the cockpit of her ship.

592253.text: The wreck of the Zoners fighter Mururoa. The pilot was deadly wounded in a fight with Nomads; body was considered unsuitable for infestation.

592255.text: The wreck of the Outcast fighter Piazza Armerina. Ship systems are disabled. Body of the pilot is nowhere to be found.

592257.text:
CLASS: Elbe
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592257.mapped:
Work on the Carrier Soltau was concurrent with the prototype Carrier Elbe’s construction, on Daumann’s risky assumption that the class would be greenlit for serial production. After the rushed Elbe met with approval, it was disassembled and many of its parts recycled for use on the Soltau’s more robust design. Completed in 818 AS, it was initially assigned to the Battleship Westfalen’s fleet as an escort carrier, and saw active service in Bering against the Liberty Navy.

Following the Hudson War, defense planners suggested the Military should pivot away from heavy and expensive battleship fleets, and instead rely on more numerous and flexible formations of Elbes and battlecruisers. Despite this, actual reform was slow to arrive, and the Soltau continued to serve as the Westfalen’s escort carrier until the end of the Saigon War. Where the Westfalen had been badly damaged while holding the beachhead in Honshu, the Soltau was only then transferred to head up its own fleet. This saw the carrier posted to Hamburg to take over garrison duties there.

In 827 AS, the Soltau fired the opening shots of the Rheinland Civil War by executing an Imperial coup on Planet Hamburg. The carrier’s fighter squadrons quickly secured the atmosphere while Marines arrested the federal planetary government. For the rest of the war it held Hamburg, while launching fighter squadrons into New Berlin to counter incursions by the Carrier Saar. In the Civil War’s aftermath the Carrier was briefly mothballed, although it has since been reactivated to garrison Hamburg again using the funds previously allocated to the Battleship Strausberg.

592260.mapped:
The Privateers of Bretonia seeking to augment their ability to raid and pillage Gallic vessels without relying upon the good graces of their employers in the Crown. In addition to requiring a place to store their goods taken from transports supporting the Gallic Royal Navy's war effort, they saw opportunity when the Villeneuve was destroyed and the Betheny battlegroup was ordered beyond, into Leeds. The ongoing push through and past Edinburgh caused some holes to begin appearing in the patrols, as the system was now part of the rear flank of the invasion. Privateer vessels infiltrated Edinburgh, and using the cover of the Arran Ice Cloud, constructed a small facility to cater to those bearing a Letter of Marque.

In a sense of irony, most of the supplies used in the construction of Providence were stolen from Gallia's corporations. Goods are stored on the base where the Crown's share is divided up and shipped out to New London, in accordance to their Letters of Marque. Following the end of the war, Privateer numbers in Tau have decreased, with many seeking fortunes in the Omega systems.

592263.text:
Toronto Station was constructed in 817 AS as a refinery and alloy foundry, processing resources extracted from Planet Huron. Deep Space Engineering (DSE) was heavily subsidized to build the base, due to Liberty’s fears of an impending war with Rheinland, which could severely impact their access to strategic construction materials. Toronto was designed to use sophisticated, DSE-produced Mining Machinery, operated by expensive teams of Liberty engineers. When the anticipated war finally came, increasingly demanding export quotas were set, with staff regularly complaining of insufficient pay and poor working conditions.

This came to a head in 824 AS, after years of grueling targets intended to fuel economic support for Bretonia during the Gallic War. Pushed too far, the engineers declared a general strike. Rather than negotiate, DSE instead contracted cheap Bretonian refugees to break the picket, dismissing the engineers with immediate effect. Outraged, the ex-workers seized Toronto’s docking bays and refused to allow their replacements access to the station. Before long, Marines were dispatched from Fort Severn to restore the strategically important flow of goods. What exactly transpired next is hotly disputed, however the “Toronto Massacre” resulted in dozens being killed, and several stolen transports and mining ships fleeing into the Georgia Ice Field.

While production quickly resumed, Toronto found itself the target of frequent Xeno attacks. Soon after the end of the Gallic War, Liberty ended its subsidies for the operation, arguing that the strategic need to distort free market forces had passed -- DSE quickly soured on the station's marginal profits. As Navy security patrols were gradually drawn down, Ontario became the most dangerous system in Liberty. When in 829 AS Liberty announced that it intended to fully withdraw system coverage, DSE stripped the most valuable plant machinery and abandoned the rest. Toronto now exists only as a skeleton, fought over by Junkers and other black market salvagers.

592265.mapped:
When Bretonia regained control of Planet Harris, it quickly resumed the terraforming process due to an urgent need to house the refugees displaced by the loss of Leeds. To fund the ongoing costs of colonization, Bretonia opened up the vast virgin resources of Harris for purchase by foreign corporations, alongside offers for private Bretonian equity. Gateway quickly capitalized on the offer, bidding heavily to secure exclusive rights to the construction of a large shipping platform in Harris’ orbit.

Lewes was completed in late 827 AS, with Gateway wagering the steep upfront costs would be amply paid off by facilitating the lion’s share of trade bound to a new Bretonian colony. Already, offices have been opened aboard by the Bounty Hunters’ Guild, Cryer, the IMG, Planetform, Samura and Synth Foods. While not yet in the black on their investment, docking tariffs and the resale of Bretonian and Kusari goods are already proving to be lucrative.

592268.text:
Fort Severn was constructed in 810 AS by the Liberty Navy, following the infamous disappearance of the Battleship Alabama. Designed as a reinforced Military patrol base, Severn was responsible for protecting Ontario’s Jump Gate and ice harvesting operations until 816 AS. During this period, the Fort was among the least popular of the Navy’s postings, owing to its extreme isolation, spartan living conditions and hazardous patrols.

In 817 AS, the Liberty government entered into a consortium partnership between the Liberty Navy, Deep Space Engineering and Detroit Munitions to expand Severn with an advanced Military Vehicles factory. Severn was responsible for massively expanding production ahead of feared hostilities with Rheinland, as well as selling large quantities of materiel to Bretonia for use on Planet Leeds and New London.

Following the destruction of Red Deer Station in Alberta, Severn was also tasked with providing protection to convoys heading towards the Ageira projects deeper in that system. In the aftermath of the Gallic War, the Fort saw severe cuts as the Military Vehicle factory was decommissioned. When Liberty announced its intention to withdraw from Ontario, Severn was among the first to be abandoned. The wreck has since been picked apart by pirates and scavengers, contributing to the debris field surrounding it.

CLASS: Interdictor Block IIId
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592271.mapped:
Launched in late 826 AS, the Battlecruiser Yellowstone was initially attached to the Arkansas Fleet in Texas. When Rheinland collapsed into Civil War the following year, the vessel breached the Treaty of Atka to patrol across Hudson’s now unmanned Rheinland Security Zone. While these patrols were publicly described as “providing aid to a troubled neighbor”, the proximity of heavy Liberty Navy assets to the Imperialist stronghold of Hamburg came with an implicit threat of consequences should serious action be taken against Liberty’s interests in Stuttgart. After secret commitments on Synth Foods’ property rights were extracted from the nascent Empire in 828 AS, the Yellowstone was withdrawn and redeployed to Coronado.

It was tasked with providing urgent military aid to the Crayter Republic, who had recently suffered heavy casualties during an exceptional Outcast assault across the Taus.During this posting, the battlecruiser’s taskforce were responsible for training Crayter pilots, supporting the consular office on Planet Yuma in enforcing Liberty’s interests, and conducting far-ranging counter-narcotic patrols. This resulted in frequent and particularly bloody clashes with Outcast smugglers -- regular deaths among the Yellowstone’s flight wing soon soured Liberty’s public on the operation. In 834 AS, the isolationist President Mildred Hawthorne terminated the deployment, instead demanding the Yellowstone bolster counter-smuggling efforts in California instead. Positioned near Planet Mojave, this also enabled its fighters to support Liberty’s brief efforts in Ontario.

After Kusari’s devastating surprise assault on Norfolk Shipyard and Pennsylvania, the Yellowstone was ordered to secure the critically damaged Battleship Alma. Facing a renewed and inspired Militant insurrection across Planet Erie and Pennsylvania, the Yellowstone has been spread thin protecting the Alma’s damage control teams while also responding to rising assaults elsewhere by Erie Militants and Kusari privateers.

592274.mapped:
Where there’s junk, there are the Junkers. They’ve been around since the earliest days of the Trade Lanes. Descended from the working classes, they developed within the House systems as a sort of necessary evil, handling the dirty work that no one else would. They do well salvaging valuable materials from the ever-increasing debris fields throughout Sirius, with the notable exception of Kusari. To this day they remain held at bay by the Hogosha.

Anyone who deals with Junkers knows they live by a strict code; if you're not a Junker, you're not part of the family. A Junker will double-cross you without a second thought, and they're fiercely protective of each other. Most House corporations consider the Junkers to be simple criminals, but Junkers will occasionally do favors for the police, turning in the odd, mid-level criminal or letting them know about the occasional drug shipment. So despite some harassment, the police stop short of shutting them down. The infrequent police cleanup operations are little more than exercises in public relations, though there's no love lost between the two groups.

The Junkers make their official money from salvaging debris within the fields, but also have a good deal going with various criminals, who like their "no questions asked" policy. Tolerated by the governments, Junkers sometimes deal in contraband, but they are extremely hard to catch red-handed. They are frequently patronized by the criminal element for the refuge they offer within the often hostile territory of House capitol systems.

The Junkers of Thunder Bay moved into Ontario in 815 AS, scavenging the ever expanding Debris Ocean as a front. In truth, Thunder Bay provided an alternate route for Colorado smugglers who were suffering increasingly persistent Xenos attacks while heading for New York. In recent years, Thunder Bay has also become central to the Junkers’ efforts to disrupt Xenos attempts to encroach on the Cardamine distribution market. As a result, the base has become a front line of sorts, hosting Junker fighters and their hired mercenaries.

592277.mapped:
Cochrane Depot was constructed in 810 AS, shortly after Liberty funded the construction of the California Jump Gate. Initially used as a simple staging post to harass Ageira operations, Cochrane quickly evolved into a joint project between the Lane Hackers of Magellan and Galileo. Pooling the skillsets of Ageira defectors from Colorado and California, Cochrane became a hub for the development of sophisticated sensor technologies and the underpinning firmware. This collaboration bore fruit with the Minified Spyglass Scanner, a Lane Hacker derivative of a stolen Liberty Navy prototype.

While this scanner was later discarded as impractical, it was an important stepping-stone to the Spyglass Network, a decentralized matrix of sensors hidden across Liberty. These satellites allow Lane Hackers to fit powerful scanners to smaller ships, outsourcing energy-expensive processing to the wider network. As a result of the expertise cultivated at Cochrane, the base has begun to offer premium sensor tuning and refit to the wealthiest of clients. In recent years, the Hackers of Cochrane have bartered these services to Outcast cartels for preferential access to stressed Cardamine supplies.

Cochrane is also the primary source of Lane Hacker produced Counterfeit Computerware -- off-the-shelf hardware and software bundles that allow even the least sophisticated groups to execute plug-and-play cyberattacks and scams. Stemming the flow of Counterfeit Computerware has become a major priority for Liberty authorities due to the significant cost its dissemination imposes on the Sirian economy. As of 835 AS, Cochrane's Executives have restricted access to the base, limiting entry to Hackers with skills needed for a "sensitive research project", and high-paying VIPs.

592280.mapped:
Fort Ramsey was first excavated in 807 AS to create additional space for the explosive growth of the Xeno movement. Xeno bases were suffering severely from overcrowding thanks to LPI crackdowns that had fueled radicalization and recruitment in Texas’ prisons. Ramsey quickly adopted the role of a quiet training ground for green recruits -- a role that was disturbed when Liberty began moving into the system two years later. The Xenos responded aggressively to the intrusion, targeting DSE ice miners that encroached too far into the Georgian Ice Field. In 824 AS, these same miners would become unexpected allies following a mutiny aboard Toronto Station. Protesting DSE engineers were attacked by Liberty Marines, resulting in the Toronto Massacre.

The rebel workers fled into the Ice Field and found refuge with the Xenos, quickly setting to work overhauling Ramsey’s workshops and excavating new facilities. The Fort received a second large boost in the aftermath of the Gallic War, as victorious Navy personnel returned home to a perfunctory discharge and mass-unemployment. These militants brought a professional edge to the Xenos that was previously sorely lacking. The blend of corporate and military influences aboard Ramsey resulted in a rigid, authoritarian culture that promoted discipline and obedience. This caused friction with the other Xeno clans who resented the domineering attitude of Ramsey’s leaders. Despite this, Ontario-trained squadrons remain in high demand across all Xeno operations.

Ramsey is also a hotbed of Xeno separatist ideologies, who see Ontario as the best candidate for their breakaway state. Separatists consistently advocated for expelling Liberty from Ontario, rather than waiting for the LSF to leave of its own accord. After almost a year of begging and bartering for manpower from the other clans, it was agreed an offensive would be launched in 835 AS. In the first example of Xeno fighters directly attacking a Liberty fleet in open space, massed waves of Xenos from across Liberty drove the Battlecruiser Lehigh out of the system and destroyed the Construction Ship Robert Peary. The victory came at a truly staggering cost, with Ramsey now preoccupied with restoring its depleted squadrons and paying its debts to the other clans.

592283.text: This extensive field of ice asteroids is an outcropping of the Barrier Nebula. Surveys revealed vast reserves of clean Water that could be used to supplement the terrafoming project on California Minor and address droughts on Planet Los Angeles. Despite promising early results, contaminants and frequent pirate attacks quickly ballooned costs to the point that it became considerably cheaper to simply continue purchasing mined ice from the Independent Miners’ Guild in Magellan. Several attempts were made to resume mining after the destruction of Freeport 4, however persistent Xeno attacks put an end to each.

592285.text: This smaller field of ice asteroids is an outcropping of the Barrier Nebula. Early attempts at ice mining were quickly abandoned due to frequent Lane Hacker and Xeno attacks. Ontario’s vast debris fields and other industrial waste have since drifted into the field, further contaminating the ice deposits.

Deployed in 817 AS, the Wyoming was the first Liberty Security Force (LSF) deep-space variant Interdictor battlecruiser. Designed as a long range commerce raider during the Hudson War, the Wyoming was ideally adapted for long flights to Hamburg after Rheinland sabotaged its Jump Gate connections to the Independent Worlds. While on missions, the battlecruiser acted as the LSF’s eyes and ears in Rheinland, assassinating high profile Military targets and disrupting war-critical industry. The Wyoming’s last status update placed it in Hamburg’s Kielfeld in 820 AS, with the LSF assuming the vessel was lost shortly after.
592289.mapped:
In reality, Division 9 -- a Nomad cell concealed within the LSF -- had coordinated with The Wild to set a deadly trap. Isolated and cut off, the vessel was overwhelmed and boarded, with the surviving crew captured and infected. The Wild initially used the Wyoming to implicate Liberty in war crimes against civilian targets, hoping to derail tentative peace negotiations. Following the end of the war, the battlecruiser went on to aid in the capture of the Battlecruiser Trier, with both then participating in the Wild attack on Thuringia’s Valhalla Shipyard. After desperately needed repairs, the Wyoming was refitted with Nomad hybrid technologies and returned to service. The vessel then carried out a range of sabotage and abduction operations intended to enflame border tensions between Kusari and Liberty, and expand the local Thrall network.

Increasingly its work focused on countering Order influence in the region, as its Thralls covertly identified and eliminated Order agents in the Liberty underworld. Eventually these activities attracted the attention of the Battleship Atum, which cornered the battlecruiser in Galileo. After several years of evasive actions, the Wyoming threw caution to the wind and was detected burning towards Colorado. The Wild successfully punched through The Order guard squadron at the Jump Hole, fleeing to Ontario where they entered a low-power state to evade detection in the South Debris Sea. They were located once more by Order scouts in early 835 AS and immediately withdrew, hoping to escape to Inverness.

Forced into a pitched battle within the Georgian Ice Field, the Wyoming faced inevitable destruction. The Vagrants then offered an ultimatum - they would rescue the ship, if the Wild aboard broke links to the Nomad mindshare and were subsumed into their own. Facing imminent death and the destruction of Liberty's Thrall network, the Wild reluctantly agreed. Heavy Vagrant warforms immediately jumped in to evacuate the battlecruiser, driving the Atum off. Having effectively stolen the Nomads' progress toward infiltrating Liberty, the Vagrants have been quick to order their Wendigos to exploit these new capabilities. The heavily damaged Wyoming is now being assessed for improvised repairs at the salvaged facilities of Leniex.

592292.mapped:
The Battleship Minneapolis was launched in 817 AS, shortly before the Hudson War with Rheinland. Throughout the conflict, the Minneapolis was tasked with protecting military logistics across Virginia, Texas and New York. Seeing little direct action, it was soon adopted as a relief assignment for combat pilots rotated away from the front lines. This continued through the Gallic War, with the Minneapolis required to secure more and more systems as Liberty surged fleets forward to respond to the Invasion of California in 825 AS.

Following the end of the Insurgency Campaign in 830 AS, the Minneapolis was transferred into the fleet reserves and mothballed. This lasted until 836 AS, when urgent work was completed to prepare the vessel for active service once more. The Minneapolis is now completing a shakedown deployment around New York, ahead of a planned assignment to Colorado where it will relieve the Battleship Rio Grande. Following the shakedown cruise around New York, the Minneapolis was ordered to relieve the Rio Grande from its post and stand as the vigilant guard of Ageira's headquarters.

592295.mapped:
Commissioned in 814 AS, the Alma was one of the first Overlords to take part in operations against Rheinland during the brief conflict, acting as the vanguard of a new force centered around the Hudson corridor.

However, due to changes elsewhere on the front, the Alma was instead repositioned in orbit of Planet Atka, where it helped protect the planetforming ventures of Liberty.

Its posting in Hudson helped greatly in training the crew for hostile environments, and, as such, the Alma took the mantle of being one of the very first warships to engage the Gallic Royal Navy in Cortez, and later in New London. After securing a victory on the Bretonian front, it was relocated to Los Angeles' orbit, where it remained for several years before being reassigned to deal with Zoner issues in Pennsylvania.

592306.mapped:
The now-aging Concord began its service during the first stages of the conflict with Rheinland, when it led several important battles and successfully captured important equipment for Liberty.

For the government, the ship became a jewel, however the reality was far more cruel, with the Concord losing the majority of its original crew and having to return to Norfolk for immediate repairs after its mayden operation. This meant that, when the Gallic War reached Bretonia, the warship was still under maintenance, and therefore unable to provide direct assistance.

With repairs completed in 825, it hastily departed for New London, though its impact on the course of the battle was minimal. Instead, after resupplying, the Liberty Navy deployed the Concord to the Bering system, where it routed important forces of a rebellion against the House.

Once repaired, the Concord returned to Liberty space, where it now patrols the California system in light of increasing Xeno and Rogue activity.

592308.mapped:
Philadelphia Station was built in 758 AS by disaffected Houston drifters looking to escape from the poverty and corruption of Texas. These colonists quickly affiliated themselves with the Zoner movement, recruiting like-minded individuals from Freeport 2. Philadelphia was constructed in orbit of Planet Bruin as a midway point between Texas and Planet Erie, with the Zoners landing Erie’s first settlements later the next year. During this early period, the station acted as a vital lifeline for supply ships and colonists traversing the remote Pennsylvania frontier, providing amenities and refueling. The arrival of Deep Space Engineering (DSE) construction ships in 774 AS signaled Liberty’s renewed interest in the system, changing everything. The completion of the New York Jump Gate shortly after toppled Philadelphia’s business model overnight, as supply shipments rerouted and Liberty corporations began to arrive.

While desperately looking for ways to sustain the station, the Zoners discovered the unusually high concentrations of Neon in Bruin’s atmosphere. With neither the expertise or capital to set up gas harvesters, Philadelphia was facing destitution by 778 AS. It was only after Liberty Police Incorporated (LPI) deployed to secure Pennsylvania that DSE offered an investment package. This provided the necessary facilities in exchange for a significant ownership stake, and a near-exclusive Neon contract for Universal Shipping. The station council reluctantly agreed to the deal, however many residents reacted negatively to the encroaching Liberty presence, and departed for Erie. Over the decades, DSE incrementally expanded its investments and control over the station. By the time of Liberty’s annexation of the system in 830 AS, Philadelphia was a de facto DSE refinery, possessing only a nominal Zoner presence.

592311.text:
CLASS: Renovo
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 7,600
592311.mapped:
Bethlehem Station was built in 780 AS as a response to the arrival of Liberty corporations in Pennsylvania, and their proposals to build Erie’s docking ring and Trade Lane connection. Many Zoners saw Erie’s acceptance of these offers as a betrayal of their core values, selling out freedom for a handful of House credits. These Zoners felt their suspicions were further validated when Erie’s planetary council accepted the Pennsylvania Protectorate Treaty in 786 AS. While some retreated into the planet’s wilderness and established remote militia communities, others migrated to Bethlehem with the objective of creating a completely self-sufficient orbital community, independent of Liberty’s corporations or control.

During these early years, Bethlehem harvested Water and Deuterium from the nearby Ralston Ice Fields, trading these reluctantly with Erie for Food Rations and other supplies. The first major step towards self-sufficiency came in 794 AS, when a citizen vote begrudgingly commissioned Synth Foods to install a biodome. Next, a Water purification plant was constructed to produce potable supplies from the Ralston Field’s dirty ice. Finally, contracts with Bristol Construction and Manufacturing allowed for significant habitat expansions, a new solar power array and facilities for the local production of Consumer Goods. While life on Bethlehem remained cramped, spartan and difficult, its residents were content that they lived completely free of House control.

When Liberty annexed Pennsylvania in 830 AS, Bethlehem adopted a position of armed neutrality. The station was overhauled with weapon platforms and self-destruction charges. The Liberty Navy quickly surmised that the station was strategically insignificant, heavily armed, and filled with civilians who would rather die than cooperate; any attempt to bring the station to heel would end in a humanitarian and political disaster. Bethlehem was accordingly left to its own devices, on the understanding that it would not provide overt support to the Erie’s Zoner Militants. While mixed on this issue, many residents were satisfied to remain uninvolved, seeing the annexation as the inevitable -- and forewarned -- result of Erie’s hubris all those years before.

592314.text:
Battleship Delaware was constructed during Liberty's conflict with Gallia, intended to take the place of the Battleship Gettysburg. However, manufacturing setbacks preventing the completion of the warship, as well as the increased aggression of the Gallic Royal Navy, forced the Liberty Navy to deploy the Gettysburg to the front lines of the conflict. This, military analysts hoped, would have allowed enough time to finish the new Mitchell-class vessel, and allow the aging Monument-class to be decommissioned.

The strategy was in vain, however, as the fierce fighting in the orbit of New London cost the Liberty Navy several of their veteran fleets, the Gettysburg among them. With the recapture of Leeds and the collapse of the Gallic Crown, the war was over for Liberty. Having finished construction very shortly after the conflict, Delaware and their supporting fleet took the place of the Gettysburg, with greenhorn crew who hope to fill the shoes of the now destroyed battegroup. Hoping to prove their potency as a Great House, Liberty ordered for the Delaware to spearhead an invasion into the backwater systems that serve as staging grounds for Insurgent forces. Supposedly acting in concert with an attempt to form a beachhead into Vespucci, the Delaware has instead opted to lay siege to enemy infrastructure in its immediate environment before pushing onwards in this bold offensive action.

Having finally secured a position in Vespucci, the Delaware's Commanding Officer sought to expedite his victory by pressing the advance without first regrouping with the Ohio. A costly engagement with the Battleship Vanquisher meant that when the hour finally struck, the Delaware was found to be lacking. The Triton's large snubcraft element whittled the Delaware down over time, destroying it despite the odds being far from in their favor.

592316.mapped: The Junkers arrived in Pennsylvania not long after the Zoners, but it wasn't until Allentown was already being built that the two groups met. The Zoners had come from the north end, through the California jumphole. The Junkers had come from the south, through Texas. The two groups mostly ignored eachother - trading a little when it was convenient, but otherwise going about their own ways. Allentown eventually grew into an important smuggling post, dealing mostly in Cardamine and "human cargo". Allentowns remote location makes sure the Navy rarely pays a visit - and if they do, there are always Rogues nearby to either destroy or distract them.

592322.mapped:
The relative safety of the Pennsylvania system has drawn a small Xenos population into the system. It was initially discovered by Xeno fighter pursuing a number of Junkers through a (to them) unknown Jump Hole. After dispatching of the Junkers, the Xenos returned to Barrow to report what they had found. Construction of Milford started two years later, in 772 AS

The Xenos in Pennsylvania are generally the least agressive of the organisation. Milford is in a good position to obtain supplies from the large Zoner population in the system, which are then sent to other Xeno bases as needed. The Rogue and Junker presence makes these trips dangerous, so the Xeno formations that depart from Milford are usually large.

TEMPERATURE: -53°C to 45°C

592335.mapped:
Erie was first discovered by Liberty explorers in 679 AS. It was briefly considered as a potential option for the resettlement of 'undesirables' from Planet Houston, which had suffered from endemic issues of crime and unemployment since the Dallas Incident over a century earlier. Further surveys revealed a cool climate and a range of dangerous reptilian fauna that would prove challenging to colonization efforts. The plans were temporarily shelved by the Senate on cost grounds, with any future attempts to revive the issue being killed by intense LPI lobbying. Self-identified Zoners were the first to colonize Erie in 761 AS, with Erie's dangerous conditions promoting the formation of close-knit, well-armed walled communities. These sorts of Zoner settlements continue to expand across Erie's wilderness to this day, despite Liberty's best efforts to control them.

Liberty was not willing to tolerate an independent planet within its borders for long. It considered the growing colony to be a security risk due to the system's lawlessness and lack of accountability to House authorities. The situation came to a head when the LPI were ordered into the system in 778 AS, in response to persistent attacks on Liberty trade vessels by local pirates. This marked the start of increasing Liberty influence over the planet -- DSE constructed a docking ring in 782 AS, opening the way for other corporations to begin opening offices. Many Zoner settlers reacted negatively to this encroaching presence, forming militias intended to safeguard their independence. Liberty chose to avoid an unnecessary conflict by offering the system protectorate status, affording the planet broad autonomy to govern its own affairs. Despite this, Liberty's culture, economy and citizens increasingly came to dominate life in Erie's largest settlements over the following years.

From 827 AS onward, Erie received increasing numbers of refugees from the ailing Liberty Insurgency. Liberty's demands that these individuals be deported as terrorists were strongly rebuffed by Zoner leaders. Matters reached breaking point in 830 AS, with the Insurgency's destruction of Williamstown Depot near Planet Tremont, and Zoner militias allegedly shooting down an LSF monitoring satellite in Erie's orbit. Liberty responded by dissolving the protectorate and landing troops on Erie, formally annexing the planet shortly after. This resulted in significant disorder, with Militant militias frequently attacking Liberty forces. Following the annexation, Liberty established large internment camps on Erie where Insurgency captives were held, pending trial for sedition. While these camps have since largely closed, their mismanagement by the LPI left many local communities resentful and suspicious. Since the declaration of war between Kusari and Liberty, Militant activity across Erie has sharply increased.

A cold lifeless moon on the outskirts of Pennsylvania system. It has a small ring system of its own, comprised of elements dragged away from the vast ring system of planet Sayre.

592344.text: The Appalachian is a medium-sized rocky asteroid field. Its proximity to the New York trade artery makes it a prime staging area for pirates. It is rumored that the Liberty Rogues have a base within the field, but Liberty security forces haven't been able to pinpoint it's exact location. Preliminary commercial surveys of the field were abandoned due to persistent pirate attacks.

592346.text: Meadville is a medium-sized field of ice asteroids with no traces of valuable resources. It is rumored that one of the largest asteroids has been converted into a base by one of the Liberty pirate factions, most probably Xenos. Meadville also contains a jump hole leading from Pennsylvania into Kansas system.

592347.text: Ralston Ice Field (Heavy Water Mining Zone)

592348.text: Ralston Ice Field is located within the Hallam Nebula. The field is notable for significant amounts of Deuterium trapped in the Water asteroids that form the field. These deposits were first discovered by ice miners gathering Water ice for early Zoner pioneering colonies on Planet Erie.

592350.text: A medium-sized field of rock asteroids. Barely explored, this field is located in one of the most remote regions of Pennsylvania and often serves as a hideout for Rogues and other dangerous criminals chased by Bounty Hunters or Police patrols.

592352.text: A large field of ice asteroids on the outskirts of the Pennsylvania system. Xeno activity is significant within the field.

592354.text: A large field of planetoid-sized asteroids coalesced in near orbit of the system's star. Studies suggest that they are the remains of several small planetoids that were destroyed by collisions during the chaos of the system's infancy.

592356.mapped:
The Bundschuh have long been concerned by the MND's work within Thuringia, amid persistent rumors of torture, human experiments and research on dangerous alien technologies. This concern would peak with the unexplained explosion of Planet Gotha in 820 AS and the spike of Wild activity in 823 AS. Tennsdedt was excavated in the Gotha Fragment Field shortly after, with significant financial and material support from The Order. The Bundschuh and The Order would cooperate on investigations into the Gotha Incident and intelligence gathering about the MND’s activities. The station’s hazardous and isolated location also made it an ideal temporary hiding spot for wanted Rheinland dissidents.

The Bundschuh and MND would strike an uneasy accord during the Civil War, as both were equally opposed to the restoration of a monarchist Imperial Rheinland. Tennsdedt would be expanded during this period, with the base offering a safe port and reprieve for Bundschuh pilots who had been fighting in New Berlin and Frankfurt. In the aftermath of the war, the Bundschuh continued to host Order patrols in Thuringia, and resumed direct combat operations against the MND following the collapse of the armistice agreement in 832 AS. Currently the Bundschuh are investigating the increasingly alarming energy readings emanating from Planet Gotha, and the spiralling situation in the Suhl Anomaly.

592359.mapped:
The Battleship Bayern was deployed in 823 AS, and is the newest battleship in the Rheinland fleet. Constructed to replace losses during the Hudson War, it incorporated many design refinements based on Rheinland’s experiences, including long-range cruise capability, and enhanced damage control systems. The Bayern was briefly deployed to Thuringia, where it worked closely with the MND to combat Wild raiders. When tensions with the Gas Miner’s Guild escalated to open conflict in 825 AS, the Bayern was placed at the head of an expeditionary fleet and dispatched through open space to the contested territory of Sigma-21. Upon detecting the construction of Ibusuki Survey Platform, the Bayern was controversially ordered to evict the joint Kishiro-GMG project by force.

Ibusuki was destroyed shortly after, killing all aboard. Rheinland has long objected that it was not actually responsible for the incident, however Kusari was not persuaded and joined the war alongside the Guild. The Bayern saw extensive combat in the resulting Saigon War, pushing all the way to Honshu before peace terms were negotiated in 826 AS. After this, the Bayern was returned to Thuringia to resume the officer training role vacated by the Kolleda. When a Military coup toppled the Federal Government, Schatten Shipyard came under attack by the Battleship Koblenz. The Bayern’s crew determined that their loyalty lay with the Republic and launched an immediate counter-attack, destroying the Imperial battleship. This victory rallied the scattered Federalist forces to Thuringia at a time when many had assumed the putsch to be a fait accompli.

The rest of the Bayern’s Civil War service focused on Frankfurt, while attempting to force the Kolleda into a decisive battle. It played a key part in the Federalist Summer Offensive of 828 AS, losing much of its supporting fleet in the process. During the Imperial assault on Thuringia later that year, the Bayern formed the center of the Federalist lines. It eventually joined the Thuringian Mutiny after several Imperial crews arrested their commanders in a bid to force peace negotiations to take place. In the bitter aftermath of the Holstein Accords, the Bayern was assigned to New Berlin, where it has taken on counter-terrorism and smuggling suppression duties.

Despite this, the cost of establishing mining operations in such a remote and hazardous region as Omega-55 has deterred exploitation, with even The Core's investors balking at the proposition.

Giessen consists of a crust of mostly solid carbon believed to cover a substantial core of rock and metal. The core makes up two-thirds of its total mass.

592374.mapped:
Wichter Station was constructed in orbit of Saigon's moon Kauthara throughout the mid-820s, intended to serve as a more secluded facility to service and construct spacecraft for ALG's own use, and for commercial sale. The Sigma-15 system also serves as a valuable stepping stone for ALG into the uncontrolled worlds of the Sigmas and Omicrons, and the remote location was chosen deliberately so that the base could conduct business with entities unwelcome in Rheinland but friendly to ALG, among them the Gas Miners Guild, the Bundschuh, and according to some rumors even the Order.

Following the outbreak of the Rheinland Civil War and the resulting loss of Dortmund and occupation of Wuppertal, Wichter became the company's corporate headquarters. Its defenses were shored up and it became host to most of ALG's remaining security assets, since its loss would likely have meant the end of the company.

Since the end of the war, alertness and security have relaxed somewhat at Wichter, though a degree of paranoia is still evident in its personnel.

592377.mapped:
An arid world scoured clean by ceaseless sandstorms that wash across its surface, Pygar was discovered in 550 AS by the Bretonian exploratory vessel Fearless. During initial surveys, individual sandstorms that lasted for several years and reached top speeds of 805 km/h were observed. These hostile conditions would destroy probes within hours, dissuading further exploratory work until a Rheinland expedition arrived in 795 AS to investigate the caverns described in Cambridge's Fearless Archives. The Rheinlanders would discover a cache of live stasis Artifacts, carelessly awakening the aliens known as the Nomads and unleashing them on Sirius.

In the aftermath of the Nomad War, The Order would thoroughly explore Pygar, charting extensive cave systems but finding little more than long dead Dom'Kavash ruins and dust. The planet was of little further interest until 826 AS when Bretonia annexed the Zoner planet of Gran Canaria. Many were unwilling to accept living under House rule, and were happy to tolerate incredible hardships to secure their independence. One such group used The Order's survey data to found a small underground colony on Pygar. The raging storms overhead made it incredibly dangerous and expensive to import basic necessities, but the settlers persevered until a docking ring could be constructed. Even now, protecting the docking ring's tethers from the cutting storm winds is an enormous and costly task.

As the colony slowly grew, tensions would emerge with the Corsairs who felt the settlers were competing with their own home world for scarce local resources. Friction between the Corsairs and Theta's Zoners would continue to mount, culminating in the Corsair seizure of Freeport 9 in 831 AS. The Zoners of Pygar were quick to form armed militias in case the Corsairs turned their attention towards them, while Corfu became a rallying point for Zoner pilots enraged by this naked aggression. A core of Pygar's colonists insist they'll die before they leave, but many have already begun to emigrate back to a now free Gran Canaria to avoid entanglement in a war over Omicron Theta.

592380.mapped:
Nishiara is an outpost station established by the Golden Chrysanthemums in 823 AS after the discovery of the system by the movement. The station was built with the purpose to strengthen the movement's presence within the system, as well as to provide a staging ground for Golden Chrysanthemum patrols and reconnaissance in Sigma-59 and the surrounding systems.

It was later discovered that the station's location and relative peace was ideal for hosting conferences and meetings between Golden Chrysanthemum and Outcast representatives. Nishiara is where most discussions, agreements and debates between the Outcasts and the Golden Chrysanthemums take place, with diplomatic envoys frequently seen entering and exiting the station. As a result of this development, Nishiara is relatively well-defended by both GC patrols and Outcast escorts, and its location is normally kept untold to outsiders.

There are many security measures in place to make sure that the words muttered behind closed doors remain secret. It is rumored that the station's air circulation systems are laced with cardamine to weed out would-be spies that would try to gain access to the station and eavesdrop on meetings.

Believed to once have been a warm and green world that teemed with life, Edmonton was plunged into a glacial ice age millions of years ago. Scientists believe that the planet's orbit changed due to an ancient cataclysm, which sharply reduced the sunlight received by most of the surface. Remains of titanic primordial lifeforms were discovered preserved in the glaciers, prompting wonder and amazement among Liberty's xenobiologists. Ageira Technologies heavily funded expeditions to Edmonton from 818 AS onwards, after surviving extremophile bacteria-analogues were discovered.

Early scientific literature published on the organisms described them as "unique living computers", due to the unusual and complex manner in which colonies networked to transmit information. These papers became remarkably difficult to locate once Ageira patented the organisms and took legal action to suppress publications in breach of their "intellectual rights". It is speculated that cultivating and commercially exploiting these lifeforms was the original motivation for the construction of Leduc Station, although Ageira remains tight-lipped on the subject.

Planet Edmonton was one of the first bodies affected by the arrival of dark matter from the Kuryo Anomaly, being enveloped by the advancing storm front in 825 AS. With the arrival of the full force of the storm in 827 AS, the world has been cast into darkness, with temperatures plunging to near absolute zero. It is common consensus that all life on the planet will have been extinguished, rendering the bacterial inhabitants extinct -- save for those colonies preserved by Ageira and academic institutions.

As the storm scythes the giant's upper atmosphere away, streams of charged particles are blasted out across the system. Calgary's volume is over three times that of Beaver Creek, but its less dense core means it is only slightly heavier.

Fort McMurray was once a Liberty Rogue stronghold in the distant Alberta system. While Liberty authorities initially believed the Rogues followed Deep Space Engineering (DSE) into the system, Fort McMurray had long since been established by that point. The base was probably excavated around 812 AS, after Rogue smugglers discovered a Jump Hole to Kepler in the Peace River Asteroid Field. This opened a discreet highway between the Rogue hubs of Alcatraz and Padua, creating the wealth and excess that set the scene for the construction of the first Scylla Destroyers. McMurray existed to protect this vital supply artery, and block the expansion of the recently arrived Xenos of Ontario.

As Ageira and DSE expanded their investments in Alberta, McMurray drew in an increasingly rowdy roster of pirates and thugs. The Rogues were blamed for the destruction of Red Deer Station in 819 AS, and the bravado of McMurray's gangs made them reluctant to deny the accusation. When the LPI pulled out of the system as a result, they turned over local security to the Liberty Navy. When even this failed to curb McMurray's murder, piracy, and kidnapping, the Battleship Concord was deployed with shoot-to-kill orders. The Fort gradually became a less popular destination for raiders, as heavily armed and escorted military convoys proved difficult to tackle.

McMurray's decline was accelerated by the arrival of a wisp of the Kuryo Anomaly in 822 AS. As dark matter gradually encroached and consumed more of the system, smuggling routes became especially hazardous. By 827 AS, the highway was severed and Liberty was finalizing its retreat from the system. The remaining Rogues made a final grasp at riches by targeting evacuation and salvage operations, however their fighters were soon preyed upon by a new and unknown threat emerging from deep within the Athabasca Asteroid Field. After the last of the Rogues fled to Ontario, McMurray was systematically stripped and left desolate by unknown third parties.

Red Deer Station was built in 816 AS as a joint operation between LPI. Inc and Deep Space Engineering (DSE). DSE had recently begun surveying Alberta, and had discovered Platinum deposits in the Peace River Asteroid Field. In a departure from their regular domestic operations, the LPI were hired to provide system security across the remote Independent World. Assuming Alberta was a desolate and unpopulated system, Captain Felicity Briggs -- daughter of CEO Harlon Briggs -- was exiled from Manhattan high society to take command of the post.

DSE's assumption of being the first to explore Alberta soon proved to be unfounded, as surveyors encountered the local Zoner community of Freeport 14, and steadily escalating Liberty Rogue raids. LPI patrols quickly found themselves overwhelmed by pirate attacks, and were regularly forced to call on Navy support from Ontario. In late 819 AS, Red Deer suffered a severe explosion, killing many of the onboard crew. Official reports blamed the disaster on a Liberty Rogue attack, claiming their lasers had penetrated the hull and ignited H-Fuel stores. Red Deer was never rebuilt, and the LPI withdrew from Alberta.

While the hull does display the tell-tale scarring of laser weapons, there is no indication that these impacts penetrated the station plating. A significant rupture can be seen on the opposite side of the superstructure, seeming to originate from the B hangar. Any other remaining evidence has long since been eroded away and obliterated by the Dark Matter storm.

Huron is a lifeless, barren world in the heart of the Ontario System. Initial surveys revealed substantial mineral deposits, yet mining was deemed less economical than importing resources from Bretonia and Rheinland. In 817 AS, Liberty heavily subsidized Deep Space Engineering (DSE) to construct Toronto Station in orbit and deploy automated mining platforms planetside. This resulted in significant quantities of Iron, Platinum and other important metals being extracted over the next decade. With the end of the Gallic War, Liberty terminated its mining subsidies, prompting DSE to scale down their operations. Not long after, Liberty abandoned the system due to spiraling security costs and falling system tax revenue. Huron is now entirely silent, save for the occasional Junker or Xeno scavenging old DSE mining sites.

Originally constructed in 825 AS as the Bordeaux Orbital Terminal, Fort Monach was designed to facilitate EFL Oil & Machinery's efforts to establish mining colonies on Planet Gaia. Following the failure of the invasion of Bretonia and collapse of the Gallic Royal Navy, radical monarchists known as the Gallic Enclave seized Edinburgh. Bordeaux Orbital was rapidly expanded and fortified by the Enclave, using salvaged cannons similar to those responsible for the Battleship Ottawa's destruction. This accelerated the development of their new capital on Gaia, and presented a looming warning against rebellion for the enslaved Bretonians below.

When Bretonia invaded Edinburgh in late 827 AS, the Enclave initiated a full-scale evacuation into the northern Hebrides, before reunifying with the Gallic Confederacy. Despite suffering a decisive defeat, the Royalist splinter extremists that had been left behind refused to surrender. Using Bordeaux Orbital to hold the Bretonian population hostage, a stalemate emerged with the advancing fleet. This ended on horrifying terms when Gaian saboteurs hijacked a Royalist supply freighter on Gaia's surface, and used it to deliver a virulent bioweapon onto Bordeaux. Purportedly a new strain of flesh-liquefying Carlisle bacteria, the Gaians claimed it had been further bioengineered to dissolve space suits and breach quarantines. Shocking broadcasts from within the station depicted "scenes of hell".

The Gaians threatened further deployments of the weapon if Bretonia attempted to occupy the colonies, rather than evacuating the population to Bretonian space. Facing public outrage over leaked settlement plans, the Bretonian government was forced to concede. Once Bretonian Marines had landed and subdued the Royalist garrison, a full evacuation was initiated. Planet Gaia was formally abandoned by 829 AS, with Bordeaux's bays welded shut and stripped of exterior turrets. In the years since, the Gaians have rebranded the platform to Fort Monach, and attached broadcast satellites and weapon platforms the outer hull. It now loops grisly broadcasts of the former inhabitants' demise, as a stark warning to any who would test the Gaians' commitment to Gaia's protection.

592413.mapped:
The Uranium Processing Center stationed at LD-14 was a vital supplier of MOX to the other colonies, generating significant revenue for the Bretonian government. Despite the harsh conditions onboard, the salaries offered to those willing to serve ensured a steady supply of workers. However, the center faced frequent attacks from terrorist groups attempting to obtain weapons-grade plutonium, which added to the already hazardous working conditions. As a result, security measures were heightened.

Following a reconstruction period that lasted until 832 A.S, LD-14 is now fully operational in the Leeds system. Its reopening not only relieves fuel pressures on the house but also provides a valuable source of exports, particularly with the situation in Dublin.

592416.mapped:
Kirkwall is a small installation built by Outcasts in 805 AS inside a large asteroid field. While the once-remote Orkney system is not a part of any Cardamine routes and is not within the scope of Outcasts' economical interests, Outcast leaders wanted to have a permanent base in the system to keep an eye on the mysterious mine field, not unlike the one located in the Tau-37 system.

When the Council broke through the minefield and revealed the existence of Gallia, Kirkwall became that much more important. The potential for distributing Cardamine to Gallia was not lost on the Outcasts. However, as most of those shipments were soon routed through Genoa, Kirkwall's importance diminished considerably, to the point of a large part of the local garrison being transferred to Cali, which suddenly found itself locked between Royal Navy patrols, IMG operations, Council patrols, and Crayterian raiders.

Sensing the opportunity, the Gaians of Edinburgh and Tau-31 organised a small strike force, consisting of a number of fighters escorting a single troop transport. The force took a long and perilous route through deeper Tau systems and surprised Kirkwall's defenders by approaching from the direction of Tau-23 jumphole. The battle cost both sides heavily, as Outcast pilots stationed on the base fought the more numerous Gaian attackers to the last ship. The Gaian boarding party had more luck than their spacefaring brethren, but took a long time clearing the outpost's interior of resistance. Some of the Outcast personnel were captured and were allowed to leave on one of the few intact ships left in the hangar. Once the base was fully under Gaian control, it underwent several thorough decontamination procedures.

With a sudden incursion of Nomads plaguing Orkney, Kirkwall has become something of an observation post for any further activity in the system. Despite being an extremely valuable and concealed piece of infrastructure in this regard, this has strained the resolve of its crew and assigned pilots immensely.

592419.mapped:
Once a backwater station owned by the Independent Miners Guild, Dounby was built orbiting the resource rich Eday 801 AS. The Guild predicted the planet could be mined when asteroid showers were less frequent, but the frequent accidents and near misses made the base a risky investment.
When the Council breached Westray, opening the way to Sirius, they made contact with the Guild, revealing the realm of House Gallia. The breach left the miners tangled between Council and Royalist forces, and so operations were temporarily suspended. Later, an accord was struck between the Guild and the Gallic Crown, resuming mining operations. Harvested minerals were mostly bought out by passing Gallic freighters.
In 824 AS, the Gallic Brigands launched an attack on Dounby. The Guild was vastly overwhelmed and the installation fell to Brigand hands, who later rechristened the base to Dinard Station. Its mining equipment was jettisoned to make room for drinking, drugging, and whoring.
In 827 AS, a combined IMG and Gallic Navy force recaptured Dinard for the Guild, restoring its name to Dounby. Back under Guild administration, the station underwent extensive renovations and restructuring to serve as a primary connection to the Gallic markets.
In order to avoid fatal collisions with stray asteroids hurling towards Eday, Dounby is equiped with several engines to avoid direct impacts from the larger rocks.

While it avoided detection by the Nomads during their purge of the system, the operations onboard the station effectively ceased, and it's continued operation is being brought into question.

592454.mapped:
Built by the Junkers in the-then desolate Inverness system across the entire year of 799 AS, this sprawling underworld freeport remains the largest and most ambitious Junker space complex in Sirius. From its inception, Invergordon was intended as a discreet shipyard and trading hub for anyone willing to deal with and pay the Junkers. It owes its success largely to its distance from any of Sirius' security authorities, which provides more than satisfactory privacy for all manner of pirates and criminal elements.

It was only the permanent arrival of the mysterious and somewhat paranoid Technocrats in Inverness that disrupted this idyllic business situation for the Junkers, and from time to time there have been strained relations between the two factions. The bone of contention is primarily an ideological dispute -- the secretive Technocrats seek to make Inverness their stronghold, while the persistent Junkers provide their services to whoever is able to pay, undermining these efforts.

In the wake of the Insurgency's collapse and the final withdrawal of the Liberty Navy from the Vespucci system, the Junkers aboard Invergordon seized the opportunity to expand their grey-market shipyard services, welcoming anyone willing to pay. As tensions subsided, the growing number of serviced freelancer, pirate, Rogue, Hacker, and even Outcast vessels aboard Invergordon served as a powerful testament to the Junkers' keen sense for profit. This development has been met with disdain from not just the Technocrats, but Invergordon's close-by Zoner neighbors as well, who occasionally find their transports hijacked or completely destroyed by the scrappers' customers.

592467.mapped:
Nimes is one of the oldest installations in Languedoc, constructed in 614 AGS (698 AS) to facilitate the colonization of Planet Quillan. Over the following decades, Nimes was expanded to contain an array of habitats and factories, ensuring Quillain’s overseers, bureaucrats, and manufacturing infrastructure remained out of the reach of potentially rebellious miners. These precautions proved to be inadequate when in 733 AGS (817 AS), infiltrated Council agents orchestrated a mass uprising by Nimes’ factory workers, resulting in its overseers and garrison immediately surrendering. The so called “Bloodless Victory of Nimes” ended the First Battle of Languedoc with the system under complete Council control.

The Council's short-lived occupation of Nimes was used to coordinate an evacuation of local sympathisers into Sirius, in anticipation of the GRN counterattack that came early the following year. After several fleet delaying actions to protect the withdrawal, Nimes was abandoned as the Council retreated into the Aveyron Nebula. For the duration of the Gallic Invasion of Sirius, Nimes served as the primary supply depot for war effort, sending materiel and reinforcements towards Tau-23 and the Bretonian front. In 742 AGS (826 AS), the Gallic Crown and the GRN collapsed. In the chaotic aftermath of the Second Gallic Civil War's end, Nimes was seized by Unione Corse agents and absorbed into the Minarchy of Provence.

The Minarchy was entirely blindsided by Kusari's Invasion of Gallia in 743 AGS (827 AS), having expected Kusari to limit its attention to their rivals in the Grand Duchy of Burgundy. Nimes was pressed into service as a frontline emergency repair facility for the Gallic Confederal Navy, however Kusari's rapid advance routed the defenders and disabled the station. Nimes remained a wreck until the war's conclusion, when IDF Shipping was ordered by the newly formed Gallic Union to repair the facility as a cargo exchange for licensed Sirian merchants delivering resources from Tau-23. As of 751 AGS (835 AS), Nimes' has been allocated as an anchorage for the Battleship DeGrasse's support ships, with military goods stockpiled aboard.

592475.mapped:
A former flagship of the Gallic Royal Navy, it spearheaded the advance into Sirius, establishing a firm foothold into the Taus before retreating for repairs after clashes with the Kusari Naval Forces in the Tau-31 system.

With its advance cut short by developments else along the frontier, it was redirected to the Magellan, and later California, systems to cut off the supply route connecting Liberty and Bretonia. Though at best securing several small victories, the effect the vessel had was minimal. Nonetheless, it moved further into California months after, only to surrender to the Liberty Navy once the Kingdom of Gallia fell.

Years later, research of the technology captured continues aboard Juneau, where the Carcassonne has been carefully split into several parts for both closer examination and future use in armament testing upon the armor plating.

592481.mapped:
Constructed in 742 AGS (826 AS), Béziers was excavated into a large asteroid formation after Limoux Base was abandoned. Following the Mazagran Massacre, the Maquis were forced to evacuate many of their holdings, fearing their former Council allies would lead government assaults on their home bases. The Languedoc Maquis' misfortune was compounded the following year, when the Ile-de-France Jump Hole collapsed, largely cutting them off from the wider Maquis movement and leadership. As a result, the Languedoc cell has largely operated according to their own isolated plans.

Wounded by the Council's betrayal, Languedoc's Maquis became more radical over time, primarily concerned with toppling local system authorities. Regular raids are launched on Gallic Navy and EFL targets, both to hinder the Gallic Union's operations and steal necessary supplies. The Maquis of Béziers have been known to target the Union Corse, accusing them of treacherous collaboration with Union authorities -- this has even led to raids into Provence and the assassination of Corse representatives on Quillan. In recent years recruitment has surged, owing to EFL's crackdown on worker unions, and Béziers' public opposition to resented Corsican gangsters.

This popular sentiment provides Béziers with a trickle of donated income that can be used to barter with the Brigands and scavengers aboard Lodeve. Maquis leadership has become increasingly frustrated with the Languedoc sect, owing to their refusal to send ships or resources to support the movement's larger plans and strategies elsewhere in Gallia.

592484.mapped:
Quillan was first colonized in 615 AGS (699 AS) after prospecting revealed valuable deposits of accessible resources. The chilly, rocky world was sparsely populated by work camps, largely crewed by transitory laborers from Planets Amiens and Marne. The Gallic Metal Service received Quillan's administration under a royal charter, and were instructed to develop the frontier world's infrastructure and economic output. While GMS was notable for allowing worker unionization, and respecting peasant rights established in the aftermath of the First Gallic Civil War, the population chafed under harsh, centrally imposed royal quotas, and the abuses of the Gallic Royal Police garrison.

Most readily available surface deposits were exhausted around 701 AGS (785 AS), requiring ever more expensive and dangerous mining techniques to meet escalating quotas. By 710 AGS (794 AS), this discontent erupted into a campaign of guerrilla strikes and industrial sabotage, inspired by the Marne Uprising. Agents of both the Maquis and Council soon arrived to support the dissidents. This culminated in the First Battle of Languedoc in 733 AGS (817 AS), when the Council seized the system and landed Marines on Quillan, routing the Royal Army contingent. Warning of an inevitable royal counterattack and reprisals, the Council began evacuating willing miners to both Champagne and Sirius, significantly depopulating the colony.

The recapture of Quillan the following year was to be a lasting one, as the planet remained in royal hands until the collapse of the Monarchy in 742 AGS (826 AS). In the anarchy that followed, the Minarchy of Provence seized control of Languedoc, securing Quillan and its resources with brutal Corsican enforcers. While GMS continued to operate the mining colonies, many workers became resentful of the Unione Corse gangsters who set tithes and extorted communities. This continued until the Kusari Invasion, when the Minarchy quickly abandoned the planet as untenable. Despite this, Kusari had no interest landing troops, instead bombarding Quillan's spaceports and obvious military facilities, before instituting a blockade and moving on.

Since the formation of the Gallic Union and end of the Kusari Invasion, the GMS administration has been supplanted by EFL Oil and Machinery, to focus on the extraction of remaining Prometheum deposits. This has prompted significant unrest, as EFL immediately rolled back numerous worker rights, and by 750 AGS (834 AS) had banned many leading workers unions. This has prompted violent clashes between incensed workers and EFL security troops, with assistance by Marines from the Nimes garrison. GMS and worker representatives have raised numerous complaints with Languedoc's Signeur, Ansel Bousquet, however the military official has so far dismissed the issues.

592489.mapped:
Established by the Gallic Brigands as a fallback base many years before the Gallic Monarchy even set up trade lane infrastructure into the Languedoc system, Lavars also serves as a hub for wanted people or smugglers to venture to in search of a safe place.

The base was expanded in recent years to better fit the need of the Gallic Brigands for a station that grants them access to the deeper Taus, where they conduct trade with representatives of various other organizations, as well as lead smuggling operations into.

Since the end of the war with Kusari, a number of Junkers have also set up shop aboard, looking to use it as a safe haven for bringing cargo into Gallia and military equipment out of the House. This has raised the attention of the Gallic Navy; however, Lavars' remoteness guarantees its safety.

592494.mapped:
Montelimar is the heart of Unione Corse operations in Languedoc. Originally a Gallic Metal Service mining station established from 631 AGS (715 AS), the Lozere Asteroid Field was depleted of the most economic deposits by the late 720s. In 730 AGS (814 AS), GMS formally closed the station. It remained abandoned until Unione Corse scouts reoccupied it 4 years later, following the Gallic Royal Navy's recapture of the system from The Council. The Corse sensed a business opportunity in Languedoc, and intended to leverage corrupt contacts in the Gallic Royal Police and Gallic Royal Navy to gain access to Orkney and Sirius beyond it.

Following the construction of the Tau-23 Jump Gate in 737 AGS (821 AS), the use of the Montpellier passage for military resupply sharply decreased. As a result, it became considerably easier for Corse couriers and people smugglers to slip through with little more than a small bribe. Accordingly, Montelimar became an important meeting point and marketplace for Corsican associates with outward interests, and a place where contracts and agreements could be brokered. When the Gallic monarchy collapsed in 742 AGS (826 AS), the Kingdom immediately shattered into a number of competing states. Montelimar was the staging post from which the Minarchy of Provence surged Corsican assassins and gangsters into Languedoc.

After seizing control of Nimes and Quillan, Montelimar was no longer necessary as a command post. Despite this, it remained extremely useful for covert drug smuggling and exchanging goods with the Brigands -- activities the other Confederal states would have condemned and politically exploited. During the Kusari Invasion, Montelimar guarded the routes to the Minarchy's Provence heartland, while launching guerilla strikes on the Kusari lines following the Battle of Ales. In the years since the rise of the Gallic Union, Montelimar has come under regular attack by Languedoc's Maquis, who accuse them of collaborating with the state as thugs and assassins for hire.

592499.mapped:
Briancon Station was constructed in 695 AGS (779 AS), after Gallic Metal Service prospecting discovered rich subterranean lodes of Prometheum on Planet Quillan. Briancon was established by EFL Oil and Machinery to process raw ores into export grade Prometheum for use in fusion reactors. This refining process was both complex and time-consuming, producing radioactive Toxic Waste that was usually dumped directly into Planet Ales' atmosphere. Briancon was originally established in close proximity to Fourchambault Shipyard, to benefit from its local defenses, expedite fueling for the capital ships produced there, and to ensure refined Prometheum did not fall into the hands of potentially disloyal peasant miners on Quillan itself.

When the Council seized Languedoc in 733 AGS (817 AS), Fourchambault fell to infiltrated agents and sympathizer crew mutinies. Possessing no independent defenses of its own, Briancon promptly surrendered. By the time the Gallic Royal Navy recaptured the system the following year, The Council had destroyed most of Briancon's sensitive purification machinery. In the aftermath, Charles XI banned the refining of Prometheum in the Gallic colonies. He decreed that all fusion fuel now be produced on Aubigny, under the crown's watchful eye -- and control. Briancon was instead repurposed as an industrial smelter, breaking down the Scrap Metal left by Languedoc's industrialization, and the Second Gallic Civil War.

When the Gallic Crown collapsed in 742 AGS (826 AS), the Minarchy of Provence claimed the system. Their demands for EFL to restore the Prometheum refineries quickly stalled when the Parisian Assembly blocked attempts to export the specialist machinery needed. The following year, any such plans were abandoned with the Kusari Invasion of Gallia. Briancon was briefly occupied by Kusari and used as a storage depot, suffering minor damage from crossfire during the Confederal-Enclave counter offensive. Following the war, battle debris posed a major hazard. Disappointed with EFL's track record and costs, the Gallic Union expropriated the station in 746 AGS (830 AS), awarding the clean-up contract to ALG Waste Disposal.

The Richelieu battleships were designed around 815 AS to correct design flaws identified in the Normandie class battleships during the Second Gallic Civil War. Battleships of this class provided a blend of withering firepower and heavy armor, built around the fearsome Warwolf spinal cannons. By the time of the Gallic invasion of Sirius, the modernized Richelieus were used as the armored fist of the Gallic Royal Navy, inflicting a deadly toll during their engagements with Bretonia, Kusari and Liberty.

The Guillestre was a first generation Richelieu class that played an important role in the conclusion of the Battle of Languedoc in 818 AS. During this campaign, The Council suffered a devastating defeat, with the Guillestre receiving commendations for its destruction of the Redemption class Battleship Argenteuil. The Guillestre was later deployed as a part of the Sirian invasion’s Grand Fleet, where it inflicted heavy damage on Tau-31’s Kusari forces during the surprise attack of the 8-Day War.

After the Grand Fleet punched into Leeds, the Guillestre was withdrawn to Tau-23 to defend Gallia’s critical supply lines and keep the unruly Independent Miners Guild in check. This changed in 825 AS, when Gallia stripped rearguard garrisons as reinforcements for a planned decisive battle over New London. In this capacity, the Guillestre was pushed forward to support the Beuvray during the Battle of Dover. This months-long campaign came to a cataclysmic end when the Battleship Ottawa sprung an ambush that destroyed the Beuvray, forcing the Guillestre to retreat.

The pair would meet again during the Siege of New London the following year. Despite initially seizing control of Planet New London orbit, the tide turned when the “Trinité” flank collapsed to an Allied counter-attack. Immediately going on the offensive, the Guillestre sought revenge on the Ottawa, but was instead obstructed by an already damaged Gettysburg. While this opponent was quickly dispatched, the Guillestre was brought down in turn by its old rivals the MacDuff and Ottawa. The hulk was shunted to the newly constructed Belvedere Refinery later that year, with deconstruction completed in 830 AS.
592502.mapped:
One of the newest battleships of the Richelieu class, Guillestre has played an important role in the numerous battles for Languedoc that the Gallic Royal Navy decisively won in 808-812 AS, practically taking the system away from the Council's control. Configured as a strike craft carrier, Guillestre has less direct firepower then the Normandie class ships, but the numerous fighter wings it deploys are more suitable to cover friendly ships and harrass enemy fleet formations.

Previously assuming the role of the role of a rear guard vessel in Tau-23 to defend against the critical supply line to Bretonia and keep the unruly Independent Miners Guild in check at Java station, the Guillestre has since been retasked with protecting the Leeds flank of the Bretonia front. While this has left the Tau-23 logistical artery vulnerable to attack, Gallic naval command feared a Liberty Navy breakthrough in the Independent Worlds was a more pressing concern given the shortening timetable for the final battle above Bretonia's capital world.

The Aveyron Nebula is one of the distinctive red clouds that frame Languedoc. Once the site of a heavily guarded Royal Navy supply passage into the Hebrides, the Aveyron was largely abandoned following the construction of the Tau-23 Jump Gate. The nebula's notoriously poor visibility, hazardous conditions, and heavy Brigand and Maquis activity has deterred any further attempts by the Gallic Metal Service to survey the field for resources.
