A planet of immense size and gravitation, Tonnerre is the center of the explored portion of the Burgundy system. Located between two stars, this gas giant is not only the largest planet in all Gallia (and possibly in all Sirius), but also has the largest system of rings that occupies a large part of the system. Tonnerre has four large moons - Clamency, Auxerre, Marigny, and Saulieu – caught in orbit around it, though the immense gravitation of Tonnerre influences all other solar bodies in this portion of Burgundy to some extent.

Constructed in 527 A.G.S. to cater to the growing needs of the Gallic Metal Service, Alesia quickly established itself as the company's main supply line to their extensive operations in both Burgundy and Lorraine, and accommodated a significant portion of its local management staff. Despite its relatively modest size compared to other Gallic corporate-owned stations, Alesia has undergone numerous upgrades and expansions throughout the years.

GMS has faced numerous lobbying attempts from various governmental entities seeking to utilize the station for law enforcement and security activities. However, these requests have largely been met with firm refusals, even in the aftermath of the military invasion from Kusari and repeated raids on the station by Royalist and Maquis forces.

Today, Alesia offers executive suites for its top-level staff and offices for representatives seeking to engage in business with the corporate giant, though due to the withdrawal of operations in Lorraine and the heavy unlawful presence in Burgundy these facilities see less use than they did in the recent past.

The Tercio is one of the newest battlecruisers manufactured at the Corsica Shipyard. Like its considerably newer sister ship, the Augusta, the Tercio has been modified to serve as a mobile operational base rather than a pure assault ship.

Tercio has spent most of its active service in the Sigma sectors, primarily serving as a coordination base for Outcast raiders aimed at disrupting the operations of GMG, Cryer, and the Corsairs, including their trade partners involved in the artifact trade. The Slave Revolt on planet Malta in 831 AS did not alter its mission, so unlike other warships, Tercio has no significant victories to its name.

This changed towards the end of 833 AS when the battlecruiser Augusta managed to penetrate from Omicron Theta into the Sigma 17 system with a singular purpose - the destruction of the Atka Research Station. This critical task for Malta forced Tercio to move forward and assist its newer sister ship in the mission as fast as it could, suffering minor damage from confused and surprised GMG and Bounty Hunter patrols in the process.

592522.mapped:
Built by the Royal Navy in 575 A.G.S, Avallon was critical in safeguarding early expansion into the Gallic Border Worlds, and was home to significant contingents from both the Royal Navy and Royal Police. During the Second Gallic Civil War the station was important in protecting the system from the Council, helping to secure Burgundy’s extensive trade lane network, and to this day is the primary base from which patrols operate in counter piracy operations.

With the war ending and the Montmorency now more focused on operations against the Maquis and Royalists in the system, Avallon has become the main focus of the newly formed Gendarmerie within Burgundy, and has seen several expansions to better suit their needs. This includes a small prison facility to hold captured criminals until they can be transferred to Ile-de-France, as well as repair facilities capable of servicing the Perilous and Taureau class vessels popular with their forces.

Avallon also hosts the local IDF Shipping offices, which have seen increased traffic as their ships tend to be hit less frequently by the Royalists present in the system, making them an increasingly popular choice to carry goods back towards the Core Worlds.

592526.text:
DIAMETER: 12,717 km
MASS: 6.07 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -12°C to 55°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.47 km/sec
592526.mapped:
A warm oceanic world placed on a wide orbit around the gas giant Tonnerre, Nevers was the first colonized moon in the Gallic Border Worlds. A high property cost did not provide a sufficient incentive for citizens to move to the planet, and the lack of easily accessible mineral deposits only made Nevers less attractive for further industrial development. In spite of this, unique types of soil on some of the larger islands proved useful for winemaking, that, along with the oceans that are well suited for the introduction of some species of fish from old Earth, among which bluefin tuna and marlin, made Nevers substantial supplier of food for the nearby stations and other colonies. Moreover, conditions on the surface were regarded by many as pleasant and thus led to an extensive tourist industry developing, second only to that on planet Marseille.

Protection of Nevers was handed over as the main task of the nearby Avallon Fortress, that, in its many years since construction, has been the home base of a significant garrison of soldiers and pilots -- and it remained so even after the downfall of the monarchy. Though the former regime fell, the Confederacy brought upon Nevers the role of serving as a capital: that of the Duchy of Burgundy. Its role was amply tested during the invasion of Gallia by Kusari, in which the small moon served as a near-frontline staging point for fleets. While not directly attacked, it remained a thorn in the invaders' side during the decisive moments of the battle for Burgundy.

Although it was a regional capital for only a handful of years, the chaos that ensued after the failure of the Royal Navy in Sirius further led to the nobility of Gallia, at large, to resettle on the moon. This trend continues well to this day, and, although it is now facing an influx of tourists rather than disgruntled aristocracy, Nevers remains a prosperous world in Gallia's distant regions -- even as the threat of Maquis raids looms ever-closer, owning in part due to the moon's role as a center for the nobility in the Union.

The population of the planet has swelled in recent years, as refugees from Planet Metz in Lorraine were relocated primarily to Nevers following the abandonment of the system as it became unviable and a drain on the Gallic economy.

A small airless moon on the orbit of Planet Beaune. Astronomers presume that Le Creusot, like Beaune, was once one of the numerous moons of Planet Tonnerre.

592532.text: Morvan was once a thriving mining field within Gallia, with miners based out of Alesia prospecting the field in early Gallic history, however with the depletion of resources from the field and abandonment of Alesia, the field now serves as a hideout for criminal elements from which to pounce on traders.

592534.text:
CLASS: Bonaparte
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 470
592534.mapped:
Located in the depths of the Nievre Asteroid Field, Macon was deemed to be an ideal location to establish the first base of operations of the Council in Burgundy. A safe position within the field guaranteed that Royalist warships would be unable to attack it directly, while numerous fighter wings ensured that lighter patrols would not pose a significant risk. By the end of the war, the Royal Navy was well aware of Macon's existence, but hesitant to expend the men and ships necessary to destroy it.

Macon became a point of contention during peace talks between the Duchy and Republique. The Council did not see the sense in maintaining a covert base, and the Duchy were not comfortable leaving it abandoned, fearing a hostile power may occupy the facility.

It was eventually decided that Macon would be handed over to the newly formed Gallic National Intelligence. Even better defended today than it was during the years of the Second Gallic Civil War, the Saint-Remy nebula is off limits to all unauthorized traffic. Macon is rumored to be a test bed for cutting edge military technologies, including experimental ship designs, which see OPEVAL with GNI forces first before being passed down to the Gallic Navy and Gendarmerie.

592536.text:
CLASS: Orsini
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 440
592536.mapped:
Formerly a Hussier installation known as Lixheim, Bourbon was seized by the local Unione Corse in 587 A.G.S. with all of the station's inhabitants being killed in the brief but brutal fighting aboard. While the exact motivation behind the attack is unknown, and was uncharacteristic because of the two groups normally amicable status, there are long standing rumors that it was in retaliation for the death of a prominent member of the Unione Corse at the hands of one of the local Hussiers.

Since then, the Unione Corse have turned Bourbon into their primary smuggling route through northern Gallia, formerly using the now abandoned Lorraine system to smuggle goods through, but more recently using it as a back route into the Taus that is much less patrolled in comparison to the more southerly routes. This has put them in a strong position locally, having almost total control over all illicit goods flowing in and out of Burgundy.

CREW: 620
592539.mapped:
Formerly the largest Hussier installation in Gallia, Bourg-en-Bresse was often considered the center of their operations. In 737 A.G.S. a hijacked Hussier transport carrying a group of Maquisard agents attempted to moor with the station, fortunately for those aboard the station redundant cargo scans revealed the agents presence, and the ship was destroyed shortly before it could dock.

Having avoided the fate of their brethren on Lixheim, the Hussiers knew their time was numbered, quickly moving to sell their facility to the highest bidder and finding that in EFL. With the previous owners having already done the heavy lifting of making the station into the local repository for all goods entering or leaving the system, EFL has used the space port to help alleviate logistics issues with their relatively small local transport fleet. The station also has some small industrial capability, mostly only producing enough to keep the station itself operational, though EFL has been looking into expanding these facilities.

>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The Ardennes is the last remaining field still mined in Champagne. The resource starved Gallic core systems often complain that GMS is artificially slowing their mining here to gouge on pricing; in reality, the richest deposits were exhausted in earlier centuries, forcing GMS to resort to less lucrative, more labor-intensive claims. Many suspect the only reason GMS maintains the operation is to avoid worsening violent unrest on Marne.

592543.text:
DIAMETER: 10,870 km
MASS: 6.54 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Ice
TEMPERATURE: -147°C to -59°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.16 km/sec

Sedan is an icy world of glaciers and rocky crags. While the surface is inhospitable and harsh, Gallic Metal Service surveyors found rich mineral lodes deep underground. While these finds were initially ignored, the depletion of Champagne’s asteroid fields and gradually rising costs of mining on Planet Marne prompted GMS to reconsider. By 706 AGS (790 AGS), plans had been drawn up to establish domed mining colonies, however preliminary works were derailed by the eruption of the Second Gallic Civil War in 716 AGS (800 AS).

Following the war's end in 742 AGS (826 AS), GMS was quick to express interest in resuming development of a mining operation on Sedan. In one of the most symbolic moments of the short-lived Gallic Republic, the superstructure of Planet Marne's secondary docking ring -- constructed to service "undesirable" traffic bound for lower class districts -- was dismantled and relocated to Sedan. The project then stalled after failing to attract additional investors, primarily due to the instability of the Gallic Confederacy and chaos of the later Kusari Invasion.

After several attempts to restart the project, GMS’ plans for Sedan were dealt a fatal blow by the Treaty of Oerlikon in 749 AGS (833 AS). The sudden flood of cheap Rheinland minerals onto the Gallic markets left the projected costs of Sedan looking deeply uncompetitive. After 3 years of unsuccessfully lobbying the Gallic Union for subsidies and funding, GMS eventually shuttered the project.

Rethel is a rocky moon with low gravity and a thin, rarefied atmosphere. Early surveys found little of interest, with the moon primarily being used as a dump for Toxic Waste generated by the various projects associated with Planet Sedan.

592547.text:
DIAMETER: 5,228 km
MASS: 2.77 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Ice
TEMPERATURE: -88°C to -46°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 4.11 km/sec

Vouziers is a small moon that is notable for its polar deposits of pure Water ice. Prior to the Second Gallic Civil War, extraction limits were imposed on ice miners to ensure that Planet Marne remained reliant on out-of-system Water imports. The Council made heavy use of Vouziers’ Water supplies throughout the war -- a practice the Gallic Metal Service has continued and expanded to this day.

592549.text:
CLASS: Augustus
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 720
592549.mapped:
Reims was built by EFL Oil and Machinery in 643 AGS (559 AS), initially to prospect Planet Sezanne’s moons for potential Hydrocarbon deposits. While these efforts were eventually abandoned, Reims was quickly repurposed as a shipping depot for goods imported from Picardy. Due to laws prohibiting their local construction, EFL were able to charge substantial fees to import Industrial Machinery and Mining Machinery to Planet Marne. As the planet’s population continued to grow over the following century, Reims also began to excavate Water from Vouziers. This was also characteristically sold at an extreme markup, supplementing reserves imported from Picardy.

In 716 AGS (800 AS), the Marne Pacification Fleet was dispatched to Champagne to bombard rebel cities into submission. As the fleet entered orbit, The Council launched their attack on Reims -- the first significant naval action of the Second Gallic Civil War. Their attempt to cut the lines of retreat for survivors of the Pacification Fleet met with partial success, and Reims itself was taken following several bloody boarding actions by green Council Marines. Until the Council’s complete capture of Champagne in 720 AGS (804 AS), Reims was utilized as a forward staging point for attacks on the Picardy Jump Gate.

For the rest of the war, Reims serviced smugglers shipping much needed goods from Provence and the Gallic core systems. It also resumed Water ice harvesting from Vouziers -- now without the artificial production caps imposed by the crown. In the aftermath of the war, the Gallic Republic sold the station to the Gallic Metals Service (GMS), who have continued to operate Water miners in a never-ending struggle to alleviate Marne’s chronic Water shortages. Despite fears that the Gallic Union will re-impose extraction caps on Vouziers, GMS has so far been allowed to work as they see fit.

592552.mapped: Epernay is a pirate installation with strong links to the Gallic Brigands which was is as a staging ground for raids against EFL and GMS convoys bound for the Gallic Core. The base was originally a staging point for mining operations within the field, however as strip mining depleted all known resources the base was abandoned. 592555.text:
DIAMETER: 11,548 km.
MASS: 6.27 x 10e25 kg.
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: -43°C to 49°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.90 km/sec
592555.mapped:
Marne is a densely populated industrial world that holds more than three quarters of the Gallic border worlds’ population. Colonized in 422 AGS (506 AS), the planet’s abundance of ores and Hydrocarbons immediately attracted the attention of EFL Oil and Machinery (EFL) and the Gallic Metal Service (GMS). Marne’s population boomed thanks to misleading promotional campaigns, economic decline in Picardy, and the freedom of movement won for serfs through the First Gallic Civil War. Upon arriving, hopeful workers discovered endless rows of bleak dormitories and factories, rather than the green cities they had been promised. Many had exhausted their savings to migrate, and then found themselves ensnared in exploitative labor contracts designed to prevent their departure.

The Gallic Crown’s primary interest in Marne was ensuring the flow of resources to the Gallic core systems. Accordingly, the Royal Police garrison solely concerned itself with the protection of industry, and the breaking up of protests that could impact productivity -- residents were left to fend for themselves. This resulted in organized crime flourishing, with the Gallic Brigands becoming deeply rooted across Marne by enforcing their own protection rackets. For more than two centuries, tensions grew as a result of crime, poor working conditions, and deeply corrupt royal officials.

In 636 AGS (720 AS), King Louis IV outlawed the Gallic Liberation Movement -- a democratic reformist bloc in the Estate General. Marne’s strong republican sentiments drove protesters to the streets, where they faced immediate and brutal repression by Gallic Marines. The Council arose from this violence -- a secret society that espoused liberal political ideas, and a vision for a democratic Gallic republic. The Council’s ideology rapidly spread across Marne, and was quickly exported off-world, taking root among serfs, radical intellectuals, and idealistic young naval officers. 22 years later, Maquis extremists were expelled from The Council, who had disavowed them for their use of ruthless terror tactics on Marne.

As Marne sank into political chaos, the crown throttled the import of Food and Water to Champagne, providing supplies only when export quotas of minerals to the Gallic core systems were met. Unfortunately, centuries of intense industrial activity had depleted many of the most accessible deposits. In 706 AGS (790 AS), an internal GMS report was leaked that set out the scale of the problem. Workers’ unions feared further backsliding on safety rules, or famines from missed export quotas. One such shortfall resulted in mass hunger in 710 AGS (794 AS) -- the enraged workers declared a general strike. Marne’s refineries fell silent. This time, The Council were ready for Marine reprisals -- the Marne Uprising began.

By 716 AGS (800 AS), it became clear that the crown was about to lose control of Marne. King Louis XI dispatched the "Marne Pacification Fleet", with orders to bomb rebel settlements into submission. As the fleet entered orbit, Council double-agents mutinied and seized control of many ships. The Second Gallic Civil War erupted, with The Council declaring Marne the capital of the revolution in 719 AGS (804 AS). Marne’s citizens were initially elated, providing much of the manpower and industry that sustained The Council’s war effort. Despite this, reforms were mild, with The Council failing to take significant action against the Brigand gangs that had plagued Marne for centuries.

Almost three decades of war took their toll on the planet and wider system, which has suffered intense rationing and hardship. Following these sacrifices, many of the population felt betrayed by the compromises that created the Gallic Confederacy in 742 AGS (826 AS), and the Gallic Union the year after that. As a result, its population are fiercely independent, resentful of New Paris' central authority, and wary of returning Gallic corporations. This resentment has only been exacerbated by Maquis agitation, and recent trade deals with Rheinland which have resulted in many job losses to imported minerals. The Gallic Union is now having to carefully consider how to deal with the troublesome world, which appears to be once again balanced on a political knife-edge.

592558.text:
CLASS: Valliere
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 750
592558.mapped:
Chalons-en-Champagne was built in Planet Marne's orbit in 625 AGS (709 AS), serving as a cargo transfer station for all imports and exports to the Gallic core systems. Tight control over the flow of goods was used as a method of control by the Gallic crown, and as a means of discouraging strike actions or industrial sabotage on Planet Marne. Despite earnest pleas by GMS against adopting the policy, King Louis “The Brute” introduced a new quota system following widespread unrest on Marne in 636 AGS (720 AS). This tied the quantity of Food and Water imported into Champagne to targets for mineral exports to the core systems.

As unrest, crime, and poverty continued to spiral out of control on Marne, Chalons-en-Champagne received significant habitat expansions to house corporate officers and local aristocrats in the luxury they were accustomed to. In the eyes of these elites, the walled community of Chalons-en-Champagne neatly resolved the aesthetic issues caused by the suffering below. By the time of the fall of the Marne Pacification Fleet and the outbreak of the Second Gallic Civil War in 716 AGS (800 AS), many of the station’s residents had already fled to Picardy. Chalons-en-Champagne’s crew promptly surrendered rather than face a bloody boarding action by The Council.

The station was then converted into a makeshift shipyard, and used as accommodation for senior Council officers. As a result of various extensions and refits, Chalons became one of the few facilities capable of maintaining and repairing the Councils’ Redemption-class battleships. Since the end of the civil war and the Kusari Invasion, the station’s makeshift nature and the weaker market for new military construction have made it largely redundant. In 744 AGS (828 AS), the Gallic Metals Service resumed control of the station as a scrappage yard for heavily damaged or obsolete warships. In recent years, it has also expanded into the repair of transports arriving from the perilous Alsace Passage.

592561.text:
DIAMETER: 16,981 km.
MASS: 14.52 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: -14°C to 129°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 16.22 km/sec

Planet Sezanne is a scorching, rocky world that is believed to be one of the most massive terrestrial planets in the Sirius sector. This has made it a notable object of interest for Gallic astronomic research, and an eye-catching landmark for traffic traveling through the system. Sezanne remains largely unexplored, after a cursory Gallic Metal Service survey in 433 AGS (517 AS) determined the crushing gravity and high temperatures would render any mining attempt uneconomical.

592562.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD<<<
The heart of Champagne’s industry between 426 - 684 AGS (510 - 768 AS), Aube has long since been depleted of useful resources. The field is littered with industrial wreckage, and clouds of acid from the practice of “remining” in later years. The area is now a hotbed of criminal activity, with Gallic authorities warning of Gallic Brigand, Maquis, and Royalist sightings.

592564.text:
CLASS: Francisci
GRAVITY: Unknown
DOCKING: Unknown
AMENITIES: Unknown
CREW: Unknown

Joinville Base once belonged to the Unione Corse, hidden deep within the Seine Nebula. Believed to have been established around 530 AGS (615 AS), Joinville was used to host secretive meetings away from prying eyes. These liaisons were often held to negotiate assassination contracts for targets across the Gallic border worlds, or to extort concessions out of blackmailed aristocrats from Planet Marne. The station hosted only a modest contingent of ships, which were used for rare, lightning-fast strikes -- often against the Huissiers.

Following the Kusari Invasion of Gallia in 743 AGS (827 AS), Joinville was largely abandoned as the Minarchy called up all available Unione Corse pilots to aid in the defense of Languedoc. Not long after, all contact with Joinville was lost. Corse scouts were dispatched to investigate early the following year, discovering a bloodbath where the skeleton crew had been massacred. The investigators were then driven off by the radical Gallic Enclave holdouts that soon became known as the Gallic Royalists.

Several additional Corse expeditions towards Joinville have been attempted since then, with each either vanishing entirely, or repulsed by Gallic Royalists after taking heavy casualties. Accordingly, the patricians of Monaco have written Joinville off as lost.
592564.mapped: An installation of the Unione Corse hidden within the Seine Nebula. In strict adherence to their own modus operandi, the Corsicans use Joinville for those meetings in Champagne too secret or too important to be conducted planetside. It houses a modest contingent of ships, used in those rare, lightning-fast strikes conducted by the Unione Corse on very specific targets.

592567.text:
DIAMETER: 5,001 km
MASS: 3.47 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 14°C to 99°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 7.90 km/sec

Planet Langres is a volcanic world with a thin, sulfurous atmosphere. EFL Oil and Machinery briefly hosted an extraction operation on the world, harvesting chemicals and gases. The camps were abandoned early in the Second Gallic Civil War, and without ongoing maintenance, were quickly destroyed by hostile conditions.

Langres was the site of a major battle in 725 AGS (809 AS), when the Gallic Royal Navy launched a surprise invasion of Champagne from the Seine Nebula. The fleet was scattered by Council and Maquis ambushes, before being decisively defeated near Planet Langres by the garrison fleets of Planet Marne and the Picardy Jump Gate.

592569.text:
CLASS: Désix
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 700
592569.mapped:
Sournia Repair Yards is currently the largest and most important space installation of the Maquisards, being a giant space dry dock with associated workshops and simpler foundries. While it prevents the construction of a completely new spaceship, it allows for the repair of even very badly damaged Maquis ships that would otherwise have to be scuttled and abandoned.

Its origins date back to 831 AS, when all the jump holes in the Lorraine system collapsed, allowing the Maquisards to concentrate their forces in the southwestern parts of Gallia. Despite the use of knowledge gained from the remains of Issoudun in Orkney, the construction of such a massive space installation was by no means easy for the Maquisards. Sournia was immediately plagued by several structural flaws, the main one being the construction of the main beams, which have proven to be of sub-standard quality. Less than a year after they were built, they have already developed micro-cracks with the potential to compromise the structural integrity of the drydock itself in the future. Replacing them, however, is no longer economically or technically feasible, and so this is a weakness that the Maquisards will have to reckon with.

Because Sournia is structurally weaker than it should be due to these major internal defects, the Maquisards have been forced to commit more men and ships to its own protection - even at the cost of less comfort for all aboard the Sournia, where personal privacy is something virtually unheard of.

592572.text:
CLASS: Petrucci
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Full
CREW: 890
592572.mapped:
Canberra Star City is the capital and first successful colony of Natio Octavarium. Originally built by an unknown third-party for officially unknown purposes, Canberra was easily transitioned to civilian life thanks to its extensive life support systems, powerful reactor, and sheer scale. Docking is open to almost everyone in Sirius, so long as they haven't committed an offense against Natio Octavarium, resulting in a thriving marketplace catering to travelers of all stripes.

While there are regular visits from pirates and smugglers, Natio Octavarium has put considerable work and money into securing the safety of their citizens and visitors. As a result, Canberra has developed a reputation as a "gateway to the underworld" - your first stop if you need goods or services of a less-than-legal nature.

592578.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATION HAZARD<<<

This large debris field formed over the centuries through industrial dumping from Fourchambault Shipyard and Nimes Station. This practice has continued unabated, despite Union authorities passing laws prohibiting further dumping. Prosecutions against individual workers rather than the companies whose orders they were obeying has caused significant anger on Quillan, with local unions launching strikes in solidarity for this perceived injustice.

592581.text:
>>>WARNING: NAVIGATION HAZARD<<<

The Saint-Hippolyte Nebula is one of the distinctive red clouds that frame Languedoc. The nebula is infamous for its difficult conditions, characterised by gravitational hazards, dampened sensors, and dense pockets of asteroids. Heavy Maquis patrols are known to attack any who venture into the nebula, with Gallic Union officials speculating that they may have constructed a replacement facility, following the destruction of Limoux Base.

592583.text:
The Toulouse Orbital Debris Field is a notorious cloud of wreckage in the Roussillon system. The field did not come into being from any one event; rather, it was formed by the gradual accumulation of Royalist, Council, and Maquisard wrecks, as well as the odd Sirian ship that happened to be in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The harsh environment of Roussillon makes any attempts to clean up and develop the Toulouse field nearly impossible. Periodically, explosions rumble through the field as the residual explosives within the amassed wreckage slowly destabilize and spontaneously detonate.

Both the Maquisards and Royalists regularly patrol the Toulouse field. The cloud not only shields their own vessels from their rivals but also holds potentially coveted weapons and valuable technology for both factions.

592585.text:
CLASS: Gulf
GRAVITY: Complete
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 220
592585.mapped:
Lodeve Space Port was constructed by The Huissiers in 586 AGS (670 AS). The Huissiers were formed from minor noble houses during the First Gallic Civil War, receiving hereditary charters as royal spies with broad privileges and autonomy. They were the only citizens sanctioned by the Crown to leave Gallia, and carried out infiltration missions throughout the colonies of Sirius. Lodeve was first created as a refuelling station for deep space flights into the Taus. The discovery of the Orkney connection to the Taus in 651 AGS (735 AS) sharply escalated the scale of Languedoc flights, with many Huissier lodges using the Jump Hole shortcut to corruptly enrich themselves by smuggling illicit Sirian goods back to Gallia's gray markets.

After the Invasion of Sirius commenced, King Charles XI became increasingly paranoid and suspicious of the Huissiers, goaded on by their rivals in Gallic Royal Intelligence. Believing the Huissier's wealth, independence, and unfettered access to Sirius promised imminent treachery, he voided their Charters of Enforcement in 738 AGS (822 AS), withdrawing all royal patronage and protection. The occupants of Lodeve scattered, fearing GRI, Unione Corse, or Maquis attacks after massacres occurred elsewhere. Lodeve was abandoned until 742 AGS (826 AS), when the Minarchy of Provence seized the system. Unione Corse agents restored the station, to skim from the smugglers running between the Aveyron and Saint-Hippolyte Nebulas.

The following year, Kusari's shock invasion of Languedoc blindsided the Minarchy. Lodeve was quickly adopted as a fleet anchorage by the Gallic Confederal Navy, however the Kusari Naval Forces successfully drove them out during the Battle of Sete. The invading forces used Lodeve as a forward fueling station, but were repelled in turn by the newly formed Gallic Union by year's end. Sabotaged during the retreat, Lodeve was again abandoned until 745 AGS (829 AS), when a group of disgruntled ex-EFL scrappers and Sirian Tau freelancers collaborated to repair it as a freeport and salvage yard. A burgeoning black market is now growing aboard, servicing Brigands, Corse, Maquis and even Sirian smugglers.

592587.text:
Located in the depths of the Nievre Asteroid Field, Macon was deemed to be an ideal location to establish the first base of operations of the Council in Burgundy. A safe position within the field guaranteed that Royalist warships would be unable to attack it directly, while numerous fighter wings ensured that lighter patrols would not pose a significant risk. By the end of the war, the Royal Navy was well aware of Macon's existence, but hesitant to expend the men and ships necessary to destroy it.

Macon became a point of contention during peace talks between the Duchy and Republique. The Council did not see the sense in maintaining a covert base, and the Duchy were not comfortable leaving it abandoned, fearing a hostile power may occupy the facility.

It was eventually decided that Macon would be handed over to the newly formed Gallic National Intelligence. Even better defended today than it was during the years of the Second Gallic Civil War, the Saint-Remy nebula is off limits to all unauthorized traffic. Macon is rumored to be a test bed for cutting edge military technologies, including experimental ship designs, which see OPEVAL with GNI forces first before being passed down to the Gallic Navy and Gendarmerie.

592589.text:
CLASS: Charlemagne
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592589.mapped:
Battleship Hossegor was the newest addition to the Confederacy's fleet, and represented a new class of warships made in favor of ship-to-ship armaments compared to older models.

Although new, the Hossegor received both new and experienced crew members – with most being veterans conscripted after Kusari's invasion of Gallia. Training was conducted in Ile-de-France, where it also spent a portion of its short service.

The warship, alongside the Cassard and various smaller vessels of the Confederacy's forces, led some of the bravest counterattacks against the encroaching Naval Forces. In this struggle, the Hossegor suffered massive damage, and had to be sent for repairs in Ile-de-France.

Though repairs were conducted, and the vessel served for several months as Languedoc's protector, it was chosen to instead scrap the Hossegor, a task for which it was sent to Rambouillet's dry docks.

592591.text: The Aisne was once mined for its sparse but valuable deposits of precious metals. These were exhausted nearly two centuries ago, making the Aisne the first of Champagne’s fields to be depleted and abandoned. Gallic Brigands, Maquis, and Unione Corse ships are often sighted in the area.

592592.text: The Seine is a large, grey nebula and ice field. Early surveys found that Water made up a relatively low percentage of the asteroids’ composition, and what little was present was expensive to extract and purify. The nebula also interferes with sensors and navigation equipment, creating hazardous conditions within. In the present day, Gallic Royalists, Maquis, and Gallic Brigands are frequently sighted within.

592598.text:
CLASS: Storta
CREW: Unknown
ARMAMENT: Unknown
592598.mapped:
Built in 833 AS, the destroyer Quezon is a newly constructed Storta-class vessel deployed to Tau-44 with the primary objective of helping the Outcasts establish a Cardamine foothold in Gallia.

For the past decade and a half, the Outcasts have attempted to establish trade partnerships in Gallia but have faced difficulties in opening a new market within the recently discovered House. Despite these challenges, they have found a network of undesirables willing to trade in Cardamine, presenting a business opportunity they deem worth the risk.

As a result, the Quezon was deployed to Tau-44, serving as a resupply and refueling warship while also providing support for Cardamine shipments into Gallia. Though the scale of these shipments is small, making a strong first impression is crucial for expanding the Cardamine trade. The thick nebula in which the destroyer is concealed allows it to frequently use the element of surprise to ambush unsuspecting hostile vessels - primarily Crayter forces - and eliminate them.

592601.text:
WARNING: MINES DETECTED

The Languedoc Minefield was deployed by the Gallic Union in 745 AGS (829 AS), in response to the earlier Kusari Invasion. Many Council veterans of the Second Gallic Civil War have expressed discomfort with the measure, believing it signals backsliding into the isolationist and xenophobic policies of the deposed Gallic Kingdom. Despite this, Union officials insist that mining Gallia’s Tau borders and imposing strict checkpoints is essential to deterring aggression by Bretonia, Crayter, and Kusari.

592603.text: Long ago a small portion of the Bermejo cloud was split off from the main mass. Unexpectedly, a local gravitational anomaly caused the seperated section to form into its own roughly sphere shaped cloud. Dubbed the Guiana Cloud, the cloud's primary feature is its unique shape. Like the Bermejo Cloud it is highly refractive and difficult to navigate, yet ships can still occasionally be seen entering and exiting the diminutive cloud.

592617.text: This Jump Gate is sealed for all unauthorized ships.

592619.text: A satellite built for temporary storage of goods and materials during space transportation.

592621.text:
CLASS: Unalaska
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: 830
592621.mapped:
Cold Bay was built near Planet Atka in 816 AS, being the first step in a terraforming project ordered by the Liberty government. Rheinland discovered this base soon after and demanded its immediate deconstruction, fearing Liberty would unilaterally annex the system. Liberty refused to comply with this order, contributing to the outbreak of the Hudson War the following year. Planetform evacuated the station to avoid the fighting, only returning in 820 AS after Liberty had expelled Rheinland from the Independent Worlds and occupied the system.

Since then, Planetform has begun stage 1 terraforming works, constructing several orbital mirrors to reflect light down to the frozen planet. Cold Bay also began to import Terraforming Gasses to thicken Atka’s atmosphere and trap additional heat. This was complicated by wartime sanctions applied by Rheinland that prohibited Planetform from entering their territory or importing ALG Terraforming Gasses. While carrying out later geographic survey works, Planetform scientists identified a primitive bacteria living on Atka’s glaciers.

Working in partnership with Cryer and Synth Foods, the bacteria’s novel cell properties led to the development of bioengineered Xenobiotic Filters, which began commercial production in 822 AS. Planetform suspects that the bacteria will be driven to extinction relatively early in the terraforming process, and has accordingly attempted to develop artificial cultures aboard Cold Bay to ensure long term access. Planetform hopes that the Atka project will hit its first major milestone within the next decade.

CLASS: La Hire
GRAVITY: No
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 0

GMS built Remoulins Station in the shadow of Planet Aude in 620 AGS (704 AS). Initially used as a fuel relay for transports traveling between Ile-de-France and the mining colony on Planet Quillan, GMS later expanded the station to facilitate Iron mining in the scorching Nyons Belt. During the Second Gallic Civil War, the Crown compelled Remoulins to host a Royal Navy garrison. When The Council invaded Languedoc in 732 AGS (816 AS), Remoulins was identified as key target to cut the southern Montpellier fleet's supply lines. After a fierce battle, the station's fuel tanks were hit by a torpedo and catastrophically exploded.

It has long been suspected that GMS were tipped off by The Council shortly before the attack, as their personnel were evacuated mere days before. Following the GRN's reconquest of Languedoc in 734 AGS (818 AS), GMS decided against rebuilding Remoulins. The need for fuel relays has been considerably diminished by the completion of the Trade Lane network, while mining expeditions into the Nyons are now launched directly from Quillan and Nimes. Much of Remoulins' wreckage has since burned up in Aude's atmosphere.

592626.text:
DIAMETER: 4,780 km
MASS: 3.1 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: 284°C to 420°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 6.20 km/sec

A hot, barren planet in the heartland of Languedoc. Agne was the site of numerous bloody battles during the Second Gallic Civil War, and Kusari invasion of Gallia. Many crashed warships now score its surface, while showers of smaller debris regularly burn up in its atmosphere.

592628.text:
DIAMETER: 5,180 km
MASS: 3.4 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: -70°C to 82°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 6.85 km/sec

Vertus is an arid, barren moon. It closely orbits the massive Planet Sezanne, with the crust cracking due to the intense tidal forces. This has resulted in networks of deep fissures and fractures, some over two kilometers deep. Landing ships on the moon’s surface can be dangerous due to its structural instability.

592630.text:
DIAMETER: 8,417 km
MASS: 7.10 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: 24°C to 88°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.65 km/sec

A lifeless desert world in Orkney that lacks any valuable mineral deposits, Vitre is located not far from the Jump Hole leading to the Tau-23 system.

592632.text:
CLASS: Bergen
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: Unknown
592632.mapped:
Once a Kruger mining facility, Wedel was one of dozens of expensive Alsterfeld operations abandoned in the wake of the 80-Years War. The station was partially restored by the Unioners in 805 AS and used for raids on Alster Shipyard and Planet Hamburg. Wedel’s role as a smuggling hub would evolve over time, with the Unioners embedding themselves as middle-men in Rheinland’s black market. For years the Unioners managed a dangerous but profitable balancing act, smuggling both Hessian Diamonds and Corsair Artifacts out into the Liberty border worlds. In 826 AS this deception came crashing down, after the Red Hessians obtained evidence of the scheme.

While the Rheinland Military were distracted by the Saigon War, the Unioners obtained intelligence indicating Vierlande Prison was substantially under-manned and vulnerable. When approached, the Coalition and Red Hessians agreed to a joint strike to liberate the prisoners within. Little did the Unioners realize that they had sprung a trap of their own making. With most of Wedel’s ships participating in the Vierlande attack, they were caught entirely by surprise by the Coalition and Red Hessians' betrayal. While the Unioner flagship Undine was destroyed at Vierlande, simultaneous assaults were launched on Wedel, destroying the station and leaving no survivors.

After the Unioners were outlawed in the aftermath of the Rheinland Civil War, they turned their eyes back to the Wedel wreck. The Salvage Liner Hausbruch was tasked with making repairs, with the facility being sufficiently patched to allow reoccupation in 834 AS. The Unioners have again used it as a relay station for their smugglers, and a launching point for raids across the system.

592635.text:
CLASS: Thirsk
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 80
592635.mapped:
Constructed in 807 AS after Planetform announced their intention to begin the terraforming of planet Wight, Holmfirth base is quite a large ice asteroid that has been hollowed out by the Gaians to serve as their main base of operations for the Manchester system, and contains a sizeable population of pilots, mechanics, engineers and even the occasional Corsair.

Located not far from the jump hole to Newcastle, the Gaians mostly use the base to launch attacks on BPA Newgate and Birmingham Station, although occasionally they will strike across the system to hit Sheffield Station. The BMM have attempted to increase security around Birmingham Station, but barely a day goes past without a Gaian attack on the station, and Planetform transports are always being hijacked along the trade lanes. The spoils and survivors of such raids are always taken to Holmfirth, where a majority of the captured goods quickly find their way onto the black markets.

The BMM have attempted to increase security around Birmingham Station, but barely a day goes past without a Gaian attack on the station, and Planetform transports are always being hijacked along the trade lanes. The spoils and survivors of such raids are always taken to Holmfirth, where a majority of the captured goods quickly find their way onto the black markets.

592638.mapped:
The Rock was first discovered by Molly scouts in 794 AS, with excavation eventually completed in 804 AS. Lisburn Rock represented the Mollys' first forays into the traditional Corsair territory of Cambridge, and an expansion of Molly influence into Omega-3. Once a relatively quiet base that was used to launch raids on local shipping, Lisburn Rock became a valuable supply hub due to its proximity to Freeport 1. It also instigated the growing alliance with the Red Hessians, as both groups' mutual interests and enemies aligned in the Omegas.

Operations on Lisburn Rock escalated rapidly with the colonization of Planet Sprague in 818 AS. The project resulted in a boom of unprotected BMM and Bowex convoys, and an Armed Forces spread too thin by the Gallic War to adequately respond. Sprague's appalling living conditions and mismanagement by BMM were also responsible for large-scale discontent among the Leeds refugee population. This provided the Mollys with an enormous windfall of resources, support and recruits from dissatisfied Bretonian workers.

With the Rock coordinating infiltration onto and extractions from Sprague, the base quickly came to host the largest Molly squadrons. In 831 AS, these inexperienced squadrons made up the majority of the force used to take Dublin, and a disproportionate bulk of the casualties incurred during engagements with the Battleship Essex. The Molly's success with Free Dublin has come at a price, with Arranmore demanding Lisburn provide ever increasing numbers of pilots and smugglers to sustain their new state.

592648.text: Scharhorn is the southernmost asteroid field in Sigma-15, and the largest of the three major fields. Daumann and Kruger both operate mining operations along the field edge.

Fort Sommerda was constructed in the orbit of Planet Oberhof in 817 AS, serving as a Rheinland Military arsenal and a heavily fortified border checkpoint. Sommerda was designed to stockpile heavy munitions and weaponry, allowing local forces to quickly respond to spontaneous Corsair or GMG incursions from the Sigmas. With the eruption of the Rheinland Civil War in 827 AS, Sommerda became a priority target for Federalist forces who had planned to secure Thuringia as a capital.

Before Sommerda could declare an allegiance, the Federalist Battleship Bayern requested to moor for fuel, and then boarded with its Marine contingent. The Rheinland Military crew quickly surrendered, with the station then garrisoned by the MND. Sommerda would continue to resupply Federalist forces operating throughout Frankfurt, Munich and New Berlin for the duration of the conflict. Since the end of the civil war, the MND has retained control of the station.

Kaiserslautern Depot was once a Kruger ore storage facility, abandoned when the Saarfield was depleted. It was restored by the LWB in 811 AS and used to launch attacks on Synth Paste and Fertiliser convoys across New Berlin. Over time, the base also became a frequent meeting point for Bundschuh, Unioners and Red Hessians to barter for LWB supplies.

In 824 AS, the LWB began to fracture, as cells dissatisfied with the movement’s progress and leadership began to fight amongst themselves. By the year’s end, this violence had driven the LWB to collapse, resulting in the destruction of Darmstadt Depot and the LWB as a coordinated force. The crew aboard Kaiserslautern found themselves cut off from support, supplies and funding, and chose to reach out to the Bundschuh for refuge.

The Bundschuh repurposed Kaiserslautern as a supply depot from which to tap into the vast black markets of New Berlin. The station is the first destination for political dissidents looking to escape Rheinland, and is a launching point for well-connected smugglers with contacts on The Ring. Kaiserslautern’s Black Market Munitions are often bartered to the Red Hessians, or other revolutionary groups further afield.

Built in 834 AS, the Krk represents a significant advancement in Corsair warship design, prioritizing the more mobile and modernized Consul-class Command Battlecruiser over heavier warships like the Legate. Designed for long-term independent operations, the Krk is equipped to function autonomously for years, supported by its battlegroup for resupply and logistics.

Although the original project aimed to complete the Krk by 833 AS, construction was delayed due to funding shortages within the Imperio. These shortages arose from overextension during military campaigns in Dublin, Theta, Dresden, and the Sigmas, which forced the Corsairs to prioritize other efforts.

With construction now complete and the situation stabilized, the Krk's initial mission is straightforward: safeguard Omicron Gamma and remain on standby for the anticipated Kappa offensive, prepared to assist the Vis' battlegroup.

One of the largest and most technologically advanced warships in the Coalition's fleet, CPW Ben Warner was first launched in 827 A.S from Aralsk Shipyard. Named after the former Premier and war hero of the Sirius Coalition, the vessel is currently the sentinel of Omega-52 and is the symbolic leader of other vessels of similar class.

The Ben Warner is capable of performing a range of deterrence operations in Omega region, pushing power projection of the Coalition against its foes and acting as command and control for excursion missions. This is the heaviest capital ship that the Coalition produces.

Incoming intelligence reports from some far-flung Dublin sympathiser noted that the Battleship Athos began moving to Omega-49. Believing the movement might be an attempt to intercept the damaged Alvin Katz on its flight back to Omega-52, the Ben Warner was deployed to cover its retreat.

The Ben Warner and the Athos did not find each other, enabling the Alvin Katz to successfully retreat. Hidden in one of the outcroppings of the Barrier nebula, serving as a staging ground for snubcraft vessels of the Mollys and the Coalition, the Ben Warner's mission remains - hunt down battleship Athos together with the Molly forces, and destroy it.

592666.mapped:
Harrisburg Station was initially a Deep Space Engineering (DSE) depot for the construction of Planet Erie’s docking ring. It transitioned ownership following the completion of the system’s Trade Lanes in 787 AS when DSE sold the station to Erie’s Zoner planetary council. Despite their ambitious plans to transform it into an orbital factory, a lack of local capital led to the auctioning of many of the station’s facilities to Liberty corporations, sidelining local businesses. By 807 AS, even the station’s administration had been outsourced, with Liberty Police Incorporated assuming management operations. Over the years, Harrisburg has seen steady expansion as Liberty corporations invested in new modules and capabilities.

Universal Shipping storage bays handle the majority of Pennsylvania’s imports and exports, while DSE Consumer Goods factories capitalize on the local low-wage workforce. Synth Foods biodomes supply Erie’s Lake City, and LPI detention facilities isolate criminals and Zoner militants in orbit before their transfer to Texas. The annexation of Erie led to the dissolution of the Zoner planetary council and Liberty utilizing Harrisburg as a naval logistics depot. In 834 AS, with post-annexation unrest and the Militant threat slowly diminishing, the government privatized the station. Harrisburg is now owned by a Liberty consortium spearheaded by Universal Shipping. Security remains high aboard amid regular bomb threats and sabotage attempts.

592669.text: Altair Research Complex is a human-built structure hidden in the Assoros Nebula. Located within a hollowed-out asteroid, it is one of the most spacious installations in Sirius, and mostly populated by Wild and a few individuals useful to the Nomads. The complex's primary goal is the war with humanity, and its dry docks house non-glowing Nomad vessels with deformities. Despite its size, Altair is invisible from outside the Assoros Nebula, potentially indicating that both the Assoros and the Kissare Nebula are artificial.

592671.text: Active Nomad City deep within the nebula. Unexplained appearence of the structure suggests it is of recent construction. Much like "Dyson city", it is also protected by impenetrable shield, however this one appears to be built with strong defense in mind: heavily reinforced and lacks vulnerabilities of the predecessor.

592673.text: This massive alien gateway appears to be directly attached to the energy shield surrounding the Nomad City, but there seems to be no way to directly penetrate the shield without activating the gate somehow. It is unknown how it works, but its most likely function is to open a gap in the shield inside the gate area, thus allowing Nomad vessels to pass through.

592676.text: Unable to determine structural composition. Object of non-human origin. Closest approximation appears to be the basis for the Ageira Technologies manufactured Trade Lane design. Suggest scanner recalibration.

AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 950
592678.mapped:
The original Freeport 14 was located in the backwater Alberta system. Its location in central Sirius enabled the speedy construction of several food-producing biodomes, and the station quickly became self sufficient. When the system was engulfed by a dark matter storm, the relatively well-off natives originally formulated an extremely ambitious plan to dismantle and tow the original station out of Alberta, but this concept was scrapped in favor of the vastly more feasible reconstruction project.

The new Freeport 14 is the newest permanent construction in Inverness, and it immediately became a thorn in the side of the Junkers, whose Invergordon served as the first freeport in the system. The growing economic and even physical conflicts between the two groups were partially quelled by the arrival of the Zoner carrier Praia, and through careful and prolonged negotiations, the tense situation calmed -- nowadays such conflicts are rather exceptional.

Conversely, the reclusive Technocrats extended an uncharacteristically warm welcome to the Zoner presence in Inverness ever since Fourteen's reconstruction. Notably, they make extensive use of the port for brokering trade negotiations at a safe distance from their home base of Valravn Citadel. However, matters in Inverness grew more complex with the arrival of refugee Gammu AI some time in 832 AS -- these intriguing machines attracted unwelcome attention to the Technocrats and their operations in the system. Consequently, they found themselves in the delicate position of balancing thinly veiled threats to overly-curious outsiders while still maintaining working relations with Fourteen's Zoners.

The Unioner-built Sachsenwald was commissioned by the LWB in 821 AS, and assigned to Saalburg Station in Frankfurt as a heavy raider. Fleeing both the destruction of Saalburg Station and collapse of the LWB in 824 AS, the Sachsenwald was isolated and without supplies. The desperate crew turned back to the Unioners, who commandeered the ship. The Unioners continued to use the ship as a raider, and - to the old crew's dismay - as a handing-off point for Corsair Artifacts.

The cruiser redeployed to Thuringia in 825 AS while investigating rumors of an unguarded Jump Hole into the system. It found rich pickings of military wrecks from the 80-Years War, although salvagers frequently came under attack by Wild patrols. Particularly bold Unioners were also seen prospecting the chaotic Gotha Fragments Belt, where free-floating Low Grade Artifacts can occasionally be found.

During the Rheinland Civil War, the Sachsenwald frequently raided supply ships moving to and from Planet Weimar. It became a high profile target for MND patrols, although its regular relocation throughout the Fragments Belt kept pursuers at bay. Following the armistice of 829 AS, the Sachsenwald retreated to the Hamburg system where it continued to target shipping. It is now hidden in the Alsterfeld, providing protection to the ongoing attempt to rebuild Wedel Station.
592681.mapped:
The LWB Cruiser Sachsenwald was built under contract by the Unioners in 821 AS. Initially stationed in Frankfurt, the ship’s squadrons targeted Synth Foods exports to Kusari, and Holstein Fertilizer shipments bound for Planet Stuttgart. With the collapse of LWB leadership in 824 AS, the Sachsenwald found itself cut off and without supplies. The desperate crew turned to the Unioners, who adopted the vessel and its pilots. For some time, the Unioners used the Sachsenwald to both launch their own less discriminating raids, and as a handing-off point for Corsair Artifacts.

The Sachsenwald would redeploy to the Thuringia system in 825 AS while investigating rumors of an unguarded Jump Hole into the system. The cruiser would find rich pickings of military wrecks from the 80-Years War, although salvagers frequently come under attack by the Wild patrols. Regardless of this risk, the Unioners persisted in stripping the ruined hulks for rare components that could supplement their own shipbuilding activities. Particularly bold Unioners have also been seen prospecting the chaotic Gotha Fragments Belt, where free-floating Low Grade Artifacts can occasionally be found.

In 827 AS, Thuringia would become the capital of the Federalist faction of the Rheinland Civil War. The Sachsenwald would frequently launch raids on supply ships moving to and from Planet Weimar, partially to further the Imperialist war effort, but mostly to exploit an opportunity for profit. The Sachsenwald would become a high profile target for MND patrols, although its regular relocation throughout the Fragments Belt kept pursuers at bay. Following the armistice of 829 AS, the Sachsenwald resumed its hazardous scavenging missions, made even more dangerous by the recent collapse of the Hamburg Jump Hole.

After the Frankfurt-Hamburg jump hole re-opened, coupled with more and more risk being exposed in Thuringia, the cruiser moved to the Hamburg system. It remains there hidden in the Alsterfeld, increasing the Unioner grip on the vital Frankfurt connection as well as being a staging point for raids on Alster and its surroundings.

A hollow structure made of an unknown material. Vagrant Hives similar to this may be found in dangerously remote or far-flung locations around the sector, each sharing the same disk-like shape and containing a variety of smaller chambers. A mysterious font of energy appears to be at its core.

This hive's proximity to the colonies of Bretonia and Liberty place it in an extraordinarily precarious situation. As the only one of its kind known to exist within the boundaries of human civilization, this hive allows the Vagrants and their thralls to conduct reconnaissance deep into heart of human territory.

Activity around the structure seems lesser than other hives, suggesting a degree of uncertainty in its position or perhaps due to its relatively younger age.

592691.text: A desolate medium-sized rock asteroid field. Traces of valuable metals have been found by initial surveys conducted by Zoners, but no further research has been made due to increasing pirate activity in the Pennsylvania system.

592693.text: Located not far from Alesia Station, most of the field formed around a gravitational anomaly during the construction of the station, the nearby Jump Gates, and the Trade Lanes connecting them. The field has become more dense recently, as most of the major capital ships destroyed during the Kusari invasion have been dragged here, a grim reminder to those traveling from the Core Worlds of the sacrifices the fleet made on their behalf.

A medium-sized nebula made up of sensor scattering ice particles, the Saint-Remy Nebula hides the Nievre Asteroid Field within it, and Gallic National Intelligence ships are frequently seen entering it. Though little is known about what is inside of the field itself, the GNI has publicly declared the entire nebula to be restricted to unauthorized traffic, and as such should be steered well clear of. Like its sister, the Autun Nebula on the far side of Burgundy, the Saint-Remy contains high concentrations of copper, leading to its vibrant green color.

A small moon of Planet Quillan. Ores and explosive compounds extracted from this planetoid were used to produce the Brittany and Montpellier minefields that for almost a century sealed Gallia away from Sirius. GMS still maintains a minor presence, however most deposits were exhausted during the Invasion of Sirius.

Gjallarbru Research Station was occupied by the Red Hessians in 826 AS, after the remains of an MND deep space outpost was discovered and then salvaged. The MND are believed to have established an operation in Omega-55 around 814 AS, pursuing rumors of Rheinland's Colony War era activities. Little is known about what they discovered, however their base was abandoned by 822 AS, when Omega-11's red giant entered a period of extreme activity, destabilizing the connecting Jump Hole. Since restoring the station, the Hessians have been fiercely protective of the Groningen Nebula, aggressively repelling intruders.

Rumors abound as to what the Hessians would be researching at Gjallarbru. The most common speculation is that they use this concealed outpost to reverse-engineer stolen enemy technology, and pilfer Artifacts excavated by The Core on Planet Skagen. Nearby gravimetric anomalies also hold scientific interest, although it seems unlikely the Hessians have the academic expertise or inclination to deeply study the phenomena. Darker stories also swirl, with some whispering of prisoners being sold to Wild agents in exchange for technological secrets. The Hessians reject these tales as slanderous lies, and are quick to turn their weapons on anyone repeating them.

Since 830 AS, the Hessians have hosted a small wing of Coalition fighters who act as scouts for gauging the disposition of enemy forces across the system. Despite contributing to the station's defense, outside pilots are still strictly confined to the hangars and their quarters.

MASS: 6.94 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Ice
TEMPERATURE: -67°C to -25°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.70 km/sec

An uninhabitable world, Eday is highly rich in resources due to it being within the vast Westray Asteroid Field, bombarded continually with resource rich asteroids. The nearby Dounby base has limited mining operations in the area and sends down mining parties on a frequent basis.

592702.text:
HFX-F1A "Falchion" Lane Hacker Light Fighter

An entirely new shipline which has its origins in old Borderworld experimental designs, the HFX series' development was quick and completely unrelated to the one of the "Bayonet" Heavy Fighter. While the series seems to bear some external design similarities, in particular the so-called "boxiness", to current Borderworld ships, the ships are not built for general versatility, but instead for top-of-the-line performance in combat situations.

While the ship's frame is incredibly stable, the newly designed internal components are very sensitive to all kinds of dirt and damage, making the costs to maintain the ship and keep it operational almost three times as high as for a comparable ship of its class. This has resulted in the limited usage of the Falchion, the ship being reserved only for high-risk reconnaissance and emergency combat operations.

592704.text:
CLASS: Mosel
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: RESTRICTED
AMENITIES: Limited
CREW: CLASSIFIED
592704.mapped:
Schatten Research Facility was constructed in 797 AS, although little is known about its purpose or activities during that period. The station was destroyed during the Colony Wars; the wreckage subsequently lay abandoned for several years. The Rheinland Military salvaged several components in 803 AS, with the reactivated facility becoming instrumental as a forward staging point for the Purge of Thuringia. Schatten went on to serve as a classified research station concerned primarily with advancing the weapons and starship technologies of the Rheinland Military.

Operational control of the facility was transferred to the MND’s research division in 822 AS, following years of vicious inter-service political infighting on New Berlin. Due to this, it is unsurprising that Schatten refused to recognise the Military-backed Imperial coup during the Rheinland Civil War. Following the Battle of the Westerwald and the destruction of the Koblenz, Schatten became a rallying point for Federalist forces. For the duration of the conflict, research activities were suspended, with the station instead operating as a front-line Federalist repair yard.

In the uncomfortable peace following the war, Schatten has once more returned to research activities under the MND's administration. In a compromise neither party is happy with, Military observers are now permanently stationed aboard to supervise and contribute to development projects.

592707.text: A heavy fighter of the Royal Navy that was recently disabled by the Council forces or by raiders belonging to one of the Gallic pirate factions. The ship is damaged beyond repair, but some equipment may remain onboard intact.

592709.text: A powerful cruiser of the Council that was destroyed in the battle for Languedoc Mine Field. Its hull had survived over 100 enemy hits; after its engine controls were disabled, the captain ordered to use whatever energy remained to direct the ship straight into one of the defending Gallic Royal Navy battleships, the Cassard. In the collision that followed, battleship's engines and some of the rear-firing turrets were destroyed, rendering Cassard almost helpless against advancing Council forces. Democratie continued its uncontrolled flight into the nearby debris field, until it hit a huge piece of debris and stopped forever. The ship was de-pressurized by that time, and the whole crew perished before the rescue teams could reach them.

592711.text:
During one of the many heated battles between the Royal Navy and Council forces, the Tarasque-class battlecruiser CLN Limousin sustained heavy damage in an engagement with the Triomphant-class battleship RNS Finistere. Desperate to escape destruction, the vessel fled through an uncharted jump anomaly, overloading the capacity of the connection and causing it to collapse. Though it emerged on the other side, its hull was crushed by the spatial distortions and its reactor went critical.

The ensuing explosion ripped the warship apart, and it went down with all hands. The wreck now rests within a cloud of its own dangerous remains, the residual anomalous energies of its fateful journey and destruction threatening to tear apart any would-be salvagers.

592712.text:
CLASS: Charlemagne (Refit)
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
592712.mapped:
The Cassard was deployed from Fourchambault Shipyard in 728 AGS (812 AS), joining the Gallic Royal Navy (GRN) fleet stationed in Languedoc. When The Council initiated the First Battle of Languedoc in 733 AGS (817 AS), the Cassard was ordered to hold Montpellier Fortress and await reinforcements. The Council assaulted the position first, with the Cassard being critically damaged through a ramming attack by the Council cruiser Democratie. the Cassard was flagged as missing in action, until GRN scouts discovered the crippled husk adrift in the Aveyron Nebula in 742 AGS (826 AS). Engineers towed the ship back to Fourchambault Shipyard, hoping to quickly press Cassard into service in the deteriorating New London theater.

The work required to repair the Cassard were only being finalized at the point of the Gallic kingdom’s collapse later that year. When The Minarchy seized Languedoc and occupied Fourchambault soon after, they found the Cassard moored, largely uncrewed. While the Minarchy’s Unione Corse gangster enforcers had no experience operating a ship of that size, they quickly commandeered it to ensure the other Confederal states would take them seriously as an independent power. When Kusari invaded the system the following year, the Cassard was among the first vessels to rally a defense.

The Cassard’s green crew were entirely outmatched when facing Kusari’s Battleships Hyono and Yamaguchi, escaping only through the efforts of allied Confederal Defense Forces. The battleship was heavily damaged during the Second Battle of Ales, and withdrawn from the system entirely. After receiving emergency repairs at Rambouillet Shipyard, it was dispatched to Burgundy to suppress Kusari privateers. With the rise of the Gallic Union and the end of the Kusari Invasion, the Cassard was reintegrated into the central Navy, and selected to garrison the troublesome Champagne system. Many of the local population were already enraged by the reconciliation with the Gallic Enclave -- to ensure loyalty, Navy commanders felt it was essential that the system garrison consist of troops that were not formerly associated with the Gallic Republic.
