593359.text: This ship was flown by a pilot from The Order. Closer scans of the vessel reveal heavy burn marks and damage, coupled with antimatter wear and tear. It looks like these vessels had been run continuously without any repair in the battle of minor. There is no sign of the pilot or pod.

593360.text: This ship was flown by a pilot from The Core. Closer scans of the vessel reveal heavy burn marks and damage, coupled with antimatter wear and tear. It looks like these vessels had been run continuously without any repair in the battle of minor. There is no sign of the pilot or pod.

593362.text:
General broadcast over all Order frequencies.

This is the High Command. Outposts have confirmed a massive nomad presence in Omicron Delta, and the Freeport has gone silent. All pilots not expressly assigned to the defense of Toledo are to report to their stations immediately and launch. You are to RV near the Arsephes, the command ship for this operation.
This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill.

593364.text:
Recovering pilot log.

God has left us. Even as I record this, a massive core fleet is testing our outer defenses. I am camped near the Isis with my contingent, holding for now while the outer defenses are tested.

This is unreal. This cannot be happening. We've heard nothing from the fleet who went to combat the Nomads in Delta. Is this a collossal joke? Is this god's way of repaying us for our sins? Where did we go wrong?

If anyone else is listening to this...

593366.text:
Excerpts from Julian Thompson's communications logs.

Oh yeah I'm smoking hot baby! Fifth core down for the day! Keep it up men, we'll send those wannabes back to their stinking holes soon enough. Target the gunboat I'm marking on your tactical, move move!

Wing, prepare for supernova volley....what the hell!?!

This...is a trick. cannot be happening. Holy mother...

Do you just see that in the distance? Yeah? Well damn it... Command, this is Thompson, Nomads have joined the party, transmitting coordinates..."

593368.text: This is Commander Julian Garret... I've already directed all the wings under my command to attempt to break the Nomad encirclement. Thankfully, they hurt the Core forces enough so we just have the Nomads to contend with... for now. Our forces were bolstered from what remains of the fleet sent to Delta. It looks grim though. Odds are very poor. They're launching out everyone they can find... it's all a bid to buy time so that we can evacuate enough people. I wish I knew what led us to this fateful day... and that the mistakes this organization made must be corrected, at any cost. For us all.

593370.text:
Recovering log partitions.

Arthur Kilpatrick here... my wing, along with a few others managed to sneak out of the encirclement and we have been doing hit and run attacks on the Nomads from the rear, near the Alien Gate. It hasn't been working too well... There are just two of us left. Minor seems oddly quiet, no transmissions coming, and I'm sure I saw a flash of light a little while back... what is that? Jason, give me a reading... heads up, looks a lot of nomads headed this way, you've been the best wing a man could get... let's do our best.

The recording clips in between, then resumes.

Jason is down. My ship is disabled, life support systems failing, so I'm done for. Nomads are going through the gate. I think all of them... Wait, something else is there... What the hell is that...

The recording abruptly ends in a clutter of static here.

593372.text:
A partial communication log has been looped within the remnants of the wreck's black box.

... found a way to sneak in with the task force. We are now preparing to hit the final blow to the Order. You all know what you have to do. Marcus, take your wingman and focus on any countering forces we may bump into. Jackson, try to hide your bomber squad within the fog as much as possible. I don't want to risk any detection before the actual assault begins. And someone check that weird reading we are having, I don't like the loo....

The data file is corrupt beyond this point, replaying the recording.

593374.text:
With proper signal boositing, it is possible to match the comm frequency of Privateer and listen to the final logs of the ship.

Commander Hovers here, I want all able craft to focus on Order capitals. We need them crippled. Establish space superiority over Toledo, and then send in the troop transports as quick as possible. Miles, take your wing and enter the atmosphere, target ground-to-space batteries. Reck, continue strafing Order fighters, we just need to keep them distracted for a while...

The rest of the log is inaudible, cluttered with broken signals.

593376.text: There isn't any information available about the fate of Meltdown from its flight records due to the extensive damage. The burnt marks on the main hull suggests a powerful energy blast has sealed the fate of her. It is hard to tell the exact time Meltdown spent drifting in space, but judging from the decomposition of the hull, it has been some time. The dead pilot's remains can still be seen in the cockpit, standing like a sign of warning to those wandering in Omicrons about the fate that awaits them.

593378.text:
Blackbox recordings from Jeremy Pattinson, Core pilot.

Well... I'm in a sticky situation all right. Engines... gone. Life support malfunctioning, won't last much longer. I'm adrift, the Core is in retreat, and I'm bleeding. They descended on us like... nothing I've ever seen. But the fact that they absolutely... urgh, absolutely crushed The Order is... no comfort. That enormous Nomad thing, must be their flagship... never seen anything like it.

It ripped apart the Zenith like paper... wait...

I can see it in the distance. It seems to be... opening? Like as if powering up. What is it doing?! It's... taking aim at the planet!

593380.text:
Final blackbox entries of the Blackwing, Order transport.

Everything just ended, it seems. My XO is sitting by my side, sobbing uncontrollably. I admit I want to weep myself... but an unnatural calm seems to have come on me. Maybe this is what the convict feels before being sent to the gallows? This ship will crumble any moment...

We were the trying to leave Minor... as we got out of the battlefield, we saw the old warhorse of a ship called The Isis moving forward against a huge Nomad ship... We cheered.

Then it ripped through Isis... More and more Nomads came in.. .we attempted to put on more speed. Don't know what happened after. A flash. I saw them, a circle around Toledo, countless little sparks... And then I remember seeing Toledo cracking, it burned, from inside out. Most were still down there... waiting for transports. I stared at it, don't know for how long.

Then a few Nomads split from the rest, chasing us... we had no chance... But then suddenly, they all turned back. Within a moment their entire fleet changed its course, all at once, disappearing into the depths of the nebula. But too late for us... our systems are fried... two containers were blown off... dead, many dead. More will die very soon...

Toledo burns

593382.text: The cargo manifest of the ship shows an array of Nomad artifacts of various types. One had been stored in a seperate container for some reason. Ship scans reveal all of the artifacts as still on the ship, the ones not present floating in space. Only one artifact cannot be accounted for, the one in the seperate container. The nomads seem to have targeted first the engines, then the cargo bay of the transport, then ignored it, as judging from the state of the bridge and other parts of the ship. The bodies of the pilots are still on board, preserved in space

593383.text:
The Isis was an experimental Osiris-class vessel, manufactured by the Order in 804 AS Derived from the original Osiris, its main difference was the lack of cloaking device. In compensation, a hyper-charged prototype power core was installed on the vessel to charge its formidable weapons array.

The Isis was the last line of defense for The Order in Omicron Minor for close to fifteen years. In the Battle of Minor, The Isis held firm against the Core attack, but in the fighting, its external shielding around the engines collapsed, but the ship maintained structural integrity.

When the Nomads attacked, The Isis, in a last ditch attempt to buy time for the retreating Order forces, activated its drives for the first time in many years, and floated into the fray, demanding the maximum from its reactor.

593384.text: Toledo, the former homeworld of the organisation known as The Order, used to be a planet covered in snow and ice. While it harbored a harsh environment, it supported native wildlife and human colonization; at least, before the bombardments that sundered Toledo's surface. Presently, boiling temperatures and seas of churning magma dominate. It was estimated that close to one million people lived on the surface before the Battle of Minor. The planet was sundered in 819 A.S; Nomads smashed through Order and Core fleets already engaged with each other in high orbit. Toledo was subsequently bombarded for days along its fault lines, systematically destroying the planet's crust. Anyone unable to reach evacuatory ships was buried under magma and rubble.

593386.text:
DIAMETER: 31,014 km
MASS: 14.21 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 19.25 km/sec

An inhospitable barren planet located on the fringes of Omicron Delta. In 820 A.S, a massive flare of light was witnessed by the denizens of Freeport 11 originating from the planet's orbit. Mysterious hostile ships have been seen patrolling the local area, and as such this has rendered any attempts of a salvaging operation or extensive surveys of the planet's surface impossible.

593388.text: A wasteland of trojan rocks, presumably once a large moon of Planet Rio. The Core reports frequent activity of Corsair, Order and other unlawful elements throughout the field, however little can be done to prevent this parties from utilizing the field as staging point for raids on APM convoys.

593390.text: Kathu is an outcropping of the Edge Nebula that features high level of background radiation and no particularly interesting resources. The only value of the cloud is the location of a jump hole that connects Rho to the deeper Omicrons.

593392.text:
Capetown was a Core installation built as a defensive strong-point and supply base for ships exploring the upper Omicrons in search of alien technology. The Core, well aware of Freeport 7's destruction, patrolled the perimeter of the station in order to give it advance warning of attackers, and supplied the installation via trade routes sourcing from Nauru. Unfortunately for them, the station ended up suffering a similar fate to the above-mentioned Freeport.

In 835 AS, with the advancement of utilizing hybrid AI technology on human vessels, the Core launched an assault on Cairo Station in Omicron Zeta, spearheaded by Battleship Mars. The initial attack was a success, severely weakening Cairo's defenses before preparing for the station's ultimate destruction. In a catastrophic turn of events, however, the Mars corrupted and went rogue, exposing the Core's overextended position without its flagship. The Nomads, lurking in the shadows as the events unfolded, assaulted and swiftly destroyed Capetown, leaving no survivors.

593394.text:
CLASS: Osiris
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
The Battleship Apophis is among the first ships to leave Carthage's drydocks in 809 AS and was based on the battleship Isis launched five years earlier. Much like its direct predecessor, which valued its combat performance over anything else, the Apophis was launched hastily with many compartments still unfinished to supply the Order with another battleship as soon as possible. Consequently, this meant the ship never received its stealth equipment, which would have allowed it to operate unhindered almost anywhere in the Colonies.

With its limitations in mind, the Apophis' service life has been marked by defensive assignments, garrison duties and few frontline operations where subtlety and secrecy was neither important nor needed.

Since its compact chassis allows it to operate more freely within various asteroid and debris fields, where bigger ships would have serious issues, the Apophis is currently deployed in Omicron Delta to yet another defensive assignment around Dabadoru Station, where it can provide support firepower and service the station's fighter complement better than its own onboard facilities can.

593397.text:
CLASS: Zephyr
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIEDOriginally laid down in the distant Crayter System, the Carrier Malachite was one of three warships converted into improvised Sleeper Ships, alongside the Hades and Helios. During an event known as The Calamity, Crayter's colonies were fatally struck by a gamma ray burst, forcing the settlers to flee for survival. After centuries of travel in stasis, the Crayterian flotilla arrived in Sirius' desolate Tau sector. Discovering Tau-44 in 811 AS, Crayter pathfinders soon struck an alliance with the Independent Miners Guild. Crayterian officers were shocked and horrified to learn of the sheer advancement of Sirian technology, which had rendered their own vessels entirely obsolete.

Singapore Shipyard helped to bridge this gap, slowly refitting the fleet with open market hull plating, armaments, and propulsion. The early Republic had little in the way of resources or credits, and instead bartered the Malachite to the Guild for the materials needed to modernize the Hades and Helios. As a result, the Malachite saw service across Orkney and Tau-23, where it primarily deterred Outcast incursions as a mobile patrol base. Following the Gallic Invasion of Tau-44 in 818 AS and the occupation of the Taus more broadly, the Guild returned the Malachite to Crayter control, fearing the Gallic Royal Navy would confiscate it. In this capacity, it aided in the evacuation of Crayter citizens from the Taus to Coronado.

Following the construction of Sabah Shipyard and the provision of Bretonian and Libertonian aid, the Malachite was fully modernized and pushed back into service. Throughout the Gallic Invasion, it saw extensive service across the nearby Independent Worlds and Barrier Pass. In the aftermath of the Gallic War, the Malachite has primarily served as a garrison ship for Coronado, save a deployment to the Taus in 831 AS, where it assisted the joint CR and IMG efforts to support rebellious slaves on Malta.

593400.text: A large and technologically advanced shipyard for the construction and repair of large ships.

593402.text: A prototype ship still undergoing construction. Specifications are unknown.

593404.text: A large and advanced research station.

593408.text: A mid-sized civilian space station.

593410.text: A base built inside a large, hollowed out asteroid.

593412.text: A mining base built around a large asteroid.

593414.text: A large manufacturing facility, typically used to build large weapons.

593416.text: A large Civilian Trade station used by marketers and hopeful individuals as a base to sell their goods.

593418.text:
A relatively small-sized cruiser outfitted with powerful sensor technology, the LSF-RC-X1 prototype is still under construction.

Built specifically to penetrate behind enemy lines and perform recon or oversee the deployment of intelligence assets, this design appears to focus on speed and evasion rather then sheer firepower. Time will tell if the project is a success.

593419.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. This jumphole appears only partially phase-aligned. It is stable enough for fighters and freighters only.

593420.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown.

593422.text: A Trade Lane ring, making possible superluminal travel within a system. Trade Lane entry and termination points are usually located near key industrial, military, or civilian bases. Solar Engineering researched and developed Gallic Trade Lane technology, later succeeded by EFL Oil & Machinery after Solar's dissolution by the Gallic Crown.

593423.text:
>>>WARNING: Do not attempt planetary landing without using a Docking Ring.<<<
Gallic Docking rings are an orbital elevator system invented by EFL Oil & Machinery. Through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, Docking Rings assist the smooth atmospheric entry and exit of interstellar vessels with landing capability.

593425.text: The third drift of the Walker Nebula in the Stuttgart system. Historically, the Nordnebel was a quiet sector with only minor criminal activity. After the Cologne-Stuttgart connection was finalized, criminal activity within the cloud drastically increased, preying on civilian ships in the area. The Nordnebel was the site of a major battle late in the Rheinland Civil War.

593427.text:
Pirna was once the Rheinland Federal Police’s headquarters in Dresden, responsible for securing Daumann and Kruger convoys within the system. Pirna was widely considered the most dangerous police posting in Rheinland due to the hazardous system conditions and frequent Red Hessian attacks. These issues were compounded by chronic equipment shortages and budget cuts due to the economic crisis following the 80-Years War.

Despite attempts to bolster system security by deploying the Battleship Altenburg, matters had reached an untenable state by 818 AS. Manpower had been increasingly siphoned away by the ongoing Hudson War, leaving both the Altenburg and Pirna severely undermanned. This vulnerability allowed the Red Hessians to destroy the station in a lightning raid that announced their first major campaign intended to wrest control of Dresden as a whole.

593429.text:
Le Cheval Vert is the remains of a Gallic civilian freighter that belonged to the adventurous freelancer Regis Gosselin, who was a well-known smuggler. He was intimately associated with the Unione Corse, with whom he had a long relationship and as such regularly smuggled Nox between Gallia and Sirius.

When a Unioner patrol caught up with him and attempted to rob him of his cargo. Regis Gosselin did not give up for free and managed to disable two fighters, including the Unioner fighter ace Henrich Ezaak, before his freighter was destroyed.

593431.text:
Gecko 4 was the call sign of a Unioner newcomer Meike Feld, who was the mistress and apprentice of Henrich Ezaak. She was known among the Unioners for her beauty and personal charm, and was their poster girl.

Not even twenty years old when they crossed paths with the cargo ship Le Cheval Verte. Her squadron leader Henrich Ezaak was shot down, causing the young woman to panic and lose focus. She was shot down mere seconds after her mentor and lover.

593433.text: The La Rochelle is the wreck of a cargo ship that once belonged to the IDF. The ship was on its way from Rheinland to Gallia with undisclosed cargo, but never reached its destination. The signs of damage on the hull do not match any known weapons. The vessel's blackbox and the data recorder were never recovered. The fate of the crew or the nature of its cargo remain a mystery to this day.

593435.text:
The Rotbussard, also known as the Red Eagle, is a specially modified Eagle-class fighter that belonged to the famous Unioner fighter ace Henrich Ezaak, who boasted nearly two dozen kills.

Although Henrich Ezaak was a very experienced pilot, he probably underestimated his last opponent, Regis Gosselin, and fell first in a dogfight. The remaining three members of his squadron, at the cost of two more losses, eventually avenged their fallen commander.

593437.text:
The origin of the Lynx-class fighter with the call-sign Arlequin-7 has never been clarified. According to some rumors, it is a ship that once belonged to the GRI, although sources close to the GNI have been unable to confirm this.

The ship bears signs of damage from Unioner lasers and the hull and is severely degraded due to prolonged exposure to the Valais Cloud environment. Whatever its origins, it is believed to have been a specially modified Lynx with a very advanced cloaking and stealth capabilities.

The pilot's fate is unknown.

593439.text:
Vesta was a cargo ship belonging to the EFL under the command of Captain Odette Cloutier. The ship had nearly twenty years of service under its belt was also known for the crew's ability to guide the ship through any hazardous system. That is, until the cargo ship fell into the trap of the infamous pirate cruiser Le Bonheur de l'Argent.

The pirates managed to temporarily disable the Trade Lanes on that fateful day, and other transports preferred to wait until the authorities had solved the problem, but Captain Cloutier decided to use her experience to attempt to fly around the star undetected, partially hidden by its magnetic emissions.

Unfortunately for her, the pirate cargo cruiser Le Bonheur de l'Argent had just attempted the same maneuver, easily overpowering Vesta and seizing the cargo, including the crew. They were reported missing by the authorities soon after, and their case eventually went cold.

593441.text:
The Cavalier-1, is a Lynx-class fighter, a machine belonging to the famous Captain Adnot Pellier, the famed fighter commander from the Battleship Dax. Adnot Pellier had excelled among pilots as a young cadet, and it was because of this that he had earned a place on the Battleship Dax from the beginning of his military career back in the then Gallic Royal Navy.

He was personally instrumental in the partial improvement and streamlining of Gallic fighter doctrine, and many excellent pilots and officers passed through his school. Perhaps his most famous contribution is the so-called Pellier half-turn, a manoeuvre exploiting the flight characteristics of Gallic fighters and used to attack an enemy approaching from six o'clock.

During his last patrol, Captain Pellier encountered a Unioner patrol and managed to shoot down several of their fighters before a gunship came to their rescue, against which even a pilot as experienced as Adnot Pellier stood no chance. His request for reinforcements was impeded by hubris and never reached the Battleship Dax.

593442.text:
WARNING: The core of this jump gate operates at 213.1% of nominal capacity for EFL gates. The exact cause of this phenomenon is unknown, but the fact is that the jump gate core resonates with the magnetosphere of Zurich's yellow giant and is being charged from ionized gas clouds.

Although the gate is stable, for safety reasons only a select number of the best jump gate engineers in Gallia are authorized to work on this supercharged jump gate.

The jump gate is under constant surveillance from a small control tower, where a modest crew of technicians carefully monitors all of the gate's output variables and is ready to initiate a gate shutdown in the event of an impending catastrophic accident.

593444.text:
This wreck is all that remains of Issoudun shipyard, once the pride of the Gallic Royal Navy and a symbol of Gallic technological dominance over Sirius. Issoudun was a mobile shipyard serving as a dry dock, repair station and spare parts factory, designed to follow Gallic invasion fleets and provide logistical support to larger Gallic ships without having to send damaged ships back to Gallia.

While this marvel of engineering did not help Gallia win the war against Sirius, the shipyard found new use as a key infrastructure for the Gallic Royal Enclave to repair and maintain their ships until the reunification of Gallia shortly after the Gallia-Kusari War.

After the abandonment of the Edinburgh system, Issoudun Shipyard began to sing its swan song as years of service in field conditions and lack of maintenance started to take its toll on an aging shipyard. With the formation of the Gallic Union, Issoudun's importance began to decline as Gallia managed to get its war-damaged shipyards operational again.

Issoudun Shipyard, its crew and most of its defenders were destroyed in early April 745 AGS by alien lifeforms known as Nomads. How they managed to penetrate the remote sensors guarding the entire system with such a great force is still under investigation, but one thing is certain - it was the loss of Issoudun Shipyard that initiated the effective withdrawal of the Gallic presence from Orkney.

593446.text:
CLASS: Wellington
GRAVITY: No
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 0

Originally built in 744 AS, Graves Station was the single most lucrative mining operation in Bretonian space, and a symbol of Bretonian control over the Dublin system. Once responsible for exporting the huge volumes of Gold that helped sustain the Bretonian economy through the Tau and Gallic Wars, the wreck is now a notorious reminder of the consequences of Bretonian industrial expediency.

Owned by BMM subsidy GS&M, the station was the site of the infamous Founder's Day Revolt in 752 AS, when workers mutinied over working conditions and executed the CEO, Sir Edmund Graves. In the aftermath of the uprising, Sir Edmund's daughter, Lady Selena Graves, was appointed to serve as administrator. Graves continued to be a dangerous place to work, but increased wages made it a lucrative and highly sought after posting.

Conditions aboard the station worsened during Gallic War, but hit a new critical low in the years following the armistice as BMM continually raised quotas to fuel Bretonia's post-war economic recovery. This situation was eagerly exploited by Molly provocateurs within the crew, who fostered increasingly radical and violent ideas among the angry miners. The death of the mining ship Glyndwr's crew due to failed air filters sparked the Second Revolt in 831 AS, with the mutineers subduing the BPA garrison and seizing control of the station.

Molly agents publicly broadcast the execution of several BMM executives to act as bait, knowing that the Battleship Essex would be forced to rush its response to the mutiny. The Essex's fighter wings were quick to arrive with boarding freighters full of Marines, however the Mollys had no intention of fighting for Graves. Instead, asteroid mining charges were used to scuttle the station as Bretonian forces landed, with Molly combatants, hostages and any cooperative crew having already been extracted.

593449.text: Formerly used as a staging ground for Xeno operations in the Kepler system, and as a supply base for the Northern Alliance that stretches further into Colorado - Nome now lies abandoned and derelict. The bay doors are left flung open, revealing a pitch black, ominous, and thoroughly inert interior. The loss of Nome renders the Northern Alliance's supply situation tenuous, and more reliant on Fort Ramsey's good graces now more than ever.

593451.text:
This wreckage appears riddled with scorch marks and the gradual erosion caused by intense radiation. Downloading the manifest proves insightful, if frustrating at first, since the drives warn you repeatedly that the data within is the proprietary property of Kishiro.

This ship is, or perhaps was, the Shotoku, and had been on a top-level assignment to deliver weapon prototypes to Liberty. The exact nature of this agreement, as well as details on what the weapons may have been are all lost to data corruption. But the manifest does thoroughly detail the security protocols, as well as the names and backgrounds of the pilots that would be escorting it. The ship was intended to be escorted by the Naval Forces from the Shikoku Jump Gate and towards trade lanes leading to Colorado. It would have then been escorted by an element of the Liberty Navy for the rest of the journey.

Evident from the ship's current state, and the lack of any further wreckage to suggest that its escorts perished in the Shotoku's defense, the circumstances surrounding its fate here are a mystery.

593452.text:
CLASS: Victoria (Derelict)
DOCKING: No
Amenities: No
CREW: 0

Originally the lead ship of the Bretonian Armed Forces' response to the Founder's Day Revolt in 752 AS, the Hood's engines were struck by a huge Molly mine and disabled. The battleship was deemed too unstable to make the jump to New London for repairs, and was officially scuttled once its weaponry, armor and valuable subsystems were stripped.

The Hood remained an abandoned hulk for decades, until it was re-pressurized by enterprising members of the Independent Miners Guild in 778 AS as a base for their own Gold extraction operations. While acting as a floating bazaar, it served as the only operational Freeport within House space. Due to this, the Hood was also of critical importance to the Mollys, as one of the few places they could exchange their Gold for necessary supplies.

Over time, the Hood developed an infamous reputation from its disreputable clientele and the popular race track in the nearby asteroid field. This dangerous circuit would more often result in a survivor than a winner, attracting a subculture of gamblers and adrenaline junkies to the system.

Following Bretonia's withdrawal from Dublin in 831 AS, Corsair raiders began to launch large scale incursions into the system, significantly escalating their conflict with the Mollys. After suffering unexpectedly heavy casualties, the Battlecruiser Santander destroyed the Hood as a calculated strategy to starve the Mollys into submission through a blockade. This strategy has had limited success, despite imposing a heavy toll on both groups.

593453.text:
DIAMETER: 10,698 km
MASS: 6.23 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: -23°C to 56°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.27 km/sec

A moon of Planet Holstein, Stulingen is a hot, dry world warmed by internal volcanic processes, with no atmosphere capable of supporting life. Early commercial surveys revealed no resources of note. Mainz Storage Facility was constructed in orbit.

593454.text:
DIAMETER: 9,145 km.
MASS: 5.05 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: 18°C to 92°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.1 km/sec

A sterile desert world, Rugen provides a bleak backdrop to Bornholm Station and its notorious Pit arena. Limited surveys indicate the planet may possess Silver and Cobalt deposits, however local Junkers are usually quick to run off any would-be pioneers who could bring unwanted attention to their operations. It is alleged that the Junkers will dump trespassers or overly unruly guests among Rugen's dunes to wander until they inevitably suffocate. Rugen has accumulated a debris field in orbit, however it is unclear to what extent this stems from the Junker's activities, or alleged Rheinland experiments from the late 790s. Showers of scrap burning up in the atmosphere frequently light Rugen's night sky.

593455.text:
CLASS: Elbe
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
593455.mapped:
Reflecting an ongoing attempt to reform Rheinland’s fleets towards lighter, faster and cheaper formations, the Carrier Saar was constructed in 827 AS. As Rheinland’s political situation spiralled out of control, the Ministry of Defence intervened to appoint a senior command staff of its own choosing, overruling the decisions of the potentially disloyal Rheinland Military. The Military-backed Imperial coup erupted mere weeks later, as the Saar completed final outfitting at Oder Shipyard. The carrier’s loyalist crew responded immediately by launching fighter squadrons to evacuate key Federal officials from Planet New Berlin before they could be detained.

In the chaos of the opening hours of the Civil War, the Saar successfully retreated to Frankfurt, where it linked up with the Battleship Bayern. Upon depositing its passengers on Planet Weimar in Thuringia, it regrouped with other Federalist fleet elements. The Saar was deployed as a mobile fleet carrier, projecting squadrons to harass Imperial forces across New Berlin, Frankfurt and Hamburg. Its fighters proved to be such a hindrance that it is alleged the Emperor announced a significant reward for the carrier’s destruction. Saar avoided any serious damage during the war, despite a number of inconclusive clashes with the Battleship Schwerin.

As a part of the negotiated peace settlement of the Holstein Accords, the Carrier Saar was formally transferred to the MND’s command. It is now stationed in the Westerwald nebula, where it provides perimeter security for the Sector-7 and Sector-9 security zones.
