594025.text:
Sunbucks Coffee is the official concession of Liberty Police Inc., expertly blended in partnership with elite Synth Foods Flavor Engineers. It is popular among commuting spacers who need a fix of something approaching caffeine -- Sunbucks New York aboard Fort Bush has long been the brand's busiest franchise.

The imposition of the Baltimore Defense Grid initially led to fears among franchisees that passing trade would collapse, however the shortfall has more than been made up for by an influx of overworked shipyard engineers and sleep-deprived Navy and LSF pilots.

MENU:
- Sunbucks Coffee and Donuts, $500

594027.text:
CLASS: Shukensha
AMENITIES: Limited
PASSENGERS: 1,200

At the outbreak of war between Kusari and Liberty, the Tsukishima Liner Yards were nationalized for use as an emergency repair dock for the Kusari Naval Forces. This displaced the Liner Tokushima, which had recently been structurally completed, but had not yet received the luxury interior amenities that characterizes the Shukensha class. Lacking alternate facilities to finish this work, the Renzu Corporation prepared to mothball the ship for the duration of the war.

Instead, the Kusari government offered a lucrative contract to ship interned Liberty citizens aboard Deshima Station to Bretonia. In consultation with their Interspace owners and the Liberty government, Renzu reluctantly accepted the offer and expects to have extradited all foreign nationals in short order. Upon the contract's completion, Renzu hope to rent a berth at Scarborough Shipyard in Newcastle to finish the liners outfitting.

596001.text: Torpedo Squadron 3 was originally comprised of four Takeda-class destroyers specifically armed with torpedos to provide fleet fire support. In line with Kusari's initiation of hostilities, Torpedo Squadron 3 was deployed alone to destroy the Colorado Jump Gate in Galileo. Unfortunately, Liberty's response was faster. As the four destroyers prepared to strike, Task Force 17 arrived through the gate and immediately opened fire. Having been taken by surprise in a twist of irony, half the squadron met their end as Liberty launched the invasion of Galileo.

596003.text: These two ships were formerly part of a Samura mining expedition in the platinum fields, believing the Colorado gate would be destroyed. These assumptions were proven false as the Carrier Ohio had these ships destroyed by its attack squadrons without warning.

596005.text:
Battlecruiser Hijiri was previously in dock in preparation for the attack on Liberty, the ship's crew anxiously seeing other ships being assigned to their respective divisions. Finally the orders came down, Hijiri, as one of the older Komainu warships, was selected to join the Hamamatsu in the attack on Norfolk Shipyard. This assault would be equivilent to a suicide attack but they took their post with pride, knowing this opening blow would be one of the most important attacks of the war.

Upon arrival in Liberty with the Hamamatsu's combat fleet, the Hijiri engaged hostile cruisers to screen for the Hamamatsu as the Missouri arranged Liberty's forces into formation. While the Liberty formation proceeded to attack and severely damage the flagship of the attack force, Hijiri received their orders to retreat towards the Badlands to regroup with the Akatsuki later on.

These orders were never realized as the Missouri brought down its considerable firepower on the ship, leaving it yet another wreck amongst the carnage that once was the beating heart of the Liberty Navy.

596007.text: These warships are the remains of the fast attack escorts of the Akatsuki, destroyed during the ambush attack on the Battleship Alma. Despite being able to severely damage the Alma, these crews paid for it with their lives.

598002.text:
CLASS: Oder
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Butjadingen is an Oder class gunboat pressed into service by the Bundschuh. Originally launched as the Muehlhausen in the service of the Rheinland Military, it took part in the Saigon War in the Sigmas and was disabled some time in 826 AS within Sigma-13. In 834, the ship was found and taken by the Bundschuh, who refurbished the Butjadingen at Bruchsal Base and launched the ship in 836 AS.

The Gunboat Butjadingen represents the Bundschuh's contribution to the Order's calls for assistance in the Sigmas. The ship is currently acting as an escort to the Carrier Ennead.

598004.text:
The Baltimore Defense Grid is the Liberty Navy's immediate response to harden Baltimore Shipyard against further KNF Norfolk-style jump attacks. Assembled at a break-neck pace, the grid is made up of what weapons platforms the Liberty Navy already had in stock with the addition of a specialized cloak detecting satellite hastily requisitioned from the LSF.

Navy spokesmen tout the grid as a key example of the cost-effective defense-in-depth strategy that Liberty is employing mitigate further KNF attacks. Questions of what will be done to protect the vital trade-lanes linking Baltimore to the rest of Liberty have so-far been left unanswered.

598006.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Block IVc
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

Constructed at Norfolk shipyard between 826 and 829 AS, Battlecruiser Chickamauga's existence itself was threatened from its very beginning. Post-war budget cuts to the Navy nearly saw the ship broken up for scrap while it was still on the stocks. Only the intervention of the LSF allowed the ship's completion. The Liberty Security Force provided funding for the remaining construction of Chickamauga after the Navy agreed it would be launched as an LSF ship upon completion. Even this proved overly ambitious, as a change of LSF leadership lead to the nearly completed Chickamauga being cut from the LSF's budget just six months after the signing of the agreement. Chickamauga's limbo was finally broken when a congressional budgetary inquiry found that it would cost the government more to break up the ship at Norfolk than it would to finish its construction. And so, Battlecruiser Chickamauga was the first Interdictor launched post-Gallic War.

Chickamauga came outfitted with only the most basic of Navy systems aboard, with none of the LSF upgrades its sisters Lehigh and Tuscaloosa had. With LSF leadership ambivalent on how to utilize the new ship, and no extra budget to outfit the battlecruiser for reconnaissance work, it was decided to assign Chickamauga to Chadwick Station in Zone-21 where it would serve as guard ship for the next six years. Over its service, Chickamauga has acted as both a training ship for new LSF combat pilots and a stalwart guard of Liberty's secrets deeper within Zone-21. In 833, it received modest upgrades to keep communications and weapons systems up to date, but no dedicated LSF upgrades were ever proposed for the ship.

In 836, when Kusari launched a surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard, Chickamauga was one of the first ships to respond. Chickamauga's fighter wing, mostly consisting of LSF ensigns, was sent forward to join the defense immediately, and Chickamauga put its pristine engines to good use and joined Missouri's battle group. Chickamauga arrived too late to stop the Hamamatsu's final maneuver, but the ship's weapons fire and fighters joined in the fight to chase off the remaining Kusari forces into the Badlands. Following the attack, it has returned to Zone-21 and has been joined by the LSF cruiser Tallapoosa to serve as the anchor of Liberty's Zone-21 defense force.

598007.text:
CLASS: Defiant
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

Liberty Gunboats were mass-produced for several centuries, however, in recent decades the Navy cut down production rates in favor of more powerful Cruisers and Defender-class fighters.

598008.text:
CLASS: Archer
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

Possessing a massive coaxially mounted cannon capable of unleashing terrible firepower across vast distances, the venerable cruiser has long stood as deterrent against foreign incursion. While possessing light conventional armaments, the awe-inspiring speed and slim profile of this craft provides a strong edge against the battering of larger craft.

598012.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Block Ia
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Omaha was one of the first Interdictor class battlecruisers produced. Launched from Norfolk Shipyard in 816, it carried on the legacy of the Liberty Dreadnaught of the same name lost in the Colony Wars. Omaha saw action in Texas during the Hudson War and supported Liberty's deep raids into Rheinland once the Hudson and Bering gates were blown. Being one of the first Interdictors made, it had many prototype systems aboard and suffered continual issues with the ship's temperamental power transfer systems. Once the Hudson War drew to a close, the danger of the Gallic advance into California demanded it press on despite its flaws. Omaha was transferred to California where it acted as an escort of the Battleship Yukon. Once the Battleship Carcassonne surrendered in 826, Omaha was withdrawn from front line service and sent to Juneau Shipyard to receive upgrades to bring it on-par with the rest of the Interdictor class. These upgrades were completed by 827, however Omaha's electrical issues were never fully resolved. The battlecruiser was found to be surplus to Navy requirements, and so Omaha was mothballed without ever having left Juneau.

In 836, Kusari launched a surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard. Several of Omaha's newer sisters were damaged or destroyed in the attack, and the Liberty Navy found themselves without sufficient Interdictor coverage for the first time since the Gallic War. A new Interdictor crew was throw together from the Sailors of its sisters who were wounded, on liberty, or otherwise absent during the attack on Norfolk. Omaha was rapidly brought back online and, without any work beyond what was absolutely necessary, the circa 827 Interdictor was kicked out the door to free up shipyard space and provide for the defense of Liberty once more.

598040.text:
CLASS: Archer (Modified)
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The LPI Raleigh started its life as LNS Raleigh, an Archer class cruiser commissioned in 789. The cruiser was removed from the Navy Registry following the end of the Hudson war. Raleigh was among several cruisers given to the LPI on the insistence of the Governor of Texas, Archie 'Long Shot' McKenny, who relentlessly campaigned Congress to provide surplus military equipment to law enforcement. The LPI was happy enough to receive the ship for free, but concrete plans on how to utilize the overly capable and expensive to operate ship never fully materialized.

Raleigh was transferred to the Texas System as part of an LPI special response force to handle emergency situations usual LPI patrols could not. Raleigh has seen limited action sense. Of note was the ship's participation in the attack on Bering in 827, serving as augmentee to the Battleship Concord's strike group. While it had only been assigned to act rear-guard and secure the Texas gate while Navy forces went ahead, Raleigh and its small guard force proved themselves when they came under attack by an ad-hoc group of Insurgency ships lead by one of the Insurgency's Judicator Class cruisers. For the first time in LPI service, Raleigh's main cannon came to life. In the fierce battle that ensued, the cruiser and its escorts successfully held off the attackers until Navy reinforcements arrived. Raleigh's conduct earned the ship's crew special commendations from both the Chief of the LPI and the Navy. Raleigh returned to Texas, where the cruiser was moored once more.

In 836, following the attack on Norfolk, the LPI was given responsibility to enforce anti smuggling measures at Liberty's border in both Texas and California. Raleigh was picked to lead the LPI task force at the Hudson Gate in Texas, with the LPI noting Raleigh's heavy firepower would allow the cruiser to rapidly respond to any incursion.

598045.text:
CLASS: Archer (Modified)
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The LPI Fort Worth started its life as LNS Fort Worth, an Archer class cruiser commissioned in 784. The cruiser was removed from the Navy Registry following the end of the Hudson war. Fort Worth was among several cruisers given to the LPI on the insistence of the Governor of Texas, Archie 'Long Shot' McKenny, who relentlessly campaigned Congress to provide surplus military equipment to law enforcement. Fort Worth was left on the stocks of Norfolk for nearly a year before the LPI finally took possession of the cruiser. Being over 30 years old and requiring specialized and expensive maintenance for a police vessel, Fort Worth was instead mothballed and stored away at Fort Bush.

Pulled out of storage in 829, Fort Worth was given enough attention to get flying and performed intermittent service with the LPI in the New York system, responding as the LPI's heavy battering ram to Insurgency raids. During a sortie near the Jersey Debris Field, Fort Worth experienced a collision with debris that knocked out the cruiser's forward gun. The ship returned to Fort Bush shortly after, where the LPI once again mothballed the ship.

In 836, following the attack on Norfolk, the LPI was given responsibility to enforce anti smuggling measures at Liberty's border in both Texas and California. Fort Worth was dragged out of storage and hastily earmarked to lead the LPI task force at the Bering Gate in Texas. The LPI have made repairs to the forward gun for the deployment, but there are no live-fire tests of the main armament on record.

598052.text:
CLASS: Archer (Modified)
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The LPI Dodge City started its life as LNS Dodge City, an Archer class cruiser commissioned in 787. The cruiser was removed from the Navy Registry following the end of the Hudson war. Dodge City was among several cruisers given to the LPI on the insistence of the Governor of Texas, Archie 'Long Shot' McKenny, who relentlessly campaigned Congress to provide surplus military equipment to law enforcement. Dodge City was stationed in California at Border Station San Diego.

The Dodge City quickly earned its stripes as the Gallic War increased in intensity. The LPI found themselves continually tasked with escort duties for convoys coming from and moving to Bretonia where Naval ships could not be spared, and so the Dodge City was given the duty of escorting convoys from the Magellan Gate to New York. Dodge City came under attack no less than 17 times during such escort missions, and as the war dragged on Dodge City ship began to take on the appearance of a patchwork Ship of Theseus from how many of its hull segments were replaced. When the end of the war came, the cruiser was relegated to performing only limited duties from its home of Border Station San Diego.

In 836, following the attack on Norfolk, the LPI was given responsibility to enforce anti smuggling measures at Liberty's border in both Texas and California. Dodge City was dispatched from San Diego to the Cortez Gate with James B. Hickok and John H. Holliday in tow. Together, the ships are ensuring no threats enter California through the Cortez Gate.

598077.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Block IVe
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Midway was the last Interdictor Class battlecruiser to be launched by the Liberty Navy. Ordered in 831, the ship was laid down a year later in Juneau Shipyards. Liberty had already declared victory against the Insurgency, and in the aftermath of the campaign it was decided to slash all Intercessor Class ships with the exception of the Midway - mostly out of a desire to keep highly skilled shipyard workers employed and production lines open. Kept in Juneau Shipyards, Midway became a testbed of innovation, with yard workers even taking time to port over the latest technology developed for the Akhetaten-class. With the Navy preferring to accept delays and focus on keeping their workforce trained, Midway's construction slowed to a crawl. Midway's construction only accelerated in 835 following the rise of tensions between Liberty and Kusari. Midway was launched to modest fanfare in mid 836.

Midway found itself in the Alaskan Corridor on shakedown cruise when Kusari launched their surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard. Without ammunition or a fighter complement, Midway's crew could only listen in as comms traffic describing the attack came in. The following day, Midway returned Juneau to take on a full wartime ammunition load and was hastily assigned one of Juneau's own elite fighter wings.

Untested, but with some of the most modern equipment in the Navy, Midway has been given the task of marshalling the Navy's strength in Southern Colorado. The ship now commands the mobilization of reserve forces into the system and acts as Jump Gate Control for the New York Jump Gate. Even more than 1000 years after the Battle of Midway was fought in Sol, the ship's name is an irony and weight that is not lost upon the crew.

598099.text:
CLASS: Interdictor Block IIc
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED

The Saratoga was launched in 822 from Juneau Shipyard near the end of the Hudson War. The ship saw limited action in Ontario acting as a mobile base and using its fighter wing to contend with Xeno and Hellfire Legion raids. On the conclusion of the Treaty of Atka and the reshuffling of Liberty's forces, Saratoga took up internal security duties in Alberta and was credited for anti piracy patrols between Camrose Supply Depot and Leduc Station. When Liberty's role in the Gallic War increased, Saratoga oversaw the safe shipment of supplies to Leduc Station which ensured the success of Ageira and DSE's COLD LAKE project. While Saratoga was not part of the initial wave of reinforcements sent to beleaguered Bretonia, in 826 when Gallic forces initiated the Siege of New London, Saratoga was called forward to Bretonia as part of Liberty's fleet serge effort. One of many ships to take part in the breaking of the siege, Saratoga was afterwards assigned to the Battleship Ottawa's task force and saw action during the Battle of the New London Gate in Leeds. Saratoga's fierce actions ensured the gate was secured despite the loss of the Ottawa. While it was too late to save Leeds, Saratoga arrived in time to engage the surrounded Gallic forces and was credited with sinking two Gallic Royal Navy cruisers near the planet and shared credit for sinking one Gallic battlecruiser in the route to Edenborough.

Following the Gallic war, Saratoga went through a modernization program that saw the ship equipped to modern if modest post war Interdictor standards. While many of the ship's sisters were mothballed after the war, Saratoga was not. Instead, the ship was given the task of reconfronting old foes and flew against the Insurgency fleets in Bering and the march through Kansas. With the conclusion of the campaign, Saratoga was reassigned to the Colorado System for border patrol duties. While there were proposals to refit Saratoga to more modern standards, Kusari's attack on Norfolk shipyard in 836 put an end to any plans to that.

Saratoga watches over the Galileo gate in Colorado with its escorts, the cruisers Oakland and Bakersfield. While the battlecruiser's officers have repeatedly requested new orders in the wake of the outbreak of the war, the battlecruiser remains formally assigned to border patrol duties for now.

600002.text:
Bounty Hunter Transport "The Big Cash"
A modified Border Worlds "Armadillo" Armored Transport, able to conveniently act as tiny carrier specifically for a Sawback-class Heavy Fighter as well as several combat drones.

This ship is the mobile base of "Lucky's Hunters", led by Lucille "Lucky" Bucks. As the head of the operation that cleared out Eska's Rogues on Curacao, Bucks gained both money and favor among Orbital Spa & Cruise. In order to provide additional protection for the wealthy and influential clientele visiting the planet, Orbital hired her and her band of bounty hunters - among many other groups - to prevent violent escalations on Curacao between citizens of Kusari and Liberty.

Giving up the on-paper cargo space for the sake of a drone launcher, "The Big Cash" tricked many rookie pirates into underprepared attacks on what they assumed to be just another transport filled with valuable goods. Instead of dropping freight containers, the transport releases multiple modified mining drones from the cargo bay, swarming and overwhelming the bandits while the transport's turrets rain hellfire down on them. Bucks herself is known to finish the job from the cockpit of her Sawback-class Heavy Fighter, the "Dragonhawk".

"The Big Cash" is usually accompanied by an Orca-class Gunboat named "Power Surgeon", piloted by Lucille Bucks' younger siblings, Kilian and Selene Bucks. Among unlawfuls, not knowing where the gunboat is counts as a bad omen.

655420.text:
L-584-B "Oasis"-class Passenger Liner

Orbital Spa and Cruise boasts of having a fleet of the most luxurious vessels available, but in order to maintain that image it must periodically decommission its existing liners to make way for new ships. Rather than scrapping ships that still have substantial working life left in them, OS&C sells them on the open market. While its early life is dedicated to luxury travel, most of a Liner's productive life is spent on less glamorous occupations.

House governments often purchase liners for use as prisoner transports, troop transports, or even fleet support ships for transporting supplies and other logistics purposes. Passenger Liners are also used by corporations and Houses for regional passenger transportation. The facilities on Liners are also ideal for long term scientific expeditions because there is more than adequate space on the passenger decks for scientific equipment, and the ship's substantial life support capabilities are designed for large crews, so that smaller scientific teams using the vessels do not require frequent resupply.

Several companies claim to have built the original model that would later become the Mender. Contrary to the newer Nomad species, the Labraid does not have the undulating tendrils of light that has become synonymous the Nomads and appear prominently on the Labraid's bigger brother the Rabisu. 655474.text:
"Marduk" Nomad Void Archon

Over the course of the year 824 AS these Nomad specimen have gradually superseded the previous Marduk species that has roamed the far reaches of the Omicron systems since the end of the Nomad War. The new Marduk's main body can be separated in three main parts that are roughly spherical and connected through a narrow column that is vulnerable to attacks. Through the opaque skin bathed in its own bioluminescence, gestating shapes are occasionally visible, giving credence to the theory that these Nomad specimen, are, in fact, breeders able to reproduce asexually or a type of carrier, able to transport smaller Nomads. However, nobody has ever observed the process given the novelty of this species and therefore, the theory is doubted in the scientific community, given that the Nomads have also multiplied before this Nomad species appeared.

Like the other new Nomad species, the Marduk also sports an array of undulating tendrils of light that are arranged symmetrically around its massive body. Smaller Nomad ships tend to flock around these tendrils and follow the Marduk as it moves just to flit away suddenly. Specked with weapon cysts across its entire mass, the Marduk is a formidable enemy that fights ever more viciously the more injuries it sustains. However, its death appears to momentarily disorient smaller Nomad ships in the vicinity.

Even bigger than the Marduk, the Ish'tar has three arm-like growths arranged around its midsection in a triangular manner that are able to unleash a torrent of devastation over long distances able to punch through even the strongest battleship hulls. Mesermizing bioluminescent lights dance across the skin of this behemoth, the undulating tendrils of light belying the stultifying hideousness left behind in the wake of any appearance of this creature.

655486.text:

Perhaps the most curious Nomad life form ever observed, the Simurgh does not seem to possess any offensive potential like all other Nomad species do. Its shape is roughly that of a slightly arced dodecahedron, where each edge emitts a large, undulating tendril of light that sways rhythmically to the movements of the alien creature. It seems to have no purpose, simply appearing in places to observe, and quickly leaving if the situation becomes dangerous for it, disappearing in a cloud of blue particles just to appear elsewhere. However, those who have seen this species report to have been transfixed by its beauty, some even going so far as to unconsciously draw the creature's shape with their fingers or a pen. Whatever the purpose of this Nomad is, it is far more insidious than anything the Nomads have employed so far.

655530.text:
DI-3 "Wyvern" Kusari Very Heavy Fighter

The Wyvern is a sleek and modern departure from the aged arsenals peddled by Samura, marketed as an alternative to the lighter and potentially lacking Chimaera that still sees active service with the Naval Forces. Despite harsh criticism and pressures, Kishiro continued development of the prototype and managed to successfully land a contract for mass production and official adoption of the series. This was owed entirely to the fact that the ship boasted an array of electronic support systems and defenses otherwise unheard of by Kusari's fighter pilots.

The test flights themselves spoke volumes, and no critic could contest cold hard facts when push came to shove. Samura has likely not forgotten this slight, but Kishiro considers the success of the design a proud achievement nonetheless, perhaps more so on account of their competitor's chagrin.

655542.text:
"Dunlin" Retrofit Explorer

The Dunlin, a ship of supposedly Junker origin, is based on an incomplete set of blueprints loosely followed by few independent ship builders. The internal structure of these vessels often vary from builder to builder and are generally improvised from any materials and components available in the region, whether handmade, salvaged, or "borrowed". It is not uncommon for these vessels to be refurbished and refitted with different internals and reused multiple times rather than being discarded due to wear and tear.

With its self-sufficient design and its durability and versatility as a deep space exploration vessel, the ship quickly earned the nickname of "Poor Man's Corvo". Despite lacking the research capabilities or safety standards of its Zoner-built counterpart, most Dunlins can be retrofitted with a docking bay to allow for servicing smaller vessels, or with basic mining and processing equipment enabling extraction of essential materials and fuel from natural sources on longer-range expeditions.

With hostilities between various factions on the rise, and a renewed wave of piracy grinding over Sirius' outer bounds, Canarian came up with the ideal solution: a marriage between the ZC-240 gunboat and a medium transport. Thus, the ZC-410 Peregrine frigate was born. Covered in thick layers of reinforced armor and sporting a heavy power core capable of supplying an array of powerful turrets with energy, the Peregrine is the perfect ship for any captain looking to cross the Border Worlds unescorted, easily capable of fending off smaller pirate attacks on its own. While offering less cargo space than transports of a similar size, the ZC-410 exceeds in survivability, firepower, and maneuverability, outperforming even some dedicated gunboats.

655569.text:
Kusari "Ikazuchi"-class Prototype Destroyer

Kusari's internal political landscape has long been characterized by many noble clans competing for power and the favor of the imperial throne. Arguably, there is no better way for a family to attract the public's gaze than directly supporting House Kusari as a concrete manifestation of their wealth, connections, and ingenuity.

The "Ikazuchi" project is one of such attempts. Two sister ships of the class were built by Samura and Kishiro under the supervision of the imperial engineers from Kure, with the design and specifications for both ships sponsored by a powerful clan under the condition that the trials be conducted under their purview.

These twin cruisers were enhanced with made-to-order communications arrays inspired by the capabilities of Kishiro's "Jintsuriki" sensor suite, as well as additional armor protection to enhance the combat capabilities of the infamous "Hatchet"-class that their basic design is adapted from. After suitable trials using these two ships are conducted, the ship is expected to be produced for regular use by the Kusari Naval Forces as an alternative to the "Hatchet" in due course.

655572.text:
CTP-H "Cyclone" Coalition Heavy Transport

With the Coalition's need for natively built transport vessels becoming ever more apparent to the Supreme Council and Premier's Office, a special design bureau of shipwrights and political advisors was formed to begin work on the Coalition Transport Project.

The first design to pass the prototype stage and enter manufacturing, the Cyclone heavy transport takes cues from both a never built destroyer design and the proven Hurricane-class battle cruiser. Abiding by the government's directive to minimize material costs while maximizing ease of maintenance and modularity, the Cyclone is little more than two rows of pressurized cargo containers wrapped in several layers of thick but inexpensive steel plating. This simple but sturdy assembly is propelled by a pair of heavy-duty fusion engines recovered from decommissioned Typhoon-class destroyers.

With initial production runs proving themselves immensely capable at rapidly and reliably moving large bulks of goods across Coalition space, the Supreme Council expects the Cyclone to revolutionize the small nation's logistics and industry.

Safeguarding Samura's business interests across Kusari space and beyond has never been an easy task, but one that throughout the corporation's early years could be reliably handled by contractors and state authorities. Following the violent coup of 321 A.S., however, Samura found itself threatened by a new, more daunting enemy than the humble pirates and highwaymen who roamed Kusari's trade lanes. Striking from the nebulae and asteroid fields came the Blood Dragons, seeking bloody vengeance against those who orchestrated the death of their shogun and the slaughter of their brethren. And so, Samura was forced to create its own security wings.

The J5 Tetsu serves as a lighter, more fuel efficient alternative to the larger Hagane, designed for long-range escorts and scouting missions. With greater maneuverability, it can easily navigate the explosive gas clouds and treacherous asteroid fields of Kusari's farthest reaches, without making any significant sacrifices to its defensive or offensive capabilities. 655721.text:
Samura J7 "Hagane" Kusari Civilian Very Heavy Fighter

Safeguarding Samura's business interests across Kusari space and beyond has never been an easy task, but one that throughout the corporation's early years could be reliably handled by contractors and state authorities. Following the violent coup of 321 A.S., however, Samura found itself threatened by a new, more daunting enemy than the humble pirates and highwaymen who roamed Kusari's trade lanes. Striking from the nebulae and asteroid fields came the Blood Dragons, seeking bloody vengeance against those who orchestrated the death of their shogun and the slaughter of their brethren. And so, Samura was forced to create its own security wings.

No longer willing to rely upon open market ships produced by foreign - and therefore untrustworthy - manufacturers, the J-series represents Samura's first foray into the production of dedicated civilian combat craft. At the head of this new family of ships is the J7 Hagane, a well-armored yet nimble, reliable and easily maintained fighter. Able to keep up in maneuverability and firepower with the hand-crafted vessels of the Blood Dragons, the cheaply mass-producible Hagane is set to quickly replace the CTE vessels that previously made up Samura security's ranks.

655729.text:
Edison MV-822 "Arrastra" Civilian Heavy Miner

The first attempt at creating an autonomous deep space mining vessel rolled off the production line at Edison Shipyard, Colorado around 312 AS. A direct result of the Colorado Silver Rush, many smaller entrepreneurs wishing to risk their fortunes on striking silver invested their entire savings into one of these vessels. Capable of self-sustained deep-space flight for over 3 months, the vessel is considered to be autonomous within a solar system. It does not have the capability to bridge the stars themselves unassisted, however. Edison Shipyard flourished for over two centuries, its interior construction bays filling orders of these craft as fast as it could produce them. As word of these vessels spread to the other Houses (in no small part due to Interspace pushing it's trade lane network outward) additional orders began to pour in.

The ship has been upgraded over the years, but the basic framework has remained the same. A generous crew compartment capable of housing five people, adequate regenerative life support systems, and a cargo pod capable of storing up to three months worth of provisions have all been added. Three independent reactors keep the craft's systems powered, and allow for the strongest defensive measures a ship of its size can muster.

655733.text:
Edison-Samura MV-622 "Scraper" Civilian Medium Miner

As mining operations pushed outward, the limitations of the Surveyor quickly became apparant to the fledgeling colonies. It was not suited to retrieve a large amount of cargo, and it could not operate autonomously for more than a few days, which limited their operations to roughly 50 kilometers around a friendly port. This hurt Kusari in particular - which was already starting to near the limits of the asteroid fields in range of New Tokyo. Samura engineers began modifying a few Surveyor ships, adding a dedicated mining array in a forward assembly, and replacing the existing one with additional storage and life support. Thus the "Risosugyazara" was born in 180 AS, although it quickly gained the nickname "Scraper" among it's pilots. As it was still far from clear whether the colonies would thrive, Kusari, in a never repeated act of generosity, shared the design with all the four Houses, so that humanity itself would have a better chance at survival. The design was quickly adopted in all of Sirius.

Although over the years improvements have been made, the basic design is still the same. A small mining array and processor in the nose of the craft can pre-refine most minerals, and the robotic claws that provide its nickname can still be employed to latch the vessel to a medium sized asteroid, while either concussion torpedos or a large-scale blaster tears it to pieces. As with the Surveyor, miners have been known to employ their tools defensively, and over the years the upsurge in piracy has prompted mining companies to fit some defensive weapons to their Scrapers.

655737.text:
Edison MV-422 "Surveyor" Civilian Light Miner

An old design that has been continuously updated and upgraded, the Surveyor is one of the few ships that still has its roots back in Sol. A large number of these vessels was loaded on each sleeper ship, designed to allow the fledgeling colonies to quickly send out scouts, in order to seek out resources that could be used to make the new colonies prosper. Lightly armed and armored, these craft depend more on agility than endurance to perform their jobs.

Typically armed with a limited number of concussion torpedoes, a few light blasters, a small mining laser and sampling equipment, a Surveyor's primary task is to seek out the richest pockets of high grade resources, so the larger mining vessels can come in and harvest them. The torpedoes are generally used to break up larger asteroids, but threatened miners have been known to employ them defensively. Cheap to operate, a number of companies have begun using the Surveyor as an auxiliary mining vessel, using it to speed up existing mining operations without risking more costly assets.

Fewer vessels have posed as much of a headache for Ageira's Universal ID system than this line of craft.

Encompassing the Junker spirit of ingenuity and manufacturing genius, each of these ships are hand tailored to meet, more or less, schematics passed down generation by generation within respective Junker clans and families.

While the traditions surrounding the forging of these ships vary from family to family, from being made to assemble the vessels using parts scavenged by the rest of the clan to being made to find the components of their own accord through barter and clever "liberation" of components

Originally built by Zoners for Zoners, due to the rapidly increasing demand for this vessel by outsider parties, the blueprints for this ship finally found its way to open-market and has since been utilized by many enthusiasts of deep space exploration and research, in every corner of the colonies.

Powerful, luxurious, and with a design steeped in tradition, it represents all of Kusari's greatest values. With an awe-inspiring design and an interior comparable in luxury and artistry only to the Imperial Palace itself, the Amaterasu is the pinnacle of Samura Industries' shipbuilding. Dwarfing even some battlecruisers while being their equal in terms of armament, it was in fact only through arduous lobbying that Samura convinced both government and military officials to permit the civilian ownership of such a vessel. Breton KS-35 "Serenity" Civilian Transport

Conceived by Breton Workshops at the onset of the Gallic invasion of Bretonia, the KS-35 Serenity began its life as a test bed for large scale implementation of modular manufacturing processes previously proven by the successful DS-2 Voyager. Kishiro has used the production of the Big Dragon to model its mass production techniques, which has allowed them to vastly expand their production capacity.

The Big Dragon has also been a huge seller on the Kusari commercial market, and has found its way into all corners of Kusari, being used by pilots of all stripes. It is even rumored that some have been integrated into the fleets of the GC and Farmers Alliance.

A new solution was needed to increase the effectiveness of Hacker fleet and to expand its range of operations. The gunship was designed to provide both greater tactical reconnaissance and heavy combat support.

The "Interloper" continues the Lane Hacker tradition of incorporating an advanced electronic warfare suite into it's already powerful arsenal. BT485 "l'Ane" Gallic Blackmarket Transport

Now when men dream, they dream of the Regent, of pools laid beneath the stars, of bar service, of Zeus's chariot with their name on the deed, of Aphrodite admiring the trim, while Eris charts the party's course.

The final culmination of personal glory and accumulated wealth, the Regent ferries her charges with agility, security and unmatched grace. With dual countermeasures, a slim profile and enough firepower to knock a small moon out of orbit, as once demonstrated against a hapless Maine by one furiously intoxicated Jay Simon of Interspace Commerce, there is no greater combination of style and security within the colonies of man.

What they got was the Recycler.

Seeing a greater need for a quick way to transport large amounts of materials from one place to another, the corporations of Sirius quickly looked to refine the functional design of the average transport. The result of the refining was the Large Transport. Boasting a greater cargo hold than it's predecessor, the Albatross is mainly used by the corporations of Sirius where lots of goods need to be moved quickly. Much like it's predecessor, the vessel sacrifices flash for functionality.

656403.text:
L-584 "Enterprise" Luxury Liner

The Luxury Liner was initially designed for Orbital Spa and Cruise by the renowned ship architect, Peter Englund, a designer employed by White Spa Lines, a subsidiary arm of Orbital Spa and Cruise itself.

Orbital Spa and Cruise ordered several of the vessels, the most notable of which are the tourist liners Hawaii and Shetland, although there are known to be several others. With all the latest in holographic entertainment and artificial persons, as well as utilizing the latest in VI technology, the liners are the pinnacle of luxurious ship design and architecture, allowing OSC VIPs and dignitaries to travel in style.

656404.text:

In the economy of the Sirius system, all of the Houses benefit from the everyday service of this craft. being one the first modern commercial transport class ships designed, while no one house has been credited the very basic design, but without its creation, it is widely known that Sirius today would be a very different place. Having two Cargo Pods in its underbelly, the Transport's design is based solely on function. Not a flashy ship, the Gull is the mainstay of every shipping corporation within Sirius.

656416.text:
Combat Service Vehicle (CSV)

The CSV slowly worked its way into contemporary use, not long after the official recognition of the emergence of the "Junker" population. The precursors of this vessel can be found in the myriad designs employed by individual Junker homebrewed designs found cruising about the inner system junk fields.

The pure economical genius of the craft found itself many admirers in the form of commercial engineering and space lifting companies, who quickly clamored for access to these vessels for their own purposes (much to the dismay of commercial vessel retailers).

Since then, the Junkers have made a tidy business issuing this small but hardy freighter for the use of the greater population of Sirius, though not without occasional "ingenious" refinements to plans and purpose that have been attributed to roughly 40% of all hair loss in official maintenance and design document producers.

656426.text:
"Labraid" Nomad Voidrunner

First encountered by Order forces in the Omicrons, scouring the deep reaches of space for new resources and locations. Identified as an organism, the voidrunner is incredibly agile and capable of delivering devastating barrages of energy at their intended targets with terrible accuracy and precision. While almost never seen traveling alone, it seems that damaged voidrunners attract the attention of other voidrunners in the area, drawing more and more to the location.

656427.text:
"Nammu" Nomad Mindnode

Nomad Mindnodes are large morphs that often accompany their smaller brethren to the far-reaches of Nomad territory. It is believed that Mindnodes are responsible for communications with the Nomad "Mindshare" network to a degree. When Mindnodes accompanying Voidrunners were destroyed, the Voidrunners appeared disoriented for several minutes before resuming attacks. Despite their role in the Nomad castes, this creature is still a force to be reckoned with. Far more maneuverable than any vessel their size, these organisms can deal and absorb enormous amounts of damage.

656428.text:
Nomad "Marduk" Guardian

Seen in densely Nomad populated systems, the Marduk is thought of to be the "mastermind" amongst the Nomad species. Highly developed and evolved, the Marduk possesses multiple loricate cysts that allow it to generate and produce multiple Nomad Veils around its enormous body. Highly evolved, this Nomad morph possesses a resilient exospore, much like those formed around dormant Nomad organisms, that gives it additional protection to weapons and the elements. Smaller nomad vessels seem to swarm around Guardians and will ferociously defend the vessel if it is attacked. It is recommended that contact with these behemoths is avoided.

To avoid the loss of all the invested credits, The Corsair Council contacted friendly groups and offered the prototype and the design copies for sale. The Hogosha were the only interested group, and the project went to them. Corsair engineers stripped the prototype of all its high tech equipment and installed a Samura power core provided by the Hogosha. The final result provides greatly enhanced cargo hold, crew amenities and grace of movement. Samura was not willing to build further numbers in their own shipyards to avoid more internal and external diplomatic complications so The Farmer's Alliance offered to produce the Raba at their shipyards at Cape Soya Station, in exchange for the permission to build a number for their own purposes. Today, the Raba is active among both the Hogosha and Farmer's Alliance fleets.

656444.text:
Leviathan class Warship

The Leviathan was discovered a long time ago by Zoner deep space explorers. It was half buried in the sands of a barren high gravity planet and lifted into space with great effort.

Later it was brought to the heavy shipyard now known as Livadia Shipyards. Almost the entire Zoner capital ship fleet is derived from the technology gained from this ship. Little is known about it and Zoners never tell anyone but the most trusted about it.

The ship's frame is supported by a superstructure that allows this ship to be significantly larger than any other ship in Sirius, a technology that was used in the derived Nephilim designs. Its armor consists of ablative plating, capable of reflecting most energy weapons, making the shell of this ship one of the heaviest while at the same time being relativly thin. The ship is powered by a singularity reactor which Zoners managed to reactivate and maintain, but do not understand well enough to replicate.

Generous spacing for the crew, heavy weapons, and multiple shield generators round out the ship. To date, Zoners have managed to restore the original wreck and deploy it as a guard ship, but little is known about the ongoing project "Leviathan."

656461.text:
Kusari "Tokugawa"-class Battleship

Engineered by Samura Heavy Industries for the Naval Forces following the coup of 321 AS the vessel was built to serve as a hallmark for the new dynasty. Surpassing contemporary Houses' counterparts in size, it is the highest symbol of Kusari military power and it has, in following Kusari tradition, a very extensive lifetime for a hull of this type. The ever progressing march of these massive war vessels into Bretonian territory despite all efforts at opposition stand as grim tribute to the vessel's original craftsmanship and Kusari's ability to blend the artisan lines of tradition with the deadly efficiency of modern innovation.

656462.text:
Kusari "Takeda"-class Destroyer

Commonly referred to as 'The Hatchet' by the Bretonian Armed Forces due to its evident shape, and ability to cleave a fiery path through defensive lines, the Kusari Destroyer is often mistaken for a heavy gunboat at range. While fragile in comparison to its heavier counterparts in the destroyer class the Kishiro built vessel easily outclasses many vessels twice its size.

656463.text:
Kusari "Ashikaga"-class Gunboat

In an effort to better enforce the will of the Emperor, the Imperial Navy and Kishiro Technologies developed this ship. With her small hull profile this gunboat is agile and higly maneuverable compared to other gunboats. In large numbers they are particularly devastating.

656464.text:
"Pelican" Civilian Armored Transport

The Pelican and its predecessors have served the police forces and travel services of Sirius for centuries, safely ferrying prisoners and tourists to their destination and capable of turning would-be raiders into an impressive fireworks display. Modern Pelicans are built in a wide variety of configurations ranging from prisoner transports and raw material haulers to exploration vessels and luxury yachts. They have recently seen a surge in popularity among freelancers thanks to the specialized Cormorant variant, which allows for a smaller crew and heavier armor than the typical commercial versions.

656465.text:
"Hercules" Civilian Base Construction Platform

The Hercules-class is designed for one specific purpose: modular installation construction at-scale. With a limited hold just large enough for the core components necessary for an outpost, the Hercules sees use among militaries, outlaws, and homesteaders alike. Constructing an outpost using its specialist nano-assembly equipment requires only an initial supply of basic and super alloys, industrial materials, optronics, construction machinery, and nanocapacitors. Typically, Hercules-class gantries only create a habitable temporary worksite for onboard engineering teams, who will then take over with conventional construction.

656466.text:
CTE CT-53 "Heron" Civilian Train

As the spaces between bases increased and so did their commercial potential, these enormous transports were developed to carry larger loads. Tasked with the shipping of freight beyond the threads of civilization represented by the Trade Lanes the Heron class of transport, the first of the Train class, maintains fantastic manouverability for a vessel of its size and amenity with an economy of movement and production.

656467.text:
CTE CT-69 "Crane" Civilian Large Train

The success of the Heron class freight train led civilian transport companies to continue the development. A logical development was the addition of an extra cargo link. The freight engine was redesigned to supply the additional power required to safely ferry the extra weight, and reinforced linkages carry the additional strain on the chassis. These modifications are very expensive however. Its cost makes the vessel rather rare, mainly used on long distance routes between the houses.

656468.text:
Samura-Kishiro N20j "Drone" Kusari Civilian Freighter

A second joint project between Samura and Kishiro, the "Drone" project followed the success of the Akegata Transport project. Ordered by the Emperor himself, these projects were meant to push Samura and Kishiro toward closer cooperation and more standardized methods and parts. Utilizing both Samura and Kishiro specific expertise, the Drone is one of the most technologically advanced freighters on the market today. With strong armor and powerful engines developed by Samura and state of the art scanning equipment and power plant made by Kishiro, this freighter is the best of what Kusari shipbuilding has to offer.

656528.text:
IMGF-15A "Nanda Devi" Bomber

Late in the Himalayan line's design cycle it became apparant to the IMG shipwrights that an answer to heavy capital vessels had to be found. The need was acute after Gallia was revealed. The solution chosen was a practical one: Mate a freighter-sized power core with a stripped down version of the Lhotse frame, and finetune the design afterward. While visually similar to the Lhotse, the Nanda Devi class bomber is anything but the same. With dual dedicated torpedo slots, a seperate cruise disruptor slot, and the ability to power freighter sized shields, the vessel is a small flying fortress that can do massive damage. It however does not maneuver well, and is vulnerable to enemy fighters and gunboats.

Pressed into service two months after the first prototype was completed, the Nanda Devi is an unproven design that IMG engineers believe shows considerable potential.

RH-D1 "Jormungand" Red Hessian Battleship

Despite the great success of the Vidar class, the Red Hessians have found themselves time and again confronted with enemy ships that were simply large enough to overpower an attack force and required a fighting retreat to be successfully combated, by which time the enemy would have regained the initiative. The Jormungand class is the Red Hessian answer to that problem. Designed to be a breakthrough assault vessel, it is the heaviest ship in the Hessian arsenal and was modelled closely after the Bismarck class battleship used by the Rheinland Military. Following the tradition of pushing their equipment to the very limits, Hessian engineers used the excess power provided by the ship's large industrial grade fusion reactors to power a massive cannon built straight into its hull. The effectiveness of said weapon has quickly earned it a nickname appropriate with the ship's name: the Ragnarok.

GM07 "Loki Mk. I" Rheinland Black Market Heavy Fighter

The Loki Mk. I was the very first of the original Asgard line of ships, designed to replace the aging Border Worlds line and provide the Red Hessians with a vessel fit to operate in the dangerous environments of southern Sirius. The vessel turned out to be slightly slower than comparable fighters, but its stronger armament allowed it to compete against heavier fighters, frequently by catching them off guard with their torpedoes and heavy weaponry, thus giving meaning to the project's codename: "Loki", the trickster.

The Loki Mk. I however, was soon phased out in favor of the Loki Mk. II to better keep up with the Rheinland Military's own developments. 656560.text:
E56-15 "Plover" Civilian Deep Space Explorer

A rugged and sturdy vessel, a design born out of necessity. Crafting a functional and surprisingly well thought out vessel from old ship parts had long been a Junker tradition. In a joint venture, the Freelancer gang from Newport and a few Junker engineers developed the Plover, a cheap and quite easily maintained deep space explorer. Offering thick armor to protect against all kinds of environmental hazards, two powerful engines capable of traversing the ship across the vast emptiness between star systems, an extra fuel tank and on top of all this a quite roomy interior for a vessel of its size while still maintaining enough space for all kinds of supplies, the Plover is intended to serve those unable or unwilling to partake in long expeditions. While forgoing most of its offensive capabilities, the Plover is still capable of defending itself adequately for a vessel of its size.

However, Ceres Innovations prefering to address these issues the same way as a sledgehammer can unlock doors, believed it was more novel to opt for a complex structural redesign. 656615.text:
Series LG-V "Prosecutor" Liberty Black Market Very Heavy Fighter

Originally the end product of seventeen years of hard work from the Hellfire Legion's greatest minds, the Prosecutor-class Very Heavy Fighter represents a seamless blend of Libertonian, Borderworlds, and in-house Lane Hacker technology. Based off a heavily modified Series Z fighter chassis, the Prosecutor augments this classic design with thicker armour, a more robust powercore, and a slight increase in combat manoeuvrability; however, this comes at the cost of the Sabre's iconic seven-gun configuration and a reduction in its aerodynamic profile.

After the Insurgency's defeat in 830 A.S., the many remaining Prosecutor-class fighters made their way into Liberty's criminal underbelly in short order, finding new homes and new pilots among the unlawful elements that plague the House's trade lanes and asteroid fields. Further tinkering and experimentation by a myriad of different organisations has left each Prosecutor unique in its own way, and it is considered rare by those experienced with the craft to find two that fly in precisely the same manner. While it may lack the finesse of more specialised and streamlined designs, the Prosecutor remains a deadly opponent to anyone foolish enough to mistake its ramshackle design for a lack of combat capability.

656619.text:
Series LG-G "Inquisitor" Liberty Black Market Gunboat

Half gunship, half ramming frigate, the Inquisitor represents a unique divergence from conventional ship design. The central features of this rugged vessel are its unmistakable ramming blade and attached breaching module; its combat capability beyond that is almost an afterthought. While it lacks almost all the grace of its closest counterpart, the Defiant-class gunboat, the Inquisitor compensates with its robust construction, remarkable ease of maintenance, and easily modified design. Its seven turrets offer the ship withering forward firepower, designed to quickly overwhelm an adversary's shields before moving in for a boarding manoeuvre.

Under Legion and Insurgency command, its molybdenum-titanium blade was expressly designed to scythe straight through the outer layers of a capital ship's hull, sealing the breach in the same motion with quick-acting metal foam nozzles and allowing its complement of onboard marines to board in short order. Since making their way onto Liberty's decentralised black market, however, individual Inquisitors have been repurposed as their new parent organisations see fit, and the class now sees more general use as a conventional gunship for those groups unable to afford or source a more specialised craft for their needs.

656647.text:
IMGT-8C "Shishapangma" Heavy Transport

Unlike most House corporations, the Independent Miners Guild favors mining operations far from the existing network of trade lanes and Jump Gates. As IMG exploration vessels pushed out further, the Guild realised it needed a large cargo vessel capable of both bridging long distances in open space, be capable of travelling through dense asteroid fields, yet still have a large enough cargo bay to be able to carry both various types of cargo.

The Shishapangma heavy transport was designed from the ground up for this task. It features a large crew section in the nose of the ship, allowing it to carry anywhere from 50 up to 250 crew, with an emergency evacuation capacity of 1000. Supply storage pods in the bridge section allow the vessel to operate autonomously for up to 4 months with a standard crew. Strong navigational scanners mounted on the top and bottom of the bridge section allow the vessel to navigate asteroid fields without risking severe damage. In addition, the entire ship is also heavily reinforced against collisions. It's point defenses consist of 12 turrets mounted on the cargopod support struts, offering good all-round coverage. 7 standard civil transport engines provide adequate thrust for the ship, as well as redundancy in case of an engine failure.

Cargo is stored in three huge hexagonal pods, which can be seperated from the ship for a quick turn-around. The pod bay doors slide inward for easy access to the interior, which allows components almost as large as the ship's length to be stored within. While generally used for bulk transport, the interior of the cargo pods can be configured for piece goods or container freight. The cargopod interior is generally not pressurized and does not have life support capabilities.

656651.text:
RT-41-PFT "Uruz" Rheinland Container Transport

As the Rheinland Military campaign against Liberty ground down into a long, sustained conflict, much of their forces had to be tasked to the frontline. This left large gaps in the patrols at the borderworlds, in the Omega and Sigma regions. Increasingly, the heavily armored but lightly armed Colossus convoys came under pressure from Corsair and Hessian raiders. A distress call could no longer guarantee help would arrive in time.

Realising they were largely on their own beyond Rheinland's borders, Republican Shipping started to look for an alternative with more firepower. Not willing or able to invest into designing a new vessel from scratch, engineers looked through the archives until they came upon the design of a heavily armed H-Fuel transport, a relic from the 80 years war. Realising it had many of the desired characterstics, a huge cargo capacity, and an extensive point defense system to deter smaller raiders, work was started to adapt the ship as a general cargo vessel. While originally designed for gaseous or liquid cargo transporting, it's pods can now accomodate a wide variety of cargo. Its small size relative to most conventional carriers enhances the potential to operate undetected in areas of interest for extended periods of time. The formidable and very expensive "Galacticus" Battleship-grade scanner array keeps the vessel well informed about its immediate vicinity. The primary dish dominates much of the vessel's profile, and its installation required the bridge to be moved forwards above the fore observation post.

The ships are housed in custom-built shelves on the hangar walls to optimise usage of the limited space available. 656727.text:
Rheinland "Tirpitz"-class Battlecruiser


Shortly before the war with Liberty drew to a close, Rheinland began to develop a new, mid-ranged warship. The Tirpitz-class Battlecruiser is designed not just as an addition to the fleets, but an improvement as well, being heavier and more versatile than its predecessor, the Donau-class Cruiser. 656787.text:
UN "Artisan" Unioner Gunboat

The Unioner reputation for technical genius combined with a pragmatic utilisation of an inconstant and frequently self-incompatible supply pool of underworld ship components and machined goods, has lead the Unioners to favour modular, bolt-on architectures that answer the puzzle as to how the disparate organisation is able to mass produce high-performance spaceframes of frightening consistency; tailored for the rough, factional realities of the Rheinland underworld; perhaps the deadliest environment for ship and crew that the houses have to offer. Unioner spacecraft survive, and, arguably, embody, the most frightening elements of the underworld with grace and precision.

The artisan is no different, indeed, it typifies the philosophy. Born emergently out of the violence that has surrounded the revanchist syndicates in recent years, the Unions' need to replace its oxidising stockpiles of Oder gunboats with designs less intolerant of jury-rigged repairs and extended operations in asteroid fields, has led to the Artisan's creation in a technical eureka that violates hundreds of intellectual property laws. By adapting the base structural components of the Oder by ripping away what the Union callously refers to as 'expenditures in the mass budget', such as any meaningful crew creature comforts or hull sculpting, and filling the negative space with layers of Unioner proprietary armor composites, the Union has created a phantom of the asteroid belts that gives even the latest Renzu, DSE, or Daumann escort design pause before promptly crushing their pork-infused wreckage against the Artisan's hull in a display of violent disrespect. Whilst aesthetically functional, the Artisan is filled with technical sophistry that gives her a charisma all of her own, although few officers of the federal police dare get close enough to scan exactly what hardware she has under the hull. To the Unioners, the Artisan is the defender of the belts, an infinitely reconfigurable modular raider platform that lends itself to the pallet of any craftsman, from the genius shipwrights who manufacture her by hand alone in adverse conditions, to the syndicates who sortie her against a brutal cosmos.

Alike its Arbeiter and Solidaritat cousins, the Artisan upscales the fast burning thorium powerplants of the Unioner fighter line to a gigantic drive torus pushed to operating only a hair away from a criticality incident. Law enforcement personnel who first sighted the Artisan have been noted to comment derisively about the back-heavy appearance that the plus-sized reactor gives the ship, often before being blown apart by the expanse of its weapons array that reactor gly sustains. The few foreign entities that the Unioners already sold Artisan export models to have been known to voice concerns about the longevity of the vessel's flight crew over the wisdom of placing the vessel's cramped tactical bridge within several metres of the drive, a reaction to which the Syndicates of the Hammer treat with disdain. Man up, and take the iodine.

656795.text:
90-ARKM-N60E "Disir" Rheinland Very Heavy Fighter

The latest entry in Rheinland's ARKM series of military craft, the Disir was designed to complement the Valkyrie-class and make up for some of its perceived shortcomings. Though its aging sister had received a number of minor upgrades to maintain competitiveness, its basic control layout still followed the older, manually-oriented style, which combined with the ship's extremely high speed and fragility made it notoriously punishing for newer recruits. The Disir was designed from the ground up with a full complement of modern piloting aids, including predictive HUD-integrated aim assist, semi-guided fly-by-wire, and scalable automatic power management. This modernized control setup is packaged into a much sturdier frame, and paired with an upgraded version of the Valkyrie's already impressive power unit.

The new design proved immediately popular with with recruits, and large-scale production and deployment began shortly after the first trials. Among skilled veterans and purists however, many still prefer the Valkyrie, its delicate frame rewarding capable pilots with unmatched performance.

However, the typical transports available to the larger civilian market proved inadequate for Ageira's sensitive operations. 656831.text:
"Sirene"-class Spyglass Retrofit Battleship

In the Grecian mythology of old Earth, sirens were beautiful singers of enchanted music that would guide smitten sailors to strike themselves on rocks, or dive under violent seas. In Sirius's ninth century, the term siren has been colloquialised by the superstitious spacefarers of the post Nomad War era to describe signals, spacecraft and objects unidentifiable to neuralnet reference. One such rumour describes a Siren as not as a singer, but as a monster of superalloy and molydenium that guards the independent systems and asteroid belts against those who would rob them of their mysteries.

The Spyglass Battleship, to which the target object bears a forty five percent structural match, was initially a prototype of the Liberty Navy, a next generation warship developed in the years immediately before, and during, the Nomad War, alongside the Osiris cloaking dreadnought. Famously, the Spyglass testbed model, the LNS Ragnarok, was lost on an expedition to perform a survey of the Coronado system, its final recorded transmission received just prior before plunging in the vast expanse of the Barrier nebula. Thought forever lost, rumours of similar vessels have been reported by Trade Lane ambush survivors in the years 807 to 815 AS, under the employ of a fraternity of underworld organisations, including the Lane Hackers, the Liberty Insurgency, the precursors to the Natio Octavarium, amongst others. However, these fabled imitations never matched the technical sophistication of the original design. With the occupation of the entire Vespucci system in 818 AS by Hellfire forces, it is assumed by the historical record that the remaining spyglass retrofits were converted into the modern Arbiter electronics warfare dreadnoughts that remain under limited commission by the Insurgency, although rumours of spyglass sightings persist in all manner of conspiracies and tall tales.

LIDAR indicates a seventy-six-point two percent probability that the target vessel is a descendent, sister ship, or copy, of the LNS Ragnarok, however, the propulsion, weapons systems, and external hull of the target appear to be of an unknown Rheinland design, a chimera of conventionally incompatible spacecraft architectures and technological ancestries. .

656879.text:
CV-Hoffnungsschimmer

The CV-Hoffnungsschimmer is a Corvo intitially constructed at Lividia Station in 817 AS under the name CV-Eclipse. Comissioned by OS&C, the ship was intended to serve as a more exclusive and more contained variant of the usual cruise liners that usually handled OS&C's prodigious array of offers in the region of luxury tours around Sirius. As such, it was equipped with the usual comfort that was and still is the trademark of the company up until this day. Another advantage that this vessel held was that its improved shielding and armor if compared to luxury liners made it an ideal choice for more long-lasting trips into the edges of space, for example the Omega regions — only for those with the connections and credits to pay for these efforts, of course.

During one of these underhanded trips to the Omega-9 system whose planetary accretion disks being immolated by the scorching heat of the sun were a rather popular view to behold for many, there was an incident with the life support systems, and the vessel promptly returned back to where it had started, with thankfully no losses. Still, the incident had diminished the vessel's overall worth, and it was thus stripped of its position and sold to a private interest on Curacao, which, all in all, had been a rather good deal for OS&C.

Bought by Ezrael Vertiga in the year 819 AS, it was first utilized as a means of personal movement whenever it became necessary to leave Curacao, which he did not do often. After all, why would one want to leave Eden? To not let it fall into disarray from underuse, the vessel quickly found itself turned into a 'stabbin' cabin', a place to host an array of sexual debaucheries that even some of the more loose establishments upon Curacao's already pretty lenient surface would have had their problems with.

With the death of his parents and the decision to leave for the Core, the vessel was taken with him, mostly staying near Yaren Base in Omicron Delta, which was not the optimal place for it to stay, Vertiga would think in hindsight, but there had been no major Corsair incidents during his time, although there could have been. During his stay with the Core, Vertiga met a woman by the name of Maren von Westefeld, a skittish girl he would sometimes run across while in Omicron Delta and the surrounding systems. Charming, a bit clumsy, and quite clever, the woman soon managed to conquer his heart, and due to her Rheinland origin, Vertiga renamed the Corvo to Hoffnungsschimmer, the Rheinland word for 'glimmer of hope', a gesture committed as a reminder that he would like to one day have a living with this woman. There was, however, the problem of the Core. Given their unwillingness to let their minions leave, Vertiga feigned his and his Core vessel's, the Apahanta's, disappearance in order to regain his freedom. Given that his own priorities lie more within the maintenance of the Apahanta and its crew from this point on, the Hoffnungsschimmer has since then more and more fallen into the responsibilities of Maren, who had started living on the ship shortly before Vertiga left the reach of the Core. Together with Nancy Sweetwater, an ex-Reaver, and Dr. Thallia Thorn, an Ingenuus xeno-archeologist, Vertiga and Maren live on this vessel up until this day.

656931.text:
ABF-2 "Harrier" Molly Very Heavy Fighter

No longer willing to rely on the haphazard designs of the nefarious Z-Series jointly developed and constructed with the Liberty Rogues, the Mollys reached out to independent shipwrights across the shadier markets of Sirius to design a bespoke line of vessels more suited for their continued struggle against the Bretonian Crown. The greatest priority was given the conception of a brand new fightercraft, able to go head-to-head with the advanced fighters deployed by the Armed Forces. Months of development, prototyping, and testing resulted in the first successful deployment of the "Harrier". Promising performance in initial sorties against BMM operations in the Dublin system gave the Mollys the confidence to greenlight the large scale manufacturing of this new very heavy fighter.

Inspired by birds of prey native to old Earth, the "Harrier" shares with them not only its appearance but also its ferocious offensive capability and incredible straight-line speed - remarkable especially for a ship of its size. Meant to intercept the ever more heavily armored transports employed by Bretonian corporations, as well as to run down military patrols that stray too far off the beaten path, the "Harrier" is quickly proving to be the weapon that may finally sever the Mollys from their Bretonian oppressors.

Inspired by the Skeleton's versatile base frame, but upscaled and upgunned, the R1 Reaper provides Edge Worlds pilots with the necessary firepower to take on ships - and aliens - several weight classes above their own. 656989.text:
"Bulwark" Bristol-Kress Heavy Explorer

The Bulwark was designed as a cooperative venture between Bristol and Kress Industries. Built to match the treacherous demands of the Independent Worlds, it provides a potent combination of fearsome firepower and an expanded hold. This allows the ship to ferry large quantities of cargo and crew through perilous space in relative safety.

Much like the broader Kress line, the Bulwark was originally designed to prioritize versatility. However, Bristol requirements forced the addition of heavier armor and a dedicated hangar, increasing complexity and sacrificing fuel range. Bristol considered the resulting increase in cost and crew compliment worthwhile for the ability to service remote mining sites far from friendly stations.

Each Bulwark built is a financial gamble for Bristol, as the ship lacks the numerous buyers of other license-built Kress ships. With Bristol being the sole supplier of replacement parts for the exploration craft, costs to repair are exorbitant and often require a return to Bristol Bay. Due to its expense and niche design, other organizations have been slow to embrace the Bulwark.

The culmination of Technocracy mechanical ingenuity, the Nightjar is a born and bred superiority fighter. Diverse design inspirations and forbidden secrets gleaned from the depths of the Omicrons have created a ship that tumbles through conflict zones with lethal grace. Its engines respond with twitch sensitivity, while sophisticated automated systems augment the skills of even experienced pilots. Nightjar sightings are rare, with its lethality inspiring awe and fear in equal measure. Only a master or a fool would dance with this angel of death.

656997.text:
Corsair "Consul" Command Battlecruiser

The Consul Command Cruiser was designed using the lessons of recent Corsair campaigns across Bretonia and Rheinland. These heavily favored the use of Tribunus battlecruisers as a flexible carriers. While the Murmillo was originally conceived as a fast carrier, the complex, foreign design and difficulty of sourcing parts led to many of those produced spending longer in drydock than on deployment. This unreliability was further compounded when the Corsair détente with The Order collapsed in the late 810s. The Consul is a domestic answer to this problem, shuttling squadrons of Crete's warriors to combat zones where it can provide command oversight for extended periods of time. This single-minded focus on reliability has resulted in an eyewatering upfront cost, and a design that some Corsairs quietly believe is over-engineered. Despite delays to the Consul's deployment, it is intended to eventually phase out the Murmillo entirely.

T-2419-U "Archon" Modular Asteroid Miner

The Archon is a medium miner designed to accommodate gas and metal extraction operations, requiring only a payload module swap. Using an expansive forward filter array, the Archon siphons gasses and ordinance-pulverized ore fragments with an advanced field generator and tractor array. This high-tech alternative to the unsophisticated Hegemon is already drawing widespread attention.

657006.text:
S-CEV01 Starfliers "Vector"-Class Compact Exploration Vessel

Called the "little brother" of the Corvo, the Vector is designed to be an exceptional exploratory asset. A huge amount of focus was given to the subsystems, prioritizing fuel efficiency and power routing to scanning systems. The vessel's internal makeup allows for a small two man team to live on board, allowing the rest of the space to be filled with custom designed consoles. A forward-facing scanner allows identification of stellar objects at longer ranges and the undermounted hinge mechanism is designed to quickly drop off and pickup cargo pods within one maneuver. Aided by a generous cargo capacity, a bespoke dual-engine and combination hyperspace-anomaly systems, the ship is tailored exclusively towards the scientific crowd without requiring further adjustment.

Although most explorers are put off by the lack of armaments and hardware customizability, those that are willing to rely entirely on their diplomatic skills to defend their ship have found a valuable asset in the powerful scientific tools offered by the vessel. The Starfliers advise their ship is perfect for explorers and scientists alike, exceeding the "Draugr"-Class in terms of research potential. Being an extremely niche design, the "Vector"-Class isn't mass produced, rather reluctantly built on stations to be flown outside of the Houses where it best operates.

657017.text:
Feanturi class Research Vessel

The Feanturi class Research Vessel was the product of certain Zoner research groups, and their attempts to mobilize high tech research facilities due to the lack of space available on a base. The vessel was designed with the ability in mind to harbor facilities ranging in all subjects of the science tree rather than remaining under a particular subject. This thought caused the final blueprint of the vessel drafted to be quite including of technology that the Zoners used naturally due to who they were, more specifically the inclusion of the Biodome.

The original copy of the vessel harbored a special fixture on the bottom due to one of the key experiments that it was drafted to accommodate. The internal mechanisms had irregular internal systems compared to standard ships developed by the Zoners, resulting in the need for an external housing for these systems, specifically the power core. Once criticized by an external source for harboring an irregular core housing on the exterior of the ship, shielding developed by the original designers dissolved hesitation. When outside spectators observed the original prototype, rumor spread of a glow located in the special attachment of the vessel, which has been kept quiet by the original builders. The final product however was a very well functioning mobile facility if supplied well enough, making it a desirable blueprint that others are beginning to pursue without much luck.

Insurgency "Judicator" Cruiser


The third of the new ship projects put into action by Reynard Joyeuse before he departed, the Judicator Cruiser was originally designed with the Insurgency's typical modus operandi in mind - heavy assault. The ship saw several complications in its inception however, and while mass production was put on hold, the Judicator changed to fit the times that the Insurgency was facing.

Initially built around a massive experimental beam weapon, this system was gutted in favor of expanded fighter facilities, more suited for the Insurgency's more recent patrols of the neighboring systems. Other notable features include a large centrifuge to supply extra power to other systems while still giving quarters of the ship gravity and a redundant engine array system, supposedly nigh impossible to disable.

Young Legionnaires often breathe a sigh of relief after being assigned to a Judicator as they are most often relegated to backwater patrols, in addition to being considered one of the safer vessels in the Insurgency's arsenal.
