657027.text:
XAF-221G "Objector" Xeno Corvette

The Xeno clans found themselves facing an unexpected dilemma after their hard-won victory in Ontario. With territory came the responsibility of defending it—a challenge that demanded new warships. Yet, even as the need for tonnage grew, there was equal pressure to replace the aging Condor-class raiders. Fast strike gunships promised a steadier stream of plunder and resources, vital to the fledgling republic’s survival.

But the workshops could not produce both types of vessels simultaneously. Designing even a single new ship class is a daunting task—more so for a movement fresh from the crucible of violent secession, now navigating the chaos of conflicting demands and clashing priorities. And so, a bold compromise was struck. Under the leadership of Foreman David Deneault, Ramsey’s shipwrights attempted to forge a hybrid vessel—a class that would bridge the gap between a cruiser and a gunship, offering operational versatility in place of specialization.

The result was the Objector, a corvette caught between roles but not without promise. It is fast enough to chase down lighter vessels, yet armed with sufficient firepower to harass ships far larger than itself. However, its design comes with a critical flaw: weaknesses in its frontal armor make it ill-suited for direct confrontations with true warships. These vulnerabilities are the price paid for flexibility—a compromise that has sparked fierce debate among both engineers and frontline crews.

Still, the Objector fulfills its intended role, even as its place in the fleet remains controversial. Time alone will tell whether this black sheep of Ramsey’s burgeoning dockyards is a failed gamble or a misunderstood success.

657031.text:
XAF "Agitator" Mk 1 Xeno Light Fighter

The Agitator is a supposed “light” fighter that flies heavy, built around an oversized, fuel-hungry engine and a modified Foreman Ltd. array. Though sluggish and wasteful compared to true interceptors, its brute-force bursts of speed, dubbed "stumbling" - and its flexible frame make it an unpredictable opponent in the field. The jury rigged prospector array, borrowed from the Foreman Ltd. catalogue is the Agitator’s real weapon, allowing raiders to relay where loot is, call reinforcements, and keep cells coordinated across hostile space, though the system’s jury-rigged quirks often produce ghost chatter and unreliable readings. 657034.text:
Liberty "Memphis" Class Battleship

Only usable by the [LN] and 46th Official Factions

The Memphis is derived from the Osiris prototype that was stolen by The Order shortly before the Colony Wars, but with marked improvements over that now decades old design. Primarily intended for heavy scouting units, the Memphis complements the long-range role of the Interdictor battlecruisers, while boasting firepower comparable to the latest Mitchell-class dreadnoughts. This is facilitated by a state-of-the-art sensor suite, reworked engineering section, and expanded crew facilities to help alleviate fatigue during long deployments.

Evocative of an old adage to “Hit hard, hit fast, hit often”, the Memphis is at the forefront of Libertonian military technology, and is seen by many in the admiralty as the next step in design philosophy for the Liberty of the future. Despite this confidence, the highly advanced design is currently only seeing limited deployment in the Primary Fleets, as some in the government doubt the need for a wholly new warship with the Memphis' capabilities.

720897.text:
ZGOZ-17bL "Pursuer No.2" Coalition Tachyon Cannon

The Pursuer is one of the latest developments from Zvezdny Gorodok. It is believed to have been developed from a mixture of Coalition and Bretonian weapons, although the speed of the weapon has been slightly modified to make it incompatible with Sirian equipment. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

720899.text:
ZGOZ-14L "Discharger No.1" Coalition Pulse Cannon

The Discharger is one of the latest developments from Zvezdny Gorodok. It is believed to have been developed from a mixture of Coalition and Civilian weapons, although the speed of the weapon has been slightly modified to make it incompatible with Sirian equipment. This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage.

720901.text:
ZGOZ-14bL "Discharger No.2" Coalition Pulse Cannon

The Discharger is one of the latest developments from Zvezdny Gorodok. It is believed to have been developed from a mixture of Coalition and Civilian weapons, although the speed of the weapon has been slightly modified to make it incompatible with Sirian equipment. This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage.

720998.text:
J63 "Javelin" Missile Launcher

The Javelin Missile launcher's main attribute is its stalwart reliability; delivering a punishing payload accurately and effectively. This and its relatively inexpensive cost make the Javelin a welcome addition to any arsenal.

*Requires Javelin Missile

720999.text:
J63 "Javelin" Missile Launcher

The Javelin is the fruit of almost half a decade of labor by dozens, if not hundreds, of separate engineering firms and design teams, being reverse-engineered and adapted from thousands of burnt-out, overcharged, laser-scorched Gallic "Flechette" launchers scavenged from the great graveyard that is the contemporary Tau sector. These disparate designs were brought together by convergent evolution, and overall dumbed down for compatibility with Sirian ships. Once the height of novelty, this model has since become commonplace across the sector, now being sold by everyone from edgeworld chop shops to high-end military manufacturers.

*Requires Javelin Missile

721000.text:
S-2 "Slingshot" Missile Launcher

Based on the original Javelin design, the Slingshot Missile Launcher delivers more firepower in the same compact casing. Though it is slightly more expensive, the reformulated payload of its missiles provides a significant advantage in all offensive and defensive situations.

*Requires Slingshot Missile

721001.text:
T4-2 "Lancer" Missile Launcher

In terms of cost verses damage potential, the Lancer Missile launcher is considered by many to be "the weapon of choice". Though its missiles have only moderate tracking abilities, this perceived drawback is more than overshadowed by its enormous payload capacity.

*Requires Lancer Missile

721002.text:
C242A "Cannonball" Missile Launcher


Delivering the most powerful destructive potential available in this category, the Cannonball's damage rating is only surpassed only by that of a torpedo. Originally formulated from demolitions research in asteroid mining, the Cannonball is now a standard loadout for military assault craft.

*Requires Cannonball Missile

721003.text:
X19 "Stalker" Homing Missile Launcher

Developed to recognize and better-track the evasive actions of target ships, the Stalker provides a remarkable advantage for its relative cost. Though delivering less of an explosive payload than many of its counterparts, this missile's strength lies in its deadly accuracy and dogged relentlessness in the field.

*Requires Stalker Missile

721004.text:
X22 "Windstalker" Homing Missile Launcher

Developed from the original design of the Stalker series, the Windstalker launcher's missile carries a larger payload yet does not sacrifice any of the necessary maneuverability. The Windstalker is considered by many to be the best choice for its ability to deliver additional power without sacrificing accuracy.

*Requires Windstalker Missile

721005.text:
X27 "Moonstalker" Homing Missile Launcher

Providing superior firepower with the renowned maneuverability and accuracy of the Stalker series, the Moonstalker continues the rich tradition. This launcher delivers a projectile so accurate and powerful that it is supremely hailed as the premiere homing missile available for its relative price.

*Requires Moonstalker Missile

721006.text:
X33 "Sunstalker" Homing Missile Launcher

One of the most advanced models available, the Sunstalker makes good on the promises of reliability and accuracy set down by the Stalker series of homing missiles. This launcher is considered by some to be the "only one to take into the Border Worlds" and therefore occupies a special place in their arsenals.

*Requires Sunstalker Missile

721007.text:
X45 "Firestalker" Homing Missile Launcher


Considered by friend and foe alike to be the ultimate in homing missile technology, the Firestalker simple delivers the best homing missile available. With maximum range, tracking abilities and destructive potential this weapon is hailed as the king of all homing weapons and has even been criticized by some liberals as being "too cruel" to use in combat.

*Requires Firestalker Missile

721008.text:
L-EMP-01 "Eraser" EMP Missile Launcher

Delivering an EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse) that disrupts the target's shields and power plant and effectively crippling its defenses, the Eraser distinguishes itself as being the perfect weapon for a combined assault; following up with a Javelin or other missile of choice.

*Requires Eraser Missile

721009.text:
M-EMP-01 "Sweeper" EMP Missile Launcher

Based on the same technology as the Eraser, the Sweeper is designed with a greater power output capacity and therefore delivers a more sizeable EMP blast to the target's shields. In terms of cost, many consider this to be an exceptionally valuable piece of necessary armament.

*Requires Sweeper Missile

721010.text:
N-EMP-01 "Neutralizer" EMP Missile Launcher

Second to only one other missile in its class, the Neutralizer releases an EMP on impact that is so devastating that it renders all but the strongest adversaries helpless within a couple of sequential hits.

*Requires Neutralizer Missile

721011.text:
O-EMP-01A "Paralyzer" EMP Missile Launcher


Based on an entirely new approach, The Paralyzer discharges the most powerful EMP on the market. Research shows that when used in combat, the Paralyzer can completely disrupt most shields in just one blast. Again this weapon serves as a very useful precursor to a follow-up attack, however further hits with the Paralyzer will also disable a target's powerplant and guns.

*Requires Paralyzer Missile

721012.text:
CD88a "Wasp" Cruise Disruptor Missile Launcher

Originally designed to help local law enforcement stop fleeing pirates, the Wasp uses a complex guidance and deployment system to effectively disrupt a target's ability to maintain cruise velocity.

*Requires Wasp Missile

721013.text:
CD89b "Hornet" Cruise Disruptor Missile Launcher

Based on the design of the Wasp, the Hornet makes use of several key improvements and is largely considered the fastest missile available today. As with the Wasp, the Hornet has little or no conventional effect in combat, however it is extremely effective against ships that have either engaged their cruise engines or are about to do so. Targets that endure an attack from the Hornet remain unable to engage their cruise engines until the field effects that this very valuable piece of weaponry produces wear off.

*Requires Hornet Missile

721014.text:
T-92 "Starkiller" Torpedo Launcher

The Starkiller launcher deploys a devastatingly powerful torpedo that has enough destructive potential to severely damage a small station, and adversely affect any small craft caught in the wake of its blast radius. Despite its power however, the Starkiller is a slower projectile and so is considered by many to be most effective against equally as slow or stationary objects.

*Requires Starkiller Torpedo

721015.text:
T-96 "Sunslayer" Torpedo Launcher

Spawned from the weapon labs of the military industrial complex, the Sunslayer stands as one of the most devastating bomber weapons in Sirius. Pound for pound, its destructive power surpasses that of most armaments. While utilizing the same guidance system and components as the Starkiller, the Sunslayer surpasses its counterpart with an immense payload, capable of inflicting devastating damage upon any target it engages.

*Requires Sunslayer Torpedo

721016.text:
M433 "Drone" Mine Dropper

The Drone is simple and effective, detonating and eviscerating its targets within a respectable kill radius. Given its relatively low cost and availability throughout Sirius, this mine dropper is by and large considered to be an old and faithful standby weapon.

*Requires Drone Mine

721017.text:
M223-X "Wardog" Mine Dropper

Representing a new direction in Sirian mine design -- an already niche field of weapons development -- the Wardog sacrifices some of the raw power of the Shredder's explosive-packed core in favour of a more robust and reliable detonation mechanism. No longer susceptible to premature activation by cruise interdiction bursts, the Wardog is the first iteration of the 'safe mine' concept, and looks set to bring a more positive reputation to a weapons system often derided as too dangerous to their users' life expectancy.

*Requires Wardog Mine

721018.text:
M472 "Tadpole" Mine Dropper

The Tadpole's revolutionary explosive mixture and shielded detonation components make it one of the most affordable and reliable mines of this category.

*Requires Tadpole Mine

721019.text:
M479 "Swatter" Mine Dropper

With more payload and the addition of no less than seventeen layers of hull-penetrating carbonized shrapnel, the Swatter is considered by most to be one of the deadliest mines available in Sirius.

*Requires Swatter Mine

721020.text:
M485 "Screamer" Mine Dropper

Based on a new anti-ship technology, the Screamer mine dropper releases a deadly wafer that is hard to see, hard to avoid and even harder to survive. Tests in the field and actual combat records demonstrate this weapons repeated superiority and effectiveness.

*Requires Screamer Mine

721021.text:
M39-X "Seeker" Smart Mine Dropper

Laden with sophisticated electronics and equipped with a full-sized transponder of its own, the Seeker mine exhibits a unique feature -- a dedicated IFF system. While the proximity fuse still detonates the mine's payload on close proximity to any target, the Seeker is capable of distinguishing friend from foe on its own initiative, and will actively avoid vectoring towards the ship that dropped it. While wider-reaching developments into 'smart mine' technology are still some ways off, the Seeker is a proof of concept that has stoked a newfound excitement into the field of mine research.

*Requires Seeker Mine

721022.text:
HM-b "Razor" Homing Mine Dropper

Though quite similar to the Seeker in theory, the Razor enjoys significant improvements in maneuverability and payload capacity. The Razor is probably the most widely used homing mine in existence today.

*Requires Razor Mine

721023.text:
HM-d "Driller" Homing Mine Dropper

Not being satisfied with the "seeking" and damage capacities of the Razor, the Driller was developed. This mine is more powerful in every way than the Razor and yet is still affordable, making it the accepted "gold standard" in the industry.

*Requires Driller Mine

721024.text:
HM-i "Ripper" Homing Mine Dropper

The Ripper combines the most advanced "seeking technology" available along with an enormous charge and array of anti-ship elements to embody one of the most feared weapons in any arsenal. The Ripper is quite possibly the nastiest and most lethal support weapon in Sirius.

*Requires Ripper Mine

721187.text:
LCT-1d "Havok" Liberty Cruiser Turret

Designed to give the Siege Cruiser additional firepower against ships that evade its main gun, the Havok can offer a steady stream of punishment against targets of any class. It is also used on the Siege Cruiser, in much the same role. Due to it's limited tracking abilities, it is best used against Gunboat and Cruiser class ships.

721188.text:
LSGM-1d "Star Lance" Liberty Cruiser Siege Gun

The most massive gun in Liberty's fleet, the Star Lance makes up more than half of the Siege Cruisers hull. Capable of breaching the hull of even the most massive battleship in a few shots, nothing can withstand it's firepower for more than a few seconds. The drawback is that this weapon cannot track - the entire cruiser must orient itself to the firing position.

721189.text:
LCM-3a "Raptor" Liberty Cruiser Missile Turret

The Raptor Missile is a long range rocket with a small fusion warhead, which can inflict considerable damage. It is often used by both the Siege and Assault Cruisers to soften up targets before using their main weapons. The rocket has moderate tracking abilities and is most effective against enemy capital ships.

721190.text:
LDH-24v "Collapser" Liberty Battleship Turret

The Collapser main battleship turret is the largest turret-mounted gun in Liberty's arsenal. Employed on both the Liberty Assault Carrier and Assault Cruiser, it can deliver a continuous stream of high damage energy bolts onto its target. These bolts are relatively slow, making this weapon most effective against enemy battleships, and larger cruisers.

721191.text:
LDL-14v "Jackhammer" Liberty Battleship Light Turret

A point defense turret for the Liberty Dreadnought, the Jackhammer fires much faster then the Collapser, but deals less damage. It is usually employed to defend against enemy bombers, or quickly destroy enemy gunboats who stray too close.

721192.text:
LDF-5a "Meson" Liberty Battleship Flak Turret

The Meson was one of the first Flak turrets designed. Upgraded and refined over the past decade, it still employs the same basic principle. Dumbfire proximity charges are fired, which trigger when anything, including incoming projectiles, comes near. The detonation releases a shockwave that deals light damage, and physically pushes anything in the blast radius outward. Initially designed to shake up enemy bomber crews by disorienting them, gunner crews quickly found that it was just as easy to disorient an incoming torpedo or missile.

721193.text:
LDM-12c "Solomon" Liberty Battleship Missile Turret

The Solomon fires long range torpedos with a large antimatter warhead, comparable to the "Nova" torpedo launchers. The blast radius and damage of these warheads is considerable, making this weapon a major friendly fire hazard to any lighter friendly craft in the vicinity of the target.

The Newton class main destroyer gun is the main weapon of Bretonian destroyers. A good allround weapon, it is able to engage a variety of targets, but is most effective against gunboats and other cruisers.

721209.text:
MDM-03 "Red Top" Bretonia Destroyer Missile Turret

The Red Top guided torpedo was designed with long-range engagements against enemy capital ships in mind. A diminished version of the Blue Water torpedo, it still carries a warhead of considerable power while retaining both range and tracking ability.

721210.text:
MG41 "Vickers" Bretonia Gunboat Primary Turret

With a high rate of fire and excellent tracking ability, the Vickers is a common sight on Bretonian gunboats. Designed to engage and destroy enemy strikecraft with a hail of light projectiles, it performs well in this role. It's range and firepower are limited however, making this turret unsuitable for engaging capital ships.

721212.text:
MGF23 "Garland" Bretonia Gunboat Forward Gun

Designed to give Bretonian gunboats an edge in fighting other gunboats, the Garland is a forward facing, statically mounted weapon. It has a much larger range and heavier firepower, but since the entire gunboat has to be oriented towards the target, it is unsuitable for engaging enemy strikecraft.

721213.text:
MGM27 "Starstreak" Bretonia Gunboat Missile Turret

A midrange explosive missile, the Starstreak is designed to quickly strip away the hulls of enemy strikecraft, leaving them vulnerable to other weapons. The missile has excellent tracking capabilities, but the loading mechanism can only accomodate a limited amount of ammo.

721214.text:
MB23a "Pounder" Bretonia Battleship Turret

The main arament on Bretonian battleships, the Pounder lives up to it's name, literally pounding away at enemy capital ships until they either withdraw or are destroyed.

721215.text:
MB12c "Hotchkiss" Bretonia Battleship Secondary Turret

A light battleship turret meant for point defense of Bretonia's largest warships. Designed to deter bombers and engage fast gunboats, it sacrifices damage potential and range for greater projectile speed and a higher firing rate.

721216.text:
MBF31 "Pom-pom" Bretonia Battleship Flak Turret

A defensive weapon, the Pom-pom can be used to physically throw back enemy strikecraft and incoming guided projectiles. This weapon launches dumbfire explosive charges at a short range. The charges have a very large blast radius, and are often considered a major friendly fire hazard.

721217.text:
MBM6 "Blue Water" Bretonia Battleship Missile Turret

When engagements at extreme range are called for, the heaviest Bretonian vessels can call upon the Blue Water guided torpedo. This weapon carries a guided fusion warhead that will home in and track it's assigned target. It carries a significant blast radius, and can be a friendly fire hazard.

721232.text:
YCT-2c "Sunflare" Kusari Cruiser Turret

A large, slow tracking turret designed for use on Kusari's Battlecruiser, although it can be fitted on Destroyers as well. A well-rounded weapon, its main purpose is to engage enemy cruisers and gunboats.

721233.text:
YDT-3a "Starflare" Kusari Destroyer Turret

With a faster fire rate then the Sunflare cruiser turret, this weapon is designed for use on Kusari's destroyers, and is better suited to attacking smaller ships such as Gunboats and even slower Bombers. It can be adapted to fit on a Cruiser.

721234.text:
YCM-7e "Purger" Kusari Cruiser Missile Turret

A long range missile designed for use on Kusari's destroyers and cruisers. It carries a sizable warhead with moderate tracking ability, and is most effective when used at maximum range.

721235.text:
YGT-3c "Radiance" Kusari Gunboat Defense Turret

A light, rapid turret that can project a hail of light damage at short range. It is designed to destroy enemy strikecraft.

721236.text:
YGH-8a "Sunray" Kusari Gunboat Forward Gun

Almost as long as the gunship itself, this large, forward facing weapon allows the nimble Kusari gunboat to strike at targets many times it's own size.

721237.text:
YGM-5a "Distorter" Kusari Gunboat Missile Turret

A fast, agile explosive missile launcher that does moderate hull damage. Specifically designed to target fighters, it can often turn the tides in a battle that involves small and fast enemies.

721238.text:
YBT-12c "Prominence" Kusari Battleship Turret

The mightiest cannons of the Kusari Naval Forces can be found on her biggest warships. The Prominence lives up to its name, being a prominent, dominating weapon wherever it is brought to bear.

721239.text:
YBT-18d "Solar Wind" Kusari Light Battleship Turret

A defensive turret that is typically mounted in large numbers on Kusari battleships, this turret is designed to defend these mighty vessels from enemy strikecraft and destroy hostile gunboats that stray too close.

721240.text:
YBF-1g "Sunspot" Kusari Battleship Flak Turret

When faced with missile attacks, these Flak Turrets can defend Kusari's warships by deflecting the projectiles before they come into range. With a large blast radius that deals light damage and physically pushes ships away, it can also be used against formations of enemy fighters, but it's indiscriminate blasts can be a friendly fire hazard.

721241.text:
YBM-8h "Sterilizer" Kusari Battleship Missile Turret

The most massive guided weapon in Kusari's arsenal, the Steriliser is a guided torpedo that is designed for long range combat. It carries an antimatter warhead that creates a considerable blast radius, and can be a friendly fire hazard if there are enemy strikecraft in range of the target.

721302.text:
Weapon Codename: CERBERUS

Widely recognized as the godfather of experimental weaponry, the original CERBERUS was birthed in a shadowy Rheinland facility. A fusillade of three projectiles are created within the chassis and merge together as the barrel forces their fusion, hence creating the moniker of the PROJECT. Contrary to popular belief, the CERBERUS isn't the name of the fighter-equipped Codename, but rather the name for the iconic patent-design. Treading thin-lines of regulations, the scheme focuses on delivering extraordinary damage at the cost of projectile velocity and inefficient reactor consumption. Despite the drawbacks the project was renowed for its capabilities and seeing one equipped on loosely affiliated Freelancers was not an uncommon sight.

When militaries and navies alike noticed the widespread use of this particular weapon, it prompted them to design and manufacture the patent on a larger scale to be fitted onto warships - using the same devastating but inefficient characteristics. The design can also be found on transports as well, making the CERBERUS the first project to be christened into civilian, military and corporate use.

Albeit plentiful everywhere as of today, the fighter variant remains a collector's item.

Users often report that their trigger-finger was unusually disciplined and felt an omnipresent, zealous aura whenever a barrage would smite their foes. This project almost never saw itself alone, and mostly by Order agents carrying six at-a-time.

Current understandings of the ROSETHORN's inner workings are patchy, and barely sufficient to replicate the design. The best recreations make use of experimental graviton-tachyon yatto-arrays which utterly fail to function when applied to other designs, and bear a nasty tendency to violently implode. While engineers pay well for intact copies, pilots operating in the deep outer rim of Sirius will pay even more.

721358.text:
SN-02 "Supernova" Cryogenic Antimatter Cannon

In response to the rapid rebuilding of hardened Sirian warship fleets in the wake of the Nomad War, modernized designs for bombers were developed in kind to provide militaries with low-cost alternatives to risking billions of credits against hostile capital ships. At the heart of these bombers lay the Supernova Antimatter Cannon, a downscaled derivative of the well-known and well-revered "Mortar" series of cryogenic antimatter projectors. Utilizing the majority of a bomber's power plant to drive the gravitic projection and supercooling of the weapon's payload, the SN-02 and its various clones deliver a cryogenically stabilized physics package of anti-hydrogen atoms suspended in carbon fullerenes, a combination that rips through hullmetal with the ferocity of a nanoscopic artificial sun.

The SN-02 succeeds the original SN-01, whose plans were released onto the open market shortly after their completion by weapons researchers in the early ninth century AS While many factions across Sirius have their own customized versions of this pocket-sized tide turner, the SN-02 is commonly available at open ports throughout the colonies to anyone who supplies the only credentials that matter to arms dealers: a nice, healthy stack of clean cash.

Inferno has long cooldown time and requires enormous amounts of energy to operate, but it deals 20 times more damage than Tizona; it is most effective against capital ships and transports.

721423.text:
TL-25 "Mortar" Cryogenic Antimatter Projector

Based off of research into antimatter weaponry and named after the ancestor of all explosive siege weaponry, the TL-25 "Mortar" is a battleship-scale artillery weapon that is commonly found on battleships and dreadnoughts throughout Sirius. The weapon contains a cryogenics package that condenses and supercools hydrogen around a fullerened antimatter payload into a supercooled "slug" of antimatter-doped hydrogen ice. The projectile is then sent down a barrel containing a number of graviton-generating toroids, which, at the cost of a significant amount of power, attract and repel it in sequence like a gauss gun, imparting a minimum of heat on the outer layers of hydrogen ice while accelerating it to an effective velocity.

The unquestionable superiority of the Mortar in capital warfare for long-range engagements compared to the relatively close-quarters plasma projectors used in Cerberus-type turrets, combined with the efficiency of a primarily energy-based weapon in a battle of attrition in contrast to conventional torpedoes, resulted in variants of the weapon being developed for cruisers and later battlecruisers, as well as a higher-input, higher-output version commonly known as the "Heavy Mortar". Regardless of the variant, the success of the Mortar ensured that the family of weapons would be seen on just about every warship in Sirius for centuries to come.

721425.text:
TL-45 "Heavy Mortar" Cryogenic Antimatter Projector

The TL-45 "Heavy Mortar" owes its existence to the ever-present line of thinking that bigger is always better. After scaling the TL-25 "Mortar" down to fit comfortably on cruiser-class warships, ship designers realized that this left energy to be used at the higher end, with even the smallest of battleship armament capacitors losing only a quarter of their charge to a Mortar firing sequence. Thus was born the Heavy Mortar, a piece of overcharged artillery that uses twice the power and delivers twice the punch of a standard Mortar.

Where the Heavy Mortar's advantage is in delivering spikes of damage to a battleship's target, the older, smaller Mortar projectors still have their own uses. The increased strain of launching a much heavier, much more volatile projectile encased in four times the hydrogen ice of a standard Mortar slug requires extra time to cool down the weapon's cryogenics package and graviton tori between firings. While some fleet doctrines prefer the standard Mortar for its relative rapidity, others choose the Heavy Mortar on the grounds that if you can rip an enemy ship apart in a single volley, you don't need to worry about when you can fire the next.

721427.text:
TL-4a "Light Mortar" Cryogenic Antimatter Projector

For decades, the champion among cruisers in the realm of countering other capital ships at a distance was the Liberty Siege Cruiser, with its devastating spinal lance. The invention of cryogenic antimatter projectors closed the gap between the houses, giving each fleet the ability to rain havoc upon each others' battleships from afar, but Liberty remained the only cruiser to be able to consistently augment the battlefield with additional cruiser-based anti-battleship firepower.

The solution was a downsized version of the Mortar, helpfully dubbed the Light Mortar, developed and marketed by the same research firm to not only the houses but also the various groups and factions throughout Sirius that fielded cruiser-scale ships. The Light Mortar is a straightforward development, with smaller antimatter injectors and a proportionately smaller cryogenics unit. While the instantaneous energy output of the weapon is lower than that of any other Mortar variant, it has the lowest cooldown time of any cryogenic antimatter projector, making it perfect for medium to long range sustained fire.

While its effectiveness is questionable, Bounty Hunter and Core gunship crews frequently boast to have "harpooned" many enemy capital ships.

721779.text:
Saoirse Molly Gunboat Turret

721781.text:
AR-101 "Arclight" Core Battleship Primary Turret

Designed by Core technicians, this turret is designed for the Core Battleship and Battlecruiser. Working in tandem with the warship power core, this turret can dish out punishing firepower very quickly, but the projectiles are slow-moving, and therefore ineffective against smaller ships.

721783.text:
AR-102 "Lastlight Mk II" Core Battleship Secondary Turret

Designed by Core technicians, this turret is designed for the Core Battleship. Recognising the need for point defense, this turret has been modified to fire its projectiles at a higher speed, but has a much lower damage potential and range. It is designed to engage slower strike craft and gunboats.

721785.text:
AR-51 "Lastlight" Core Cruiser Turret

Designed by Core technicians, this turret is used on both the Core Destroyer and Battlecruiser. While able to engage targets of any size, battle performance has shown that it is most effective when used against gunboats and other cruisers.

721787.text:
AR-23B "Firstlight" Bounty Hunter Gunship Turret

Designed by Bounty Hunter technicians, this turret is used on their gunships. Boasting an extremely high projectile speed and high rate of fire as well as rapid tracking, it can effectively engage and overwhelm multiple fast moving strike craft. Its damage potential and range are limited however, making this weapon less effective against capital ships.

A defensive weapon designed to protect Rheinland Battleships from enemy strikecraft, the Zwiling (Twin) fires fast moving, moderate damage projectiles. It does not have the range or firepower of the Hummel, and is mainly used to deter enemy bombers and gunboats from coming too close, or destroy them when they do.

721805.text:
Battleship "Heavy Glaive" Positron Cannon

The Glaive fires a massive positron charge held in place by a superdense neutronium fragment, which annihilates upon impact. The positron radiation deals extreme damage to the hull of the target ship once its shields are down. With the extremely low refire rate and high power requirements, it is used to violently vaporize small enemy ships before the pilots realize their mistake.

721807.text:
Cruiser "Mitrailleuse Reffye" Turret

This is modified version of the gallic "Mitrailleuse", designed for cruiser-class vessels.

721809.text:
Gunboat "Light Glaive" Positron Cannon

The Glaive fires a massive positron charge held in place by a superdense neutronium fragment, which annihilates upon impact. The positron radiation deals extreme damage to the hull of the target ship once its shields are down. Gunboat Glaives do not have energy requirements as high as the larger variants, allowing gunboats to mount multiple Razor turrets.

721811.text:
Trebuchet

Trebuchets are heavy artillery weapons found on most Gallic capital ships.

The standard Trebuchet offers a reasonable rate of fire, producing one high-yield blast every five seconds, provided the siege platform can supply the energy required to do so. These blasts travel slowly, and can easily be avoided by smaller craft, making the Trebuchet a weapon best used against large, slow, or immobile targets.

721813.text:
Light Trebuchet

Trebuchets are heavy artillery weapons found on most Gallic capital ships.

The Light Trebuchet offers a reasonable rate of fire, producing one massive blast every four seconds, provided the siege platform can supply the energy required to do so. These blasts travel slowly, and can easily be avoided by smaller craft, making the Light Trebuchet a weapon best used against large, slow, or immobile targets.

721815.text:
Heavy Trebuchet

Trebuchets are heavy artillery weapons found on most Gallic capital ships.

The Heavy Trebuchet offers a lackluster rate of fire, but will produce one massive blast every ten seconds, provided the siege platform can supply the energy required to do so. The Heavy Trebuchet carries enough firepower to destroy gunboats and smaller cruisers in one hit, however its blasts travel slowly, and can easily be avoided by smaller craft, making the Heavy Trebuchet a weapon best used against large, slow, or immobile targets.

721817.text:
DCF-1 "Mitrailleuse" Battleship Point Defense Turret

The Mitrailleuse is a rapid fire point defense weapon for Gallic capital ships. It fires small bursts of energy at high speed and good accuracy. Individual shots do not deal high amounts of damage however, limiting this weapon to anti-strikecraft use.

721819.text:
DCF-2 "Mitrailleuse" Cruiser Point Defense Turret

The Mitrailleuse is a rapid-fire point defense weapon for Gallic capital ships. It fires volatile bursts of energy at high speed. Although the weapon sacrifices accuracy at long range, individual shots are capable of dealing significant damage to any nearby craft. As a consequence, the Mitrailleuse excels at defensive action.

721821.text:
"Nuage Noir" Gallic Flak Turret

The Flak Cannon is designed to physically repel incoming projectiles using concussion charges. It can also be used against groups of fighters. It fires unguided explosive projectiles, and can be a major friendly fire hazard.

721823.text:
"Ouragan" Gallic Battleship Primary Turret

The main arament of Gallic Battleships, these weapons have seen use in nearly all of the major Gallic wars. While their firing rate is low, these guns inflict heavy damage with every hit.

721853.text:
Weapon Codename: AHRIMAN

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

This experimental weapon is believed to have been developed by Bretonian engineers aboard Southampton Shipyard during the Gallic War. Fragmentary records imply that all extant prototypes were fitted to the Battleship York's fighter squadrons shortly before the Battle for Trafalgar, where the York and its complement were lost in action. The weapon's designs are thought to have been destroyed when Southampton was scuttled.

721855.text:
Weapon Codename: LAMIA

Utilising aspects of Outcast technology in its design, the Lamia is a truly unique armament. Featuring a series of electromagnetic flywheels and tachyon accelerators, this gun is extremely advanced and barely understood by anyone but its designers. Only the Tachyon accelerators from the Outcast tachyon cannon are present, how the rest works can only be theorised.

721919.text:
Nomad Heavy Disruptor

Nomad capabilities of interfacing with energies of gates and lanes are well known. As our cruise technology works in a similar fashion it has been expected that they devise a technology capable of distrupting our engines. Our surveys show that they are capable of firing an extremly fast and maneuverable energy based projectile into space, which creates an explosion that seems to leech onto the cruise engines of nearby vessels, disabling them instantly and forcing our engines to reboot themselves to get rid of the excess energy which overloaded them.

Nomad Mine Dropper

Several reports indicate of a new weapon used by the nomad entities. These "mines" as our pilots call them, seem to be a stationary energy based projectile that the nomad releases from its body. They somehow manage to compile a large amount of energy in a single part of their body, and then release it out into space. The energy is subdued by a field of biological molecules that somehow restrain the energy from escaping the "ball" shaped projectile. After anything hits the projectile, it distrupts the field and the energy is released, creating an explosion of similar magnitude to our Shredder mines.

721927.text:
Bretonia KB4-G "Banger" Transport Turret

A contradiction of common Bretonian engineering philosophy of "bigger is better", the Banger was a weapon built out of necessity. Built to bridge the gap between freighter turrets and the massive heavy transport turrets, this weapon will fit on smaller transports, yet has comparable firepower to that of the CT-403 "Iron Hammer". It is widely available to the civilian market within Bretonia.

721929.text:
Kusari TT97 "Kyuunana-shiki Jidouho" Transport Turret

Built with the same elegance as their ships, this transport turret is as functional as it is aesthetically pleasing. Built to fit on Kusari's smaller transport vessels, it has been reduced in size while maintaining functionality. It has comparable firepower to that of the CT-403 "Iron Hammer" and is widely available to the civilian market within Kusari.

721931.text:
Liberty SW4-T "Spiker" Transport Turret

It has been reduced in both size and energy demand so that it can be fitted on Liberty's smaller transport ships. It has comparable firepower to that of the CT-403 "Iron Hammer" and is widely available to the civilian market within Liberty.

721933.text:
Rheinland KR4-T "Schutzer" Transport Turret

Based upon Rheinland's plasma bolt technology that has become widely known as the Cerberus series of weapons, this transport turret is a diminished version of that technology. Built to fit on smaller transports, it has comparable firepower to that of the CT-403 "Iron Hammer" and is widely available to the civilian market within Rheinland.

721935.text:
EMT-14S "Grinder" Mining Array

Mining small asteroids and other spaceborne bodies requires specialized equipment, as these objects are too fragile to be effectively mined with regular weapons. The Mining Array, also known as the Multi-Spectrum Mining Beam Emitter, is the primary tool used by mining ships to survey, parse, and extract valuable minerals, lattices, and organic compounds from these spaceborne bodies. It allows mining operations to be conducted with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency, making it an essential component for any mining ship.

721937.text:
G2 LS92-1 "Lacerator" EMP Cannon

As gunboats gained agility and gunboat class shield technology improved, bomber pilots were having difficulty suppressing gunboat shields. To knock out the damaged shields of gunboats and possibly larger capital ships the Lacerator cannons were produced. The Lacerator enabled bombers to knock out shields without depleting their powerplant with a Supernova salvo.

The basis of the weapon's design was similar to the Debiliator line of pulse weapons, but deliver significantly more shield damage per shot. Since it fires a pulse projectile, any unshielded hits also temporarily weakens the target's powerplant. The drawback was that the weapon was very demanding on the bomber's energy core. So much so, that it was impractical to use on fighter craft.

When the first few models of the Lacerator were deployed in the battlefield, factions who encountered them recognised the effectiveness of the gun and quickly reverse engineered their own copies. Today they have been widely adopted and used by all bomber deploying groups.

While not as energy efficient as the heavier antimatter weapons, the Render's speed allows bombers to target and hit gunboats more effectively.

The basis of the weapon's design was to be used on bomber craft to deliver significantly more damage per shot than traditional fighter weaponry. The drawback was that the weapon was very demanding on the bomber's energy core. So much so, that it was impractical to use on fighter craft.

721947.text:
"Warwolf" Gallic Navy Battleship Forward Gun

The "Warwolf" was perhaps the largest trebuchet ever built on ancient Earth. It was commissioned by Britain's King Edward I for his siege of Stirling Castle in Scotland during a rebellion. The Gallic Royal Navy chose the name for this ironic quality, since it was first deployed in their assault on Bretonia. The gun creates the most devastating non-nuclear blast in existence, delivering more than twice as much destructive power as a Mortar. The weapon is capable of obliterating conventional cruisers in one shot to their hulls, and causes massive concussion waves throughout battleships and dreadnoughts, incapacitating crew members that somehow survive the impact. The weapon's energy requirements and long recharge time are significant, and are its only disadvantage. The Gallic Navy considers use of the weapon so important that relatively high ranking officers act as its gunner under direct command of an admiral, and these officers have been known to be court martialed or demoted for failing to hit their target, since use of the weapon prevents the ship from firing other weapons due to the energy drain. Gallic Navy combat doctrine calls for the "Warwolf" to be deployed primarily as an opening salvo in engagements versus capital ships, since its use significantly impedes use of the ship's other weapons systems. Loss of shields while in range of an Gallic Navy battleship that has sufficient energy to fire this weapon is almost suicidal for a capital ship.

"Escopeta" Corsair Dispersion Cannon

While it is an energy weapon, due to its unique behaviour and higher energy requirements, it takes the place of a torpedo or disruptor. The "Escopeta" uses multiple barrels to fire a cluster of high-energy projectiles at close range. While the projectiles decay over longer distances, the weapon has proved effective at applying significant damage to larger, slower targets at close range.

721966.text:
RH-CT600 "Höllenfeuer" Red Hessian Battleship Turret

The Höllenfeuer is an immense model of the Feuersturm. Its large turret chassis gives the capability of harnessing a larger payload into a single blast. The enormous amount of energy required for firing demands a Jormungand-class reactor to use this turret. Manufactured at Wolfsburg Shipyard, the Höllenfeuer offers a balance of damage and power consumption.

Originally designed by engineers defecting from the Rheinland Military, these series of turrets are readily adopted by Red Hessian capital ships.
