The Stichflamme is a Secondary Battleship turret created specifically to benefit the characteristics of the Jormungand-class ship. Due to its lower power output yet higher refire than the Höllenfeuer, it has been adopted as a point defense turret. Manufactured at Wolfsburg Shipyard, the Stichflamme offers a balance of damage and power consumption.

Originally designed by engineers defecting from the Rheinland Military, these series of turrets are readily adopted by Red Hessian capital ships.

721970.text:
APAC-X44 ".44" Bounty Hunter Antimatter Cannon

I know what you're thinking. "Did he fire that six seconds ago, or five?" Well, to tell you the truth, in all this excitement I kind of lost track myself. But being as this is a .44 Antimatter Cannon, the most powerful antimatter cannon in Sirius, and would blow your ship right to hell, you've got to ask yourself one question: "Do I feel lucky?" Well, do ya, punk?

721972.text:
"Cleaver" Bretonia Antimatter Cannon

While antimatter weapons technology is nothing new to the Sirius sector, scientists at Cambridge were charged with finding ways to streamline and perfect existing weapons systems to make better use of Bretonia's limited bomber fleet. "Faster, safer, and more powerful" was the call-to-arms for researchers and engineers. The result is the "Cleaver," a prototype cannon made exclusively for the Bretonia Armed Forces.

721974.text:
"Cockney's Revenge" Black Market Bretonian Antimatter Cannon

As they say, "you can't con an honest John," but you can almost certainly blow his ship to bits with this, the "Cockney's Revenge" antimatter cannon. Built upon the lessons learned fighting the BAF, the Mollys spearheaded this project with a focus on durability and reproducibility. From a firepower standpoint, this cannon isn't a far cry from the ever-popular "Supernova," but carries an intimidation factor capable of making even the most do-gooding blokes hand over the dosh.

721976.text:
SN-02 "Supernova" Cryogenic Antimatter Cannon

In response to the rapid rebuilding of hardened Sirian warship fleets in the wake of the Nomad War, modernized designs for bombers were developed in kind to provide militaries with low-cost alternatives to risking billions of credits against hostile capital ships. At the heart of these bombers lay the Supernova Antimatter Cannon, a downscaled derivative of the well-known and well-revered "Mortar" series of cryogenic antimatter projectors. Utilizing the majority of a bomber's power plant to drive the gravitic projection and supercooling of the weapon's payload, the SN-02 and its various clones deliver a cryogenically stabilized physics package of anti-hydrogen atoms suspended in carbon fullerenes, a combination that rips through hullmetal with the ferocity of a nanoscopic artificial sun.

The SN-02 succeeds the original SN-01, whose plans were released onto the open market shortly after their completion by weapons researchers in the early ninth century AS While many factions across Sirius have their own customized versions of this pocket-sized tide turner, the SN-02 is commonly available at open ports throughout the colonies to anyone who supplies the only credentials that matter to arms dealers: a nice, healthy stack of clean cash.

721978.text:
"Cabron" Corsair Antimatter

"Cabron" might not be a seemly name for the Corsairs to give their proprietary antimatter cannon, but once you feel the impact of this unforgiving weapon, you will understand. Overcharged and deadly accurate, the Corsairs have already made great use of the Cabron in skirmishes taking place in lower Sirius. Its inner workings and construction are a mystery to all but a few trusted Corsair dealers and machinists, but its backstabbing, bloodletting, ruthless, oppressive power is obvious to all.

721980.text:
"Veuglaire" Gallic Antimatter Cannon

Developed in utmost secrecy, "Veuglaire" is the codename of the latest generation of Antimatter Cannons in service of the Gallic Navy. Originally constructed by the Gallic Royal Navy as a reply to Sirian technology deployed against them, the "Veuglaire", just as effective against hostile warships as it is against foolish smugglers, quickly became a piece of standard equipment for any bomber squadron belonging to Gallic authorities.

721982.text:
"Ballista" Black Market Gallic Antimatter Cannon

First encountered in the early 726s AGS on Council bombers, the "Ballista" was the Council's reply to the Royals newly developed "Veuglaire" cannon. While loosely basing on the same schematics, the "Ballista" was developed with the Council's scarce resources in mind, thus creating a more easily reproduced weapon with similar lethality. Nowadays, the "Ballista" can be found on vessels of all stripes and colors of the Gallic underworld.

721984.text:
"Purifier" Kusari Antimatter Cannon

Dissatisfied with the foreign design and unfamiliar upkeep and maintenance of the "Supernova" antimatter cannon, Kusari Naval Forces pilots and engineers have long clamored for a domestic alternative. In but a short time, Kishiro scientists reverse-engineered the Supernova, and rebuilt a new antimatter cannon using only domestic parts and engineering. Dubbed the "Purifier," KNF engineers have delighted at its familiar design, and claim a 50 percent reduction in maintenance costs and time. Bomber pilots have said they feel more "at home" with the Purifier, and that it restores that Kusari-built feeling of superiority so needed in battle.

721986.text:
"Kanabo" Black Market Kusari Antimatter Cannon

Naval and State Police officers weren't the only Kusari pilots to resent the foreign and unfamiliar "Supernova" antimatter cannon. The development and success of the Kusari "Purifier" antimatter cannon signalled the feasibility of a home-grown variant, and Blood Dragon researchers spent gruelling hours and millions of credits developing their answer: the "Kanabo" antimatter cannon. Now widely available on the Kusari black market, the weapon can be found in the hands of all manner of undesirables.

721988.text:
"Peacemaker" Liberty Antimatter Cannon

Upholding the Libertonian spirit of "bigger is better," the "Peacemaker" antimatter cannon is a souped-up modification on the already grossly-overpowered "Supernova." While any reasonable tactician would cringe watching Liberty's bomber pilots fully drain their power cores at the push of a button, they certainly can't argue with the spectacular results. These brazen pilots swear by the Peacemaker's unyielding power. In the lawless and forbidding Libertonian Borderworlds, antimatter cannons don't kill people, Peacemaker-equipped bombardiers kill people.

721990.text:
"Lil' Bastard" Black Market Liberty Antimatter Cannon

The so-called "Lil' Bastard" antimatter cannon is a mix-breed of many technological sources. So named, less for the weapon itself, and more for the sling of cusses often heard across system comm channels after it is deployed, this technological mutt can bring the hurt to unassuming transports and reinforced capital ships alike. Virtually every criminal group in Liberty claims to have had a hand in the production of this weapon, and so infighting over its "official" name is common.

721992.text:
"Ammit" Order Antimatter Cannon

The "Ammit" antimatter cannon, like much of The Order's arsenal, is cutting-edge and top-of-the-line. The science behind this powerful weapon is highly secretive, but is rumored to capitalize on previous research gains made in utilizing Nomad energy signatures. The Ammit was first seen in battle shortly after the destruction of Planet Toledo, and has quickly earned a reputation among Bounty Hunters as a terrible threat to capital vessels of all sizes.

721994.text:
"Hydra" Outcast Antimatter Cannon

Some say they infused it with Liquid Cardamine. Others say they utilized advanced alien technology. Yet others say it is enchanted with ancestor spirits. Whatever the case, Outcast scientists have certainly produced a buzz-worthy weapon in the "Hydra" antimatter cannon. With rumor and speculation circulating throughout the colonies regarding its nature and power, the Hydra has become a significant deterrent in itself for would-be raiders in Omicron Alpha and nearby regions. Experts have noted, however, that it is unlikely to be much different from the familiar "Supernova" antimatter cannon, and that the determination and ferocity of Outcast pilots are the real deterrence.

721996.text:
"Panzerfaust" Rheinland Antimatter Cannon

Following in the storied tradition of Rheinland weapons manufacturing, the "Panzerfaust" takes baseline Supernova Antimatter technology and greatly increases its reliability and firing accuracy. The Panzerfaust is the only mid-sized antimatter cannon model to earn the government's Five-Star safety rating. Packing a 1,622,636-horsepower blast, it can reduce a target's hull from 60 to 0 in less than .003 seconds. It's nothing short of what you've come to expect from precision Rheinland engineering.

721998.text:
"Sturmfaust" Rheinland Antimatter Cannon

Despite ultra-secret research and development protocols, it was only a matter of time until underpaid and under-appreciated Military scientists "misplaced" a copy of the schematics for their forthcoming "Panzerfaust" cannon. The Red Hessians were the first to boast publicly about their newly-acquired "superweapon." Now, the plans and details can be found on nearly every unlawful base in Rheinland, with a select few possessing the parts and facilities to manufacture counterfeits.

722000.text:
Blood Dragon "Nagakami" Battleship Secondary Turret

The Nagakami is a smaller battlecruiser turret used by the Blood Dragons. Only a few vessels within their ranks are capable of mounting this weapon - the aging Togo class battlecruisers. The Nagakami is designed as a point defense turret, able to engage and destroy strike craft and gunboats with fast projectiles.

722002.text:
Blood Dragon "Naginata" Battleship Primary Turret

The Naginata is the heaviest turret developed and used by the Blood Dragons. Only a few vessels within their ranks are capable of mounting this huge weapon - the aging Togo class battleships. The Naginata is the most destructive turret the Blood Dragons posess, capable of inflicting heavy damage. It's slower projectiles are best suited to engage enemy capital ships.

722004.text:
"Blackout" Pulse Cannon


Designed around a revolving chamber that rapidly pulls high volumes of power from a ship's powerplant, the Blackout was designed to overload the shield systems of any fighter, and in a pinch it can be used in massed attacks to harass larger vessels. The flexibility offered by what is essentially a scaled up version of a standard pulse blaster made it attractive for all manner of customers, from lowly defense forces struggling to be cost efficient, to the Great Houses. This unprecedented degree of proliferation and demand has also resulted in the weapon being quite popular on the blackmarket.

722006.text:
"Scythe Mk IV" Edge Worlds Tachyon Turret

This is a tachyon-based weapon that has the longest range of all energy-based weapons, but requires enormous amounts of power to fire. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields. This is the best Edge Worlds Tachyon Turret available.

722008.text:
"Scythe Mk II" Edge Worlds Tachyon Turret

This is a tachyon-based weapon that has the longest range of all energy-based weapons, but requires enormous amounts of power to fire. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722010.text:
"Sickle Mk II" Edge Worlds Particle Turret

This is a particle-based weapon which, although delivering significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields. This is the best Edge Worlds Particle Turret available.

722012.text:
"Sickle Mk I" Edge Worlds Particle Turret

This is a particle-based weapon which, although delivering significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722014.text:
"Scythe Mk II" Edge Worlds Tachyon Cannon

This is a tachyon-based weapon that has the longest range of all energy-based weapons, but requires enormous amounts of power to fire. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields. This is the best Edge Worlds Tachyon Cannon available.

722016.text:
"Scythe Mk I" Edge Worlds Tachyon Cannon

This is a tachyon-based weapon that has the longest range of all energy-based weapons, but requires enormous amounts of power to fire. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722019.text:
Edge Worlds "Sickle Mk I" Particle Cannon

This is a particle-based weapon which, although delivering significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722021.text:
Edge Worlds "Obelisk" Antimatter Cannon

Developed on Alabama Shipyard by the Core, the Obelisk was the first modified iteration of the "Supernova" Antimatter Cannon in the Edge Worlds. With the Core expanding its influence to Freeport 11, it is speculated that the design was leaked to opposing Edge Worlds factions in the regions by the Zoners. With the model now being out in the open, the Core instead developed their own antimatter cannon, while the Obelisk remains the older, more open alternative.

722023.text:
Rogue "Tartarus" Pulse Cannon


Desperate to end their dependence on Outcast technology, the Liberty Rogues and Mollys established a joint research team to design and build a pulse cannon of their own. Reflecting the Rogues' and Mollys' need for lightning fast offensives that allow ample time to disappear before hostile reinforcements arrive, the Tartarus inflicts 20 percent more damage to shields than the Inferno, but also requires 20 percent more energy and inflicts less hull damage. The Tartarus thus cannot be fired as often as the Inferno, making it less useful in extended battles. Instead, it functions as a devastating opening salvo against shielded targets.

722025.text:
Weapon Codename: ASURAS

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

Hailing from a region unrestrained by sanity or safety regulations (namely, the deep Omicrons), the ASURAS takes the design of the Inferno Pulse Cannon to its most extreme conclusion. The weapon draws obscene amounts of power, controlling the oversized EMP blast through retrofitted cryogenic antimatter containment injectors. The mounting hardware and power bus adapters are almost identical to those used in the Supernova, and the EMP projector itself resembles that of a miniaturized cruiser-grade cannon. This dangerous yet perversely brilliant weapon is the unsubtle final word in a bomber's EMP arsenal.

722027.text:
ZGOZ-AM1 "Equalizer" Coalition Antimatter Cannon

No longer content to be dependent on the Order to supply antimatter weapons for their bombers, The Coalition devoted considerable scientific resources to reverse engineering a weapon of their own. While the antitampering systems installed by The Order proved to be unbreakable, careful examination of the weapon's discharge led to several breakthroughs in Coalition scientists' understanding of physics, and allowed them to develop an antimatter weapon.

722029.text:
"Yellow Jacket" Xeno Antimatter Cannon

Xenos tell the story that the lead weapon designer on the team responsible for developing the Xeno's antimatter cannon frequently wore a yellow jacket, which gave this weapon its name. Others claim that the weapon leaks radiation so badly that its handlers turn yellow from illness. Few outsiders believe that the Xenos were capable of designing such a sophisticated weapon themselves, and suspect that its blueprints were actually stolen, or its designers were kidnapped scientists. Regardless of the cannon's real origins, it punches through capital ship armor with sufficient force to make a Xeno bomber a competent adversary and a serious threat to foreign shipping or Liberty Navy capital ship patrols that lack fighter escorts.

722031.text:
"Hellfire" Rocket Pod

The Rocket Pod is a recent innovation in bomber armaments. The weapon rapidly fires unguided rockets that are primarily designed to breach gunboat hulls, but also do significant damage to shielding. The ammunition limitations of the weapon forces pilots to make a well thought tactical decision regarding its deployment, but, when used effectively, it can devastate a gunboat. Bomber pilots are heavily discouraged from relying solely on the Rocket Pod, and are urged to use a well rounded complement of weapons.

722033.text:
Gallic M0-3H "Sacre Bleu" Transport Turret

A common sight in almost every port in Gallia, these basic, easily maintained turrets are the staple of its civilian sector. Used on virtually anything from the smallest transport to the huge Pachydermes, this turret has caused many a Brigand to curse its name. Built to fit on smaller transports, it has comparable firepower to that of the Sirian CT-403 "Iron Hammer" and is widely available to the civilian market within Gallia.

722035.text:
RH-SMB1 "Ragnarok" Red Hessian Battleship Forward Gun

The "Ragnarok" forward gun is a trademark Hessian development. It is based on a civilian mining blaster designed to break apart large asteroids through an energy discharge as opposed to traditional chemical explosives. The Hessians oversized and overcharged it until it became a devastating siege weapon. The sheer size of the weapon required a specially designed Battleship-class hull to encase it - and even then, it can only be fired directly ahead. Needless to say, Corsair and Rheinland Military capital ships learned quickly not to stay in front of any Hessian ship equipped with the Ragnarok.

722037.text:
Gallic Solaris Turret

The Solaris Turret developed in Gallia's weapon labs fires twice as fast as its counterpart in Sirius, but does significantly less damage. Designed primarily as a measure to counter hostile fighters, it is still able to deliver a withering stream of fire onto capital class targets and space stations until its ship's energy reserves are depleted.

722039.text:
Solaris Gatling Turret

Unsatisfied with the refire capabilities of conventional Solaris turrets, and under pressure from capital ship fleets to upgrade the weapon, weapons designers across Sirius constructed a Solaris turret that is capable of twice the refire rate of previous designs for battleships and cruisers. The enhanced refire does come with a penalty, however. The damage to hull and shields inflicted by the upgraded weapon is approximately half that of its older counterpart. With highly expert gunners in short supply due to attrition in the various wars being waged across Sirius, the ability to fire faster is prized more highly by some commmanders than the ability to hit the target with each shot. Experienced crews scoff at the innovation as a sign of declining standards, but some embrace it as a more effective means of dealing with hostile fighter swarms.

722041.text:
CDI-RFEW-3 "Kopis Mk I" Crayter Particle Cannon

This is a particle-based weapon which, although it delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722043.text:
CDI-RFEW-5 "Kopis Mk II" Crayter Particle Cannon

This is a particle-based weapon which, although it delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722045.text:
CDI-NEW-9 "Hoplon Mk I" Crayter Light Particle Cannon

This is a particle-based weapon which, although very energy efficient, has a shorter effective range than most energy weapons. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields

722047.text:
CDI-RFEW-6T "Kopis Mk I" Crayter Particle Turret

This is a particle-based weapon which, although it delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields..

722049.text:
CDI-NEW-12T "Hoplon Mk II" Crayter Light Particle Turret

This is a particle-based weapon which, although very energy efficient, has a shorter effective range than most energy weapons. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722051.text:
CDI-LHW-10 "Athos" Crayter Gunboat Turret

The Athos is a light point defense turret designed for targetting fast moving objects like fighters. Its low range and limited damage output make it unsuitable for attacking larger ships.

722053.text:
CDI-MHW-32 "Hesperius" Crayter Cruiser Turret

An adaptation of the T5b IMG cruiser turret, the Hesperius was designed by Crayter Defense Industries in collaboration with IMG. Intended to be mounted on Thanatos-class cruisers, this turret features a considerable amount of firepower with adequate tracking ability, making it a good all-around weapon. It is most effective when used against other cruiser-class ships or gunboats.

722055.text:
CDI-VHHW-73 "Rhea" Crayter Battleship Primary Turret

The third-generation Rhea battleship turret is the largest gun produced by the Republic. Just like its smaller counterparts, this weapon works by compressing antimatter into an incendiary slug and accelerating it to lethal, armor-piercing speeds. While seen as a crude design of a bygone era, the Rhea still does a formidable job at halting the advance of Crayter's enemies.

722057.text:
CDI-VHHW-51 "Koios" Crayter Battleship Secondary Turret

As the Rhea's younger brother, the Koios is a third-generation point defense turret that bears many similarities to its larger sibling. Unlike the Rhea, the Koios possesses formidable targetting and tracking ability that allows it to destroy smaller craft like fighters and bombers.

722059.text:
H4-Z "Brimstone" Insurgency Gunboat Turret

Originally based off blueprints presumably stolen from Liberty Navy and Ageira Technologies computer data-banks, this is the second generation of the "Brimstone" turret. An evolution from its predecessor which was created out of conflicting technologies to form a better whole, it is the smallest of the H4-series turrets and designed to be utilized on Gunboat-class ships.

722061.text:
Blood Dragon "Omiyari" Cruiser Turret

A powerful allround cruiser turret developed by the Blood Dragons. While capable of engaging targets of any size, it excels at damaging Gunboat and Cruiser class ships.

722063.text:
Blood Dragon "Chigiriki" Gunboat Turret

A small, fast-tracking gunboat turret developed by the Blood Dragons. While doing light damage, it is highly accurate, perfect for engaging enemy strikecraft.

722065.text:
T-EMP-37 "Oxybeles" EMP Torpedo Launcher

The Oxybeles is a new development and so far one of a kind. While featuring similarities to the renowned Incapacitator EMP Torpedo, the Oxybeles was constructed to deliver a torpedo with an EMP charge of a wide detonation range capable of harming more than one target at once. This launcher was developed solely for the usage as an integrated weapon on the Claymore Super Heavy Fighter.

722068.text:
"Xyston" Plasma Accelerator

The Xyston Plasma Accelerator marks a new development in heavy fightercraft weaponry. Effectively a crossbreed between standard Plasma-based fighter weapons and the magnetic slingshot technology applied in defense turrets for Transports, the Xyston is capable of firing high-powered, relatively fast-moving Plasma balls at its target.

The Xyston was exclusively designed for the HFX-F8B Claymore as a variant of its integrated forward cannon.

722070.text:
"Acinaces" Beam Cannon

An upscaled version of the Corona Beam Cannon utilized on bomber crafts, the Acinaces was developed as a Beam Cannon integrated into the HFX-F8B Claymore's hull with the intention of granting the vessel an additional way of attacking gunboats and transports.

722072.text:
"Palintona" Particle Cannon

The Palintona is an overcharged Particle cannon that comes as a variant of the weapons designed exclusively to be directly integrated into the HFX-F8B Claymore's hull. While too slow and inaccurate to be effective against smaller targets, the Palintona's high damage output and comparatively low power draw make it an excellent tool in the Claymore's anti-capital arsenal.

722074.text:
"Amentum" Unguided Missile Launcher

The Amentum is loosely based on the design of the Catapult missile and rapidly fires unguided missiles at every foe risking to get in front of a HFX-F8B Claymore, featuring this variant of integrated weaponry. While being cost-efficient, the lack of tracking capabilities renders the Amentum as best employed against larger targets or for the usage as spray and pray tactic only.

722077.text:
Asco Forward Torpedo Launcher

A unique torpedo launcher installed on the Gallic Brigand "Asco" class gunboat. The weapon is designed to allow the gunboat to disrupt the shields of large transports or capital craft from a safe distance, before moving in close for the kill.

722079.text:
T-EMP-04 "Incapacitator" EMP Torpedo Launcher

As shields got stronger and conventional "Nova" type warheads became ineffective against large capital vessels, Kishiro engineers set out to create a heavy torpedo that could deliver an immense EMP charge. The design was quickly copied and adopted across Sirius, and the "Incapacitator" class torpedos are now available throughout the colonies.

722081.text:
"Hellfire" Rocket Pod Ammo

Ammunition for the Hellfire Rocket Pod.

722083.text:
Katyusha-17 Coalition Battleship Turret

A very large turret produced by the Coalition, mainly intended for station defense. It can be retrofitted for use on battleships.

722085.text:
Afanasev-12 Coalition Light Battleship Turret

An adaptation of the CTR-43 Destroyer turret, this weapon boasts faster tracking and projectile speeds, but requires significantly more energy to fire. Mainly intended as a station point-defense, it can be retrofitted for use on battleships.

722087.text:
Afanasev-7 Coalition Destroyer Turret

A large turret designed for use on Coalition Destroyer-class ships. This turret features a considerable amount of firepower with moderate tracking ability, making it a good all-round weapon. It is most effective when used against other Cruiser-class ships, or gunboats.

722089.text:
Goryunov-5 Coalition Gunboat Turret

A fast-tracking, high speed turret designed to engage and destroy strikecraft quickly. It's damage potential and range is limited however, making it less effective when used against capital ships.

722091.text:
LT41 "Reaver" Bounty Hunter Laser Turret

This is a laser-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields. This is the best Laser Turret the Bounty Hunters have to offer.

722093.text:
CL-dt "Improved Flashpoint" Civilian Laser Turret

This is a laser-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields.

722095.text:
CL-ht "Heavy Flashpoint" Civilian Laser Turret

This is a laser-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields. This is the best Civilian Laser Turret available.

722097.text:
ZT43t-4 "Fury 4" Zoner Photon Turret

This is a photon-based weapon which, though providing a high refire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy to deliver a significant damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields.

722099.text:
ZT43t-5 "Fury 5" Zoner Neutron Turret

This is a neutron-based weapon which, though very energy efficient has a shorter effective range than most energy weapons. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722101.text:
ZGOZ-14.t "Sapper No.1" Coalition Pulse Turret

The Sapper is one of the latest developments from Zvezdny Gorodok. It is believed to have been developed from a mixture of Coalition and Civilian weapons, although the speed of the weapon has been slightly modified to make it incompatible with Sirian equipment. This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage.

722103.text:
"Pot-de-fer II" Gallic Civilian Neutron Turret

This is a neutron-based weapon which, though very energy efficient has a shorter effective range than most energy weapons. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722105.text:
P3-W "Shimmer" Transport Turret

Originally designed by the GMG who were reluctant to rely on Samura-built civilian weapons, these turrets are now a common sight throughout the colonies, and widely available. The turret is small enough to fit on any transport-class ship, and carries enough of a punch to deter enemy fighters.

722107.text:
Y4-RR "Bleeder" Transport Turret

Much like the civilian transports on the Trade Lanes, smuggler transports need to defend themselves from the odd Bounty Hunter or Police patrols that might come across it. The Bleeder turret fits this bill nicely, being small enough to fit on any transport class ship, and packing enough of a punch to challenge anything from fighters to gunboats.

722109.text:
DCP-2 "Pointe de Lumiere" Destroyer Photon Pulse Turret

The Pointe de Lumiere is a point defense weapon for Gallic capital ships. It fires a burst of energy at incredable speed, with pinpoint accuracy. Individual shots do not deal high amounts of damage however, limiting this weapon to anti-strikecraft use.

722111.text:
CST-G2 "Solaris Gatling" Gunboat Turret

A higher powered version of the regular Gunboat Solaris Turret, this turret features the same high velocity but deals more damage, and can fire even more quickly. The weapon's high rate of fire and speed, however, come at a cost. Solaris Gatling Gunboat Turrets consume larger amounts of energy and are slightly less accurate than their lower-powered variant.

722113.text:
CPR-1X "Zapper" Photon Ray Cruiser Turret

The next logical step up from the Transport Zapper, the Cruiser version demands more power, but has a greater range and deals more damage. The power demands of this weapon can be a problem for some smaller destroyers.

722115.text:
Large Station Torpedo Launcher


This is a guided torpedo launcher for use on space stations.

722118.text:
Junker Gunboat Turret

Inspired by the "Bleeder" Transport Turret, this overcharged turret was designed by the Junkers to give their ships a little more punch in an increasingly hostile environment.

722120.text:
"TD-1-F" Transport Flak Turret

The newly developed TD-1-F Transport Flak is a recently developed piece of hardware that serves as defense against torpedo attacks, for transport class vessel. Because it is a downsized Battleship Flak with minor adjustments to fit on transports, it is very energy inefficient and recommended for use only with a massive powercore.

722122.text:
"Petit Carbine" Gallic Civilian Pulse Cannon

This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage. This iteration of the Carbine is intended for use on light fighters.

722124.text:
CDI-HHW-47 "Azeios" Crayter Battlecruiser Turret

The Crayter Republic is well known for innovative solutions when it comes to war machines and weaponry. The new generation of battlecruiser turrets produced for the Argus-class offers competitive firepower to stand toe-to-toe with most adversaries.

722126.text:
UNT "Emancipator" Unioner Cruiser Turret

This turret appears to be the largest mass produced cannon in Pacifica's inventory. If sensor readings are correct, the Emancipator follows the Unioner convention of disguising a sophisticated, modular anti-ship weapon in a byzantine, unimposing shell. Close inspection shows that the cannon contains advanced beam attenuators, current-generation microtransistors and field focusing equipment containing trace design elements extracted from the various wrecks littering the Independent Worlds, although the overall system appears innovatively unique, with no obvious ancestor. Possibly due to financial restrictions, the cannon lacks heat sinks, instead discharging spent coolant directly out of the barrel, creating distinctive muzzle flashes. Eyewitness accounts attest that the Republican traders presented by the green glow of the Emancipator are quick to emancipate themselves from their credits, rather than risk emancipation from their lives. Caution is advised.

722128.text:
UNT "Organiser" Unioner Battleship Secondary Turret

Oddly, sensor data reveals this weapon to be the only known heavy weapon in the Unioner arsenal that does not contain any recognisable trace of Eighty Years War era engineering. Instead, the Organiser features advanced, possibly Lane-Hacker acquired guidance systems, providing target acquisition capabilities that the rudimentary anti-fighter weaponry that the Rheinland battleships of the Eighty Years War could not match, capable of organising hostile strike craft into fire pockets with extreme ease. Despite being a masterful work of ordinance design in hugely adverse conditions, the minimal number of questionably functional battleships the Unioners possess limits the cannon to being little more than a shrine to Unioner technical brilliance, instead of a viable weapons system. The riveted construction of the turret implies the weapon has been built entirely by hand, in contrast to every other large capital artillery piece presently used by humankind. Caution is advised.

722130.text:
UNT "Salvation" Unioner Battleship Turret

This turret's general construction remains loosely similar to the ponderous battleship cannons of Imperial Era Rheinland Navy, and is likely built to similar schematics, although the power readings from the cannon imply that the weapon is extremely sophisticated for an underworld design, carrying various bizarre aerospace innovations from each of the disparate Unioner cells, the specifications of which cannot be identified from sensor data alone, neuralnet record, or the known laws of thermodynamics. The names of dead and imprisoned Unioner activists, engineers and raiders carved into the barrel in the place of a serial number indicates that this turret is not intended for mass production and has been built at great expense to the Unioner movement as a whole, perhaps as a monument to the Union's past, or, more ominously, as a vision of the Union's future. This bizarre artillery piece should be thought of as a fetish item to the paranoia that would justify the construction of such an unworkable weapon, rather than a functional battleship gun. However, such obvious over-engineering implies that Unioners would regard as hostile any foreign spacecraft flying close enough to scan the turret. Extreme caution is advised.

722132.text:
UNT "Activist" Unioner Gunboat Turret

Whilst the ancient turret housing of this plasma cannon implies nothing more than out-of-date design dating from the Rheinland Empire, the gun itself shows signs of modification with the salvaged components of modern weapons systems that the attached gunboat has chewed its way through. Close analysis casing of the weapon infers suggests the comparatively excellent build quality for which the Unioners are renowned, despite the exotic mixture of radiation signatures leaking from the turret. Caution is advised.

722134.text:
UNT "Agitator" Unioner Forward Gun

The Agitator was originally conceived by a short-lived Imperial Shipping subdivision as the main gun for a speculative civilian retrofit of the Oder gunboat in the golden years of the Rheinland Empire. The collapse of the Empire, and subsequent 'disappearance' of most of the design bureau stalled the project indefinitely. Whilst the design for the gunboat is lost to history, the forward gun was not. Statistically indistinguishable -- if more eccentrically engineered -- than the Military's own Brummbär, Unioner economising has increased the emissive signature of the cannon, resulting in a distinctively terrifying barrel flash.

722136.text:
Asco Torpedo Ammo

Ammunition for the Asco Torpedo.

722138.text:
AR-23B "Firstlight" Core Gunboat Turret

Designed by Core technicians, this turret is used on their gunships. Boasting an extremely high projectile speed and high rate of fire as well as rapid tracking, it can effectively engage and overwhelm multiple fast moving strike craft. Its damage potential and range are limited however, making this weapon less effective against capital ships.

722140.text:
APXARX-01HF "Ultimus" Core Gunboat Forward Gun

Designed to complement the Pleco, the Ultimus Gunboat Forward Gun fires a bolt of energy that weakens capital ship hull at the molecular level. The extremely deadly nature of this weapon makes it even more effective against organic matter such as Nomadic vessels. However, The Core has no qualms about employing this weapon against human ships either - or the pilots inside.

722142.text:
Bomber "Deluge" Gatling Laser

A rapid-firing weapon designed to punch holes through capital ships and fighter craft alike. The Deluge exercises devastation by delivering a violent storm of high-powered lasers - akin to the Flashpoint fighter laser, but on a much bigger scale and magnitude.

722144.text:
CG-12 "Browning" Chaingun Rounds
As the Maxim chaingun's ability to deal sustained damage was realised, it was only a matter of time before a large caliber model was developed. The Browning is the result of such development, carried out by an anonymous benefactor somewhere in probably not too bright parts of Sirius.

The Browning is based on the very same principle that its lesser brother. Its multiple barrels fire a steady stream of heavy tungsten rounds designed specifically to shred ship or station hull panels, at the cost of rather lackluster performance against energy-based shields. Unlike the Maxim, however, the Browning chaingun was met with little critic or opposition, as its predecessor has already established rapid-fire kinetic weapons as a respected and popular weapon type. As such, this next step in chainguns' evolution quickly found its way to almost any arsenal in Sirius, its doubtful origins hardly any dissuasion even for lawful forces, who quickly adopted "their own" variants for combat use.

*Fired by Bomber Chaingun

722146.text:
Bomber "Arbalest" Neutron Blaster

Once a weapon developed for the Royalist legions back in the first Gallic civil war. The Arbalest is a repeater capable of slinging inaccurate, overcharged Neutron payloads that will bludgeon and smolder the toughest of warships.

In the wake of 817 A.S. it was pioneered onto Freeports by a Corsican haggler, and with expeditive success, the Arbalest encroached and garnered popularity within the Sirian market.

722148.text:
"Scorcher" Plasma Bomb Launcher

The Scorcher is a modern reincarnation of millennia old method of dealing with large naval ships or land targets. The weapon is, at its very core, a simple, overcharged plasma cannon firing powerful, slow moving projectiles of impressive power.

Although not particularly useful when dealing with gunships or smaller cruisers, the sheer damage output has drawn the attention of both military forces in need of dealing with hostile capital ships, as well as pirate and terrorist factions seeking a quick solution to stubborn merchants.

*Requires Scorcher Bomb

722150.text:
"Neutralizer" EMP Bomb Launcher

The bomb designed for use with the Neutralizer Bomb Launcher is a specifically modified version of its predecessor, the Scorcher Bomb. This variation is focused on an internal EMP charge that detonates upon contact, releasing an incredible amount of energy that generates a large electromagnetic pulse. This allows even a few of these bomb charges to overwhelm even capital shield generators and cause them to overload and shut down for a brief period of time. Due to the size of this charge, the bomb itself has a relatively slow speed and requires leading of the target to ensure a direct hit. It has almost no effect on hull plating due to the nature of its payload.

*Requires Neutralizer Bomb

722152.text:
Weapon Codename: THUNDERWAVE

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

There is no information available on this weapon other than its project name.

722154.text:
"Silencer" Gunboat Missile Launcher

The Silencer is a lightweight guided missile launcher for gunboats. Most of the missile's capacity is taken up by its sophisticated tracking computer and propulsion system, resulting in a light payload but unmatched agility to engage small targets.

722157.text:
"Vandal" Gunboat Missile Launcher

The Vandal is a medium-payload missile designed mainly for engaging other gunboats and cruisers. The design offers a good compromise of agility, speed, and destructive capabilities.

722160.text:
"Marauder" Cruiser Missile Launcher

The Marauder is a medium forward-firing cruiser guided missile launcher. Its main qualities are the powerful propulsion, extensive range and an excellent warhead performance against unshielded targets.

722163.text:
"Devastator" Cruiser Ion Torpedo Launcher

The Devastator is a substantial departure from conventional guided missile systems, unleashing a huge wave of ionizing radiation upon detonation that can damage components throughout the target vessel. Though relatively fast for its size, it compensates its lack of hull damage with devastating shield damage potential to compete with the Marauder.

722166.text:
"Reaper" Battleship Missile Launcher

The Reaper is an upgraded version of the Devastator Cruiser Missile Launcher, scaled up as a battleship weapon. With more internal space provided by the hardpoints it is mounted in, the Reaper can carry heavier missiles with better range and payload, along with a 360º horizontal traverse, expanding upon the Devastator's flexibility.

722169.text:
"Nightmare" Battleship Missile Silo

The Nightmare torpedo is the most powerful electromagnetic pulse ordinance in all of Sirius. Traditional launchers cannot load such oversized ordinance, so custom silos are built to house and discharge them during the battleship's initial construction. The missiles themselves are discharged in a vertical parabolic arc at extreme ranges. The flight path of the missle ensures that it picks up a frightening amount of speed upon its downward trajectory through the use of stage rockets attached to the missles themselves. Upon impact, any small ships within detonation range risks losing their electronic systems entirely, and larger capitals risk their shields disappearing if the Nightmare scores a direct hit. The horrifying power of the Nightmare comes at a cost, as the sheer size of the Nightmare torpedo means that there is an extreme reloading time between missle launches.

722171.text:
BSX-1020 "Nightmare" Torpedo

Superheavy silo-launched EMP cruise missile.

*Fired by Nightmare Missile Silo

722173.text:
"Lightning" Battleship EMP Missile Launcher

The Lightning is a variant of the Reaper, carrying an EMP warhead instead of explosives. It offers battleships a high speed, accurate guided missile that will rapidly extinguish cruiser shields and threaten battleships.

722176.text:
"Hurricane" Battleship Heavy Torpedo Launcher

The Hurricane is designed to get the absolute maximum capacity out of a traditional battleship launcher setup. Firing a huge torpedo optimized for unmatched payload delivery, it forgoes any semblance of agility to simply deliver a barely-guided bomb to a slow target. While it lacks effective control mechanisms, it has very powerful propulsion, making a well-aimed launch difficult to avoid.

722179.text:
MLI-510 "Desolator" Missile Silo

The "Desolator" missile system blurs the line between a traditional forward-firing launcher and a vertical launcher. This complex arrangement uses a rail bridge to feed self-contained magazines from the rotary housing located below the turret onto the launcher. With this approach, the Desolator can quickly reload even the heaviest ordnance available. Equipped with multiple electromagnetic pulse charge missiles in each magazine, the Desolator offers excellent, rapid-fire shield suppression.

722182.text:
"Annihilator" Gunboat Rocket Launcher

The Annihilator is a new Rocket Launcher design of unprecedented capacity, constituting a completely new class of heavy anti-capital gunboat armaments. Unleashing a barrage of rockets with shaped charge warheads, the Annihilator is capable of heavily damaging even the thickest of hulls, and its advanced propulsion systems allow it to engage all but the most nimble targets. However, the chemical compound of the rocket booster burns unevenly, resulting in increased dispersion.

722185.text:
"Hellbore" Battleship Heavy Mass Driver

Improving anti-warship damage while maintaining adequate rates of fire at the largest scales forced the Royal Armament Research Group at BMM to apply modern technologies to venerable solutions. A series of highly conductive electromagnetic coils around a smoothbore barrel charge and discharge in sequence to rapidly accelerate a 180-millimetre armour-piercing shaped charge projectile to supersonic speeds. Upon impact, an explosive charge in the payload rapidly superheats and deforms a tungsten plate, turning it into a hypervelocity jet of molten metal that sears through anything short of a space station's emergency shields. During the last stages of the Gallic War, plans for the weapon were leaked, and copies begane to appear throughout Sirius, including within Gallia's borders under the name "Mons Meg".


*This turret is only compatible with Dreadnought class ships.

722187.text:
"Mons Meg" Gallic Battleship Heavy Mass Driver

One of Gallia's intelligence operations during the second half of the war against the allied powers of Sirius retrieved the design schematics for the battleship-class weapon that would be eventually publicly released as the Hellbore-type mass driver series. Based on the same electromagnetic propulsion principles as the weapon it was based on, the "Mons Meg" varies in the layering of materials used in the explosively-formed penetrator of the warhead and the coating of the projectile in a brilliantly-sparking burgundy tracer that serves primarily for displays of sophistication and might. Battleships both of the Enclave and of post-royal Gallia are often seen with this weapon both due to its efficacy and its intimidation factor.


*This turret is only compatible with Dreadnought class ships.

722189.text:
"Neutralizer" EMP Bomb
The Neutralizer is a younger cousin of the Scorcher launcher, operating in a very similar manner. Much like its plasma-based relative, the Neutralizer is in essence a heavy, overcharged cannon. Instead of plasma, however, the weapon releases slow EMP pulses, capable of overloading even the heaviest shield generators in a matter of a handful of bombing runs.

This weapon is most commonly employed against hostile battleships and dreadnoughts, as its slow projectile speed make it difficult to accurately hit gunships or even more nimble cruisers.

*Fired by Neutralizer Bomb Launcher

HFGx-05lc "Retribution" Liberty Blackmarket Laser Cannon Mk I

722193.text:
HFGx-06lc "Retribution" Liberty Blackmarket Laser Cannon Mk II

This is a laser-based weapon that delivers a good amount of damage with a good refire. This weapon is most effective against positron-type shields, and weakest against graviton shields. This is the best and newest laser cannon the Insurgency has to offer.

722199.text:
HFGx-10an "Flamberge" Liberty Blackmarket Antimatter Cannon

As the Insurgency grew stronger they felt the need to become less reliant on civilian manufacturers, and chose to invest in equipment built by their own workers. The Flamberge carries the might of the Insurgency in its shots, and each round strikes fear into the hearts of those who oppose them.

722201.text:
Nomad Hybrid Blaster

These weapons, as unique as they are deadly, are employed by Nomads and Nomad-human hybrids to convert the mysterious energies of their vessels into potent bolts of energy. Since their operating mechanisms are unknown, scientists will pay handsomely for any samples they may secure.

722203.text:
Adapted Nomad Blaster

This appears to be an attempt to configure Nomad weapon technology to be compatible with ships from the colonies. Order and Core scientists originally developed the experimental mountings that were capable of utilising the energy conversion units, however the poorly understood technology has since leaked onto the black markets and proliferated across Sirius.

It is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722267.text:
AI Cruiser Turret

722285.text:
APXA-T "Finis" Core Antimatter Cannon

After gaining control of Planet Nauru, AP Manufacturing had both room and resources to experiment further with antimatter weaponry. Based on samples of the Hybrid Antimatter Cannon, the "Finis" Antimatter Cannon quickly disintegrates matter over a large radius on impact. An incredibly deadly asset against hostile capital vessels, the Finis is at the forefront of The Core's conquest in the Edge Worlds.

722287.text:
XAF-4 "Boomslang" Xeno Gunboat Turret

Fueled by unrivaled patriotism and held together by duct-tape, this Xeno weapon is designed to shoot fast, deadly blasts from gunboat-class ships.

722289.text:
Eco-LL "Gaia's Champion" Gaian Gunboat Turret

This very recently designed weapon was made specifically for the "Claymore" Gaian Gunboat. Firing speedy energy bolts with moderately high damage output, this turret is perfect to fight smaller opponents.

722291.text:
CDI-AIP-1 "Yuma's Flame" Crayter Antimatter Cannon
With the increasing need for more bomber wings to combat the Gallic advance, the Crayter Military needed to create a more capable antimatter cannon than the black market ones they were using. Based on the schematics of the Coalition's own Equalizer antimatter cannon, the CDI-AIP-1 "Yuma's Flame" has proven easy and affordable to produce and steadfastly reliable under extreme conditions.

722293.text:
"TDGWM5K" Pulse Cannon

Prototype pulse weapon of non-human origin. The TDGWM5K gets its unwieldy name from a single decoded string in the weapon's designation code. It is a pulse weapon calibrated for very high refire rate, well beyond typical equivalents. Despite its mysterious origins, it is manufactured to be compatible with typical human hardpoints.

722295.text:
Weapon Codename: SUPERSONIC

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

Prototype photon cannon of unknown origin, firing low charge bolts at astonishing speed. This weapon is not compatible with standard targeting computers; it must be aimed manually.

722297.text:
Jump Drive Batteries

There is no information on this item.

722299.text:
"W+7754KT" Cruiser Repeater Turret

Rapid-fire cruiser weapon of unknown origin. This "Repeater" turret is an allrounder weapon, suitable for use against a wide range of targets. It is technologically closely related to other cruiser weaponry of its type, but calibrated for a much higher fire rate.

722301.text:
"Coup de Grace" Cruiser Blaster Turret

Gallic prototype cruiser weapon, intended as a "finisher" on very close targets. The weapon has impressive power output, high speed and quick refire, but lacks range compared to similar guns.

722303.text:
"WACISFN" Cruiser Ion Blaster

It seems the focal point when developing these Blasters was to annihilate all contemporary forms of shielding, human or nomad. The turret mount exhibits a crude application of an extended barrel and a better-reinforced chassis, in order to deliver a stabilized shot and withstand the ionizing radiation that emanates upon discharge. End-users beware of inefficient reactor-core consumption.

722305.text:
"OA5IVRU" Battleship Heavy Ion Blaster

This unusual battleship weapon is a development by the mysterious "Cult of Technology", and a very small number have been salvaged from their wreckages. The massive ion charge it fires neutralizes a target's power supply, draining huge amounts of energy from the ship's reactor. On a shielded vessel however, the neutralization will occur before affecting the ship's systems, making it suitable only against unprotected targets.

722307.text:
MK-81 Battleship Autopulse Turret

The MK-81 is a newly developed pulse-type weapon built by the Coalition. With enemies such as the Corsairs fielding many large warships, there was a need for a specialized weapon built specifically to take down heavy shielding on large targets. The MK-81 is not designed for precision shooting, but rather for creating a heavy barrage of powerful EMP fire, suppressing capital ships at long range.

722309.text:
"Thumper" Battleship Rapid-Fire Turret

Very little is known about this weapon. Although it is clearly designed for use on human capital vessels, its origins are unknown. The weapon has a high firing rate, optimized for use against smaller targets.

722311.text:
RBT-84h "Sledge" Heavy Battleship Turret

Rheinland prototype battleship weapon which never advanced past early trials. The Sledge follows typical Rheinland trends: A very heavy, slow firing, high powered weapon suitable for use on Rheinland's massive battleships, and optimal against targets of equal size. The trials were promising, but the project was expensive and ultimately deemed unnecessary with the end of the Liberty conflict. A few of the remaining prototypes had apparently gone missing and have since shown up in unexpected places.

722313.text:
RA-20 "Gale" Battleship Cannon

The "Gale" is an ancient Corsair design, an ambitious project to create a weapon that is fast, powerful, and has extensive range. The design succeeded in meeting these goals, but politics prevented it from entering production, as the family supporting the development of the now-universal RA-72 used their greater influence and wealth to suppress the Gale's adoption. The prototypes, dusty but functional, were recently rediscovered in a centuries-old abandoned warehouse on Crete.

722315.text:
"Volée" Battleship Cannon

The Volée is a multi-shot, "shotgun"-type battleship defense weapon, designed to keep smaller away from the mighty Valor class. The Gallic capital ship doctrine focuses heavily on grand battleship warfleets, but the heavy, slow weaponry on these ships leaves them somewhat vulnerable to smaller, very close ships. The Volée was intended to alleviate this problem, but the doctrines have since changed to focus more on light support. Although a number of these weapons were produced, their fate is unknown.

722317.text:
MB10a "Lewis" Battleship Cannon

The Lewis is an archaic design, a true projectile weapon, firing 240mm explosive shells in a double-barrel configuration not unlike the weapons found on naval warships of the Sol era. Used heavily by Bretonia in the early centuries of colonization, these weapons were made obsolete by shield technology, which renders this type of weapon useless. Most Lewis cannons were destroyed, but a small number still remain in museums or forgotten armories. Against an unshielded target, they are still as effective as ever.

722319.text:
"Kreisky" Dual Gatling Laser Turret

This new design is a cooperative effort between the Red Hessians and the Coalition. Unlike most other capital weaponry, it is actually based on fighter and freighter turrets, scaled up massively to create a very rapid fire laser turret to engage small ships. Although the individual shots are weak, the sheer volume of fire the double barreled weapon provides makes it terrifyingly effective against any smaller craft threatening a red capital ship.

722321.text:
RBT-1000 "Schwerer Gustav" Battleship Siege Turret

"Gustav" is a heavy battleship kinetic weapon design originating in an abandoned Rheinland program from the time of the Liberty war. Its massive armor-piercing ion-stabilized discarding sabot rounds contain an almost seven meter long tungsten jacketed osmium penetrator dart, capable of defeating the armor of any battleship and even heavily fortified space stations. The intricate construction of the weapon itself and the very high cost of its ammunition led to the project being officially abandoned, but the design was leaked and some weapons of the type have since been constructed and used in assault roles across Sirius.

722323.text:
"ORZLMUE" Battleship EMP Dissipation Field

Another unusual prototype of unknown, possibly non-human origin, this peculiar device functions by releasing massive EMP charges in a general area. Only a handful have been discovered, on a wrecked ship drifting in the Edge Worlds. The devices are likely developmental, although for what purpose they were created and by whom remains unknown.

722325.text:
"Terminator" Battleship Defense Turret

One of very few cooperative projects between Samura and Kishiro since the democratic coup, the Terminator was developed at the government's request as a very high powered capital weapon to deal with the Imperial's hit-and-run tactics. Although slower to fire than comparable weapons, the Terminator carries incredible damage potential with only a few hits.

Very little information is available about this weapon.

722381.text:
Battlecruiser Flak Turret

With any large ship, ordinance deterrence becomes a staple of the survival of that craft. The Battlecruiser flak does just that, disrupting enemy missile and torpedo fire, as well as inhibiting snub craft success in the small area it covers.

722383.text:
Liberty Battlecruiser Turret

The motives behind the development of this weapon are unclear, though it is certain the LSF had a crucial role in its creation, the information on it has been classified beyond reason to include even the software in each cannon. Tampering can result in immediate deactivation of the weapon. WARNING: Do not attempt to obtain additional information on this weapon.

722385.text:
Kusari Battlecruiser Turret

The Empire of Kusari has never been known for using conventional means, and their rendition of the Primary Battlecruiser turret is no exception. While striving for efficiency over all else, but still superior payload to the most common variant, the Kusari Primary Turret goes above and beyond to give the advantage to ace helmsman.

722387.text:
IMG Battlecruiser Turret

Some would argue that the IMG is most notable for their mining achievements. Then there are those who know the true potential when people unite for a common cause of profit. The latest installment of IMG battlecruiser tech delivers a more than acceptable quantity.

722389.text:
Core Battlecruiser Turret

APM is well known for its incredible balance between quality and quantity. While never sacrificing one for the other, the Core maintains its competitive edge on weapon technology.

722391.text:
"Caldera" Insurgency Battlecruiser Turret

The "Caldera" Insurgency Battlecruiser Turret lives up to the sound of its name. With a level performance curve, this turret offers substantial destructive force while remaining efficient and easy to maintain.

722393.text:
Rheinland Battlecruiser Turret

The Rheinland Military has never ceased to bring quality equipment to the battlefield. Offering, yet again, some of the highest performance Battlecruiser weaponry. Rheinland, yet again, sets records when it comes to maximum kinetic impact force at a colossal cost of power.

722395.text:
Order Battlecruiser Turret

With adversaries developing heavier battlecruiser weaponry, the Order moved to remain constant at the peak of technology. Most information about their battlecruiser weaponry is classified, with the exception of a few minor details of cannon size.

722397.text:
Gallic Battlecruiser Turret

Bigger and better, onward and upward. Gallia is known around Sirius as a formidable force, and their improvements to Battlecruiser weaponry is no exception. With improved range and payload, at quite the expense of power, the Gallic fleet produced yet another addition to their "Heavy hitters" list.

722399.text:
Maquis Battlecruiser Turret

Regardless of how the Council receives their equipment and technology, there's always a reason to acquire more. Whether it's salvage or reverse engineering, there is always a means to an end when it comes to achieving the best available military technology. By focusing on larger efficiency over power, the Council moved to improve their abilities to sustain combat for longer durations without taxing the cannon or power core too much.

722401.text:
Basic Battlecruiser Turret

With a miniature arms race passively advancing on any warfront, each power desires to create a weapon better than the last. By taking the concepts behind Basic Cruiser Turrets and supercharging them, a conventional primary turret was born. Sometimes bigger is better.

722403.text:
PPCWS-1 Battlecruiser "Sunwreath" Turret

A lumbering and archaic particle cannon. While its origins are subject to immense controversy and dispute among weapons experts, the effectiveness of it is not. The potency of the overcharged beam it produces is capable of melting through several layers of capital-class armor. Even the pinnacle of engineering behind Liberty warship design is ill-suited to receive the punishment this cannon exemplifies. However, it is glaringly less potent against agile craft, weighed down by oversized heatsinks and coolant vents - a necessity given the volatility of the charge it produces. Rumors abound that this weapon was likely developed by criminals as an answer to House aggression. Or, that the weapon was designed by one of the Great Houses for use by criminals against a rival House. Regardless of potential origins, the Sunwreath is fielded by any organization with ships that can sustain its demanding profile and logistical hurdles.

722405.text:
Battlecruiser Pulse

With the constant improvements to shield technology, it becomes a requirement to improve the plain and simple device to which has always been its bane. The Battlecruiser Pulse Cannon improves slightly on the proven concept of EMP weaponry to deliver a payload of significant shield drain, and notable power drain.

722407.text:
Gallic Battlecruiser Trebuchet

With the evolution of capital ship combat, it became necessary to improve upon the weaponry used by Gallic Battlecruisers. With more power readily available, a modified, supercharged version of the Light Trebuchet enabled a middle ground between Cruisers and Battleships. With superior range and firepower to its lighter counterpart, the everyday task of ship hull deconstruction became significantly easier.

722409.text:
Coalition Battlecruiser Turret

To accompany the Hurricane's ridiculous firepower at the front, the Coalition designed high output primary turrets to cover all sides. Regardless that the vessel is a blockage cracker, it is important to have a strong area of defense around the vessel to prevent strike craft from gaining an advantageous position.

722411.text:
"Tsar" Coalition Battlecruiser Forward Cannon

The 'Tsar' is highly experimental, due to heat generation and power requirements requires that the gun be built directly into the superstructure of the 'Hurricane' Battle-Cruiser. During testing at full power it was noted that the power requirements required more to power all four Cannons. Aralsk's Research & Development Team has thus built in limiters on the weapon's output in order for all cannons to fire, this unfortunately has shown a sharp decrease in firepower per cannon. However High Command officials deemed it a small sacrifice for the purpose of the ship as a 'Break Through' vessel.

722413.text:
"ACROBATIC" Limited Edition Cannon

The ACROBATIC is a high-tech design loosely based on older Bounty Hunter technology. A limited production run was produced by Archeos, a Kusari consumer electronics company known for stylish but overpriced products. The small batch sold out before the first weapon was even delivered, and those still on the market command a hefty premium among collectors.

722415.text:
"FEUERBALL" Plasma Cannon

The FEUERBALL is a slow-firing, massively overcharged plasma cannon developed by a small Rheinland engineering company, Kessler GmbH, on the basis of the widely used Flametongue series in the late 790's. After the Nomad crisis, Kessler was forced to file for bankrupcy after producing only a few hundred of the weapons. Today, the few surviving examples are hard to come by and highly sought after.

722417.text:
"Mauler" Cruiser Reactive Mass Driver

After the recent advancements in mass driver technology were put into Sirius-wide production in the form of Hellbore-type battleship cannons, a small group of weapons engineers in the Independent Worlds set to work scaling down the weapon to something that could be used to turn retrofitted transport frames into discount cruisers. In order to deliver devastating strikes against hulls while still remaining functional at a smaller scale, the Mauler's projectiles use a matrix of volatile charges that spread a reactive payload over a wide area, causing stress fractures in armour plating at the cost of reduced effectiveness against shields. While the project never came to fruition, and the engineering team split shortly after funding was cut, prototypes found their way onto the grey market and small batch production of reverse-engineered copies is starting to be seen in the wild.

722419.text:
Battlecruiser Particle Pulse Accelerator Cannon

The origin of the few suriving examples of this turret is relatively unknown; it has no identifying information, design patterns, emissive signatures, or manufacturing marks, and does not seem to be based on any existing weapon design. The curious turret is designed to be mounted on the reinforced hardpoints for battlecruiser-scale weaponry. Engineers assessing the PPAC's construction and apparent purpose tend to be confused by the appearence of sloppy production, though most will agree that the sloppiness also appears to be entirely by design, as if someone had given a brilliant madman access to a weapons lab somewhere far away from civilization and came back to check in six months later.

722421.text:
"Breaker" Battlecruiser Prototype Heavy Mass Driver

The battlecruiser turret that resulted from Development Project 32-Breaker was never put into mass production, as the plans were scrapped by the Royal Armament Research Group when Development Project 32-Affirm -- later deployed as the Fortitude-class battlecruiser -- was delayed. Nevertheless, the plans were leaked much like those of the Hellbore-type cannon that the Development Project 32-Breaker was basing its design on. The complexities involved in scaling the Hellbore's interlock-staged coil driver system down to operate on the current provided by a battlecruiser-scale weapon hardpoint resulted in the incomplete plans being difficult to produce working examples from, and as a result, not many Breaker-type cannons are in service throughout the colonies.

722423.text:
Battleship EMP Flak Turret

Very little information is available about this weapon.

722425.text:
SHT-83 Cruiser “Hammer” Torpedo Launcher

Developed by Samura in a bid from the Kusari Naval Forces, the Hammer Torpedo is another eaxmple of tried and true Samura philosophy. Featuring as few new components to qualify as a new design- and win the contract- the Hammer carries a heavy anti-matter payload designed to knock-out enemy capital ships, and provides cruisers the ability to punch up against heavier ships.

722427.text:
Hammer Torpedo

Cruiser Hammer Torpedo Launcher

*Fired by Cruiser Hammer Torpedo Turret

Weapon Codename: GARNET

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

There is no information available on this weapon other than its project name.

722433.text:
Weapon Codename: MALACHITE

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

722435.text:
Weapon Codename: TANZANITE

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED
