722437.text:
Gallic Brigands Gunboat Turret

No information available.

722439.text:
CGB-Y1768 "Amarezza" Unione Corse Gunboat Turret

The Amarezza is a short-range, rapid-firing Gunboat Turret, based off of the Brigands' own Gunboat Turret. It is designed to destroy strikecrafts.

722441.text:
ARAPSS Mk. VIII "Augur" Active Probing Scanner

The All-Range All-Purpose Science Suite (ARAPSS) has guided exploratory vessels throughout Sirius for centuries. The latest iteration, the Mark VIII, celebrates the 800th anniversary of the model with the most powerful and versatile toolset to date. Among the diverse array of software and hardware tailored specifically for deep space science missions, the Mark VIII has included a new addition to these missions: the "Augur" Active Probing Scanner. So named for its ability to scry and examine any object it comes across, the Augur has seen great success in analyzing a number of mysterious, formerly indecipherable discoveries. The Augur and its variants has become commonplace among Sirian and Gallic science ships and is commonly used to analyze Baxter anomalies and other oddities in the great black void. The device utilizes a charged tachyonic neutrino pulse to probe objects in a minimally invasive manner, though this is only possible through the use of disposable charges fired from an external launcher. As such, the Augur must use specialized batteries that are readily obtainable at most Sirian research stations.

*Requires Anomaly Scanner Batteries

722443.text:
Anomaly Scanner Batteries

The All-Range All-Purpose Science Suite (ARAPSS) has guided exploratory vessels throughout Sirius for centuries. The latest iteration, the Mark VIII, celebrates the 800th anniversary of the model with the most powerful and versatile toolset to date. Among the diverse array of software and hardware tailored specifically for deep space science missions, the Mark VIII has included a new addition to these missions: the "Augur" Active Probing Scanner. So named for its ability to scry and examine any object it comes across, the Augur has seen great success in analyzing a number of mysterious, formerly indecipherable discoveries. The Augur and its variants has become commonplace among Sirian and Gallic science ships and is commonly used to analyze Baxter anomalies and other oddities in the great black void. The device utilizes a charged tachyonic neutrino pulse to probe objects in a minimally invasive manner, though this is only possible through the use of disposable charges fired from an external launcher. As such, the Augur must use specialized batteries that are readily obtainable at most Sirian research stations.

722445.text:
V2-lp "Venom" Rheinland Ion Compression Cannon Mk 2

Originally an experimental weapon designed by the MND in 825 A.S., the Venom is an Ion Compression Cannon, designed to deliver a massive amount of damage, at the cost of efficiency and slower refire. The hardware was inspired by other Cannon-style weapons, but the main difference in the Venom's operation is the use of the exceedingly-rare Vanadium to allow a massive transfer of energy, without compromising the stability of the weapon's construction. After nearly a decade of lab, and eventually field-testing, the Venom has been modified and reworked numerous times throughout the development process to ensure that pilots can effectively mount and use the weaponry without the risk of a catastrophic weapons failure. However, due to the lack of efficiency, the Venom is only recommended for the most experienced MND operatives, to make use of it's potent damage potential. This weapon is agnostic to shield types, being effective to all of them equally.

722447.text:
Eco-XL "Gaia's Archangel" Gaian Destroyer Turret

No information available.

722450.text:
S-APS01 Starfliers "Lucubrate"-Class Active Probing Scanner

Powered by the Deep Space Explorer's full capacity power core, the standard "Augur"-Class Active Probing Scanner has been fine tuned by the Starfliers to make use of the reactor. The internal wiring and tubing required to make use of the core accommodates a significant section of the ship's cargo hold. The new "Lucubrate"-Class scanner has been created to ensure the best data is retrieved from any points of interest without being held back by a battery requirement. Without any spare room to house a massive data server onboard, the Deep Space Explorer relies on another Starfliers vessel to safely store any discovered information.

722452.text:
PT-XX Ingenuus "TECK-Y7P" Mass Driver

The "TECK-7YP" Mass Driver is part of the Ingenuus line of weapons manufacturing that utilize forms of newly harnessed compounds to accomplish tasks in a very old-fashioned way. Using readily available minerals, this mass driver uses capcitor discharge far beyond that of traditional weapons, with the added longevity of weaponry and low maintenance due to its localized heating. Plasma weaponry often receive heat damage on use, and in return must be repaired and replaced regularly, where as the concept of a mass driver produces significantly less heat, with most of the energy taxation moving to the power cores and capacitors. However, the concept is not without flaws, as it requires significant ammunition costs, and requires the user to rearm after extended use - or in the case of the Angurvadal, its micro-refinery and smelter allows for ammunition to be fabricated as long as the minerals required are collected - which falls within the speciality of the vessel's forward mining laser.

722454.text:
A-CLE-95 "Polybolos" Technocracy Particle Emitter Mk I

This is a particle-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722456.text:
A-CLE-95 "Polybolos" Technocracy Particle Emitter Mk II

This is a particle-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722458.text:
A-CPC-100 "Falx" Technocracy Particle Cannon Mk I

This is a particle-based weapon which, though delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722460.text:
A-CPC-100 "Falx" Technocracy Particle Cannon Mk I

This is a particle-based weapon which, though delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722462.text:
A-CLE-95 "Polybolos" Technocracy Laser Turret Mk I

This is a laser-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields.

722464.text:
A-CPC-100 "Falx" Technocracy Particle Turret Mk I

This is a particle-based weapon which, though delivers significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722466.text:
A-AXP50 "Kontos" Technocracy Antimatter Projector
The Covenant's paramilitary has faced extensive engagement with heavy assets that vary as much in origin as they do in composition. This appropriately necessitated the production of a native Antimatter Projector, for the purpose of securing the territory that Technocracy lays claim to. Knowing that bomber-craft would need a weapon that was not only powerful but also reliable, the Valravn Arsenal requisitioned a bulk-order of exotic materials to produce this series of weaponry. The Covenant was happy to provide these resources in exchange for hardware that they could trust, thus creating incentive for the "confiscation" of various alien materials.

The weapon itself acts as both a challenge and promise to the forces that would lay siege to regions of space patrolled by Technocracy vessels, and it is more than capable of supporting allied warships.

722468.text:
A-ADLX-Z99 "Cheiroballista" Technocracy Gunboat Forward Gun

A modified "Ultimus" named after a handheld tension operated projectile weapon. Taking to heart the design philosophy of its predecessor, the Cheiroballista received significant improvements to its focusing lens and power conduits in order to accommodate for a new and improved reactor system. The re-modulation and focusing of the energy bolt had condensed it so targets and disrupts the atomic makeup of any vessel - alien or otherwise. The nature of the modifications make it an extremely effective and dangerous tool in field service with the Technocratic Covenant.

722470.text:
A-ADT-20 "Scorpio" Technocracy Gunboat turret

The Scorpio is a rapid-fire turret designed to be used on Gunboats and Gunships. Its namesake originates from a deployable Ballista design known as the Scorpio, which served as an anti-personnel and field artillery piece. Lighter than other torsion engines of the time, the Scoprio was versatile enough to be deployed in many different situations, ranging from open offensive missions to perimeter defense and security duties.

722472.text:
A-CDT-40 "Springald" Technocracy Cruiser Turret

Developed on the basis of open-source technologies like the BSC-GEN model of cruiser turrets, the Springald was given a unique twist by Technocratic engineers. This model of capital ship turret incorporates many features characteristic of the Gammu machine intelligences' engineering, rendered compatible with human ships and tweaked for increased efficiency. A universal sight on Covenant cruisers, and a rare one in the hands of their allies, the Springald is a force to be reckoned with, tearing through hostile hulls with inhuman precision.

722474.text:
A-BCPC-200 "Onager" Technocracy Battlecruiser Turret

The "Onager" was designed by Technocracy to serve as the primary battery on vessels in the Battlecruiser weight class. Its namesake was a small-sized catapult used as a more mobile siege engine. Its "hit-and-run" philosophy remains ingrained within the modern adaptation, taking advantage of the sophisticated focusing lens to propel a highly condensed bolt of energy along an acceleration rail, in order to deliver the highest possible damage output the weapon can produce. Much like its ancestor, the "Onager" loses its effectiveness against smaller and agile targets, yet remains a valuable tool in conflict with craft of equal or greater classification.

722476.text:
A-HPC-400 "Mangonel" Technocracy Battleship Primary Turret

Aptly named after an ancient siege engine, The "Mangonel" was a fixed-arm weapon designed to lob heavy projectiles at long ranges against heavy targets and fortifications. The modern adaptation of the name follows a similar philosophy in terms of power and ease of construction. This turret was designed for use as a Primary Battery on Battleship and Dreadought classed vessels. The hard-hitting Manongel retains its versatility, however much like its namesake it's not very effective against mobile and small targets.

722478.text:
A-AADT-60 "Spiculum" Technocracy Battleship Secondary Turret

Following the design philosophy of the "Pilum" both in history and its modern adaptation, the "Spiculum" is a heavy defensive turret which improved upon the necessary categories intended for effective use on Battleship and Dreadnought classed ships. The Spiculum was designed to be a slower, harder hitting defensive turret for use against vessels in a smaller weight class.

722480.text:
Bretonia Battlecruiser Turret

No data has been released about this weapon.

722482.text:
Outcast Battlecruiser Turret

No data has been released about this weapon.

722484.text:
"Corona" Heavy Plasma Beam Turret

Seeking a safer alternative to the inherent risks of antimatter based weaponry, the Corona utilizes new advancements in magnetic containment to condense superheated plasma into a coherent beam. To compensate for the immense heat generated by the weapon, the Corona foregoes traditional gimbaled Sirian weapon architecture to support a cutting edge coolant system, saturating the plasma emitter bowl and magnetic coiling with a cryogenic slurry. Containment field entropy limits the Corona's effective range to medium before the beam loses cohesion.

722486.text:
Nomad Vandal Missile Launcher

Nothing is known about this weapon.

*Requires Nomad Vandal Missile

722488.text:
Nomad Vandal Missile

No information is available.

*Fired by Nomad Vandal Missile

722490.text:
Nomad Silencer Missile Launcher

Nothing is known about this weapon.

*Requires Nomad Silencer Missile

722492.text:
Nomad Silencer Missile

No information is available.

*Fired by Nomad Silencer Missile

722494.text:
Weapon Codename: STORMBREAKER

A prototype weapon system based around black market hardware that is seemingly of Rheinland origin. This Tachyon cannon features a series of modifications which allow it to bypass the energy limitations imposed for safety reasons, such as a reinforced power supply system and a more resilient frame and barrel to withstand the increased heat levels.

There is every likelihood that the "souped-up" nature of the design could result in overheating and damage if fired without proper trigger discipline, something that would suggest some amount of restraint inherent in the user, but also the fact that risks could be taken in extreme situations.

722496.text:
A-CPLC-105 "Harpe" Technocracy Plasma Cannon Mk I

This is a plasma-based weapon that delivers large amounts of damage, but cannot be refired quickly. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722498.text:
A-CPLC-105 "Harpe" Technocracy Plasma Cannon Mk II

This is a plasma-based weapon that delivers large amounts of damage, but cannot be refired quickly. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722500.text:
A-CPLC-105 "Harpe" Technocracy Plasma Turret Mk I

This is a plasma-based weapon that delivers large amounts of damage, but cannot be refired quickly. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields.

722502.text:
Nomad Gunboat Pulse Turret

Very little information is available about this weapon. It has been identified as being 'mounted' on Gunboat-size Nomad vessels.

722504.text:
"Triplette" Multi-Shot Cannon

The "Triplette" is a multi-shot dispersion cannon that fires three projectiles simultaneously. It was the result of a Council development program prior to the Second Gallic Civil War, with the aim of producing a weapon that would give fresh, unskilled recruits better hit chances, by virtue of its widened shot pattern. Though the prototypes showed promise, setting up mass production was deemed too costly and the project was scrapped at the outbreak of the conflict. The fate of the prototype blueprints is unknown, but following the chaos of the Council's offensive that ultimately ended the war, a number of functional examples have started appearing.

722506.text:
"Moonblast" Tachyon Cannon

The Moonblast is a new development by Selection International, a house-independent engineering firm formed by veteran designers from various backgrounds to capitalize on the increased demand for modern weaponry by parties not willing or able to get large scale military contracts. When the slow-firing, powerful cannon design was released to a technology expo in early 827, it quickly proved more popular than the small firm could handle, and production was widely licensed out to other companies.

722508.text:
"Moonblast" Tachyon Turret

The Moonblast is a new development by Selection International, a house-independent engineering firm formed by veteran designers from various backgrounds to capitalize on the increased demand for modern weaponry by parties not willing or able to get large scale military contracts. When the slow-firing, powerful cannon design was released to a technology expo in early 827, it quickly proved more popular than the small firm could handle, and production was widely licensed out to other companies.

722510.text:
"Carbine SC" Gallic Civilian Pulse Cannon

This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage.

722512.text:
"Grand Carbine" Gallic Civilian Pulse Cannon

This is a pulse-based weapon that does enormous amounts of shield damage, but virtually no hull damage.

722514.text:
"MELES" Particle Turret

MELES is a powerful particle turret weapon developed by Bowex for their famous Clydesdale squads in the teens of the 8th century. The design is similar to particle weapons used by the Armed Forces and the civilian weapons of the house, but overcharged massively for veteran pilots to exploit the greater power potential of their freighters. While some saw experimental deployment during the conflict with Gallia, the weapon's difficult handling with its slow firing rate, low range, and massive energy consumption led Bowex to scrap it. In the design's brief existence, its licensure to other companies caused some examples to leak out onto the open markets, although only expert freighter pilots can really appreciate its potential.

722516.text:
"ASMD" Railgun

The latest in cutting-edge offensive technology from Selection International, the ASMD (Accelerated Slug Mass Driver) represents a new breakthrough in hybrid weapons design. The railgun's ammunition takes the form of a superheated nanite cloud that coalesces rapidly into a ferromagnetic slug before being accelerated at blinding speeds, with the low mass of the projectile being more than offset by the raw force of the resultant impact. While concerns with overheating render the weapon's rate of fire slower than that of energy-based armament, the use of nanites as a payload renders the ASMD practically immune to ammunition constraints, in comparison to other ballistic and kinetic weaponry available to fighter craft.

The emergence of hybrid railgun technology onto the open market poses a unique challenge to the sector's shield manufacturers, as the superheated metal slug tends to punch through most shield harmonics with enough force to violently destabilise the energy field. Only time will tell if shield technology can evolve to meet this new threat, or if these weapons are set to join the Debilitator series of weaponry as a premier shield-busting option for pilots across the sector.

722518.text:
Weapon Codename: ENTROPY

These weapons, as unique as they are deadly, are employed by Nomads and Nomad-human hybrids to convert the mysterious energies of their vessels into potent bolts of energy. While the means by which they are employed are unknown, scientists will pay hungrily for any sample they may secure.

722520.text:
GC "Harai" Gunboat Turret

The "Harai" Gunboat Turret is named after the Shinto ritual of purification with the purpose of cleansing evil, pollution, and sin.

This gunboat turret is a capital class weapon created by the Golden Chrysanthemums and is the next evolution of the "Suncannon" weapon series. The Harai was redesigned from scratch using newly developed technology, allowing the turret to channel the higher power output of a gunboat reactor.

The Harai is a powerful multi-purpose gunboat weapon, effective against both fightercraft and capital ships.

722522.text:
RH-CT480 "Laevateinn" Red Hessian Battlecruiser Turret

The Laevateinn opts out of the usual Red Hessian engineering doctrine of damage at the cost of efficiency, and instead gives Vidar-class battlecruisers the ability to sustain their barrage for much longer. Manufactured at Wolfsburg Shipyard, the Laevateinn is an efficient turret of its class.

Originally designed by engineers defecting from the Rheinland Military, these series of turrets are readily adopted by Red Hessian capital ships.

722524.text:
RA-125 "Gastraphetes" Corsair Battlecruiser Turret

An RA-165 Battleship turret with its parameters lowered to suit the Tribunus' power reactor, it functions in a similiar, devastating fashion. Manufactured at Corsair shipyards, the Gastraphetes is one of the strongest turrets of its class.

722526.text:
LTP-121 Cruiser Impact Cannon

At some point in the lifecycle of this weapon design, it was drastically modified in a manner that deviated from its initial concept. The resulting modifications have rendered the weapon system extremely power hungry but greatly simplified the manufacturing process. As simple as any blunt force instrument in principle, this oversized plasma cannon is intended to thoroughly mangle anything it comes into contact with.

722528.text:
MD31b "Disintegrator" Bretonia Destroyer Defense Turret

A gentle refresh to a tried-and-true design, the "Disintegrator" serves as the Agincourt's primary deterrent for any enemy trying to avoid the barrage of her "Witherer" cannons. With its heavy anti-capital ordnance, the "Disintegrator" turret ensures that those who challenge the Agincourt on the battlefield tread carefully.

722530.text:
SWS-50 Cruiser Tachyon Lance

Making use of a large degree of Kusari technology, this was likely a modification of more traditional weapon systems in the Naval Forces arsenal, intended to serve as a replacement or hopeful innovation within the field of use. The fact they never replaced standard primary turret systems makes it apparent that they failed to succeed that regard, but it has not stopped organizations from upscaling the initial design so that they serve as a long range support system with added punch.

722532.text:
HGF-78 Cruiser Storm Cannon

A crossbreed of a pulse generator and particle focus array. The innovative design allows EMP based damage to be augmented with some degree of versatility, allowing the ship utilizing it to continue firing even once the targets shields have been broken. Given its efficiency and sophisticated assembly techniques, it seems odd that this cannon did not find a place among the list of successful designs, and has instead become an abandoned prototype rendered open source.

722534.text:
RNWP-12C Cruiser Shard Cannon

Developed in a Gallic weapons testing facility, or so the alleged weapon designation would suggest, the shard cannon is an atypical weapons device. The charge dispensed by the weapon actually supersedes the amount that a conventional turret design would be able to withstand without serious engineering, but this is offset by a funnelling mechanism laid deep in the barrel. The particle streams thus projected are sent outwards in a scattered pattern rather than a single beam that would cause a catastrophic weapons failure. It is speculated that the nature of the weapon indicates that it might have been an attempt to equip cruiser class vessels with the means to employ hit-and-run tactics against larger warships, but either for reasons of doctrinal contradiction or naval politics, never saw popular service.

722536.text:
C-22b "Orthrus" Cruiser Turret

A downscaled version of Cerberus turrets often used by Rheinland capital ships, the Orthus Cruiser Turret fires two high-powered projectiles capable of quickly taking down enemy capital ships.

722538.text:
Muninn Scanner Array

The Muninn Scanner Array is a dedicated chin-mounted module for the Grendel transport. Rumour has it that the Unioners developed the system in their attempts to increase environmental information feedback when operating in asteroid or debris fields.

722540.text:
"Cathal" Molly Cruiser Turret

The "Cathal" Cruiser Turret has been designed by a crack team looking to equip their cruisers with home-fashioned weaponry. With almost complete disregard to user safety, which no legal body could enforce anyway, the gun packs a whopping punch and is easy to maintain in compensation. Some captains have even claimed it's safer to use than the Rogue counterparts.

722542.text:
Weapon Codename: FROSTBITE

Originally the product of an eclectic celebrity weapons designer, the Frostbite is thoroughly an artisan and engineer's flex. The first set was hand-tailored as a one-off, four-of-a-kind package for an infamous Bounty Hunter, crafted to deliver peak performance at utmost efficiency. The gun's stabilised tachyon emitter tears through shields and hull alike with rapid fire, high speed, and at incredible range. Given the payload this weapon delivers at blistering rates of fire and with enough cohesion to be carried downrange, a complex cryogenic vent system had to be built into the mounting itself to prevent fatal overheating. It was this eccentric but necessary feature which lent the project its name.

Over time, copies have leaked onto the market, though the original gunsmith insists to have never made so much as a fifth. Some claim these reverse-engineered versions to be inferior to the legendary originals, but that doesn't stop high rollers from paying top dollar for their own sets.

722544.text:
Liberty Rogue "Abaddon" Particle Cannon

A lunatic's cockamamie science project, this weapon system only gives the slightest nod towards anything that resembles sense. Designed with the singular vision of shooting a large projectile at extreme speed and with no compromises made when it comes to damage potential, but this says nothing about the techniques employed to make the device function this way. A large block of metal with wires criss-crossed between the coils, strung together like an elaborate game rather than any actual engineering. Techniques seem to be borrowed from various criminal groups, such as how the Mollys fashion their barrels and employ discharge chambers. But there are equally dubious and perhaps "innovative" touches added throughout. The fact the mounts do not spontaneously detonate upon firing is itself an achievement, and when shots do land it ceases to be funny for whomever saw this haphazard mess for a weapon.

722546.text:
12-1b "Carver" Bretonian Bomber Particle Cannon

A scaled up development of the Sunrail weapon system, the Carver is designed as a supplementary weapon to Bretonia's lumbering bomber wings, effectively allowing them to punch above their weight class and make use of their expansive power capacities. They also serve as an adequate deterrent to enemy fighters, providing bomber pilots with much needed defensive capability after extensive complaints regarding the "toothless" performance otherwise.

722548.text:
"Vanquisher" Gallic Bomber Plasma Cannon

In an effort to keep pace with Bretonia's weapons development, Gallia studied the doctrines of the other Houses and found their methodology behind bomber arsenals to be lacking. Theories were soon elevated to funded projects and finally live tests, resulting in the Vanquisher, an imposing but woefully inefficient cannon. Contrary to most weapons fielded by Gallia, these cannons produce an extremely visible amount of heat as a consequence of their internal workings, and are easily identified by their "smoky" and volatile plasma trails.

722550.text:
"Sunderer" Bomber Particle Cannon

Witnessing the success of the Deluge gatling laser cannon and encouraged by the popularity of their Moonblast and Helios guns, Selection International quickly set out to start work on their newest project: a next generation bomber energy cannon. The Sunderer trades raw damage output for a higher rate of fire and greater effective range. Settling in a middle ground between the existing Render energy cannon's effectiveness against gunboats and transports and the Deluge gatling laser's anti-fighter capability, the Sunderer is set to be a further success for SI.

722552.text:
"Firestorm" Rheinland Bomber Plasma Cannon

Rheinland has a history of setting the benchmark for heavy weaponry, and the bomber plasma cannon used by their peacekeeping forces is no exception. Designed with the singular intent of being able to hammer against larger craft and based around a solid and reliable frame, it evens the odds in one of the most upheaved Houses in the Sector.

722554.text:
"TREMOR" Neutron Blaster

With every up-and-coming startup like Selection International, certain designs are an immediate hit. The "Moonblast" tachyon cannon catapulted the firm to the fore of weapon manufacturers and designers, and now nearly every pilot in Sirius is at least familiar with the name, if not the weapon itself. However, behind every success is a long, long string of failures. Codenamed "TREMOR", this neutron blaster was designed to offset the typical disadvantages of the weapon type. Featuring an undersized particle collating coil, combined with redundant and overcharged particle generators and accelerators, the weapon launches a loosely-contained "blob" of neutrons at a high velocity and rate of fire. Interest in the design dwindled after multiple fatal incidents resulted in the loss of numerous test craft, one of which has yet to be recovered.

722556.text:
"Thunderbolt" Liberty Bomber Tachyon Cannon

An odd blend of frontier improvisation and Liberty engineering, the Thunderbolt is an attempt to miniaturize the tachyon lance weaponry system for use on heavy snubcraft. While this ambitious pursuit was initially found untenable, it was quickly realized that these weapons would serve well as part of a Bomber's arsenal. The Thunderbolt accordingly earned itself widespread adoption by a variety of factions in the region, used by all manner of peacekeepers, terrorists and common pirates.

722558.text:
"Redeemer" Kusari Bomber Photon Cannon

Having found great success in supplying fighters of all roles and sizes with their popular Cleanser line of photon blasters, Kishiro's arms designers set out to upscale the weapon systems for bombers. The resulting Redeemer photon cannon packs a significantly larger punch than its fighter-class cousins, capable of rending the heavy armor of even the largest warships. However, this increase in destructive power comes at the cost of muzzle velocity and power draw - the latter offset by the typically far greater power cores built into bombers.

722560.text:
"SURIEL" Laser Cannon

SURIEL is a laser cannon developed by a Liberty Rogue engineer named Ivy Sorrell. The Rogues have always been known for weapons that sacrifice efficiency for greater power, but Sorrell's design was extreme even by their standards: The power calibration is so excessively imbalanced that the laser's lens alignment warps during firing, resulting in inaccurate fire. SURIEL requires constant maintenance and even when cared for properly, the weapon's lifespan is short even by Rogue standards. Finding no love for her design among her fellow pirates, Sorrell left Buffalo for the Barrier with her prototypes in early 828. She was never heard from again.

722562.text:
YBT-66v "Sunstorm" Kusari Battleship Turret

A newly designed turret destined to give Tokugawas the supremacy against enemy battleships during close range engagements. True to its name, the Sunstorm delivers impressive photon-based projectiles at a relatively high refire rate, allowing the battleships to chase smaller targets with it.

722564.text:
C-48 "Cerberus" Rheinland Battleship Turret

Cerberus-type turrets figure as one of the most massive weapons available in the arsenal of the Rheinland Military. The Cerberus provides a continuous stream of considerable damage within its limited range, making it more efficient at engaging close-ranged targets.

722566.text:
VAL-3STU "Baliste" Gallic Battleship Turret

Originally designed as a long-range battleship artillery, the antimatter projectile of the Baliste proved to be too unstable for great distances. Nevertheless, the Baliste found a new use as a short-range weapon. Offering unmatched destructive power, the Baliste is responsible for the annihilation of countless Sirian warships during the many conflicts in which Gallia was confronted.

722568.text:
MB17x "Carronade" Bretonia Battleship Turret

The Carronade shares many similarities with the Battle Razor, firing heavy charges of antimatter and tachyon energy bolts at great speed. Despite sacrificing the original destructive power of the Razor for higher refire rate and reduced energy consumption, the Carronade remains a formidable weapon used by Bretonian battleships to engage successfully the heaviest warships in Sirius.

722570.text:
LDH-57k "Warhawk" Liberty Battleship Turret

Designed and built in secret by the engineers of Juneau Shipyard, the Warhawk equips a large part of the Navy's battleships and carriers. Capable of firing high-powered plasma projectiles at a superior velocity, the Warhawk represents an infamous threat for large warships, should they dare to come within its limited range.

722572.text:
Battlecruiser "Battle Razor" Tachyon-Antimatter Cannon

The Battle Razor fires charges of antimatter encased by a powerful tachyon field for acceleration and stability. Antimatter deals unmatchable amounts of damage to the hull of the target ship if its shields are down. Battlecruiser Razor is equivalent to the Battleship Razor, although, it has a smaller turret basis which severely limits its frequency of fire and its overall versability on the battlefield.

722574.text:
DRDD-M9 Battlecruiser Voidstorm Turret

While technically two devices coupled into one unit, the Voidstorm appears to be an attempt to deliver an otherwise unstable plasma charge over distance by using an energized containment shell. The design originally began life as an alternative to cruise disruptors and specifically for police use. Early development was promising, but tests always revealed targets as being more charred than intended. Faced with the dilemma of corpses being far less valuable than live prisoners who could be put to work, the project was cancelled - but evidently the specifications have been leaked onto the open market. And these modern day Voidstorm units are favored for their ability to "fry" the complex electrical systems of anything it might touch. Often used in the opening salvos of combat to prime a target for violent decompression by a complementary weapon.

722576.text:
KDS Mk II Battlecruiser Arcfire Turret

Produced by Kishiro for use by the Kusari Naval Forces, the Arcfire was commended for its ability to allow warships of an intermediate tonnage to "screen" themselves against a variety of targets. Dispensing a rapid series of neutron blasts with precision and reliability. A key drawback was its obscene power consumption - a fact Samura was quick to criticize repeatedly. Persistence won out over experimentation and change, with the weapon never being adopted by the Naval Forces. It has seen a return to form over time as the threat posed by gunships and bombers surged. Revealing an undeniable truth that Kishiro was not only right but capable of predicting a trend. Though Samura has been uncharacteristically silent regarding the weapon system's Sector-wide popularity.

722578.text:
M900-GB "Ravager" Mine Dropper

The Ravager's name alone sparks endless debates in bars across the Sector. Not regarding the efficiency of it as a weapon or anything of the sort. But merely over whether the weapon can even be classified as a mine to begin with. One half of the spectrum vehemently insists the name is a misnomer, while the other says that its method of operation and deployment by a dropper system warrants the classification. Whatever the case may be, the Ravager mine, or plasma charge, is a frighteningly fast deployable ordnance. Its tracking ability operates according to the energy wavelengths created by ship propulsion, rendering it somewhat temperamental and short ranged in the realm of target acquisition. Any direct detonation is followed by an explosive shockwave, and arcing plasma currents which lash out across target's hull. A well placed Ravager hit has been known to silence overly aggressive opponents, if not cripple them outright.

722580.text:
M720-GB "Riposte" Utility Mine Dropper

A highly unconventional design intended to replace mine droppers, the Riposte releases a large burst of energetic plasma loosely bound together by an electromagnetic field. The plasma burst is capable of absorbing dozens of shots worth of energy from most conventional weaponry, but after a certain point the EM field providing its structural integrity will dissipate, resulting in a large explosion. Alternately lauded and lambasted by groups ranging from engineering unions to military veterans' advocacy groups as either "patently unsafe and absurd" or "a revolution in defensive warfare", this controversial utility weapon is set to see widespread deployment across Sirius.

The plasma field generator is very large, and can only be safely mounted on gunboat- and frigate-type ships.

722581.text:
M720-GB "Riposte" Mine
A highly unconventional design intended to replace mine droppers, the Riposte releases a large burst of energetic plasma loosely bound together by an electromagnetic field. The plasma burst is capable of absorbing dozens of shots worth of energy from most conventional weaponry, but after a certain point the EM field providing its structural integrity will dissipate, resulting in a large explosion. Alternately lauded and lambasted by groups ranging from engineering unions to military veterans' advocacy groups as either "patently unsafe and absurd" or "a revolution in defensive warfare", this controversial utility weapon is set to see widespread deployment across Sirius.

*Fired by Riposte Mine Dropper

722583.text:
Gunboat Storm Cannon

The cruiser Storm cannon represented itself as a versatile weapon system, so much so that the ambitious, or perhaps stupid, have scaled the weapon down. This new bastardized spin on the original Storm cannon design, lacks many of the safety features of the original, but is thankfully no less effective at this scale. Unlike a typical pulse cannon, this weapon is capable of inflicting appreciable damage to a ship's hull as a result of the extreme heat it inflicts on impact. However, the Storm cannon is often eschewed in favor of more reliable weapon systems by more traditional gunship commanders.

722585.text:
Streamer Gunboat Forward Gun

A tachyon emitter of thoroughly unremarkable design quality and potency. Designed by Canaria's Colony Defense Force for use against the Bretonian occupation during the worst point in the conflict. Believing, perhaps to a fault, that versatility would be key in undermining a Great House's overextension. The design was ironically rushed to completion only to then be met with Bretonia's withdrawal from the system due to severe economic concerns. Consequently, this weapon received a lukewarm reception from gunship commanders. And while the Streamer does see frequent use, this is typically only to serve as a basis for radical modifications according to individual preference.

722587.text:
H-06-5SH4 "Sakazuki" Hogosha Gunboat Turret

Hogosha owes this weapon system to its longstanding ties to Samura. Although the Sakazuki is technologically based on a similar weapon system widely used by the Kusari authorities, Samura weapons engineers have taken into account Hogosha's economic concerns and simplified the design to keep operating costs and maintenance as simple and low as possible -- at the cost of little loss in overall firepower.
It is largely due to those efficient methods of reducing operating costs that, as soon as the system was put on the market, the top brass of the Kusari military turned its attention to it. Though purchases were quickly organized in a manner resembling any other such order -- with corporate lobby teams working around the clock -- the military's attempt to cut costs has had an unexpected twist as the government struggles to keep its corporate allies in check.

722589.text:
Nomad Gunboat Mine

Nothing is known about this weapon.

722591.text:
Weapon Codename: DOOM

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

There is no information available on this weapon other than its project name.

722593.text:
Weapon Codename: QUAKE

INFORMATION CLASSIFIED

There is no information available on this weapon other than its project name.

722595.text:
Bretonia 20A "Longbow" Missile Launcher

The 20A "Longbow" first appeared in the closing days of the Gallic War. Originally conceived and designed by Donksoft, a shady and little-known firm operating somewhere out of the Barrier, the Longbow was quickly picked up by desperate militia groups looking for something that they could kludge together for nearly free out of the abundant spare parts littering the lanes. As it turned out, war-era Bretonia was the perfect market for the weapon, which is perfectly suited for tearing holes through slow-moving monarchist warships -- be they Gallic or Bretonian. Since then, the missile's well-earned street cred has seen it picked up by more legitimate manufacturers and employed by pilots as diverse as terrorists, private militias, and Armed Forces squadrons.

*Requires Longbow Missile

722597.text:
Bretonia 20A "Longbow" Missile

The 20A "Longbow" first appeared in the closing days of the Gallic War. Originally conceived and designed by Donksoft, a shady and little-known firm operating somewhere out of the Barrier, the Longbow was quickly picked up by desperate militia groups looking for something that they could kludge together for nearly free out of the abundant spare parts littering the lanes. As it turned out, war-era Bretonia was the perfect market for the weapon, which is perfectly suited for tearing holes through slow-moving monarchist warships -- be they Gallic or Bretonian. Since then, the missile's well-earned street cred has seen it picked up by more legitimate manufacturers and employed by pilots as diverse as terrorists, private militias, and Armed Forces squadrons.

722599.text:
Gallia Ev.R "Flechette" Missile Launcher

Considered by many to be one of the greatest innovations in Gallic military technology since the end of the beleaguered house's isolation, the "Flechette" launcher is an innovation on the same technology powering the infamous Trebuchet cannon. Early designers found that they simply could not siphon enough power from even the most overclocked snubcraft engines to power the graviton bursts without an unacceptably high risk of disrupting essential internal systems, but an up-and-coming firm contracted to provide materials science assistance found a workaround in expensive, ultracompact batteries, which store so much power that they fizzle out after each use. The resulting projectile packs such a hefty punch that not even the extreme cost of operation has stopped native pirate groups from acquiring and fielding their own versions.

*Requires Flechette Missile

722601.text:
Gallia Ev.R "Flechette" Missile

Considered by many to be one of the greatest innovations in Gallic military technology since the end of the beleaguered house's isolation, the "Flechette" launcher is an innovation on the same technology powering the infamous Trebuchet cannon. Early designers found that they simply could not siphon enough power from even the most overclocked snubcraft engines to power the graviton bursts without an unacceptably high risk of disrupting essential internal systems, but an up-and-coming firm contracted to provide materials science assistance found a workaround in expensive, ultracompact batteries, which store so much power that they fizzle out after each use. The resulting projectile packs such a hefty punch that not even the extreme cost of operation has stopped native pirate groups from acquiring and fielding their own versions.

722603.text:
Kusari SH-Y "Shuriken" Missile Launcher

Graceful, elegant, and precise are the traditional hallmarks of all things Kusari. Yet, while a Samura product, the SH-Y "Shuriken" is anything but. A design born out of economic desperation during the days of the Kishiro-dominated Republic, production was postponed until after the reformation of the Empire. Still, it fills its niche well as an affordable and user-friendly weapon; firing a cluster of sharp, almost dangerously overcharged electrodes fitted with a basic guidance system, each individual missile looks more like a clump of tangled razorwire than a warhead. Pilots targeted by the Shuriken would do well to take the image to heart, taking to the evasive before it shreds through their shields like a butcher's knife through flesh.

*Requires Shuriken Missile

722605.text:
Kusari SH-Y "Shuriken" Missile

Graceful, elegant, and precise are the traditional hallmarks of all things Kusari. Yet, while a Samura product, the SH-Y "Shuriken" is anything but. A design born out of economic desperation during the days of the Kishiro-dominated Republic, production was postponed until after the reformation of the Empire. Still, it fills its niche well as an affordable and user-friendly weapon; firing a cluster of sharp, almost dangerously overcharged electrodes fitted with a basic guidance system, each individual missile looks more like a clump of tangled razorwire than a warhead. Pilots targeted by the Shuriken would do well to take the image to heart, taking to the evasive before it shreds through their shields like a butcher's knife through flesh.

722607.text:
Liberty JR-2 "Peacekeeper" Missile Launcher

Representing a bold foray from the realm of personnel armaments into ship-based equipment, the JR-2 "Peacekeeper" snubcraft missile is one of the newest innovations out of Detroit Munitions. The JR-2 fires small "canister"-like projectiles - each containing a single cheap tracking device, an equally cheap gyroscopically-oriented thruster, and a whole lot of flaming plasma. While the projectiles can't always be counted on to actually hit their targets without skillful aim on the part of the pilot, when they do the results speak for themselves. The simplicity and effectiveness of the Peacekeeper's design has seen it quickly reverse-engineered and employed by groups all across central Sirius.

*Requires Peacekeeper Missile

722609.text:
Liberty JR-2 "Peacekeeper" Missile

Representing a bold foray from the realm of personnel armaments into ship-based equipment, the JR-2 "Peacekeeper" snubcraft missile is one of the newest innovations out of Detroit Munitions. The JR-2 fires small "canister"-like projectiles - each containing a single cheap tracking device, an equally cheap gyroscopically-oriented thruster, and a whole lot of flaming plasma. While the projectiles can't always be counted on to actually hit their targets without skillful aim on the part of the pilot, when they do the results speak for themselves. The simplicity and effectiveness of the Peacekeeper's design has seen it quickly reverse-engineered and employed by groups all across central Sirius.

722611.text:
Rheinland GR66 "Feldgeist" Missile Launcher

The Feldgeist has its origins in a proposed upgrade to the Rheinwehr's antimatter cannons. While technically sound, trial runs in both holosims and live-fire exercises showed that its plasma-based projectiles underperformed against heavily-armored targets to such a degree that not even homing features could compensate for the loss of sheer destructive force. The outbreak of the Imperialist-launched civil war prevented any kind of further testing, until the blueprints and licensing were sold off for pittances by the reunited but now nigh-bankrupt Wehr to whatever manufacturers wanted to buy them. This gave the GR66 dozens of "second chances"; eventually, Kruger and ALG both simultaneously realized its true utility for escort craft and heavy interceptors. The conflicting political leanings of the corporations, who supported opposite sides of the civil war, means that it ended up deployed by both the very same Military that designed it as well as a number of outspoken "activists".

*Requires Feldgeist Missile

722613.text:
Rheinland GR66 "Feldgeist" Missile

The Feldgeist has its origins in a proposed upgrade to the Rheinwehr's antimatter cannons. While technically sound, trial runs in both holosims and live-fire exercises showed that its plasma-based projectiles underperformed against heavily-armored targets to such a degree that not even homing features could compensate for the loss of sheer destructive force. The outbreak of the Imperialist-launched civil war prevented any kind of further testing, until the blueprints and licensing were sold off for pittances by the reunited but now nigh-bankrupt Wehr to whatever manufacturers wanted to buy them. This gave the GR66 dozens of "second chances"; eventually, Kruger and ALG both simultaneously realized its true utility for escort craft and heavy interceptors. The conflicting political leanings of the corporations, who supported opposite sides of the civil war, means that it ended up deployed by both the very same Military that designed it as well as a number of outspoken "activists".

722615.text:
AUM-8 Battleship Plasma Mortar

While the tried and true TL-45 "Heavy Mortar" has served Sirian warfleets well for decades, the use of highly volatile antimatter and expensive graviton generation devices are so prohibitive that the TL-45 is cost-ineffective outside of use as a fleet battle "checkmate" play. Numerous groups within Sirius have long scrambled for a solution, but it was the Unioners who first devised a working model that can be effectively mass-produced for sale to their allies across Sirius.Making use of much more stable plasma ejection devices and utilizing laser targeting systems, the AUM-8 "Plasma Mortar" has unsurprisingly proliferated throughout the Sirian underworld with great haste, and lawful organizations have been quick to reverse-engineer their own editions based on the few captured samples they have recovered from skirmishes with pirate fleets.

722617.text:
HEQ-C7MZ "Corruptor" Battleship Turret

Decryption of the guidance software inside this turret identifies it with a long and unwieldy string not matching known organizations' project designation templates. Fortunately, another name is inscribed on the outer casing of samples that have appeared throughout Sirius.The "Corruptor", as it is known, utilizes relatively standard photon- and tachyon-ejection technology, albeit in an unwieldy and hastily-crafted configuration in an apparent attempt to maximize effective refire rate. One prominent rumor has it that it was a last-ditch project by the Insurgency to attempt to turn the tide of their doomed crusade, while others insist it was a Kusari black project leaked by Gallic spies. Regardless of the wild speculation, the model punches through shields and heavy armor with equivalent ease.

722619.text:
Bessemer S6-R "Zulfikar" Battleship Turret

Fed up with the dominance of the established hypercorps in ship and weapon manufacturing, Bessemer Logistics sought a way to intrude into the traditional markets of Ageira, BMM, and CTE. The result of their mad dash for recognition was the Zulfikar -- a fast, heavy-hitting turret that shreds through pirate and naval gunboats alike. Allegedly designed in imitation of Lane Hacker technology, this rare and expensive model of weapon has made its way into the armories of groups who have no access to more standard armaments.Within a year of the Zulfikar's emergence onto the market, Bessemer had become defunct, with their intellectual property being snatched up for a pittance by BMM. Though the once-scrappy manufacturing company is now forgotten, their legacy lives on in the ferocious flurry of tachyons the few surviving models of their product still unleash upon their foes.

722621.text:
LBW-110 "Moonfire" Battlecruiser Turret

The LBW-110 “Moonfire” type turret is the end result of an extensive experimental weapons design program undertaken by clandestine development facilities within the house of Liberty. Whilst the turret itself is heavy and lacks great traversal speed, it makes up for this shortcoming with a significant rate of fire and unexpectedly high projectile speed. These projectiles, once fired and exposed to the vacuum of space, have a distinct ultraviolet glow that dissipates as the projectile travels. Upon impact, these laser-based emissions deal substantial damage to both shield and hull, with the latter being affected more significantly.

722623.text:
CO-W3A "Novaspear" Battlecruiser Turret

Internally referred to as “CO-W3A”, the “Novaspear” battlecruiser-class turret is not commonly seen in operation. It is the result of a series of advancements in Plasma-based weaponry, focusing on maximizing the sheer potential power of the projectile over the logistics of the turret operation itself. Whilst the tracking of this turret is suboptimal, and therefore less suited to engaging smaller vessels, it is optimal for delivering a large photon of plasma to larger capital-sized ships. The plasma projected from the weapon has a large amber glow, accompanied by an aura around the charge and a trail of light that follows in the projectile’s wake.

722625.text:
EMP-9P Modified Cruiser Heavy Pulse Turret

The EMP-9P is a further development of the EMP-3s series of cruiser pulse turrets, essentially overcharging the internal components which allows for a greater pulse charge to be launched. This larger charge features significantly more shield damage than its predecessor, whilst still maintaining its excellent range. This increase in size however has greatly reduced the rate of fire the turret can maintain, whilst also making it less energy efficient.

722627.text:
EMP-3s Modified Cruiser Autopulse Turret

he model marked as “EMP-3s” appears to be a modified version of the common pulse turrets found in most shipyards across Sirius, although these extensive modifications have made the turret significantly different from the model it was originally based on. The pulse charge it launches has been reconfigured to prioritise its effectiveness against ship shield defences over physical damage to the hull. This new charge is larger in size and thus has a slower projectile speed, but makes up for this shortcoming with its extended range, allowing engagements at a greater range.

722629.text:
TLS-39 Series Cruiser Hybrid Mortar

The TLS-39 Series Cruiser Hybrid Mortar is the next evolution in the TLS series of heavy capital weaponry designed for use against large capital ships, stations and weapon platforms. As it’s Xeno-affiliated designers considered energy usage less of a priority, they were able to push the limits of the energy consumed by this weapon to an extreme amount, allowing the projectile launched to travel at an incredible speed and for a considerable distance. The energy retained by it, along with the speed it impacts at, ensures that both shields and hull alike take significant damage from any successful hits. Conversely, due to these factors sustained firing of this weapon is almost impossible.

722631.text:
STALACTITE Gunboat Turret

Whilst little is known about the manufacturers behind this peculiar weapon, it is rumored that it is the result of a clandestine rapid-fire weapon project undertaken by a team based at an undisclosed location within the Alaska system. This turret fires shards that almost have an ice-like appearance, at a rapid rate of fire, which travel at a distance comparable to most fighter weapons available on the market. The energy usage of these weapons is also remarkably efficient for a turret of its size.

722633.text:
VOIDBLAST Gunboat Turret

The only official record of this specific weapon design relates to its initial discovery within the remains of a derelict Wild station that had been destroyed by military forces within Rheinland House space. Originally thought incompatible with power cores commonly found within Sirius, it appears to have been reverse engineered and can now fit upon, and be powered by, a regular Gunboat turret mount. The turret produces a large purple charge that ejects photons in its wake as it travels, before the orb itself decays and phases out.

722635.text:
MD27x "Blunderbuss" Cruiser Defense Mortar

A crudely refined form of what appears to have been a discarded Gallic War prototype, the "Blunderbuss" is an attempt to push as much power through a cruiser-sized cryogenic antimatter projector as possible, with predictable results. While significantly more powerful than its "Light Mortar" cousin, the resulting sluggish projectile and unwieldy, oversized turret housing limit it to predominantly defensive uses.

722637.text:
Battleship SR-HE Unguided Rocket Battery

Whilst less common than its traditional energy based counterparts, rocket batteries have become an increasingly sought after weapon type due to their significant increase in firepower and range. The SR-HE Unguided Rocket Battery specifically relies upon a rotating missile bay which allows the turret to fire its rocket and quickly rotate to allow loading of the next warhead, without a large delay. This makes the fire rate of these rocket launchers comparable to most commonly found Battleship turrets, although the energy used to operate this weapon system is significantly higher. Caution is advised when using this weapon due to its unguided nature and the debris created by the turret after the launch of each rocket.

722639.text:
Battlecruiser Melter Turret

As implied by its name, the “Melter” turret relies upon its heat transfer properties to deal damage to vessels, especially to a ship’s hull and armor plating. The projectile consists of a heated shot that is then released as a jet that can move through space quickly, although this speed causes the projectile to cool and fizzle out, which limits its potential range. Because of these factors, the turret is often preferred in short to medium range engagements, where range is an acceptable tradeoff for the increased firepower and projectile speed. The turret’s fast rotation speed also makes it a weapon of choice against smaller vessels that will be within close proximity.

722641.text:
Battlecruiser EM-7C Pulse Repeater

Whilst essentially a larger, upgraded version of the ‘EMP-3s’ model of cruiser autopulse turret, the ‘EMP-7C’ is a much larger turret designed for use with Battlecruiser sized vessels. It delivers a similar type of highly charged pulse shot to its predecessor, but with considerably more energy discharged upon impact with shields. This upgraded pulse shot also is able to cover a considerable range before discharging, and further optimizations in the ‘EMP’ series of turret have ensured the power usage remains moderate, allowing for a sustained rate of fire during prolonged engagements.

722643.text:
WR-8D Wraith Cannon

The WR-8D appears to be the result of salvagers modifying a recovered turret into a custom particle-based weapon. They are designed to manipulate particle energy within a central chamber which is then ejected at high speeds, to be used as a makeshift type of weapon. The nickname “Wraith" was given to it by operators due to its ghost-like appearance as it travels through space. It is able to produce impressive results in damage tests against both shield and hull. Its energy based nature unfortunately means the range is suboptimal and the firing process requires more energy than other more conventional types of weapons.

722645.text:
Cruiser Battle Razor

Whilst the origins of the first “Battle Razor” class of turret are still widely contested and uncertain, this cruiser turret is a powerful piece of weapon technology that many on the black market are keen to obtain. Despite its turret housing looking similar to most commercially available turrets, the underlying technology is heavily custom made, hence its desirability among pilots. The turret is capable of producing a large shot at high velocity, which is highly effective against both shield generators and hull plating. This great damage output comes at a cost, however. As it lacks decent range and requires a large amount of energy to fire, resulting in a slow rate of fire.

722647.text:
Weapon Codename: GEKOKUJOU

The weapon known as “GEKOKUJOU” was claimed to be a custom weapon developed internally by Blood Dragon tech cell located somewhere deep within the Tohoku system. Its first appearance was officially documented by Kusari Naval Forces engaging Dragon vessels noting a new pink/ultraviolet coloured laser, with a high rate of fire, that was capable of incredible damage against their patrol vessels. Because of its association with high ranking Blood Dragons, It is considered a highly sought after weapon, both by officials and freelancers alike, due to its reputation and scarcity.

722649.text:
Weapon Codename: ENVY

Actual documentation related to this weapon have never been confirmed, however one mention of this weapon was rumored to appear within a Rheinland Military “Prototype Test Log” that was found within the wreckage of a military ship that was abandoned for unknown reasons somewhere within Omega-11. Although the mention only notes the name ‘ENVY’, no more information was present about its origin or functionality. The weapon features a large bore, allowing the projectile launched to be larger than typically found on a weapon of this size. This enhanced size allows for more damage upon impact, especially against hull plating, whilst its effect on shield generators is less pronounced.

722651.text:
Weapon Codename: LARIAT

The “LARIAT” weapon, according to legend, is a product of the Lane Hacker organization. During their operations in Magellan, there was a focused effort on intercepting high value transports headed to Liberty space, some of these ferrying weapons for internal Liberty weapon projects that were unknown to the general population. After one specific transport convoy was reported as not checking in after their passage through the system, it was suspected this convoy was carrying the prototype that would later become the ‘LARIAT’ weapon. It remains unclear if this was the weapon stolen, or if this is a reversed engineered, evolved product of the original design. The projectile’s large blue light, combined with its shining inner core and rotating outer shell, is an unmistakable trademark of the weapon.

722653.text:
Weapon Codename: MOONLIGHT

The name of this weapon is based on a lunar archaeological project that took place sometime in 825 AS on Olathe, in the Kansas system. The weapon itself was found by Zoners exploring the abandoned dig site, although they were unsure why the project was abandoned. They had suspected “Project MOONLIGHT”, as the archaeological project was known, was a cover name for the development of the weapon, hence it has since been referred to as simply “MOONLIGHT.” The weapon itself features a high rate of fire, with a crystalized trail that follows behind each shot, that tends to inflict greater damage to hull plating than shield generators.

722655.text:
M-4D “Rage” Antimatter Torpedo Launcher

A premier black market torpedo launcher, the M-4D model torpedo launcher is often sought by unlawful organizations that engage in combat with the larger Naval vessels of the houses. It was thought to have been developed by pirate groups operating in Rheinland, seeking to enhance more commonly found torpedoes into an even more effective anti-capital weapon. Its sheer destructive power, combined with its slightly faster propulsion, makes it a deadly combination when used by experienced pilots. The bright green glow of the torpedo’s propulsion gives it a distinctive look, and is unmistakable compared to its widely available counterparts, the Nova and Incapacitator.

722657.text:
M-4D “Rage” Antimatter Torpedo

Guided torpedo designed against large vessels.

*Fired by Rage Torpedo Launcher

722659.text:
MD31a "Witherer" Bretonia Destroyer Heavy Turret

Designed alongside the Agincourt-class to function as its main armament, the MD31a "Witherer" is an oversized, quad-barreled weapon array capable of laying down a substantial field of fire that rivals even Liberty's siege cruisers in forward-facing firepower.

722661.text:
EW-39 Gunboat Prototype Electromagnetic Railgun

"The EW-39 is a reproduction of a pre-production electromagnetic linear accelerator designed as a forward artillery platform for gunboats. Unlike conventional directed energy systems, the EW-39 rapidly accelerates a dense 5kg armor piercing Iridium-Uranium composite slug on a ferromagnetic armature along two parallel rails using electromagnetic propulsion. Though sometimes prone to over penetration on small unshielded targets, assessors have described resultant damages to be ‘satisfactory.’

Developed by MagTech Armory for the Liberty Department of Naval Ordnance “Next Generation Mass Drivers” initiative as a platform for bypassing conventional shielding, the designs were shelved and then subsequently leaked after advances in shield technology rendered the advantages of kinetics obsolete.

722663.text:
EW-101P Cruiser Prototype Electromagnetic Railgun

The EW-101P is a reverse-engineered copy of an electromagnetic linear accelerator cannon for cruiser heavy artillery platforms. The EW-101P rapidly accelerates a dense 20kg armor piercing Iridium-Uranium composite slug on a ferromagnetic armature along two parallel rails using electromagnetic propulsion. Compared to the other models of the EW line, the 101P sacrifices rate of fire in order to maintain optimal impact velocity despite constraints due to cruiser power limitations and the massive projectile. Hits on target have been described by assessors as ‘devastating.’

Developed by MagTech Armory for the Liberty Department of Naval Ordnance “Next Generation Mass Drivers” initiative as a platform for bypassing conventional shielding, the designs were shelved and then subsequently leaked after advances in shield technology rendered the advantages of kinetics obsolete.

722665.text:
EW-109 Series B Battlecruiser Prototype Electromagnetic Dual Railgun

The EW-109 is a battlecruiser class kinetic main battery based on electromagnetic linear acceleration. EW-109 rapidly accelerates a superdense proprietary alloy slug the mass of a small freighter on a ferromagnetic armature. In order to address the long reload time necessitated by factors such as the large projectile, required acceleration profiles, and coil heat dissipation, the designers added a second barrel to double the throughput. Although billed as a purely ‘kinetic’ platform, the super-dense slug is prone to undergo limited supercriticality events on impact with unshielded targets.

Developed by MagTech Armory for the Liberty Department of Naval Ordnance “Next Generation Mass Drivers” initiative as a platform for bypassing conventional shielding, the designs were shelved and then subsequently leaked after advances in shield technology rendered the advantages of kinetics obsolete.

722667.text:
EW-407 First Generation Battleship Prototype Railgun

"The EW-407 is a battleship class magnetic accelerator kinetic main battery. Approaching the scale of some industrial orbital mass drivers, the EW-407 consumes a staggering amount of power to accelerate superdense alloy slugs of over three metric tons in mass. As the largest and most powerful shipbourne railgun to date, on-target shots to the critical components of enemy ships have been known to cripple vessels within a single hit, if not disable ships outright. Although development had halted before testing with orbital bombardments, the large and superdense slug of the EW-407 can theoretically survive re-entry at terminal velocity, potentially rendering its usage within the orbital limits of a populated planet as a class IV war crime.

Developed by MagTech Armory for the Liberty Department of Naval Ordnance “Next Generation Mass Drivers” initiative as a platform for bypassing conventional shielding, the designs were shelved and then subsequently leaked after advances in shield technology rendered the advantages of kinetics obsolete."

722669.text:
Weapon Codename: STELLAR

Originally conceived deep in the heart of the Kusari Naval Forces' weapons lab, the prototype "STELLAR" is a one-of-a-kind weapon. Kusari Intelligence, through strongarming local Hogosha cells, were able to get their hands on the feared "Escopeta" dispersion cannons favored by the infamous Corsairs. Wanting to come up with an even more powerful iteration, STELLAR was designed to be fired in short, two-round bursts unlike its Hispanian cousin. Due to the sheer number of projectiles and burst-fire technology, the STELLAR is only suited for the largest of powercores. Ships encountering this weapon will expect to suffer cataclysmic damage at close range. The project was abandoned in 827 A.S., after a series of catastrophic failures resulting in the deaths of three Naval Forces pilots during a live test was leaked to the general populace, and the project died stillborn.

722671.text:
Weapon Codename: HOWLER

A successor to the much-vaunted bomber Antimatter Cannons, project HOWLER began development by Bretonia's finest engineers in 831 A.S. Augmenting standard antimatter technology with prototypical Vanadium injectors, the HOWLER can recover and fire much more quickly than its predecessors. Currently, the HOWLER is too unstable and too expensive to produce to roll out en masse. The weapon system has only been rolled out to specific experimental units, and has seen very-little field testing, albeit with positive results. However, rumors within the Bretonian intelligence networks suggest that a potential data breach has seen these prototypes potentially sell onto the black market. When interviewed by Colony News Service on the data breach, officials were "confident that no sensitive data had been accessed or hijacked during the attack."

722673.text:
IFRIT Gunboat Turret

The IFRIT project started as the brainchild of a Lane-Hacker thinktank and a turncoat LSF scientist around 820 A.S. Lacking the technological support or expertise to make the weapons system come to life, the Lane Hackers sold the blueprint to an anonymous buyer 7 years later. After a few years of experiments and fusion with cryogenic technology, the IFRIT made its way onto the black-market, and only a select few buyers are aware of its existence, let alone its creator. The system is a mounted heavy-weapons platform designed for gunboat-class vessels. Upon further inspection, the weapons systems are extremely intricate and it is unlikely the IFRIT would ever hit the open-market or mass production. Fired in short bursts, the weapon posts significant damage output at close range, losing effectiveness in longer engagements due to dispersion.

722675.text:
RH-x3 Cruiser Crimson Blaster

The RH-x3 "CRIMSON" is a cruiser class heavy blaster platform. Initially developed by Bundschuh engineering students in an attempt to reverse engineer stolen samples of the Rheinland Military Orthrus class defense cannon, Hessian engineers picked up the project when the former abandoned the project due to shifting priorities. In typical Hessian engineering fashion, the "CRIMSON" blaster sports none of the safety features built into the Orthrus, allowing for a short torrential stream of uncontained but lethal plasma far exceeding the output of the more controlled Orthrus turret. Due to issues during initial field tests that resulted in over a hundred casualties from various meltdown induced hull breaches and explosive decompression, the plasma waveguides require a lengthy immersion in coolant after each burst. The designs were ultimately sold on the black market, where they have seen enough popularity to leak into broad circulation.

722677.text:
Battlecruiser Hailfire Turret

The "HAILFIRE" Heavy Repeater is a battlecruiser main battery system. Initially developed by Deep Space Engineering as an intermediate sized planetoid cracking platform to be used on the AM-333 "Hegemon" Civilian Asteroid Miner, the project was shelved before ultimately being rebranded for weapons development after issues concerning operational safety and the 'excessive' and 'uncontrollable' vaporization of desirable ores rendered its use as mining equipment moot. As a weapon system, the original shortcomings that rendered the "HAILFIRE" unsuitable as mining equipment could be addressed with much better military grade power supplies and tolerances, or desirable in the case of 'excessive' and 'uncontrollable' disintegration.

722679.text:
ESB-51 Energy Shell Barrage

The ESB-51 is a battlecruiser class weapons system created to surpass the ever-present pulse cannons. This weapon fires multiple superheated Iridium casings, which contain electromagnetic pulse devices, and detonate upon impact. The weapons system is built for the sole purpose of making heavy capital ship shields obsolete in the field of battle. This model has seen very little field-testing, but initial results done by the manufacturer were positive, and battlecruisers positioned for long-range fire support will find these weapons highly effective. Due to the intense strain that the ESB-51 puts on a Battlecruiser's weapons systems, they are fired in short bursts, which take time to recharge.

722681.text:
HT-43 Battlecruiser "Concussion" Hybrid Turret

The HT-43 'Concussion' Turret was developed in 831 A.S. by Helios Technologies, a now-defunct arms manufacturer and private military contractor with origins in Bretonia. During their brief tenure, they developed multiple weapons designed specifically to outfit Battlecruisers, with goals to outfit their own civilian carriers as well as sell on the open market. This weapon in particular is a burst-fire laser cannon, tailor-made to fire a barrage of weaponry in the span of a few seconds. Designed to pierce capital hulls, the projectiles are hard to track, and nearly impossible to dodge. Helios tried to produce these weapons on-site in their home system of Tau-31, but a catastrophic failure in one of their Palladium reactors sealed the company, and most of its employees' fates. The Helios weaponry survived on a few of their PMC's capital ships, and are exceedingly rare and valuable on the black-market. The status of the ships outfitted with these weapons is unknown.

722683.text:
TL-10 Battlecruiser Mortar

With Cryogenic Antimatter mortar technology becoming omnipresent in both cruisers and battleships, a unique niche was left out in the form of Battlecruisers. The TL-4a 'Light Mortar' doesn't pack enough of a punch and the TL-25 'Heavy Mortar' is simply too much for a battlecruiser's powercore. With that in mind, the TL-10 Battlecruiser Mortar system was implemented. This modified weapons system retains all of the features and drawbacks associated with the cruiser and battleship variants, but fits the Battlecruiser's mold perfectly. Providing a reliable, long-range damage option for Battlecruisers without sacrificing potential damage or efficiency, the TL-10 weapons system is the future in battlecruiser combat.

722685.text:
RK-67 Battlecruiser Avalanche Heavy Laser Turret

The RK-67 'Avalanche' is a battlecruiser turret platform aiming to provide long-range, sustained suppression against capital class vessels. Modelling its construction from current Cryogenic Antimatter mortar weapons systems, the avalance is designed to provide a more consistent and faster firing system than the traditional mortar at the sacrifice of damage and range. The weapon is much less stressful on the overall power-systems of a battlecruiser compared to the mortar, and thus can withstand sustained fire for longer. The weapon is laser-accurate, and gunners have no need to compensate for any sort of dispersion with this system. The brains behind the RK-67 see this system as 'the next step forward in Cryogenic weaponry.'

722687.text:
RK-89 Battlecruiser Breacher Plasma Cannon

The RK-89 'Breacher' is a burst-fire battlecruiser turret system that aims to provide long-range fire support in short bursts. The projectiles discharged from the RK-89 are designed to provide stable, sustained velocity over longer ranges. This weapons system uses projectiles composed of magnesium, aluminum, and cobalt, and then superheated within its twin-titanium ignition primers before firing. Discharged in two-round bursts, the RK-89 is the modern solution to long-range hull damage for the Battlecruiser-class. Given the intense demand on the weapon system's ignition primers, gunners will need to allow for a few seconds of cooldown time to ensure the weapon performs optimally in combat.

722689.text:
RK-41 Battlecruiser Particle Repeater

The RK-41 Battlecruiser Particle Repeater system was established in 831 A.S. to provide gunnery crews with the ability to provide rapid-fire while still being a meaningful anti-capital threat in fleet engagements. This particle system is discharged in 10-round bursts at high-speeds into capital hull vessels, effectively stopping capital vessels in their tracks. This weapon is most effective at medium-to-close range, as the dispersion upon firing is more difficult to control. Originally developed by an obscure arms-manufacturer out of Kusari, the blueprints were sold after the company went under, and the weapons system has proven to be a cost-effective way to outfit battlecruiser-class vessels in a short amount of time.

722691.text:
HT-21 Battlecruiser Revenant Cannon

The HT-21 'Revenant' Cannon was developed in 829 A.S. by Helios Technologies, a now-defunct arms manufacturer and private military contractor with origins in Bretonia. During their brief tenure, they developed multiple weapons designed specifically to outfit Battlecruisers, with goals to outfit their own civilian carriers as well as sell on the open market. A dispersion cannon firing six massive projectiles at once, its goal is to obliterate any large capital ship in its sights. Although the projectiles are a bit slower-moving, the spread on them ensures that even smaller-class capital vessels are not elusive enough to avoid damage. The Revenant Cannon is a slower-firing projectile, and has a few-seconds of cool-down time to compensate for its massive power core drain. Helios tried to produce these weapons on-site in their home system of Tau-31, but a catastrophic failure in one of their Palladium reactors sealed the company, and most of its employees' fates. The Helios weaponry survived on a few of their PMC's capital ships, and are exceedingly rare and valuable on the black-market. Speculations within Sirius suggest that the Rheinland Military are in possession of this weapons system, but news outlets and intelligence agencies have failed to substantiate these claims.

722693.text:
RK-23 "Harpoon" Battlecruiser Cruise Missile Turret

The RK-23 "Harpoon" is an intermediate battlecruiser class missile system designed to fill the gap between cruiser and battleship torpedos. Designed by the Peltast Arms for the Bretonian Armed Forces to be "a Marauder but bigger," the Harpoon recycles the Marauder guidance and thrust vectoring systems but with a scaled up payload composition and shaped charge geometry.
