722702.text:
"Executor" Battleship Mass Driver Battery

The Executor Mass Driver Battery is an ancient design made to defend important stations and specific locations. This weapon was mostly used on weapon platforms because of the outdated auto-reload mechanism. A group of scientists saw an opportunity for research after recovering some of these batteries from derelect weapons platforms in the deep Taus. After dozens of tests, they managed to adapt the technology used on the platforms to outfit onto heavier battleships.The improved auto-loading chambers and internal cooling system allows this weapon to fire projectiles in rapid fashion. Inferior acceleration systems make this weapon projectile much slower than some of its competitors, however, the usage of compressed titanium on the shells themselves provides a more compact profile, increasing their range drastically compared to it's weapon-platform predecessor.

722704.text:
Cruiser "Phalanx" Heavy Autocannon

The PHALANX is a cruiser class heavy defense autocannon. Designed by Kishiro as an intermediate to bridge the gap between low accuracy high volumetric fire based point defense systems and larger and slower kinetic kill and interception platforms, the PHALANX is capable of delivering greater precision and stopping power at a respectable cyclic fire rate at the cost of enormous power consumption. Unlike SOLARIS projectiles which transfer the vast majority of its thermal payload across a shallow surface of the impact site, PHALANX bolts utilize a novel plasma containment envelope which preserves packet integrity several milimeters into the surface before delivery - allowing for devastating post penetration damage on fighters, missiles, and large asteroids alike. While the debut of the PHALANX saw moderate success with the Kusari Navy, Kishiro did not receive a lucrative exclusivity contract from the Navy as shareholders had hoped, resulting in the sale of manufacturing rights to third parties abroad.

722736.text:
Battlecruiser EM9M "Shockwave" Pulse Torpedo Launcher

The EM9M is a torpedo launch system created to surpass the ever-popular pulse cannons. Dubbed the Shockwave, this double-barreled launch platform fires two dumbfire torpedoes which contain electromagnetic pulse devices at their core. The torpedoes are armed with proximity fuses designed to pick up on the unique signatures an active shield generator radiates, and automatically detonate the volatile core once near - or in contact with - a shield bubble. The Shockwave torpedo is built for the sole purpose of making heavy capital ship shields obsolete, dealing tremendous damage.

This model has seen very little field-testing, but initial results done by various organizations were positive, and battlecruisers positioned for long-range fire support will find these weapons highly effective. Due to the need of the heavy and sizeable torpedoes needing to be physically reloaded into the tubes after a barrage has been fired, the weapon is only able to be used once before needing to enter reload cycle.

722739.text:
Cruiser Scatter Micro Missile Launcher - The "Locust" Micro-Missile Swarm (MMS)

Cruiser Scatter Micro Missile Launcher - The "Locust" Micro-Missile Swarm (MMS) system is an anti-fighter anti-matter payload kill vehicle platform for the Cruiser Primary platform. The delivery system was originally developed in 352AS by Kishiro as the "Suzumebachi" civilian cargo freight module for active interception of navigational safety hazards of Kessler Class 3 or lower, it was shelved after advances in civilian shield technologies provided a much more cost effective solution to space debris. A subsidiary of DHC obtained designs for the missile system during the failed Rheinland Campaign into Kusari in 826AS - and the patterns were repurposed for combat applications under a different, much longer name which has been since lost and replaced somewhere along the line as "The Locust". Comprising of a swarm-controlled guidance system, chemical propulsion and maneuvering jets, and a modest payload - the Locust traded sophistication for fire effect volume, with entire racks of autonomously guided ordnance fired off at a time, but with limited effect due to the constraints of conventional warheads. With the discovery of the Deep Omegas, and the discovery of several varieties of stable yet readily explosive anti-matter particles, the "Locust" can deliver much larger effective payloads at the same small form factor - albeit with exorbitant cost.

722741.text:
AC-80 "Homewrecker" Battlecruiser Autocannon

A significantly upscaled version of the AC-8 "Heartbreaker", this terrifying monstrosity of a turret spews forth a tide of white-hot titanium alloy more than capable of annihilating any small craft foolish enough to be caught in its line of fire. Unlike its little brother, many of those who utilize the AC-80 have found the unavoidable barrel deformation to be more of a feature than a design flaw. With a rate of fire this high, it's no wonder some prefer to flood the battlefield with flame instead of aiming.

722743.text:
AC-8 "Heartbreaker" Autocannon

Speculated to be either a Corsair or a Hessian design, the AC-8 has been employed by both pirate groups in their war against each other for control of the Omega cluster. This weapon utilizes a unique design, rapidly chipping tiny shards of alloyed titanium off a solid block that functions as an ammunition source, superheating them, and ejecting the projectiles at an absolutely blistering rate. These shards are capable of shreddng through all but the densest of ablative armor with ease, though the intense forces at work frequently deform the barrel, necessitating frequent replacement. While these barrel replacements are cheap, they represent a significant challenge to those who would employ this weapon without regular supply lines.

722745.text:
Codename Weapon: SHATTERER

After the recent discovery of new materials located in the deeper Omega Systems, new scientific methods allowed development of advanced exotic weaponry types. One of these new advanced weapons is the weapon known as SHATTERER. This weapon is characterized by its surprisingly high fire rate and proximity EMP discharge.

Whilst the increased fire rate is a benefit, this is partially offset by it's increased shot dispersion, but still a deadly weapon in the hands of a skilled pilot. This weapon's existence is proof that proximity fuses for fighter-scale weaponry is indeed now possible.

722747.text:
Codename Weapon: Rupturer

With complex inner workings making use of hazardous and newly-discovered materials, examples of this weapon are rarely seen. Disturbing rumors regarding its origins abound, alongside an oft-repeated claim that the gun is impossible to reproduce through normal methods. Whether true or not, the rumors regarding their craftsmanship -- and the proven fact of their effectiveness -- ensure that pilots making use of these guns are respected and reviled in equal measure.

722749.text:
Codename Weapon: STARBLAST

The STARBLAST is a prototype Exotic Particle decay lens adapted to be mounted on a fighter heavy weapon slot. Originally assembled from salvaged parts of a Hawking isolation chamber and linear accellerator by survivors of the stranded Lehrmann expedition into the Deep Omegas as a weapon of necessity, the STARBLAST is essentially an exotic particle stabilization module with a gravitational aperture to direct exotic decay ejections in the general direction of the target. Given the unpredictable nature of exotic decay, the particles are propelled forward at seemingly random trajectories whilst phasing in and out of real space, only to explode in a matter-antimatter annhilation as the decay products themselves also inevitably destabilize.

722751.text:
Cruiser Flak Turret

With any large ship, ordinance deterrence becomes a staple of the survival of that craft. The Cruiser flak does just that, disrupting enemy missile and torpedo fire, as well as inhibiting snub craft success in the small area it covers.

722752.text:
"Sickle Mk II" Edge Worlds Particle Cannon

This is a particle-based weapon which, although delivering significant damage at a decent fire rate, requires enormous amounts of energy. This weapon is most effective against graviton shields, and weakest against molecular shields. This is the best Edge Worlds Particle Cannon available.

722753.text:
AI Emitter

An energy emission device that is part of an adaptable series of emitters, used only by AI Drones. When used as a weapon, the energy blasts are equally effective against all known shield types.

722757.text:
Maquis "Bastard Culverin" Tachyon Cannon

This is a tachyon-based weapon that has the longest range of all energy-based weapons, but requires enormous amounts of power to fire. This weapon is most effective against molecular shields, and weakest against positron shields.

722758.text:
"Arquebus" Gallic Brigands Plasma Cannon

This is a plasma-based weapon that provides a high refire rate at a reduced damage output. This weapon is most effective against positron shields, and weakest against graviton shields.

722759.text:
SN-02 "Supernova" Cryogenic Antimatter Cannon

In response to the rapid rebuilding of hardened Sirian warship fleets in the wake of the Nomad War, modernized designs for bombers were developed in kind to provide militaries with low-cost alternatives to risking billions of credits against hostile capital ships. At the heart of these bombers lay the Supernova Antimatter Cannon, a downscaled derivative of the well-known and well-revered "Mortar" series of cryogenic antimatter projectors. Utilizing the majority of a bomber's power plant to drive the gravitic projection and supercooling of the weapon's payload, the SN-02 and its various clones deliver a cryogenically stabilized physics package of anti-hydrogen atoms suspended in carbon fullerenes, a combination that rips through hullmetal with the ferocity of a nanoscopic artificial sun.

The SN-02 succeeds the original SN-01, whose plans were released onto the open market shortly after their completion by weapons researchers in the early ninth century AS While many factions across Sirius have their own customized versions of this pocket-sized tide turner, the SN-02 is commonly available at open ports throughout the colonies to anyone who supplies the only credentials that matter to arms dealers: a nice, healthy stack of clean cash.

722767.text:
Bomber "Hailstone" Missile System

First sighted on wrecks picked over by the Junkers of Bornholm, this missile launcher bears all the hallmarks of Coalition engineering. Lightweight, flexible, modular, and astoundingly lethal to those who dare underestimate it, the BM-21 fires rapid salvos of self-propelled rockets filled with barely-contained plasma. The number of projectiles released in a burst can be easily modified in drydock, allowing pilots to adapt the weapon to their own preferences and contributing to its quick adoption by many groups in the Omegas.

722769.text:
Bomber Hailstone Missile

Light payload high tracking missile.

722771.text:
"Gravedigger" Improvised Ultra-Heavy Torpedo Launcher

When Madeira was at risk of discovery at the hands of a Corsair battlegroup, the Independent Miners' Guild called the Hessians and the Coalition for aid. Both groups were preoccupied with more immediate threats to their own operations, and with no heavy assets of their own in the area, the Guild's pioneers were left to muster an impossible defense against a foe far outclassing them. In desperation, the miners of Madeira cobbled together improvised torpedoes from dozens of deep-core mining charges, rigged them with half-repaired heat signature trackers, and sent a wing of bombers to sortie in defense of their home. To the station crew's amazement, the entire wing returned alive, proclaiming that Madeira would stay under the radar for the foreseeable future. Sometimes all you really need is a bigger boom.

However, the large blast radius and EMP damage come at a cost - the mine does virtually no damage to the armor.

Launching forth lethal projectiles of neutron-enriched plasma, the devastating effect of this device inspires both fear and jealousy in its manufacturer's enemies.

722786.text:
Weapon Codename: ENERVATOR

While the Independent Miners Guild has long been known as a smalltime manufacturer of ships, less well-known are the weapons they produce. While popularly regarded as an eccentric choice compared to more widespread civilian options, decades of experience producing tachyon-based weaponry have given the IMG a thorough understanding of the underlying technology. These successes have been built on the backs of dozens of failed projects.

This gun is one such project, with tachyon flywheels which also produce pulse fields through an elegant quirk of physics, rendering the resultant projectiles equally effective against hulls and shields. These unusual properties lead the gun to be perceived as more trouble than it's worth by many pilots, but less conventionally-inclined escorts and mercenaries are occasionally willing to pay good money for the occasional model that turns up in a Guild warehouse or on the grey market.

722788.text:
Battlecruiser "Whirlwind" Rocket Launcher

Designed from the ground up to fire rockets forged from dense molybdenum-titanium alloy, equipped with scorching chemical thrusters, and each carrying a devastating payload of unknown composition wrapped in a highly-volatile plasma containment field, this device mount is more a desperate assemblage of half-baked safety features with a chamber attached than it is a true rocket launcher.

Each of these safety features is intended solely for its users, however, as the moment a Whirlwind's rocket is set loose, every head on the battlefield turns and high alert is declared, with no care wasted in avoiding its frenzied path. Upon impact, all evasive maneuvers prove themselves justified as the chain reaction of the anomalous payload, freed from its plasmatic containment, tears a vicious hole through anything in its wake.

722797.text:
Cruiser Particle Bolter

The Cruiser Particle Bolter is a volley saturation fire platform for cruiser defense modules. Designed and manufactured under contract for the Libertonian Advanced Weaponization Laboratory by the Cyril Initiative under the Next Generation Suppressive Fire Program, the Particle Bolter is a defensive wide area denial coverage system. Dispensing a steady and wide stream of slow but superheated volatile slugs, the Particle Bolter is intended for discouraging the encroachment of armored capital ships and small fightercraft alike. Given the characteristic emerald green glow by the intense but sustained oxidation of the surface coated copper-thallium jacket, a given bolt comprises of a superheated slug of solid iridium-tungsten composite magnetically launched at just below flash point, and will readily react violently with any unshielded metallic surfaces on contact.After a number of unsuccessful combat trials and numerous failed experimental versions the project was scrapped, never entering mass production. Today, such weaponry can only be found mounted on what few vessels have had it installed for purposes of trial and testing. Due to the platform's highly experimental state, sophisticated adaptations need to be made to render it not only operational but also compatible with most of today's technology.

722799.text:
MB8a "Onslaught" Battlecruiser Kinetic Cannon

The Onslaught cannon is a prototype kinetic cannon designed to be used on battlecruiser class main battery hardpoints. The cannon fires 1326mm high-explosive armor-piercing shells in a triple-barrel configuration, offering unparalleled penetration when in contact with armor. The cannon is a downscaled version of the MB10a and is inspired from archaic designs that were used in naval warships during the Sol era. The low velocity shells have virtually no effect on the shields that complement today's warships. However, with advances in hull plating being primarily focused on energy dissipation, this old and otherwise obsolete approach is yet again proving to be effective.This rare and forgotten design has seen sparse production by various organizations, with most cannons serving as exhibit pieces in museums across the colonies.

722801.text:
Cruiser "Leecher" Prototype Attenuator Lattice

An innovation born of the efforts of enterprising and often foolhardy explorers and technologists, this weapon is constructed in part from exotic matter found on the fringes of known space. The internals of the weapon bear some structural similarities to those of conventional mortars, but such commonality ends where a specialized chamber concentrates energy in a flexible, moving lattice, whose contours and motions shape and direct the projectile, which would be too energetic to stabilize with more typical weapons-grade materials.

While the projectile loses some of its theoretical destructive force to instability after leaving the chamber, the electromagnetic disturbance it produces on impact proves a threat to shields and reactor cores of all magnitudes.

722805.text:
Weapon Codename: RICOCHET

The RICOCHET MK1 is an experimental weapon designed by APM for usage by the Bounty Hunters Guild. Veteran Bounty Hunters operating in the Edge Worlds and far corners of Sirius found the Guild's standard issue weapons to be ill-suited for hunting notoriously dangerous criminals and aliens in environments far away from civilization, where these opponents had significant technological and numerical advantages over them.With the Core's recent progress in both acquiring and understanding AI technology, the RICOCHET is APM's way to sell highly exotic, overtuned weapons to elite Hunters who are willing to pay top dollar for any advantage that would help them not only survive, but dominate the harsh environment of the Edge Worlds. The RICOCHET uses components from Gammu to blend the infamous effectiveness of AI weapons against all human-made shields with an overcharged, but otherwise conventionally made human laser to create a highly damaging and fast firing weapon suited for overwhelming targets and leaving quickly before reinforcements can respond.The weapon has yet to complete its development phase, and only Hunters with very deep pockets or connections to the higher-ups in APM have managed to get their hands on the weapon.

722807.text:
"Nullifier" Pulse Cannon

Conceived as a way to jumpstart ships that have lost propulsion as a result of power failure or heavy damage. It is evident from the weapons current employment that this originally intended purpose has been grossly ignored. What might have once served to restart critical ship systems, now enthusiastically projects overcharged pulse fields to cause cascading system failures. This philosophy is especially popular with pirates, who prefer to disable their prey rather than destroy them outright. In escalated conflict, the weapon can punch well above its own weight and strain even the likes of capital class shield generators. As such, all manner of homebrew variations of this cannon have come to occupy arms dealer stockpiles across the Sector.

722809.text:
Adapted AI Cruiser Turret

Corrupted through a virus, this turret has been debased from the intrusive efforts of attempting to reverse engineer the technology, placing it under several restraining bolts to prevent any unwanted surprises.

722811.text:

722816.text:
"Borer" Gunboat Siege Cannon

Much as the Storm Cannon found itself bastardized into a gunboat-sized platform, so too has the "Auger" Siege Cannon found itself with a smaller, reckless brother. Dubbed the "Borer", this weapon is both an engineering miracle and nightmare, channeling a terrifying amount of energy in order to release a focused charge of plasma capable of penetrating the most hardened shield systems in Sirius.

Featuring power consumption that would put small factories to shame and a barrel lifetime measured in minutes, the "Borer" is nonetheless finding itself mounted (or crudely welded) on more and more craft throughout Sirius, especially on those belonging to organizations who cannot afford to field larger, traditional anti-installation warships. Like its larger brother, it too requires a steady supply of cooling cartridges or barrel changes - the former being much more preferable if your Chief Engineer's lifespan is of any concern.

722818.text:
Corsair "Ignis" Plasma Cannon

722820.text:
"Auger" Cruiser Siege Cannon

Massive improvements in installation shielding caused something of a minor arms race in the latter half of the 820s; and, among a handful of failed "superweapon" and "bunker buster" projects, one proposal decided to keep it simple.

The "Auger", as it has come to be known, is simply an LTP-121 "Impact" modified with focusing chambers that massively accelerate and compact the projectile into a rod of barely-contained superheated plasma, offering superior penetrative power at the cost of immense heat generation and power usage.

The resulting projectile is capable of piercing many of the most reinforced shield systems currently in use in Sirius, and as such has found its way onto military siege craft and pirate raiding fleets alike. The main downside of the "Auger" and its ilk are the specialized heat sinks required to operate a weapon such as this under such high loads. Most models currently available feature disposable heat sink cartridges, which must be cycled after only a few shots.

Gallic Repair Ships were recently spotted with a new similar system, repairing damaged Valor battleships in the Leeds warzone. Rumors are a dreaded Gallic Hacker codenamed Blodo has reverse-engineered the Bretonian invention for the Gallic Crown.

722879.text:
"ASFMD" Heavy Railgun

An evolution of the lighter ASMD railgun design, the ASFMD (Accelerated Slug Fusion Mass Driver) utilises the higher power output available from bomber-class reactors to full and terrifying effect. Higher temperatures and a more massive nanite payload allow the railgun slug launched from this weapon to reach temperatures in the hundreds of millions of degrees, inducing an uncontrolled fusion reaction in the projectile as it streaks towards its target. The resultant devastation on the target is breathtaking to behold; even capital-class armour plating stands little chance of fully absorbing a superheated slurry of molten metal punching deep into its surface, and the low rate of fire is thoroughly compensated by the pure penetrative power the ASFMD offers its wielder.

The emergence of hybrid railgun technology onto the open market poses a unique challenge to the sector's shield manufacturers, as the superheated metal slug tends to punch through most shield harmonics with enough force to violently destabilise the energy field. Only time will tell if shield technology can evolve to meet this new threat, or if these weapons are set to join the Debilitator series of weaponry as a premier shield-busting option for pilots across the sector.

722887.text:
RH-SMB1 "Gungnir" Zoner Battleship Forward Gun

The "Gungnir" forward gun is a modified variant of the trademark "Ragnarok" Hessian forward gun. Similarly based on a civilian mining blaster designed to break apart large asteroids through an energy discharge as opposed to traditional chemical explosives. The Zoners reproduced the oversized and overcharged version and gave it stability and control to improve accuracy and longevity. The precision of power output allows the weapon to maintain its firepower and its utility as a colossal mining laser capable of shattering colossal asteroid bodies to allow for hasty harvesting of minerals and compounds.

722889.text:
Bt1-p Batrachotoxin Ion Compression Repeater Mk I

This prototype weapon is the result of several years of development by Rheinland's government laboratories. Samples of weapons recovered from independent laboratories in the Omegas, notably the so-called "MALACHITE" series and the obscure "WILD FIRE" model, were reverse-engineered and synthesized into a more perfect whole. The addition of titanium carbide alloys into the barrels, alongside all-new plasma ionizers developed by the Marinenachrichtendienst's top materials scientists, have yielded a unique sting for this venomous weapon. While copies would certainly be in demand by revolutionary groups and other houses, the challenge of recovering intact samples is more than daunting enough in its own right.

722891.text:
Weapon Codename: BEOWULF

A product of a small arms manufacturer in fifth century Bretonia, the Beowulf was born of a contest to develop new weaponry for the nation's Armed Forces. It is by all counts an unorthodox design, favouring raw firepower, recharge rate and short term reliability over long term endurance. The design’s tradeoffs were deemed as acceptable, however, with it being assumed that military logistics would be able to support the maintenance and replacement rate of the Beowulf in exchange for the greater offensive capability the weapon provided.

The weapon, once released to the civilian market, found a similar popularity in some circles of corporate security where similar supply and maintenance requirements could be absorbed. The design proved extremely unpopular with mercenaries and freelancers, however, many of whom preferred the greater durability of lower power weapons systems, even with the Beowulf’s advantages. Despite its success, the Armed Forces would, several decades later, list out a specification for a more durable and longer lasting replacement to cut down on logistics expenditure. As a result, the Beowulf was phased out in favour of newer replacements, with the last known example being lost by the turn of the century in 500 A.S.

This weapon, an original production from the fifth century, appears to be repairable enough with modern technology to make it operational once more. Proprietary tachyon lenses, however, are heavily worn and irreplaceable; the weapon’s accuracy is likely to have faded as a result.

722939.text:
Selection Intl. "ASMD-R" Light Railgun

The ASMD-R (Accelerated Slug Mass Driver - Repeater) is Selection International's latest answer to the proliferation of light strike craft: accuracy by volume. Outwardly unchanged from their flagship "ASMD" design, the Repeater utilizes experimental cooling technology combined with a smaller nanite load allowing for a higher sustained rate of fire. While the resulting slug is notably less powerful than those produced by the "ASMD", the ability to sustain several follow-up shots massively increases hit potential on smaller targets, and as such the Repeater variant is marketed as an anti-strikecraft solution first and foremost.

The emergence of hybrid railgun technology onto the open market poses a unique challenge to the sector's shield manufacturers, as the superheated metal slug tends to punch through most shield harmonics with enough force to violently destabilise the energy field. The success of SI's previous venture has allowed procurement of smaller, more efficient energy field stabilizers; improving both shield penetration while boasting higher speeds.

722947.text:
"Frack" Battlecruiser Siege Cannon

Following the footsteps of the reliable Auger design, the Frack has been developed to shore up the limitations of Battlecruiser sieging capabilities.

Using the Avalanche as a base, the Frack uses a highly dense slug of chirodebris, encased by the same shell of Cryogenic Antimatter to launch a projectile that is highly malleable, crystallizing, melting, and recrystallizing again to shape itself for any angle of armor it is exposed to.

722956.text:
"Rockhound" Cruiser Rocket Launcher

The Rockhound is a rocket propelled mining charge designed for Heavy Cruiser mount platforms. Initially designed by Planetform as a deep planetary crust probe that could be launched from orbit en masse, the Rockhound utilizes a proprietary solid state penetrator head to achieve low friction entry up to half a kilometer deep into a variety of rocky substrates. As Planetform transitioned from automated orbital deep core sampling to more economical manned surface sampling, the designs were sold off to several interested parties including Deep Space Engineering.

The Rockhound was first repurposed as an asteroid deep core sampling probe, and then as a payload delivery platform for deep penetration seismic fracturing. Scaling down the overall size of each rocket by over a half, replacing long-range high penetration communications and sensor suites with two hundred kiloton yield seismic charges, and downgrading the penetrator rating from five hundred meters to ten, the current Rockhound was redesigned as an inexpensive method for asteroid based surface ablation and mineral vein exposure. Relaxed policies stemming from the recent dissolution of the Libertonian Bureau of Pharmaceuticals Ordnance and Wetlands has resulted in widespread proliferation - some even making their way into the hands of pirates.

*Requires Rockhound Rocket

722966.text:
EW-39 Gunboat Prototype Electromagnetic Internally Integrated Railgun

"The EW-39 is a reproduction of a pre-production electromagnetic linear accelerator designed as a forward artillery platform for gunboats. Unlike conventional directed energy systems, the EW-39 rapidly accelerates a dense 5kg armor piercing Iridium-Uranium composite slug on a ferromagnetic armature along two parallel rails using electromagnetic propulsion. Though sometimes prone to over penetration on small unshielded targets, assessors have described resultant damages to be ‘satisfactory.’

Developed by MagTech Armory for the Liberty Department of Naval Ordnance “Next Generation Mass Drivers” initiative as a platform for bypassing conventional shielding, the designs were shelved and then subsequently leaked after advances in shield technology rendered the advantages of kinetics obsolete.

786432.text:
ARTIFACTS

Remnants of an alien civilization that existed long before humanity crawled from the ocean. The particulars of each individual Artifact vary, but archeologists and scientists have been unable to determine their function; for all intents and purposes they appear to be inert chunks of crystal and metal inscribed with decorative patterns. A thriving market for Artifacts has sprung up over the years among art collectors and the social elite looking for a new status symbol.

BASIC ALLOYS

Melding the strength of Titanium with the lightness of Aluminum, Basic Alloys can be used economically to construct durable machine parts. The non-ferrous nature of parts constructed from Basic Alloys and their resistance to oxidization makes them ideal for use in almost any manufacturing environment. When Basic Alloys are infused with a matrix of Boron fibers and combined with Super Alloys, the resulting material is then fabricated into the Ship Hull Panels used by shipyards throughout the colonies.

BERYLLIUM

In its processed metallic form, Beryllium is one of the lightest and stiffest naturally occurring materials known to science; unfortunately, it is also highly brittle, making unalloyed Beryllium unsuitable for most industrial processes. However, Beryllium was discovered to be extraordinarily effective at absorbing neutron radiation, and has since become a key component in the construction of modern reactors and engines.

Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

786435.text:
BORON

Boron is an essential element in a number of industrial processes. In its fibrous form, Boron filaments are used as a stiffener in the creation of Ship Hull Panels, lending them unparalleled structural integrity. An isotope of Boron, Boron-10, is also used for control rods in the nuclear reactors that power large ships, stations, and planetside bases.

Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

786436.text:
CARDAMINE

Cardamine is a naturally occurring complex chemical found in orange coloured grasses in the unique ecosystem of the planet Malta. The Outcasts are known for growing more concentrated varieties of this grass on their plantations and distributing it further into Sirius. Cardamine has strong stimulant effects on its users, which are enhanced by the fact that the body does not build up a tolerance to it. However, it is notorious for quickly creating an irreversible chemical dependency in its users and altering the DNA of its users. With long-term use, Cardamine eliminates the risk of degenerative diseases in its users and cancer. Cardamine also increases fitness in its users, which translates into an extended lifespan of ten to twenty years on average.

For the Outcasts who were born on the planet Malta, Cardamine has more beneficial effects. In general, the Outcasts enjoy several times longer lifespans thanks to this substance, and are faster, stronger, tougher, more intelligent, and in some cases more attractive compared to ordinary humans and long-term Cardamine users. The downside for them, however, is a significantly lower fertility rate, which severely limits their population growth compared to the rest of Sirius, and the fact that they must return to the planet Malta periodically for their long-term survival, as for significantly altered individuals like them, the mere use of Cardamine is no longer enough.

The Outcasts distribute Cardamine in two main forms. The gaseous form is cheaper, less refined, easier and safer to take through special breathing masks and inhalers, and is the most common form of the drug in Sirius. The more expensive, concentrated and refined liquid form of Cardamine is for intravenous use by users who find inhalers inconvenient or cannot afford them because of the secrecy of their addiction.

Properties
Base Price: $115
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

786437.text:
COBALT

Thousands of years ago the distinctive coloration of Cobalt was used to create blue-tinged glass that was admired throughout the known world. Since that time, Cobalt has become recognized as a strategic metal with diverse military and commercial applications. Brittle in its unalloyed form, Cobalt Alloys exhibit tremendous hardness and resistance to corrosion. When combined with Niobium, the resulting High-Temperature Alloy can withstand even the intense heat and pressure generated by the combustion chamber of a fusion engine.

CONSUMER GOODS

Once the basic necessities of survival have been met, most human beings look for ways to improve their life or to entertain themselves along the way. Consumer Goods satisfy these needs and include a broad range of relatively inexpensive bulk items such as clothing, toiletries, housewares, and Consumer Optronics. While most Consumer Goods are mass produced in automated factories, the ongoing rise in the prison population within the colonies has yielded a cheap labor force that many governments have turned to for handmade goods.

Properties
Base Price: $1
Container Hitpoints: 250
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

COPPER

Copper is a malleable, ductile, and essential component of room temperature Superconductors. Superconductors must be surrounded by shunt materials capable of carrying heavy currents around occasional Superconductor faults. For many of the same reasons that Copper was originally used in electrical wiring, it is an ideal shunt material in Niobium Superconductors. And, of course, Superconductors are an important component of modern Jump Gates and Trade Lanes.

DIAMONDS

Diamonds are the hardest natural substance known to modern science. Composed of a crystalline lattice of simple carbon formed under enormous heat and pressure, diamonds are an essential component of mining machinery, allowing saws and drills to cut through even the toughest asteroid or planetary crust. When properly cut and polished, however, the distinctive pattern of light refraction exhibited by diamonds results in the characteristic glittering, which has made them a hallmark of the rich and powerful elite.

ENGINE COMPONENTS

Fusion engines generate thrust by superheating plasma in a magnetic bottle. The plasma is then emitted as exhaust through a nozzle assembly, providing thrust for even the largest of battleships. The temperatures and pressures exerted by a fusion engine require that their components be manufactured from High-Temperature Alloys, while Superconductors are necessary to generate the huge magnetic fields needed to contain the plasma.

FERTILIZERS

Fertilizers increase crop yields and enable plants to grow in planetary environments that lack the necessary nutrients due either to natural conditions or as a result of large-scale harvesting and grazing. Fertilizers are also a key component of the terraforming process, acting as a catalyst to accelerate the production of the self-sustaining plant ecologies that regulate climate and provide food for more advanced lifeforms.

FOOD RATIONS

Most planets in the Sirius Sector are rich in natural resources, but few are capable of supporting large-scale agriculture. As a result, Food remains one of the basic but essential inputs of the Sirius economy. A large assortment of Food stuffs are available in the different colonies, with Bretonian, Gallic and Kusari Food Rations largely consisting of 'traditionally' harvested plants and proteins. Despite this, Synth Foods has cornered much of the sector's market with its revolutionary Synth Paste, a fact that is an ongoing source of resentment and concern for farmers of 'traditional' produce.

OXYGEN

A typical human being consumes over 12,000 liters of Oxygen (O2) daily. Oxygen, usually mixed with a neutral gas such as nitrogen, is absorbed through the tissues of the lungs and then diffused into the bloodstream, where it is carried throughout the body. All humans require a constant supply of Oxygen or they will perish within minutes.

GOLD

Gold is the oldest precious metal known to humanity, initially prized for its smooth, shiny appearance, and later for its unique physical characteristics. Gold is the most malleable and ductile of all metals known. Combined with its high reflectivity to radiation and resistance to corrosion, gold has obvious applications in both the optronics and ship construction industries. Of course, the scarcity of gold -- colony holdings of gold increase by only 1.2% per standard year -- also makes it the ultimate status symbol for those who can afford it.

H-fuel production is almost totally monopolized by the Kusari who obtain their supplies from the Gas Miner's Guild or Samura before shipping it to storage depots and distribution facilities throughout the colonies.

High temperature alloys are essential to the construction of engine components: only a material with the strength of cobalt and the temperature resistance of niobium could withstand the tremendous amount of heat and pressure that exists within the combustion chamber of a fusion engine. However, the rarity of niobium and the complex fabrication methods employed mean that high temperature alloys are relatively expensive -- but without them, modern space travel would be impossible.

HULL PANELS

One of the most important pieces of technology developed during the course of settling the Sirius Sector has been resilient hull panels, used in the building of ships large and small as well as space stations and other spaceborne constructs. These wonders of materials research combine a polymer and hydrocarbon base along with basic and super alloys to create a substance that is light and flexible, while providing insulation from hard vacuum and all but the most intense radiation. Boron fibers are infused into the panels to endow them with structural rigidity, protecting ships against kinetic impact and high-energy weapons fire.

HYDROCARBONS

Hydrocarbons are a class of organic compounds composed only of hydrogen and carbon molecules, resulting in a wide variety of substances that have important industrial applications. While hydrocarbons naturally occur in a gaseous state almost everywhere in the known universe, frozen deposits present the most easily exploited form of the substance. Hydrocarbon mining is key to the industrialization of the Sirius Sector as it provides the raw materials for the creation of the Ship Hull Panels and Optronics, upon which modern society depends.

AGEIRA JUMP GATE / TRADE LANE PARTS

Jump Gate and Trade Lane parts are manufactured Ageira Technologies in Sirius for assembly into important FTL travel infrastructure. Ageira's White Boxes are notorious for their security features, which include scanner-resistant casing, tracking beacons, complex biometric locks requiring input from multiple designated personnel to unlock, and detonation if attempting to access them outside of an authorised facility. Further measures are confidential.

DETROIT LIGHT ARMS

Detroit Munitions' Deathware line is widely considered to be the finest in precision personal armament in Sirius. They include a wide array of portable weapons intended for personal defense, ranging from handheld blasters to shoulder-mounted needler rifles. While not suited to major military offensives, this line of weaponry is more than adequate for protecting oneself in close quarters combat. And with piracy on the rise throughout the colonies, the need for protection has never been greater.

LUXURY CONSUMER GOODS

All of these items are valuable precisely because they are rare, often fabricated from the most uncommon or difficult-to-obtain resources in the Sirius Sector.

LUXURY FOOD

The first colonists found strange planets full of unknown flora and fauna, much of it indigestible or even toxic to human beings. As time passed, though, the colonists grew more confident about which indigenous life forms were both nutritional and flavorful, while some gene-banked plants and animals unexpectedly flourished in their new environments. Such delicacies quickly became some of the most popular and expensive imports from the worlds that produced them.

MINING MACHINERY

Much of the rich resources of the Sirius Sector are locked within barren planetoids or buried beneath the crust of an airless, frozen planet. By combining super-hard Diamond drill bits and advanced sensor arrays, however, even the deepest deposits can be excavated with relative ease. When used in conjunction with automated crushers, grinders, and sifters, a complete mining operation manned by only a few key personnel can rip apart an average-sized asteroid within a matter of standard weeks.

MOX

A mixture of uranium oxide (UO2) and a small (<3%) portion of weapons-grade plutonium, MOX is the primary fuel for the nuclear reactors used aboard large spacecraft and the monstrous blast furnaces of manufacturing platforms. MOX is typically formed into ceramic pellets that are then loaded into zirconium fuel elements and packaged for transport. It is an efficient source of energy that utilizes a large percentage of recycled materials and exhibits only trace radiation, thus posing little threat to the environment.

NIOBIUM

Relatively light and extremely heat resistant, Niobium-derived alloys have been used in the construction of spacecraft and nuclear reactors for centuries, while at lower temperatures Niobium acts as an effective Superconductor. But aside from its practical uses, Niobium is also visually distinctive. When anodized using an electric current, Niobium turns a range of iridescent colors. This property makes it a natural subject for the jeweler's art.

ALIEN ORGANISMS

A previously undiscovered bacterial lifeform unique to the Sirius Sector, these microorganisms are remarkably efficient at metabolizing certain elements into oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon dioxide. When seeded in an immature planetary environment they can accelerate the terraforming process tenfold, or provide a rich, abundant source of food for other organisms in more mature planetary ecosystems.

The Optical Chip is a tiny electronic component featuring a general purpose array of optical switches that can be programmed and instantly reprogrammed to perform nearly any function. Rather than using electricity, however, beams of light transfer information almost instantly, making general purpose stateless computing machines possible. Optical Chips are the core components in the new field of Optronics on which all advanced technology is based.

These Optronic devices utilize almost no moving parts, consume very little power, and operate at the speed of light. Because Optical Chips can almost instantly reprogram themselves, Optronics excel at the kind of signal processing and computation that underlie a host of practical applications ranging from Consumer Goods to ship avionics.

PHARMACEUTICALS

Using scanners and optronic computers, scientists can determine the precise molecular structure required for a drug to be most effective in treating a particular disease or affliction. The resulting drug is then assembled molecule by molecule from raw polymers; however, prototype drugs must be researched in zero-g to avoid the effects of gravitational pull which could disturb the delicate process.

POLYMERS

A polymer is a large molecule of high relative molecular mass composed of five or more monomers, smaller molecular structures repeated over and over to form the polymer. While the simplest of polymers have only five monomers, typical polymers contain hundreds or thousands of monomers, and some advanced polymers stretch into chains of millions. Because of their physical and chemical characteristics, polymers have a tremendous range of uses and are ubiquitous within the technology and consumer products industries.

The rapid industrialization that followed the settlement of the Sirius Sector has resulted in large fields of Scrap Metal, the detritus resulting from extensive manufacturing and mining operations. These debris fields present both a navigational hazard and a potential second-stage resource, so a small cottage industry has sprung up among those who collect scrap metal and resell it at smelting plants.

SILVER

Silver has long been valued by humanity for its beauty, scarcity, and broad spectrum of uses. One of the most important uses for Silver today, however, is in terraforming. Silver iodide (AgI) is employed as a cloud-seeding agent to catalyze nascent ecologies by encouraging the production of rain. Silver also remains highly desirable for its aesthetic beauty, accessorizing the suit of many a technocrat or the arm of a society matron.

SUPER ALLOY

In its unalloyed form, Beryllium is incredibly strong and light but also highly brittle; when combined with aluminum, however, the resulting Super Alloy offers all the benefits of Beryllium along with the stiffness of aluminum. The Super Alloy fabrication process is somewhat more complicated than that used to make Basic Alloys, though, and Super Alloy is consequently more expensive. Super Alloys are used in everything from Ship Hull Panels to the frames of advanced military vessels.

Base Price: $30
Container Hitpoints: 4000
Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

SUPERCONDUCTORS

Superconductors are materials that transmit without loss any current applied to them. Unfortunately, many materials act as superconductors only when cooled to temperatures near absolute zero. The discovery of "room temperature" superconductors built around a core of specially treated niobium with copper shunting, however, made possible quantum leaps in technology. Most importantly, superconductors are key components in fusion engines and in the construction of Jump Gates and Trade Lanes.

Cargo Space Per Unit: 1

TERRAFORMING GASES

The injection of gases such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and perfluorocarbons (PFCs) into the atmosphere of a developing planet is an essential first step in the terraforming process. These greenhouse gases trap solar heat and raise the mean temperature to a sufficient level where a self-sustaining ecology can be initiated. PFCs are up to 10,000 times more effective than carbon dioxide as a greenhouse gas, but they do not occur naturally in planetary environments, and large quantities must be transported to any planet undergoing terraforming.

The inevitable byproduct of many of the industrial processes used by the different colonies is Toxic Waste. Deprived of Water, most humans can only live three days. The process of dehydration is a painful one, as tissues shrivel and vessels shrink in a desperate bid by the dying body to preserve its remaining vital functions.

Strains of Bioproduce selected for export generally have a broad range of industrial, medicinal and construction uses.

Most Wendigos are not directly infected, instead being psychically indoctrinated Thralls that execute their masters' plots. There is no known way to remove an uncooperative incubus without killing the host, and captured Wendigos of either category will fight to the death rather than submit to interrogation. GRACE'S REFRAIN

It draws us together,
It tears us apart,
It marks the end of a beginning,
Or does it simply make it start?
Unquestionable and divine
It charts a lineage for big and small
Controlling strings that thus connect us all.
In all our lives it guides us, pushes and controls us.
For purposes and causes relatively unknown.
Inevitable and undeniable, like a statistic,
It runs my life, behind curtains of chaotic turns.
I've seen its face, though counting the passing days
It's neither good nor evil, like a program.
It merely bends and shapes all things,
Into the linearity of life and the development of soul.
It makes my purpose rather clear,
And yet completely unknown if I can change it all.

DAAM K'VOSH ARTIFACT

What appears to be a trasure of the Daam K'Vosh origin, the artifact was first discovered during survey operations of a fragment from the Fischer Daam K'Vosh structure, and later recovered by the unfortunate vessel that succumbed to the environmental damage, letting the artifact drift on the ship indefinitely.

The object is roughly 25 centimeters in length, irregular in shape, with a surface composed of a single solid material of uniform deep violet coloration. No visible seams, joints, or manufacturing marks are present. Its surface does not reflect light in a consistent manner - sections appear matte from one angle and faintly lustrous from another.

Spectrographic readings show the material has a refractive index that shifts slightly during repeated measurements, though the composition remains unidentified. No heat signature or electromagnetic emissions have been detected. The artifact’s mass is higher than expected for its size, and density mapping suggests a solid, homogeneous interior with no internal cavities.

786588.text:
WELCOME TO DISCOVERY FREELANCER 4.87: CONQUEST!

Thanks for downloading and installing the Discovery Freelancer modification. This mod's purpose is to expand the Freelancer universe without spoiling its original atmosphere. We have not changed every aspect of Freelancer that could possibly be changed, as it is not our intention to create a total conversion mod. Even though a list of new Discovery features is huge - and growing with each new release - all modifications are integrated into the familiar Freelancer world.

The year is 820 After Settlement (AS), 19 years after the single-player campaign of Freelancer, and two years after the events of Discovery 4.86. The Sirius sector is still embroiled in one major war, while other smaller conflicts are approaching critical instability in other areas. Bretonia has been forced to retreat from the GRN onslaught, and Leeds is now under the total control of Gallia. The GRN's seemingly unstoppable advance has overflowed into other systems, and even now their scouts encroach upon the Independent Worlds that connect Bretonia to Liberty. However, in response to Gallia's increasing threat, Liberty is diverting some of its own naval squadrons to the region in order to slow the hostile advance and protect the key shipping lines between the two Houses. This is only becoming possible due to drastic action by Rheinland, in which they severed the Jump Gates to the Hamburg system in order to halt further Libertonian attacks. While these two Houses are still technically at war, the scale of the conflict has been greatly reduced.

However, despite facing less aggression from Liberty, the choice to focus its attention on that war front in previous years has had dire consequences behind the lines. The Red Hessian movement has run rampant over the Dresden system, claiming most of it for themselves. Meanwhile, a mysterious disaster in the Munich system is causing thousands to flee the settlements there, and investigations are still continuing.

Having been defeated by Gallia in the field of battle, the newly-reformed Republican government of Kusari has opened its borders for economic exchange. Their intention is to reinforce their not insignificant infrastructure with new technologies introduced by Gallic Corporations. However, all may not go to plan, as there is increasing civilian unrest driven by supporters of the exiled Imperial family who would see them returned to the throne. Soon the Kusari Exile fleet will be returning home, and it will not be quiet.

Discovery version 4.87 is focussed on improving and updating much of the content added in previous version, with greater diversity of equipment available for different ship classes. Many new commodities throughout Sirius offer exciting opportunities for profit through various lawful and unlawful trade routes. NPCs are now fewer, but more challenging to defeat. There are many more changes, additions and enhancements introduced in Discovery, see the Readme.txt for a full list. The modification is tested to make each release as bug-free as possible, but should you encounter any issues, please contact us on the official forums to help resolve them.

Discovery is playable both in multiplayer and single-player game modes. The original SP has been disabled as it is no longer compatible with the mod, and thus "Open SP" is enabled. In multiplayer, you may play on Discovery RP 24/7 official server, as well as on many other servers running Discovery mod.

If you are playing on one of the official servers, don't forget to visit http://www.discoverygc.com for additional information and server rules. It is strongly recommended that you read the server rules before playing. Our community is welcoming to newcomers, and you can receive help for whatever problems you may encounter. Please take note of any messages being displayed while you are playing: they contain some of the important information you should know. There is also an item containing the core principles of our rules in your character's cargo hold that you receive when your character was first created.

We hope you will enjoy every moment playing Discovery. Good luck out there!

Please see the Readme.txt for a list of mod Developers and other contributors. Thanks to everyone who helped to make this achievement possible!

786604.text:
Discovery RP 24/7 Server Rules

This is a brief summary of Discovery Freelancer RP 24/7 official server rules that contain the most important regulations related to PvP, ID usage and role-playing (October 2013 revision). Please read complete and up-to-date server rules at www.discoverygc.com. If you are not playing on the Discovery 24/7 RP server, you must refer to your server's rules instead of the rules listed below.

Discovery RP 24/7 is a role-playing server. This means you are expected to behave and communicate like the pilot of your ship, and refrain from using any emoticons, leet terms and Out of Roleplay (OoRP) form of speech in system or local chat.

Communication between players is essential for gameplay, and you are not recommended to play without decent knowledge of English. Using coarse language, posting abusive, hateful, racist content in chat, public or private is prohibited under any circumstances. Threats and insults are only allowed on the server if used within roleplay.

Names of characters must be pronounceable, free of special symbols (except faction tags), emoticons and leet terms. Do not overuse numbers and capital letters.

Since Discovery is a role-playing server, all PvP engagements should be reasonable in terms of RP. The ID of the victim must be scanned prior to attack. ID status has a priority over red/white/green color on HUD.

Attacking characters of level 29 and below which use Recruit ID is prohibited. For exceptions to this, refer to the complete version of the server rules.

A player who was killed in a PvP fight is not allowed to re-engage using any of his/her characters within 2 hours. Characters of a player who was killed in a PvP fight must not return into the system where the fight took place within 2 hours. Fleeing from combat by docking on a station or planet while still within the scanner range of hostile vessels counts as PvP death.

Aggressors are not allowed to destroy a trade vessel prior to issuing a demand in system or local chat, and allowing sufficient time to respond. "Halt" is not a demand, however, a trade vessel may be destroy if they refuse to stop after being asked to in form of a proper demand.

For purposes of the server rules:
- All light fighters, heavy fighters, very heavy fighters, super heavy fighters, and bombers are considered fighters
Cargo ships with cargo hold less than 750 units are considered freighters
- Cargo ships with cargo hold more than 750 units, including liners, are considered transports
- Gunboats, cruisers (including destroyers and battlecruisers), battleships (including carriers) are considered capital ships.

Cheating, hacking attempts, and abusive or insulting behavior toward other players is not tolerated.

786638.text:
SIRIUS HISTORY

This document contains Sirius chronology, including the new Discovery events that happened after 801 AS

1 AS - Liberty sleeper ship lands on Manhattan.

60 AS - Sigma-13 discovered.

110 AS - Von Rohe explores Omega-11.

300 AS - Tau-29 discovered by a Kusari research expedition.

450 AS - Harris terraforming initiated.

543 AS - Great California Drought.

620-700 AS (approximately) - 80-Year War between Rheinland and GMG.

702 AS - Popular Revolution in Rheinland.

761 AS - Passage from Omicron Theta into Omicron Eta is discovered. Corsairs gain direct passage into Outcast territory.

800 AS - Nomad attempt to overtake Sirius is stopped by The Order. Single-player campaigh is set through 800-801 AS

802-804 AS - Nomad-infested humans from Rheinland populate an uncharted Omega system. The Wild are formed.

810-814 AS - Tensions rising between Bretonia and Kusari.

812 AS - The Wild begin sporadic raids against Rheinland that continue until present day.

814 AS - War between Bretonia and Kusari has started and continues until present day. The Wild ships are seen as far as New Berlin.

815 AS - Kusari forces occupy Tau-31. In several decisive battles, Bretonia fleets are defeated and retreat to Leeds.

816 AS - Front line in Tau-31 stabilizes, but fighting continues. Nomad gates build by The Wild are discovered. Rheinland gains proof that Liberty conducts secret experiments on the Nomads.

817 AS - Gallia reclaims Languedoc and invades the Tau systems, forcing Kusari to end the war with Bretonia. Kusari's government is overthrown and the Emperor is exiled with a small fleet in Bretonia. Liberty advances in the war with Rheinland. Numerous factions undergo upheaval as Gallia shifts the balance of power in Sirius.

820 AS - Gallia breaks through Bretonian lines and claims Leeds. Rheinland destroys the Jump Gates leading into the Hamburg system, preventing Libertonian attacks through those Gates and significantly down-scaling the war with Liberty. Liberty begins to redirect military forces towards Bretonia in order to help stop the Gallic advance. Kusari opens up trade with Gallia but faces internal turmoil as citizens riot, demanding the return of the exiled Emperor.

786642.text:
NOMAD POWER CELL

At some point prior to the Colony Wars, a Rheinland expedition sponsored by Chancellor Niemann pushed deep into a then-uncharted Omega system. While excavating a barren planet, they discovered two Daam-K’vosh Power Cells sealed in stasis. One was catastrophically lost during the attempt at removal, while the second was successfully extracted. The surviving Power Cell was withdrawn to Thuringia for study.

Following the collapse of Sirius’ Daam-K’vosh energy network following the Nomads' defeat in Omicron Major, the Wild of Omega-58 used this Cell's mass to energy conversion protocols to create their own local power supply, narrowly avoiding energy-starvation. Their experimentation on the Cell’s mechanisms later provided the blueprint for the Nomads’ crude attempts at replicating this ancient technology. Limited numbers of Nomad Power Cells have now been produced, allowing for more and more inert Daam-K’vosh structures sequestered throughout the deep Omicrons to be reactivated.

Calculations that traditional Optronic chips are incapable of solving are easily guessed by bio-neural processors. The primary function of the bio-neural processors on board space-ships is to perform optimal fuel, navigational, and tactical calculations across an exponentially increasing field of inputted data.

Once mined by Kruger Minerals, Rheinland's loss of the Dresden system has left the Red Hessians as the sole vendor of these gems. Nicknamed Hessian Tears, they have come to be associated with the Hessian movement, with their wealthier ideological allies and sympathisers wearing them to display their sentiments. However, many of the native flora and fauna are reputed to be natural aphrodisiacs and are also rare delicacies, leading to widespread poaching that the authorities are finding difficult to control. Planetform is rumored to be attempting to introduce certain species from Gaia into the ecosystems of planets that they are terraforming, although the company denies these rumors. The transportation of wildlife from planet Gaia is illegal in Bretonia, yet there are many willing to take the chance in order to reap the potential profits.

The band responds by creating a virtual reality in the mind of the user according to pre-programd scenarios and manipulates their neural impulses so that they perceive themselves as actually participating in the activities that the band is programd with. Popular holo-tainment scenarios include exotic vacations and allowing a user to perceptually "become" a character in a fictional storyline. It has a wide range of commercial applications, from lighting and high voltage indicators to its use in specialized lasers. It is most commonly used in its liquid form in cryogenic and refrigeration systems, and is in huge demand throughout the main Houses.

Interchangeable nuclear devices were developed in order to simplify the exchange of "used" radioactive fuel for "fresh". Each device is a self-contained nuclear core connected to the control mechanisms that operate it, surrounded by a radiation shield. Transport and storage of nuclear devices is the most highly regulated and secure "commercial activity" in Sirius. They are primarily used as energy generators, but have also been adapted into weaponry as homing mines.

Gallic engines use a form of fusion known as the CNO cycle, a process that occurs naturally inside stars. Unlike stars, Gallic technology cannot recycle the carbon, it is converted to nitrogen in the fusion process.

786738.text: CLASSIFIED: Report on status of Brittany

786739.text:
INTRODUCTION:
This is a report based on data collected by the GRN research ship Astrolabe and its probes sent through the Gallic minefields. This report is compiled based on the findings in 731 AGS in case new facts are discovered in the near future.

SIRIAN SYSTEM DESIGNATION: Orkney
SYSTEM RECLASSIFICATION: Brittany

DESCRIPTION:
Vast and barren star system devoid of habitable planets, prominent asteroid belts across the star system. Geological analysis has not yet been performed; mineral deposits of low to average abundance expected based on visual estimates.

ACTIVITY:
The system is barren and uninhabited except for a small asteroid installation built by a group of Sirians known as the Independent Miners Guild - IMG for short. Activity significant around their installation, declining with distance, generally insignificant. Estimated population as small, expected growth only very gradual, stagnation or decline not ruled out.

Also noted presence of groups known as Outcasts and Gaians. Presence of both groups insignificant, apparently with no permanent presence in the system. Outcasts have been observed raiding IMG's assets in the system.

No Sirian ships came to investigate the Gallic minefields during the observation period (59 days). Estimate - they are aware of its presence but do not consider it a major threat at this time.

CONCLUSION:
The Brittany system is unsuitable for colonization. Civilian use limited to mining colonies. Militarily, it can serve as a border system due to the asteroid belts. Need to consider the possibility of an increase in criminal activity against the Crown due to the presence of the previously mentioned asteroid belts.

Nox is a highly potent drug that originates from Planet Marseille and is illegal to trade within Gallia. "Nox" translates from Latin as "darkness" or "night", and since precise chemical designation of the substance is impossible, this name is used both officially and unofficially across Gallia. Bacteria known to be the only source of this substance are symbiotic to several relatively rare echinoderm species present in the oceans of Marseille. The bacteria are extracted from their hosts, cryogenically frozen and shipped to drug laboratories, from where the pure Nox is shipped to dealers. The bacteria do not reproduce without their host, and Nox itself cannot be synthesized chemically, being a complex combination of flunitrazepam, psilocybin and over a dozen organic components not used in chemistry or medicine. The effect of the drug also cannot be reproduced by any known drug, making Nox the highest-rated drug substance in Gallia (before the introduction of cardamine). Nox has initial time-slowing and sedative effect, shortly followed by increase of brain activity and hallucinations while the consumer's body is relaxed. In some time, the hallucinations are followed by very deep, nearly lethargic sleep lasting for 12-16 hours, after which the consumer experiences short-term amnesia. While physical dependency caused by Nox is relatively light, psychological dependency develops quickly and is very difficult to recover from. No currently accepted medical use of Nox exists, and experiments on humans that involve Nox were banned throughout Gallia over 50 years ago.

When alloyed with Molybdenum, it reduces its hardness and sensitivity to temperature variations. In compound with other rare elements it can function as a Hydrocarbon Cracking Catalyst.

LASERS

Laser is an acronym that stands for Light Amplification by Simulated Emission of Radiation. Atoms or molecules of gases, liquids, crystals, or other materials are excited within a Laser cavity, elevating most of them to higher energy levels, while reflective surfaces in the cavity reflect energy and enable it to build up. Through a process called stimulated emission, photons with matching frequencies and phases are emitted into a directed Laser beam. Lasers are used in a wide variety of applications, including cutting metals, material heat treatment, welding, data transmission, medical treatment, scientific research, and holography.

LIBERTY ALE

MAGNETS

A Magnet is a material or object that produces a magnetic field, attracting ferromagnetic materials and attracting or repelling other Magnets. Electromagnets are created by passing an electric current through a coil of wire. Specialized alloys and superconducting materials can be used to create extremely powerful Magnets that are very small in size. Magnets are used in medicine, industry, consumer products, power generation, and are critical to the specialized functions of Jump Gates and Trade Lanes.

Ranging from pharmaceutical delivery systems, to sensitive bioscanners, to surgical tools and trauma kits, this equipment is vital to the repair and recovery of the human body and mind. Sake is then aged for nine to twelve months in order to develop a more enjoyable taste.

SOLAR PANELS

Solar Panels generate electricity from star light in order to provide power where fuel based electrical generation is impractical or needs to be supplemented. Electrical generation from Solar Panels leaves no residue and minimizes energy signature, making it ideal for any operation that desires to avoid detection. Nearly all remote space stations rely on Solar Panels at a minimum for backup power generation, and many criminal bases and some Zoner Freeports almost entirely depend on them due to the expense and procurement difficulties of nuclear fuels.

Base Price: $30

786882.text:
STABILINE

Cryer Pharmaceuticals manufactures Stabiline using the most advanced nanotechnology processes in a zero gravity environment. Stabiline is a therapeutic agent that mimics key molecular structures naturally occurring in Cardamine, and is intended as a gentler synthetic replacement for the treatment of patients addicted to the Outcast drug.

Although Stabiline can replace the Cardamine necessary for survival and metabolism stabilization in normal patients, Stabiline is designed to not affect the DNA of its users and they cannot become physiologically addicted to it. For severely altered users like the Outcasts, Stabiline, like Cardamine, provides only a temporary solution and cannot keep them alive indefinitely by itself.

Stabiline has none of the beneficial effects on the user's metabolism unlike Cardamine, apart from a temporary boost, and as of 829 AS - the more recent clinical studies on long term user have pointed to an increased risk of neurodegenerative diseases and some aggressive forms of cancer. However, Cryer was quick to vehemently deny the veracity of these studies.

Despite all its issues, Stabiline remains a very profitable venture for Cryer as the steadily increasing number of Cardamine addicts raises its demand and the company is more than ready to offer its premium services to the patients suffering from its side effects. This has earned the pharmaceutical giant a substantial amount of hostile attention from the Outcasts, as their product, especially if further refined, poses an existential threat to the Cardamine distribution network across Sirius.

It is widely used to manufacture Tantalum capacitors for use in consumer electronics. It is an important ingredient in some alloys that possess high melting points, making it useful in extreme heat environments such as engines and nuclear reactors.

Titanium is a common metal with a wide range of applications. On its own, Titanium is highly resistant to corrosion, which has numerous advantages in chemical industries. When alloyed with other metals, the result is a good-quality alloy with a high tensile strength. Adding Titanium to Aluminium produces standard Basic Alloy, which is in high demand throughout the colonies. A secondary application of this element is in the form of Titanium Dioxide, a bright white pigment used to color a wide range of consumer products.

BLUE JILLIES

A native species of Planet Stuttgart, Blue Jillies have been cultivated for centuries. Because they require a high oxygen level and specific nitrogen contents in the soil to grow, during the last two decades the environmental changes caused by Synth Foods' business practices have caused significant decreases in the quality of their growth. Despite this, they continue to be very popular because of their vibrant sapphire blue petals and strong, pleasant aroma. They are currently a source of controversy as many of the dispossessed Stuttgart farmers blame their recent decline on Synth Foods, which has resulted in some LWB-supporters wearing the flower as a symbol of pride and solidarity.

Tungsten carbide is used extensively to form metal working tools. It's high melting point makes it ideal for use in high temperature conditions such as rocket nozzles, turbine blades, and as an ingredient in Superalloys. It's high density makes it valuable in radiation shielding, and its strength makes it ideal for use in the production of armor piercing Munitions.

While Ultralloy does not make a ship indestructible, it does measurably increase survivability for the crew by reducing their radiation exposure.

The addition of Yttrium to alloys generally improves workability, adds resistance to high-temperature recrystallization and significantly enhances resistance to high-temperature oxidation. Yttrium can also be used to deoxidize Vanadium and other non-ferrous metals. Yttrium is a critical component of room temperature Superconductors, and is combined with Neodymium and other elements to form near-infrared Lasers that operate at high power and are used for drilling into and cutting metal.

SUNBUCKS COFFEE AND DONUTS

Sunbucks is the official concession of the LPI. Consumption of any other product by LPI personnel while on duty or in uniform is strictly prohibited and grounds for immediate termination of employment. HEALTH WARNING: Consumption of a ridiculous amount of coffee and donuts has been determined to cause belt tightening by the Libertonian Bureau of Excessive Health Regulations. Ridiculous is defined as continuous consumption exceeding 5.8 kg of product per standard hour over a 12 hour shift. WARNING: Laughter induced during consumption of coffee and donuts has been determined to be a choking hazard to interstellar navigation, and is thereby banned. The cracking of jokes within a 5 meter radius, or over comms while consumption of coffee and donuts is taking place is also banned. Dry sarcasm is permitted with limitations. For details, refer to code 5.43.326 of paragraph 839.36, chapter 1,026, book 37 of the LPI Operations Manual. ADVISORY: Do not attempt to dunk a donut in coffee during active combat operations. NOTICE: Use of hot coffee or stale donuts as a projectile in zero g environments is strictly prohibited. PLEASE NOTICE: This message will self destruct in 5 seconds. In recent years, combat drugs have also been developed to even the odds at any cost, despite severe side effects on the operatives. 787003.text:
DEPLOYABLE MINING CONTAINER

The Deployable Mining Container is a versatile device designed to streamline your mining operations. This portable container automates the collection and storage of mined ore, ensuring a seamless and efficient mining experience.

Usage
Jettison the Deployable Mining Container from your ship's cargo hold near mining targets. Engage your mining laser and target the Deployable Mining Container to enable automatic transfer of ore from the mining beam to the container. The container will autonomously receive and store the mined resources. Once the container reaches its full capacity, it will neatly compress the ore into large, organized packets before ejecting them for easy retrieval and further processing.
The Container will automatically compress itself upon sustaining moderate damage, ready for its next use.

Technical Details
The following commands can be input into the ship console:
/cs Displays the current amount of extracted material stored within a targeted Deployable Mining Container.

CERULITE CRYSTALS

Left behind by a stellar collision on the edge of the Sirius Sector, these molecular compounds form highly variable crystaline structures. Some facets are reflective, while others shine a brilliant, completely opaque blue when under direct light.

Some forms of bacteria are capable of "feeding" on these compounds, stripping off the crystals' irregularities and leaving behind a highly reflective and slightly flexible lattice, while producing extremely toxic by-products in the process. Some of the bacteria die during feeding, as the corners of the crystal structure - when viewed at a micro scale - are so sharp as to pierce their membranes. Sterile and secure laboratory conditions are necessary to prevent contamination of or with the alien organisms.

Instead of the steady charge–discharge cycles of man-made capacitors, these organisms are able to release their stored charge in one great burst. Researchers are still studying how to replicate them, but enterprising military-industrialists have discovered how to exploit their unique physiology for the construction of particle accelerators.

CHIRODEBRIS

Extracted from the depths of a deep-space ship graveyard in far-off uncharted space, this scrap seems useless at first glance. Upon closer examination, it emanates endless delta and epsilon radiation, seemingly independent of outside energy sources. Nanoscopic analysis of such samples indicates that the molecules, unlike mundane ship-building components, universally bear left-handed chirality. Preliminary theories abound, most suggesting that this anomalous structure is responsible for the seemingly infinite radioactivity of this so-called "chirodebris", but mainstream institutions have been quick to decry the researchers advancing these theories as quacks -- despite presenting few alternative hypotheses.

Right now, this scrap is useless by itself, being little more than a scientific curiosity and radiation hazard; brave material engineers, however, might pay handsomely for large quantities, and are rumored to attempt various refining processes.

This opens up potent opportunities for their use in selective and advanced radioelectric devices.

However, major precautions are required to safely handle chiromaterials, as with all seemingly-anomalous substances; they emit endless delta and epsilon radiation, posing not only cancer risks but also potentially corroding whatever machinery they are employed in from the inside out. Only master engineers can make any good use of chiromaterials.

787082.text:
CRYO-ORGANISMS

A recent discovery on the fringes of known space, cryo-organisms are apparently distant genetic cousins to the much more well-known alien organisms that are utilized by Cryer and Planetform. Like their more mundane relatives, they are reasonably useful to the growth and long-term sustainability of crops, and still metabolize gases in ways conducive to standard terraforming practices -- albeit marginally less efficiently.

Where these "cryos" (as they've grown to be called colloquially) differ is in their thermometabolic reactions; while Planetform's terraforming organisms, and Baffin's scrubbies, produce exothermic reactions and emit heat, cryo-organisms' metabolic processes appear to be exclusively endothermic, with the intensity of the reaction varying intensely according to what they consume. This allows handlers to tightly regulate the temperature of the cryos' surroundings, and opens up the possibility of their use in niche industrial applications as an efficient organic coolant. These properties are made even more convenient to employ thanks to the fact that the cryos exude mostly inert and harmless gases like oxygen and argon which are easy to dispose of or harvest and repurpose for other fields.

Despite their wondrous qualities, quantity is a major bottleneck -- they are only economical as temperature regulators, and they have only been reliably documented as present beyond the fringes of known space in poorly-charted systems. However, unverified reports of alleged spaceborne clouds of cryos kilometers wide occasionally trickle in, and have been a major draw for the most adventurous of prospectors.
