"Tower" Basic Plating

A slim exterior plating enhancement of typical aerospace beryllium-titanium alloy reinforced with carbon fiber, more akin to a dense vest than plate armor upon the ship. The loose weave of fiber will absorb a degree of energy transfer from weapon fire and impacts, but isn't intended to stand up to sustained damage.

Stats
Hull Mass: +10%
Hitpoints: +15%
Nanobot Repair Amount: +15%

852522.text:
"Battlement" Hardened Plating

A hardened armor plating of layered ceramic plate, duralumin-type alloy, and shock-absorbant filler. The heat retention capabilities of the ceramic elements greatly improve protection against energy weapons, but the setup increases the bulk of the vessel substantially.

Stats
Hull Mass: +20%
Hitpoints: +25%
Nanobot Repair Amount: +25%

852524.text:
"Castle" Composite Plating

Tungsten-lined plate armor, due to the high density, tensile strength, and thermal capacities of the metal, provides excellent protection from almost any conventional weapon. A thin tungsten layer underlies lighter base plate to obtain maximum protection for its weight, but the setup still burdens the ship to a significant degree and maintenance costs if damaged are significant.

Stats
Hull Mass: +30%
Hitpoints: +35%
Nanobot Repair Amount: +35%

852526.text:
"Stronghold" Reinforced Composite Plating

A massive plate armor setup composed of alloys of superheavy actinide metals such as uranium. Most traditional weapon fire merely scratches the paint on this plating, as the sheer density of the material simply does not budge under thermal or kinetic pressure from anything other than specialized armor-piercing munitions or incredibly overwhelming output. However, the hyperdense alloy will add nearly half the mass of the ship in most setups, which together with the cost of these specialized fabrications prevents its widespread use.

Stats
Hull Mass: +40%
Hitpoints: +45%
Nanobot Repair Amount: +45%

852528.text:
Universal Armor Upgrade Mk VI

Spaceship armor upgrade is an essential piece of equipment for anyone heading in distant dangerous areas of the Sirius sector. The Mk VI version of the upgrade takes advantage of special Ship Hull Panels that can withstand high pressure and all known radiation types. Multiplies base armor by 2.3; occupies 9 cargo space.

852530.text:
Universal Armor Upgrade Mk VII

Spaceship armor upgrade is an essential piece of equipment for anyone heading in distant dangerous areas of the Sirius sector. The Mk VII uses the best alloys on the market and newest hull reinforcement technologies while remaining cost-efficient. Multiplies base armor by 2.4; occupies 12 cargo space.

852532.text:
Projects energy beams to manipulate or retrieve objects in space. Uses a variation of the same technology that produces energy shields.

Using of this item is no longer allowed. Please get ID instead.

Range: 1500 m
Extend Speed: 1000 m/s

852533.text:
Scanner

Standard tomographic imaging device that employs magnetic, infrared, sonar, and gravitational sensors to produce a three-dimensional model of a target and then match that target to a database of known ships.

Range: 17500m
Cargo Scan Range: 2500m

852535.text:
Advanced Deep Scanner

The Advanced Deep Scanner was originally developed in Kusari for deep space reconnisance missions. While the range of this scanner is superior to the Deep Scanner, its cargo scanning distance was consequently reduced in half.

Range: 18000m
Cargo Scan Range: 2000m

852537.text:
Wiretap Scanner

Wiretap is the latest advancement in the area of remote sensing technology. Developed by The Order and their allies, most notably the Bundschuh and Blood Dragons, it was originally a prototype design of the Liberty Security Force known as "Project Discovery". The goal was to create a new scanner capable of strength equal to the Battleship Scanner, mountable on all vessels, in order to fight off the alien threat during the Nomad War. Due to most of Liberty's high-ranking officials falling prey to the Nomads mid-research, the project was abandoned. It is not known how the Order came to possess the prototype, though it is assumed to be a byproduct of espionage warfare for which they are famous. Characterized by combining the strengths of scanners available on the market in exchange for sacrificing a portion of the vessel's hold, after nearly three decades of research and struggle the Order and their allies saw the project through and thus revealed the new Wiretap scanner.

Range: 18000
Cargo Scan Range: 9500

852539.text:
Huegenot Engine

Stats

Cruise Speed: 500 m/s
Cruise Charge Time: 7s

852542.text:
AI Auxiliary Engine

A small auxiliary engine that can provide short bursts of speed, supplementing the drive core.

852544.text:
AI Graviton Shield

The AI Drone Shield uses an advanced form of energy pulses to deflect or disrupt incoming projectiles or energy based attacks. It is equally effective against all known weapon types.

852545.text:
Battleship Graviton Shield

This is a graviton-based shield that provides improved protection from laser and photon weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Battleship and Dreadnought class ships.

852547.text:
Cruiser Graviton Shield

This is a graviton-based shield that provides improved protection from laser and photon weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Destroyer and Cruiser class ships.

852549.text:
"Vanguard" Light Gunboat Graviton Shield

This graviton-based shield provides enhanced protection against laser and photon weapons for Gunboat class ships, without requiring additional reactor power.

852552.text:
Minified Spyglass Scanner

This newly-refined scanning system is a heavily modified variant of the Spyglass system originally developed by Liberty for an experimental electronic warfare battleship. A few prototypes of a compact variant of the scanner were produced by the Lane Hackers early on, while they were still operating their own Spyglass vessel, but the project was frozen when the far more efficient Spyglass Network Scanner was developed. Recently however, it was decided that there could be a market for a very powerful scanner without giving away the top secret Spyglass Network technology. The old compact Spyglass project was revived and updated with the Hackers' most modern technology, creating a system far superior to, but also vastly more expensive than conventional scanners, sold openly on the black and grey markets to those who can afford such a luxury.

Range: 18500m
Cargo Scan Range: 6000m

852560.text:
Cargo Pod

Large containers for carrying cargo. Can be mounted on transports and trains.

852562.text:
Spyglass Network Scanner

The Spyglass Network Scanner is a lightweight version of the Spyglass Scanner. It relies on The Lane Hackers' distributed network of data processing hubs instead of a ship's own capabilities to perform expensive computations of raw signal. It allows Lane Hackers to use the scanner on small ships that are unable to support the more powerful processing unit.

Range: 19000m
Cargo Scan Range: 4000m

852564.text:
The Liberty Navy is responsible for protecting the economic well-being of Liberty through military force, both within the boundaries of the colony and in the independent systems that border its territory.

This Liberty Military ID is used by Liberty Navy servicemembers, who:
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Coronado, Vespucci):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can enforce laws within Liberty.

852566.text:
Liberty Police, Inc. (LPI) is a private company that handles the policing of Liberty space to interdict the importation of contraband and to prevent attacks on civilian and commercial traffic.

This Liberty Corporate Police ID is used by employees of Liberty Police, Inc., who:
- Cannot use Battleships or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can enforce laws within Liberty.

852568.text:
The Bretonian Armed Forces, a veteran military bloodied by two wars, represents the first and last line of defence for the Kingdom of Bretonia.

This Bretonian Military ID is used by Bretonia Armed Forces servicemembers, who:
- Can attack Gallic and Kusari combat ships within the Taus.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Omega-7, Tau-23, Tau-29):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can enforce laws within Bretonia, Dublin, and Omega-3.

852570.text:
Officers in the Bretonia Police Authority are well-trained, well-armed, and widely considered to be a bastion of incorruptibility. They are also spread few and far between, depleted from conscription into two bloody wars and the ensuing criminal uprisings that followed.

This Bretonian Police ID is used by constables of the Bretonia Police Authority, who:
- Cannot use Battleships or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can enforce laws within Bretonia, Dublin, and Omega-3.

852572.text:
The Kusari Naval Forces are the highly organized and technologically advanced military elements of the Empire of Kusari. Despite being rooted in strict tradition and unflinching hierarchy, the KNF nevertheless continues to innovate due in no small part to the considerable advantages of Kusari industry.

This Kusari Military ID is used by Kusari Naval Forces servicemembers, who:
- Can attack Bretonian and Gallic combat ships within Taus.
- Can attack Rheinland combat ships within the Sigmas.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Tau-31):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can enforce laws within Kusari and Tohoku.

852574.text:
The Kusari State Police are the highly disclipined police force of Kusari, infamous for their distrust of foreigners. They settle disputes, protect civilians and hunt criminals within Kusari.

This Kusari Police ID is used by officers in the Kusari State Police, who:
- Cannot use Battleships or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can enforce laws within Kusari and Tohoku.

852576.text:
The Rheinland Military serves as both protector of the recently-reunified Federal Empire, and a symbol of the traditions they hope to return to.

This Rheinland Military ID is used by Rheinland Military servicemembers, who:
- Can attack GMG and Kusari combat ships within the Sigmas.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Omega-3, Zurich):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can enforce laws within Rheinland and Sigma-15.

852578.text:
The Rheinland Federal Police (RFP) are the federated police forces of Rheinland, providing security and law enforcement to their respective systems.

This Rheinland Police ID is used by officers of the Rheinland Federal Police, who:
- Cannot use Battleships, or any ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can enforce laws within Rheinland.

852580.text:
Samura is one of two Kusari megacorporations, with a focus on heavy industry and shipbuilding. A company rooted above all else in the tradition and history of the Kusari Empire, Samura goes to great lengths to maintain both their market share and their political standing, often employing the Hogosha syndicates to handle their dirty work from the shadows.

This Kusari Corporate ID is used by Samura Industries employees, who:
- Can attack Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums ships.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can attack competitors outside of Kusari.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Kusari.

Mining Bonuses: Helium-3 (3x), Niobium (3x), Platinum (3x)

852582.text:
Daumann Heavy Construction is the largest mining and manufacturing corporation in Rheinland. It has a partnership with Imperial Shipping and competes with other mining corporations operating through Rheinland. Daumann often uses mercenaries to attack competition and protect its interests.

This Rheinland Corporate ID is used by employees of Daumann Heavy Construction, who:
- Can demand Hessian Tears.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Omegas, Sigmas):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can attack competitors outside of Rheinland.
- Can demand Diamonds and Uncut Diamonds within Omega-11.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Rheinland.

Mining Bonuses: Aluminium (3x), Diamonds (3x), Silver (3x)

852584.text:
Kishiro Technologies is one of two Kusari megacorporations, best known for their developments in Optronics, optical computing systems that power the information superhighways of Sirius. Their work in FTL travel has also fostered a fierce rivalry with competing firms Ageira, DSE, and EFL.

This Kusari Corporate ID is used by Kishiro Technologies employees, who:
- Can attack Blood Dragons, Farmers Alliance, and Golden Chrysanthemums.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can attack competitors outside of Kusari.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Kusari.

Mining Bonuses: Aluminium (3x), Helium-3 (3x), Platinum (3x)

852586.text:
Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing (BMM) is one of the largest commercial concerns in Bretonia, a network of semi-autonomous operations that range throughout Bretonian space. Alongside Bowex, they form an industrial partnership and conglomerate that curries the lion's share of government contracts and favor.

This Bretonian Corporate ID is used by Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing employees, who:
- Can attack Mollys.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Omegas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can attack competitors outside of Bretonia.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Bretonia.
- Can demand Gold and Gold Ore within Dublin.

Mining Bonuses: Copper (3x), Gold (3x), Niobium (3x), Silver (3x)

852588.text:
Deep Space Engineering is a Libertonian heavy industry corporation, known for their close ties with Universal Shipping and Ageira Technologies. They are perhaps best known for building and maintaining the Ageira-designed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates found throughout Sirius.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by employees of Deep Space Engineering, who:
- Can attack Lane Hackers.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Vespucci):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can attack EFL and Kishiro ships outside of Liberty.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Liberty.

Mining Bonuses: Copper (3x), Platinum (3x)

852590.text:
The Border World Exports Shipping Company is a pioneer in the exploration of the Border Worlds, and the preferred supplier of the Bretonian government. The bulk of their contracts are the result of a direct partnership with Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing, providing shipping of their raw materials and finished goods at an extremely competitive rate.

This Bretonian Corporate ID is used by Border World Exports employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Omegas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can attack competitors outside of Bretonia.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Bretonia.

852592.text:
Imperial Shipping is the premier shipping corporation in Rheinland, responsible for the vast majority of all domestic cargo transport within the Empire's borders.

This Rheinland Corporate ID is used by employees of Imperial Shipping, who:
- Can attack Unioners.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Omegas, Sigmas, Zurich):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can attack competitors outside of Rheinland.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Rheinland.

852594.text:
Ageira Technologies, one of Liberty's "Big Three", is the Liberty corporation responsible for the development of Jump Gate and Trade Lane technologies. They partner with Universal Shipping and Deep Space Engineering.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by Ageira Technologies employees, who:
- Can demand Black Market Munitions and Ageira or Gallic Gate/Lane Parts.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Can attack Lane Hackers.
- Can treat any system containing a DSE Gate Construction Site as part of their ZOI.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within their Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Vespucci):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can attack competitors outside of Liberty.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Liberty.

852596.text:
Synth Foods is the Liberty firm responsible for the revolutionary food product Synth Paste, and a highly successful line of food-producing biodomes. The company maintains a close commercial relationship with many independent organizations who rely on Synth Foods biodomes to provide sustenance far from civilization.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by employees of Synth Foods, who:
- Can attack Farmers Alliance.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Rheinland, Sigmas, Shikoku):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can attack Samura and Hogosha ships outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852598.text:
Kruger Minerals is a Rheinland mining and materials corporation which focuses on expanding resource extraction operations in the border worlds, often coming into conflict with the GMG, IMG, and Hessians.

This Rheinland Corporate ID is used by employees of Kruger Minerals, who:
- Can attack Red Hessians.
- Can demand Hessian Tears.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Omegas, Sigmas):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can attack competitors outside of Rheinland.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Rheinland.

Mining Bonuses: Aluminium (3x), Diamonds (3x), Helium-3 (3x), Silver (3x)

852600.text:
Planetform Inc. specializes in the terraforming of non-viable planets in Bretonia and elsewhere. They are most often preyed upon by Gaians, who see Planetform and their terraforming operations as the ultimate ideological enemy to be conquered.

This Bretonian Corporate ID is used by Planetform employees, who:
- Can attack Gaians.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, California, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852602.text:
Interspace Commerce (IC), one of Liberty's "Big Three", is a banking and insurance corporation best described as the financial juggernaut responsible for the financing and insurance of many of the largest corporate and civilian undertakings in Sirius.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by employees of Interspace Commerce, who:
- Can attack Lane Hackers.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Systems containing a Sirius Trade Lane):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Interspace.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can demand credits from Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852604.text:
Universal Shipping, one of Liberty's "Big Three", specializes in the shipping of high-risk, high-value cargo, most notably Ageira's "white boxes" containing Trade Lane and Jump Gate parts which are shipped to DSE construction sites across Sirius.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by employees of Universal Shipping, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Vespucci):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can attack competitors outside of Liberty.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Liberty.

852606.text:
Cryer Pharmaceuticals is the Liberty bio-medical corporation that developed Stabiline, an expensive synthetic pharmaceutical that staves off the effects of Cardamine withdrawal. High demand for the drug, combined with the Outcasts' obvious desire to destroy it, have left Cryer facilities and personnel under constant threat.

This Liberty Corporate ID is used by Cryer Pharmaceuticals employees, who:
- Can attack Golden Chrysanthemums, Lane Hackers, Liberty Rogues, and Outcasts.
- Can demand Cardamine.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Sigmas and bordering Omicrons, Cambridge):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852608.text:
ALG Waste Disposal is an industrial company originating from Rheinland that specialises in the disposal and reprocessing of hazardous industrial waste.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by ALG Waste Disposal employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within their Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Omegas, Bretonia, Languedoc):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by ALG.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852610.text:
Orbital Spa and Cruise operates an array of resorts and luxury liners throughout the Sirius Sector. Headquartered on the idyllic resort planet Curacao, OS&C goes to great lengths to ensure that their customers receive the all-star experience they deserve.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by Orbital Spa and Cruise employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Cortez and bordering systems, Stuttgart and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by OS&C.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852612.text:
Gateway Shipping is a Bretonian firm that hauls raw materials across the Border and Independent Worlds, catering chiefly to smaller, independent companies. They are partnered with the IMG and ALG, forming a small but hearty alliance of independent corporations in the Omegas.

This Bretonian Corporate ID is used by Gateway Shipping employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Omegas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can attack competitors outside of Bretonia.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Bretonia.

852614.text:
Considered by many to be the largest criminal organization in Sirius, the Corsairs are a quasi-nation of raiders and pirates, targeting civilian and military targets with reckless abandon as they plunder the border worlds. They frequently clash with the Outcasts for territory in the Edge Worlds, while continuing a bloody battle with the Hessians and allies for the resource-rich Omegas.

This Independent Unlawful ID is used by Corsairs, who:
- Can attack any ship carrying Hessian Tears or Cardamine.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia, Kusari, Omegas, Omicrons, Rheinland, Sigmas, Dublin):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

Mining Bonuses: Gold (3x), Xeno Relics (3x)

852616.text:
The enigmatic Outcasts are the principal producers and suppliers of the drug Cardamine throughout the Sirius sector. While they routinely clash with their Corsair brethren over territory in the edge worlds, their primary goal is the sector-wide distribution of Cardamine.

This Independent Unlawful ID is used by Outcasts, who:
- Can attack any ship carrying Artifacts or Stabiline.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia, Kusari, Liberty, Omicrons, Sigmas, Taus, Coronado, Cortez, Galileo, Inverness, Kepler, Languedoc, Magellan, Ontario):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

Mining Bonuses: Niobium (3x), Xeno Relics (3x)

852618.text:
The Red Hessians are a large and well-organized pirate group in Rheinland who attack civilian and commercial targets of opportunity. Originally formed as a radical political movement fighting against harsh working practices, the average Hessian is nowadays more interested in simple piracy and theft.

This Rheinland Unlawful ID is used by Red Hessian pirates, who:
- Can attack ships carrying Artifacts.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland, Omegas and bordering systems, Cologne, Zurich):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

Mining Bonuses: Diamonds (3x)

852620.text:
The Blood Dragons are a terrorist organization supposedly descended from the royal guard of Shogun Hideyoshi -- deposed during a coup several centuries before -- and are dedicated to the overthrow of the current Kusari government, and the destruction of Samura Industries.

This Kusari Unlawful ID is used by members of the Blood Dragons, who:
- Can attack Samura, Hogosha, and Farmers Alliance.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852622.text:
The Junkers are a group of smugglers and black market traders who maintain a legal front through scrap peddling. They are remarkable for being one of the few organisations to preserve their neutrality in the war between Corsairs and Outcasts, regularly trading with both parties.

This Independent Quasilegal ID is used by Junkers, who:
- Can attack Hogosha and Xenos.
- Can engage in piracy.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

852624.text:
The Hogosha are a quasi-legal organization that ostensibly exists to promote the "welfare and prosperity of the Kusari people." With influential agents inside Samura, Kishiro, and even in the halls of Kusari government, the Hogosha syndicates are one of the strongest power blocs underpinning modern Kusari society.

This Kusari Quasilegal ID is used by members of the Hogosha, who:
- Can attack Junkers.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space, except for the Corsair Train.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas, Taus):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can enforce laws within Kusari.
- Can engage in piracy.

852626.text:
The Mollys are a Bretonian separatist group formed by former BMM employees committed to a Dublin free and independent of Bretonian rule. Their indiscriminate attacks against civilian and military traffic alike have left them branded terrorists by all major governments and corporations.

This Bretonian Unlawful ID is used by members of the Mollys, who:
- Can attack BMM.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

Mining Bonuses: Gold (3x)

852628.text:
The Xenos are a Libertonian isolationist terrorist organization opposed to any trade or relationship with foreign states.

This Liberty Unlawful ID is used by Xenos, who:
- Can attack Hogosha and Junkers.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Inverness, Shikoku, Vespucci):
- Can attack any ship, except Liberty Corporate ships.
- Can demand cargo.

852630.text:
The Bundschuh are a populist political organization declared an enemy of the state by the Rheinland government. A loosely organized confederation of dissident tendencies ranging from progressive to far-leftist, it has substantial support from Rheinland's underclasses and intelligensia alike.

This Rheinland Unlawful ID is used by members of the Bundschuh, who:
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Sigmas, Omega-3, Pennsylvania, Texas, Zurich):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852632.text:
The Gaians are a grassroots, radical group opposed to terraforming and uncontrolled industrialization. Their chief opponent and target is Planetform, especially in defense of the threatened Planet Gaia from which the movement draws its name.

This Bretonian Unlawful ID is used by members of the Gaians, who:
- Can attack Planetform, and treat systems containing a Planetform base as part of their ZOI.
- Can attack ships carrying Gaian Wildlife or Terraforming Gases.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space, other than the Corsair Train.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Taus, California, Inverness, Kansas, Vespucci):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852634.text:
The Lane Hackers are a criminal group in Liberty who focus on piracy of high-value targets. They prefer to attack Ageira, Universal, Interspace and DSE ships, or shipments of high-tech equipment, especially Trade Lane and Jump Gate components.

This Liberty Unlawful ID is used by Lane Hackers, who:
- Can engage in piracy against Ageira, Interspace, or any ships carrying Ageira Gate/Lane Parts.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Leeds, Manchester, Inverness, Shikoku, Vespucci):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852636.text:
The Unioners are an outlaw group chiefly comprised of former Rheinland shipyard workers, operating as smugglers and shipbuilders-for-hire on the border between Rheinland and Liberty.

This Rheinland Unlawful ID is used by Unioners, who:
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Texas, Zurich):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852638.text:
The Golden Chrysanthemums are a terrorist organization seeking to the overthrow the Kusari government and institute a matriarchy. To that end they have forged alliances with the Blood Dragons - who also wish to upend Kusarian society - and the Outcasts, who obviously oppose the Corsair influence in Kusari.

This Kusari Unlawful ID is used by members of the Golden Chrysanthemums, who:
- Can attack Samura.
- Can attack ships carrying Artifacts or Stabiline.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852640.text:
The LWB is a collection of radical farmers devoted to eradicating Synth Foods from Planet Stuttgart. The LWB previously fell apart to infighting, with survivors being absorbed by the Farmer's Alliance. The LWB has since violently broken away from the Alliance to assert their independence again.

This Rheinland Unlawful ID is used by members of the LWB, who:
- Can attack Synth Foods.
- Can attack ships carrying Agricultural Machinery, Biodome Materials, Fertilizers or Synth Paste.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Sigmas, Omegas):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852642.text:
The Farmers Alliance was originally a Kusari political organisation that lobbied for farmers rights, before turning to direct action against Synth Foods. Their overt attacks on foreign shipping and consolidation with the LWB have left them branded as terrorists, though they still enjoy unofficial financial support from their backers in Samura.

This Kusari-Rheinland Unlawful ID is used by members of the Farmers Alliance, who:
- Can attack Synth Foods.
- Can attack ships carrying Synth Paste or Biodome Materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Rheinland and bordering systems, Sigmas, Omegas):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852644.text:
The Liberty Rogues are a motley assortment of petty criminals who operate mainly in Liberty, attacking targets of opportunity and fencing illegal goods, namely Outcast cardamine.

This Liberty Unlawful ID is used by Liberty Rogues, who:
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Copernicus, Coronado, Inverness, Shikoku, Vespucci):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852646.text:
The Order is an organisation which has its roots in Liberty and now operates Sirius-wide to counter the threat posed by the Nomads. They oppose the smuggling of Artifacts and the proliferation of dangerous alien technologies. They are considered a terrorist faction by all major Houses, working from the shadows with their allies in the Bundschuh and Blood Dragons to protect humanity at any cost.

This Independent Intelligence ID is used by Order operatives, who:
- Can attack Combat Ships considered hostile by The Order.
- Can attack Intelligence ships, and ships using Alien equipment.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by The Order.
- Can demand Alien and Core equipment and materials.
- Can enforce laws within the Omicrons.

Inside House Space:
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships, except for the "Resheph" Recon Cruiser.
- "Resheph" Recon Cruisers can only engage Alien ships unless acting in self-defense.

Mining Bonuses: Azurite Gas (3x), Iridium (3x), Xeno Relics (3x)

852648.text:
The Gas Miners Guild (GMG) is a tight-knit professional organization that acts as the primary supplier of H-Fuel to the four major Houses of Sirius. The GMG is closely partnered with Kishiro Technologies, and secretly supports the Blood Dragons, Golden Chrysanthemums, Bundschuh, and the Order.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by Gas Miners Guild members, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Sigmas and bordering systems, Kusari and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by GMG.
- Can attack Rheinland combat ships outside of House Space.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.
- Can enforce laws within the Sigmas.

Mining Bonuses: Helium-3 (3x)

852650.text:
The Nomads are organic guardians left behind by an ancient alien civilization. Over thousands of years, Nomads evolved into well-organized beings, forming a civilization of their own - one that is extremely hostile to all save their former masters.

This Alien ID is used by Nomads, who:
- Can attack any ship to protect allied Alien ships.
- Cannot engage in piracy.
- Cannot leave their Zone of Influence except when alongside a ship carrying an Alien official faction ID, or while flying a Nomad Light Fighter.

Within Zone of Influence (Omicrons and bordering systems, Omegas, Taus, Sigmas, and systems containing an allied Alien base):
- Can attack any ship.

852652.text:
The Independent Miners Guild (IMG) is a loose confederation of miners who work in the undeveloped border worlds, staking claims and harvesting deposits far from the reach of the larger corporations. They often compete with House Corporations over their mineral claims in the border worlds.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by Independent Miners Guild members, who:
- Can attack any ship in defense of allied ships.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot dock Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships in House Space, except on IMG bases.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Taus, Omegas):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by the IMG.
- Can attack competitors outside of Bretonia.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Bretonia.

Mining Bonuses: Copper (3x), Diamonds (3x), Gold (3x), Niobium (3x), Silver (3x)

852654.text:
Zoners are a diverse group of individuals who, for their own reasons, have struck out to live in the untamed worlds beyond House control. Most Zoner communities are freeports, small yet vibrant markets on the edge of civilized space open to anyone, so long as they keep the peace.

This Independent Quasilegal ID is used by Zoners, who:
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Zoners outside House Space.
- Can enforce laws in systems containing a Zoner base.

Inside House Space:
- Cannot dock Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 3,600 cargo space, except in Pennsylvania.

852656.text:
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a well-established mercenary group with roots in the underclasses and ex-cons of Texas. Many of the Guild's best hunters are former pirates themselves, using the knowledge from their past life to hunt down those on the wrong side of the law.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by Bounty Hunters, who:
- Can attack any ship to protect Police, Military, or Corporate ships.
- Can attack Unlawful combat ships.
- Can attack any ship that is the target of a contract.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

852658.text:
Freelancers are people not affiliated with any faction in particular. They generally operate independent trade ships or snubcraft, taking the odd job here or there to pay for fuel and supplies.

This Generic ID is used by Freelancers, who:
- Can attack any ship that is the target of a contract.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 3,600 cargo space.

Mining Bonuses: Heavy Water (3x)

852660.text:
This ID is used by Discovery server administrators.

Please report cheating if this item is seen equipped on players not part of the Discovery staff team.

852662.text:
Neutral ID

Pilot carrying this ID has declared themselves to be lawful and Neutral towards all factions.

- Cannot be attacked by any other players except in Guard systems or by mutual agreement.
- Cannot join any faction, except factions that are Neutral themselves.

Allowed ships: Fighters, Freighters, Transports, Gunboats, Cruisers, Battleships.
This ID can only be given by an Admin and may not be transferred or replaced without Admin permission.

852664.text:
CD98Rc Reinforced Cruise Disruptor Missile Launcher

Reinforced Cruise Disruptor is a modification of Mosquito developed specially for capital class ships: Dreadnoughts, Battleships, Battlecruisers, Cruisers, Destroyers, and Gunboats. Increased durability of this weapon guarantees that it won't be ripped from hull after several enemy hits. Battleship CD requires significant amounts of energy to fire, and fighters cannot use it effectively.

*Requires Reinforced Cruise Disruptor Missile

852666.text:
CD98Rc Reinforced Cruise Disruptor Missile
Reinforced CD missile is a slightly modified Mosquito with improved reliability and range.

*Fired by Reinforced Cruise Disruptor

852668.text:
Battleship Molecular Shield

This is a molecular-based shield that provides improved protection from plasma and particle weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Battleship and Dreadnought class ships.

Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.

852670.text:
Battleship Positron Shield

This is a positron-based shield that provides improved protection from tachyon and neutron weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Battleship and Dreadnought class ships.

852672.text:
Cruiser Molecular Shield

This is a molecular-based shield that provides improved protection from plasma and particle weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Cruiser and Destroyer class ships.

Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.

852674.text:
Cruiser Positron Shield

This is a positron-based shield that provides improved protection from tachyon and neutron weapons. This shield is specifically designed for the Cruiser and Destroyer class ships.

852676.text:
"Redoubt" Light Gunboat Molecular Shield

This molecular-based shield provides enhanced protection against plasma and particle weapons for Gunboat class ships, without requiring additional reactor power.

Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.

852678.text:
"Sallet" Light Gunboat Positron Shield

This positron-based shield provides enhanced protection against tachyon and neutron weapons for Gunboat class ships, without requiring additional reactor power.

852680.text:
CG-6S "Pavise" Transport Graviton Shield

Designed for Transport ships, the C6S shield series takes its nickname from an ancient Earth infantry shield designed to cover the entire body, similar to how this energy shield wards the entire vessel. With a very minimal power draw, this shield can absorb more incoming fire than the regeneration-focussed "Kite", while not requiring the heavy power draw that plagues the "Tower". This is a graviton-based shield that provides improved protection from laser and photon weapons.

852682.text:
CG-4C "Kite" Transport Graviton Shield

A simple transport shield, the CG-4C "Kite" has lower damage capacity but is rapidly-regenerating. Often the first choice for civilian traders, this shield is a common piece of equipment in Sirius, and can even sometimes be found on cargo interdiction transports, when they want to draw energy from defensive systems and divert it to produce more firepower. This is a graviton-based shield that provides improved protection from laser and photon weapons.

852684.text:
CG-8A "Tower" Transport Graviton Shield

For situations where a transport could be alone or with very light escort through particularly nasty regions of space, the C8A "Tower" series of shields can be the difference between life and death. With nearly double the maximum absorption capacity of the CG-6S "Pavise", the CG-8A can take a serious beating and is optimized for larger transports with little firepower that otherwise can't make use of a full capacitor. This is a graviton-based shield that provides improved protection from laser and photon weapons.

852686.text:
CM-6S "Pavise" Transport Molecular Shield

Designed for Transport ships, the C6S shield series takes its nickname from an ancient Earth infantry shield designed to cover the entire body, similar to how this energy shield wards the entire vessel. With a very minimal power draw, this shield can absorb more incoming fire than the regeneration-focussed "Kite", while not requiring the heavy power draw that plagues the "Tower". This is a molecular-based shield that provides improved protection from plasma and particle weapons.

Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.

852688.text:
CP-6S "Pavise" Transport Positron Shield

Designed for Transport ships, the C6S shield series takes its nickname from an ancient Earth infantry shield designed to cover the entire body, similar to how this energy shield wards the entire vessel. With a very minimal power draw, this shield can absorb more incoming fire than the regeneration-focussed "Kite", while not requiring the heavy power draw that plagues the "Tower". This is a positron-based shield that provides improved protection from tachyon and neutron weapons.

852690.text:
CM-8A "Tower" Transport Molecular Shield

For situations where a transport could be alone or with very light escort through particularly nasty regions of space, the C8A "Tower" series of shields can be the difference between life and death. With nearly double the maximum absorption capacity of the CM-6S "Pavise", the CM-8A can take a serious beating and is optimized for larger transports with little firepower that otherwise can't make use of a full capacitor. This is a molecular-based shield that provides improved protection from plasma and particle weapons.

Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.

852692.text:
CP-8A "Tower" Transport Positron Shield

For situations where a transport could be alone or with very light escort through particularly nasty regions of space, the C8A "Tower" series of shields can be the difference between life and death. With nearly double the maximum absorption capacity of the CP-6S "Pavise", the CP-8A can take a serious beating and is optimized for larger transports with little firepower that otherwise can't make use of a full capacitor. This is a positron-based shield that provides improved protection from tachyon and neutron weapons.

852694.text:
Universal Ship Armor

Spaceship armor is an essential piece of equipment for anyone heading in distant dangerous areas of Sirius sector. The Mk VIII uses the best alloys on the market and the newest hull reinforcement technologies. Multiplying base hull by 2.5 and taking no cargo space, makes it standard issue for all new ships, and a mainstay of ships unable to mount heavier upgrades. It is possible to fly without ship armor, but not recommended.

852696.text:
Infinite Shield

The Infinite Shield may only be used on admin-approved ships that do not participate in roleplaying and are not part of any faction. Report cheating if you see this item in cargo hold or equipped on any other ship.

852698.text:
The Liberty Security Force (LSF) is the intelligence branch of the Liberty Armed Forces, operating in secrecy to ensure the free flow of goods and services in the Liberty economy. LSF agents are infamous for their broad authority and oversight over the rest of the Armed Forces.

This Liberty Intelligence ID is used by operatives of the Liberty Security Force (LSF), who:
- Can attack Combat Ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can attack Intelligence ships.
- Can demand Alien equipment and materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Liberty and bordering systems, Coronado, Vespucci):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Liberty.
- Can enforce laws within Liberty.

Outside Zone of Influence:
- Must only attack in self-defence while using Cruisers or Battlecruisers.

852700.text:
This ID is for the sole purpose of setting up a character with another ID, and the ship carrying this ID does not exist for the purposes of roleplay.

This Generic ID is used for setting up ships, and its holder:
- Cannot participate in server roleplay, trade, or engage in combat.

852702.text:
Independent Pirates are unaffiliated unlawfuls with little interest in sharing their profits. Usually regarded negatively by organized crime groups due to their unwillingness to share their illicit gains, some pirates manage to find a suitable arrangement with their more organised brethren.

This Generic ID is used by independent Pirates, who:
- Can engage in piracy against trade ships.
- Can engage in piracy against combat ships outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

852704.text:
Heavy Armor Upgrade Mk I

Armor upgrades specially developed for transports and light capital ships are cheaper and offer more protection than the universal upgrades of similar class, but occupy more cargo space. It is so cheap, that it comes as standard from most ship dealers. Multiplies base armor by 2.25; occupies 60 cargo space.

852706.text:
Heavy Armor Upgrade Mk II

Armor upgrades specially developed for transports and light capital ships are cheaper and offer more protection than the universal upgrades of similar class, but occupy more cargo space. The Mk II upgrade is mostly used on smaller transports, although some heavier bombers have been outfitted with it as well. At only a slight expense of cargo space this armor still protects a transport better than most universal armor could. Multiplies base armor by 2.5; occupies 120 cargo space.

852708.text:
Heavy Armor Upgrade Mk III

Armor upgrades specially developed for transports and light capital ships are cheaper and offer more protection than the universal upgrades of similar class, but occupy more cargo space. The Mk III upgrade offers you cheap, reliable protection, though it takes a little extra cargo space. Multiplies base armor by 3.0; occupies 170 cargo space.

852710.text:
Heavy Armor Upgrade Mk IV

Armor upgrades specially developed for transports and light capital ships are cheaper and offer more protection than the universal upgrades of similar class, but occupy more cargo space. The Mk IV upgrade is more or less the standard issue armor for many heavy transports and gunships built today. Great value for your credits. Multiplies base armor by 3.0; occupies 150 cargo space.

852712.text:
Capital Ship Armor Upgrade Mk V

Armor upgrades specially developed for capital ships offer a much higher degree of protection, but occupy much more cargo space. The Mk V upgrade utilizes standard procedures for extra hull durability. No further gains can be made without much more expensive modifications. Multiplies base armor by 3.8; occupies 190 cargo space.

852714.text:
Capital Ship Armor Upgrade Mk VI

Armor upgrades specially developed for capital ships offer a much higher degree of protection, but occupy much more cargo space. The Mk VI upgrade utilizes new technologies developed by specialised ship engineers. Due to latest production technology it offers great protection while production costs are minimized. Multiplies base armor by 4.0; occupies 300 cargo space.

852716.text:
Capital Ship Armor Upgrade Mk VII

Armor upgrades specially developed for capital ships offer a much higher degree of protection, but occupy much more cargo space. The Mk VII version was constructed by specialised ship engineers using top secret alloys. This upgrade is one of the best of its class, and one of the most expensive. Multiplies base armor by 4.0; occupies 250 cargo space.

852718.text:
Capital Ship Armor Upgrade Mk VIII

Armor upgrades specially developed for capital ships offer a much higher degree of protection, but occupy much more cargo space. The Mk VIII is the ultimate armor upgrade. The materials needed to construct armor of this type are extremely difficult to fabricate, making it the most expensive armor upgrade available. Multiplies base armor by 4.0; occupies 190 cargo space.

852720.text:
Mysterious and largely incomprehensible machines, the Gammu AI 'evolved' from automated interstellar probes sent as part of the Sleeper Ship program. Their technology, principles, and goals are almost indecipherable by outsiders, though they largely show no hostile inclination toward mankind.

This Alien ID is used by Artificial Intelligence, who:
- Can attack Core ships.
- Can attack any ship carrying AI equipment or materials.
- Cannot use Cruisers other than the AI Cruiser.
- Cannot use Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 3,600 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Omegas, Omicrons, Sigmas):
- Can attack any ship.

852722.text:
The Coalition as the Sirius Sector knows it sprang into life some time into the early 600s AS, formed by a motley band of ex-Corsairs, Rheinland dissidents and unaligned sympathizers. Claiming to be the descendants of Sol Coalition saboteurs that disabled the Hispania, they have managed to create a facsimile of their ancestors' home deep in the Omegas.

This Independent Military ID is used by Coalition pilots, who:
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Omegas and bordering systems, Bretonia, Dublin, Rheinland):
- Can attack combat ships considered hostile by the Coalition.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by the Coalition.
- Can enforce laws in Omega-52.

852724.text:
Products of Nomad influence and infestation, the so-called "Wild" are Nomad-controlled puppets, infiltrators, and saboteurs. Infiltration and subterfuge is their primary modus operandi, though they are known to engage in overt acts of terrorism in pursuance of the Nomads' inscrutable plans.

This Alien SRP ID is used by a Wild infectee, who:
- Can attack any ship.
- Can demand cargo.
- Cannot use Battleships.

852726.text:
Gunboat Thruster

While most transports have versatile equipment mounts, allowing their operators to choose between heavy-duty snubcraft thrusters or lighter capital ship thrusters as their budgets and operating conditions allow, gunboats have presented more of a challenge for engineers. This is not least of all due to their more advanced power-management and load-balancing requirements -- unlike a transport, a gunboat always has to be ready for action. In recent years, this particlar thruster has become widely available, catering to the high-performance needs of 'always-on' combat ships while still being economical to maintain.

852728.text:
The Nomads are organic guardians left behind by an ancient alien civilization. Over thousands of years, Nomads evolved into well-organized beings, forming a civilization of their own - one that is extremely hostile to all save their former masters.

This Alien official faction ID is used by the Slomon K'Hara, who:
- Can attack any ship.
- Cannot engage in piracy.

852730.text:
Countermeasure Flare

Developed by Ageira in their attempt to encroach on the ECM market, the basic "Countermeasure Flare" takes a specialized approach, prioritizing ammunition capacity and low reload time. With its reduced size and reliance on a combination of EMR technology and a spatial profile scanner, the Silencer is designed to provide users with a high-capacity option for countering homing weaponry, especially on snubcraft.

*Fired by Countermeasure Dropper

852732.text:
AGCM-15 Countermeasure Dropper

Developed by Ageira in their attempt to encroach on the ECM market, the basic "Countermeasure Flare" takes a specialized approach, prioritizing ammunition capacity and low reload time. With its reduced size and reliance on a combination of EMR technology and a spatial profile scanner, the Silencer is designed to provide users with a high-capacity option for countering homing weaponry, especially on snubcraft.

*Requires Countermeasure Flare

852733.text:
Armored Thruster

This is a modified version of the ordinary Thruster, sporting vastly more expensive armor plating that allows it to withstand all but the most destructive explosions.

852735.text:
Cheetah Thruster

The Cheetah Thruster is the most efficient thruster available on Sirius market today. Cheetah utilizes very expensive superconductor components, therefore its price is much higher than price of any other thruster, and even higher than price of most ships it can be installed on.

852737.text:
Cargo Scanner

The Cargo Scanner is a modified version of the basic Scanner with an improved cargo scanning module. Its cargo scanning range is superior to its more expensive counterparts, but general scanning range is relatively short.

Range: 16000m
Cargo Scan Range: 7500m

852738.text:
Deep Scanner

A new version of the standard scanner that has become available about 15 years ago, the Deep Scanner not only provides basic information about a target, but also uses proprietary sensor technology and AI heuristics to analyze any cargo that may be present.

Range: 17000m
Cargo Scan Range: 4000m

852740.text:
Improved Cargo Scanner

The Improved Cargo Scanner features an extended cargo analysis subsystem capable of scanning ship cargo bays up to three kilometers away. This well-balanced scanner also offers good general scan range.

Range: ----
Cargo Scan Range: ----

852742.text:
Advanced Cargo Scanner

The Advanced Cargo Scanner is the best cargo scanner available on the market today. Superior scanning ranges and poweful cargo analyser make it an excellent choice both for military pilots and freelancers.

Range: 15500m
Cargo Scan Range: 9500m

852744.text:
Jintsuriki Scanner

Developed by Kishiro, the Jintsuriki is a technological showcase of what might become the scanner of the future. An array of nanofilaments forms the receptor, pushing its detecting range out to distances previously only achieved by much larger capital vessel systems, although cargo scanning range is compromised. The scanner's astronomical price prevents its use in conventional police, military or commercial applications, but Kishiro has found a stable market among well-funded researchers and wealthy tech freaks looking for bragging rights, as well as a rumored small number of purchases by intelligence agencies.

Range: 19000m
Cargo Scan Range: 4000m

852746.text:
Battleship Scanner

The Battleship Scanner requires vast amounts of energy to operate and is often installed in the largest military ships. It provides the best detection performance and range of all scanners in Sirius.

Range: 19000m
Cargo Scan Range: 9500m

852748.text:
Smugglers are traders who deal in illicit goods or illegally cross embargo lines. The occupation is a dangerous one, as they may find themselves targets of both law enforcement and pirates, but the demand for drugs, weaponry, or exotic alien materials promises great rewards to the daredevil pilots who are willing to take the risks.

This Generic ID is used by Smugglers, who:
- Can only use Freighters and Transports.
- Can only haul the following illicit commodities: Artifacts, Black Market Munitions, Black Market Augments, Black Market Pharmaceuticals, Counterfeit Computerware, Cardamine, Cardamine Cartridges, Gaian Wildlife, Hessian Tears, Low-Grade Artifacts, Nomad Materials, Nox, and Xeno Relics.

852750.text:
Researchers embody the curiosity, hope, determination, and boldness of mankind. However, their intentions may sometimes vary from the pure to the self-serving.

This Independent Quasilegal ID is used by researchers, who:
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 3,600 cargo space.

852752.text:
Special Operative:

The owner of this ID must follow the written restrictions of the Special Roleplay Request made in order to obtain this ID, and may not act outside the boundaries specified in their request. Pilot carrying this ID is associated with the faction they display as their IFF.

Allowed ships: Fighters, Freighters, Transports, Gunboats, Cruisers, Battleships
This ID can only be given by an Admin and may not be transferred or replaced without Admin permission.

852754.text:
Bretonian Privateer ID

The Privateers are a group of mercenaries and pirates who engage in piracy and raiding of houses or factions Bretonia considers hostile. They are secretly supplied and sanctioned by Bretonia, and may not commit unlawful acts inside Bretonia or against Bretonian corporations or Bretonian allies.

Pilot carrying this unlawful ID is a Bretonian Privateer, who :

- Can attack any ship in self-defense or to protect an allied ship.
- Can attack any ships within their Zone of Influence, except transports. Ships belonging to Bretonian corporations or allies of Bretonia are exempted from this.
- Can demand cargo and credits from any ship within their Zone of Influence, and attack them if they do not comply. Ships belonging to Bretonian corporations or allies of Bretonia are exempted from this.
- Cannot ally with anyone except with Bretonian lawfuls, Golden Chrysanthemums, Outcasts, Council and Maquis.
- Cannot use any transports with more than 4,300 cargo.

Zone of Influence: Bretonia, systems directly bordering Bretonia, Taus, Omegas, Gallic Borderworlds
Allowed ships: Fighters, Freighters, Transports, Gunboats

852757.text:
The Kusari Office of Intelligence operates as an independent bureau of the Empire, performing clandestine operations in regions predominantly beyond the reach of the Naval Forces.

This Kusari Intelligence ID is used by operatives in the Kusari Office of Intelligence, who:
- Can attack combat ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can attack Bretonian and Gallic combat ships within the Taus.
- Can attack Rheinland combat ships within the Sigmas.
- Can attack Intelligence ships.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can demand Alien equipment and materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Kusari and bordering systems, Sigmas):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Kusari.
- Can enforce laws within Kusari and Tohoku.

Outside Zone of Influence and the Taus:
- Must only attack in self-defence while using Cruisers or Battlecruisers.

852758.text:
The Marinenachrichtendienst (MND) is the intelligence agency of Rheinland, formed after the Colony Wars with the explicit mandate of investigating the Rheinland Military. While their purview has broadened to general national security since, their relationship with the military has never improved.

This Rheinland Intelligence ID is used by operatives of the Marinenachrichtendienst, who:
- Can attack combat ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can attack GMG and Kusari combat ships within the Sigmas.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can attack Intelligence ships.
- Can demand Alien equipment and materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Rheinland and bordering systems, Zurich):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Rheinland.
- Can enforce laws within Rheinland and Cologne.

Outside Zone of Influence:
- Must only attack in self-defence while using Cruisers or Battlecruisers.

852760.text:
The Technocracy is an illusive organisation aiming to create an open, transhuman society. They have adopted covert techniques and controversial methods, making deals where they can to ensure their survival - even with aliens, if the rumors are to be believed.

This Independent Intelligence ID is used by technocrats of the Technocracy, who:
- Can attack Core and Intelligence ships.
- Can demand Alien materials and Cardamine.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia, Liberty and bordering systems, Coronado, Inverness, Vespucci, Omegas, Omicrons):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by the Technocracy.

Mining Bonuses: Azurite Gas (3x), Xeno Relics (3x)

852762.text:
Militants are Zoner pilots who have taken up arms to protect other Zoners from the encroaching influence of foreign militaries and savage pirates, or those who have refused to accept compromises over past grievances and instead seek their own form of revenge.

This Independent Unlawful ID is used by Zoner Militants, who:
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Liberty and bordering systems):
- Can attack combat ships.
- Can engage in piracy.

852764.text:
The Core is a private military company operating mainly within the Edge Worlds. They relentlessly search for Alien Artifacts and technology that can be exploited and sold to wealthy and powerful benefactors in the Houses.

This Independent Corporate ID is used by Core pilots, who:
- Can attack any ship to protect allies.
- Can attack Alien, Order, and Technocracy ships, and ships carrying Alien, Order, or Technocracy materials.
- Cannot use any ship with more than 4,300 cargo.

Within Zone of Influence (Omicrons and bordering systems, Omegas):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by The Core.
- Can enforce Core laws within the Omicrons.

Mining Bonuses: Azurite Gas (3x), Iridium (3x), Xeno Relics (3x)

852766.text:
Gallic National Intelligence (GNI) is Gallia's newly formed intelligence department, decoupled from the Navy and given carte blanche to investigate and pursue matters relating to counter-terrorism and national security.

This Gallic Intelligence ID is used by operatives in Gallic National Intelligence, who:
- Can attack combat ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can attack Intelligence ships.
- Can demand Alien equipment and materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus, Cologne):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can enforce laws within Gallia.
- Can attack Bretonian, Crayter Republic, and Kusari combat ships within the Taus.

Outside Zone of Influence:
- Must only attack in self-defence while using Cruisers or Battlecruisers.

852768.text:
The Gendarmerie is the military police authority of Gallia, operating under the direct supervision of the Navy. They settle disputes, protect civilians, and hunt criminals within Gallia.

This Gallic Military Police ID is used by gendarmes of the Gendarmerie, who:
- Cannot use Battleships or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can enforce laws within Gallia.

852770.text:
The Gallic Navy represents the bulk of Gallia's remaining military and police forces, organised under one banner. The eclectic mix of former Royalists and Council members now serving together in many ways represents the shaky and awkward political landscape of the newly unified Gallic state.

This Gallic Military ID is used by Gallic Navy servicemembers, who:
- Can attack Bretonian and Kusari combat ships in the Taus.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Cologne, Tau-29, Tau-31):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can enforce laws in Gallia.

852772.text:
The Gallic Metal Service is a Gallic megacorporation focusing on mining and manufacturing. They currently hold a near-total monopoly on the Gallic mining industry, from planetside excavation to deep space prospecting, as well as an ever-growing share of domestic shipping, directly cutting into IDF's market share.

This Gallic Corporate ID is used by Gallic Metal Service employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus, Cologne):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can attack competitors outside of Gallia.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of Gallia.

Mining Bonuses: Molybdenum (3x), Niobium (3x)

852774.text:
EFL Oil and Machinery is a Gallic industrial corporation which focuses on fuel production, heavy industry and shipbuilding. They are the principal architects of Gallia's Trade Lane and Jump Gate network, and are now focused on exporting those services to Sirius.

This Gallic Corporate ID is used by EFL Oil and Machinery employees, who:
- Can demand Gallic and Ageira Gate / Lane parts.
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus, Rheinland and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

852776.text:
Ile-de-France Shipping (IDF) is the premier Gallic shipping corporation, at one time responsible for the vast majority of shipping within the Kingdom. With the monarchy's collapse and introduction of foreign trade, IDF has struggled to adapt, all while being targeted by anti-royalist politicians who consider them complicit in the former government's crimes.

This Gallic Corporate ID is used by IDF Shipping employees, who:
- Can engage in piracy against competitors outside of House Space.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus, Rheinland and bordering systems):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Gallia.
- Can attack competitors outside of House Space.
- Can engage in piracy against Corporate ships outside of House Space.

This Gallic Unlawful ID is used by Maquisards, who:
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus):
- Can attack any ship.
- Can demand cargo.

852780.text:
The Unione Corse is an organised criminal syndicate which focuses on smuggling, black market trade, and mercenary work in Gallia. Despite their rumored links to the Nox trade and the Gallic criminal underground, the Unione Corse nevertheless remains a legal organization.

This Gallic Quasilegal ID is used by members of the Unione Corse, who:
- Can attack any ship that is the target of a contract.
- Cannot use Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus):
- Can engage in piracy.
- Can enforce laws within Provence.

This Gallic Unlawful ID is used by Gallic Brigands, who:

Within Zone of Influence (Gallia and bordering systems, Taus and bordering systems, Cologne):

- Can engage in piracy.

852784.text:

This Bretonian Intelligence ID is used by Bretonian Intelligence Service operatives, who:
- Can attack combat ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can engage in piracy against ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can attack Gallic and Kusari combat ships within the Taus.
- Can attack Intelligence ships.
- Can demand Alien equipment and materials.
- Cannot use Battleships, or ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Bretonia and bordering systems, Omegas, Inverness):
- Can attack ships considered hostile by Bretonia.
- Can enforce laws within Bretonia, Dublin, and Omega-3.

Outside Zone of Influence and the Taus:
- Must only attack in self-defence while using Cruisers or Battlecruisers.

852785.text:
The Crayter Republic was formed from the remains of an experimental sleeper ship program, launched prior to the Alliance-Coalition War. Forced to abandon their initially colonized worlds due to a natural disaster, the Crayterians evacuated in a ragtag fleet that eventually arrived in Sirius.

This Independent Military ID used by Crayter Republic pilots, who:
- Can attack Gallic Royalists and Outcasts.
- Cannot use ships with more than 4,300 cargo space.

Within Zone of Influence (Coronado and bordering systems, Taus and bordering systems, Magellan):
- Can attack any ship considered hostile by Crayter.
- Can enforce laws within Coronado and the Taus.

Outside Zone of Influence:
- May only attack in self-defense while using Cruisers, Battlecruisers, or Battleships.

852788.text:
Nomad Lesser Veil

Recently re-opened studies from high ranking Order scientists have shown that the Veils around the Nomad ships act as shields, protecting them from incoming gun and projectile fire alike. The Nomad ships can create lattices of semi-sentient micro-organisms around their ships at their own discretion which will take the damage otherwise inflicted on the Nomad ship. This version of the Veil is mostly seen on the weaker and smaller craft and uses the fewest Micro-organisms of all the veils to protect the Nomad husk.

852790.text:
Nomad Greater Veil

Recently re-opened studies from high ranking Order scientists have shown that the Veils around the Nomad ships act as shields, protecting them from incoming gun and projectile fire alike. The Nomad ships can create lattices of semi-sentient micro-organisms around their ships at their own discretion which will take the damage otherwise inflicted on the Nomad ship. This version of the Veil is the most generic type. Commonly seen on gunboats and cruisers, the Greater Veil carries an increased amount of protective micro-organisms and is adept at protecting the Nomad ships against a great deal of firepower.

852792.text:
Nomad Superior Veil

Recently re-opened studies from high ranking Order scientists have shown that the Veils around the Nomad ships act as shields, protecting them from incoming gun and projectile fire alike. The Nomad ships can create lattices of semi-sentient micro-organisms around their ships at their own discretion which will take the damage otherwise inflicted on the Nomad ship. This version of the Nomad Veil shows to be the toughest of all the veils. Making use of a massive swarm of protective micro-organisms, the Superior veil can take the biggest amount of firepower.

852794.text:
Nomad Superior Veil

Recently re-opened studies from high ranking Order scientists have shown that the Veils around the Nomad ships act as shields, protecting them from incoming gun and projectile fire alike. This version of the Nomad Veil is found only on very large Nomad specimens. Using a massive swarm of protective micro-organisms, the Superior veil can take a huge amount of firepower.

*Requires Cloaking Device Batteries

852810.text:

852818.text:
Hyperspace Survey Module Mk I

The Hyperspace Survey Module measures the hyperspace coordinates for a point in Einsteinian space. The Mk I module is the smallest module available and takes the longest to complete a survey. The ship must not move during a survey or the survey must be restarted. Hyperspace coordinates surveyed by this module remain accurate for approximately 7 days.

Like the Hyperspace Jump Drive Module this module has an integated multi-mode fusion power plant that can run on a variety of fuels although MOX is considered the most efficient.

852820.text:
Hyperspace Survey Module Mk II

The Hyperspace Survey Module measures the hyperspace coordinates for a point in Einsteinian space. The Mk II module can only be mounted by large transport ships. The ship must not move during a survey or the survey must be restarted. Hyperspace coordinates surveyed by this module remain accurate for approximately 30 days.

Like the Hyperspace Jump Drive Module this module has an integated multi-mode fusion power plant that can run on a variety of fuels although MOX is considered the most efficient.

This docking module may be fitted to any ship with sufficient hold capacity.

CNO-U Gunboat Engine

The CNO-U series, unlike the other CNO-based propulsion systems, is primarily focused on maneuverability and acceleration at the cost of durability and fuel consumption. Such an engine was built to complement the agile Corsican 'Noir' shipline, placing it against the traditional Gallic engines that are fuel-efficient, but this added cost is of little concern to Corsican operators. Similar in design to other CNO-based engines, they are manufactured in Gallia and use Promethene as a catalyst to fuse petroleum. 852910.text:
DF-S Engine Type 1a

Like most of the technology used by the Blood Dragons, the DF series of ship propulsion systems are based on centuries-old early Imperial Kusari designs. Having been blessed with an abundance of fuel, early Kusari systems were focused more on power than efficiency. The Dragons stuck with this formula, refining the DF series to grind the absolute maximum performance out of a dated design and keep maintenance simple rather than follow newer trends. The Dragons' modern engines are easily competitive with modern designs in terms of performance, though they do lack efficiency. This type is designed for Light Fighters.

Battleship Molecular Shield

853108.text:
Nomad Superlative Veil

Recently re-opened studies from high ranking Order scientists have shown that the Veils around the Nomad ships act as shields, protecting them from incoming gun and projectile fire alike. The Nomad ships can create lattices of semi-sentient micro-organisms around their ships at their own discretion which will take the damage otherwise inflicted on the Nomad ship. This version of the Nomad Veil shows to be the toughest of all the veils. Making use of a massive swarm of protective micro-organisms, the Superlative veil can take the incredible amounts of firepower.

853132.text:
Lesser Paradox Cyst

Recently opened studies by the Core and the Order discovered a certain tribe of Nomad native to the Omicron Lost system seemingly capable of mobile hyperspace travel. While the exact extent of this ability is unknown, it has been linked to an asymmetrical cyst on the front of the affected Nomad ships. Observers sent by the Core have reported smaller Nomad ships repeatedly blinking in and out of the system in regular intervals, suggesting that the ability to traverse hyperspace comes effortlessly and is very much used in a planned and orderly manner by these Nomads. Those who have been observed performing these travels have, upon death, left a small, hard object roughly the size of a pearl in their wake, which is believed to be produced as a byproduct of the Nomadic way of hyperspace travel.

The effectiveness varies greatly depending on the size of the Nomad and its health. This cyst has repeatedly been sighted only on Nomads the size of human gunships and, while allowing the Nomad an incredible amount of mobility, seems to be unable to affect any nearby ships.

Properties
Compatible Ship Classes: Gunboats
Maximum Jump Range: 2
Charge Time: 30 Seconds
Jumphole Lifetime: 15 Seconds
Jumphole Traffic Limit: 1 Ship

Fuel Consumption Rates
Any Jump: 480 Batteries

Greater Paradox Cyst
