Rheinland authorities have already detained six of the assailants for the brutal crime. Gallic Union officials have issued revised guidance for transport crews in Rheinland, recommending Gallic citizens travelling abroad acquire Union personal permits for Enfer Blasters. “This will enable you to defend yourself against the foreign assassins of Bretonia and Kusari,” noted Wildau Cultural Attache Nicolas Jetté.

918861.text: [835 AS] New gang sets up shop on Ithaca

918862.text: ITHACA -- 835 -- There’s a new Bretonian gang on Ithaca, calling themselves the Privateers. Those of you who had Tau business back in the day might recognize the name -- they were the cutthroats who went after Kusari and Gallic transports at the Queen’s behest. After the war, Bretonia got cold feet about their feral mutts, and tried to muzzle them. Many ended up on Newgate, while others went to ground and turned full pirate. Henry King has paid tribute to the Captains Council on the Privateers’ behalf, and promised to keep the peace. “We ain’t here to step on toes, just got some business in Rheinland,” he says.

918863.text: [835 AS] Earhart probes discover Kusari secrets

918864.text: EARHART -- 835 -- Liberty’s drone mapping program continues to reveal more details about the Earhart sector. Programmed to attempt a return to Sirius by locking onto Jump Hole signatures, these probes have a 14 percent successful return rate. LSF retrieval teams are tasked with collecting returned devices from wherever they reappear. Probe AED325 shocked analysts by revealing a Kusari battlecruiser equipped with what is believed to be prototype Jump Drive technology. If so, this confirms suspicions on the state of Kusari’s program. The President has been briefed on options for securing and retrieving this evidence.

918866.text: KEPLER -- 835 -- Upon arrival at the Niyodo wreck site, Kusari guard probes were alerted and escaped through a nearby Jump Hole. Soon after, our fears were confirmed when a hostile Kusari taskforce entered the operational area via a functional Jump Drive. While the Niyodo drive core was successfully extracted under fire, exit through a nearby Jump Hole placed the expedition in Kepler. The Kusari force was destroyed, however most LSF ships were lost. Lane Hackers took the opportunity to attack the survivors, hijacking the Argonaut and its payload. We do not believe they know what they have stolen -- retrieving it is of critical importance.

918868.text: KEPLER -- 835 -- While planning for the Niyodo’s retrieval was underway, a passive guard probe returned to Sirius and broadcast an alert of approaching Liberty forces. The Battlecruiser Misawa generated an emergency breach to Yomi, dispatching the Chochinbi, and other on-hand KOI elements. The Liberty group was intercepted while retreating from the Niyodo, carrying a salvaged component aboard a Heavy Lifter. Available forces pursued the retreating convoy, which blindly exited through a Jump Hole leading to Kepler. Surviving units were forced to retreat from the resulting combat. We must assume the Niyodo’s drive core has fallen into foreign hands.

918870.text: AMES RESEARCH STATION -- 835 -- Ames Research Station has been thrown into chaos after a battle erupted nearby. Barbara Kaestner of the rescue ship Sunnyvale noted, “transponderless ships appeared from no-where and started blasting one another. Then the Lane Hackers joined in too!” The survivors seem to have grabbed their own pilots and beat a hasty retreat into the dark matter storm. Ames suffered light damage to its port wing during the commotion, with the station crew urgently requesting replacement materials to patch the compromised radiation shield. Who was responsible and why remains a mystery.

918872.text: COCHRANE -- 835 -- Cochrane is abuzz after the heist of the century. Lane Hackers launching from Leiden first noticed a spike in encrypted comms bouncing off the Ames relay network. Checking in on Kepler, they, discovered absolute mayhem. “Liberty and Kusari ships fighting, dying,” noted the squadron lead. “Obviously LSF and KOI, but they had their transponders off.” The spooks were scrapping over a heavy lifter carrying a radioactive ship component. Not one to shy from destiny, the Gatebreakers overrode the “Argonaut” remote link and made off with it, bringing the loot back to Cochrane drydock.

918874.text: GALILEO -- 835 -- Following an unspecified “security incident” in the Independent Worlds, military forces in Colorado and Shikoku have been ordered to high alert. Observers have raised alarms as the Liberty Navy and Kusari Naval Forces surge to their respective borders, warning of a heightened risk of “accidental escalation” in Galileo. Despite urgent calls for information from local system representatives, the governments of Kusari and Liberty remain tight lipped, other than confirming Manhattan and New Tokyo were in “active dialogue”. Both Houses have since put traffic controls in place, and are actively stopping and searching shipping entering their mutual borders.

918876.text: NEWCASTLE -- 835 AS -- Newcastle’s criminal underworld waits with bated breath, following the disappearance of Outcast Arnold De Angelis, son of Don Liviano De Angelis. The enraged cartels have dispatched a squad of their elite assassins, who have resolved to uncover the fate of the missing son and mete out retribution -- whatever the cost. While a hundred thousand credit bounty for information has been offered, Dardi Squadron also promises to leave a trail of corpses in their wake. The presence of some of Sirius’s deadliest killers has already led to unease among Newcastle’s Gaians, Mollys and Bounty Hunters.

918877.text: [831 AS] Cartels clash on Xeno issue

918878.text: MALTA -- 831 -- The Council of Dons have summoned Liviano De Angelis to answer for his family’s dealings with Liberty’s Xenos. Don Benitez sharply chastised the arrangement, arguing it undermined the Council’s decision to punish the Xenos for their earlier actions. Giving an impassioned speech before the Dons, De Angelis argued that there were already signs of growing Cardamine addiction within Xeno ranks, projecting they would be fully under Outcast control within a decade. In a humiliating setback for Don Benitez, De Angelis’ argument swayed the Council, with a vote narrowly ratifying his approach.

918879.text: [831 AS] Caught in their own trap?

918880.text: BARRIER GATE -- 831 -- Word is the Xenos have a Cardamine problem. Recruiting from the bottom of Liberty society, most Xenos lived in poverty and decided to lash out. Now they’ve got a foot in the door with the Cardamine trade and their leaders are having issues keeping the grunts out of the goods, after that first taste of luxury. Witnesses report one such incident aboard Barrier Gate, after a Xeno executed a green wingman who’d used the product he was supposed to be shipping. Even if you’re only in the trade for business, the GC and Rogues can tell you there’s always a catch in the contract.

918881.text: [835 AS] KOI warn of imminent Order threat

918882.text: BATTLESHIP HAKODATE -- 835 -- KOI intelligence indicates that Order and Blood Dragon terrorists are preparing for a third strike against Kusari positions in Tohoku. Their previous assault aimed to disrupt experimental work at the Ichigaya Drydocks, with indications that the next will be an attempt to “finish the job”. Following a persuasive briefing by Chochinbi operatives, Lord Tazuka has authorised a punitive expedition into Omicron Mu, executed by the Battleship Hakodate. Intelligence from the Omicrons indicates that the Core is preparing for their own assault against Order positions -- KOI officers agree timing our own strike to align ensures the greatest chance of success.

918884.text: ICHIGAYA DRYDOCK -- 835 -- The expedition into Omicron Mu, intended to root out Order terrorists, has failed -- achieving only limited objectives. Disastrously, the Battleship Hakodate has been lost following the intervention of Blood Dragon bombers, critically compromising Kusari’s Omicron defensive screen. Disproportionate casualties were inflicted on terrorist forces, however key shipyard facilities were only minimally damaged. KOI commanders have blamed the failure on “disgraceful” KNF combat performance, while the KNF assert the true fault lies with “profound” KOI intelligence lapses that failed to anticipate the scale of resistance. The Shogun has convened a military tribunal to investigate.

918886.text: CAPETOWN -- 835 -- In a stunning display of product effectiveness, the Core has routed Order forces in Omicron Zeta, pushing them back to the Yap Asteroid Field. This field trial of our Core Autonomous Patrollers and the Hesione-model Persona-Integrated Battlefield Suite has already generated significant market interest among Rheinland observers. The Battleship Mars masterfully directed CAP drones in swarms that autonomously isolated then overwhelmed hostile vessels. While these units were significantly depleted by the fighting, the minimal losses to human personnel demonstrates obvious utility to law enforcement authorities.

918887.text: [835 AS] Zeta fleet withdraws to Capetown

918888.text: CAPETOWN -- 835 -- On the cusp of victory against The Order, Core forces were thrown into disarray by a malfunction aboard the Battleship Mars. The Hesione-model Persona-Integrated Battlefield Suite suffered a critical alignment failure, and turned on its operators. Core Autonomous Patrollers were similarly affected, with many local Drones also exhibiting hostility. Despite the best efforts of Core pilots and unaffected Drones, the Mars successfully engaged its cloaking devices and fled into the Pohnpei Nebula. Temporarily abandoning the Cairo offensive, Core forces will reconstitute and launch a dragnet to locate and subdue the Mars.

918890.text: CARTHAGE -- 835 -- The Order has come under near-simultaneous attack on two fronts. The Core launched a large-scale assault in Omicron Zeta, while Kusari vessels attacked Omicron Mu from Tohoku. Akabat has ordered defenders to stop the Kusari fleet at all costs. Cairo Base in Omicron Zeta has been instructed to fight a delaying action, allowing much of its garrison to be redeployed to defeat the primary threat in detail. A call for aid has also been issued to the Blood Dragons of Ryukyu Base. The Battleship Hakodate is currently pushing towards the Carthage Capital Yards -- if Carthage falls, our mission will be critically jeopardized.

918892.text: AKABAT -- 835 -- The Kusari invasion of Omicron Mu has been repulsed, after Order and Blood Dragon forces succeeded in destroying the Battleship Hakodate. The effort inflicted heavy casualties, with urgent rescue and recovery missions ongoing to identify survivors. Carthage has survived, suffering superficial damage from Chochinbi strikes. The situation in Omicron Zeta has proven to be untenable, however the Core offensive has stalled within the Yap Asteroid Field after large-scale infighting broke out across their fleet. Combat-ready survivors of the Mu theater are preparing to redeploy in an attempt to relieve Cairo Base.

918893.text: [835 AS] Delta under siege as Zeta falls

918894.text: ZETA -- Following recent clashes in Omicron Zeta, both the Core and Order were left bloodied and reeling. This appears to have been the opportunity the Nomads were waiting for, as a tide of alien vessels poured from the Pohnpei Nebula. Given the scale of the threat bearing down, both groups abandoned their outposts and retreated. Many were killed fighting to buy time for evacuation efforts, with the withdrawal largely succeeding thanks to the support of a rescue flotilla from Freeport 11. The Zoners came to the aid of both parties, arguing that the Nomad threat eclipsed any human dispute. Nomad ships have now begun to pour into Omicron Delta, intensifying raids on human stations.

918895.text: [835 AS] Atacama requests assistance against raiders

918896.text: ATACAMA -- 835 -- In recent months, Gaian salvagers working around Planet Veracruz have come under attack by unknown vessels. Over this period, many pilots have been killed, captured or simply vanished. These attacks have continued to escalate, with reports of unmarked Liberty and pirate vessels launching raids on Atacama itself. After the local cell issued a distress call, Islay dispatched the Destroyer Artemis to investigate and provide support. She is expected to arrive shortly; in the meantime, Atacama’s wings are restricting non-essential deployments, and travelling in force when necessary.

918898.text: DURBAN -- In the chaos following the Battle of Zeta, Durban Station suffered numerous network intrusions using the access credentials of Commander Atlas Brown. Forensic reconstruction indicates that no lasting damage has been done, however significant quantities of data were extracted on Artifact research and cataloging. Commander Brown is assumed dead following the loss of the Battleship Mars -- measures have already been implemented to prevent further attacks, and address technical deficiencies exploited by the AI Hesione. A sudden uptick of AI activity has also been detected across Omega-55 and Omicron Pi, with fireteams on Planet Gammu reporting intense tectonic tremors.

918900.text: NEW TOKYO -- 835 -- Multiple KNF officers have been relieved of duty with immediate effect by a military tribunal. The board, appointed by Shogun Ikeda Yamato, was investigating the conduct of unspecified military operations. The panel dismissed several admirals and many senior commanders for “dereliction of duty” during these classified missions. The findings were privately met with shock by many Naval servicemen, who note the purges have installed replacements affiliated with the KOI’s Lord Tazuka. Anonymous sources have also expressed confusion regarding purges of the Nagasaki fleet, which is not believed to have participated in the relevant operations.

918902.text: PLANET GAMMU -- 835 -- As the situation in the Omicrons becomes more and more volatile, Los Angeles has approved a withdrawal from Planet Gammu. The continued occupation of the planet represents a significant strategic liability at a time when Durban Station is at unacceptable risk of Nomad attack, and a renewed AI assault is likely imminent. Asset Forfeiture Personnel have already reported a spike in aggressive AI warforms emerging from below Gammu’s surface, while scouts continue to report rapidly massing AI drones in the Omegas and Omicron Pi. A protective fleet under the command of the Battlecruiser Addis Ababa has been dispatched to protect the evacuation.

918903.text: [835 AS] Alliance attack on Deshima thwarted

918904.text: DESHIMA -- 835 -- The Bounty Hunters Guild have confirmed a major terrorist attack on Deshima Station has been thwarted. “Agents of the Farmer’s Alliance were apprehended while attempting to smuggle a large-yield dirty bomb aboard,” confirmed chief security officer Bill Parker. The attempt was foiled thanks to precautions put in place following the deadly Alliance attack on Roppongi Station in 832 AS. According to Parker, “this was the exact same playbook”. The detained crew and fissile material are believed to have been provided to the LSF; Kusari has lodged a furious complaint with Manhattan about the unauthorized interference in its own investigation.

918905.text: [835 AS] Agents lost during Deshima strike

918906.text: KAGOSHIMA -- 835 -- Plans to detonate a bomb aboard Deshima Station and drive out the foreign filth in Shikoku have met with dismal failure. Operatives aboard a hijacked freighter were identified by foul Bounty Hunters and apprehended before the bomb could be detonated. The loss of the device may have consequences for our future plans, and those of our Sponsor. Commander Hiroki Osaka, the disgraced architect of the operation, has vowed to atone for the failure with his life. At dawn, he will embark on a lone assault on Deshima, crashing his vessel into one of the accursed Synth biodomes.

918907.text: [835 AS] Liberty and Kusari trade sanctions

918908.text: DESHIMA -- 835 -- Liberty’s President Hawthorne has announced sanctions targeting key Kusari high-tech industries, blocking their access to advanced Superconductors and funding. This came following a “security incident” in the Independent Worlds, and a failed Farmers Alliance attack on Deshima Station, which Liberty says is part of a state-endorsed campaign of terrorism against its citizens. Kusari has dismissed the claim as “lurid nonsense”, and responded by banning the export of Optronics to Liberty until its “economic coercion” is ended. Liberty has vowed to increase pressure until Kusari takes steps to eradicate the Farmers Alliance and root out their backers.

918909.text: [835 AS] Kusari diet passes sweeping defense budget

918910.text: NEW TOKYO -- 835 -- Kusari’s national diet has passed a sweeping defense budget, allocating significant additional funding to fleet readiness, modernization, and shipbuilding. This has included extensive military contracts for Kure, Yukawa, and Yokohama Shipyards, with Kishiro Technologies and Samura Industries both announcing record hiring programs in response. The new budget also ended the remaining reconstruction funding grants for Planet Kyushu, noting Governor Toho’s termination of the local state of emergency.

918911.text: [835 AS] Kusari is the enemy of Liberty’s workers

918912.text: OURAY -- 835 -- The government is starting to wake up to the reality that Kusari isn’t Liberty’s friend. We’ve known that for centuries, since their goods shut down our factories, and their “keiretsu” killed our shipyards. When the corporations can’t use Kusari imports as a crutch, Liberty’s worker wins. War breaks this broken market, and it's our job to swing the hammer. The Navy are already crawling all over Colorado which makes our work difficult, but the Clan leaders are making plans to light the fuse on this powderkeg. Be ready for action, we strike soon.

918913.text: [835 AS] Lend-Lease ships return to Liberty

918914.text: CORDOVA -- 835 -- Liberty’s Hawthorne administration has ended the wartime Lend-Lease program with Bretonia. The initiative saw Liberty provide large loans and huge quantities of military materiel during the Gallic War, throwing the beleaguered House a vital lifeline. The sudden development sees most remaining Liberty capital ships in Bretonian service returned to their parent House with immediate effect. Anonymous Bretonian sources have expressed dismay with Liberty’s insistence on an expedited return, arguing it undermines domestic security at a critical moment of Armed Forces’ preparations for a major deployment.

918915.text: [835 AS] Gammu falls to AI onslaught

918916.text: OMICRON KAPPA -- 835 -- The Core evacuation of Planet Gammu has been attacked by massed AI forces. The Battleship Mars re-entered Omicron Kappa at the head of a fleet of AI Drones, opportunistically aided by local Corsairs. Most freighters successfully launched, rescuing many Core personnel from the horde of machines boiling to Gammu’s surface. The Addis Ababa was lost covering the escape to Delta, however it successfully drove off the Corsair Battlecruiser Vis, while its escorts damaged the Mars’ engines. The Mars once again cloaked and retreated, however proposals are being assembled to trace it via leaking radiation emissions. Material extracted from Gammu will keep R&D busy for years to come.

918917.text: [835 AS] Core routed from Corsair borders

918918.text: CIUTADELLA -- Corsair scouts sounded the alarm after a large force of Core ships amassed near Planet Gammu. Ciutadella’s garrison moved to block any attack on Omicron Gamma, however the Core were soon beset by a huge force of AI ships. Seeing a chance to dislodge the Core blight, the Battlecruiser Vis led an attack on their flank. While the Vis suffered heavy damage fighting a Core battlecruiser, the enemy fleet was routed and chased into Omicron Delta. The AI Drones exhibited hostility to our pilots until a withdrawal was ordered. The Elders have been appraised of these resurgent AI, and the abnormal Core battleship leading them.

918919.text: [835 AS] Fate of the Kappa crossroads uncertain

918920.text: LIVADIA -- Travellers of the remote Omicrons have gathered anxiously aboard Corfu Station and Freeport 11 while awaiting news from Omicron Kappa. The Core infamously seized control over Planet Gammu in 832 AS, displacing the intelligent machines residing there. Now, these AI have reclaimed their territory, ejecting Core vessels from the system. Rumors whisper of an abnormal Core battleship leading an AI swarm of unprecedented size. Many fear what this development means for the strategically vital crossroads, through which goods from Omicron Delta must travel. The Zoners of Livadia have attempted to contact the enigmatic Gammusians to confirm their intentions, but have received no response.

918921.text: [835 AS] Sisterhood signs deal on FA captives

918922.text: FURYOKU -- 835 -- The Sisterhood wept for the loss of Roppongi Station, and the needless murder of Kusari’s women and youth. The Alliance may have pulled the trigger, but they are far too stupid to have orchestrated the attack. It seems we are not alone in these suspicions. A deal has been brokered with Interspace Commerce for captive Alliance pilots to be delivered to Furyoku Station for interrogation. In exchange, they will barter supplies and Agricultural Machinery, which we will to trade to the Outcasts for technical support and ships. It is only a matter of time before the screws are tightened and an Alliance puppet betrays their Samura paymasters.

918923.text: [835 AS] Interspace brokers Sigma export deal

918924.text: LOS ANGELES -- 835 -- Synth Foods and Interspace Commerce have announced the opening of a new factory plant on Planet Los Angeles, after negotiating a major Agricultural Machinery export contract to Furyoku Station. Interspace is a major investor in the development of Sigma-59, and has placed the order to accelerate local economic development. The factory is expected to provide several thousand jobs, in addition to shipping roles within Synth Foods and Universal Shipping. The Los Angeles Chamber of Commerce has hailed the deal, calling it a “bright day for Liberty’s competitive edge”.

918925.text: [835 AS] Bretonia and Rheinland call for de-escalation

918926.text: CURACAO -- The governments of Bretonia and Rheinland have called on Kusari and Liberty to attempt formal talks, amid fears that continued escalation and military friction could spark war. Queen Carina and Emperor Frederick have offered to mediate an emergency summit on Planet Curacao after Kusari and Liberty imposed mutual sanctions that are already having rippling effects across Sirius. Gallia’s Grand Marechal de Varax meanwhile has condemned Kusari as a “belligerent and destabilizing actor”, and called for Liberty’s demands to be met. Neither Kusari or Liberty has agreed to attend, with each demanding pre-conditions be met by the other. Gallia has not received an invite.

918928.text: BATTLESHIP ESSEX -- 835 -- Admiralty representatives have confirmed that the Bretonian operation to recapture Dublin has been initiated. Defense commentators have long assumed the Bretonia Armed Forces would breach the system via a Jump Hole believed to be concealed within the Cumbria Asteroid Field. Forecasts predicted a bloody advance, given the Mollys renown expertise as ambush fighters, and prolific use of concealed mines. Despite this, Bretonian officials confirm that the Battleship Somerset has established a bridgehead in the system without casualties. “This will be a quick operation,” Admiral Rowley noted. “The Mollys cannot stand in open space.”

918929.text: [835 AS] Jump bridge a strategic innovation

918930.text: BATTLESHIP SOMERSET -- 835 -- Admiral William Rowley, captain of the Battleship Somerset, has hailed the Kusari Jump Drive as “a new dawn for military doctrine”. The Armed Forces assault into Dublin used a networked pair of Jump Drives to bypass defensive minefields in the Achill Asteroid Field. “The widespread adoption of this technology will completely upend military thinking regarding fixed defenses,” Rowley noted. Military analysts in both Bretonia and Kusari have raised fears about implications for deescalation frameworks such as the Boorman Treaty, once knowledge of the technology and its capabilities becomes widespread.

918932.text: ARRANMORE -- 835 -- In a grim day for the Republic, Bretonia has avoided the Achill minefields and deployed forces directly into Dublin. Seeming to use an artificially created Jump Hole, scouts report the Battleship Somerset is acting as some sort of anchor. Bretonian cruiser formations have immediately begun to push towards the Achill and Founders Fields to cut our supplies and force a fight in open space. A coordinated defense will be complicated by the continued Corsair occupation of the Hood Field, which limits our ability to launch ambushes from that direction. Arranmore’s Brigades are being deployed to block Bretonian advances, while Hellburner assets are moved into position.

918933.text: [835 AS] Dublin suicide attacks stall offensive

918934.text: BATTLESHIP SOMERSET -- 835 -- The Dublin offensive has encountered severe setbacks with the loss of the Battlecruiser Adlington and the immobilization of the Battlecruiser Bracknell. The Mollys dispatched their own cruisers to engage the First and Fifth cruiser flotillas, followed by waves of captured Hegemon Asteroid Miners. Many of these were still flagged with BMM transponders, and broadcasting that civilian hostages were aboard. It was discovered too late that these vessels had been rigged with huge quantities of explosives. Standing orders have been issued to destroy such vessels on sight, particularly within the confines of the BMM Gold Field.

918935.text: [835 AS] Bretonians bloodied by Hellburner bombs

918936.text: ARRANMORE -- 835 -- As insurance against Bretonia breaking through the Achill minefield, the Hegemons Hope and Fortune were converted into enormous armored bombs. As our Brigades engaged the enemy near the Achill and Founders Fields, waves of Hegemons were launched to obscure our fire ships. The Fortune arrived first, with the detonation destroying the Battlecruiser Adlington. The Hope was heavily damaged on approach, nearly allowing the Battlecruiser Bracknell’s escape. Captain Saoirse Keane heroically chose to prematurely detonate the Hope rather than evacuate, crippling the Bretonian invader. Both directions of advance have now stalled, allowing us to reconstitute depleted Brigades.

918938.text: ITHACA -- 835 -- The Mollys have significantly increased offered pay for pirates and mercenaries willing to go fight in Dublin. Many gangs have been reluctant to take up the Gold-plated offer, seeing a House invasion fleet as a much bigger deal than tangling with local police. Despite that, there’s always someone bloodythirsty or mad enough to follow the money, and a steady trickle of pilots have headed to Trafalgar Base in New London to reinforce the Molly Brigades. If you think you’ve got what it takes, track down a Molly officer on Ithaca and accept the Golden shilling.

918939.text: [835 AS] Coalition force scores mighty victory in Dublin

918940.text: DUBLIN -- 835 -- Dublin’s Powrie Brigade, led by Coalition commanders, has scored a mighty victory against the Bretonian imperialist invaders. Single-handedly holding back the royalist tide, Coalition forces destroyed the Battlecruisers Adlington and Bracknell, throwing the Bretonian offensive into disarray. The Mollys have expressed their heartfelt gratitude for the Coalition people for saving their Republic, comparing it to our liberation of Omega-49 through the vanquishing of the Battleship Stirling. Senior commanders have confirmed that the Mollys are now sufficiently secured to see to their own defense, allowing the Coalition to focus on suppressing Omega threats.

918941.text: [835 AS] Coalition reinforcements slow to arrive

918942.text: ZHEJIANG ORBITAL -- 835 -- Molly emissaries have been dispatched to Omega-52 in an attempt to petition Coalition leaders. After Coalition auxiliaries attached to the Powrie Brigade suffered heavy casualties, replacement reinforcements have been slow to arrive. Despite promises of “bottomless materiel resupply”, Coalition leaders have dragged their feet and evaded questions on when exactly additional ships will arrive. Mid-level functionaries on Zhejiang Orbital have prevented our emissaries from travelling further into their space, while advising that a significantly increased “donation” of Molly Gold may rebalance the Supreme Council’s priority assessments.

918943.text: [835 AS] Liberty court rules on Platinum dispute

918944.text: MANHATTAN -- 835 -- Liberty’s Supreme Court has issued its verdict on the Galileo Platinum dispute between DSE, Samura and Kishiro. Ruling in DSE’s favor, the court has ordered the Kusari corporations to end all mining activities in Galileo, and pay compensation to DSE for losses. Kusari’s courts have objected to the ruling, calling it an “unprecedented breach of protocol” due to the Liberty court’s failure to consult and reach a mutual finding on issues of cross-border law. Liberty has threatened to deploy the Navy to evict illegal miners, while Kusari has warned that this would be interpreted as an “illegal act of hostility”.

918946.text: HINSDALE REFINERY -- 835 AS -- Executives from Deep Space Engineering have cut the ribbon on the newest Platinum-processing line at Hinsdale Refinery. This officially launches full operations at the largest ore-processing refinery in Colorado since the collapse of the industry over two centuries ago. This comes mere weeks after the Liberty Supreme Court ruled in DSE’s favor over the long-running Galileo Platinum dispute; Kusari vehemently opposes the ruling. The opening was marked by a significant security presence, largely driven by the increased tensions with the Kusari Empire.

918947.text: [751 AGS] Bretonia must return stolen Jump Gate

918948.text: BATTLESHIP DE GRASSE -- 751 -- During Kusari’s invasion, the Gallic Jump Gate between Tau-23 and Tau-31 was occupied, and then unlawfully transferred to Bretonian custody. Kusari claimed this excluded the Gate’s status from peace negotiations, as it was no longer within their legal control. Grand Marechal de Varax has now issued a blistering decree to Bretonia, ordering the Gate’s immediate return to Gallic ownership. It is intolerable that Gallic state industrial secrets remain in the hands of a foreign House that has time and again demonstrated its hostility to the Gallic people. The Grand Marechal has warned of “dire consequences” should his demand be refused.

918949.text: [835 AS] Gallic threats raise Tau fears

918950.text: SCALPAY OUTPOST -- 835 -- The Taus are once more on edge, after Gallia threatens the use of force to retrieve the Tau-23 to Tau-31 Jump Gate. Bretonia constructed the first Jump Gate in the system, which was later annexed during the Gallic War. Bretonia was gifted the current Gallic Jump Gate by Kusari during their invasion of Gallia, and has held it since -- with Gallia formally ceding its Tau claims through the Treaty of Rishiri. Bretonia has historically refused to discuss the Gate’s status until its own demands on the extradition of war criminals and payment of Gallic War reparations are met. The Bretonian government has warned that Gallic aggression or threats “will not be tolerated”.

918951.text: [835 AS] New deal eases labor crunch

918952.text: NISHIARA BASE -- 835 -- A new deal has been struck with the Golden Chrysanthemums for Agricultural Hardware. Our negotiators settled on a small reduction in wholesale Cardamine prices, and access to Outcast shipwrights for technical consultations. Malta has struggled with labor shortages since the abolition of slavery in 832 AS. While boosted wages have drawn some Outcast fieldhands back to the plantations, a lack of workers and a shortage of specialist machinery has constrained Cardamine production. Between Freeport imports and the suspiciously new Synth Foods equipment the Chrysanthemums have procured, Malta is ready to transition towards a more heavily automated agricultural sector.

918954.text: COCHRANE -- 835 -- The Battleship Atum recently arrived in Ontario, chasing down an infected battlecruiser -- apparently the Wyoming, Leiden’s favorite ghost story. The Order are good customers, so Cochrane offered update the Sinclaire Network if anything went bump in the night. When the Wyoming finally surfaced, we put the Atum on its tail -- however, alien ships appeared through an artificial jump hole and covered its retreat. The Atum dived through before the breach collapsed, and has since disappeared without a trace. We’ve passed the bad news onto our Order contacts. The captured data has also given us some new ideas about the prize sat in Cochrane’s quarantine dock.

918955.text: [835 AS] Atum missing after Ontario battle

918956.text: ONTARIO -- 835 -- The final messages from the Battleship Atum have been corroborated by Lane Hacker sensor readings. After catching and crippling the infested Battlecruiser Wyoming in Ontario, large Nomad warforms intervened to stage a rescue. Appearing to arrive via Jump Drive, these were likely entities of the Vagrant sub-specie. Contact was lost with the Atum after it pursued the retreating warforms through the Drive breach. The Atum likely considered that the risk was worthwhile to destroy the Nomads’ Liberty infiltrator network, which we believe is anchored by the Wyoming. Agents have been dispatched to Liberty’s Independent Worlds to search for the missing taskforce.

918957.text: [835 AS] A different kind of intruder

918958.text: ATACAMA -- 835 -- Atacama’s defenders were scrambled after a massive unknown contact was detected entering the Sonora Field. Rather than mindless aggression from transponderless raiders, the intruder was nothing less than an Order battleship. The vessel was heavily damaged and fighting fires on multiple decks. After a terse initial exchange between Gaian and Order fighters, it was agreed that the “Atum” would be allowed to moor near the wreckage of the Warspite to carry out damage control. The battleship’s officers were then shuttled across to Atacama for discussions with local cell leaders. Gaian patrols have since rescued several Order pilots from the wreckage of a new battlefield near Veracruz.

918959.text: [835 AS] Leaks reveal Ontario alien technology

918960.text: MANHATTAN -- 835 -- The neural net is abuzz with speculation and worry after sensor readings of an active alien facility in Ontario were widely distributed. The datafeed claims the source of an enormous beam of energy is an ancient alien ruin on Planet Sudbury. Inert alien ruins are often discovered in the remote Edge Worlds, enticing adventurers and scientific expeditions. According to professor Johan Miller of the Hammer Institute, the discovery of an active Daam-K’vosh site is “unprecedented”. In an attempt to reduce panic, government officials have confirmed that steps have been taken to secure Liberty’s borders, and reiterated that there is currently no threat to Liberty’s people.

918962.text: LOS ANGELES -- 835 -- The Battlecruiser Tuscaloosa has been withdrawn from Inverness on the express orders of Director Maxwell. Current analysis suggests the Crayter Republic are capable of maintaining a quarantine of Inverness while LSF assets intervene to secure priority objectives in Ontario. This is primarily Site Alpha on Planet Sudbury. Agents launching from the Battlecruiser Lehigh also believe the Niyodo Component may be present in the system, based on radiation traces and prisoner interrogation. Once the Tuscaloosa has finished refuelling and taking on provisions at Planet Los Angeles, it will enter Ontario and secure Sudbury’s orbit.

918963.text: [835 AS] LSF receives a black eye in Ontario

918964.text: ONTARIO -- 835 -- For months, the Battlecruiser Lehigh has skulked around Ontario. Neither the Xenos or Lane Hackers were happy about having house guests, but it seems the Xenos were the ones to put their money where their mouth was. A tide of Xenos poured from the Georgian Ice Field, using suicidal waves to peck apart the heavy defenses with sheer numbers. Lehigh was sent packing with its tail between its legs in a major victory for the Xeno movement. “They laughed at us before, but no-one’s laughing now,” says veteran Xeno Hamish Garcia. The Lane Hackers avoided getting their hands dirty, but helped out by jamming Liberty’s comms and disrupting LSF transponders.

918966.text: BATTLECRUISER LEHIGH -- 835 -- The LSF position around Ontario’s California Jump Gate has been overrun by Xeno radicals. Following the departure of the Battlecruiser Tuscaloosa, the Lehigh’s came under attack by massed waves of Xeno fighters, followed by an antique battleship flagged as the Liberty Rose -- likely the missing Battleship Alabama. Reinforcements from California were slow to arrive due to sophisticated comms jamming, resulting in heavy damage to the Lehigh, and the destruction of the construction ship Robert S. Peary. DSE has withdrawn further support for maintaining the unstable Jump Gate. The Tuscaloosa has been ordered to complete its assignment at Planet Sudbury, and cruise for Colorado if this becomes untenable.

918967.text: [835 AS] LSF Director dismissed after congressional grilling

918968.text: PLANET MANHATTAN -- 835 -- Following a four-hour closed congressional hearing, Adam C. Maxwell has been officially dismissed by President Hawthorne as a Director of the Liberty Security Force. Congressmen cited a loss of confidence following the destruction of the DSE Construction Ship Robert S. Peary in Ontario, and the gross mismanagement of the Battlecruiser Lehigh’s deployment in the system. Sources familiar with the investigation have blamed the systematic withholding of intelligence from the Liberty Navy for the fiasco, resulting in a botched emergency response to terrorist attacks.

918969.text: [835 AS] Congressional support for Navy hardens

918970.text: PLANET MANHATTAN -- 835 -- In the wake of congressional hearings into the LSF’s bungled Ontario operation, a growing group of representatives are calling for budget cuts to the agency in favor of boosting the Navy’s capabilities. While interservice jockeying in Congress is not uncommon, the LSF’s Ontario scandal -- combined panic over “Artifact sites” and rising concerns over the Kusari Empire -- are beginning to tip the scales in favor of more traditional military responses. While the impact on both services is unlikely to be felt until the next budget approval, the tarnished influence of LSF advocates is already increasingly apparent.

918971.text: [835 AS] Erie camps scheduled to close

918972.text: PLANET ERIE -- 835 AS -- For several years, internment camps on Erie have held captives from the Insurgency Campaign. Most were residents of the Commonwealth terrorist state, or Insurgency combatants. Newly appointed governor Mike Davis has confirmed that the last of the camps will be emptied by year’s end, as court backlogs are cleared and captives finally processed. Common sentences include corrective labor on Planet Houston. While most internees once possessed Liberty citizenship, some were Bretonian Refugees. Bretonia publicly applauds Liberty’s apprehension of Insurgency “terrorist agents”, but it is believed private negotiations on repatriation have been a point of contention for some time.

918974.text: PLANET ERIE -- 835 AS -- Interspace has issued a new report describing Pennsylvania as the most dangerous of Liberty’s core systems. Since Erie’s annexation, Zoner Militants have been responsible for the majority of strikes against corporate and government entities on Erie and in space, however this has begun to change. LSF raids targeting dissident leaders appear to have set back Militant activities, while Liberty Rogue and Xeno attacks have continued to rise -- driven by the influx of impoverished Liberty settlers seeking a fresh start. LPI sources admitted that the Militants continued to be a severe problem, buoyed by disgruntled Zoners and reconstituting Insurgency survivors.

918976.text: PLANET ERIE -- 834 AS -- Many impoverished Liberty citizens have been flocking to Erie, looking for a fresh start. Unfortunately, that’s easier said than done in Liberty. Dragged down by debts, criminal records, or a lack of jobs to go around, many have ended up resorting to crime to make ends meet. The Liberty Rogues and Xenos have both seen recruitment surge, as gangs take up the very profitable activities of smuggling and shakedowns. The Navy and LSF are mostly interested in squashing the Militants who want to topple the new governor, leaving breathing room for the common crook.

918978.text: PLANET DENVER -- 835 -- The 14 year old daughter of Senator James Woodson has been killed in a “monstrous” bomb attack on her Denver home. Senator Woodson was attending Congress on Manhattan at the time, issuing a speech calling for harsher economic sanctions against Kusari. LPI leaks have blamed The Order for the attack, however force insiders claim many believe the murder may have been a botched Kusari assassination attempt against hostile politicians. Senator Woodson has withdrawn from public service to grieve, with knowledgeable sources claiming the devastating loss has led to a traumatic amnestic episode.

918979.text: [835 AS] Liberty cell roots out Nomad network

918980.text: PLANET DENVER -- 835 -- Liberty Senator James Woodson came to the Order’s attention when affiliates reported erratic and unusual behavior. The Senator sits in the Intelligence Select Committee, recently reversing his policies to demand harsh measures against Kusari. Through observation, Order agents concluded it was likely the Senator had been indoctrinated as a Nomad Thrall. Based on his routines and associate network, it was deduced with reasonable confidence that the Senator’s daughter hosted a Nomad parasite. The target was cleanly removed through a bomb attack on their Denver home, with the Senator now demonstrating the tell-tale signs of the traumatic termination of a psychic leash.

918982.text: YUMA -- 835 -- Public data feeds have lit up with distress calls from Coronado, after a system-wide EMP pulse wreaked havoc. Emergency requests for aid have been issued by the Crayter Republic and IMG, with early reports indicating that the system’s Trade Lane project has been destroyed. Ageira has confirmed that the Jump Gate remains unaffected thanks to post-Blackout safeguards, allowing relief to be delivered from Bretonia and Liberty. Panic erupted on many Liberty worlds after footage was released showing an energy field around the moon Jericho, seeming to indicate another activated alien site. President Hawthorne has called for calm, and reiterated that security forces were moving to contain the situation.

918983.text: DURBAN -- 833 -- Breakthroughs in Project Gammu reverse engineering and Artificial Persona fragment splicing have allowed the production of prototype replica Drone vessels. While these are still heavily reliant on salvage, many mundane components are now well enough understood to be produced at Durban’s fabricators. As a result, a strategic pivot has been agreed by Core executives, with significant investment being allocated to ramping up Drone production. It is hoped that this will facilitate a viable combat force for field demonstration within the next year. A decisive demonstration will encourage the Houses to revisit issues of AI and inter-colony law.

918984.text: [835 AS] Interspace voids Coronado Trade Lane policy

918985.text: SCOTSDALE REFINERY -- 835 -- Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering have threatened to sue Interspace Commerce over an insurance dispute. Interspace provided a loss prevention policy for Coronado’s Trade Lane construction project, however the financial giant says the policy is now void. Describing the Jericho Pulse as an “act of god”, Interspace exercised force majeure clauses to deny compensation claims. Local transports caught in the blast are similarly out of pocket.  Liberty itself has yet to comment on the situation, however the prospect of starting over with massively increased risk premiums has thrown the project’s future into question.

918986.text: [828 AS] Cortez cleanup begins after delays

918987.text: CURACAO -- 835 -- DSE has accepted a cleanup and salvage contract to address war debris in Cortez. The Aruba Debris Field has long been a cause for complaint by Orbital Spa and Cruise, over concerns that the unsightly wreckage would blight local tourist attractions. The site does not obstruct traffic, so clearance has been of low priority to both Bretonia and Liberty. This appears to have changed following a significant Orbital contribution to a clean-up fund. DSE was appointed as the primary contractor, as preferred subcontractor ALG does not have capacity for the job. The Rheinland group is facing manpower constraints following the Rheinland Civil War, and exploding demand for battlefield salvage across the sector.

918988.text: [835 AS] Freiburg targeted in terrorist strike

918989.text: FREIBURG STATION -- 835 -- Emergency responders have rushed to Freiburg Station after a serious terrorist attack killed 7 Gallic visitors. 3 Gull-class Transports attempted to ram an IDF Shipping convoy moored to the station, exploding once they hit their targets. 1 of the vessels was successfully disabled by the station’s defense grid. The assailants had just arrived from Omega-7, broadcasting the convoy shipping papers of a small export company based on Freeport 1. RFP officers believe the Gallic ships were the actual target, and have suggested either the LWB or Bretonian radicals could be responsible. Bretonian and Rheinland authorities are cooperating to investigate the incident.

918991.text: FREIBURG -- 751 -- Despicable Bretonian assassins have once more targeted Gallic citizens on Freiburg Station in Stuttgart. In the latest provocation, a moored IDF Shipping convoy was attacked and destroyed by Bretonian transports loaded with bombs. “Now more than ever, we must set aside our differences and come together as one House to oppose foreign tyranny,” Grand Marechal de Varax boomed during a speech to the Parisian Assembly. De Varax further vowed to obtain justice for the slain crew, and root out Gallia’s enemies wherever they may hide. Bretonia was recently ordered to return the stolen Jump Gate of Tau-23 -- it appears they have provided their perfidious answer.

918992.text: [835 AS] Unlikely friends offer common cause

918993.text: DARMSTATD -- 835 -- The LWB have received an unlikely offer in our mission to win back the freedom of Stuttgart’s farmers. A new gang of Bretonian pirates recently moved into Omega-7, however it’s not loot they’re looking for -- it’s Gallic wreckage. Their recent attack on Freiburg Station targeted an IDF Shipping convoy, fortuitously destroying its cargo of Luxury Foods bound for New Berlin. These “Privateers” want to work together to bloody Gallia as badly as possible in the Alsace Passage -- potentially freeing us to focus more heavily on Synth Foods and other fronts. Darmstadt will be holding open discussions on the proposal shortly.

918995.text: NEW BERLIN -- Imperial officials have announced the dissolution of the Reichstag, arguing that the body was not “fit for purpose”. With legislative power now delegated to the Emperor’s ministers, further announcements were made establishing the Empire as a unitary state, and retracting the powers devolved to system authorities under the previous Federal structure. Palace spokesman Baron Ulrich Keufer stressed that, “in this time of crisis we must have a strong central state, free of the corruption that plagues System governors”. Exiled Chancellor Neumann has urged Rheinlanders to take up arms and fight to preserve “historic freedoms”.

918996.text: [827 AS] Imperials write a blank cheque

918997.text: PACIFICA -- 827 -- The Imperials have long promised many things. Rheinland jobs for Rheinland citizens. Blocking the sale of foreign-built transports. Bringing back well-paid construction jobs to Hamburg. Nothing ever came of this, until now. After losing the last election, they’ve taken matters into their own hands and toppled the government with the Military’s support. We’ve no love for the Feds who sold our people out to Kusari and then looked the other way when Republican crushed the Unions. Senior Imperials have offered us major concessions for armed support against the Feds. After thinking it through, we’ve taken them up on the offer: why not get paid for something we’d have done anyway?

918999.text: BRUCHSAL -- 827 -- A coup has toppled the Federal government in an attempt to restore the wretched Empire our ancestors fought to remove. The Federal Republic was a corrupt perversion of the ideals of the Popular Revolution. Unfortunately, this new Empire already promises to be far worse, by crushing democratic institutions, conducting murderous orbital strikes on New Berlin, and eliminating the devolved governance of the Systems. We have agreed a truce with Federal forces to focus on this greater threat. Despite this, we must remember the betrayal after the Popular Revolution: we temporarily share an enemy, however the Federalists must not be allowed to learn of our bases or networks of agents.

919000.text: [834 AS] New governor appointed to Erie

919001.text: PLANET ERIE – 834 -- Veteran political troubleshooter Mike Davis has been dispatched to Pennsylvania as Planet Erie’s new governor. Davis’ policy team is renown for presiding over the economic regeneration of Planet Denver, and guiding the controversial LPI sweeps that pushed out many less affluent citizens. Since its annexation in 830 AS, Erie has continued to prove troublesome for the Interim Administration there. Davis’ appointment as governor appears to indicate a directive from Manhattan to finish pacifying the unruly frontier, to pave the way for full assimilation as a core Liberty territory. Governor Davis has his work cut out for him, as previous efforts have been violently resisted by Erie Militants.

919003.text: PLANET ERIE -- 830 -- The Liberty Navy has launched Operation PESTICIDE to annex Pennsylvania, following the collapse of talks between Liberty and Zoner authorities. President Hawthorne declared that Liberty could no longer tolerate a "lawless frontier" within its very core, and that the Zoners had repeatedly refused to extradite criminals and terrorists from the Pennsylvania protectorate. The recent destruction of an LSF satellite was the straw that broke the camel's back. Militias congregating around Planet Erie were routed following the Zoner Carrier Pinnacle’s destruction. The Battleship Alma then secured Erie’s orbit and landed Marines to impose Liberty law on Lake City. Surviving militants have vowed to resist Erie’s occupation.

919004.text: [829 AS] Navy bloodied by Pennsylvania strike

919005.text: WILLIAMSTOWN DEPOT -- 829 -- The Liberty Navy have been struck an embarrassing blow in their campaign to scour the Insurgency from the Independent Worlds. The Navy has been carrying out combat operations across Kansas, but staging its forces and logistics from Pennsylvania. In an attempt to disrupt the Navy’s inevitable advance towards their heartlands, the Insurgency launched a surprise raid on Williamstown Depot. Liberty authorities have tersely commented that search and rescue efforts are still ongoing, but it appears the fuel and munitions store detonated after being struck by multiple torpedoes. When asked for comment, President Hawthorne stated simply that she would not discuss ongoing combat operations.

919006.text: [830 AS] Militants take up arms in Pennsylvania

919007.text: PINNACLE STATION -- 830 -- Many Zoner captains flocked to Pennsylvania to protest Liberty’s overreach when the direction of President Hawthorne’s demands became clear. This included the Carrier Pinnacle and several Fearless destroyers. The Battleship Alma’s callous destruction of the Pinnacle as it protected fleeing evacuation freighters should serve as a wakeup call to any who believe Liberty’s occupation will be business as usual. Those with the will to resist are assembling in the Driftwood Ice Asteroid Field, where Pinnacle Station is being assembled. Liberty cannot be allowed to crush our freedom and steal our homes. Whatever it takes, we will strike back against oppression and liberate Erie from the invaders!

919008.text: [818 AS] Order deception falls on deaf ears

919009.text: DABADORU -- 818 -- Order representatives have contacted Core scouts to beg for assistance with a developing Edge Worlds threat. They claim the Nomads have launched an invasion of “Omicron Major”, and that this effort succeeding would place humanity as a whole at risk. Dabadoru’s analysts have dismissed these claims as a ruse, likely intending to lure Core pilots out of position and into an ambush. For several years, Acquisition Service hunting packs have dealt with Nomad vessels throughout Omicron Delta. It is obvious that these creatures are scattered, few in number, and unable to mount a coordinated offensive of the sort described. We may still profit from this situation by reversing the Order’s trap.

919010.text: [833 AS] LPI commissioner sentenced following Erie probe

919011.text: PLANET ERIE -- 833 -- Helen O’Shea, Pennsylvania’s former LPI Commissioner, has been sentenced on corruption charges over the mismanagement of Erie’s planetary internment camps. The facilities were constructed to temporarily hold prisoners from the Liberty Insurgency while the courts cleared sentencing backlogs. Following allegations of human trafficking, the LSF launched a major investigation, discovering that as many as 10 percent of inmates were suspected of having been sold to traffickers. O’Shea is the latest and most high profile prosecution to date, and is expected to serve a ten year sentence at a minimum security penitentiary on Planet Los Angeles.

919012.text: [835 AS] Samura recruits for Kyushu production initiative

919013.text: NANSEI -- 835 -- Antimatter research at Nansei Research Complex is beginning to wind down as Samura announces an expansion of its Superconductor fabrication program. Recruitment campaigns are now running across Kusari to attract talented engineers to Kyushu, despite Samura's historic preference for local Kyushu University alumni. This shift in priorities comes with a substantial manufacturing renovation to the station, which expects to begin producing viable Superconductor stocks shortly. Samura spokesman Ichiei Suga noted that the pivot will "significantly benefit Kusari's economy, which has been buffeted by external shocks".

919014.text: [836 AS] Jump Drive approved for serial production

919015.text: KANSAI -- 836 -- Following extensive trials and prototyping, the Ministry of Defense has approved the current Phase 4 Jump Drive iteration as the baseline for future production. Considerable focus is now being placed on the development of anti-tamper protections that will allow the limited commercial export of the technology to trusted parties in the future. These efforts will be modeled on Ageira's extremely successful White Box security measures. Preparations are being made to scale up production, through the construction of additional facilities at Kansai Research Institute.

919017.text: BATTLESHIP KOKURA -- 835 -- For centuries Samura has researched antimatter aboard Nansei Research Complex, although it is a barely concealed secret that these projects are heavily embezzled to fund their other illegal interests. Now, they have pivoted to the manufacture of Superconductors, which sources whisper are marked for Kansai Research Institute in Honshu. New Libertonian friends in the Taus have provided us with the funds and weapons to ensure this does not happen. Striking Nansei before antimatter generation is discontinued will leave a deadly mark, and badly bloody both keiretsu.

919018.text: [835 AS] Cooperative assets secured in Kusari

919019.text: CLISHAM -- 835 AS – Undercover LSF operatives in the Taus have finalized a deal with the Blood Dragons to curtail Kusari's aggressive efforts to avoid economic sanctions. Shell companies established on Freeport 6 and Newport Station will funnel finance and Detroit Side Arms to Blood Dragon freedom fighters to aid in striking Nansei Research Institute in Kyushu. Nansei has recently accelerated attempts to manufacture embargoed Superconductors, which are believed to be a critical input to Kusari's illegal Jump Drive program.

919020.text: [836 AS] Planetform provide update on Wight proposal

919021.text: PLANET WIGHT -- 836 -- Planetform has submitted its initial report on surveying efforts around Planet Wight in Manchester. It argues that terraforming could be completed in a century, and would generate hundreds of thousands of jobs. The government will now consider the case before taking a proposal to Parliament later this year. Protesters have planned large-scale demonstrations across New London and Cambridge, objecting to expensive new terraforming when so many are destitute and need assistance. Green Party MP Louise Davidson condemned the report, calling the proposal "morally bankrupt corporate welfare".

919023.text: FORT RAMSEY -- 836 -- The Liberty Rose has caused fights between the Xeno clans from the day she was captured. The border clans see her as a wasteful resource-hog, while others argue she's a powerful symbol of independence. Ramsey is used to having its own way, but the pendulum has swung back hard in the aftermath of the Battle of Ontario. The clans owed debts for their involvement are now calling in the cost, and have forced the Rose from its scaffold to begin work on prototyping the Objector corvette. The design has languished as a concept for years, due to a lack of funding, facilities, and support -- engineers now hope the first ships will be hitting the Trade Lanes soon.

919024.text: [835 AS] Cochrane calls board meeting over discovery

919025.text: COCHRANE -- 835 -- Cochrane’s director has summoned all Lane Hackers executives for an emergency briefing on the outcome of the Argonaut project. Almost a year of frenzied work on the Niyodo wreckage has yielded an unimaginable result: most of the schematics for a ship-mounted Jump Drive. This technology promises to turn Sirius on its head and annihilate Ageira’s monopolies, possibly making the Jump Gate redundant. We do not have the facilities or resources to fabricate or test such a complex device ourselves, however a decision must be made on our next steps. The executives will draw up a business case for approaches ranging from private licensing with partners, to full public disclosure.

919027.text: COCHRANE -- 835 -- For centuries, Ageira’s Jump Gate monopolies across Sirius have enforced Liberty’s whims. Now, Kusari has access to a ship-mounted Jump Drive, which promises to crush Sirius under a new heel unless immediately checked. Despite sharply conflicting views, the executives have decided to trip up both parties by publicly leaking the Battlecruiser Niyodo’s reverse-engineered drive schematics. The datapackets were distributed too widely for the KOI or LSF to stop, and Ageira’s stocks are already in freefall. We expect the data to earn us a handsome profit in consultancy work, as well as opening many hidden doors with those foolish enough to run the archive outside of an airgapped environment.

919028.text: [836 AS] Lane Hackers leak Jump Drive plans

919029.text: MANHATTAN -- 835 -- Lane Hacker criminals have shocked the sector by releasing the schematics of a ship-mounted Jump Drive, allegedly salvaged from a classified Kusari military project. The Hackers claim Liberty destroyed the secret prototype to try and seize the technology, and that no single party should possess the power it provides. Many analysts believe the leak was motivated by inflicting maximum harm on both Liberty and Kusari, rather than altruism. So far, the Houses have responded to the disclosure with alarm, as defense officials grapple with the security implications presented.

919031.text: ATACAMA -- 835 -- Following negotiations in Vespucci, an alliance has been struck between the Order and Gaians. The Gaians have evacuated the Atum’s casualties to medical facilities aboard Skye Base, then assisted in escorting the beleaguered battleship to Magellan, where it was collected by a Crayter Republic guard formation. In exchange for Gaian support in suppressing the Nomads and their thralls in Bretonia, the Order has agreed to station specialist alien hunters aboard Gaian bases in Orkney and Vespucci, and provide the Gaians with the skills and knowledge they need to protect themselves from humanity’s greatest enemy. This partnership extends The Order’s reach into Bretonia at a time when infected forces appear to be on the march in the region.

919032.text: [836 AS] Ageira's stocks plummet over Jump Drive shock

919033.text: MANHATTAN - 835 - Following the unprecedented leak of Jump Drive schematics, panic hit the Manhattan Stock Exchange. Ageira Technology's value dropped by 21 percent during opening hours as investors dumped their shares, with the price only mildly rallying following a press conference by CEO Ken Hawkins. Hawkins asserted that Ageira’s products and research remained as vital to Sirius’ prosperity as ever, and their investments in these fields would continue with the full faith and backing of Liberty’s government. He also ominously warned the public that the leaked plans were “unreliable” and that their use would lead to “regrettable losses of life and property”.

919034.text: [836 AS] Liberty condemns dangerous Kusari experiments

919035.text: MANHATTAN -- 836 -- Liberty has strongly condemned Kusari following the leak of Jump Drive schematics by the Lane Hackers. In a blistering speech, President Hawthorne accused Kusari of violating the Denver Convention and the Boorman Treaty -- agreements that ban the weaponization of Alien Artifacts, and establish neutral territories between the Houses. The President has demanded Kusari immediately end their “destabilizing” Jump Drive program, and committed to using “all available means” to ensure its destruction. Intelligence Select Committee chairman, Senator Brendon Tromer, noted “the technology was designed for warships, for use in war”. Liberty Navy forces have been ordered to high alert across Liberty.

919036.text: [836 AS] LSF prioritizes Jump Drive countermeasures

919037.text: PRUDHOE -- 836 -- The President has ordered Ageira and the LSF to begin immediate work on Jump Drive countermeasures, and testing a replica device based on the Niyodo Files. A joint task-force has been assembled at Prudhoe Skunkworks to lead on this project. Additionally, the LSF is to draw up a strike package to directly attack facilities associated with the Kusari Jump Drive program. LSF scouts have previously mapped routes from Galileo to a remote system known as Copernicus, with the latter providing an unstable link to the Sigmas. An Interdictor battlecruiser will be deployed to a holding position in Copernicus, to project raiders into Kusari and assist Blood Dragon freedom fighters.

919038.text: [836 AS] Kusari blasts Liberty Jump Drive accusations

919039.text: NEW TOKYO -- 836 -- Following the leak of the Niyodo Files, Kusari has formally confirmed the existence of its Jump Drive program, while striking back at Libertonian accusations. “Our Drive was developed over decades through Kusari ingenuity -- there was no breach of the Denver Convention,” declared Shogun Ikeda Yamato. “Liberty has relentlessly attempted to coerce and sabotage Kusari’s legitimate scientific pursuits, driven purely by greed and fear,” added Minister Kojirou. “Our intentions are peaceful, and we fully intended to share the gift of our discoveries following sufficient testing.” Responding to Liberty’s fleet mobilization, Kusari has placed the KNF on high alert for defensive operations.

919040.text: [836 AS] Niyodo leak lights strategic fuse

919041.text: NAGASAKI -- 836 -- Our worst case forecasts following the Niyodo’s loss have come to pass with the public leak of Jump Drive schematics. It is now only a matter of time until countermeasures to mitigate the Drive are developed and deployed. The loss of the Drive as a strategic weapon will place Kusari at a dire disadvantage against Liberty’s superiority in conventional forces, which continue to amass on our border. Emergency plans have been submitted to the Shogun for review, detailing a number of Drive-enabled decapitation strikes that could tip the balance in our favour. Liberty must understand that the cost of war will be steep, and that to proceed is profoundly unwise.

919042.text: [836 AS] Bretonia calls for Jump Drive regulations

919043.text: PLANET NEW LONDON -- 836 -- Bretonian officials have responded with dismay to the public leak of Jump Drive schematics, citing concerns over public safety. “We have no reason to believe the device described in the Niyodo Files is safe to use,” noted a Home Office spokesman. Despite this, the Bretonian government has so far declined to join Liberty in condemning the Kusari Jump Drive program, instead arguing that Kusari had a legitimate right to pursue technological innovation. Government ministers have noted that the Jump Drive could be of great benefit to the Houses of Sirius, if properly regulated -- as a result, Bretonia has called for a summit on the technology’s licensing and use, but notably fell short of suggesting a ban on military deployments.

919045.text: ARK ROYAL -- 836 -- Admiralty officers are urgently re-evaluating defense planning in light of the Niyodo Files. The pacification of Dublin has demonstrated the utility of Jump Drives for bypassing fixed defenses, if at an astounding cost in fuel and maintenance. This capability now appears to be within reach of our adversaries, potentially imperilling the Northern Aegis doctrine of border forces and fortifications. The risk of aGallic first-strike into core Bretonian systems is an existential threat to the Kingdom. Budgetary constraints will complicate the process of developing technological Drive countermeasures, however doctrinal solutions and partnerships with other Houses may bear fruit.

919046.text: [752 AGS] Jump Drive a knife at Ile-de-France’s throat

919047.text: NEW PARIS -- 752 -- Libertonian criminals have leaked schematics for a ship-mounted Jump Drive. Once more, Kusari’s reckless and aggressive actions have placed the Gallic people in jeopardy, by opening a Pandora’s Box that will not be easily closed. The Union supports Liberty’s reasonable demands that Kusari destroy their weaponized Jump Drive program. The Grand Marechal immediately formed a bureau to counter the technology, which could allow feral Bretonian terrorists to launch assaults directly into Gallic territories. The Assembly has additionally been instructed to raise taxes to fund the mobilization of rapid response forces that will combat Jump Drive incursions and foreign threats.

919048.text: [752 AS] Grand Marechal demands Jump Drive investigation

919049.text: CALAIS -- 752 -- Following the distribution of apparent ship-mounted Jump Drive schematics, the Grand Marechal has ordered a bureau be convened to replicate this technology. The remote Calais Research Station has been selected as a venue, with specialist support from the EFL engineers of Abbeville Production Facility and hyperspace experts of Melun Research Institute. It is essential that Gallia is able to quickly produce this technology for deployment in an offensive capacity. This will ensure we possess an effective deterrent to interference in Gallia’s sphere of interest by the other Houses. The Gallic Navy have been ordered to present a modernised battlecruiser hull for primary testing.

919050.text: [836 AS] Rheinland seeks clarity on Jump Drive use

919051.text: NEW BERLIN -- 836 -- Following the leak of the Niyodo Files, Chancellor Neumann and Emperor Frederick have issued a joint statement seeking clarity from Kusari on the nature of their Jump Drive program, and future intentions regarding its use. Rheinland noted that it welcomes the development of new technological paradigms -- providing their benefits are shared with the wider sector. Rheinland hopes to see enhanced competition among the vendors of hyperspace infrastructure, which it says will drive innovation and reduce prices. Rheinland has to date been the sole battleground market between Ageira Technologies and EFL Oil and Machinery, with each corporation having to fiercely bid for development contracts.

919052.text: [836 AS] Jump Drive leak creates threats

919053.text: BADEN BADEN -- 836 -- Military and MND officers have convened to discuss the risks and benefits stemming from the Niyodo Files. It is agreed that Rheinland should urgently develop countermeasures to Jump Drive usage, to ensure Rheinland’s territorial integrity against first-strike attacks. While senior Admirals were content that such an attack was unlikely from any House peer, given current political and economic arrangements, a renewed threat was presented by terrorist forces such as the Red Hessians and Coalition. It was recognized that this was a double-edged blade, and the Drive could also offer strategic options for striking terrorist dens concealed beyond the traditional reach of Rheinland’s borders.

919054.text: [836 AS] Jump Drive leak creates opportunities

919055.text: BADEN BADEN -- 836 -- Military and MND officers have convened to discuss the risks and benefits stemming from the Niyodo Files. It is agreed that Rheinland should covertly develop its own Jump Drive capabilities, providing greater expeditionary reach into the Edge Worlds for the purposes of exploration and resource acquisition. Understanding Kusari’s method of hyperspace manipulation may enhance insights gathered from the Wexler Anomaly, potentially allowing for the expansion of Jump Stabilizer technology. The natural end-state of this project is the production of a domestic Rheinland Jump Gate -- this is likely beyond current budgetary constraints, but sets an ambitious goal for the next decade.

919056.text: [836 AS] Dragon commanders brace for attack

919057.text: KYOTO -- 836 -- Sympathisers within the Kusari regime have long warned us that the key ambition of the Jump Drive program is to launch an instantaneous military assault on Chugoku. Following the release of the Niyodo Files, Kusari is cornered -- there will be growing pressure to strike before rivals can develop a means of stopping their Drives. Accordingly, we must be prepared to imminently defend Kyoto in a decisive battle. The only way we can prevent this fate is by immediately drawing Liberty into the conflict, forcing Kusari to redeploy all available forces to its southern border. At that point, we will have the freedom to strike again at either Ichigaya Drydock or Kansai Research Institute.

919058.text: [836 AS] Jump Drive the result of Nomad collusion?

919059.text: AKABAT -- 836 -- The release of the Niyodo Files is of grave concern to The Order. While this action alone was severely irresponsible, The Order believes the Nomads may have colluded with Kusari to facilitate the fundamental research. We suspect this is part of a plot to fracture any remaining solidarity among the Houses. When fleets can bypass demilitarized buffer territories without warning, immediate militarization and pre-emptive aggression is the foreseeable response. It is vital that the Order designs and distributes a Drive suppressor. By ensuring the balance of power between the Houses, we prevent a calamitous series of wars that will threaten the survival of humanity as a whole.

919060.text: [836 AS] Outcast cartels ponder Jump Drive possibilities

919061.text: GALICIA -- 836 -- The Lane Hackers have recently dumped the schematics for a Kusari Jump Drive onto the public neural net. The devices appear to be incredibly expensive to produce, and well beyond the capabilities of most organizations -- including the Hackers themselves. The Dons have proposed funding several Hacker luminaries to travel to Galicia to lead an Outcast Jump Drive research initiative. This will aim to fit the Dreadnought Basilica with a functional Drive, ensuring unrivaled mobility and lethality across our territories. As a reward for success, procured specialists will be indulged with a permanent exile to Planet Malta, where they will live in unimaginable luxury for the remainder of their lives.

919063.text: DAGGER OUTPOST -- 836 -- Core executives have reacted with considerable interest to the recent disclosure of ship-mounted Jump Drive schematics. The Core has for some years struggled with the challenging logistics of supporting extraction efforts in the remote Omicrons, with hostile forces greatly complicating product exports to House clientele. A Core-branded Jump Drive would potentially circumvent these issues, while adding additional marketable IP to the Advanced Hardware lineup. Dagger Outpost has received orders to begin preliminary scoping works to determine the investment requirements for both facilities and material inputs. Further funding rounds will be launched shortly to cover these expenses.

919064.text: [836 AS] Jump technology promises new frontiers

919065.text: CORINTH ANNEX -- 836 -- The uncontrolled release of schematics for a ship-mounted Jump Drive has set the independent scientific community ablaze. The Zoners have immediately been seized by the possibilities, which could include surveys of distant stars without needing to rely on months-long cruises through interstellar space. Researchers aboard Corinth and Livadia in Omicron Kappa have issued a call for Zoners across Sirius to contribute resources and scientific skills to a “hyperspace working party”. It is currently unclear what facilities and manufacturing capabilities will be required, but confidence runs high that all obstacles can be overcome with persistence. Success here means prosperity for all Zoners.

919066.text: [836 AS] Kishiro addresses Jump Drive technology

919067.text: PLANET HONSHU -- 836 -- Kishiro Technologies have issued a statement on their plans for Jump Drive technology. Spokesman Sachio Matsuoka began by addressing the Niyodo Files, declaring that replicating the technology would be a “gross violation” of Kishiro’s property rights, and subject to extreme legal penalties. He further confirmed that the schematics were “incomplete”, and likely to result in total loss of life if activated. In partnership with Kusari's Ministry of Trade, Kishiro then stated their eventual intention to license devices to trusted partners in Bretonia and Rheinland. Kusari officials were unable to confirm an exact timetable, due to ongoing security concerns as to Liberty’s intentions.

919068.text: [836 AS] Liberty limps away from Ontario

919069.text: SUDBURY -- 836 -- Almost a year on from the loss of the Robert Peary, Liberty appears to have cut its losses and abandoned its final toehold in Ontario. The Battlecruiser Tuscaloosa was skulking around Planet Sudbury, looking into the alien ruin that fired a laser at Coronado last year. Locals have reported the distant flashes of blasts on the surface, and shuttles running back and forth from the ship. The LSF even initially attempted a direct bombardment -- despite that, the shield is still up and apparently unbothered. At last sighting, the Tuscaloosa was burning towards the system perimeter, and a long, quiet trip through the black. The residents of the newest Independent World can once more breathe a sigh of relief.

919071.text: TUSCALOOSA -- 836 -- Specialists aboard the Tuscaloosa were ordered to devise a means of deactivating or destroying Site Alpha -- the alien ruin buried on Planet Sudbury. Excavations over the last year have revealed the site shield is a perfect sphere, totally surrounding the facility. Efforts to compromise the shield before the Tuscaloosa’s supplies ran low have failed. As a contingency against Site Alpha falling into enemy hands, the battlecruiser’s magazine has been emptied, creating a shaped charge of gravimetric mines and antimatter warheads below the Site. The boreholes were collapsed, sealing this bomb below the facility. If the energy output of the shield significantly deviates, the bomb will detonate.

919073.text: OMEGA-47 -- 835 -- Numerous pilots have reported a significant skirmish in Omega-47 last week. The clash took place north of the system's central star, between the Corsairs and a combined Hessian-Coalition force. The confrontation inflicted heavy losses on all sides, leaving no faction satisfied with the outcome. This marks yet another bloody chapter in the relentless struggle for dominance in the Omegas between the Corsairs and the Red Alliance. Both sides hope controlling Omega-47 will open the flanks of Omega-5, securing a final decisive victory.

919074.text: [835 AS] Junker Convoy Attacked by Rheinlanders?

919075.text: BORNHOLM -- 835 -- Junkers on Bornholm Station in Omega-55 have reported unusual instances of Rheinland vessels attacking their convoys. The attacks have been so devastating that no ship has survived to recount the events firsthand. The only evidence the Junkers possess are intercepted radio signals emitted shortly before the convoys were presumably destroyed or captured. An official complaint has been filed with the Rheinland government, but there has yet to be an official response.

919076.text: [832 AS] Kaiser declares war on Hessians!

919077.text:
NEW BERLIN -- 832 AS -- Yesterday, our beloved Kaiser declared war on us! In a public broadcast, we've been compared to Rogues, rats and several other things, but no actual plan of action against us or our assets was made.

After declaring a massive 5％ increase in military spending and hurling a bunch of insults at us, we do not expect much to come out of this announcement, but as a precaution, command is issuing minor reinforcements of our most vulnerable asset: Leipzig Station. A number of fighter wings are being redeployed, including the Schalke Squadron, our latest addition to our forces, ready to show the Kaiser what they're made of!

We expect it all to be a crude attempt at increasing popular opinion without actually doing anything, but report any unusual Military movements directly to your superiors.

919079.text:
DRESDEN -- 832 AS -- Contrary to popular belief, the Military was actually preparing to conduct an assault on our positions in Dresden. An attack by a force led by Battleship Strausberg managed to blow up Bautzen that was in Bundschuh control, and proceeded to attack Leipzig.

The defenders despite being outnumbered valiantly kept the enemy occupied while Battleship Kassel got into position to ambush and critically wound the Strausberg, forcing the enemy to withdraw, and eventually scuttle the vessel, becoming a monument to Hessian control over the system. Unfortunately, the Leipzig was beyond saving, but their sacrifice will not be forgotten.

The loss of Strausberg caused riots sprung up all over Rheinland against Kaiser, demanding his resignation, which are further incited by numerous supporters to our cause. We expect a concentration of Military forces in the core systems, allowing us to pillage the border worlds all more easily as a result.
