991385.text: Looking for a good time, eh? Well you won't find one here. While the Zoners own this planet officially, they'll only keep it as long as they stay in Liberty's good graces. Therefore you'll not find too much illegal stuff going on here. Certainly nothing like you'll find out at Freeport 2 in Bering. Shame, really. It might liven up my job a bit.

991386.text: I just pulled a typical eight hour shift here. Once I'm done, I'm done. I don't care if someone commits a crime in front of me, I'm off home. The company doesn't pay overtime. Besides, the chances of a crime happening on this planet are remote. Half of the time I even get put in charge of traffic control. You know how many I've arrested this week? Yeah, that's right. I haven't arrested anyone. This posting sucks.

991387.text: This place is nice and safe, enjoy it. At least, that is what my friends tell me. The problem is, they're all earning the big bucks at Houston while I'm stuck here watching paint dry and listening to Zoner cattle ranchers having a quiet beer after a day of farming. I'm telling you, this place ain't for me. I've requested a transfer several times, but I always get told that there are no available positions. Those damn pen pushers up at the city hall really annoy me sometimes.

991388.text: I'm told that Liberty has invested loads into this planet, but it sure doesn't look like it. There isn't even a single strip club on the planet. Sure, there are plenty of bars, and there is an entertainment complex for movies and stuff that was built back in 812 AS, but that's about your lot. I hear that the entertainment facilities on Philadelphia are better, though. Gotta check them out sometime.

991389.text: I love this planet. It is so quiet and peaceful. There is hardly any crime here either. Officially the Zoners control Erie, but naturally Liberty has a vested interest here. I was posted here to keep my ears open for any information or rumours that might come my way, but there is hardly ever anything. Like I said, this place is quiet and peaceful. I'd prefer it if it stayed that way, although some people wouldn't, like that LPI officer, Jake Bullet.

991390.text: The Zoners colonized planet Erie in 761 AS, but Liberty moved into the system in 768 AS, after we realised that we'd screwed up in not bothering to colonize this system. I arrived here in '09, and enjoyed it so far. We've had a few problems with the Zoners on occasion, and we hear from our sources that the Xenos and the Liberty Rogues have both set up bases in the system fairly recently, but with the Gettysburg in orbit I doubt we'll get any problems on the planet itself.

991391.text: Why'd I join the LSF? Good pay, good hours, good medical care. It is not a bad job if you are careful. What did I do before this? Well I was a model doing work on Denver, and I still do some from time to time. Do you know that I was crowned Miss Alaska amongst the LSF? Maybe I'll even run for a senator position on Manhattan someday. Uh, you're asking me where Alaska is? Um... uh... it's a suburb of Crichton Springs on Denver. Yeah.

991392.text: I quite like this system, its quiet and the law doesn't bother you too much. There are quite a few bounties to be had here too, mostly Liberty Rogue and Xenos. Most of my compatriots work out of Houston, but this system has quite a few jump holes connecting to several other Liberty systems, and the criminals use them all the time. All I have to do is sit here and let them come through the jump holes, then zap em. Easy enough, eh?

991393.text: I was born on planet Hamburg originally, and lived there for quite a few years. My father was an executive for Republican Shipping while my mother worked in the offices that Universal Shipping has on Hamburg. They were killed in 807 AS by a Liberty Rogue ambush on the Texas side of the Jump Gate when their transport was destroyed. I considered joining the Rheinland Military, but they're too strict and they can't operate in Liberty, so I joined the Bounty Hunters Guild. I mainly target the Liberty Rogues and look for information on Rogue hideouts, and eventually I'll find out which ones killed my parents. And those won't end up on Sugarland by the time I'm done with them.

991394.text: I would say don't listen to my friend, Max Flight, but unfortunately his bragging isn't just bragging. He really is one of the best fighter pilots I have ever met. I guess he was aptly named. He might have a loud mouth, but you can rely on him to back you up in a fight. He took out seven Liberty Rogue fighters by himself last week, while I was out on patrol with him. I only killed two others. If it hadn't been for him and his prowess in a fighter craft, I think the Rogues might have killed us both.

991395.text: Yeah, I bagged me three Xenos earlier! Whoo! The Guild gets paid 40,000 credits by Liberty for every Xeno it takes out, and I get paid half of that. Then, I can send the kill records to Ageira for another 10,000 credits each. If I manage to take a Xeno captive, I can sell him to the LPI for 10,000! Not a bad job at all, eh?

991396.text: You should have seen that fight I was in earlier! Two Xenos tried to intercept me near the Texas jump hole and I had to bank so hard that I nearly slammed into an asteroid. I just managed to dodge it, but the Xeno tailing me wasn't so lucky. Then the second Xeno slipped into my sights and bam! I took it out with several well-placed shots from my Buckshots. That'll be another 60,000 credits in my pocket for those two.

991397.text: Huh, you wanna know about my name? My parents had a real sense of humour, I guess. I love it though! You don't even want to know my middle name, although it begins with F. Anyway, it kinda fits with what I do, so I ain't complaining.

991398.text: I've lived on Erie all my life, right here in the planetary capital city of Lake City. My parents were advocates of the Zoner way of life, and helped settle this planet when I was only 5 years old. There used to be quite a few virulent microorganisms on Erie, but they can only be transmitted by insect bites. Thankfully, all of the insect carriers were eliminated during the initial settlement, so you don't need to worry about getting any shots during your stay.

991399.text: Cattle ranches are big business on Erie, although in the southern hemisphere there is quite a considerable amount of atmospheric mining for Neon. There's a lot of Neon gas in the atmosphere, and it's extremely useful for various commercial applications, so the scientists and bigwigs tell me. I don't care really, so long as they leave me and my cattle alone.

991400.text: There was a battle in early 767 AS, right here in Lake City, which is the capital city of planet Erie as I'm sure you youngsters know already. We Zoners may be pacifistic and we try to keep a neutral stance, but we still get attacked, so we always have armed security for our protection. Anyway, these pirates attacked us and they'd landed their own forces to take control of the planet. Thing is, we don't like thuggish upstarts trying to take our homes away from us, and we gave 'em hell. Unfortunately, there were more of 'em than there were of us and if it weren't for the Liberty Navy intervening, Erie'd probably be a pirate stronghold by now. Of course, I doubt Liberty saved us out of the goodness of their hearts, as they themselves moved into the system a year later, but we still owe them our lives, so I guess we've got to thank them Libertonians for something.

991401.text: I work in the Neon mining industry in the south, and it pays well enough. While Neon isn't flammable or particularly toxic, the gas requires an extensive cooling plant in order to seperate it from the atmosphere. When the coolers fail, the gases boil quickly and the tanks can explode. Ruptures in the tanks can also snapfreeze anyone standing close by in case of a spill. Not a very nice way to go...

991402.text: Erie is a large Neon exporter - it has a number of commercial applications that have made it valuable. It is most commonly used in cryogenics and refrigeration since Nitrogen and Helium are rather more expensive to mine, and it is also used in constructing laser weaponry and some lights. Of course, since the annexation, most of the Zoner plants were "sold" to Liberty corporations or closed down over "regulatory violations".

991403.text: Looking for jump holes? Hmm, I can tell you where one is. Look on your Nav map. You'll find the Texas jump hole to the far south of this planet, even further south than the suns in this system. Be careful though, I hear there's a Xeno base out that way.

991404.text: I was born on Los Angeles, but I grew sick of the endless smell of Synth Crop on the wind. I'm telling you now, it's disgusting. Then again, maybe you like Synth Paste? You look the type. In any case, I eventually got tired of living in the corporate state that is Liberty and decided to head out and live on Freeport 2 for a while, before being asked by a few friends to come here. It's not a bad place, but not where I envisioned ending up. Still, it is better than Los Angeles.

991405.text: You can get a good price for Gaian Wildlife here, if you happen to be over in Bretonia and are thinking of shipping something back. Of course, the Bretonian and Liberty governments generally consider those live animals from planet Gaia in the Edinburgh system to be illegal, so watch yourself if you choose to transport them. Still, think of the money.

991406.text: I'm in charge of one of the heavy transports that make the run from here to Corfu carrying supplies of Neon gas for the researchers there. I'm not sure why they need so much of the gas. Maybe they're doing some kind of cryogenic research there... It is a long run and quite dangerous in places, especially in the Omegas, but it is worth it once you get there. I will soon have earned enough to retire.

991407.text: I know of a jump hole to the California system, in the far west of the system in relation to your nav map display. I hear either the Rogues or the Junkers have a base somewhere out that way too, but I wouldn't put too much stock in rumours. Never been out that way myself, I tend to stick to the Trade Lane network wherever I can, it is much safer.

991408.text: I hate flying through here, even if the infrastructure leading between the two gates is safe enough. My eyes keep playing tricks on me, seeing things out in that big dark nothing, shapes stirring in the black. I try not to stay out here too long because of it.

991409.text: We knew we were taking a risk by sticking with our station even in the thick of the storm, but it seems to have paid off. Our biggest concern was that the lull of traffic would make surviving out here tough, but the new dark and eerie form that the system has taken makes it appealing to tourists and explorers. The odd commercial ship will also chance it to save time wasted on the bypass, but they don't always make it.

991410.text: Between you and me, Ageira's been really interested in Kepler after the storm settled. Apparently it's safe, well at least safe enough, to keep the network here online. They've hired us to cull the rabble running around every so often, probably to keep their own teams investigating in the system safe.

991411.text: Those scummy Bounty Hunters have been pouring into the system lately. They seem to mostly target the lurking Hackers, they move in packs and shoot to kill. They're just as quick in gutting our ships too, so we've had to step up our game a little to keep them from getting the drop on us too often. This place just got a whole lot more lively, and I think I like it.

991412.text: Ageira thinks they're being clever with that retinue of Hunters they've let loose on our operations in the system. But their successes are few and far between, our eyes and ears on the other side of the corporate veil warn us when a trap is going to be sprung.

991413.text: System is rife with opportunity these days. But if you want my advice, stick to the lanes and run like hell if anyone pulls you out of them. You won't last long trying to run off grid, and if you get stranded out here you might never get found.

991414.text: We call the tunnel that's formed around the lanes here the murky road, should be obvious why.

991415.text: Explorers and salvagers are a common sight here nowadays. They don't always stay around long and some of them don't even come back at all, no idea what it is they're looking for. Maybe they want to see if this storm dragged anything in with it? More likely they're just insane.

991419.text: We have been experimenting with Cardamine in an attempt to make it grow inside the station's bio-dome. If this venture proves successful we would no longer be chained to Malta. Sadly there has been little success so far.

991434.text: Our cause was torn apart not so long ago, but in finding common ground with our brethren of the same trade we have returned to take back what is ours. Mark my words, we will not break a second time, it's time Synth Foods did.

991435.text: So many new faces, it's almost startling. Feels like not so long ago I was trying to move on with life and find a new way to pursue our dream. But now that I'm back here again, I never want to have to do that again.

991436.text: Their cultures might be different and we may not always see eye to eye on things, but our partners have only been helpful so far. We're able to project so much more force now, it's honestly impressive. Synth Foods ought to watch their backs.

991437.text: We recently reached out to our likeminded dissidents in House Rheinland and struck an agreement. They found that our movement was essentially an umbrella they could act under, and we agreed to support them in tackling Synth. Together, I feel we will do a better job in curtailing those foul people and their so called product.

991438.text: I expected our benefactors might take offense to our initiative of linking up with other farmers, but they were actually supportive. They must realize it's simply more efficient this way.

991439.text: Damn farmers are cooperating, it was bad enough that Rheinland tried and failed to give us the boot. Now just when business is starting to look up, these desperate imbeciles who couldn't compete show their faces again. Can't they see that our product is just better?

991440.text: After the end of the Nomad War, I decided that my skills and knowledge would be better served with the Order. Besides, I wanted to learn more about the Daam-K'Vosh! Oh, if only my peers at the Cambridge Institute could see me now! They'd die of envy.

991441.text: Yes, I remember Edison Trent. He was a bit too mercenary for my tastes, but he came through in the end for humanity. Whatever else that could be said about him, humanity owes him a great debt, as we couldn't have defeated the Nomads without all his help. As for where he is now? I have no idea. The last I heard he was in Liberty, working on something for the Order, but he could be anywhere now.

991442.text: These Nomads who have infested people...these "Wild", as people refer to them as...they seem to be operating somewhat beyond the normal levels of autonomy of Nomads as we understand it. Perhaps it is prolonged integration with a human host, I don't know, but they certainly seem to be able to function better on their own and for longer periods and distances from the rest of this telepathic network that they appear to have. Don't ask me what the telepathic network is exactly, because it's very difficult to explain, and I'd have to use a lot of language that you wouldn't understand.

991443.text: Nauru? Oh yes, in the Omicron Delta system. Those ruins are quite impressive, and all the more so for not even knowing who built them. It definitely wasn't the Daam-K'Vosh or the Slomon K'Hara, and although some artifacts discovered match with technology used by the Phantom terrorist organisation, they did not create it and they did not build the ruins either. Quite a mystery, eh?

991444.text: I hate the fact that the Order are so badly misrepresented by all the Sirius Houses, especially with all the work that has been done to keep them safe from the Nomads. I have been trying to use my contacts back on planet Cambridge to get the Queen to acknowledge their sacrifices for the good of humanity, and we seem to have some progress. The problem is actually getting someone close to the Queen to actually listen to us, before we can even consider getting an audience with the Queen herself.

991445.text: My colleagues here on Toledo tell me that Tekagi's Arch has been inhabited once again by the infested humans known as the "Wild", but at this present time we do not have the available forces to mount any kind of attack against it. The Blood Dragons and the Golden Chrysanthemums have been alerted to the nature of the threat, and I can only hope that they are capable of keeping them in check for the time being.

991462.text: Welcome to Peterborough, youngest station in Bretonia as of 819 AS, and still under construction. But that doesn't mean we don't have any fair Bretonian Stout here. Or an abundance of Beryllium for that matter. The boys in their mining ships are quickly tagging the richest deposits of Beryllium in the field. Early mining operations always start with a high yield before mining begins in earnest.

991463.text: If you ask me, the Crown should simply have nationalised Cardiff. That would have both given us all the infrastructure we need, and put an end to the IMG operations in the system so that all profits from Cambridge could go to the Crown. The IMG decided against siding with Bretonia. That makes them as bad as the enemy.

991464.text: With the first three smelters operational, we can produce roughly 15 isotons of ore at a variable purity on the refined product. Once the other 9 come online, we'll have at least 30 percent more capacity then Cardiff does. That will allow us to undercut the IMG operation, so long as we get enough raw materials delivered.

991465.text:
A Molly and a Corsair are both aboard a ship. Who's driving? Well?
Why, the Constable of course!

991466.text: One of these days I'm going to visit Trafalgar, and make a Corsair snack on a Cardamine-laced crumpet, and cam the whole thing. I bet that would be a hit on NeuraTube! Ten thousand thumbs up at least!

991467.text: I once knew a joke about paper, but forgot what it was about. It was... tearable.

991468.text: As far as BMM postings go, this station isn't half bad. Sure, it's a new facility and bound to have a few teething problems. But I'd rather be here then on Graves. We're smackdab in the middle of a busy trade route, which means that in case of attacks, we'll have Police and Armed Forces from Planet Cambridge not too far away.

991469.text: There's rumors of another increase in the worktimes due to the ongoing war. Not sure what it'll accomplish - people can only be pushed so far, you know? Before soon people will start napping or drinking on the job, and that's when accidents start to happen.

991470.text: They say that space is dangerous. I believe that, so I signed up for stationboard duty. Sure, the view isn't as great in the smelter 3 control room, but at least you don't get your ship shot out from under you by Mollys, Corsairs, Hessians, Gaians... need I go on?

991471.text: If you handle any broken storage containers which contained Beryllium, don't forget to wash thoroughly afterward. Beryllium is toxic and will slowly poison you. Handling Beryllium is part of the job here. Staying alive however isn't in the job description - it's just common sense.

991472.text: Beryllium is essential to the Bretonian economy because it's used many ways - Engine Component construction, Nuclear Reactors, Radiation Shielding. But most essentially for us, it is part of the Bretonian Super Alloy synthesis. BMM and Bowex refused to be dependent on the IMG for their supply of Beryllium, so the Crown nationalised the Beryllium deposits north of Cambridge for exclusive use by us.

991473.text: Mollys and Gaians have both started to show an uncanny interest in this station. So far nothing serious, but it is a sign of things to come. The Gaians probably worry that we'll end up damaging Planet Cambridge, but there's very little risk since we barely do any smelting on this base. The Mollys are just being their destructive selves.

991474.text: Finally a familiar run again. Albeit with a slightly changed starting point. Delivering Beryllium to Liberty was one of the runs I was often assigned to before the Tau war. Good folk, down in Liberty. Well, except the Xenos of course. And the Rogues. And Lane Hackers. But otherwise, good folk! Always kind enough to set me up with a load of Light Arms or Superconductors to bring back to Bretonia.

991475.text: Those Gateway boys must be seething now that we're cutting into one of their prime traderoutes. Delivering Beryllium to Rheinland and undercutting the IMG and Gateway would be a major blow to their business. I wonder if the bosses could persuade the Crown to offer a few "incentives" to get Peterborough going...

991476.text: The Corsairs are a bigger problem on this side of the system then the Mollys are. Near the Keswick that changes, so I guess they come from there. Another reason to take this route rather then to pass by Cardiff - you only have one set of ruffians to deal with.

991521.text: Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing\nPortsmouth Ship Dealer\nRay Finnes

991525.text: Liberty Security Force\nAmarna Commissary Officer\nCoordinator Mason Roxwell

991526.text: Liberty Security Force\nAmarna Quartermaster\nCoordinator Ian Stephenson

991539.text: You heard? Apparently one of the guys that broke outta Attica was some big-shot Rogue boss. Word around town is, he plans to gather up some of the bigger gangs and unite 'em... y'ask me? I'm filing for an early retirement the second I catch wind of that.

991540.text: This is gonna sound crazy, but... when I'm out on patrol, I can't shake the feelin' something is watching me. Y'know, like... in the clouds behind me, or somethin'.

991541.text: One of the boys got stabbed here last week. Last I heard, he's gonna end up losing most of his fingers. That'll teach ya - don't try to stop a knife with your bare hands.

991542.text: This bar's got the best drinks on all of Manhattan, and the price ain't half bad either.

991543.text: I don't know how much longer I'm gonna stay in this job. Partner of mine went off to work for the Guild on Deshima, ended up bagging enough bounties to retire comfortably in a year. Me? I'll be lucky if the Chief sends me a Sunbucks gift card.

991546.text: On one hand I am sad this planet did not burn, on the other hand I am glad for a place to sell my stolen goods.

991547.text: I dont know what you are thinking, but it is not what you think.

991548.text: I would very much like to kill everyone in this bar. Why? Nobody gets along, not for long anyway. If criminals like us spent less time killing eachother fighting over scraps, we might have a chance against the big boys.

991550.text: The wreck of a Royal Navy destroyer captained by Émilien Bouchard. The Guépard was last sighted in 826 AS, as part of a flotilla of mutinous Royalist warships fleeing from the glassing of Leeds. The Guépard appears to have suffered catastrophic damage to the engine compartment, leading to total depressurization.

991960.text: Those Zoner seperatists sure choose a good time to cause all this trouble. I had just heard that the Liberty government was seizing all Samura assests in Liberty, so I snuck my ship out in the chaos, but I only made it this far. I just hope they have more than those signs to keep away any Navy forces....

991962.text: The Kuji-yama was last seen departing Pittsburg in a rush, off the trade-lane network, after the captain had a rushed call over the neural net. It is expected the it meet its end at the hands of the local criminals, though no group has claimed responsibility yet.

991963.text: The Order pilots keep a tight lip on what's going on; but when every other patrol comes back with one less ship, you know it's bad out there.

992004.text: We recently cracked the security protocols for Farmers Alliance transponders. For %d0 credits we can plant the data trail that will give you some basic cover. Don't get too close to their patrols or bases, or they'll blow your cover.

992005.text: Zoner is often a self-imposed label, but transponders are registered to particular Zoner Freeports or colonies. For %d0 credits we can plant the data trail that will give you a plausible Freeport paper trail. Try not to blow your cover.

992006.text: The Independent Miners Guild have a somewhat open door to those fleeing other industrial corporations. This has given us ample opportunity to install our own agents. For %d0 credits, they can plant the data trail that will give you a plausible Guild transponder. Try not to blow your cover.

992008.text: As the Battleship Hamamatsu struck Norfolk Shipyard, Deshima Station was simultaneously brought back under state control. The Bounty Hunters Guild have proven very useful in Shikoku over the years, but the organization simply poses too high a risk in a time of war. I do not doubt the Guild is riddled with LSF informants and agents. We had no choice but to instruct them to depart Kusari.

992009.text: Deshima is a critical supply point for projecting force into Liberty. Its hangars and cargo warehouses dwarf those of our battleships, allowing us to garrison a great many strike squadrons and all of their support staff. A great deal of work is underway to convert the factories and other facilities to purposes that will further aid us in our efforts against Liberty.

992010.text: Operation Ichi-Go -- the first strike against Liberty -- was as successful as we could have hoped for. Our ambition was to cow the Libertonians with a show of overwhelming power, that lays bare their vulnerability to our superior technology. We can strike anywhere, no-where is safe. Once they fully absorb this lesson, we expect they will seek to negotiate terms. The war will be over in a matter of weeks.

1114184.text: A remote field of rock asteroids. Beryllium mining operations were once conducted within the field's outskirts.

1114186.text: Commonly know as "The Devil's Golf Course" by the Xenos, this asteroid field contains no known usable resources. However, the high density of the rocks makes it perfect for defending the field against larger, less maneuverable vessels. This, along with the presence of very large asteroids in the field, are among the reasons that the Xenos chose it for the site of Refugio Base.

1114188.text: Commonly known as "Lake Manly" by the Xenos, this field is the Xenos' primary source of Water. Some of the water is mined directly by small freighters, but the great majority is collected at Gonzales Station and transferred to Refugio for further processing into the drinking water, oxygen, and fuel that the Xenos need to survive.

1114194.text:
DIAMETER: 6,485 km
MASS: 4.73 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: -38°C to 69°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.04 km/sec

Commonly referred to as "Death Valley" by the Xenos, this planet was first surveyed by Deep Space Engineering in 790 AS and designated "SAC-II". DSE soon constructed a survey outpost, Alamo, in near orbit. When the Xenos moved into Kansas, destroying Alamo in the process, they named the planet "Death Valley", a name which has stuck ever since.

The most notable feature of the planet's surface is a three-mile-tall mountain called Dusty Peak, first discovered by Xeno pilot Glenn Thacker during a short expedition to the planet's surface. The rest of the planet is largely dusty and featureless, with only small mountain ranges and valleys occasionally interrupting endless desert.

The planet contains untapped mineral resources of unknown limits, but the atmosphere is thin and poor in oxygen, with the magnetosphere unstable, making any sort of settlement an unlikely prospect. This difficulty is compounded by Death Valley's location in the remote Kansas system. While the Xeno presence in Kansas is sparse, they have been known to go out of their way to disable, chase off, or destroy any ship that looks to be surveying Death Valley, and some speculate they hope the planet's resources will be a source of jobs for them in the case their war against Liberty's government is won.

1114199.text: [819 AS] Rheinland Forces Destroy Jump Gates To Hamburg!

1114200.text: MANHATTAN -- 819 AS -- In what military analysts call an act of desperation, Rheinland has sabotaged and destroyed both the Bering and Hudson Jump Gates leading into Hamburg. The damage is still being assessed, but initial scans by Deep Space Engineering maintenance teams suggest the gates are both a total loss. Carriers Roanoke and Weatherlight were both lost to the Rheinland Jump Gate sabotage, with over half their crew lost in the subsequent implosion.\nThis unprecedented move has effectively ceded both Bering and Hudson to Liberty. While Liberty Naval patrols will keep a close eye on any Rheinland activity, it seems likely the bulk of the Rheinland fleet will now concentrate its actions in New Hampshire, where Battleship Concord was forced to withdraw.\nWith Hudson no longer in dispute, Liberty has dispatched Battleship Alma to secure the Atka terraforming operation, and has asked Planetform to resume the terraforming process.

1114201.text: [818 AS] Daumann Engineers Develop New Ship

1114202.text: THE RING -- 818 AS -- Despite the relentless Libertonian push on our fatherland, the last few months of war were not in vain! Daumann engineers have today unveiled the product of many months of development, designed to support our operations on the very front: the Elbe class carrier. Financed in part by the wealthy Rutger family from New Berlin, the design was completed just a few months ago after a complete battlefield analysis of Liberty Navy force composition. This ship was thus designed from the ground up to supplement Rheinland forces against the Libertonian invader. Its armament and size will make it especially effective in supporting the fighter craft based from its landing bays. The ship is expected to make its first appearance on the front lines in a few weeks time.

1114203.text: [818 AS] Naval Forces Deploy New Battlecruiser

1114204.text: YOKOHAMA -- 818 AS -- The Komainu class battlecruiser is a rare example of the engineering prowess of Kusari's two great keiretsu joined in one hull and the latest addition to the Kusari Naval Forces shipline. The project has lead many critics to wonder what might have been achieved if Samura and Kishiro had set aside their commercial ambitions much earlier in service to the State.\n\nIn the clear expanse of Kusari hub systems, the advantage was with the largest and most heavily armored of capital ships. However, the Komainu was designed for a significantly different theatre of war. While the Kusari Battleships blazed a path through the Tau systems and into Bretonia, they struggled to maintain an efficient hold on that territory due to the hostile maneuvering environment of the asteroid fields. In their stead, the Komainu guards the gates of Kusari in the Tau systems, and combines a sleek hull with the firepower to destroy any threat to its sacred home.

1114205.text: [818 AS] Kusari Declares War Against Gallia!

1114206.text: NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- In a shock announcement, the Shogun of the Kusari Government has declared war against the Kingdom of Gallia. Efforts to negotiate a settlement regarding a joint invasion of Bretonia have broken down, and fighting between elements of the GRN and KNF are already coming in from across the Tau sector. Casualties are expected to be high, with initial reports suggesting many thousands could perish within the first few weeks of conflict.

1114207.text: [818 AS] Gallia Claims Tau-31, Kusari Forces Mobilise

1114208.text: NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- The Kingdom of Gallia, a relative newcomer in Sirius politics, was today reported to have sent an invasion fleet into independent Tau-23 and Tau-31 and has requested all military forces present there to withdraw immediately. The Gallia Royal Navy, the main naval force behind their house, is estimated to hold numbers far exceeding those of even the greatly overdeveloped Liberty Navy, to this date considered the largest navy in the colonies. Although it is currently unclear whether Gallia forces have any intent to fire on Kusari forces enforcing the imperial claim to Tau-31, The Kusari Government has called for an immediate meeting between commanders from both sides, referring to the Gallic claims as "deeply offensive to the Kusari nation".\n\nThe Honourable Emperor Jien Kogen is currently personally leading Kusari Naval Forces in Leeds despite mounting pressure for his return home. His response to the situation is as of yet unknown.

1114209.text: [818 AS] Tau Border Worlds Taken By Gallia

1114210.text: JAVA -- 818 AS -- In as many years as the Independent Miners Guild has existed, the Tau systems have never witnessed a troop movement on this scale as the one we are witnessing right now. Gallia, a new arrival on the Sirius political scene, did not waste time in making war on two of the biggest warmongers. The force they sent in to seize the systems separating the two however outnumbers both the Bretonian and Kusari navies combined. This means that Tau-23 and Tau-31 is now officially under Gallia rule, with all IMG personnel subject to their war time laws. IMG Guild Masters are wasting no time in assuring the public that they will do everything in their power to ensure that this transition goes through as smoothly as possible.\n\nNiobium prices are expected to rise as a result of the added danger of operating here, so hopefully not a great lot of you will leave the confines of Java station for safer pastures.

1114211.text: [818 AS] Naval Forces Stuck In Bretonia?

1114212.text: HOLMAN -- 818 AS -- The last five years have been anything but boring for the inhabitants of Holman: the Bretonian-Kusari war, Bretonian occupation soon turning into Kusari occupation, many "accidental" shots hitting Holman itself through all the fighting occuring right next to it, and now Tau-31 seized by storm by the biggest naval taskforce seen to date in the history of the colonies. It would seem that the only option left for Holman is either to evacuate themselves to safety or to bow down to their new Gallian overlords. But can Gallia really hold Tau-31? Even though Kusari officially backed out of the war, a large chunk of their navy disagrees with this decision. Supposedly led by their former Emperor Jien Kogen, they have banded together with what remains of the Bretonian Armed Forces in Newcastle, bent on kicking the Gallia Naval Forces out of Tau-31. Only time will tell if they will succeed however.

1114213.text: [818 AS] Armistice Signed With Kusari Forces

1114214.text: NEW LONDON -- 818 AS -- In the face of the impending Gallia invasion fleet and rising threat of an attack on Leeds, the Kusari Emperor-in-Exile has seen fit to step forward and present the Queen's government with an offer of peace and alliance against the Royal Navy. The Queen has officially signed the agreement only yesterday, but the general order to cease all hostility against former KNF forces in Bretonia has already been issued. The secretary of state has also used the occassion to announce a call to arms, stressing the inevitability of the Gallian invasion of Bretonia. The remaining Kusari forces in Bretonia are expected to make their base somewhere in Newcastle, and will help with the defense of the system against any Gallian attacks.

1114215.text: [818 AS] ATTN Naval Forces: Our Current Situation

1114216.text:
BATTLESHIP YAMAGUCHI -- 818 AS -- In light of the recent events on the Bretonian front, the honourable Emperor Kogen addresses all Naval Forces still under Imperial command:

"To Our Honourable Samurai still serving in the war against the foreign devils,
After years of victories against the Bretonians, nobody could have ever expected such a course of events to come to bear. The past from Sol is coming back to haunt us in the form of this French house, declaring war upon us from a position of surprise and dishonour. Their limitless hordes are too many to stand against on our lonesome, even for such proven warriors as the valiant Seto battlegroup. We will receive no more support from our homeland, as they have decided to abandon my wisdom in favour of what they perceive to be their own.

We cannot, will not dishonour those who died for Kusari's right to the Tau sector by retreating like cowards! The Kusari Naval Forces are proud, we cannot be defeated! Making war on the Bretonians was honourable, we fought each other from a position of tactics and the superiority of ideals. This Gallia has no regard for either ideals, nor tactics, nor honour!

My fellow samurai, the Bretonians may be our enemy but our feud was interrupted and defiled, and for this affront we must strike back. We will reclaim Tau-31 from the dishonourable Gallians so that we can finish what has been started."

1114218.text: NEW LONDON -- 818 AS -- The New London Parliament has spent the last few days discussing almost exclusively matters of war as the threat of an invasion of Leeds, much bigger than what was ever expected from Kusari forces, now forms like a shadow cast by the incredible numbers of ships that Gallia has sent to fuel their imperialist conquest of the Tau systems. Several measures were passed by almost unanimous vote, including forming an emergency leading party coalition for the duration of the war with Gallia, war time resource rationing and, perhaps most controversially, a general draft. All able bodied citizens from ages 18 to 40 will soon be receiving their draft letters and will be commissioned as either full time troops or reserves. All Bretonian shipbuilding companies are expected to receive large scale rapid ship construction contracts shortly as a direct result of this.

1114219.text: [818 AS] Council Forces Evacuated From Languedoc

1114220.text: TOULOUSE -- 818 AS -- As the last Council evacuation ship makes it out of Languedoc toward the newly colonized system of Roussillon, Council forces breathe a sigh of relief knowing they have managed to get away from the blunt hammer of the Royal Navy forces. While it was obvious from the start that Languedoc would not be held for very long, it seems the Council has far underestimated the veracity of the Royal Navy as the first assault waves advanced into the system long before the end of the evacuation effort. The evacuation was nonetheless completed successfully thanks to the valiant efforts of a last ditch defense fleet who have managed to hold the Royal Navy at bay at great cost. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten, nor will it be in vain. The Council will begin efforts to sabotage Royal Navy operations in the Tau sector within the space of a few weeks.

1114221.text: [819 AS] Liberty Attacks Research Outpost In Bremen!

1114222.text: HAMBURG -- 819 AS -- Rheinland defense forces in Bremen sent out a general distress call today following an unexpected suicide attack by the Liberty Navy which successfully disabled the Battleship Westphalia and allowed a good portion of their strike force waiting on the other side to jump through unharmed. The Liberty forces used a similar tactic to the one use by the Kusari Naval Forces in their breakthrough to Leeds over two years ago. While the heroic crew of the Westphalia restored their stricken vessel, the Liberty fleet attacked and plundered a civilian research outpost elsewhere in the system. Reinforcements from New Berlin quickly drove back the attackers, destroying a good number of them. The Westphalia is reported to be pursuing the remaining attackers in New Hampshire.

1114224.text: VIERNHEIM -- 819 AS -- After years of Hessian occupation, the Corsairs have finally launched an attack strong enough to overwhelm the defense at Casablanca and have retaken the base. It has taken them more than eight years to accomplish this, and it was something that allowed the Red Hessian movement to continuously raid their supply transports to and from Gran Canaria, dealing the Corsairs greater blows than on any other front. While this will undoubtedly create new battle lines in Omega-47 and Omega-5 now that the Corsairs have secured their supply line, the Red Hessian Oberkommando has stated that counter assaults are already in preparation and that the war over Omega-47 is only set to escalate. Meanwhile, Omega-47 operational command has been moved to Viernheim base, which has been fortified against possible Corsair raiding parties. Preparations for the first counterstrike continue.

1114225.text: [819 AS] The Council Begins Munitions Sales to Sirian Factions

1114226.text: TOULOUSE -- 819 AS -- Capitalizing on the proficiency of its work force in the munitions industry, The Council's first industrial product manufactured in its new home is Munitions. The Munitions are being stockpiled to replenish the fleet from its recent operations against the Royal Fleet, but are also being sold throughout Sirius to factions who are desperate for a reliable, low cost source of Munitions on the black market. The Council sees these economic ties as the beginning of possible new alliances for the faction, as well as a way to create sympathy and attract support for their own fight against the Crown.

1114227.text: [819 AS] Outcast Shipwrights Unveil New Ship Designs

1114228.text: MALTA -- 819 AS -- Outcast shipwrights at Malta have announced that a new line of ships specifically tailored to Outcast needs are now available. Visitors of Malta who frequented the Valletta Shipyard have likely already caught a glimpse of these ships. Dubbed the "Conquistador" line, these ships are sleighted to slowly replace the aging "Borderworld" line, which has been the mainstay of the Outcasts for over five centuries. The designs have reportedly received mixed results, with some pilots indicating they would prefer to stick with the proven models, such as the Dagger or Sabre, while others favor the narrower profile of the Gladius or Rapier.

1114229.text: [819 AS] The Council Relying on Soft Diplomacy

1114230.text: TOULOUSE -- 819 AS -- The Council knows that the establishment of long term diplomatic relations with the Houses of Sirius is in its best interests, and is critical to its desire to end the war between Gallia and Sirius. The reprocessing of the atmospheric toxins into Hydrogen Cyanide - a powerful but extremely toxic solvant - is quickly becoming the main export product of the nascent civilisation that established itself in Roussillion. The Council sees trade with foreign powers as an important step towards establishing friendly relations, in a time where most people know Gallia only as invaders.

1114231.text: [819 AS] Sirius Robotics Strikes Deal with IMG

1114232.text: ALAND SHIPYARD -- 819 AS -- Sirius Robotics signed a lease with the IMG entitling the robotics manufacturer to industrial production space on board Aland Shipyard. The small company, which has quickly become a leader in robotics innovations and design, is taking aim at Ageira's and Kishiro's market shares in consumer robotics. The deal to manufacture robotics on Aland positions the company astride existing logistical routes, but removes it from oversight from what it calls "intrusive and sedentary House bureaucracies" that hamper the progress of technological development. Ageira contends that its products have withstood the test of centuries, and its track record speaks for itself, predicting that Sirius Robotics will "bankrupt itself even faster than its gadgets and gizmos malfunction".

1114233.text: [819 AS] Junyo Fire Pearls are Hot Items

1114234.text: JUNYO -- 819 AS -- The discovery two years ago of unique mollusks in Planet Junyo's deep oceans ignited a fire storm of interest on the part of Kusari marine biologists. The interest soon spread to the board room of Samura Industries, which established multiple deep sea farming operations on Junyo to cultivate the small shell-dwelling creatures that produce unique red-tinged pearls. Early attempts to grow the mollusks at shallower depths failed, apparently due to the mollusks' strange biological need for the higher pressure environments found in the deep oceans in order to survive. Fire Pearls quickly became the hottest selling items across Sirius' jewelry markets, and top designers in all the Houses have adapted them into their new fashion collections. Samura boasts that Fire Pearls may soon rival diamonds as a "lady's best friend," but Daumann and Kruger spokesmen dispute such claims, reminding consumers that pearls are easily ground into dust, but "diamonds are forever".

1114235.text: [819 AS] ALG's Nuclear Devices Certified Safe and Secure

1114236.text: NEW BERLIN -- 819 AS -- In its latest bid to pacify anxious politicians across Sirius, the Chief Science Officer of ALG Waste Disposal held a press conference on Planet New Berlin while flanked by nuclear physicists from major universities in Rheinland, Kusari, and Bretonia. Responding to numerous rumors about ALG's Nuclear Devices being unsafe during transport, or potentially lethal in the hands of criminal or terrorist groups, ALG's CSO presented certifications from nuclear physics departments at major Sirian universities showing that Nuclear Devices are both safe and secure from tampering. The CSO stated, "Nuclear Devices possess multiple safety protocols and fail safe measures that totally eliminate any possibility of meltdown or explosion. The devices are constructed to "scram", that is to shut off all fission activity as their default state, making them unusable for military purposes. The anti-tampering mechanisms make the fissionable material in the core entirely secure from unauthorized extraction or detonation. ALG's Nuclear Devices are fully as secure as Ageira's legendary white boxes."\nSimilar assurances from leading Sirian nuclear physicists are expected to result in the removal of the restrictive political measures enacted regarding transportation and sale of the devices, since, as the academicians note, these restrictions are based on "false, misleading, and superstitious notions" rather than scientific facts. Supporting statements released by the public affairs bureaus of the four House militaries confirm the reliability of ALG's Nuclear Devices, noting the lack of a single instance where a Nuclear Device has caused any loss of life or hazardous nuclear spill.

1114237.text: [819 AS] OSC Expands into the Luxury Goods Market

1114238.text: CURACAO -- 819 AS -- Anxious to diversify it revenue streams, Orbital Spa and Cruise has established several lines of luxury products. Planet Curacao's unique native tea species is being harvested for sale throughout Bretonia and Kusari. "Miracle elixirs" are being marketed as novelty drinks throughout the Houses.\nIn a risky gamble to enter the technology field, OSC has contracted with several famed Kusari artists to produce Holosculptures on board Luxury Liners Hawaii and Mackinac and sell them throughout the Houses. Visitors can watch the artists at work in their studios, and for a large fee can commission specific art works or sit for portraits.

1114239.text: [819 AS] HazMat Canisters - Waste Containment Breakthrough

1114240.text: DORTMUND -- 819 AS -- ALG Waste Disposal has fired a shot across the bow of its rival BMM for dominance in the toxic waste industry. ALG's HazMat Canisters offer a high technology solution for industries across Sirius. While until now industry had to risk toxic leaks while accumulating enough material to justify dispatch of a waste disposal vessel, ALG's HazMat Canisters offer a safe, durable solution that eliminates the need for costly waste containment areas near industrial sites. The canisters can be safely and reliably stored in any normal environmental conditions, and their contents may be transferred directly to the cargo holds of ALG Movers without danger of leak or local contamination. Privately, ALG executives are reported to be confidant that their new innovation will push BMM right out of the toxic waste business altogether, and that governments will soon ban the more common dumps into gas giants completely.

1114241.text: [819 AS] Human Trafficking Ring Busted on Sugarland

1114242.text: MANHATTAN -- 819 AS -- Sugarland Prison's long time warden and several of his deputies were forced into permanent retirement after conviction for numerous counts of felonious conduct for their operation of a "labor racket" on board the prison. After a lengthy investigation by the LSF, the LPI's upper echelons of management on Sugarland were indicted and subsequently convicted of several thousand counts of felony kidnapping, false imprisonment, and conspiracy, among other crimes. Some of the felonious acts date to the warden's former posting as a LPI officer on Planet Houston.\nRather than facing certain death by imprisonment alongside their former prisoners, or construction of expensive isolation cells on Huntsville or Sugarland, the former LPI officers have been given sentences of hard labor for life in Pittsburgh's boron mines, where authorities assure the public they will both be punished and prevented from further exploiting Liberty's most vulnerable members of society.\nThe conclusion of the trials brings an end to a sordid tale of corruption, exploitation, and alleged slavery that have plagued Houston politics for decades, and mired the LPI in scandal for over a year. An LPI spokesman hailed the verdicts as long overdue justice and pledged that "Liberty is once again a safe haven for the unfortunate, and free of the wicked institution of slavery that exploits the vulnerable for the enrichment of the unscrupulous." Liberty politicians have used the trials as a forum for heaping scorn on the Outcasts and Liberty Rogues, who are reputed to be the criminal syndicates behind the abuses.

1114243.text: [819 AS] Foreign Labor Sought for Boron Mines

1114244.text: PITTSBURGH -- 819 AS -- Planet Pittsburgh's long history of labor problems took a turn for the worse soon after the outbreak of war between Liberty and Rheinland. Using the increased demand for boron due to its necessity in ship hull panel construction as leverage, the planet's largest labor union, United Boron Miners, went on strike to protest the chronically low wages, hazardous working conditions, and lack of adequate medical care provided by the mining companies.\nDespite months long negotiations, the mining companies failed to reach a settlement with UBM, and turned to Refugees as a solution for their labor dilemma. Bretonians fleeing the Kusari advance in Leeds were offered free transportation to Pittsburgh in exchange for a signed contract of five years labor in the boron mines. The opening of Gallic space to Sirius has seen an influx of more Refugees from Bretonia in spite of the withdrawal of Kusari's forces. Rumors of Refugees from Gallic space composed of political dissenters have sent the mining companies into political spin mode, claiming that Gallic Refugees being provided work and homes in Liberty is a moral victory over the tyrannical Gallic monarchy.\nUBM representatives see the influx of Refugees to Pittsburgh in very different terms. Refugees are seen as "scabs" and "illegal immigrants" who are taking native Libertonian's jobs. UBM ominously predicts the permanent ousting of its members from their homes on Pittsburgh if the mining companies are able to replace the labor force in its entirety. Outbreaks of violence on the planet have led some pundits to speculate that the ongoing labor strife may soon spill over into space, if the out of work miners are able to acquire spaceships to interdict refugee convoys, or if the Xenos are somehow pulled into the dispute. Both LSF and LPI spokesmen describe such predictions as mere union scare tactics.

1114245.text: [819 AS] Baden Baden Luxury Seafood is a New Delicacy

1114246.text: BADEN BADEN -- 819 AS -- After a decade of costly development, Planet Baden Baden's oceans are finally yielding a commercial resource in the form of edible crustaceans that are being marketed through the exclusive auspices of Orbital Spa and Cruise Lines as a unique feature of its luxury accomodations. Plagued for years by unexplained mass die-offs among its coastal sea farms, OSC was unable to sustain a viable supply line for its expensive menus until a joint team of Planetform and Cryer scientists identified the parasitic contagion that was depopulating Orbital's sea farms.\nNoted for their unique flavor, Baden Baden's native crustaceans have now become the entree of choice for elite diners vacationing at OSC resorts.

1114247.text: [819 AS] Ageira Signs Contract to Supply Liberty Military Hardware

1114248.text: FORT SEVERN -- 819 AS -- Ageira Technologies has secured a highly sought after contract to take over Military Vehicle manufacturing. Despite the highly sensitive nature of the top secret design specifications developed by the Navy for construction of it's equipment, cost overruns and failure to meet production deadlines led to the Liberty government forcing the Navy to license the production to a civilian company. Ageira sees the new contract as a means of diversifying its military hardware portfolio, while other Liberty companies are quietly concerned about Ageira's rising influence within the Liberty government. Critics are quick to point out the "close" relationships between government and industry in Bretonia, Rheinland, and Kusari as problematic for civil reforms, but Ageira spokesmen herald the close cooperation between the company and the government as necessary for the profitable and efficient manufacturing of military equipment and the stability of the republic.

1114249.text: [819 AS] Quantum Multiplexors Reach 2nd Generation of Technology

1114250.text: SHINJUKU STATION -- 819 AS -- Samura Industries rolled out the second generation of its Quantum Multiplexor networking system with the opening of its new Misaki Station production facility in the Tau-53 system. Renowned for their ability to seamlessly integrate the complex computer systems employed by corporations, governments, space stations, and capital ships, Quantum Multiplexor technology has revolutionized command and control functions across Sirius. Samura's proprietary design of the technology has secured a dominant market share within the industry due to its reputation for long term network stability and self debugging features.\nRumors of inquires by the Gallic Royal Navy into Samura's technological designs prompted fierce protests from other House governments, and led the new Kishiro backed government in Kusari to completely outlaw any transfer of the technology to Gallic control through Kusari space. Samura maintains that Misaki is not technically in Kusari space, and since Gallia can easily import goods through the recently revealed Lorraine Jump Gate in Tau-53, it is unlikely this outlawing will have any effect.

1114251.text: [819 AS] Cell Therapy Breakthrough for Agriculture

1114252.text: CANTERBURY STATION -- 819 AS -- Cooperation between Planetform, Synth Foods, and Cryer Pharmaceuticals on the development of Xenobiotic Filters encouraged the corporations to continue joint research and has led to another technological breakthrough. Enhanced plant growth through fertilizer application was the mainstay of agriculture for centuries, but in 817 AS Cryer scientists developed a microcellular enhancement technique that causes accelerated energy production by plant cells' mitochondria, leading to increased tissue growth. Once a delivery system that could convey the cellular enhancers directly into the plant cells was developed by Planetform the following year, the corporations began mass marketing their new product, called FloraGro, throughout Sirius.\nCrops using the product yield up to 10％ more at harvest than without it, and Synth Crops yields are sometimes increased by 20％. Since only a tiny amount is necessary to achieve results, the increased expense of FloraGro application is no deterrent to House agricultural operations which are hard-pressed by labor difficulties due to conscription for the various Houses' wars.\nPlanetform chose to locate its Floragro production on California Minor, in an apparent attempt to stimulate immigration to the planet and broaden the base of the planet's economy.

1114253.text: [819 AS] Alien Bacteria Re-engineered for Air Filtration And Waste Disposal

1114254.text:
COLD BAY DEPOT -- 819 AS -- In 815 AS, a Planetform survey vessel discovered an unknown bacteria indigenous to Planet Atka in the Hudson system. Further study conducted after the construction of Cold Bay Depot in 816 AS revealed that the bacterial organisms had evolved the unique ability to split carbon atoms from their adjoining elements in order to use the carbon as a food source. Any molecular structure containing carbon can be "digested" by these bacteria. The digestion process consumes approximately half of the carbon in the molecule as fuel for the bacteria, and secretes the remainder along with other elements back into the environment. Planetform scientists speculate that the bacteria evolved this unique ability as a result of originating in an environment of deep space, instead of what are normally considered habitable planets, and arrived on Planet Atka aboard a meteorite.
Early experiments with the bacteria revealed that their spread throughout an ecosystem habitable by humans is exponential, and that if allowed to reproduce unchecked in such an environment, a habitable planet could be rendered a complete wasteland within decades by the bacteria's ravenous life cycle. This discovery turned initial excitement into frustration as the disastrous impact that the bacteria's introduction would have on planetary environments was fully understood. The terraforming of Planet Atka has been put on hold due to the countereffects that the bacteria would create.
The solution to the bacteria's destructive appetite resulted after a research grant contributed by Synth Foods funded a joint team of Planetform and Cryer Pharmaceutical scientists. The Cryer scientists used their latest genetic manipulation techniques to genetically re-engineer the bacteria. An enzyme critical to the bacteria's survival was discovered, and the gene responsible for it's production was isolated and then removed from a breed line of bacteria. The following generations of bacteria were unable to produce this simple enzyme, and died without reproducing unless artificially supplied with a steady diet of the enzyme.
A nanotube filtration pack was developed that carries enough of the enzyme to feed a bacterial colony for several weeks. The bacteria are implanted into the nanotube filtration packs, which are then positioned on racks within a filtration system. Waste is then pumped through the racks of filters, and the resulting discharge contains only non-toxic atomic elements. In water purification systems, the discharged hydrogen and oxygen are rejoined into H2O molecules in an electrostatic recombinant process that is in wide use on space stations and large spacecraft throughout Sirius.
The bacteria are harvested by Planetform from Planet Atka and are implanted into nanotube matrices, and then sold as filtration systems for air, soil, and water purification systems, and even toxic waste disposal. The filters efficiently eliminate all poisonous or toxic materials by breaking down the molecular structures into more basic elements which can then be recycled or deposited into an ecosystem without threat of contamination. The benefits to space station and spacecraft environmental systems is tremendous, and the cost savings more than compensate for the limited shelf life of the filters.
The resulting Xenobiotic Filter product is sold throughout Sirius. Planetform Inc. supplies the genetically engineered bacterial colonies and nanotube filter packs, Cryer Pharmaceuticals holds the patents on the breed line of bacteria that it genetically altered, and Synth Foods secured an "at-cost" 100 year licensing agreement for it's Synth Paste production operations as repayment for it's research grant which funded the product's development. All three corporations are positioned to reap windfall profits from the filters' sales for the forseeable future as biodome communities and population centers retool their waste disposal facilities to use the new filters.

1114256.text: FREITAL -- 816 AS -- In the past year the renegade group known as "the Wilde" has become more and more common in the southern parts of Sirius, extending its influence well across the Omega systems and even impacting the results of battles between Corsair and Hessian forces. Red Hessian commanders have been increasingly preoccupied with finding a suitable weapon to defeat these new invaders, as a result learning more about the Wild's goals and abilities. According to data gathered by field agents, individuals identified as the Wild are not only extremely dangerous through superior technology, but also capable of basic mind suggestion and exerting influence on other individuals in a limited manner. This ability makes them able to turn their enemies against each other in certain scenarios, and has prompted the Red Hessian Oberkommando to declare Wild ships as priority one targets for this reason alone.\n\nIn addition to that, deep space recon into bordering systems has revealed free standing structures under construction in the system marked as Omega-58. Although their purpose remains to be seen, speculations arising from the shape and design include some kind of an alien Jump Gate or super weapon. According to a high ranking Hessian commander: "We need to find as much information as we can on these Wild. Something or someone is controlling and helping them, and we will find out who it is soon".

1114257.text: [817 AS] Chancellor Reinhardt Issues Call To Arms

1114258.text: NEW BERLIN -- 817 AS -- The entire board of Rheinland ministers was called into an emergency meeting with the Chancellor and the Fleet Admiral of the Military shortly after the official declaration of war from Liberty. With the meeting ending only minutes ago, Chancellor Reinhardt has emerged from the chamber to address the nation personally:\n\n"Fellow Rheinlanders, countrymen. Today is a day of shame for the colonies. Today we all plunge right back into widespread war as the warmongers in the Liberty government decide to take by force what they claim is theirs: our fatherland. Make no mistake, they will not give us pause nor respite. Their forces are numerous and well equipped, and it will not be an easy fight. And yet I am not worried! We as Rheinlanders have always overcame the greatest of strifes by a united effort, and we will do so once again. The Rheinland Military has the equipment, able leadership and experience to push the invaders back. What they need above all is you! All able men must serve our nation in this time of great need. Together we will push back the invaders and shame them in the eyes of the colonies, so that we may live in peace until the end of days. Victory to Rheinland! Victory to our Fatherland!"

1114260.text: MANHATTAN -- 817 AS -- Former President Barbara Jacobi, the famed "survivor" of the last Rheinland aggression on Liberty, now a senator and a member of the Liberty Reform Party has today criticised President Powell's statement on the escalation of hostilities with Rheinland, calling it a "heavy handed approach to a problem that is quickly running out of control". President Jacobi is known for not pushing for any reparations from Rheinland after the conflict of 800 AS, a policy which President Powell famously disagrees with. Jacobi's allegations that Powell's policy regarding the aftermath of the 800 AS war is leading Liberty into yet another conflict has been sternly rebuffed by Powell's supporters, who claim Rheinland to be using money from Liberty to fund their own Military. Jacobi herself and other members of the Reform Party have announced they will continue pressing the issue.

1114262.text: NEW LONDON -- 815 AS -- As the war rages on in Tau-31, many companies and organisations suffer great losses due to the widespread militarisation of the adjoining systems. But it would appear this does not include the Bretonian Mining and Manufacturing company, which has reported record profits in the last five years just two days ago. Analysts confirm the outbreak of the war and the subsequent threat of Leeds has led to prolonged peace in Dublin which allowed the BMM to expand their mining operations. Furthermore, BMM operations in Tau-23 fell under the protection of the Armed Forces after Harris became the last Bretonian bastion in the Tau-31 system, further earning the company protection against pirate attacks. A BMM spokesman commented on the situation: "Despite our great profits, we do have a war going on. Our hearts are out to the transport captains who did not make it back to the homeland because of Kusari attacks on such civilian transports".

1114264.text: NEW TOKYO -- 815 AS -- Although the latest Bretonian attack on Holman has been repulsed swiftly by the valiant Naval Forces defenders, a tragedy befell the IMG station as battery fire from the IKN Satsuma cruiser hit and heavily damaged a docking bay due to a misfire during the defense, killing 27 civilians and wounding several more. The Kusari government issued a press statement today apologising for this unfortunate situation and announced the sentencing of the captain involved to dishonourable discharge. "Our hearts and minds are with the grieving people of Holman outpost. We will do everything in our power to prevent such tragedies occuring in the future, however the demilitarisation of the Holman zone is not yet an option at present" - a Kusari spokesman said.

1114266.text:
BRUCHSAL -- 815 AS -- It is relatively well known in modern Rheinland that the Nomad War came as a result of the machinations of the alien infested Chancellor Niemann. What is less known is how much of his orders were carried out by people who simply "believed in the cause". Many of those people are still in charge in the Rheinland Military as if nothing had happened, and nobody is able or willing to stop it. But despite the threat that the Military poses through their blind willingness to follow orders, there is a different threat that is far more dangerous that has evolved and yet diverged from the Rheinland Military of the times of the Nomad War.

In mainstream Rheinland they are known as "Die Wilden", the traitorous followers of Niemann who have fled into the Omega systems after the death of their Chancellor, and who decided to attempt a bloody coup against the present government in an effort to redeem his legacy. But there is a far darker truth in this particular story.

Red Hessian and Bundschuh forces had dealt with these "wild" groups of Military since 801 AS when their scattered remnants attempted a withdrawal into the deep Omega systems following their defeat in Honshu. They have later encountered them yet again during the Red Hessian push on Casablanca Base in 811 AS and now we are seeing them once more, this time on a murderous rampage through the lanes and outlying areas in the core systems. These are not just fanatics bent on taking over Rheinland. Any who fight them know their skills and responsiveness, almost as if they were guided by something else. There is a growing concern that we may once again be dealing with the alien forces that enslaved our fatherland once before in order to make war upon the colonies. If there is one thing we do know for sure is that they must be stopped before they succeed in whatever they are trying to do this time.

1114267.text: [816 AS] Terrorist Attacks on the Rise in Omega-3

1114268.text: CAMBRIDGE -- 816 AS -- Omega-3 has had a long and turbulent history of being a lawless space, where Bounty Hunters and criminals duke it out in the absence of house naval presence, and civilian transport captains are caught in the middle. But if one were to look at the casualty statistics, it would not be hard to spot a very recent extreme rise in fatalities within the system. The Bretonia Police Authority has been on the case for a number of weeks and have managed to obtain proof that these terrorist attacks have been perpetrated by a gang utilising Rheinland made ships, but with weapons of strength unlike any seen before.\n\nWhen asked, the Rheinland Foreign Ministry was quick to deny any allegations of privateering, citing standing Military orders that forbade regulars from patrolling beyond Omega-7 unless actively pursuing an offender.

1114269.text: [819 AS] Daumann Suffers Due To Hessian Attacks

1114270.text: NEW BERLIN -- 819 AS -- Consumer confidence in Daumann Heavy Construction is reaching a record low, as the company's stocks continue to drop following the loss of Leipzig Station to the Red Hessians in Dresden. The war with Liberty has forced the Rheinland Military to move its assets away from Dresden to help the war effort, and after the destruction of Pirna, the Federal Police indicated they could no longer guarantee the safety of Dresden. Daumann's high temperature alloy industry has been moved to the industrial facilities on The Ring, but production capacity is still being restored after the hasty evacuation of Leipzig. Talks with ALG concerning the use of their new Wuppertal facility have been cut off after it became clear that ALG wishes to start its own High Temperature Alloy production line to compete, rather then cooperate, with Daumann.

1114271.text: [818 AS] Gallia Forces Stronger Than Suspected

1114272.text: NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- In breaking news, reports coming in from the Tau-31 system indicate reinforcements of the Gallic Royal Navy continue to engage the KNF. Neither KNF High Command nor the Kusari Government can confirm the status of the Emperor and Shogun. Government executives have declared a state of emergency, suspending the constitution and calling upon the military to maintain order in the face of mounting panic from civilians across Kusari. The government remains defiant in the face of calls for the government to step down, stating that it has every confidence the KNF can hold its lines of defense against the overwhelming numbers arrayed against them, citing Emperor Kogen's call to "defend Kusari to the last man, the last drop of blood".

1114273.text: [818 AS] Imperial Palace Seized, Government Declared Invalid

1114274.text: NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- In a surprise move, senior generals of the Kusari Naval Forces have seized key government installations in New Tokyo, including the Imperial Palace. Sources within the KNF state High Command no longer had confidence in the Kusari Government. Since the Constitution was suspended, and with the Emperor and Shogun considered MIA, it appears that the KNF has given their support to the Democratic Party of Kusari to negotiate an end to the Gallic conflict and hold fresh elections. Without support from the military the current government has little choice but to resign. Violence has broken out in Kyushu, where loyalist elements of the Farmer's Alliance have vowed never to let Kusari's royal heritage be lost, in what appears to be the start of a new chapter in Kusari political history.

1114275.text: [819 AS] Emperor Kogan Passes Away in Foreign Space!

1114276.text: NEW TOKYO -- 819 AS -- Shogun Sulu has appeared on media channels to bring the sad news that Emperor Kogen has passed away. To prevent speculation regarding the circumstances of his death, Shogun Sulu revealed the Emperor had been fighting metastaticed cardiac sarcoma - heart cancer - for the past two years. "When his Imperial physician had indicated that he would not make the end of the year, the Emperor departed for Seto at once, to offer Kusari one final service in leading the war personally, before his end." \nEmperor Kogen is succeeded by his brother Tetsuya, who will ascend to the Imperial Throne in exile. Shogun Sulu also had the following statement: "It is a disgrace that the Father and Steward of Kusari cannot be laid to rest even within Her own borders. Honor demands that one day it shall be so. I can not believe any Son of Kusari would deny Emperor Kogen that final honor."

1114277.text: [819 AS] The Republic of Kusari Is Born

1114278.text: KYUSHU -- 819 AS -- In a watershed moment for the Kusari nation, the people have spoken. A majority of votes across Kusari have fallen in favour of removing reference to the Imperial Majesty from public life. The new Prime Minister Kato Takahashi had this to say: "This is a defining moment for our nation. The Democratic Party of Kusari has made its case to the people, and the people have declared their support for this historic reform". Voting was least favourable in the conservative heartland of Kyushu, where government and media offices have come under attack by angry mobs. At least 200 people have been killed in the violence so far, with representatives of the Farmer's Alliance vowing to keep an honour guard of security ships in space "Until our Beloved Emperor returns to claim what is rightfully His".

1114279.text: [819 AS] Elections Herald New Era in Politics

1114280.text: HONSHU -- 818 AS -- Fresh elections instituted by the interim military government have seen a massive upset in most electorates. News from the poll rooms across Kusari indicate a majority seats being held by the Democratic Party of Kusari, 60％ by the final tally. The Conservative Party is expected to take up most of the remaining seats, along with a few independents. Exit surveys indicated a strong voter resentment for the previous government's failure to avoid conflict with Gallia, as well as concerns over corruption in the ranks of former government officials. The interim government is expected to formally hand power to the DPK, led by Kato Takahashi and former general Shimura Yokitara. Mr Takahashi has vowed to hold a referendum on the status of the Imperial Majesty "as soon as is practical, to end the question of Kogen's return and enshrine in law the mandate for reform granted to us by the Kusari people".

1114281.text: [819 AS] Kusari And Gallia Open Borders For Trade

1114282.text: NEW TOKYO -- 819 AS -- The Kusari Republican Government has reached a trade agreement with the Kingdom of Gallia, opening their respective borders for commercial traffic with respect to eachothers corporations. The agreement came several weeks after the revelation that Gallia had secretly been constructing a Jump Gate in the Tau-53 system. While this Gate was likely intended to open up a second front on Kusari initially, it will now serve a more peaceful purpose. As a result, traffic through Hokkaido and Tau-53 is expected to increase dramatically. Gallic officials have promised Gallia will respect Tau-53's independent nature, and considers it a demilitarised zone much like the Tau-29 buffer around Freeport 6.
