1116440.text:
CURACAO -- 826 AS -- The Allied Forces struck a costly, yet decisive blow to the Gallic Royal Navy today, after a multi-day protracted battle over the shipping lanes of Cortez and, ultimately, the fate of those desperate for supplies on New London.

Allied operations were undertaken by a combined task group of the Liberty's Alma and Yukon battlegroups, as well as the Bretonian's Harlow battlegroup, with light support from the Crayterian Military. Arrayed against them was the Gallic battleship Betheny and its attendant craft, as well as a raiding party of Corsairs who came to the Royal Navy's aid shortly into the fight.

The Gallic battleship Betheny was the latest in a long line of attempts by the Royal Navy to significantly hamper the supply lines of Libertonian war materiel entering Bretonia. Even with the deployment of Liberty's Yukon, relief supplies were just as likely to be seized by Gallic raids or destroyed outright as were to safely travel make it into Manchester. The Alberta-Poole jump corridor had made the route largely supplemental, but with the loss of that corridor and the ever-growing threat of New London coming under siege, this long-brewing stalemate became an intense focus for the war planners on both sides, and the Allies were the first to act with the deployment of the Harlow and Alma into Cortez.

The first few days of battle proceeded at range. The battlegroups' smaller, lighter craft fought over and over in a large-scale stalemate between the deadlocked warships, each side hoping to gain the advantage in indirect fighting. After the fourth day ended in another inconclusive draw, however, the Allied Forces recalled their lighter craft and readied to enter into a close range engagement. According to representatives from the Liberty Navy, the Allies had feared the Betheny might escape should they delay further, or that an unseen savior might come to rescue the vessel before it could be put to rest.

The charge was led by the Libertonian battleship Yukon and its attendant battlegroup. The Alma followed not so distantly in its wake, with the Bretonian Harlow bringing up the rear. According to a source within the Allied military command, the captain and crew of the Yukon moved to engage ahead of the scheduled assault, believing that the Betheny was preparing to withdraw before they had planned to attack.

The resultant clash could be seen quite clearly from Curacao's surface, a spectacle which has already lit up the social neural-nets. The Yukon and Betheny engaged in a close-quarters melee, duelling with high-powered weaponry. The Alma quickly moved in to bracket the vessel, attempting to take her down before the Yukon suffered critical damage. The Harlow, however, remained outside the effective range of the Betheny's main cannon, offering primarily bomber support against the Gallic capital ship from distance.

Despite the valiant efforts of the Allies and the Royal Navy, however, both the Yukon and the Betheny fell to hostile fire with all hands. The vast majority of the Betheny's attached battlegroup were destroyed outright, although some managed to escape deeper into the system, along with their allies in the Corsairs. A good portion of the Yukon's escort elements were also lost before they could be reinforced by the Alma's, and the surviving remainder under Rear Admiral Jack Yeager have since been attached to the Alma pending reassignment, Navy representatives told the CNS. Both Harlow and Alma themselves suffered non-critical damage in the fighting, and they have been noted to be receiving materiel from naval logistics vessels in Curacao orbit since the fighting ended.

A joint allied statement has called the operation an unequivocal success, whilst simultaneously lamenting the lives lost, especially aboard the Yukon. Representatives from Orbital Spa & Cruise were quick to applaud the cessation of fighting within the sector, and told the CNS they were hopeful that this would be the start of Curacao's rebuilding and growth after being struck by the war so directly. For the first time in over three years, traffic advisories posted by Interspace Commerce have dropped to "caution", the lowest level posted since the destruction of San Diego Border Station. For those watching the skies on New London, this news comes none too soon.

We will keep you updated as the situation throughout the war front develops. This is the Colony News Service.

War Correspondent Alexander Cooper

1116445.text: [826 AS] New London Cities in Ruin

1116446.text:
NEW LONDON -- 826 AS -- Initial estimates of the damage to New London indicate 612,325 km2 of the planet, primarily in the Westminster City Megalopolis, the North Delta Industrial Zone, and the Fishing Bank Economic Region were struck by Gallic 'Warwolf' Beams. Buckingham Palace, a fifth of the planet's military installations, one hundred thirty-seven cities, thousands of towns, villages and burgs have been destroyed. Six hundred, ninety-seven million persons were known to live in those regions.

The weapons cast an extremely energetic beam over two kilometers in diameter, causing firestorms in their wake. Forests and parks were rendered to ash and charred remains, small villages continue to smolder, and thousands of blocks of urban structures are destroyed or severely damaged. Structures over mega block-size have remained standing, with slagged exterior rooms but still largely intact. The surface of lakes and shores stuck were vaporized, ejecting huge amounts of vapor into the atmosphere, which has increased the violence of the rainstorms we're currently experiencing, aiding local firefighting and but complicating rescue efforts.

Counts of survivors are still ongoing but initial reports indicate the death rate is nearly 43％ of the populations of the three metropolises. Only underground facilities that didn't collapse and those extremely large structures capable of holding their mass after their exteriors were slagged were not completely ruined, though many people had success evading the linear paths of the beams. Unfortunately, many other such evacuations were caught in backtracking beams, part of what led to such high casualties.

Hospitals and emergency workers from around the planet are going to every extreme they can; millions of BAF personnel on the planet have been deployed into the areas to handle the more dangerous relief efforts, and a general draft has been issued under wartime powers to relocate labor to disaster recovery.

1116448.text:
LOS ANGELES -- 826 AS -- Following just over a year of conflict within the California system, the Battleship Carcassonne surrendered to Liberty today, marking a historic moment: the end of the Gallic Conflict within Liberty space.

Our sources in the Liberty Navy suggest that the crew began to mutiny. Led by the ship's second in command, the crew began by sabotaging the weapons systems and seizing control of propulsion before making a move to relinquish control of the vessel from their commanding officer. Given that the Battleship Carcassonne has been deep behind enemy lines for some time with no way to resupply, it's unsurprising that the crew had reached their breaking point. The exact casualty report has yet to be made public, however estimates put it in the hundreds.

The Carcassonne was first sighted emerging from the Tahoe Ice Cloud, the executive officer issuing an unconditional surrender to any and all vessels in range. The Battleships Alma and Concord closed in to flank the Royal Navy vessel early this morning and after a short delay, the two ships escorted it into the cloud from whence it came. As of now, the whereabouts of the Carcassonne remain a mystery, and the Liberty Navy has refused to comment further on the matter.

Since the year 822, the Battleship Carcassonne along with the Battleship Bethany had continued to put pressure on the Liberty Navy, choking allied supply lines into Bretonia. In more recent times it has been stationed in the California system, launching attacks from the Tahoe Ice Cloud as far as Planet Los Angeles. As of today, the Carcassonne's guns have fallen silent, and at last commerce may be able to continue without the fear that ship's traversing the Tahoe cloud may become one of the Royal Enclave's next targets.

What's next for the Battleship Carcassonne? According to our contacts within the Provisional Gallic government, this vessel, once the flagship of the Gallic Royal Navy, led an attack directly against the Council in the Languedoc system. Acquisition of this Battleship by the current government would be highly symbolic. Given the nature of how the Liberty Navy has handled the situation thus far, one has to ask - what does Liberty plan to do with Battleship Carcassonne and her crew?

1116458.text:
NEW BERLIN -- 827 AS -- Overall support in the latest elections have closed doors for one and opened doors for many, the recent conflicts in all direction have shown a deep division between the populace. The mainline conservative party that have seen the light through the war with Liberty right up to the Sigma conflict have faltered; But in its place rising support for once minor hard line parties have grown extremely. The final seat count sets the Imperial Party as the single largest party with 39 percent of the seats, with the Federal Conservatives in second place with 35 percent, and neither party able to form a majority government.

Arguably the biggest victor in these elections is however the United Democratic Foundation, a radically left leaning party, which used its 26 percent share of the seats to force the Federal Conservatives to settle for a shared government with an almost equal split. While the UDF's new-found popularity & policies have provided their political growth, the Imperial party, now the single largest party in Rheinland, has become the major opposition to the allied parties, and is raising concerns that this new coalition will be the downturn of valued Rheinland business. Especially concerning major corporate growth to Rheinland business and Military, opposition business strategist Koller Zimmer calling it "A major insult to our founding traditions of Shipbuilding and Rheinwehr strength."

The coalition government, as a result of UDF representation is markedly more left leaning, with controversial policies such as legalization of the Bundschuh movement reportedly being considered for legislation, a policy met with the condemnation of the Imperial Party.

1116460.text: PLANET HAMBURG -- 827 AS -- Fredrick von Albrecht has been central to the recent turmoil in Rheinland. The socialite is the last remaining heir to the defunct Rheinland throne, and has consequently acted as a lightning rod for the Imperial Party’s increasingly revanchist rhetoric. Albrect broadcast his own inflammatory speech on Tuesday, calling for the dissolution of the Reichstag and reinstatement of the office of Emperor. Seemingly in response, Albrecht’s Hamburg residence was set alight by unknown assailants. Albrect was reportedly injured, and has called on his supporters to take action to protect him from further assassination attempts. Federal Police have opened an investigation while calling for calm.

1116462.text: CANBERRA -- 827 AS -- Contacts within Rheinland report that between the unproductive Sigma War, the fall of Dresden, the Munich disaster, and the loss of Omega-11, discontent within Rheinland has reached levels previously unimagined. A deepening rift has formed between those who believe a return to imperialism will bring back Rheinland's glory days and those who do not, which has only been further inflamed by the rhetoric of noted politician Koller Zimmer.\n\nWhile some within Rheinland believe the current tensions can be used to gain more support for their respective movements, others have expressed concern that the Imperialist movement is growing too fast to contain. Much of the Imperialist support has come from the Rheinland Military, raising concerns about a potential military lead takeover of power.

1116464.text: HAMBURG -- 827 AS -- Political tensions have exploded across Planets Hamburg and New Berlin in the wake of the Federal government's announced plans to decriminalize the Bundschuh movement, and the alleged assassination attempt of a prominent Imperialst figure, heir to the defunct throne Von Albrecht. Federal Police have described scenes of violence between street gangs aligned with Federal and Imperialist ideals. The Police acted in response to the violence with an unprecedented use of force after several hours of violence. Several thousand protesters were fired upon by Police forces with lethal force after the police claimed to be targeted with light arms fire from the crowd, several thousand protesters were caught in the crossfire, with reports that over a hundred protesters may have been killed.\n\nFederal Minister of the Interior Sophia Kuester (UDF) decried "Imperialist thugs" who she claimed were instigating violent assaults against peaceful activists, defending the violent crackdown and claiming police were acting in self defense. "These brazen attacks on our democratic foundations will not be tolerated, and the Federal Police will make use of the full extent of the law to prevent further Imperialist attacks." Professor Hans Von Albrecht has condemned the government's stance as "partisan nonsense" which "ignores the reality of radical infiltrators bringing violence to our streets." Imperialist Party representatives have called for peace, but for their members to defend themselves against aggression.

1116466.text: HAMBURG -- 827 AS -- Political tensions have exploded across Planets Hamburg and New Berlin in the wake of the federal government's announced plans to decriminalise the Bundschuh movement. Federal Police have described scenes of violence between street gangs aligned with Federal and Imperialist ideals. Several hundred arrests have been made on Hamburg, with wide-spread reports of property damage and injuries. Violence on New Berlin has been rife but quickly contained, with Federal Police riot units sealing and clearing affected tunnels and districts.\n\nFederal Minister of the Interior Sophia Kuester (UDF) decried "Imperialist thugs" who she claimed were instigating violent assaults against peaceful activists. "These brazen attacks on our democratic foundations will not be tolerated, and the Federal Police will make use of the full extent of the law to prevent further Imperialist attacks." Professor Hans Von Albrecht has condemned the government's stance as "partisan nonsense" which "ignores the reality of radical infiltrators bringing violence to our streets." Imperialist Party representatives have called for peace, but for their members to defend themselves against aggression.

1116467.text: [827 AS] Rheinland Unrest Hits the Markets

1116468.text: NEWARK -- 827 AS -- Concerns regarding political instability in Rheinland have continued to grow over recent weeks. Following an unexpected snap election, a new federal government was formed from a coalition of minority parties. Tensions have recently erupted into outright violence on Planet New Berlin and Hamburg, with the death toll from clashes between gangs of activists steadily rising. The intensified disorder was prompted by yesterday's attempted assassination of Hans Von Albrecht, heir to the defunct Rheinland throne.\n\nThe governments of Liberty, Kusari and Bretonia have issued temporary advisories for their citizens travelling in Rheinland, warning them to exhibit extreme caution in light of the spike in violence. The markets have also reacted with volatility, due to the prospect of a protest general strike potentially shutting down Rheinland exports and manufacturing industries. The Manhattan stock index continues to underperform in light of these evolving issues, compounding the drag caused by the problems in Bretonia.

1116470.text:
STUTTGART -- 827 AS -- The battle of Stuttgart, as it has come to be known through offhand comments by residents, appears to be the final straw amid the growing stack of nails that is Rheinland's current political stability. With Imperial-Federal tensions boiling over with increasing allegations of corruption, military and bureaucratic inefficiency. Circulation of footage depicting exchanges of salvos between the two ships have become commonplace, with the average citizen waking up to the spectacle of the two warships exchanging heavy blows and fielding what has been likened to a "swarm" of smaller vessels to assert orbital superiority.

The engagement began at roughly 06:00 local Stuttgart time, and our sources in the military report that the commanding officers of both ships had a brief conversation before the order to commit was given. The CO of the Altenburg was reportedly asked to surrender in light of his apparent insubordination with orders from Federal authorities, to which he allegedly responded "No, for that would be a treason too great for me to commit," a response that was quickly enunciated by a brief but vicious clash above the green jewel. Nearby stellar traffic and even the adjacent Synth Foods installation reported frequent explosions from fighting between escorts, snubcraft and the warships.

It was observed that despite the threat of mutual destruction, the Altenburg persisted, while the Karlsruhe eventually retreated after having sustained from, and dealt heavy damage to, its Imperial opponent. Therefore it is evident to state that the system of Stuttgart, has come under Imperial rule following the restoration and properly marks the beginning of a struggle between the incumbents and their combative successors. A struggle that both sides are willing to further through violence if necessary.

1116472.text:
COLONY NEWS SERVICE -- 827 AS -- New Berlin chokes under political tension that has by now become an event of interest to the sector at large. Rheinland has entered a state of civil war, with the Imperial party gaining momentum necessary to seize Government offices across the House.

It is believed by political analysts that the cause for this sudden governmental reform is the failed assassination attempt of The Cambridge University Professor and matrilineal descendant of Empress Leicht Freidmann, Hans Edvard Franz Von Albrecht, during his series of speeches on Hamburg, the rented house he used the target of arson. Critics of the federal government condemn the Bundestag for what they allege as being a state-sponsored attempt at eliminating political opposition. Public reception toward the attempted assassination has been notably negative, with riots breaking out after peaceful protests bubbled over into violence. The protests were centered around the alleged conspiracy that the federal government tried to assassinate Von Albrecht to protect its political influence on Hamburg. The death toll of protestors is believed to be in the hundreds, and a federal spokesperson claimed the riots to be a criminal putsch perpetrated by the Imperial party.

Elements of the Military loyal to the Imperial Government acted in response to the killings, occupying nearly all major centers of Governance. With isolated incidents of resistance across major colonies, the Imperial party reinstated Imperial rule and simultaneously declared the former government to be enemies of the State. Elements of the forces loyal to the Federal Government have secured themselves in Thuringia, refusing to acknowledge Imperial rule as legitimate. Both parties have proven unable to reconcile, and further conflict seems likely.

Rheinland finds itself on the verge of turmoil. Sources state that the power struggle has given rise to an increased hessian presence in cologne. Criminal activity in the system is on the rise, and the fighting is far from over.

1116474.text: FREEPORT 5 -- 827 AS -- While battles between Corsairs and Red Hessians in Omega-47 are common, the conflict reached new heights recently, culminating in the destruction of Viernheim Base in a Corsair attempt to capture the planet. Viernheim was vital to Hessian operations in the system, serving as a logistics hub for Hessian expansion. Corsair forces had regularly assaulted the station, hoping to cripple the installation before the Hessians could become more entrenched.\n\nWith Hessian forces weakened and focused on other fronts, the commander of the Fes fleet saw an opportunity. an assault on Viernheim was ordered. The defenders were however reinforced by the Coalition fleet Alvin Katz, and a bloody, drawn-out battle ensued, with numerous ships on both sides destroyed in battle. In a desperate move to salvage a result from the battle, Corsair forces focused their full attention on Viernheim, ensuring its destruction. Despite succeeding at their objective, Fes and her surviving escort were heavily damaged, and limped back to friendlier space for repairs. The Coalition fleet fared only slightly better, and is in desperate need of relief as it holds orbit.

1116476.text:
STUTTGART -- 827 AS -- As the smoke clears in the Stuttgart System, Imperial officials have been left to assess the cost of victory. The plasma-blasted hulks in orbit of Planet Stuttgart can attest to the ferocity of the fighting that occured in the system, with forces loyal to both the Imperial and Federal causes redeploying from the Omegas and frontier systems. This lapse in security provoked an immediate response from the region's pirates and terrorists who opportunistically exploited the Imperial Restoration for their own purposes.

The largest casualty of this predation has been the Cologne System, which fell prey to the Red Hessians. Imperial security officers have noted that the Federal government had ineptly underfunded the system's security for many years, choosing instead to appoint unreliable Bounty Hunters to undertake patrols. It is believed that the Battleship Karlsruhe's treasonous refusal to stand down at the legitimate Imperial government's request prevented Military reinforcements from saving Cologne from the Red Hessian invasion.

Military Commanders state that the Hessians' unacceptable incursion into Rheinland space will be repelled promptly. A bounty has also been issued for information regarding the Karlruhe's location, in order for its crew to be brought to justice for the abhorrent occupation they directly enabled.

1116478.text:
NORTHEIM -- 827 AS -- The Red Hessians have always been prepared for the day of the Second Popular Revolution. In the years following the conquest of Dresden, Hessian fighters have stood poised to strike a decisive blow against the rotten state of Rheinland. It was with surprise that their planners found an opportunity had arisen not through a workers' uprising, but rather a military coup fuelled by Imperial discontent. The spiralling civil war in Stuttgart resulted in garrisons across the Omegas and Cologne being withdrawn, providing a rare window of opportunity.

Reacting to this windfall, squadrons were redeployed to Northeim Base to muster for an overwhelming strike on the Cologne System. The cowardly Bounty Hunters of Tholey Base have long been a thorn in the Hessians' side, preying on their recruits in Omega 54. After a decisive assault, the Bounty Hunters fled the system to cower behind the skirts of their Military paymasters, followed not long after by the skeleton force the Police could muster. Scouts reported a fleeting sighting of the Battleship Karlsruhe near the Norddrauwolke Field, but no engagements with Military forces were recorded.

While the Hessians have secured a great victory in denying the Imperialists the system, the Revolution is still beset by foes. The barbaric Corsairs have seized the moment to launch a renewed offensive on Hessian holdings in Omega 47, and forces from Gallia are beginning to launch patrols into Cologne through their newly constructed Jump Gate.

1116574.text:
CLASS: Ranseur
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
1116574.mapped:
The dreadnought Captana was the first Ranseur-class capital ship to be commissioned by the Outcasts, and during the Gallic invasion she served as a forward defense in case the Gallic Royal Navy decided to turn more attention against the Outcasts and their homeworld.

Fortunately for the Outcasts, however, this threat never came to fruition, and so for most of her career she served in the Tau-37 system as the guardian of the entrance to Omicron Alpha and so unlike her one generation newer sister, the Basilica, she never participated in any glorious battles.

Although the Outcasts attempted to modernize Captana during her active service and keep her combat capability up to date, even such brilliant ship designers as the Outcasts made several unsolvable errors in her design, and so in 830 AS the decision was made to retire her from service and scrap her at Valletta Shipyard.

The once proud ship is now a hulk, which is currently being carefully and painstakingly recycled in an effort to save as much valuable material as possible for the eventual construction of other ships. Work to dismantle her has been interrupted several times, most notably during the infamous slave revolt, and much of the vessel is still intact years after the decision to scrap her was made.

1116577.text:
Scans indicate the wreck of the GMG Namura - former RNS - Blitzkrieg, stolen in Sigma-13 from the Rheinland Military during the 80-year war. Last reports of the Namura indicate a surprise attack by the Outcasts.
Transcription of the last communication received from the Namura follows:

"... ... outnumbered... ...ings... ... Sab... e f....ers... ..............."

1116579.text:
The wreck of the GMG Namura fighter wing Leader, escorting the Battleship Namura en-route to Omicron Minor. The pilot didn't leave the site even when the hull of the Namura buckled under the Outcast heavy fire.

With the Namura's demise, the Escort Leader, Shinji Tenaka, performed Seppuku.

1116581.text:
One of the GMG Namura Escort Wing fighters. The twelve pilots fought valiantly but were outnumbered by the Outcasts forces. The wrecks were left scatered throughout the system on the same places the pilots ended their lifes, hunted down by the Outcasts as they dispersed after the Namura's demise.

With the Namura's demise, the Escort Leader, Shinji Tenaka, performed Sepuku.

The wrecks are left as a reminder to the future tresspassers.

1116591.text: A rumor is circling about a recently found Gate to another world populated by the Great Spirits.

1116592.text: The Red Hessians were once with us against the Corsairs, but they feared our influence and broke the alliance. Bretonia called for our help against the Gallic Royal Navy, but betrayed us as soon as that threat was gone. Many Sirians don't stay our allies for long, but those we made dependent on Cardamine like the Liberty Rogues will always remain loyal to us as they have no other choice.

1116593.text: No one really knows what disaster befell Corsica, but drilling the shipyard complex into the planetoid's husk saved us a lot of money on station hull plates. First was Corsica, named after the rock, followed by Valletta and Venice is the newest addition to the Outer Sanctum.

1116594.text: If you take the jump hole to Tau-37 you will see the wreck of the carrier Hades on the other side. We hauled it as a trophy from Tau-44 to serve as a reminder to those who would dare cross the Outcasts.

1116597.text: A field of rocky particles coalescing into a ring system around Planet Sardinia. No further information available.

1116607.mapped:
The remains of Santa Verna were excavated into the interior of a giant planetoid in high orbit around the planet Carinea. Santa Verna was originally used for logistics and exploration due to its almost non-existent signature on long-range sensors.

Thanks to the sacred Outcast burial ground near Santa Verna, the station later became infamous as a sanctuary and shrine for the more religious Outcasts and their few trusted outsiders. To this end, several of the large interior halls were converted for religious ceremonies, and the elaborate architectural ornamentation was quietly admired by those who visited Santa Verna.

When the slave revolt occurred on the planet Albegna in 831 AS, the slaves here also rebelled against their masters. Although their rebellion was quickly put down, a small group of surviving slaves managed to infiltrate the station's power centre and irreversibly sabotaged the station's reactor. By the time a rescue operation could be organized on Santa Verna, the station had already been destroyed and all aboard were long dead.

The remains of Santa Verna thus became another tomb located near the Outcast Graveyard and became a place of spiritual pilgrimage and burial for those wishing to rest forever in its still hauntingly beautiful ceremonial halls.

1116609.mapped:
Construction of Venice Shipyard started in 806 AS to make use of the rich metal deposits found on Albegna. Although several key materials are in short supply, the abundance of Titanium made the construction of another shipyard complex on the Corsica asteroid's husk a logical choice. The new facility proved to be necessary, as the fighting on multiple fronts in both the Tau and the Sigma sectors was starting to overwhelm the existing Outcast shipyards with drydocks and facilities running at maximum capacity.

In a matter of five years, the shipyard was completed. Since then, the giant Corsica Complex called the Outer Sanctum has been operating with capacity to spare. Venice, which has undergone a number of renovations since it became operational, mainly handles the construction of transport ships, while Valletta and Corsica focus on capital warships of all sizes.

DIAMETER: 26,343 km.
MASS: 4.90 x 10e24 kg.
TERRAIN: Terrestrial
TEMPERATURE: 0°C to 43°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 10.27 km/sec
Soledad was the second planet settled by the Outcasts. As seen from space Soledad is a beautiful planet with green continents and an abundance of water, but the planet is surrounded by a rather powerful magnetic field that quickly destroys any electronics that come into it's influence. No ship can withstand extended exposure and building docking rings is impossible. Because of these challenges only a small group of scientists resided on the planet at first.

These scientists experimented with seeding alien organisms into the biosphere in order to expand Cardamine production beyond Malta. While initial results seemed promising, they were ultimately unsuccessful, and further attempts have been aborted. Now, the planet is settled predominantly by slaves gathering natural resources, and the armed guard watching over them. A small detachment of scientists remains to study the magnetic field.

1116612.text:
DIAMETER: 30,216 km
MASS: 9.89 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: 247°C to 400°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 16.42 km/sec

The burned and barren world of Alcara shields Venice Shipyard from the brunt of the star's radiation. The world is totally inhospitable due to the surface taking most of the brunt of the two suns with temperatures on the dayside reaching 247 degrees on a cool day. But the planet is rich in metals, which the Outcast Nation desperately needs to fill the growing demand for warships. Mining shuttles make the decent onto the night side of the planet and proceed to strip mine whole cliff faces and take the raw resources to Venice before the sun rises.

1116613.text:
DIAMETER: 9,867 km
MASS: 6.21 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: 300°C to 456°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.22 km/sec

The moon orbiting Alcara has one of the most mineral-rich deposits found on Outcast space today. Metals of all sorts are mined from Terre and transported to Venice where they are transformed into all manner of ship parts. These pieces are then assembled into Sabres, Falcatas, Daggers, Tridents, destroyers, dreadnoughts, and battleships. All of these warships go toward expanding the Orange Dream.

1116614.text:
In late 816 AS, an Outcast splinter group stumbled across a newly formed jump hole in the Omicron Tau system. Ignoring warnings, the curious patrol pilot got a little too close and the unstable vortex grabbed his ship, sending him spinning across the light years and into a new system. Astonished he gazed at the place he found himself in. Two planets orbited an intense blue star and a dense nebula floated in the distance behind one of the planets. As he sat there in amazement alarms started blaring in his cockpit. Between the radiation of the star and the stress of tumbling through an unstable Jump hole his ship electronic system was about to shut down leaving him stranded in unknown space. He quickly turned around and entered the jump hole for the second time. It spewed his ship out in Alpha again and he quickly made his way back to Malta. Today Huescar Nebula is named after the finder of Omicron-81, Villop Huescar.

Later an even more important discovery was made in Huescar Nebula. The alien organisms found floating in the midst of the nebula helped scientists turn the soil of Terre into a fertile ground for Cardamine growing. Galicia Research Station was set up shortly after the discovery of Omicron-81 to study the intricate nebula and the strange anomalies in the system.

1116637.mapped:
The Amorgos satellite is locked into a slow orbit of the greater Mykonos Gas Giant, but rotates rapidly on its own axis. With a thin Oxygen-argon atmosphere with pockets of dinitrogen monoxide, the air on Amorgos is barely breathable for short periods. For many years the prospect of colonization was deemed unfeasible because of intense dust storms and hallucinations induced by the high concentration of dinitrogen monoxoide in the moon's atmosphere. Due to the heavy casualties incurred by previous manned expeditions, the Council of Elders on Crete formally forbade further survey missions to take place on the moon in 803 AS.

When deep scans from more powerful survey equipment developed by Cryer brought the wealth of ancient alien ruins beneath the surface to the attention of the Corsairs, the Council of Elders lifted their no fly restriction on Amorgos and colonization, though difficult, began in earnest. Hollowing out deep tunnels with atmospheric scrubbers to escape the moon's harsh surface, many Corsairs have begun to flock to Amorgos despite its tenuous location on the Rheinland and Maltese fronts. Working the artifact mines is lucrative, and for those who prefer a more honest and less dangerous trade, there is still much work to do helping to reinforce and expand the growing colonies of Amorgos.

With the rapid expansion Amorgos has seen, there have been rumors of a backroom deal between Cryer and the Council of Elders for funding of the moon's colonies. Scrupulous Corsairs may note that certain artifacts are siphoned off the top by dockworkers due to safety precautions, and unmarked transports have supposedly been sighted leaving areas of the moon with no documented infrastructure. Talk of this nature tends to be waved away as paranoid delusion, and most Corsairs are happy to simply have a second world to call home.

Due to the plethora of ruins located within the moon's mantle and its proximity to the deeper Omicrons, it is only a matter of time before the Core take an interest in the moon. Not eager to repeat Nauru, the Corsairs of Amorgos are well armed with both rifle and wit, conducting weekly drills for a possible invasion scenario. These Corsairs are just as willing to flee into the mines and collapse the entrances behind them as they are to form a firing line, and with their knowledge of the moon's intricate tunnel networks it is unlikely that the insurgency they'll surely present would be easily subdued should Amorgos ever see the Core's troop transports blacken its sky.

ESCAPE VELOCITY: 7.80 km/sec
1116640.mapped:
Albegna is a desert world with a thin atmosphere consisting mainly of carbon dioxide (96%) and trace amounts of argon and nitrogen. While initial surveys detected little to no precious metals on the surface, more thorough scans revealed the presence of large deposits of Titanium and veins of more precious metals within the planet's crust.

In the past, there was an Outcast mining colony relying on the extensive use of slaves where mining machines were not practical. The death rate among slaves here was very high, due both to the danger of their work and the cruelty of their masters.

The cup of patience ran over when the Benitez Cartel executed 200 slaves in 831 AS, leading to a widespread slave uprising not only in the mining colony on the planet Albegna, but also on Malta itself. The mining colony was subsequently destroyed by the Dreadnought Basilica from orbit, less than two weeks after the rebellion broke out in retaliation for the death of Don Benitez.

1116643.text:
The Unquera cloud is a medium-sized offshoot of the Walker Nebula. The dust particles contained within have some scanner dampening properties, but the cloud itself is clear from any bodies of significant mass. There are trace deposits of rare elements such as gold, silver, and even niobium, yet since it is all dust, it cannot be gathered with any efficiency. Thus, efforts to extract these materials from the clouds have proven to be futile.

There are theories that the Unquera cloud used to contain asteroids of sizable mass which they have long since disappeared, possibly drawn in by the much larger Calborana asteroid field. It is unclear however, why the dust did not follow the asteroids, if this theory is correct.

1116645.text:
The Calborana field is a massive offshoot of the Walker Nebula surrounding Rheinland. Within its boundaries, it contains glowing rocks, heated by the unique properties of the dense dust inside of the cloud. Heat that goes into the field rarely comes out, keeping the temperature a toasty two thousand degrees centigrade. Once inside the field, ships without strong hull plating start to soften and melt, occasionally resulting in a cockpit blowout for those in fighter-sized craft. This is mistaken by most ship sensors as high levels of radiation.

Despite the heat, many artifacts have survived the eons that they've been trapped inside this baking field of rock and are available to mine. Only ships with hull plating resistant to heat can venture inside though, making artifact extraction unreliable.

1116647.text:
The Santa Marina asteroid field is a dustless field whose asteroids are of low density but voluminous in nature. Alexandria station, the first station to be constructed in Omicron Omega, lies within this field, conspicuously placed for the ease of navigation of freighters hauling construction materials.

The asteroid field is used primarily as a training ground for pilots permitted to be in the system. Many battles that the Corsairs have fought in the past have been inside asteroid fields, so pilots use the Santa Marina field to hone their combat skills for these situations.

Santa Marina itself contains no resources of any value, and is consequently not a target for further development by the Corsairs.

1116649.text:
DIAMETER: 26,216 km
MASS: 9.89 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Desert
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 15.42 km/sec

Planet Lesbos is slightly smaller, yet much more arid than planet Crete. Its atmosphere consists of 75% Nitrogen, 22% Oxygen, and various trace gasses, which under normal circumstances would make it suitable for life, but withal there is a complete lack of water, even in the form of vapor. The excessive heat and dust storms on Lesbos are also a major barrier to the settlement of the planet. Despite its current environment, topographic scans conducted have shown that there may have once been primitive life on Lesbos, long in the past before humans arrived in Sirius. The planet is the subject of some study, as many remain baffled by its current situation and what happened to make it become so arid.

The Council of Elders once expressed great interest in this planet as a future source of artifacts for the Corsairs, citing the plausibility of ruined cities existing, buried deep under the sands of Lesbos. However, given the conditions on the surface it has been deemed that, for the foreseeable future at least, there is no possibility of surveying and extracting any resources from this world.

1116651.text:
This ship is the remains of a Titan seen flying into the Calborana asteroid field a few years ago. Despite the extensive damage by the heat of the field, scans show that the pilot of this vessel was the founder of the Brotherhood, Alexander Cross. At the time of Alexander's disappearance, he was suffering from terminal cancer. This was probably the reason for his flight into the Calborana asteroid field.

Since this ship appears to be Alexander's own personal Titan, it may have valuable equipment onboard.

1116659.text: I'm so excited! I just brought in a shipment of construction materials and machinery from Skiros station. Everything looks like it's in top condition here. I wish I could stay longer, but I have to get back to Skiros soon. They are expecting me to bring more shipments here. I wouldn't recommend you do the same, there's no money to be made.

1116660.text: I was one of the Corsairs who salvaged parts from the wreck of Freeport 7. It's great to see Zoner investment go into the construction of Corsair stations. In all honesty, we should blow them out of the water. They had no right to delay the construction of the installations in this system.

1116661.text: It's hard to feel sorry for the Zoners. They charge us extortionate prices for the food we need and give us a pittance for the water and oxygen that we ship to their stations. Still, I don't think it's wise to attack the Zoners. We Corsairs still aren't completely self-sufficient yet. Even if we were, the Zoners are useful in supplying many goods that we simply don't have. I think that the Elders take them for granted, carelessly talking about attacking their stations. But who am I to comment?

1116662.text: They say that the planet in this system has many artifacts hidden beneath its surface. At the same time, they say that the conditions are too treacherous to attempt to colonize it. Its seems like it's much more than a coincidence to me. Then again, why would anyone want to stop the colonisation of a planet in friendly space? Maybe I'm just being paranoid.

1116663.text: I was here when Alexandria was first commissioned as a base of operations in this system. So much has happened since then. Both the system and this station are indistinguishable from what they used to be a few years ago.

1116664.text: I'm here to scoop up all the scrap that our prey leaves behind, Tripoli could always use more to fashion us ships and weapons.

1116665.text: As a member of the Corsairs, I really enjoy having a place to call a second home. It's very relaxing for us. The bar here is a clean place, not like the ones on Crete. The food is great too. I love it here.

1116666.text: This station was designed with two purposes in mind; the production of small attack vessels and the cultivation of food. I think the engineers were also instructed to design a station to anger the Zoners, but that's just a rumour.

1116667.text: The food here tastes lovely! Not like that awful synthesized paste that comes from the colonies. Here it's fresh, and it's delicious. Try some! You'll love it. I certainly do. Life is great, huh?

1116668.text: I've got to pick up some raw materials from Crete soon. It's all needed for the construction of the fighters in production here. I wish I could get back to fighting on the front lines. I really don't enjoy this shipping job.

1116669.text: The weapon platforms outside really pack a punch. I gave one a scan the other day, and those cannons are more like death rays. I pity the fool who gets on the wrong end of those guns, that's for sure. Hopefully though, no one will be stupid enough to invade this system.

1116670.text: The families on Crete really need the food produced here on Barcelona. Many times, I've seen hungry families who look more like skeletons than people. That is why I've taken the liberty of purchasing a freighter and moving some of the food here to Crete. I can't sit idly by while my brothers and sisters die of starvation.

1116684.text: A wreck of a Corsair fighter in an uncharted system. No further information available.

1116686.text: The Andros Field was the first area of Omicron Xi to be charted by the Corsairs. Extensive surveys confirmed the presence of trace iron oxide and aluminium oxide deposits, but not in concentration high enough for extraction to be viable. Currently, Andros is a scorched-earth battlefield between Corsairs and patrols from nearby Rheinland. A number of wrecks from both sides lie scattered amongst the field, emblematic of a brutal struggle.

1116688.text: An outcropping of the Edge Nebula, the North Aegean Nebula is largely uncharted. Recon missions by the Corsairs have been largely unsuccessful due to radiation emanating from within the nebula, and navigational hazards caused by the electromagnetic interference within the cloud. Many survey ships dispatched into the nebula have not returned, and out of those that have, at least two have reported encountering hostile entities. Since this report, the Battleship Delos was dispatched to patrol the edge of the nebula, and continued reconnaissance into the nebula was suspended.

1116690.text:
TYPE: M6

1116692.text:
DIAMETER: 25,738 km
MASS: 11.68 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: N/A
TEMPERATURE: N/A
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 31.45 km/sec

Planet Mykonos is one of the most visible and significant features of the Omicron Xi system. A gas giant, Mykonos has an atmosphere made up almost entirely of oxygen, hydrogen and noble gasses. Unprocessed, gas collected from this planet is toxic due to its high oxygen concentration wreaking havoc on a subject's lungs, but after processing can be used in the artificial atmosphere of space stations and ships. A technique called "Gas scooping" originally developed by the GMG (and stolen) allows Corsair ships to harvest oxygen and hydrogen from the planet, pressurize it, and offload the gasses on nearby bases to supplement their artificial atmospheres. Waste products of maintaining the atmospheres of stations in the system (such as Carbon Dioxide) are released back into Mykonos' atmosphere to ensure a net atom economy is maintained.

1116694.text:
DIAMETER: 23,645 km
MASS: 8.01 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Volcanic
TEMPERATURE: 42°C to 90°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 21.45 km/sec

The second largest planet in the system, Santorini is a dark and very dense world with a toxic atmosphere. High concentrations of Sulphur Dioxide and Chlorine in the atmosphere make the air of the planet totally un-breathable. Added to this, convection currents caused by the strong solar radiation falling on the planet lead to large dust clouds primarily composed of carbon particulates that can not only clog lungs but also machinery. With no out-right economic value, Santorini's main significance is it's unique asteroid belt, held in place due to the gravitational pull of the planet's dense core. This belt houses the relatively newly established Thira Colony.

1116696.text:
DIAMETER: 2,356 km
MASS: 2.43 x 10e24 kg
TERRAIN: Barren
TEMPERATURE: -48°C to 75°C
ESCAPE VELOCITY: 4.45 km/sec

A moon of the much larger Mykonos gas giant, Naxos is a small rocky satellite with little economic value. Pot marked by craters from asteroid impacts, the moon has a very thin atmosphere and is primarily used for weapons testing by the Corsair contingent in the system.

1116698.text:
For the longest time, Knossos has remained largely untouched due to its location within the North Aegean Nebula. While it was known to exist, its location deterred most from attempting to chart the planet nestled within the depths of the hostile nebula. However, with the Corsairs further advancing into Omicron Xi, it was only a matter of time before someone stumbled upon the remains of an ancient Nomad installation that had been constructed within the upper atmosphere of the planet. Appearing utterly destroyed, the installation shows signs of having been damaged by an especially heavy atmospheric storm a long time ago, although the reason for its abandonment is just as arcane as its original purpose. Thus it only floats, slowly getting pulled in by Knossos' gravitational pull until the jagged remains of the alien installation one day burn up in the planet's lower atmosphere.

The discovery did not go unnoticed, however. Both the Outcasts and the Corsairs have set their eyes on the site, as rumors had quickly spread about a new source of Xeno Artifacts that would fetch exorbitant prices on the black market of Sirius. Due to the contested nature of Omicron Xi, however, the journey to Knossos is one littered with dangers and so it remains to be seen as to whether Malta or Crete manages to assert dominance over the site or whether they content themselves with merely denying the other access to it.

GRAVITY: Complete

AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 120
1116700.mapped:
Deep within the Andros Field, Tinos Relay was established shortly after the system was discovered by the Corsairs in 786 AS, originally intended to act as the watchtower at one of the furthermost frontiers of the Corsair Empire. Tinos' purpose was adjusted with the construction of Syros and the deployment of the Battleship Delos to Omicron Xi, to act as a relay station for communications and patrols between them and Crete. After discovery of unknown hostiles in the Aegean Nebulae, an experimental satellite monitoring system was put in place, with sensor satellites deployed across the system to give warning of any incursion. With telemetry relayed back from these satellites to Tinos, the station is able to distribute this intelligence to all other bases and allied vessels in the system, providing both whereabouts and tactical data about the perceived threat.

Fortuitously, this same satellite monitoring system has been of great aid in confining Rheinland Military operations to the southwestern solar end of the system. As Tinos directly controls the data received from the Satellites, the loss of the Relay to Rheinland would be catastrophic for Corsair control of the system. The Corsairs are fully aware of this threat, with patrols from Battleship Delos constantly swarming the field.

CLASS: Herreria
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 400
1116703.mapped:
Syros was a project undertaken by the Corsairs in 802 AS, overseen by one of Crete's powerful military families. Originally intended to act primarily as the base of operations for forces in the area, the station was later expanded to include a drydock. Syros has been dubbed a shipyard since then, acting as a primary service and repair facility for many Osiris, Legate, and now Murmillo-class battleships for fleets operating in the upper Omicrons and Sigmas. Following Delos' deployment to Omicron Xi, Syros Shipyard was expanded to include a secondary drydock, making the station formidable in terms of capacity, but despite its size, historically the construction of new vessels has rarely taken place at Syros. This is in part due to the difficulty of transporting raw materials to the base, as well as its strategic position.

In advent of suddenly finding itself flanked and vulnerable in the face of the encroaching Rheinland Military, the families of Crete relocated an additional one hundred crew to kick the facility into desperate overdrive. Production is inefficient, and the cost of lives manning the frequently-raided facility has increased dramatically as the weathering attacks take their toll.

After extensive damage was done to the base, crippling its life support systems and forcing the Corsairs to shut down the reactor core, the RNC Schwerin and her battlegroup were ordered to withdraw to the Munich system to consolidate Rheinland's forces in light of escalating tensions in the Crow nebula theater. The Corsairs now work to restore Syros to its former capacity, though timeline is not optimistic.

CLASS: Ocaso
GRAVITY: Partial
DOCKING: Yes
AMENITIES: Yes
CREW: 230
1116706.mapped:
Thira Colony was established within the large asteroid ring around Santorini in 810 AS. With precious little raw materials in the system, the planetoid chosen was almost entirely impermeable and thus perfect for a "dig in" outpost. With the increased frequency of attacks on Omicron Gamma and other Corsair establishments in the Edge by their enemies, Corsair leaders felt it necessary to lay provisions for a tactical retreat to a defensible location if such drastic action was ever called for.

Thira was the centerpiece of this plan, which was designed to help house several thousand people for a short time, out of harm's way if the time ever came when Crete was no longer defendable. By current projections, the Thira project has only utilized an eighth of the planetoid's volume so far, and thus has huge potential to be expanded if necessary. Operating at a sustainable five percent of current capacity, Thira Colony currently only houses around two hundred people, but is largely self sufficient. Occasional gas-scoops from nearby planets provide the station with Oxygen and water to sustain its current populace, and enough food can be produced in experimental hydroponics centers within the planetoid to feed the minimal crew that currently reside there.

Once renowned as the "quietest place in the Corsair Empire", Thira was intended to act as the last place of refuge if Gamma is ever overthrown. This plan has been all but sidelined as an extremely vengeful Rheinland Military emerged out of a jump hole from nearby Munich into this formerly nearly-uncontested portion of Corsair space. The number of ships stationed aboard the colony have at least tripled since this new threat unveiled itself and the Corsair leaders have re-started intensive efforts to hollow out portions of the crust for hangar-space and the like. In comparison to the shipyard stationed elsewhere in-system, Thira has thus far escaped notice from the invaders.

CLASS: Storage Facility
GRAVITY: None
DOCKING: No
AMENITIES: No
CREW: 5

The C6 refueling platform was commissioned shortly after the deployment of the Delos to Omicron Xi. Manned by a skeleton crew of only 5 people, the platform's only purpose is to continually refuel the Delos between patrols to ensure that the Battleship remains deployed and on patrol for as long as is possible.

1116711.text: Part of a network of similar structures in the system, this satellite transmits telemetry and tactical information back to Tinos Outpost. After the discovery of possible hostile forces in the system, and with vulnerable bases already established, the Satellite network was established to provide the Corsair bases with prior warning of possible attacks, and to provide corsair ships with precise whereabouts and tactical information about threats, allowing interception to take place.

1116714.text: So...where you from? Not part of the crew? Me neither, I just come here occasionally with supplies. This ship's been out here for years chasing ghosts. By rights it should have been decommissioned a decade ago. Want to know what I think? The captain set this all up to keep his command.

1116715.text: Gah. Can you do me a favour and get the barman to darken the windows? That sunlight's blinding me.

1116716.text: We're not supposed to drink on duty, but people did, so no alcohol is allowed onboard. If you want anything stronger than synth juice here, speak to Pedro. Crazy bastard has a still hidden in an old reactor in engineering!

1116717.text: I just got back from the Refuelling Platform. The crew take it in turns to man the platform for five days at a time. Trust me; five days in that hell hole was plenty. You come back with muscle cramps and stinking like death. It's hot as hell in there and there's barely enough space to move around. Still, at least I won't have to go back for at least another 3 months.

1116718.text: Gonzalez told me he saw something a few patrols back, at the edge of the Nebula. Then again, Gonzalez is a little off his head. Probably just a wisp of cloud caught in a gravity well.

1116719.text: Don't listen to all the sceptics. I've seen the enemies with my own eyes. It's a damn good thing we're out here, or I'm sure they'd overthrow the system. I reacon they fear the Delos.

1116720.text: The sun? Don't be ridiculous. No, this ship runs on H-Fuel made with hydrogen scooped up from Mykonos. It's brought from there to the Refuelling Platform, and then picked up every time we stop between our patrols.

1116721.text: You know, I'm sick of this place. Paroling back and forth along a dead frontier is no life for a true corsair. I'd rather be out there on the front line battling Bounty Hunters and Hessians, rather than on this old ship chasing sensor ghosts.

1116722.text: My brother was part of the reckon group that where attacked. He managed to get back alive, but could never fly again. My brother's no liar; something IS outhere, even if most of the crew no longer believe it.

1116723.text: You ever been on one of those Legate Dreadnoughts? I did once. My god, they're huge. Go to the Front Turret control area and you can't even hear the engines. I've always preferred the Delos though. After so long working in engineering, it feels like home.

1116724.text: Spoken to any of those idiots who still believe there are dangers out here? We've been patrolling this frontier for years, and I haven't heard of any encounters. Let's face it; this is all an excuse to keep the Delos from being sold for scrap.

1116725.text: I tell you, the day the Delos leaves the Omicron Xi frontier is the day that whatever lurks beyond will overthrow this system. We stay here, and the people living at Thira remain safe. The minute the Delos is called back to Tripoli, the entire system will be in danger.

1116726.text: I got a message from the duty officer today. I'll be part of the next team manning the Refuelling Platform. It's gonna be awesome. We're each gonna smuggle in a couple of bottles of Pedro's bootleg brews. 5 uninterrupted days of getting whasted, and we'll be getting paid double for it too!

1116731.text:
I'll never trust a Zoner. Those cold-blooded pacifists would sell their own mother to make a profit. I've heard so many stories of them sitting by while Bounty Hunters or Outcasts attack our ships. Anything to protect their precious neutrality. Mark my words friend, if I find a lone Zoner out of contact range with the rest of his corporation, I won't hesitate to kill him. It's what they deserve.
?

1116732.text: This place is basicly a relay station. Every transmission going between Omicron Xi and Omicron Gamma passes through here, and if they're not encrypted, we're at liberty to read them. Let me tell you, there's plenty going on in this system that most guys aren't told about. I won't go into details; the commandante'd have my head.

1116733.text: See those guys over there? They're on leave from the Delos. Loads of guys from that Battleship come to spend their off-days here because our bar serves proper alcohol; rather than that vile bootleg stuff a few guys make there.

1116734.text: We must have the best jobs in the empire. My amigos and I work up in the Satellite Reception room. Every day we go up there, play cards and drink while the satellite receiver clicks away. Occasionally we're interrupted by an alarm as something shows up on one of the sensors, but it's normally just comets or the like. I've only had to notify the Delos of a sensor disturbance twice, and both times they didn't find anything.

1116735.text: Joey takes cardamine. Says he likes the buzz. Gotta say I can't imagine what kind of Corsair would take the Outcast drug. If he wasn't my amigo I'd definately report him. Hopefully I can get him into Synth Ganja or something instead.

1116736.text: Whew. That was fun. I just got back from a patrol on the other side of the Gamma Hole. We take regular patrols through it, mostly to ensure no bounty hunters that find the entrance to Omicron Xi live to tell of it's whereabouts. A couple of them where on the other side when we jumped. They where no match for us though.

1116737.text: Seen Amorgos? It's a rocky moon that orbits Mykonos. A couple of years ago they did survey missions there, but because of something in the atmosphere all the guys went crazy. Thing is though; almost every group that returned mentioned alien ruins. I reckon there's more on that Moon than the Council of Elders want us to know about.

1116738.text: Ever seen a Praetorian Bomber in action? Ever flown one? Back when I was younger, I co-piloted one of them. I remember firing the torpedo launcher while my hermano would handle all the manoeuvres. It's a great feeling to pull the trigger and watch a Hunter Gunboat's cockpit decompress. Those where the days.

1116739.text: Back before I came to work here, I used to work as a co-pilot on a smuggler train. We'd haul Artifacts all the way to Liberty. Back in those days, you could make a hefty profit on the way back too; for a reasonable fee we used to rent out space in the cargo hold and smuggle migrants from Liberty all the way to Munich. It was a great route, because there's an arms factory on Nuremberg. We'd fill the hold with Rheinland Blaster Rifles and then take them all the way back to Crete. I made a fairly good wage, though it was my boss that made the big bucks from it.

1116740.text: I bet you thought this place was ruled by the Council of Elders on Crete! Ha! You'd be wrong my friend. This entire system is controlled by the descendants of the great Corsair explorer who discovered it. O'course, they normally do as they're told by the Elders, but essentially this system has it's own government.

1116741.text: It's been years since I was last on Crete. I never liked it much there. I mean, sure, it's the centre of the empire, but with that comes the hectic lifestyle. Here in Omicron Xi we're not plagued by foreigners, and we're miles away from the politics between the different families that always leads to trouble. My whole family moved here when I did, so I've got no reason to want to go back.

1116750.text: Whatever they might say, this place ain't no shipyard. No ships bigger than a Titan have been built here. We just service and repair existing warships, like the Battleship Talos currently sitting in dry dock 1.

1116751.text: I'm here with the constructors building dry dock 2. It would have been finished months ago, but it's not a very high priority, and the hull panels needed to finish it keep being diverted to Tripoli to be used in building warships. By my reaconing, it's going to be a long while before it's completed.

1116752.text: After being serviced here, ships normally do a last-minute weapons test by firing all turrets at Naxos. It's a useless ball of rock, but they've made a bit of mess of it anyway. I don't think the Gaians would approve. Luckily they don't know about this place.

1116753.text: I'm part of the team that scoops gas from Mykonos so it can be processed here to produce breathable atmosphere and hydrogen fuel. The planet doesn't supply enough fuel for the whole fleet; just enough to keep the Delos running, along with afew small patrol groups.

1116754.text: Gah...I don't think dry dock-2 will ever be finished. Just as we manage to secure a shipment of hull panels, which we need to complete the project, the supplies get diverted to Tripoli Shipyard to be used in warship construction. We're told that "that has to be the priority". Meanwhile, my workmen spend week after week sitting on their hands waiting for supplies.

1116755.text: I've fixed up enough gunboats to have a pretty good idea of how they work amigo. A gunboat's power-plant is rarely sufficient to allow all it's guns to fire simultaneously for very long. You gotta group them! Some turrets work better against fighters, some against other warships. Keep these seperate, and your power plant will last.

1116756.text: D'you know we've even had Order warships roll through here? Yep. Normally they'd get repaired somewhere else, but every so often one of them gets damaged in our territory and can't make it the whole way back! I'd be lying if I told you we've never stolen any technology during these occasions.

1116757.text: Heh. You here exploring? My advice to you is stay well away from the Aegian Nebulae. I hear the radiation there is so strong your skin begins to crumble away almost the minute you enter. There's probably worse things in there than radiation too.

1116758.text: Captaining a warship requires very different skills to piloting a fighter, amigo, and a good fighter pilot might not make a good warship commander. D'you know some of the most respected and powerful Corsairs alive choose to fly fighters? There's more glory to be found in a cockpit than on a battle bridge.

1116763.text: Santorini's a pretty unstable planet. Every so often when you look out you can see eruptions on the surface. Some are quite impressive.

1116764.text: You think this place is big? You have no idea, amigo. We've only used a tiny portion of this planetoid so far. There's just so much room to expand if we ever need to! This place has loads of potential.

1116765.text: My daughter still lives on Crete. I can't think why. It's so much more peaceful here, and there's less risk of attack. She's rather attached to her job, though, working in the Cretian spaceport bar.

1116766.text: This must be the quietest place in the empire. People rarely come and go, and we're so far from any potential threats that children that grow up here can do so without fear. Of course, there are the scaremongers that try to spoil this utopia with their stories of enemies lurking in the Aegean, but I tell my kids to ignore them.

1116767.text: Have you been to the hydroponics room? It's beautiful; a garden hidden within a cavern. One day, perhaps, we will build biodomes like the Zoner ones at Freeport 9. Of course, it would be easier if those swine shared the technology with us.

1116768.text: The Santorini Asteroid Belt is considered by many Corsairs to be a wonder of Sirius. Thin belts made up of dust are common, but none quite compare to this; a belt that a station can hide comfortably within and still be almost un-detectable.

1116769.text: I tell you...there are alien ruins on that moon. My dad was on one of the survey missions. He still swears to this day that what he saw was real. If there are alien ruins, chances are the stories about creatures in the Aegean Nebula might be true.

1116770.text: You know, if I where a trader, I know where I'd fly. There's big demand for Gold on Tripoli, and if you're careful not to give away your allegiances, you can pick up gold pretty cheaply from the Mollys in Dublin.

1116771.text: Corsair weaponry is some of the best around, and the "Del Cid" weapons are a great example. The Colada Del Cid is the most powerful shield-killer I've ever seen in my career mounted on a fighter, but here's a secret; two Tizona Del Cids are together more energy efficient and more powerful.

1116773.text: At some point over the last decade, the Southern Aegean Nebula split, drifting to cover the Munich jump hole. Guarding the only passage to and from the jumphole is a Benitez family cruiser and gunboat. These two are under the command of the well known Benitez commander Seth Benitez, widely respcted for defending Xi against several nomad invaders in the summer of 815 AS.

1116775.text: A heavily armed Benitez cruiser standing guard.

1116859.text: What appears to be a Nomad Hive can be glimpsed by the very few to enter the Lebanon Cloud's depths and survive. The close stellar proximity to Sigma-17 suggests that the hostile entities responsible for destroying Freeport 7 and sparking the Nomad War originated from here.

1116861.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
Lebanon is a cloud of Crow Nebula gases, the composition within being unknown and nigh-impossible to permeate with scanners; a trait shared with many similar nebulae in the Sigmas. Hostile life-forms are believed to inhabit the interior and entry is heavily inadvisable.

1116863.text:
>>>CAUTION<<<
An outcropping of the Edge Nebula, of unknown internal composition. Visiting xenoarcheologists and scientists believe that some kind of gravitational satellite at the center of the system's nebulae keeps the Black Hole from tearing them apart. In Damascus' case, the "anchor" is believed to be a jump hole.

1116865.text:
A vast asteroid field locked in an embrace around the titanic black hole slowly drawing in the system's stellar matter. The most likely culprit for the scattered rocks are ancient and long-dormant remains of destroyed planets or moons.

House Intelligence agencies local to the area heavily caution against lingering, as the terrorist organization known as The Order is believed to have vested interests in the region.

1116867.text: An Offshoot of the Edge Nebula, locked into alignment with Sigma-17's trinary stars. While largely unexplored, Shikotan is known to house micro-organisms found native to planet Kurile, however no corporation yet has made any definite claim to resources within the cloud.

1116869.text: Nearly two years after the sundering of Toledo, a group of radical tight-knit Zoner colonists hailing from the southern Omicrons attempted to settle within Omicron Minor's massive, cloying nebula. Arousing the ire of both the Order and Core, the station was eventually the site of a battle between the two paramilitaries. Freeport Jackson was never completed, being destroyed after the attack of an unknown party killing the entirety of the colonists in a single stroke. Neither side claimed responsibility, pointing out the volatile political and even xenobiologic situation so deep into the Edge Worlds.

1116871.text: One of three dense asteroid field formed by the remains of a planetary collision that occurred early in the system's development.
