1116920.text:
ESSEN - Active Kruger Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

Kruger has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Bautzen Station - Dresden: Diamond mining in the Schwefelwolke.
Bautzen is one of the oldest mining operations in Rheinland, harvesting clear diamonds from the Schwefelwolke asteroids. Recently, new deposits have been located in the southern end of the nebula, still suitable for mining.

Elbich Mining Facility - Omega 7: Silver and Cobalt mining operation in the Walker Nebula.
The Omega-7 region of the Walker nebula is rich in mineral resources. Kruger has established the Elbich Mining Facility north of the Jump Gate to Stuttgard and staked claims northeast of Elbich.

Wuppertal Refinery - Cologne: Aluminium mining in the Wildspitze.
The Wuppertal refinery is a joint project between ALG and Kruger. The base is not yet fully operational, but mining operations can already be initiated. The nearby Wildspitze field, northeast of the base, posesses a good quantity of Aluminium.

1116922.text:
THE RING - Active Daumann Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

Daumann has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Solarius Station - Omega-11: Diamond mining in the Riemen Von Rohe.
Solarius is our primary diamond mining operation. Diamonds float freely in the ring around the red giant. Be aware of the intense radiation throughout most of the system. A heavily armored mining ship is recommended. Daumann has placed marker buoys near greater concentrations of diamond-bearing asteroids. 

Briesen Mining Facility - Omega-7: Copper and Cobalt mining operation in the Walker Nebula.
The Omega-7 region of the Walker nebula is rich in mineral resources. Daumann has established the Briesen Mining Facility south of the Jump Gate to Stuttgard and staked claims south of Briesen.

Rugen Station - Omega-3: Hydrocarbon mining.
Rugen, located south of the Omega-7 Jump Gate in Omega-3 is our primary source of raw hydrocarbons. The heaviest concentration is found south of Rugen Station itself.

Raubling Station - Munich: Aluminium mining in the Chiemsee fragments.
Raubling was located close to the Chiemsee before the Munich disaster, but the asteroid field has fragmented since then. Two dense portions remain, one located southwest of Passau Station, and one northwest of Ingolstadt. Daumann has laid claim to both of these fragments.

1116923.text: Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing - Space-based Mining Operations

1116924.text:
THAMES - Active BMM Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

BMM has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Graves Station - Dublin: Gold mining in the Dublin system.
Dublin has been the primary source gold for Sirius for over 400 years, and this isn't likely to change any time soon. Graves has several active mining operations, but the most commonly used field is to the southeast of the base.

Cambridge Mining Facility - Cambridge: Beryllium Mining.
The Cambridge system has an extensive asteroid field north of Planet Cambridge, rich in Beryllium. A new station, which at the time of this writing has not received an official name yet, is being established to initiate mining on this field.

Douglas Station - Omega-3: Hydrocarbon mining.
Douglas, located south of Planet Nottingham in Omega-3 is a major source of raw hydrocarbons. The heaviest concentration is found south of Douglas Station.

1116926.text:
SHINJUKU - Active Samura Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

Samura Heavy Industries has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Sapporo Station - Hokkaido: Helium-3 Gas Mining
With the Gas Miners Guild no longer supplying Samura, we have seen fit to resume our own Gas Mining operations in the Hokkaido system. These our based from Sapporo, and can be found east of the base.

Planet Tomioka - Tottori: Platinum Mining.
The Shirane planetoid has a debris field surrounding it which has proven to be rich in Platinum. Astronomers are unsure whether this planetoid will remain in Tottori as of yet, so Samura has not built a permanent mining facility. Instead mining craft can be serviced at Tomioka, and ore shipped elsewhere for processing.

Shinkaku Station - Tau-29: Hydrocarbon mining.
The Shinkaku field is a good source of a variety of organic compounds, ranging from nitrates to hydrocarbons. The best hydrocarbon deposits are located in the northwest part of the field.

1116928.text:
SHINEGAWA - Active Kishiro Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

Kishiro has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Gas Miner Ogashawa - Sigma-19: Helium-3 Gas Mining
Our partnership with the Gas Miners Guild allows us to operate our own Gas Mining operation within the Sigma-19 system. Kishiro's gas miners are located northeast of the Ogashawa.

Nago Station - Tau-29: Hydrocarbon mining.
The Nago field is a good source of a variety of primary hydrocarbons. The highest density is located northwest of the station.

1116929.text: Deep Space Engineering - Space-based Mining Operations

1116930.text:
PITTSBURGH - Active DSE Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

DSE has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Camrose Supply Depot - Alberta: Platinum Mining
Scouts in the Alberta system have found a midsized asteroid field in the far north of the system rich in Platinum. While collection is fairly easy, the remote location of this field does not make it easy to reach.

Philedelphia Station - Pennsylvania: Silver mining
Also a rather remote location in the Pennsylvania system, the Wilkis-Barre asteroid field in the far northeast of the system contains small amounts of silver. Yields are not as high as those reputed in the Omegas, but the field is still a valuable asset.

1116931.text: Independent Miners Guild - Space-based Mining Operations

1116932.text:
ALAND - Active IMG Space-based Mining Operations, for guildsman reference. 

The IMG has the following opportunities for miners:
Java Station - Tau-23: Niobium and Beryllium Mining
Gallia has thus far tolerated our presence in Tau-23, so our operations in the system are going on as usual. There is Beryllium in the southeast, and Niobium in the northwest, both in dense asteroid pockets. 

Falkland Base - Tau-37: Niobium Mining
Falkland is our most remote mining outpost. Beware of a heavy Outcast presence if you launch from this base. The main field in Tau-37 is in the west of the system. 

The Hood - Dublin: Gold Mining
The Hood, famous for it's racetrack, is also host to our gold mining efforts. Expect badmouthing from BMM and the occasional Molly and Corsair raiders if you visit Dublin. Main mining fields we use are northeast from the Hood.

Cardiff Station - Cambridge: Beryllium Mining
Cardiff is our main Beryllium mining operation. The mining effort is north of the base, behind the planet Cardiff orbits. 

Freistadt Base - Omega-7: Copper, Silver and Cobalt Mining
Omega-7 is extremely rich in resources. The IMG has established claims on several smaller fields northwest of Freistadt, from which Copper, Silver and Cobalt are harvested.

1116933.text: Gas Miners Guild - Active Gas Collection Operations

1116934.text:
AOMORI - Active Gas Mining Operations, for employee reference

The Gas Miners Guild maintains operations in the following systems:
Sigma-13: A cluster of miners still operates east of the protostars. The Sigma-13 resources however have been on the decline for years, and the recent increase in Corsair and Outcast activity makes this mining operation a risky one. 

Sigma-19: The Sigma-19 system is expected to be viable for several more centuries. Our partner, Kishiro, also has a smaller operation established in the system. All operations are based out of Gas Miner Ogashawa. Our main effort is currently focused to the south of Ogashawa. Hogosha and Outcast raiders pose a threat to these operations. 

Okinawa: Our most recent endeavour, Okinawa has a major gas mining operation centered around the Fujisawa facility. The highest concentration is currently in the southern end of the nebula, so our operations focus there. Be aware of the volatile nature of the nebula around Fujisawa however - strong shielding is recommended.

1116935.text: Gallic Metal Service - Space-based Mining Operations

1116936.text:
ALESIA - Active GMS Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference. 

GMS has the following operations which are in need of additional employees:
Toulon Mining Facility - Provence: Niobium mining in the southern end of the Camargue field.
The Camargue dustfield is rich in various precious metals. While the Toulon facility refines a number of these, Niobium has been found in sufficient concentration for direct mining operations. The richest deposits are in the southern end of the field.

Indochine Outpost - Tau-23: Beryllium mining east of the base.
The Tau asteroid fields seem rich in various metals. The Royal Navy has seized a Bretonian mining operation in the system labeled Tau-23, which was mining Beryllium. We can now begin exploiting these resources ourselves. The field is located to the east of the base. It is easy to find - simply follow the trail of Bretonian wreckage.

1116938.text:
ROCHESTER - A scrapper scoop for all you scrappers out there. Here's where the good stuff is.

Texas: Good old 'Tex has been a boon for Junker scrappers for almost 200 years, and that ain't changing any time soon. Sure, most of the good stuff that was easy pickings has been picked, but there's still plenty, if you know where to look. And you'll have to look inside the dark, menacing Negra clouds. Plenty of Premium Scrap pieces there, but the radiation can be bad. Ye'll need a heavily armored ship for scrapping in that mire. The boys at Beaumont will fix you up if you take some damage.

New London: Southampton's been churning out refuse for centuries, and those Brets weren't too keen on "recycling" until quite recently. So there's plenty of still useful stuff. The Southwest section of the debris field is usually the best spot - ask around on Trafalgar.

Bering and Hudson: Unexpected opportunities. When the Rheinies blew the gates and wrecked a few Liberty heavies in the process, they left that pile of wreckage just sitting there. Liberty doesn't seem to be in a hurry to make repairs either. Their loss. Our gain. Scoop up the good stuff close to the gates, but keep an eye out for Xeno raiders, they seem to think they own those places.

1116939.text: We ship Prisoners out from here to the Texas prisons. Xeno and Rogue activity in this system is fairly high, and they manage to infiltrate Erie all the time, despite our best efforts. I suspect the Junkers help the Rogues get onto the planet. Nobody has figured out how the Xenos do it, yet. Some say they've got some sort of pact with the Zoners, but I'm not so sure. Aren't Zoners foreigners? Who knows... Those Xenos are nuts.

1116940.text: We seem to be always last on the H-Fuel delivery schedule in Liberty. Our tanks were practically running on fumes the last time a supply ship arrived. Those rascals in Naval Logistics always favor their former commands, and nobody from Gettysburg can manage to get promoted up to that department. It's all a greedy plot, I'm sure of it.

1116941.text: One thing we do get plenty of here is Light Arms and grunts to fire them. Oh, I guess that's two things. I have to hand it to the Marines, those numbskulls are fearless. Some Rogue was hijacking Hydrogen miners out in the fields a while back. An Assault Transport of Marines flew out there and started transmitting broadcasts like they were a mining ship. Sure enough, before long that Rogue posse showed and boy did they get a surprise. The field is so thick that the Assault Trans managed to hide right up until the last moment when they popped out from a dense cloud and magnetically latched on. That Rogue boarding party must have been awful surprised when they got a taste of their own medicine.

1116942.text: Did you know the Zoners didn t even bother to clean up when they packed their things and left Pennsylvania? What a shameful attitude is that, I ask you!

1116943.text: Have you heard of the new multiplayer game? Its set up in an environment of a totalitarian dictatorship with strict rules, violence and oppression. I hear it is very popular among Zoners who enjoy getting pushed around in their spare time.

1116944.text: Things aren't half bad here in Pennsylvania. Sure, the pay isn't as good as on some of the corporation bounties out in the borderworlds, but you don't exactly have a battleship to pull back to in those either. Usually. Anyway. Shout me another Liberty Ale?

1116945.text: You got two kinds of jobs here as a Bounty Hunter. One's called Liberty Rogue, the other Xeno. Both of them require a bit of agressive negotiations to turn a tidy sum. Both of em tend to harass the lanes and Jump Gate area most of the time. That's where I go once I'm loaded. Shout me another Liberty Ale?

1116946.text: There's one more place to keep in mind as a Hunter. The Junker smugglers hive near Sayre. Rogues go there to sell off whatever they looted. Xenos come there to stomp on the Junkers. I usually limit myself to the Xenos down there, that way I actually get some help from those damned Junkers. Won't last though, those bastards are criminals themselves, but not worth my time until Liberty puts a bounty on them. Shout me another Liberty Ale?

1116947.text: I don't know what I did wrong to get assigned to this blasted hellhole. I don't even get what we are doing here. Liberty is at war with Rheinland and probably Gallia soon as well. Dealing with criminals is the LPI's job, not ours.

1116948.text: The Zoners don't want us around, that much I know. If it wouldn't violate standing orders, I'd simply no longer "opress" Liberty Rogues taking apart one of their Dromedaries one laserblast at a time. Hypocrites, the lot of them. Yech.

1116949.text: I've put in a request for transfer to the Concorde. I heared they took quite a beating over in New Hampshire, and need exprienced people. I hope it comes through, I need to leave this place before I go insane.

1116950.text: I've drawn far patrol this week. It's the least desirable assignment: You go out in a patrol ship outfitted with extra sensors and just fly practically blind, scanning for anomalous readings. Mostly, this is to prevent the Xenos or Rogues from establishing a base within striking distance of the lanes or Erie. You're out there on your own, and if a stronger flight of Rogues ambushes you, you're in for a hard fight.

1116951.text: The Rogues and Xenos have both attempted to build small bases nearer to the Trade Lane. Our blind patrols help spot those. The last attempt was only two months ago, when the Rogues tried to build a small depot on the far side of Planet Bruin. Gettysburg blew their attempt out of the sky not long after we found it - what's left of it left a nice impact crater on the planet.

1116952.text: One of the more interesting patrol routes has you circling Tremont. The large rings around that gas giant are beautiful. I'm told that they contained small quantities of Platinum at some point, but have since been mined out by Zoners and Freelancers looking to make a quick buck. Now there's just dust out there.

1116953.text: I'm fresh out of West Point. The Gettysburg is my first combat posting. I'm quite excited about it. Sure, I'm still a greenhorn when it comes to combat, but I'll stick with the rest of my squad and see what kind of tricks they know that aren't in the naval handbook.

1116954.text: It hasn't been dull so far, this first posting of mine. My first flight after receiving my posting, I was travelling to the Gettysburg by lane. Usually a very simple journey, just one gate, three lanes. But there was a large Rogue raiding party right at the Pennsylvania gate. I think they were as surprised to see us as we were to see them. Half of them fled while the other half opened fire - it would have been even if those Rogues stayed together, but with only half of their force staying, it was over in minutes. I scored 2 kills!

1116955.text: I've received my first orders. Perimiter duty around the Gettysburg. I hear its a very dull assignment, but that will give me a bit of time to familiarise myself with Pennsylvania. A good pilot doesn't need nav controls to know where he is relative to the nearest safe base. The position of the various planets relative to the star is all you should need.

1116957.text:
OMG-CYN-105 Engine
Based loosely off upon the MOX VP engine series, the kitbashed OMG propulsion series was a questionable solution to reduce the hellish costs of the VP's maintenance nightmare. It is not known who made the first rudimentary engine, but these engines are notorious for their gargantuan scorching emissions and unstable chambers. Due to its considerable risks of spontaneous combustion, pilots consider as a last resort option for those who love to live on the edge.

This Cyan engine is intended for use primarily on Light Fighters.

Top Speed (theoretical): 425

1117061.text:
Z-6150 "Bactrian" Pirate Freighter

On the edge of legality, the demands for the most basic fruits of commerce become incredibly pressing. Basic foodstuffs, recycled water, new clothing, fresh materials for station-side equipment...All of these are things that every station needs, and when you cant simply have it delivered, you have to find an alternative method. The Bactrian is the solution to the problem of supporting the needs of the thousands of people who cannot simply tap into the legitimate trade networks in each system. It is seen hauling stolen goods in its sizable and well armored cargohold just as often as it is seen buying goods, bringing every sort of product to the markets that line the underbelly, and indeed the pockets of the underbelly, of the Sirius trade network.

1117063.text:
Nova Torpedo
Nova Torpedo is the most devastating anti-battleship weapon in Sirius. It requires a Nova torpedo launcher to fire.

1117064.text:
CLASS: Scylla
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
1117064.mapped:
The Shillelagh is one of the Scylla class destroyers produced at Foyle Shipyard, launching in 822 AS. It initially operated as a commerce raider in New London and Manchester -- occasionally cooperating with Gallic forces. As the Mollys prepared to take action aboard Graves Station in 831 AS, the Shillelagh played a critical role in the second phase of their plan. Molly leaders believed that an independent Dublin could never be secured while the New London Jump Gate remained intact, allowing unimpeded access by Armed Forces reinforcements. The Jump Gate itself was heavily protected by the Battleship Essex and its support fleet, which would normally make a direct attack impossible.

Following the mutiny aboard Graves and the public execution of a number of BMM executives, the Essex was forced to intervene immediately. With Graves under Molly control and the Essex deployed to the edge of the Founder's Gold Field, a once in a lifetime opportunity was available; the Shillelagh and all of the Molly reserves were committed to a win or die assault. The Shillelagh's escort incurred heavy casualties fighting through the battle hardened but outnumbered squadrons the Essex had left to guard the jump gate. Once a path had been cleared through this rearguard, the Shillelagh towed an enormous demolition mine into place and affixed it to the superstructure. The resulting explosion shattered the outer gate housing, destabilizing the gate core.

To avoid being cut off in Dublin, the Essex issued an immediate evacuation order. The survivors of the Molly diversion force and Shillelagh squadrons attempted to intercept the fleet as it withdrew, but were unable to prevent its escape to New London before the gate core detonated. The Shillelagh itself took heavy damage from the Essex's gunners before being forced to retreat. After receiving repairs at Foyle, the Shillelagh took command of the Sluagh Brigade, and began operations against the Bretonian blockade and Corsair raiders. In 835 AS, the Shillelagh once again crossed swords with a Bretonian fleet, leading the action against the First Cruiser Flotilla near the Achill Asteroid Field. Despite its Brigade suffering heavy casualties, the Bretonian advance was halted.

1117065.text:
AI Emitter
An energy emission device that is part of an adaptable series of emitters, used only by AI Drones. When used as a weapon, the energy blasts are equally effective against all known shield types.

1117066.text: Liberty Rogues rarely use Outcast Destroyers these days, but several ships of this class still remain in their posession. One of them had previously been stationed not far from West Point; when the war with Rheinland has started, the Liberty Navy has increased security in all Liberty systems, forcing the ship to move into the small nebula located within the Pittsburgh Debris Field. Previously, this location was occupied by a small Rogue depot that was destroyed in 800 AS by a Liberty Security Force squadron. Edison Trent, at that time an unremarkable freelancer working for the LSF, participated in this attack.

1117078.text: [813 AS] Tensions Rising between Kusari and Bretonia

1117079.text:
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 813 AS ]]

NEW TOKYO -- In a press release today Kusari officials have condemned Bretonia once again for the scale of the Bretonian Armed Forces build up in the Tau systems, after new information has emerged showing Bretonian warships stationed near Holman Outpost, a peaceful IMG installation in the Tau-31 system. Bretonian patrols were spotted as far as Tau-29, prompting fears of possible Bretonian annexation on the Kusari public. IMG officials have expressed regret over this course of action and continued to press for a peaceful resolution, despite already being pressed by obvious Bretonian colonialism. In response, Queen Carina I of Bretonia has officially attempted to explain these actions by pointing the blame at the honourable Kusari Naval Forces who have stalled for as long as they could in the face of a Bretonian military advance. She further continued spreading lies about Kusari material support for Bretonian eco-terrorists.

In response, the Kusari government has officially put out an order to rally the Naval Forces in preparation for a possible Bretonian attack. The Tau-29 system is shortly expected to be declared as part of a Kusari protectorate to ensure the system's continued independence from Bretonian military ambitions. The protectorate will also encompass the lawless Tau-23 system in order to assure the safety of Kusari territory.

1117080.text: [812 AS] Tensions Rising between Bretonia and Kusari

1117081.text:
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]

NEW LONDON -- Peace in Sirius sector is under threat once again. The militaristic Kusari government supported by Hogosha criminals is doing everything to destabilize the situation in Tau space. Previously the only enemies that Bretonia had to deal with in the Tau systems were the Outcasts and the Gaians. Now however it appears that there is a new, more dangerous enemy - the Kusari Naval Forces. If that wasn't enough, the Queen's government has recently recovered proof that the Gaian eco-terrorist movement is being supplied directly from Kusari.

In response, New London launched an attempt to negotiate on the fragile Tau situation with Liberty as a mediater, an attempt which was repulsed by the Foreign Ministry of Kusari. This immediately launched concerns that the Kusari government is trying to provoke a full-scale war with Bretonia. The Queen's government refused to officially acknowledge this until proof had been produced of a Kusari military buildup in Tau-29, when hundreds of Kusari destroyers and gunboats have been spotted entering neutral Tau space.

To secure Bretonian borders, the Bretonian government ordered an increase in Armed Forces presence in the Tau-31 system. Armed Forces will concentrate on securing Bretonian holdings in the system, but will remain clear of the other Jump Gates within Tau-31. A Bretonian official commented on the situation: "We hope dearly that Kusari does not try to push this diplomatic failure into a war, for it will cost many lives. Bretonia will not bow to this sabre rattling and our forces will remain on orders to hold fire unless the Kusari Navy openly strikes us first".

1117082.text: [812 AS] Coalition Formed Against Corsair Expansion

1117083.text:
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]

BUFFALO -- Since early 812 AS tensions have been steadily rising between the houses of Bretonia and Kusari, and it is expected open war will break out soon. What was less than expected however was news of Corsair involvement. A few weeks ago the Corsair plot was uncovered by Outcast operatives: the Corsairs and their Hogosha allies are attempting to use their influence on Samura to steer the Kusari government into open war with Bretonia! While the reasons for such a move are unknown as of yet, many speculations have emerged, including a possible renewed Corsair offensive on Cambridge while the Bretonian Armed Forces are busy elsewhere, and perhaps even a renewed strike on Outcast holdings in the Omicron systems in an attempt to tip the scales in the long war.

Word has also came in of many factions now supporting the Corsairs in their move, including the Gaians in Bretonia and the Farmers Alliance movement in Kusari. This has immediately prompted a call for a summit on the issue, and today marks a breakthrough in the proceeding talks as a majority of Liberty Rogue, Lane Hacker and Molly leaders officially came together on Buffalo base to sign an alliance with the Outcast nation. The Junkers have also expressed their support, and in Kusari the Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums have invited Outcast representatives to discuss long term plans. Outcast leaders have stated that they hope this to successfully tip the scales in their favour and nip the Corsair threat in the bud.

1117084.text: [812 AS] Tensions Rising between Bretonia and Kusari

1117085.text:
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]

MANHATTAN -- Crucial diplomatic talks between Bretonia and Kusari broke down today over the issue of implied Kusari funding of the notorious Gaian eco-terrorist movement, which operates in Bretonia and is responsible for over a hundred confirmed hits on Orbital Spa and Cruise staff, including Libertonian citizens. Although neither side has as of yet officially declared war on the other, fighting is said to have already broken out in the disputed Tau-31 system. It is at this time unknown which side initiated the hostilities, but word from both houses implies a heavy military build up on the move into the Tau systems followed by a lock down of traffic between the two houses. The Libertonian government remained committed to peace, calling for a restart of talks - a motion promptly denied by Kusari officials citing Bretonia's "obvious colonialist intentions". Upon being accused by a unaligned news agency of initiating the military build up in Tau-29, Kusari officials refused to comment.

In other news, reports of an increase in pirate attacks on the fringes of house space have Libertonian analysts working over time. A connection seems to be implied between the rapidly increasing Kusari aggressiveness, an influx of artifact trade coming in unchecked from Shikoku and these pirates. Libertonian government officials reported they will be looking into the matter.

1117088.mapped:
Tholey Station was established as a joint operation between Daumann, the Bounty Hunters Guild (BHG) and the Rheinland authorities. The BHG had been commissioned by Rheinland to help bring order to the rampant, lawless frontier of Cologne whilst Federal forces were occupied in Dresden and elsewhere. Faced by Unioners to the north and Hessians to the south, Tholey's bounty hunters became some of the highest paid in Federal Rheinland space.

As the old Republic stagnated into infighting, Federal investment into Cologne slackened. As a means of cutting costs, the Guild was given administration over the station. Corporations moved in to fill the space – Daumann and Planetform rapidly privatising the station. The construction of a Synth Foods biodome to feed the terraforming effort encouraged Daumann to use production facilities to compete with ALG – the station was now valuable corporate real estate on the frontier. With the discovery of the Zurich by the Rheinland's more legitimate entities, the station was expected to form a waystation for a new trade route to Gallia.

The fall of the Federal government in 827 AS put an end to any further expansion efforts. An onrush of Hessians into the system met surprisingly light resistance at Tholey once the resident Bounty Hunters realised that the corporations had little interest in paying for a siege defense, and the corporate residents of the station fled. With no local authority left to pay their contracts, the Guild did not defend the base with much heart. Tholey is now the Red Hessian staging ground for small craft within the system, as the movement picks through the wares that the corporations have left behind them. The terraforming effort has stalled, and without the expertise to revive the program, seems unlikely to continue under Hessian administration.

1117103.text: FREEPORT 9 -- 804 AS -- Negotiations between the Corsairs and the Zoners to build a Corsair installation in Omicron Theta have failed. Zoner representatives would not agree to allow a Corsair battleship fleet into their system, despite the fleet being necessary to protect the building site. The Zoners claimed that the presence of a Corsair fleet would threaten the peace in the whole sector. Further conflicts between the Zoners and the Corsairs such as this are expected, as the Corsair expansion is more and more dependent on continuing Zoner shipments. However, both the Corsairs and the Zoners have profited greatly from the recent decades of cooperation and expansion in the Omicron worlds, and are therefore unlikely to start a costly war with an unknown outcome and doubtful consequences.

1117104.text: [813 AS] Liberty Trying to Prevent War

1117105.text: MANHATTAN -- 813 AS -- President Jacobi has today proposed a meeting of representatives from all the colonies in an attempt to resolve the rapidly escalating tensions in Tau-31. Should the call be answered, the meeting would take place on Planet Los Angeles in the California system, far away from the encroaching war. Queen Carina's office has already confirmed Bretonia's attendance, but it is still yet unclear whether Kusari will agree to participate, after the Kusari government accused their Bretonian counterparts of assisting various pirate and terrorist groups in Kusari proper a few days ago. Rheinland officials have also declared their doubt, but promised attendance of one of their representatives.\n\nDespite Jacobi's call for peace, it is unlikely the fighting in Tau space will cease, as both Bretonia and Kusari continue to mobilise for the conflict. Reports confirm a Bretonian pre-emptive strike is under way into Tau-29, while Kusari is expected to slowly pull forces from their main systems in order to reinforce their defense. The reason, Naval Forces spokesmen have said, is a string of heavy handed pirate attacks on Kusari holdings in Honshu which required strong intervention: "Intervening forces are expected to shortly make their way to the Tau-29 front where they will push the battle in their favour". When asked about the feasibility and impact of such a move on the Kusari core, Liberty Navy officials declined to comment.

1117106.text: [813 AS] Rheinland Responding to Tau Events

1117107.text: NEW BERLIN -- 813 AS -- The Rheinland Foreign Office has issued a press release regarding recent Tau events today stating Rheinland's official stance on the matter: "Bretonia and Kusari seem to be locked into pursuing this senseless conflict, and although their leaders seem headstrong to participate in the coming bloodshed, the rest of Sirius should not". After making it clear the blame for the hostilities lies on the Bretonian house for pushing the situation to the breaking point, the Office continued by expressing their support for the IMG plight: "Rheinland remembers the horrors of war better than anybody else, and it is always the civilians that end up on the firing line. The colonies should do everything in their power to ensure IMG miners are safe in the struggle". The speaker has also stated a Rheinland representative will attend the Los Angeles summit called by President Jacobi for promoting peace between the colonies. Among rumours of Bretonian intent to threaten IMG holdings in the Bretonian core worlds in order to assure their cooperation, Rheinland is expected to further condemn continued Bretonian operations against Kusari in the Tau systems.

1117109.text: MALTA -- 814 AS -- The Bretonia-Kusari conflict continues to escalate in Tau-29 and Tau-31, and the Corsairs are expected to also make a move soon. The Outcasts are preparing their defenses as Corsairs continue to try and ensure a lack of Zoner involvement in any military operations that would take place in Omicron Theta. Despite the obvious Corsair threat, the Zoners of Freeport 9 continue stalling between proposals for cooperation from both the Outcasts and the Corsairs.\n\nDespite this surprising lack of direct military activity, the Outcasts have succeeded in rallying many core world factions to their cause.  These include Mollys from Bretonia; Liberty Rogues and Lane Hackers from Liberty; Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums from Kusari; and lately and most importantly the Red Hessians and Bundschuh from Rheinland. In contrast the Gaians of Bretonia, Hogosha and Farmers Alliance from Kusari, and Unioners from Rheinland, as well as in an extremely surprising move, The Order chose to side with the Corsairs. Both sides continue to try to rally support from the other factions of Sirius, however no other group has openly declared support for the Outcasts or the Corsairs so far.

1117110.text: [813 AS] Bretonia on the Brink of War

1117111.text: NEW LONDON -- 813 AS -- The Bretonian government today delivered a bleak and extremely controversial speech after reports of open conflict between Bretonian and Kusari forces appeared in the news earlier this week. "All attempts to secure a peaceful solution have failed. The Kusari media is already blaming us for the first shots. We have no choice but to respond, or let Planet Harris fall into Kusari hands". The Home Office has followed by quickly declaring war time measures in place, and further Bretonian forces are expected to embark for the Tau-29 front within a matter of days. First news from the front suggest Bretonia is making progress against the Kusari defenses with Kusari casualties several times higher than Bretonian ones to date. Further Armed Forces reinforcements are expected to shift the balance squarely in Bretonia's favour.\n\nIn the mean time in Bretonia itself the IMG is unpatriotically accusing the Queen's government of coercion by threat of blockade. The IMG representative claims this was done "in order to assure the IMG cooperates with Bretonia's plan of claiming the majority of independent Tau space". The Bretonian government swiftly denied these accusations, and responded by saying that these rumours are the product of Kusari media "seeking to justify their parent government's attack on Bretonian holdings". The matter is expected to be resolved in the Bretonian Royal Court.

1117112.text: [814 AS] Kusari Close to Victory in Tau-31

1117113.text: NEW TOKYO -- 814 AS -- Bretonian attempts to delay Kusari fleet movements by employing pirates known as the Golden Chrysanthemums within the Kusari core worlds has failed, as a Naval Forces mobilisation has reduced pirate presence in Kyushu to an all time low. The Chrysanthemums are a fanatical female movement which attempts to overthrow the Kusari government in order to replace it with a liberal, cardamine fueled matriarchy. The Bretonian government was further implicated after State Police forces seized a transport smuggling explosives to Hokkaido, on board which was a message intended to Chrysanthemum terrorists, signed by a high ranking Bretonian official. These efforts, as underhanded and sneaky as they might be, have hardly impeded progress however with no less than six Kusari battleship class vessels expected to reinforce the front line in Tau-29 within the next three days.\n\nWith Bretonian attacks rapidly diminishing, the final liberation of Tau-31 appears to draw close. Although the Naval Forces has stood its ground and maintained low losses, a spirit of vengeance befalls our people. Bretonia must be purged from the Tau border worlds, there is no other way.

1117115.text: CRETE -- 814 AS -- The Bretonians always take their time to make a point about Corsair "pirates maiming their peaceful men, women and children". In the mean time they not only launch the first strike against another colony, but they also shoot at IMG civilians to pacify them, ally with and and take supplies from Outcast drug dealers for their cut of the spoils, and shove the blame squarely in other people's laps so that their war can extend as far outward as possible. How can the colonies listen to their lies, in the wake of all that has happened lately? The Bretonian government grows rich on gold and high on cardamine, and it is only a matter of time before their madness is noticed and disposed of.\n\nThere is only one thing we can do now: support the Kusari navy in their advance. Allow them to smash the Bretonian war machine, and secure the Tau systems from the vile Outcast cardamine trade. Any true Corsair will see that this is the right thing to do. Do this, and soon we will rise toasts to the smoldering ruins of Cali Base deep in the Tau systems -- and soon after, the burning cardamine fields of Malta.

1117148.text: CALI -- 814 AS -- Fighting in Tau continues, and unfortunately our Kusari enemies are gaining the upper hand. Bretonia Armed Forces have lost a battle near the Jump Gate from Tau-31 to Tau-29 that lasted five days; both sides suffered heavy casualties. Now Kusari battleships freely roam in Tau-31 ice fields as far as Holman and attack both military and civilian ships of Bretonia and Bretonian corporations. Therefore, our installations in Tau-23 and Newcastle are under threat from both Kusari Navy and our pirate enemies.\n\nDestroyer Ceuta base in Newcastle is relatively safe since our Molly allies will help in defending it. Corsairs won't strike against Bretonia until Bretonia and Kusari forces won't weaken each other in endless skirmishes. However, Cali is under direct threat, and we will be relocating our forces from Malta to Cali during the next few weeks. Uneasy times await Outcasts, and we are hoping for the help of our allies as the only chance to survive the uneasy times that will follow.

1117149.text: [814 AS] Kusari Victorious in Tau Space

1117150.text: NEW TOKYO -- 814 AS -- Just as we expected, Kusari Navy won a decisive victory over Bretonia Armed Forces in a bloody battle near the Jump Gate between Tau-31 and Tau-29. Bretonia lost dozens of fighters, as well as five destroyers and two gunboats. Over 1500 Bretonia troops died in the fight, leaving even more wounded. We also lost over 1000 men and women; each of them died a honorable death, contributing into our great victory. Greater battles will follow, and we are never intended to lose.\n\nKusari Navy already secured Holman Outpost, installation of our Independent Miner Guild allies. Soon enough we will destroy Planetform terraforming infrastructure on planet Harris. After this, Tau-31 will be absolutely free from Bretonian scourge. Our next primary target is Outcast base in Tau-23 known as Cali; this base is a key point in primary Cardamine routes leading into Liberty, Bretonia and our homeland. Needless to say that losing this base will be a fatal blow for Cardamine business of the Outcasts.

1117151.text: [814 AS] Bretonia Fleets Recalled to Border

1117152.text: NEW LONDON -- 814 AS -- Bretonia Armed Forces command admits that Bretonia is unable to defend Tau-31 from increasing Kusari aggression. Being outnumbered and outgunned, Bretonia frontier fleets had to withdraw from the Holman Outpost and Tau-29 Jump Gate. Now we are concentrating our forces to defend Leeds and Newcastle systems, if Kusari ever dares to attack native Bretonia territories. Citizens of Leeds and New London should not be afraid, for we will never allow a single ship of our enemy to come close to any of the populated planets of our homeland.\n\nPlanetform expects heavy losses, cause Harris terraforming effort would have to be stopped. Assault on Harris appears to be one of the main goals of Kusari conquering Tau-31. Right now Kusari Navy is gathering forces near Holman, getting help from the treacherous IMG and eco-terrorists known as Gaians. However, Planetform and Bretonia Navy won't leave Harris without making our enemy pay a high price. A trap is being prepared, trap that Kusari Naval Forces will never forget.

1117153.text: [814 AS] Kusari Attacking Civilian Targets in Tau

1117154.text: NEWARK -- 814 AS -- With the Bretonian Armed Forces reported as "leaving Tau-31 in haste", reports continue cropping up on gross misconduct on the part of the Kusari Navy, which allegedly has already led to deaths of several Liberty nationals. DSE and Planetform both reported loss of shipping through hostile actions in the past week, citing Kusari forces targetting their vessels with minimal warning. While the reports are still hazy and could indicate increase pirate activity within the currently chaotic system, concern continues to mount among Interspace Commerce who is in charge of insuring the vessels of the aforementioned corporations.\n\nThe crews of the three ships reported as lost so far have not yet been recovered. The Liberty Department of State is expected to renew calls for a cease-fire between Bretonia and Kusari as a result of this.

This, however, did not turn the tides of Tau-31 struggle, for Kusari quickly brought massive reinforcements from Tau-29.

1117164.text: [814 AS] Tau-31 Lost, Harris under Siege

1117165.text: NEW LONDON -- 814 AS -- A Kusari push has disabled a significant portion of Bretonian defenses in Tau-31 yesterday, after a surprise attack from a previously unknown jump hole allowed the enemy to perform a two pronged strike. Armed Forces admirals were forced to call a general retreat into the Leeds system, with only a handful of troops and one battleship remaining stranded behind enemy lines, locked in a desperate defense of Planet Harris made possible only through extensive use of mines and other fortifications hidden within the ice asteroid field. Kusari forces were reported to seize on their momentum in a careful fashion, allowing only scouting units to jump through to Leeds as the Armed Forces organised their second line around Glasgow.\n\nInstead, an effort to completely blockade Planet Harris was organised after a failed attack on the lone Bretonian Battleship left in the system left Naval Forces with several cruisers either destroyed or disabled, and many fighter wings lost to the ever present mines and dogged Armed Forces defenders. Although the situation appears grim, a spokesman from the Armed Forces has insisted that a counter strike plan is already being prepared and that the current state of affairs in Tau-31 is only temporary.

1117167.text: MALTA -- 814 AS -- The situation in Tau space becomes worse by the day as the Bretonians crumble under the force of the Kusari Naval Forces. In but a month Kusari has managed to occupy the Tau-31 system and create a massive obstacle on the path of our Cardamine transports to Liberty. Cali Base is being rallied in case of a surprise attack. At the very least the ever annoying IMG miners that infest the Tau systems continue to refuse to pick a side in the conflict, though it is quite obvious that by doing nothing they benefit Kusari more than Bretonia. The biggest threat the Outcasts face however is one of a two pronged strike. If the Corsairs and their new Kusari lap dogs decide to attempt an attack on Malta, the Outcast fleet will be hard pressed to fight on two fronts.\n\nTo prevent this, resources will be poured to the Red Hessians in the Omega systems, so that the Corsair forces are occupied and off balance. A generous twist of fate has also made the Unioners reconsider their previous allegiances and join their Hessian allies against the Corsairs once again. Other allies need to continue to fight against the Corsair allies in any way they can, such as the Mollys who provided the Armed Forces with enough stationary mines to cover the entire approach to Harris in Tau-31 and delay the Kusari navy seemingly indefinitely. The Maltan way must prevail.

1117168.text: [814 AS] Disgrace of Bretonia in Tau-31

1117169.text: CRETE -- 814 AS -- Kusari Naval Forces waste no time in liberating Tau-31 from the blight of Bretonia. Meanwhile, Outcasts carry on trying to rally their servants to help the failing Bretonians hold on to their last scrap in the system: Planet Harris. And yet even then the Armed Forces continues to lose every protracted engagement. Not even the Mollys with their endless supply of mines and other cowardly tactics will be able to hold off the Naval Forces advance for long. Soon enough the Kusari will enjoy a drink on Leeds, and the Corsairs will have one on Cambridge. Without their Cardamine highway, the Outcasts will fall into ruin and it is then that the Corsair Empire will be able to strike at Malta itself.

1117170.text: [814 AS] Bretonian Cowards Trap Kusari Fleet

1117171.text: NEW TOKYO -- 814 AS -- In a shameful move that disgraced Bretonia and Queen Carina, Bretonia Armed Forces have set a trap for the assaulting Kusari fleet. With the help of Molly terrorists, mine fields were set up around Planet Harris, a terraforming site of Planetform. Outcasts helped to conceal the mines from our scouts. 7 cruisers and 6 gunboats and numerous fighters were trapped in those mine fields and destroyed, either by mines or by Bretonia patrols. More than 800 women and men of Kusari died this day, but their death will quickly be avenged.\n\nThe battle near Harris in 813 AS will be known as our only defeat in the war with Bretonia. Bretonia Armed Forces cannot win in an open fight, as was proved in the recent battle for the Leeds Jump Gate. Losing most of their fleet, including one battleship, Bretonia forces fled to Leeds and to Harris. The Kusari Naval Forces surrounded Harris and mapped the mine fields to avoid further casualties. We will proceed with care, expecting more dishonest moves from the cowards of Bretonia.

1117172.text: [814 AS] Bretonia is Losing the War

1117173.text: MANHATTAN -- 814 AS -- After several months of unabated fighting, Bretonia is buckling under the unrelenting assault of the Kusari Naval Forces in the Tau-31 system. Despite the exceptional bravery of Armed Forces pilots in fighting back the Kusari aggressors, they are forced into continuous fighting retreat as almost the entire might of the Kusari navy is pouring forth from Kyushu and New Tokyo into the Tau systems. Bretonia, having issues securing Cambridge from unrelenting pirate attacks as it stands, is unable to gather enough forces to effectively stand ground, and are forced to retreat to their many fortifications -- such as the ones set up around Planet Harris, which immediately sparked condemnation from the Kusari government after an assault on the Planet was successfully repulsed before ever reaching the surface due to the valiant Armed Forces defenders present there.\n\nThe front line, however, is not the only place for casualties of war. Many Bretonian citizens, tourists and businessmen present in Kusari at the time of the official declaration of war were arrested and placed in camps for foreign nationals. They remain under hold by the Kusari government whose officials are still declining any offers of prisoner and civilian exchanges. Officials in Liberty have widely condemned these actions, and pressure continues on Interspace Commerce to begin financial sanctions on the house of Kusari until prisoners of war and Bretonian civilians are allowed to be expatriated back to their home colony. Officials have also stated that, "despite the advanced stage of the war, it is never too late to seek a peaceful resolution". The Bretonian-Kusari war however looks set to continue for many years more, with Kusari forces expecting to push into Leeds in a matter of months.

1117174.text: [814 AS] Bretonia In Violation Of War Charter

1117175.text: NEW BERLIN -- 814 AS -- The Rheinland Reichstag today almost uniformly decried the Bretonian use of concealed mines in the defense of Planet Harris, after Kusari officials suggested mine use will leave the area heavily dangerous for years to come, regardless of when the conflict will end. The public outcry was followed by an implication that Bretonia may in fact be in violation of the War Charter established in the colonies after the events of the 80 Years War, which specifically forbids the use of passive weapons which may render an area extremely dangerous to civilians after the conflict has passed. The discussion concluded with a motion for a new demand for Bretonia to withdraw all forces from Tau-31 and cede claims of the system to Kusari, so that proper demilitarisation can occur. The Rheinland Foreign Office has refused to comment on the Reichstag's proclamations, implying that the views held by the representatives are their own, and may not be in line with those held by the Chancellor of Rheinland.

1117200.text:
Yaren Base orbits at Nauru's high orbit and serves as an important garrison and transit installation for the Core and its goals within Omicron Delta.

Despite the fact that the base is currently owned and operated by the Core, it was originally built by the Corsairs in 812 AS as a remote outpost tasked with overseeing mining and research operations located at Nauru. After the Corsair-Order alliance broke up around 818 AS, their priorities changed and Yaren became less significant as their the most remote outpost in Omicrons. Shortly thereafter, the base was captured by the Core and has remained in their ownership ever since.

Yaren Base has always served as a military base and stronghold for the Core in Omicron Delta, and its ability to process Iridium shipments was always limited. To solve that issue, the Core has made a deal with Daumann Heavy Construction and allowed them to build Ennibeck in close proximity to alleviate their logistic issues and free up Yaren as a purely military installation.

However, as Ennibeck Startport began to financially struggle and its operation became unsustainable for Daumann in the long run, the Core reopened Yaren to their friendly logistic vessels once again to keep their economic chains intact should Daumann shut their operations down at Ennibeck in the near future.

The Sunderland Research Aerostat was constructed at Scarborough Shipyard in 736 AS, and towed to the gas giant Darlington later the following year. The Aerostat is the Bretonia Intelligence Service’s most ambitious and expensive project, acting as the headquarters for the research and exploration of the Dom’Kavash structure known as Site Jarrow. Sunderland relies on a combination of locally harvested buoyancy gasses, onboard thrusters, and secured anchor struts to maintain its altitude in spite of the planet’s tumultuous atmosphere and intense gravity well.

The decision to deploy Sunderland followed a breakthrough in the study of the Amiatinus Cache, a recovered Artifact that had progressed the then-rudimentary understanding of Dom’Kavash glyphs. This hinted at an acoustic, almost musical, component to their language. Experiments in this area revealed the presence of a concealed airlock on Site Jarrow, allowing for the creation of the Sunderland Umbilical to gain access to further sections of the interior. While scientists now have access to several isolated compartments within Jarrow, understanding of its purpose and technologies remains stubbornly limited.

Despite this, even small insights have occasionally advanced Bretonian science by decades. Notable examples include the 798 AS discovery of an Artifact fragment depicting part of a novel chemical process for the production of Super Alloys. By 806 AS, Sunderland provided an experimental procedure to Scarborough Shipyard for implementation; this revolutionized the previously inefficient and expensive method used aboard Stokes Smelter, allowing the faltering industry to catch and then surpass Liberty's progress in the field.

Bretonia’s recent wars and dire situation have placed Sunderland under incredible pressure to produce useful military technologies. This created a culture of high-stakes risk-taking, causing the injury or death of numerous explorers and scientists. In 831 AS, Sunderland also received significant damage during “The Blink”, in which Jarrow’s anti-gravity pylons momentarily failed, causing it to drop over a kilometer. As of 834 AS, there are signs that Jarrow may be preparing to fully awaken. Most other avenues of research have been halted, in favor of investigating the implications of an activation scenario -- and developing contingencies for Jarrow’s destruction should this pose a threat to Bretonia.

1117233.text:
South Shields Refinery is a large mining and processing complex orbiting the gas giant Hartlepool. The Independent Miners Guild first arrived in Newcastle in 668 AS, to significant controversy. Border World Exports had announced promising astronomical studies of the star the year before, and later dispatched a slow-burn deep space expedition to carry out a survey of potential exoplanets. The young Guild instead wagered a significant portion of its early resources on charting Leeds in detail, looking for a Jump Hole they believed could provide a substantial shortcut.

This extreme gamble paid off, allowing the first Guild explorers to arrive six months before Bowex entered the system’s borders. By 670 AS, the IMG began construction of South Shields -- their second station. This provided the Guild with a local headquarters and mineral claims at a time when other Bretonian corporations were only just beginning to carry out detailed evaluations. South Shields’ completion prior to the deployment of a Jump Gate to Leeds also allowed the IMG to exploit a Bretonian legal loophole, circumventing various regulatory issues and colonial taxes.

For over a century, South Shields made relatively easy money by harvesting Water and Oxygen from the nearby Tyne Ice Field, and filtering trace Hydrocarbon impurities. Potable supplies were then sold to local stations and the then-enormous population of Planet Leeds. With Rheinland's economic collapse after the Colony Wars, the Guild received a wave of recruits from Kruger Minerals, including several specialists from Mannheim. This provided the Guild with the expertise to begin skimming Hartlepool's atmosphere for the Hydrogen and Deuterium needed to produce H-Fuel. While this resynthesis process has never been consistently profitable, it has allowed the Guild to maintain a strategic fuel reserve for its own Tau operations.

1117234.text: A hot, arid planet with no atmosphere, Middlesbrough nevertheless has significant quantities of raw materials, from titanium and copper to beryllium and silicon. The planet has a considerable amount of volcanic activity, so there have never been any attempts at planet-side settlements. However, its mineral wealth has resulted in Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing launching regular mining operations.

Gateshead Station was constructed in 692 AS to facilitate the study of Planet Carlisle, and provide a system headquarters for the Bretonia Police Authority. The Police Authority is responsible for conducting patrols across the system's Trade Lanes, and protecting the space between Planet Carlisle and Redcarr Protection Facility.

During the Gallic War, Gateshead was placed under the command of the Battleship MacDuff, and served as a fortified staging point and logistics hub for military operations in the north of the system. During this period, the station's storage capacity, armor and weapons were significantly enhanced.

In 826 AS, Cryer and Planetform successfully field trialed an anti-bacterial aerosol on Carlisle. Soon after, they established a zero-gravity factory aboard to locally synthesize more of the treatment. Due to this and Gateshead's role as a shipping platform, the station is now vital to the success of the colonization project, and a frequent target of Gaian attacks.

The Battleship Strausberg was completed in 815 AS and deployed to bolster security in New Berlin. During its initial years of service, the Strausberg acquired a reputation for ruthlessness, with a disproportionately high kill to capture ratio against Bundschuh and Red Hessian targets. During the Fall of Dresden in 820 AS, the Strausberg was ordered to prevent “contagion” disorder in Berlin by conducting aggressive anti-Hessian operations in the Saarfield. It departed New Berlin in 825 AS with the outbreak of the Saigon War, where it assisted with the invasion of Sigma-21 and occupation of Planet Saigon. Similar to the Battleship Kolleda, Strausberg initially refused to honor the Sigma Treaty ending the war, only withdrawing to Rheinland when threatened with desertion charges.

In the days before the Civil War, the Strausberg returned to Oder Shipyard for ‘unscheduled’ maintenance. From there it unsuccessfully attempted to arrest the Federal government, who were instead evacuated by the loyalist Carrier Saar. The Strausberg fired several times on Planet New Berlin during the war, and frequently fought the Saar’s strike wings as they sortied from Frankfurt. Following the Holstein Accords in 828 AS, the Strausberg participated successfully in the Recapture of Cologne, alongside the Battleship Altenburg. Believing the Hessians to be significantly weaker than previously thought, the Strausberg later led Rheinland’s Dresden Campaign in 832 AS.

The expedition was ambushed by the Hessian Battleship Kassel in the Innenstadtfeld. Despite suffering heavy damage to its reactor plating, the Strausberg’s heavier armament and fleet allowed it to overpower its opponent. The fleet was forced to abandon the attack on Leipzig, initiating a slow retreat towards New Berlin. Near the Bautzen Wreck, the Strausberg again came under heavy assault by Hessian bomber squadrons. These wings successfully landed several torpedoes on the damaged reactor, leading to a critical meltdown. Orders were given to strip and scuttle the ship to prevent it falling into enemy hands. Some in the Military have bitterly complained that the Hessian defense was significantly aided by the operation’s start date being announced by the Emperor at a social event, while gloating about the Hessians’ impending destruction.

1117269.text:
CLASS: Bismarck
CREW: CLASSIFIED
ARMAMENT: CLASSIFIED
1117269.mapped:
Commissioned in 805 AS, the Karlsruhe was assigned to protect Rheinland interests in the Stuttgart system, stationed near the Planet Stuttgart Docking Ring, an area frequently raided by LWB fighters. This has led to some rumors that Synth Foods did more than merely appeal to the Rheinland government for better protection of its assets. The Karlsruhe did its job well in orbit, but did little to stop the extremists on the surface.

Following the Imperial coup in 827 A.S., the Karlsruhe was faced with a choice to either join the Imperialists or remain loyal. The latter option was taken, in contrast to the vast majority of the Rheinland Military. This would lead many to think that a career long service in defense of Synth Foods interests in Stuttgart, had resulted in the officer corps being in the pay of the corporation. A more common theory is that many of the men and women of the fleet were Stuttgart natives, whose families had not suffered economic turmoil under the Federal government as other planets had. The victims of the Synth Foods monopoly were not a common recruit of the Military that served to protect it, so anti-corporate, anti-federal sentiment was at a minimum.

There was a brief period of uneasy calm before the scale of their predicament, and the gravity of their choice became clear. The Imperials were quick to respond, and the Altenburg pursued from Omega-7. The Karlsruhe opted to flee to Cologne, however the Altenburg arrived just as the Karlsruhe left orbit, and a brief yet bloody engagement ensued. Losses were many, but the Karlsruhe succesfully disingaged. and entered Cologne.

This would not be the final destination however, as the system was beset by reports of Hessian fleets building in the Weisskugelfeld. Fearing the worst, the Karlsruhe took the only path available to it, and entered Zurich directly through the new jump gate, and into the unknown.

The Augsburg Orbital Colony originally began construction in 781 AS, but did not finish until 805 AS, due to a shortage of funding. It was an effort by the Rheinland government to experiment with orbital cities in order to increase available luxury living space without the need for planetary environments. Built around a modular design for easy upgrades, with large food producing biodomes and efficient solar and nuclear powered storage batteries, it was one of the largest space stations ever constructed, with an intended population of over four thousand people.

The Augsburg colony took the worst blow when the Munich Disaster struck. Much of the base ended up mired in the irradiated murk that now surrounds the system, which has rendered the base all but uninhabitable. ALG had been attempting a salvage operation, rebuilding the station using components salvaged from the wreck, but many parts of it are irreparably damaged. The Junkers were also drawn to the wreck, looting whatever valuables they could find from the hasty evacuation. The abandoned wealth of old Augsburg eventually ran dry, though, and the Junkers largely left the station in favor of Ingolstadt.

Despite their progress, ALG were also in the process of withdrawing from the project, believing the station and its environment too dangerous for their workers. Federalist forces seized on this opportunity to occupy the wreck without alienating any supporters they may have within ALG. Since occupying the newly-christened Fort Augsburg, the Federalists have been working to fortify the station as a secure base from which to launch operations in eastern Rheinland.

1117271.mapped:
Although the Augsburg colony took extreme damage during the Munich Disaster, it was not considered to be a total writeoff. In what may be the largest salvage contract since the Yanagi project, ALG was tasked by Republican to dismantle still functional parts of the Augsburg colony, and reassemble them into a new station outside of the irradiated zone. Analysts are sceptical that the current state of Munich will be a large attraction to wealthy inhabitants, and expect that Republican will turn the station into a production facility of sorts.

The first major components to be salvaged were a solar panel, biodome, two habitat towers, the docking wing and a light manufacturing plant - none of which are fully repaired yet. Still, the station is selfpowered and, due to it's light current crew, self-sufficient.

Despite the civil war, work on New Augsburg continues unabated. Supply ships to and from New Augsburg make up a significant portion of Munich's traffic. Rumors have begun to spread that some of those ships are covertly supplying Federalist activity, though ALG denies these allegations.

Formally one of the Federal Police's toughest postings, Passau guarded the trade connections in Munich from Unioner, Bundschuh and Corsair raiders. After the Nuremburg disaster brought a hardier breed of criminal to Munich, the station's role evolved into intercepting human traffickers and slavers.

The station serves the same role its service with the Federal remenants. Seized by forces loyal to the deposed goverment, Passau serves as an armoured hangar for squadrons guarding the borders of the system.

1117273.text:
Freeport 11 is one of the most remote outposts of Sirius' human population, in close orbit of the young Delta star. It became operational in 810 AS when rich Iridium reserves were discovered in the system's asteroid fields, and until the Freeport administration's intervention, inhabitants of the station mercilessly competed with one another over access to the extremely valuable metal.

Today, the station's utmost dedication for safety verges on being authoritarian and xenophobic, due to the constant threat posed by the Nomad presence throughout the Omicrons. There are constant checks and redundant countermeasures in place against the infected. While extended stays are not common, random disappearances are suspiciously frequent.

Freeport 11's long-suffering population now faces increased difficulty as an accord signed by the station and the Core to prevent any further conflict has soured relations among the Order and the Corsairs, escalating tensions within the already highly volatile Omicron Delta.

First charted in 539 AS, after the discovery of the Munich system in the same year by a Kruger survey vessel, the planet Nuremberg was largely ignored for nearly twenty years, despite a pleasantly temperate climate, with large tracts of plains and savannah that were suitable for farming and settlement. Kruger was instead more interested in the Schwarzwald and Alps clouds, which contained significant amounts of cobalt and silicon, and constructed several small automated mining platforms within the nebulas.

In 557 AS a jump gate was constructed, connecting the Munich system with Frankfurt, and civilian traffic was able to move freely into the system for the first time. Upon further inspection of Nuremberg, it was agreed to begin colonisation immediately, and hundreds of thousands of people from across Rheinland flocked to the new planet in the hopes of securing some of the available land for themselves. Deep Space Engineering soon moved in to begin construction on a series of trade lanes, and the Battleship Erlangen was stationed in orbit of Nuremberg to maintain order.

Nuremberg's oceans were soon revealed to be largely unsuitable for fishing, as most of the dangerous oceanic predators, such as the Pirasharq, quickly destroyed any imported fish stocks. On the land it was a similar story, and it was discovered that the initial planetary scans had missed the dangerous Gimeni worms that inhabited the soil across much of the planet. Virtually all of the imported crops also failed to germinate, despite seemingly ideal conditions. After several years, science teams from Planetform were able to determine that a chemical in the soil was responsible. It was soon found that the skin of the Gimeni worm secretes a chemical that kills any plant life not native to Nuremberg.

In despair, many of the planet's population started abandoning Nuremberg and returning to other parts of Rheinland, leaving the planet largely deserted, until in 738 AS when Daumann and Republican Shipping jointly purchased the planet from the bankrupt Rheinland government in order to build manufactories for the construction of military vehicles. As such, many of Nuremberg's current population and available land was devoted to the manufacture of the heavily armored vehicles, and the heavy industry had slowly been polluting the planet.

Despite population numbers still climbing as of 816 AS and the increasing demand for imported food to Nuremberg to support them, the Rheinland government has refused to grant construction approval for any farming concerns, despite continual lobbying by the legitimate political arms of the LWB and Bundschuh, especially after it was discovered that the native grasses could be safely ingested by a number of animals - including pigs and cows - thus making it safe for livestock farming. This had angered the LWB and the Bundschuh, and to some extent even the Unioners, and raids on the planet's surroundings became fairly commonplace over the last few decades.

In advent of a massive dark matter storm that descended upon the system seemingly from nowhere, Nuremberg's population began to undergo a second and likely final exodus. Planetside meteorologists discovered that the dark matter was quickly eroding the entire planet's atmosphere, as what few crops upon the planet remained universally failed. Cancerous diseases increased exponentially upon the surface population and entire cities were thrown into chaos.

Opposition movements both legitimate and otherwise within Rheinland criticized the government, Daumann, and Republican for their tepidly slow response in providing refuge or aid to the masses of desperate Rheinlanders still fleeing the system by the millions. While still nominally capable of its former wartime output, thousands of craft from civilian-fighters to trains routinely breach the atmosphere every day, despite the best efforts of law enforcement to maintain some semblance of order.

The dying planet has in the span of a single year grown to become the most dangerous and lawless place in Rheinland, dropping to the bottom in nearly every civil demographic.

Discovered more than 50 years ago by Zoners, planet Gran Canaria became their new hope for peaceful life on a hospitable and oxygen-rich world far away from house territory. However, as soon as a jump hole to Dublin was discovered in Omega-49, Zoners realised that if Bretonian government gets to know about Canaria, they might attempt to conquer the system. Mollys from Dublin also posed threat for Zoners' new home.

Shortly after Nomad War, Zoners made a strategical decision to sell secret Omega-49 routes to Corsairs in exchange for money and protection. Zoners secured their bases in Corsair zone of influence, including Freeport-9. Corsairs, in return, gained alternative route to strike both Bretonia and Mollys from where they least expected. Nowadays, more and more Corsairs settle on Gran Canaria; Zoners also come to this planet from all over Sirius, leaving behind their home freeports.

1117286.text: Augsburg Orbital Colony was built by Rheinland Government and Interspace Commerce as a perfect place of living for Rheinland elite away from unhospitable republican planets. Augsburg is known as the largest space station built by humans in Sirius Sector, its life supports systems can handle over 7 thousand colonists. Large food-producing biodomes and efficient solar batteries will surely become an example for building many other civilian stations in Rheinland - and beyond.

1117287.text: Ingolstadt Station is an important outpost of Republican Shipping built several years ago as company's base of operations in Munich system. The station orbits Planet Nuremberg.

1117288.text: Riverside Station was constructed by Liberty Police only a year ago to secure commercial traffic near Mojave. In the past, Mojave was a favourite place for Liberty Rogues to attack hapless traders.

Despite possessing a thin atmosphere, this planetoid is rendered uninhabitable by the choking, acrid dust that covers its surface -- in some places to a depth of several kilometers. All survey probes have either been swallowed by the dust oceans or ceased functioning shortly after planetfall, presumably due to the nearly microscopic dust particles working their way into the delicate electronics.

1117290.text: Lancaster Trade Center is a support facility for Gateshead, mainly operating with smaller shipments for independent traders from all over Bretonia. Lancaster is maintained by Border World Exports.

1117291.text: Scarborough Shipyard is the home base for Border World Exports in the Newcastle System. In the recent years, Bretonia Police pilots also frequent this place because of the persistent Molly attacks from the nearby Belfast facility. Scarborough also houses a well-established ship building facility that mostly produces civilian transports and other commercial vessels. However, with Newcasle system almost completely surrounded by the Kusari forces, the station currently gets very few ship construction contracts.

1117316.text: Planet Nuremberg may seem one of the most hospitable worlds in all Rheinland space when seen from space: large oceans, green continents and thick cloudy atmosphere. However, its atmosphere contains gases that are dangerous for human nervous system. Origin of those gases remain unknown; many scientists assume that they are produced by vast equatorial rainforests. Breathing unstrained air in warmer areas of Nuremberg causes hallucinations and may even be lethal. Therefore, people prefer to settle in colder regions close to north and south poles.

>>>CAUTION<<<
During the formation of the Omega-55 system, the heavy gravitational pull of its twin stars attracted a great amount of mass from the resource rich Walker nebula in its vicinity. The unusually large accretion disk of the system managed to form many planets, which collided over billions of years and flung millions of fragments throughout the gravity well, eventually coalescing into the Ferner Field.

While it's possible that the field may contain vast, untapped amounts of minerals, the Junkers, Coalition, and Core alike all warn against entering. Of the local powers in the region, only the Core dares to traverse the Ferner Field, and even then not without heavy escort. Core ships seen leaving the field almost always carry scorch marks consistent with weapons fire, but none ever say what lies within the planetary graveyard. One rumor circulating on Bornholm is perhaps more frightening than the rest - that the Core have no earthly idea themselves.

Discovered in 810 AS, Borneo is a frigid world of dotted land masses and sparse coastlines. Its oceans contain a diverse array of fauna, all of which are highly toxic to humans. Additionally, lush forests populate the equator, providing a breathable atmosphere. The planet is capable of supporting human settlement without the need for large-scale terraforming, though dependence upon biodomes and scarce ground limits the islands to small colonies.

The Crayter Republic intended to settle the planet, building Minato Harbour in orbit to handle supplies and colonists bound for the surface. However, colonisation was interrupted by the Gallic Royal Navy, forcing a planetary evacuation. The Gallic forces showed no interest in continuing the colonization efforts.

The Royal Navy withdrew following the liberation of Tau-44 in 824 AS. The Crayterians later discovered the settlements had been neglected during the Gallic occupation, with the infrastructure battered to a ruinous state by the harsh climate, adding considerable cost to restart colonization.
