1117378.text: [815 AS] War in Tau Space Continues

1117379.text:
MANHATTAN -- 815 AS -- Fall of 814 AS will be remembered as the first time the nations of Sirius saw a hope for peace between Kusari and Bretonia in the War for Tau-31, when in a surprising move Kusari offered a six month truce to Bretonia, which was quickly accepted by the Queen's government. Analysts were quick to point out that the attrition of Bretonian fortifications at Harris and the skilled use of the Leeds Jump Gate choke point continued to put great pressure on the Kusari Naval Forces which now needed time to consolidate and protect their gains from frequent and frenzied pirate attacks. At the same time Bretonia lacked the strength to accomplish a breakthrough against Kusari lines. The ensuing stalemate and the following truce proposal seemed like an excellent opportunity for lasting peace negotiations.

It was thus all the more shameful that the peace process broke down so quickly. Only two months into the truce, at the beginning of 815 AS both sides began gathering forces at each side of the Leeds gate in an attempt to dissuade one another from any surprise attacks. Within two more months fighting broke out once again after Bretonian forces broke the truce by engaging Kusari forces in Tau-31 through a surprise attack using the jump hole from the Dundee system followed by the main strike from Leeds. However, despite Bretonian initial gains the Kusari Navy held the fort. Bretonian forces suffered heavy casualties during the Leeds break out, a loss they would be hard pressed to recover from.

The fleet striking from Dundee had more success, having taken the Kusari forces at Holman Outpost completely by surprise and inflicting heavy casualties. It was not until reinforcements from Tau-29 arrived, that Kusari has repulsed the attack and forced the Armed Forces in Tau-31 to retreat to Harris once again. During the battle itself Holman Outpost was heavily damaged by Kusari battery fire. Several independent miners were killed; an act that prompted an apology from the Kusari government, but did nothing to demilitarise the area around the station. Kusari Naval Forces continued to use Holman as a staging area, despite IMG requests to the contrary.

With the truce broken and any hope of a quick peace in shambles, the war for Tau-31 rages on. Kusari continues pressing its goal of complete Bretonian elimination in the Tau systems, while the dogged defenders of Harris continue to stand in the face of a naval blockade. Time will only tell how this conflict will finally end.

1117381.text: NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- The war for Tau-31 continues. The six month truce offered to Bretonia by Kusari was broken this week by the Bretonian Armed Forces, after the latter launched a surprise attack on the Kusari staging area at Holman Outpost in an attempt to cripple the Kusari defenders. A previously unknown jump hole was purported to have been used in the breakout attempt, though the attackers were in the end unable to hold the offensive, and were forced to pull back to Planet Harris before further Kusari reinforcements reached the system, thus effectively lengthening the war by many months. Twenty eight independent miners have also been reported to have died due to collateral damage as a result of the attack. The Kusari government delivered a quick apology for the incident, but continued pressing the need for a militarisation of the space around Holman in the face of unexpected Bretonian attacks on the area.A spokesman from the Rheinland government said: "We share the concerns of the IMG regarding such a move, I think it is safe to say we can expect only an escalation of violence in Tau-31 as a result of this Bretonian attack".

1117383.text: CALI -- 819 AS -- The invasion of the Gallic naval fleets into Orkney and Tau-23 were cause for uncertainty among many Outcasts. But since then, we have learned much about their capabilities and intentions. The Gallic forces are bound for Bretonia, and in their wake follow many supply shipments, which provide an opportunity to seize materials much closer to Malta then ever before. The Gallic forces seem unaccustomed to fighting within the dense asteroid fields of the Taus, but it is second nature to our own fighters. They are however better equipped than the miner vagrants that call themselves the IMG.\n\nIt is in our best interests to inflict as much damage on the Gallic forces as possible. Should Bretonia fall, Gallia may decide to attack towards Genoa instead, and that would eventually put Malta itself at risk.

1117385.text: NEW LONDON -- 815 AS -- In a recent address to the nation, Queen Carina has called for the Bretonian people to "stand firm, patient and courageous in the face of Kusari aggression" after the treaty that was supposed to last six months at the minimum was broken after only four. Bretonian Armed Forces officials cite the reason for renewed hostilities as "the need to respond to the Kusari naval build up preparing to strike on Leeds", with government officials rallying to the opinion that Kusari government was planning to break the truce regardless so that they can push their advantage into sovereign Bretonian territory.\n\nThe truce was broken after Bretonian forces moved through a previously unknwon system into Tau-31, bypassing Kusari defenses at the Leeds gate and seizing Holman for a couple of hours before Kusari reinforcements arrived at the scene. Despite the attack not making any significant gains, the Bretonian Armed Forces reports that the strike allowed them to reinforce both Planet Harris and BMM holdings in Tau-23, further strengthening the defensive lines. The war is expected to continue in full capacity for months to come.

1117386.text: [815 AS] Bretonia Attempts to Strike Back

1117387.text: CRETE -- 815 AS -- Yet another treacherous strike marks Bretonia's history today, as the Armed Forces moved into Tau-31 in an attempt to catch the Kusari navy unprepared, and broke the cease fire that was supposed to last for months more. Kusari forces have rallied fast and repulsed the attack, but the damage was already done: more Bretonians now reinforce Planet Harris, which will make the war even more drawn out than it already is. A quick resolution is now all but a myth.\n\nThe attacking Bretonians revealed one of the jump holes they have been using to communicate with Tau-31 through this however: the so called Dundee jump hole was used to transport a large attack force behind Kusari lines, and after that attack was routed the Kusari fleet quickly moved through it to engage the remaining Bretonian forces there and seize the choke point. Should they manage to win in the system, Edinburgh should be up for easy grabs.

1117389.text: NEW TOKYO -- 815 AS -- The Bretonian government has once again proved their incompetence and treachery by breaking the peace treaty and attacking Kusari Naval Forces in Tau-31 just two days ago. The treaty having been proposed by the honourable Kusari government was made last year in the name of promoting an end to the vile conflict in Tau-31, and was supposed to last for six months - yet was broken after only four. The Kusari government has been swift to respond by making it explicitly clear that peace is out of the question in the face of the constant militaristic threat that Kusari is facing, and that the Bretonian government must be unseated for any peace process to be able to occur. A Naval Forces spokesman mentioned Kusari forces having found a "new way into Bretonia, one that will allow [Kusari forces] to fight on an even more equal footing". He further added that the war is expected to progress into core Bretonian systems within a matter of months.

1117390.text: [815 AS] The Legacy of the Nomad War

1117391.text:
NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- Although the war instigated by the traitor Niemann has been over for almost 14 years now, echoes of the conflict continue to shake Rheinland society as it struggles to rebuild its former power after the abject defeats during the many battles of 801 AS What remains a mystery however is the unexplained disappearance of the survivors of the battlegroup that attacked Honshu. Accounts from the conflict itself seem to confirm that the Military fleet made great initial gains against the Kusari navy but was eventually pushed back and forced to retreat to Sigma-13, where the surviving forces seemed to simply disappear into the gas clouds.

Statistics show no less than hundreds of ships going missing in the aftermath of the War of 800 AS that were never accounted for since. This mystery kept on baffling historians and analysts: could it be possible that the battlegroup's officers were more loyal to Niemann than to their Fatherland? A connection was made when a rising spate of pirate strikes on the edges of Rheinland space turned out to actually be terrorist attacks by what seemed to have been Rheinland pilots flying older generation Military ships. In the wake of such attacks the inevitable question was raised: could Niemann and his cronies have returned to plague Rheinland once more?

These attackers have quickly earned the nickname "Die Wilden" or the "Wild" by the survivors of their attacks, owing to a supposed feral attitude and lack of mercy for military personnel and civilians alike. In response the Rheinland Military was officially briefed on action against such traitorous attacks, such that it continued to steadily protect the nation and themselves. Nonetheless, little is known about the group or their ultimate goals. All that is taken for granted is the fact that these so called "Wild" shoot to kill, take no prisoners and are extremely dangerous, and that any who encounter them would do well to attempt escape toward the nearest Military strong point immediately.

1117392.text: [819 AS] Independent Miners in Tau Space Threatened

1117393.text: SOUTH SHIELDS -- 819 AS -- The annual South Shields conference concluded today, with attendees discussing the future of the IMG in the Tau region. The Bretonian/Kusari conflict caused the deaths of at least 65 miners, most of whom perished when Outpost Holman was hit by Kusari fire during a Bretonian raid. With Gallia's shock arrival, some are calling for an evacuation of Guild personnel. Others note that only Rheinland corporations could employ so many on short notice, and many Guildsmen came to the Taus to escape those companies. The conference concluded with a reaffirmation of the IMG's neutral stance in the conflicts, and a commitment to maintain work while adhering to the civilian law of the House which has local military control.

Nauru Terminal was formerly an inseparable part of Yaren Base, and only recently redesigned part by the Core for another purpose. Previously, it was used largely in servicing the Core's military vessels up to the size of a cruiser when Ennibeck Starport was constructed nearby. However, as Ennibeck Startport started to struggle financially through 828 and 829 AS, there have been worries in the Core's top management that the startport will be shut down and all remaining logistical chains severed.

To prevent such a scenario, the Core has decided to re-open their Yaren Base to civilian traffic in hopes of keeping the logistical chains intact in the event of Ennibeck's closure and decommission.

Technically still part of Yaren Base, Nauru Terminal is used to handle mostly civilian traffic to and from Nauru. Nauru Terminal's security procedures are lax in comparison to Yaren Base in order to make the traffic as fluent as possible, despite the dissatisfaction of security experts.

1117420.text: [816 AS] War in Tau-31 and Dundee Set For Stalemate

1117421.text: NEW TOKYO -- 816 AS -- The war over Tau-31 continues to rage on, meanwhile Naval Forces commanders have abandoned their plans for immediate offensive into Leeds over allegations that the government is sending too many forces abroad, leaving the homeland exposed to pirate attacks. The admiralty has instead opted for a tactic of entrenchment in Tau-31, devoting present standing forces to crack down on smugglers running the blockade to Harris and Tau-23 within the system for as long as further reinforcements from Kusari are delayed. When asked whether it is a wise move to give the Bretonians ample time to prepare, a spokesman for the Naval Forces responded: "the Bretonians have nothing and they know it. The only thing they can do is delay the inevitable".\n\nKyushu, Tau-29 and Tau-23 have reported a record number of pirate attacks in the last quarter, with a great likelyhood of these attacks being funded by the Bretonian crown. These new measures by the Kusari navy are expected to help stamp this presence down once again.

1117422.text: [816 AS] A New Threat in the Omega Sector

1117423.text: CADIZ -- 816 AS -- The Bretonian-Kusari war is set to last far longer than the Corsair Elders initially expected. The initial expectations of a swift, surprise conquest of Tau-23 that would cripple the Outcasts at the start fell terribly short, and gave the opposing factions time to rally together to oppose the Corsair plan by putting their mutual issues aside and uniting against them. That not being the end of it, a new enemy using unknown, exotic and extremely dangerous brands of weapons appeared suddenly within core Omega space, dealing noticable losses to both the Red Hessians and standing Corsair forces, making it look as if the fates had conspired against the Corsairs in every way possible.\n\nThus, the order to consolidate has been given. The conquest of the Outcast homeworld is no longer considered as the main objective. The Outcasts have heavily fortified the Omicron Eta system, to the extent that head on assault is no longer feasible. With Rheinland openly criticising Liberty and vice versa, any future conflict between the two may lead to the Red Hessians relocating more of their forces to the Omega systems, and forming a critical mass that may even threaten Cadiz and Leon bases. Whatever happens, the Corsairs will be prepared. The Elders are ready to wait for their time to strike one of the many Corsair enemies, and at least a few of them will be weakened enough soon so that they can be finished off.

1117425.text: NEW LONDON -- 816 AS -- Despite the hard push by Kusari naval units, the Bretonian Armed Forces has kept the border safe with not a single Kusari strike managing to break through the line so far. The Kusari assault on Dundee was broken and forced to retreat back into the Tau-31 system. The Leeds Jump Gate remains secure with a Bretonian build up keeping the space safe on the Leeds side, while the defenders of Harris continue staring down the besieging Kusari navy with neither side willing to advance into the mine fields separating them.\n\nThe war is set to descend into yet another lengthy stalemate, although some analysts are set in their claim that this situation is simply "the calm before the storm". Not content to just disregard such claims, the Armed Forces continue to fortify the borders hoping to be prepared for any kind of Kusari attack long before it happens.

1117426.text: [816 AS] Sirius Wide War on the Horizon

1117427.text: MALTA -- 816 AS -- The war between Bretonia and Kusari continues as expected. Neither house is ready to give up, with the Bretonians hoping the attrition on the Kusari forces will force them to give concessions, while the Kusari navy stays firm with its assurances of an ability to breach Bretonian defenses. Both are locked in a stalemate at the moment, although Kusari is expected to eventually breach the lines even if at great cost.\n\nIn the mean time past rivalries between Liberty and Rheinland suddenly begin to flare up once again with Rheinland's public accusations of unsanctioned Libertonian research taking place in a hidden system. The Rheinland Foreign Office officially blamed the newly elected President Powell for this research, claiming they have proof to back it up, yet have still so far refused to release any files pertaining to the situation. Furthermore, several rumours of a purported Nomad control over a great many Liberty Navy officers have been spreading across the neural net almost unchecked. One can only assume what the answer from Liberty will be at this point in time.

1117428.text: [816 AS] Rheinland Media Blast Powell for "Unethical Research"

1117429.text: MANHATTAN -- 816 AS -- Liberty officials have been rushing to rebuke claims by the Rheinland state media that the Liberty Navy is pursuing unsanctioned and extremely dangerous research on alien technology, despite similar activities already leading to one Sirius wide war not 15 years ago. When asked for his statement on the situation, President James Powell responded: "This is a wholly ridiculous claim. The Liberty Navy has never possessed alien technology or artifacts, nor has it done research on them. This is simply yet another attempt by Rheinland to bash this presidency for pushing for the remainder of the Stuttgart debt to be repaid sooner, and I for one will not stand idly by while they try to instigate a pointless witch hunt to discredit us".\n\nThe Liberty government has also officially responded by stating that claims of the Liberty Navy being infiltrated are unfounded, as the LSF has been heavily involved in screening every individual holding high positions within the Navy structure since the end of the Nomad War in order to prevent any future possibilities of an armed coup. Meanwhile, the Rheinland state media is set to publicly release a documentary on the subject within a matter of weeks, possibly further exacerbating the crisis.

1117430.text: [816 AS] Stalemate in the Tau Sector

1117431.text: NEW BERLIN -- 816 AS -- The Tau sector looks set to be embroiled by war for years to come, as both Bretonia and Kusari turn to stationary defenses with only minor direct engagements taking place while they consolidate their forces once again. The Kusari government however is set to once again achieve the upper hand if the decision to transfer further forces from the core Kusari systems is made. In the mean time, Bretonia revels in their small victory in Dundee where they repulsed an equal Kusari force back to the Tau-31 jump hole and successfully held it.\n\nNo matter the outcome of the war, it appears clear that the IMG will be the losers. Faced with either Kusari military occupation or Bretonian sanctions against Holman on charges of collaboration, the independent miners are faced with a difficult position of attempting to balance between two strong forces. Holman itself has become virtually abandoned as a result of the war, with only a skeleton crew remaining after the most recent incident where a misfired blast hit the station's hull and killed several crew members. If the war drags on for a few years more, the station is quite likely to be eventually left derelict.

1117433.text: The Rheinland freighter Westerwald was captured in the Dresden system by The Wild in 814 AS The ship was then stationed inside the Nomad gate that The Wild were building for unknown purposes at the time.

1117434.text: [816 AS] Liberty Into Research On Aliens?

1117435.text:
HAMBURG -- 816 AS -- It is a matter of public knowledge that the Liberty government is as opposed to alien artifact trading as any government in Sirius. But could the actual truth be different? An unnamed source in Liberty has provided a great amount of insight into the forbidden forays of the Liberty government: an effort to import alien artifacts and carry out forbidden research, wholly against the Charter of the Colonies.

According to the information sent by the source this initiative was started by President James Powell, a strong supporter of Libertonian "military power", at the onset of his term. Since then Liberty has not only amassed a strong, militaristic buildup of Naval forces, but has also secretly imported thousands of supposedly defunct alien artifacts -- a fact that has been quite simply concealed from the public. Considering it is well known that the only documented source of such nomad technology is placed deep in the edge worlds in the form of a notorious pirate empire, it can therefore be concluded that Liberty has since established a relationship with these unlawful brigands, likely to the detriment of both Rheinland and Bretonia.

Then there is the research on live specimens. According to our source, Liberty has allegedly procured a number of live alien hosts several years ago, using which its scientists successfully performed extensive research on the alien genome, going so far as breeding them in laboratory conditions and experimenting with human-alien hybrids! News of this have left Rheinland government officials in complete bewilderment: has Liberty already forgotten the folly of experimenting with alien technology, and the effect it had on the crazed Chancellor Niemann? Right now the possibility of President Powell already being under the influence of alien artifacts is considered by the Rheinland government as quite real, and the recent increase in Liberty patrols and checkpoints on the Liberty-Rheinland border has prompted a similar response from the Rheinland state. State officials have already responded they will be attempting to establish the legitimacy of the Liberty source before further action is taken.

1117437.text: FREEPORT 9 -- 819 AS -- Since the Omicron Eta system was discovered for the first time, it was destined to become the "no man's land" between the Corsairs and the Outcasts. Providing quick access to both Omicron Alpha and Omicron Gamma, both sides were quick to fortify the system on their own respective ends, and fighting has continued inbetween ever since. In response to the constant attempts at deeper incursions, both sides began spreading stationary mines between the nebula and Planet Catania. Eventually the last Zoners from the inhabiting the system left, and the result was a battlefield split in two by a large field of stationary mines, deadly to any who would venture inside.\n\nBoth sides continue fighting over the system, though locked in a stalemate. The superior skill and abilities of Outcast pilots are evenly matched by the numbers the Corsairs employ in their pursuit of conquest. It is without doubt that to conflict in Omicron Eta will carry on for many years more before any conclusion is reached.

1117438.text: [819 AS] Unioners Warming To Corsair Influence

1117439.text: LEIPHEIM -- 819 AS -- Despite the risk of a rift with the Red Hessians, the Unioners in the Munich system are once again cooperating with the Corsairs. Unioner leaders stated they "expect no more trouble then the Junkers" in doing so, which suggests they are primarily motivated by the Alien Artifacts smuggling profits. So far the Hessians seem to tolerate the cooperation, so both the Unioners and Liberty Rogues are likely to be making a fortune in smuggling both Artifacts and Hessian Tears into Liberty.

1117449.mapped:
The Tayport Extension was constructed by the Mollys of Mull Base at first in order to facilitate the storage of stolen goods acquired from the convoys passing through Newcastle. However, over time as the Molly Raiders became more successful in their acquisition of goods, the Crown demanded the Armed Forces take action. This led to convoys being more heavily guarded, which made it more difficult for the Mollys to make successful raids against Bretonia's corporations.

Rather than waste the numerous storage facilities, associated hanger-bays, and office space, the Mollys reached out to their allies in the Coalition with a deal. The Coalition would aid in Mull's defense and increased shipments of war materials, in exchange for administration of the extension. This allowed the Coalition's forces to extend their reach deeper into Bretonia as well as the nearby war-torn Taus and closer access to Libertonian systems.

1117457.mapped:
Toronto Station was constructed in 817 AS as a refinery and alloy foundry, processing resources extracted from Planet Huron. Deep Space Engineering (DSE) was heavily subsidized to build the base, due to Liberty’s fears of an impending war with Rheinland, which could severely impact their access to strategic construction materials. Toronto was designed to use sophisticated, DSE-produced Mining Machinery, operated by expensive teams of Liberty engineers. When the anticipated war finally came, increasingly demanding export quotas were set, with staff regularly complaining of insufficient pay and poor working conditions.

This came to a head in 824 AS, after years of grueling targets intended to fuel economic support for Bretonia during the Gallic War. Pushed too far, the engineers declared a general strike. Rather than negotiate, DSE instead contracted cheap Bretonian refugees to break the picket, dismissing the engineers with immediate effect. Outraged, the ex-workers seized Toronto’s docking bays and refused to allow their replacements access to the station. Before long, Marines were dispatched from Fort Severn to restore the strategically important flow of goods. What exactly transpired next is hotly disputed, however the “Toronto Massacre” resulted in dozens being killed, and several stolen transports and mining ships fleeing into the Georgia Ice Field.

While production quickly resumed, Toronto found itself the target of frequent Xeno attacks. Soon after the end of the Gallic War, Liberty ended its subsidies for the operation, arguing that the strategic need to distort free market forces had passed -- DSE quickly soured on the station's marginal profits. As Navy security patrols were gradually drawn down, Ontario became the most dangerous system in Liberty. When in 829 AS Liberty announced that it intended to fully withdraw system coverage, DSE stripped the most valuable plant machinery and abandoned the rest. Toronto now exists only as a skeleton, fought over by Junkers and other black market salvagers.

Battleship Delaware was constructed during Liberty's conflict with Gallia, intended to take the place of the Battleship Gettysburg. However, manufacturing setbacks preventing the completion of the warship, as well as the increased aggression of the Gallic Royal Navy, forced the Liberty Navy to deploy the Gettysburg to the front lines of the conflict. This, military analysts hoped, would have allowed enough time to finish the new Mitchell-class vessel, and allow the aging Monument-class to be decommissioned.

The strategy was in vain, however, as the fierce fighting in the orbit of New London cost the Liberty Navy several of their veteran fleets, the Gettysburg among them. With the recapture of Leeds and the collapse of the Gallic Crown, the war was over for Liberty. Having finished construction very shortly after the conflict, Delaware and their supporting fleet took the place of the Gettysburg, with greenhorn crew who hope to fill the shoes of the now destroyed battegroup. Hoping to prove their potency as a Great House, Liberty ordered for the Delaware to spearhead an invasion into the backwater systems that serve as staging grounds for Insurgent forces. Supposedly acting in concert with an attempt to form a beachhead into Vespucci, the Delaware has instead opted to lay siege to enemy infrastructure in its immediate environment before pushing onwards in this bold offensive action.

Having finally secured a position in Vespucci, the Delaware's Commanding Officer sought to expedite his victory by pressing the advance without first regrouping with the Ohio. A costly engagement with the Battleship Vanquisher meant that when the hour finally struck, the Delaware was found to be lacking. The Triton's large snubcraft element whittled the Delaware down over time, destroying it despite the odds being far from in their favor.

Heldrungen is a high-security prison within a desolate area of Thuringia constructed in the year 822 AS as a joint project of the MND and Rheinland Military, originally foreseen as an experimental facility to improve the resocialization of convicts in existing prisons through humane or inhumane conditions. Rheinland's secret service deemed it necessary to operate a cage for special, or rather, hopeless cases - people who either know too much or are a threat to national security. War criminals, warlords, terrorists and spies, but especially traitors - individuals deemed unworthy of a second chance, are all locked away here from the rest of civilization. Those interned within simply disappear from existence without leaving a trace, as though they never existed. The prisoners do not even know where they are detained. The MND does not intend to release any inmates from Heldrungen.

Heldrungen's personnel is said to be brutal towards its inmates, often interrogating them for hours to squeeze out every last bit of information through the use of drugs and thorough "enhanced interrogation methods." Officers of the Rheinland Military who are aware of the facility's existence believe that Heldrungen's prisoners serve as experimental subjects for genetic tests, viruses, Nomad infestation and other unethical experiments. Hence it is a dreaded prison earning the nickname "Das Eiserne Tribunal" ("The Iron Tribunal") among the military.

Grand Vista Orbital was originally a Zoner installation constructed to serve as an intermediary trade platform in orbit of Planet Gran Canaria. When Bretonia annexed Omega-49 in 826 AS, this drew the hostile attention of the Coalition, later culminating in the destruction of the Battleship Stirling after the Gallic War. Seeing the threat posed by Coalition forces and their allies, the Bretonian Government requested the assistance of The Core to help fortify Omega-49.

Since then, AP Manufacturing has retrofitted Grand Vista Orbital into a military installation, which The Core has now taken full administrative control over. The station's previous population has largely either been replaced with Core and APM personnel or locals sympathetic to the Core's ideals. The exact nature of the agreement between The Core and Bretonia is not known.

1117580.mapped:
With every war that spans several star systems, the inevitable problem seems to be lying not with morale, military prowess or communication, but with basic supplies. Everything, from soldiers to weapons has a basic cost of supplies that, if not delivered, would inhibit the potential in combat drastically. Issoudun Shipyard was the Crown's attempt to address at least part of the problem. Designed as a mobile field drydock and repair facility, Issoudun was able to produce many spare parts of Royal Navy ships on the spot using resources located in the surrounding systems, thus circumventing many supply line issues.

Unfortunately for the Enclave, the fateful events of the Glassing and subsequent mutiny of a large portion of its remaining fleet - As well as upheaval back home - radically shifted Issoudun's function into the Royal remnant's sole means of supporting what remains of its capital fleet. An ironic reversal of fortunes forced the Enclave into adopting a system of ship maintenance and recycling not unlike that of their nemesis in the former Council only a few years ago. Using these methods, Issoudun was rapidly expanded into a shipyard complex from all manner of repurposed hull panels and scrap from the billions of casualties from their ill-fated crusade to Bretonia.

No longer able to treat any of their assets "disposably", Issoudun has a constant rotation of over-worked technicians and engineers boarding, manning, and departing the shipyard at all times to keep it at near full-efficiency at all standard hours of a solar day. The facility is almost always performing intensive repairs to at least one warship at all times, and this critical asset can be reinforced in moments by the veteran Battlegroup Dax, usually stationed within visual range. Although Issoudun's facilities are theoretically suitable for the construction of new spaceframes, resource production from Brittany and Bordeaux just barely approach the capacity needed for the construction of new warships.

The facility is almost always performing intensive repairs to at least one warship at all times, and this critical asset can be reinforced in moments by the veteran Battlegroup Dax, usually stationed within visual range. Although Issoudun's facilities are theoretically suitable for the construction of new spaceframes, resource production from Brittany and Bordeaux just barely approach the capacity needed for the construction of new warships.

Vienne is a cold, ancient world with primitive organic life, mainly represented by a range of dwarf coniferous plants and microorganisms. A surprisingly low oxygen percentage in its atmosphere had stalled plans to terraform it, until the Minarchy approached the Languedoc authorities and offered to fund the planet's terraformation, no matter the cost, in exchange for the system's allegiance. Languedocs authorities happily accepted, and the Vienne Deal is cited as having practically written the ink on the papers of Languedoc's annexation by the Minarchy.

Following the Kusarian invasion however, the terraforming project was abandoned before it even launched properly. Government officials stated as reason that the sheer amounts of credits required to finance such a large scale project are more urgently required elsewhere in Gallia for the time being.

1117593.mapped:
Gap Station, orbiting Planet Drôme, served as the administrative capital for the Languedoc system, a role it was not designed to perform. As such, system authorities, with backing from the Minarchy of Provence, are commencing a series of modifications and expansions to ensure the station can look and act the part of a capital.

Its unremarkable exterior masked Gap's pivotal political role in contemporary Gallia. During the Second Gallic Civil War, it was the theatre of a violent ground battle between the defending Royal army and the attacking Council marines. The fight lead to a decisive, if costly, Royal victory. In a rare display of anger, the Council retreated and turned the heavy weapons of its orbiting warships on the station's various points of ingress to try and depressurise it. They were only partially successful due to the Guillestre battlegroup's timely arrival to chase the Council fleet as the station's engineers managed to weld the breaches shut.

This event scarred the Languedoc population, historically favourable to the otherwise publicly clean-handed Council. It was a rare act of violence against non-combatants on their part, and the matter has always been dodged by their authorities, putting the blame on misinterpreted orders. The truth of it remains unknown, but by the time the Languedoc authorities had to choose between joining the Council's Republique or aligning themselves with the Minarchy with their offer of substantial, no-questions-asked support, the choice was obvious.

Gap would become one of the casualties of the Kusari War, falling in the second battle of Languedoc.

1117596.mapped:
One of the serial vessels constructed at Rambouillet Shipyards for the needs of Gallic Royal Intelligence, the Battlecruiser Nice participated in numerous operations to provide Royal Navy with intelligence gathering and sabotage behind enemy lines. Similar to other serial battlecruisers under Royal Intelligence command, Nice was not assigned to any particular fleet and operated as stand alone asset. Specification of the ship suggests that it's designed to play a role of the light carrier for intelligence wings. Nice lacks firepower to be an assault ship, but may apply hit and run tactics in critical situations.

Nice was first spotted by the Liberty patrol in Magellan, few weeks before Gallic battlegroup led by Battleship Carcassonne has entered the system. Nice was freshly deployed from the reserve after the destruction of Battleship Oubli in 738 AGS. While there are numerous rumors about battlecruisers similar to Nice appearing at Gallic fronts or even beyond them, they lack documented evidence. Later Nice participated in Royalist attempts to deal with the pocket resistance in Taus. The last documented assignment of Nice was in late 740 AGS, the battlecruiser had to track down the Outcast traffic in Tau-37. All of the archived reports coming from vessel after receiving orders are either corrupted or missing, supposedly destroyed by GRE agents who sided with Enclave.

Battlecruiser Nice among several other ships became a part of the conspiracy theory about alleged Gallic expedition to the Omicrons. Such rumors were dismissed by the official sources in post-war Gallic Confederation, while the new Gallic government had conflicting reports about fate of the ship coming from different sources. Some reports suggested that the ship was lost to the Outcasts, some that it joined one of the Royalist resistance groups.

Montbrison Prison Station is a new development ordered to replace the infamous Fleury-Mérogis prison in Ile-de-France, an overpopulated prison with deplorable conditions, a fact considered to be a great embarrassment by the Parisian society. Cofinanced by the New Paris authority and the Gallic Navy, Montbrison will house the same kind of convicts (and in some cases, the very same convicts) that were detained in Fleury-Mérogis: dangerous, high-security individuals, with the added benefit of moving these away from the sophisticated Core worlds.

Publicly, efforts have been made on living conditions to avoid turning Montbrison into the same nightmarish installation it replaces, but some have already questioned the legitimacy of such claims given Montbrisons location between Planet Sete and its moon Cerbere effectively keeps the Prison far away from the public eye.

Chateau Salins was built in 768 AS, at the time when pirate activity in Lorraine was already on the rise. Originally designed to harvest rare minerals from the volcanic world it orbits, the Marne Rebellion reduced activity on the station to a near standstill. It served as a makeshift shipyard during the Second Gallic Civil War, maintaining Navy fighters and various civilian craft that run supplies to and from Metz.

Given the extravagent cost of harvesting minerals from the scorching Planet Mirecourt as well as increased terrorist and pirate activity in the Lorraine system, the station was passed on to the Gendarmerie. It is currently used as their HQ in Lorraine, but the station itself is woefully undergunned and is frequently the target of heavy Maquis attack, often requiring reinforcement from the Epinal's airwing.

1117631.mapped:
In many ways similar to its now dismantled sister station of Montpellier in Languedoc, Luneville was built to maintain and secure the mines that surround jump hole leading into the dangerous Outcast space. By the time the Outcasts themselves arrived, the mine field was already in place. Having no means to penetrate it, the Outcasts simply avoided the area, establishing Genoa base in Tau-37 to keep watch over their side of the field.

Unaware of what lay on the other side, the minefield was eventually breached in 817 AS by a surprise Council strike from Lorraine. Their method was as crude as it was effective: A large engine salvaged from a derelict Navy cruiser was grafted onto a dense asteroid in the Sarre nebula. While Council and Maquis raiders distracted the bulk of the GRN's Lorraine forces with a diversionary attack on Metz, this asteroid was sent straight into the center of the minefield. This unconventional attack succeeded, creating a wide path through the mines all the way into Tau-37. Starved of reinforcements, the Luneville defenders were unable to restore the minefield. The Council later came to regret this as the Outcasts arrived, first in a trickle, then a wave that Gallia, in the midst of its civil war, was powerless to stop.

Supply lines to Luneville have been reinforced by the newly repaired and combat ready Epinal, but efforts to restore the minefield have so far proven futile. This is due not only to near constant Outcast strikes on the base, but Maquis attacks as well. Although the Maquis have no love for the Maltese, it seems the continued presence of the Outcast raiders in Lorraine and Burgundy taxes the Duchy greatly, something the Maquis have a vested interest in.

The biggest threat to the facility would come from not the Outcasts, but the Kusari Navy, which invaded Lorraine in mid 827. As a military facility, it was deemed an acceptable target for the KNF, and the station was subsequently captured after intense fighting, causing damage to the base. The base has been locked down until it is deemed safe.

1117659.mapped:
An installation of Unione Corse hidden within the Le Thillot Asteroid Field. The Corse had a vested interest in acquiring intelligence on Sirian houses, and were eager to learn what laid beyond the mysterious Lorraine minefield. As such, the Corse of Thionville assisted the Council in obtaining a large asteroid from Le Thillot, which was used to breach the mines.

The breach proved damning to the Corse over the Gallic drug trade. Within mere months, tens of thousands of former customers considered Nox to be out, and the new chic Sirian drug - Cardamine - to be in. As a result, profits dropped while an epidemic of Cardamine withdrawal deaths sparked. Many Corsicans have found this unexpected outcome to be reprehensible to their reputation.

Today, the Unione Corse uses Thionville to intercept Cardamine runners and to launch preemptive strikegroups into Tau-53. Additionally, being on the fringe of Sirian space, the Corsicans have established a grey market-hub to haggle with Sirians.

1117753.text:
The Malta Orbital Dock was constructed shortly after suppressing the slave revolt on the planet Malta, in response to the new security challenges faced by the Outcasts. While many Outcast ships can land on Malta without any issues - ranging from transports to cruisers - the starports on the planet proved vulnerable, allowing rebellious slavers to destroy or, even worse, partially capture and utilize these valuable vessels against their former masters.

The Malta Orbital Dock serves as a security and logistical intermediary between incoming ships and the planet's surface. It enables the crews of smuggling vessels to conduct their business with the Outcasts without requiring access to Malta's surface.
1117753.mapped:
The fifth sleeper ship, the Hispania, launched at the same time as its sister ships and broke through the Coalition blockade in the Sol system. Unfortunately, sabotage by Coalition agents that had secreted themselves onboard crippled the engines just as the vessel arrived in the Sirius sector. The passengers awakened from their cryogenic sleep to discover the ship was drifting towards an unknown star system. When the Hispania drifted within range of a red dwarf system, conflict aboard the ship escalated, and about half of the surviving colonists decided to take escape pods, chancing their survival on the promise of a habitable world. The remaining half coaxed the damaged vessel onwards to its eventual destination in the Omicron Alpha system, arriving some time in the year 41 AS Upon their arrival, the crew discovered a planet capable of supporting human life in orbit of the primary star. The Hispania's passengers named the planet Malta -- a harsh place of acidic oceans, gray skies, and vast plains covered in a species of tall, thin, orange grass. Taking whatever equipment they could salvage from the crippled Hispania, they left the hulk in orbit of Malta and began to make a home for themselves on Malta.

Eventually the Outcasts -- as they came to think of themselves -- began a limited exploration of their home system. As pilots wandered farther and farther afield in search of resources, many became seriously ill. Upon returning to Malta, the crews recovered quickly. After making a number of genetic scans of critically ill pilots, the doctors made a startling and disturbing discovery. Their genetic code had been altered considerably. The Outcast human DNA was found to contain strands identical to that of the orange grasses that covered the planet -- from which the drug Cardamine was derived. Trace amounts were present in everything on the planet, in their food, their water, even the very air. Once pilots made lengthier journeys away from Malta, their bodies went into shock, followed by death.

The Outcasts were now truly separated from the rest of humanity -- changed so that they could never expand beyond the planet on which they had landed. They needed Cardamine now, like air, food, or water. But with the origin of the sickness solved, they could at least compensate by carrying supplies of Cardamine with them and resume their exploration of their surrounding systems. Over time, their knowledge of Cardamine improved, and the Outcasts learned that distributing it in a highly concentrated dose causes extreme euphoria. When they finally encountered the rest of the Houses in the seventh century, a new strategy emerged. The Outcasts would deliver the poison that would rot the other Houses from the inside out and grow rich from the profits of their trade.

The planet's crust is largely devoid of usable metallic elements, with a few notable exceptions, namely at the heart of her largest continent, and highly unusual deposits of metallic Copper on the ocean floor. Most of its landmass is covered in prairies with natural, low-grade Cardamine grass; large plantations with heavily bred and modified strains have been built on the most fertile sites. Malta's architecture is a largely low-hung and flat, one-story affair in the rural areas; cities are an expression of extremes, built almost entirely in the rare hilly regions of the planet. There is little at ground-level, except starports; most structures are built both deep into the ground and into massive towers that reach towards the sky, constructed yet again as to mimic the textures of the ground. Malta's oceans are strongly acidic and home to algae that tolerate its high acidity. They appear to hold a slightly green tint from the surface.

These days the Outcasts conduct a lucrative drug-smuggling operation using the network of Jump Holes to escape detection and transport their product into the heart of the House systems through various proxies. They remain relatively few in number; a crash in the birth rate seems to have been another side effect of their genetic modification, although the modifications have lengthened the Outcast's lifespan and physical resilience considerably. There have been no known cases of cancer on Malta since the Outcasts made planetfall.

A new development has been Cryer's continued efforts to create a synthetic version of Cardamine that would be approved as a legal medication within Liberty. This poses a direct threat to the Outcasts' source of income. The Atka Research Station, with nearby access to Edge Nebula clouds, is the most immediate threat to the Outcasts. The location of the base within Corsair territory has brought the Outcasts into conflict with their ancient brethren. The Atka Research Station has come under repeated attacks by Outcast raiding parties in recent years, and the Outcasts always destroy any Cryer transports encountered throughout Sirius without mercy.

When the Dons instituted new disciplinary and security measures for Malta's plantations following Albegna's mining colony slave revolt in 831 AS, fear spread among Malta-bound slaves of mass executions and worsened living conditions. On plantations whose owners took a more lax approach to the new protocols, many slaves began to steal and cache weapons and materiel from their Outcast masters, culminating in a slave revolt that captured a starport and seized control of Malta's defenses.

Though many slaves died or were recaptured by Outcasts during the struggle, many others escaped off-world, either in stolen ships moored at the starport, or in ships flown by IMG, Crayter Republic, or abolitionist group pilots. Ultimately, the revolt was quelled, leaving the Outcasts without enough cardamine to meet market demand, and raising the problem of seeking a newer, more obedient source of labor.

1117797.text:
Bourgoin-Jailleu used to serve as a Royal Police station meant to defend the nearby Trade Lane intersection. It was neutralised by a complex attack, carried out by the Council in preparation for the invasion of Languedoc : fighter wings disabled the station's defenses before a heavy transport packed with explosives crashed directly into the hull, killing all personnel onboard.

With financial support from the Confederacy, Bourgoin-Jailleu is being rebuilt for the purpose of housing a Gendarmerie contingent and assisting local authorities in maintaining some degree of law and order.

Secretly constructed in 762 AS, Leipheim Base lies in the south eastern reaches of the Alps Cloud. Carved out of a large asteroid within the nebula, the base is home to a large number of Unioners, many of whom prefer the seclusion that Leipheim offers, compared to the more well known Pacifica Base in Bering.

The base has seen a considerable surge of activity as the Unioners rekindled their ties to the Corsairs. Artifact smuggling out of the Sigma systems often passes by Leipheim, and Corsair raiders have begun to use the base to stage attacks on the lanes. Surprisingly, the Unioners do not seem too concerned with this intrusion on their turf.

1117805.mapped:
Eltmann Moor is a Bundschuh base that lies in the southern end of the Schwarzwald Cloud. Constructed in 801 AS, it is the Bundschuh's first attempt to expand their operations outside of Frankfurt, and the first base they have ever built, after the construction of Bruchsal Base in 718 AS

Many of the Bundschuh initially decried the financial expenditure of creating another base, but have since agreed it was for the best, as the memory of nearly having lost their only strongpoint during the Nomad War was still fresh in their minds. The base suffered substantial damage in wake of the Munich Disaster, and several sections of the asteroid remain off-limits to crew and visitors entirely due to their lack of structural integrity.

Despite this, the controversial decision was made to use Eltmann and the cloud as a hiding place for the Exiled Party's larger ships in absence of an actual drydock to service them. Most of the depot's crew has some training in ship maintenance, and as such a minor drydock was roughly copied from scraps of schematics taken from past raids on Alster and Oder Shipyards.

While Eltmann is the nearest Bundschuh station to Nuremberg, it is very rarely more than a processing center for emigrating refugees. Living conditions are austere at best, with nearly the entire asteroid's internal structure dedicated to transport mintenance or smuggled goods.

Viernheim is a newly built Red Hessian base orbiting the planet Tangier, commissioned in early 815 A.S, and designated to assist in the construction of the planet's docking ring once all materials are assembled, and the Corsair threat removed. Apart from its primary function, it also serves as a refueling base, and more importantly: a resource storage platform. Resources mined from the planet surface are transported to this base using atmospheric shuttles. From there, conventional freighters and transports deliver these goods to their destinations.
Relatively well equipped and manned, Viernheim is able to support its own fighter garrison and a number of small capital ships for defense purposes, while still retaining at least two transport docking bays for incoming and outgoing shipments. The Corsairs have occasionally attempted to destroy the facility, with the most recent attack occurring in late 816 AS, but the heavy Red Hessian defences have always managed to repel these attacks.

The Richelieu battleships were designed around 731 AGS (815 AS) to correct design flaws identified in the Normandie class during the Second Gallic Civil War. Richelieu battleships provided a blend of withering firepower and heavy armor, built around the fearsome Warwolf spinal cannons. By the time of the Gallic invasion of Sirius, the modernized Richelieus were used as the armored fist of the Gallic Royal Navy, inflicting a deadly toll during their engagements with Bretonia, Kusari and Liberty. As one of the first Richelieus, the Rocroi saw extensive service during the Second Gallic Civil War. Led by Rear Admiral Bastien de Fontenoy, the unwaveringly loyal fleet was charged with the defense of the King and Planet New Paris.

When the GRN collapsed in 742 AGS (826 AS), the Rocroi executed plans to evacuate the King. To their shock, the King had already vanished, consumed by paranoia that the Navy was planning to betray him. Instead, the Rocroi prepared Ile-de-France's garrison for a forlorn and bloody resistance against The Council's looming assault. When de Fontenoy and his crew received a ceasefire order from the Grand Duchy of Burgundy, it was seen as a gross betrayal of their oath. In the chaos of the Gallic Confederacy's formation, the Rocroi and its fleet slipped away to Burgundy, hoping to find noble supporters to aid in toppling Grand Duke Valentin Trintignant, and restore the absent King Charles at the head of the Gallic Enclave.

Her campaign against Confederal and Maquis forces in Burgundy was cut short by the Kusari Invasion the following year. As the situation became increasingly dire for Gallia, the Confederation was forced into negotiations with the Enclave on reintegration. As a result, the Enclave ordered the Rocroi south, to support a renewed counteroffensive in Languedoc. Significanty, the Rocroi succeeded in destroying the retreating Battleship Hyono with its Warwolf cannon, before being dispatched in turn by the Nagasaki's fleet. The battleship's survivors have since been awarded prestigious postings throughout the Gallic Union fleet, with now-Admiral de Fontenoy appointed to lead Compiegne Naval Academy.

1117827.mapped:
Aland was initially constructed by unemployed Bretonian shipwrights in 805 AS following layoffs at Scarborough Shipyard. Functioning as a repair depot for transports too large for Freeport 1 to service, IMG vessels would quickly become the outpost's primary clients. Aland would formally join the Guild in 817 AS, resulting in the addition of drydocks capable of manufacturing IMG designed transports and mining ships. As the station grew, Aland's worker-centric practices attracted a large workforce of ex-BMM specialists who had sought to flee Bretonia's troubles.

In 825 AS, the war between Bretonia and Gallia entered its final, critical phase with the destruction of Southampton Shipyard. In desperate need of an accessible shipyard that could rearm and repair capital class vessels, Bretonia issued the IMG with a notice requiring Aland's nationalisation for the duration of the war. The IMG were appalled at this violation of their neutrality, with many fearing the retaliation they would face following what was assumed to be an imminent Gallic victory. Attempts to resolve this impasse broke down entirely following the deployment of the Battleship Norfolk to Omega-3.

This attempt at forcing an ultimatum backfired spectacularly, with the so-called "Aland Incident" flaring into violence. Over the ensuing weeks, bloody fighting would spread across the system, involving a coalition of IMG, ALG and Red Hessian forces. Notable incidents included the Red Hessians' destruction of the Gwent in orbit of Planet Sprague and the loss of the allied CFV Olympia to Aland's garrison. Aland would ultimately be boarded and captured, although at significant cost. The station was immediately transferred to BMM in order to begin the work of upgrading the drydock facilities to service military ships, with The Core hired to provide local area security.

Post-Gallic War, Bretonia has faced growing diplomatic pressure to return the station to the IMG - demands it has so far refused, citing the Guild's violent resistance to the initial occupation. In apparent retaliation for the shipyard's loss, Bretonian shipping in the region has also faced intensified attacks from the Red Hessians. Aland's future is currently uncertain due to the ongoing construction of Portsmouth Shipyard in Cambridge; the impending end of Aland's duties as a military shipyard has raised questions of the installation's sale to The Core as a revenue-raising scheme.

1117832.text:
With the destruction brought by the Omega-58 incident, the Wild were in disarray. However, with almost mechanical efficiency, they adapted to the changed conditions and constructed a small yet durable base in the Sternengraben Nebula. Hewn out of an asteroid containing large quantities of heavy metals that would shield the inhabitants from much of the ambient radiation, Recklinghausen Base is serving multiple purposes. Equipped with storage containers, it is not quite clear what the Wild would need to store, as it is widely believed within Core and Order circles that the Wild have no need to use normal fuels if they are not in need of being secretive. This led to the belief that the Wild are most likely storing food and water, as the basic laws of thermodynamics still apply even to infested humans, which therefore still requires them to eat and drink.

However, most of the inner workings of Recklinghausen is based on conjecture, as nobody was able to actually observe the Wild during their 'everyday lives' yet, or if they have, it is more than likely that nobody would rightly believe them.

1117835.text:
Kusari "Satsuma" Imperial Yacht

In the first centuries of Kusari expansion the Emperor and his Shogun would traverse the glowing skies of the state in a flotilla of vessels, each in turn housing the guardsmen and secretaries of state needed to enable the will of the Emperor. When came the day that the royal house would travel to Liberty in order to effect trade negotiations it was decided that a vessel as secure as it was awe inspiring more suitable vessel was needed.

Built to dwarf the fleets of nations, the Satsuma was commissioned as a artisan craft, as ornate as it was deadly, as awe inspiring as it was indestructible. It was the crowning vessel of its age, the flag vessel of the Liberty Navy would have been blackened in her shadow if it were not illuminated by her light. Now centuries old these vessels, one still for the Emperor and his Shogun, maintain the same dominance of grace and beauty with the deadly ferocity to ensure the safe passage of her precious cargo.

The Battleship Yamaguchi is a Kusari Naval Forces battleship with a storied history. Constructed after the Nomad War, it participated in the Kusari Empire's invasion of Bretonia in the early 810s where it captured Stokes Mining Station. It would then go on to see action against the Gallic Royal Navy as part of the Kusari forces that became stranded in Leeds after the initial Gallic invasion of the Tau systems in 818. From there, it fought its way out of Bretonia and through the Border Worlds together with the Nagasaki fleet and the assistance of the Council on their voyage home.

During the early 820s, the Yamaguchi was one of the principal battleships of the Imperialist forces during the Kusari Civil War that fought against the Republic of Kusari established in the Emperor's absence. Following the conclusion of the civil war in 825 AS, the battleship was deployed to Honshu in a new conflict against Rheinland caused by a diplomatic incident near the disputed Planet Saigon in the Sigma-59 system. The emergence of social instability back in Rheinland during the Second Sigma Conflict however caused Rheinland to abort their offensive into Honshu, and resulted in a status quo peace treaty before the Yamaguchi could be deployed in a counteroffensive.

Following the completion of the Honshu gate in Sigma-59, the Battleship was relocated inside the Honshu system. There she continues to maintain overwatch over the systems of Kusari's eastern border, primarily concerned with the activities of Rheinland in the region as well as the Corsairs.

1117952.text:
Kinkaku-ji Station was constructed in 826 AS, as a shrine dedicated to the founder of the Golden Chrysanthemums - Yuyu Matsuda, and the patron goddess of the movement - Amaterasu. The shrine itself is located in the central biodome, where artificial sunlight basks the gardens and the Heian-era architecture. Restricted areas include a Cardamine-laced atmosphere.
What first started as a small religious outpost, quickly grew as smugglers found their way to the station and bargained aboard. The Golden Chrysanthemums built around the main biodome to accommodate the increased traffic. While the shrine remained off-limits to most visitors, a lively market of Cardamine, arms-deals, and human male trafficking began to flourish. Pure Gold is imported at a hefty price by virtue of the insatiable desire to fashion gleaming, customary ornaments.
The Golden Chrysanthemums recognized and utilized the funds generated by their smuggling operations, and made the first steps towards converting Kinkaku-ji into a shipyard. Initially, it could only produce snubcraft, but with Outcast assistance, the shipyard was expanded to facilitate gunboats. In 828 AS, the drydocks developed further, attaining the ability to maintain and repair cruiser class vessels.

1117979.text:
B2 "Pytho" IMG bomber

As each progressive stake exhausted itself and house corporations continued to expand on their heels, the men and women of the IMG were made to venture deeper afield, pushing into wild and remote systems of the borderworlds to seek the fortunes that sustained their way of life. Some worried that they might have dug too greedily, and too deep.

Within the Taus the IMG encountered the Outcasts, whom they were ill equipped to face. Their mining ships were prepared to repel the stings of borderworld brigands, but the warships brought down upon their freighters and space superiority fighters took a heavy toll in life during some of the bloodiest years in the history of the guild.

Wrought from those lessons, and upon the design experience garnered from the development of the Nyx, is the Pytho. A monstrously powerful assault bomber capable of slipping amongst cluttered asteroids with grace and finesse to bring down murderous ruin upon the cumbersome capital vessels of their foes.

The Armored Transport has long been considered the ultimate private yacht, a ship designed around transporting a very few people in high security or luxury, and has an incredibly large amount of armor and firepower packed into its reasonably small package, which often guarantees safe flights for its passengers. Internally, Armored Transports have two distinct patterns: Luxury transportation, carrying VIPs to corporate or military meetings, or secure prisoner transports, for moving the very most dangerous of Sirius's criminals to secure prison locations.

1117987.text:
HFX-F2B "Broadsword" Lane Hacker Bomber

While technically the second ship of the HFX line, the Broadsword class is in all actuality a pair of cunningly designed self contained power generators developed for modular mounting upon the light frame of the Falchion. Whereas lesser bomber designs require the development of entirely new frames, which results in even more time and resources spent on development, the Broadsword pods contain sympathetic thrust and attitude mechanisms that respond in time with the movements of her mother ship and provide excessive power which is used to support Bomber class weaponry.

This next-generation ship is finetuned for frantic combat situations and high-speed strikes against all opposition the Lane Hackers might face on the battlefield, a role in which it excels more than the venerable "Falcata" Bomber. Similar to the Falchion however, the Broadsword class has retained a large part of the very sensitive internal components and is even more costly to maintain. Aside from those costs, a further turn-off might be the very limited cargo hold, which makes this ship even less attractive to all kinds of freelance Pirates. Nevertheless, if there's a target that needs a good dose of "shotgun diplomacy", the Broadsword is the Lane Hackers' first choice.

1117989.text:
AR-102 BHG Battleship Turret
Designed by technicians in the pay of the bounty hunters, this turret is specifically tailored for the bounty hunter battleship. Recognising the need for anti-bomber protection, this turret boasts a high speed, but a comparatively low firepower and range. Fire from this cannon is ineffective against capital ship armor compared to its primary cousin, but it has proven to be much more effective at targeting and destroying small attack vessels.

Built upon the same spaceframe as the Rhino Freighter, the Grizzly was developed to serve as an armed and armored transport for critical personal within the Liberty government. From flag officers to government contractors the Grizzly provides the hardened transport necessary to ferry critical minds to critical locations.

1118016.text: The Council gunboat that was disabled in the battle for the Languedoc Jump Gate. While the Council attempts to recover and repair as many disabled capital ships as possible, the hull of this gunboat is damaged too heavily and is no longer suitable for re-pressurizing.

1118018.text: Dague is a Royal Police ship destroyed in a surprise attack of the Gallic Brigands in the beginning of 733 AGS. Brigands are known for their exceptional hatred for the Police, and none of the ships belonging to the same patrol survived. Dague was not destroyed after its pilot was killed, and Brigands chose to leave it as a reminder and a warning to any other lawfuls who might venture into their territory.

1118020.text: Disabled by a precise hostile missile hit sometime in 731 AGS, the Tenace slowly drifted into the nearby Longwy Asteroid Field. The ship was on a classified Royal Navy mission, and its escort was scattered by the attacking Maquis and could not retrieve the pilot.

1118022.text: Royal Navy's heavy fighter that was stripped of all weaponry while defending the Lorraine Mine Field and attempted to flee to Languedoc. Brigands were faster and overtook the ship in the Lozere Asteroid Field.

1118024.text: Nievre asteroid field is considered one of the most dangerous places in all Gallia by GRN pilots. The Brave was part of a reconnaissance mission sent within this field. The ship was surrounded by the Council fighters and disabled by weapon fire. Fate of the pilot is unknown.

1118026.text: Sceptre is the Gallic Royal Navy bomber that was damaged near Montelimar Station and attempted to retreat towards the mine field. Chased by two Council light fighters, it was able to destroy one of them by turret fire, while the second damaged its steering contros. The ship got too near the mine field, and nearby mine explosion killed the pilot. Ship hull remained intact and may still hold some valuable equipment.

1118028.text: This IDF freighter was part of the convoy travelling through the Trade Lane in 732 AGS. The lane was disrupted by Gallic Brigands, and Pomone was the only ship to escape the fight... which, however, did not save the ship's crew. Left in open space without fuel, with damaged communication devices and life support, Pomone still holds whatever riches it was carrying to the Gallic Core Worlds.

1118030.text: Maurice once belonged to a Gallic freelancer, Olivier Monnerville, who was supplying Lixheim Base with various rare goods from the Core Worlds. At one point, the freelancer did not return from his route to Lixheim. It is rumored that Olivier attempted to dictate higher prices for the cargo he carried due to the war breaking out in the Gallic Border Worlds, and that Junker dealers were not too pleased about his offer.

1118032.text: A heavy fighter that once belonged to an overly self-confident EFL pilot, the Superbe broke off its convoy to chase a fleeing Corse light fighter. The chase led him into the vasts of the Cote-d'Or Asteroid Field, from which he never returned.

1118034.text: Gerfaud was a Royal Police fighter lost in 731 AGS in a fight with the Council ships not far from the Le Thillot Asteroid Field. Fate of its pilot remains unknown.

1118036.text: Flamand is the heavy fighter of the Council that was disabled in the battle not far from the Burgundy Jump Gate in Languedoc. Its remnants are supposed to be located somewhere on the edge of the Nyons Asteroid Field.

1118038.text: Boree was a Council Heavy Fighter severely damaged in one of the battles for Languedoc in 731 AGS. Pilot escaped and was rescued by a Council patrol, but the ship drifted away to the outskirts of Lozere Asteroid Field.

1118040.text: Dignite was part of a group of five fighters that were the first Council ships to enter the Omicron Tau system. Three of those ships were damaged in an occasional mine explosion, they were losing pressure and headed directly to the nearby space station in order to receive urgent help and repairs. The station was the Outcasts' installation, the Genoa Base. Due to communication synchronization issue, the Council pilots misinterpreted the Outcast commands and entered the safety zone of the base. Outcasts opened fire without giving the newcomers a chance to explain what was going on. After a brief fight in which the Council ships were both outnumbered and outgunned, most of them were destroyed, while severely damaged Dignite attempted to escape and got lost in the surrounding dust field.

1118042.text: A Council bomber trapped in the confines of the Tille Debris Field. The bomber was part of the Council raiding party tasked to attack a Royal Navy cruiser heading to reinforce the Navy group near the Champagne Jump Gate. The cruiser, however, had more escort fighters than the Council intelligence predicted, and Destin had to retreat to the nearby debris field. Cruise engine breaks have failed, and the bomber hit a large piece of debris at full speed. Severely injured pilot was later rescued by other Council ships.

1118044.text: In 732 AGS, Invincible participated in an operation to distract the Royal Navy forces from advancing into Languedoc. In a daring assault against the Dijon Station, Invincible and accompanying ships destroyed several dozens of Police and Navy fighters until capital ship reinforcements could arrive from Nevers. While Invincible could fight back the Navy gunboats, its hull was severely damaged, and it had to retreat to the nearby debris field. Remaining fighters of the Council covered the retreat, and the crew of the gunboat was saved. Hull of Invincible will remain stuck inside the Genlis Debris Field until Junkers who clear the field will be able to retrieve it.

1118046.text: A light fighter of the Gallic Brigands that never returned from a long-range reconnaissance mission.

1118048.text: Saphir is a Unione Corse light fighter that was attacked and damaged by an unidentified enemy shortly after the mine paths within the Lorraine Mine Field had been completed by the Council. Its hull is supposed to remain somewhere within the Sarre Nebula.

1118050.text: Corse heavy fighter with a notorious reputation, the Minerve was crippled in a fight with a Gallic freelancer Rober Gravois employed by the Gallic Metal Service in 732 AGS. The freelancer hoped to return to the base and receive the bounty, but other Unione Corse ships caught up with him on his way to the Jump Gate.

1118052.text: When the rumors of Emile Bartoli's death in Champagne reached the Brigands whom he knew, his friend Sophie Bouvier collected a few of her mates and went on a mission to revenge upon the Unione Corse. Quenza was part of the first Corse patrol they encountered after entering the Autun Nebula in Burgundy. The Brigands approached Corse ships close-range and opened fire unexpectedly, killing all pilots before they could report back to their base. Trophy Royal Police weapons were used so that no one would be able to identify the attackers. Satisfied with the outcome, Sophie returned to Valence triumphant.

1118054.text: One of the few bombers in the service of the Unione Corse, the Danae was damaged in a surprise attack of the Royal Navy patrol. The Corse had been searching for the ship and its pilot for several years, but the efforts proved fruitless, and by 732 AGS they stopped trying.

1118056.text: Being one of the few gunboats owned by the Gallic Brigands, the Revanche was disabled by the Gallic Navy bombers in 733 AGS. It was hit by over a dozen torpedoes before Brigands' reinforcements arrived on the site of the attack. Few survivors from the gunboat's crew were saved, but the hull was damaged beyond repair and remained within the Isere Dust Cloud.

1118058.text: Pelican, a L'Ane class transport belonging to the Maquis, was on its usual route from Lavars to Limoux when a group of Navy reconnaissance ships attacked and disabled it. The communication devices and engine of the ship were severely damaged, and it drifted to the edge of the Herault Asteroid Field devoid of power and life support.

1118060.text: The Maquis light fighter named Fendant was lost in the Herault Asteroid Field in 732 AGS. In his last communication with the base, its pilot reported that he is surrounded by Navy ships and has no chance to escape.

1118062.text: Flamaran was a heavy fighter belonging to the Maquis. Its pilot was killed by an occasional shot in a fight with Royal Navy, and the ship drifted into the confines of the Saint-Remy Nebula located within the Nievre Asteroid Field.

1118064.text: Owner of this civilian fighter was an experienced freelancer named Rober Gravois who mainly worked for the Gallic Metal Service. In 732 AGS, Gravois had been tasked to destroy Minerve and kill its pilot, a notorious Corse who has organized a number of successful attacks against GMS convoys in Languedoc and Burgundy. After successfully completing the mission, he was headed towards the Jump Gate to escape to the Core Worlds and receive his bounty. However, other Unione Corse ships overtook his fighter, Levrette, disabled it and brought the desperate freelancer to Montelimar Base where he was cruelly tortured to death.

1118066.text: A Maquis freighter that was carrying cargo from Verdun to Montbard and never completed its mission. The ships of its escort were destroyed by hostile fire, possibly by Royal Navy, and the hull of the freighter itself had never been found.

1118068.text: This Deep Space Exploration train was on its usual route from Minnesota to Texas when a group of Rogues attacked its convoy. The escort fought bravely but was defeated, and remaining Rogues had to retreat. The ship with disabled engine and failing life support drifted away into the depths of the Lamberton Ice Field.

1118070.text: This Molly freighter was carrying contraband on a long-range trade mission to Newcastle. However, pilots of his escort suddenly demanded higher payments to compensate "the dangers of war going on in Dundee". Owner of the freighter disagreed, and his escort fired at the ship's engines, boarded the ship, killed everyone inside and took all cargo they could carry away. The treachery was uncovered, and the Mollys who commited the crime were executed on Belfast, but they never revealed the location of the lost freighter.

1118072.text: Fubuki was a very heavy fighter of the Kusari Naval Forces. Its pilot was daring enough to engage a lone Bretonia Gunboat in a group of two - and while his teammate was killed in a matter of seconds, Fubuki survived for much longer and was able to damage most of the gunboat's key systems. However, the remaining firepower of the gunboat was enough to destroy the fighter's engine and leave it drifting towards the outer reaches of the Tau-31 system.

1118074.text: This gunboat of the Bretonia Navy was heavily damaged in a fight with several Kusari Bombers. While the ship was trapped within the Falkirk Asteroid Field, those few crewmembers who survived the assault were rescued by Mollys from the nearby base.

1118076.text: Breslau was on patrol duty within the Westerstede Nebula when its patrol encountered a group of Liberty reconnaissance ships. While other ships on his patrol escaped, pilot of the Breslau attempted to fight the intruders, and his ship was disabled by hostile fire. Fate of the pilot is unknown.

1118078.text: Grafton was a Liberty Navy reconnaissance craft tasked to collect intelligence on the Rheinland military buildup in the Bremen system. The ship was damaged in a fight with a daring Bundshuh who engaged him and two other Liberty ships alone, and then became an easy prey for the local Rheinland Military patrol.

1118079.text:
Large Train

The flexible backbone of every trading concern, the Large Train has performed the role of efficient and able commercial envoy for centuries. Without the cumbersome demands of her larger sister nor the humble performance of her juniors, the train encompass' the perfect balance of nimble freight, efficiency and reliability, with the fortitude of hull and spirit to ensure that the goods are delivered on time, every time.

1118081.text: A nebula located in a desolate region of the Chester system. Was never explored; strong emission from within the field suggest that entering it may be dangerous for unshielded vessels.
