1121669.text:
WG-94 RSM Defense Grid

The WG-94 Rolling Spaceframe Missile Defense Grid, colloquially known as the "Hedgehog," is an experimental weapon employed aboard the LSF Battlecruiser "Willow Grove." The complete Hedgehog system consists of a septet of launch pods taking the place of the typical small-craft defensive turrets, designed to fire the WG-94 RSM. Each missile is slaved to the TGH-77 targeting and guidance computer mounted deep within the bowels of the Battlecruiser

The WG-94 itself is a very simple munition, consisting of little more than the shell of a CD98Rc disruptor missile with the bulky guidance computer and disruption package replaced with a miniaturized transmitter and EMP warhead. 40 rockets are contained in each quick-detach launcher, allowing for rapid restocking of the system following depletion. Designed to be controlled remotely by the mother craft, the WG-94 RSM is fast-moving and difficult to intercept or evade.

Within the Willow Grove is the TGH-77 Targeting and Guidance Handling computer. Designed to simultaneously compute trajectories and targeting information for up to 21 WG-94 missiles, the TGH requires huge amounts of power when activated. Slaved to the sensor grid of the ship, the "brainbox," as it is known, calculates optimum intercept courses and transmits the information to the missiles up until the moment of impact. This system allows for extreme miniaturization of the WG-94, without sacrificing tracking ability or payload.

Together, the "Hedgehog" is a deadly weapon against enemy bombers and fighters, stripping them of their shielding and draining powercore, while still applying modest hull damage. The project was abandoned, however, after a number of design issues became clear. The WG-94 proved woefully inadequate at damaging gunships and cruisers, and the reliance on physical ammunition prevented extended sorties into unfriendly space.

1122671.text: While factions usually provide the necessary learning environments to their pilots, there are those who would much rather not commit to any one particular cause and make their own way through Sirius. For those people, skill can be bought. Valley Forge Flight School is the largest such institution in Liberty. Owned and operated by Interspace Commerce, the company uses it both as a means to generate revenue and to search for potential candiates to join the company's security wings.

1122673.text:
ICE ASTEROID

Dihydrogen monoxide (H2O) is odorless, tasteless, transparent, and absolutely essential to human life. Roughly 75% of the human body is composed of Water. Deprived of Water, most humans can only live three days. The process of dehydration is a painful one, as tissues shrivel and vessels shrink in a desperate bid by the dying body to preserve its remaining vital functions.

1122674.text: Another perk of this base that may not be entirely obvious is that it's in a good spot for moving goods to and from Rheinland. Folk who don't mind crossing the Rheinland lawfuls can bring in Blood Diamonds or Black Market Munitions from the Hessians. If you plan on visiting them, take some Gold to them. But be aware, the 'Sairs will space you any chance they get.

1122675.text: I just got here from Arranmore. Used to be a miner. Now I got me a Greyhound with some right powerful blasters. Gonna mine me some Bowex knuckleheads once I find a good group to join up with. If you're gonna hit the lanes, it's folly to go alone.

1122676.text: BMM recently moved into the system. Built themselves a small base on the far side of the sun. Suppose we'll have to pay them a visit every now and then - when we're in need of construction materials. Slightly charred construction materials. Heh.

1122677.text: The Norfolk ain't that much of a problem for us. Sure, you'd be mad to get in range of those guns, but ships like that are vulnerable inside the ice clouds. Besides, ever since Hood the Armed Forces learned not to shove their battleships inside a Arranmore Asteroid Field. If need be we'll teach them that lesson again.

1122678.text: The Cardiff Beryllium field wasn't the only one that got missed in the BMM survey. Those guys must have really been sleeping at the time. There is a huge Beryllium-rich asteroid field north of planet Cambridge. While the Cardiff field is ours, the field north of the planet is too large to lay an individual stake to. It's only a matter of time before BMM starts mining there.

1122679.text: BMM has opened its own Beryllium mining facility in Cambridge recently. I suppose it was only a matter of time after they lost their Tau operations. We didn't try to lobby against it, it would have been futile to do so. Besides, their operation is still being built, while ours is a tried-and-true one. It'll be months before that base of theirs can produce Beryllium in bulk.

1122680.text: Our partner ALG requires a lot of Beryllium. They reprocess spent MOX and build canisters to store hazardous radioactive waste. Beryllium absorbs radiation, so any storage and transport containers for that kind of material tend to have a layer of Beryllium as a radiation shield. Reactors and Engine Components use Beryllium in the same way.

1122805.text:
CLASS: Toitsu
CREW: N/A
ARMAMENT: N/A

One of the frontrunners of the Toitsu class, the Hyono deployed from Kure Shipyard in 825 AS, shortly before the Saigon War with Rheinland. Following the destruction of Ibusuki Survey Platform in Sigma-21, the Hyono fleet was dispatched to aid the Gas Miners Guild against the Rheinland Military. While her expanded hangar bays initially allowed generous strike wings to contest Planet Saigon, the tide dramatically turned with the arrival of Rheinland reinforcements. By exploiting Sigma-21's open space, the Bayern and Westfalen fleets forced their enemies to fight on unfavorable terms, inflicting heavy casualties. The Hyono was damaged during the 826 AS rout back to Honshu, where it regrouped to rally a defense.

Using the cover of Honshu's Hiryo Cloud, the Hyono and other KNF elements succeeded in holding the Rheinland fleets at bay, while severing their Sigma-21 supply lines. Following the war's end, the battleship was sent for extensive repairs and refits at Kure Shipyard. Its next assignment in 827 AS shocked Sirius, when a significant Kusari military buildup along the Tau borders was justified as a dispute with the Crayter Republic. While the KNF did then expel the Reublic from Tau-31, this was a pretext for maneuvering their fleets closer to the Gallic border to launch a surprise invasion. As a result, Gallic Confederal forces were taken by surprise when the Hyono, Nagasaki, and Yamaguchi fleets swung north into Tau-23.

The Kusari fleet rapidly scattered the local Tau garrison and destroyed Cheronsee Outpost, to avoid a time-consuming boarding attempt. Breaching the Languedoc Jump Gate, the Hyono was met by the Battleship Cassard, which was heavily damaged and driven off. The Hyono then advanced with the Nagasaki alongside the Trade Lanes, and was responsible for disabling Nimes Station while the Nagasaki destroyed Quillan's spaceports. It later participated in the Battles of Ales, scuttling Fourchambalt Shipyard late in the year when the joint Confederal-Enclave counter-offensive was launched. The Hyono was eventually lost while retreating back towards the Taus, falling to the Warwolf cannon of the Enclave's Battleship Rocroi.

1122807.text:
In many ways similar to its now dismantled sister station of Montpellier in Languedoc, Luneville was built to maintain and secure the mines that surround jump hole leading into the dangerous Outcast space. By the time the Outcasts themselves arrived, the mine field was already in place. Having no means to penetrate it, the Outcasts simply avoided the area, establishing Genoa base in Tau-37 to keep watch over their side of the field.

Unaware of what lay on the other side, the minefield was eventually breached in 817 AS by a surprise Council strike from Lorraine. Their method was as crude as it was effective: A large engine salvaged from a derelict Navy cruiser was grafted onto a dense asteroid in the Sarre nebula. While Council and Maquis raiders distracted the bulk of the GRN's Lorraine forces with a diversionary attack on Metz, this asteroid was sent straight into the center of the minefield. This unconventional attack succeeded, creating a wide path through the mines all the way into Tau-37. Starved of reinforcements, the Luneville defenders were unable to restore the minefield. The Council later came to regret this as the Outcasts arrived, first in a trickle, then a wave that Gallia, in the midst of its civil war, was powerless to stop.

Supply lines to Luneville have been reinforced by the newly repaired and combat ready Epinal, but efforts to restore the minefield have so far proven futile. This is due not only to near constant Outcast strikes on the base, but Maquis attacks as well. Although the Maquis have no love for the Maltese, it seems the continued presence of the Outcast raiders in Lorraine and Burgundy taxes the Duchy greatly, something the Maquis have a vested interest in.

The biggest threat to the facility would come from not the Outcasts, but the Kusari Navy, which invaded Lorraine in mid 827. As a military facility, it was deemed an acceptable target for the KNF, and the station was subsequently captured. The station would eventually be scuttled with all other bases in Lorraine as the KNF left the system.

1122846.text:
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED***
Magnetic and gravimetric readings are consistent with a Jump Hole -- a natural phenomenon that functions similar to a Jump Gate, though the hazards associated with traveling through a Jump Hole remain largely unknown. Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.

1122848.text:
Vandoeuvres was built in 429 AGS by Tannier Industries as one of the more remote space colonies in Gallic space. Circa 610 AGS, when Tannier was restructured, the site was purchased by Ile-de-France Shipping under Crown permission. Before the IDF transfer, the facility was not prospering. It reached less than half its maxium housing capacity, and the station was notorious for a high unemployment rate and poor accommodations.

IDF dismissed most of the crew and moved the inhabitants to temporary housing on Metz. The station's structure was renewed and expanded with new habitats. In 619 AGS, Vandoeuvres was re-opened for settlers, becoming one of the more convenient and affordable space settlements in Gallic space. Vandoeuvres lies away from major trade routes and areas of pirate activity, making the colony very safe and calm to live in. The facility does not have any notable industrial capacity, but it is almost fully self-sufficient, with hydroponic farms and food production available to serve the colonists' needs. The station also produces a wide array of Luxury Consumer Goods, most of which are exported to other stations and planets by IDF and their partners, allowing the station's residents to enjoy a comfortable middle class income. Currently, most of the station's crew is employed by IDF, although it is technically administrated by the Gendarmerie.

Due to the station's food production capabilities, Vandoeuvres has been pressed into the unusual role of ad hoc breadbasket to Metz and Nevers, where agriculture is difficult. This is expected to be a temporary measure, as the Grand Duchy enacts plans for expanded agricultural projects, including more greenhouses on Metz and floating farms on Nevers.

Following an evacuation ordered by the occupying Kusari Forces. the station was scuttled with all other bases in the system. The loss of the space colony has potential ramifications for Metz, as it was a large source of food for the planet.

1122850.text:
Chateau Salins was built in 768 AS, at the time when pirate activity in Lorraine was already on the rise. Originally designed to harvest rare minerals from the volcanic world it orbits, the Marne Rebellion reduced activity on the station to a near standstill. It served as a makeshift shipyard during the Second Gallic Civil War, maintaining Navy fighters and various civilian craft that run supplies to and from Metz.

Given the extravagent cost of harvesting minerals from the scorching Planet Mirecourt as well as increased terrorist and pirate activity in the Lorraine system, the station was passed on to the Gendarmerie. It is currently used as their HQ in Lorraine, but the station itself is woefully undergunned and is frequently the target of heavy Maquis attack, often requiring reinforcement from the Epinal's airwing.

Following an evacuation ordered by the occupying Kusari Forces. the station was scuttled with all other bases in the system.

1122852.text:
Saint-Exupery's construction was completed in 551 AGS. It replaced a base named Oullins that previously served as a transit point for some of the shipments going to and from Lorraine. Over time, the need for a shipping platform in Metz's orbit was no longer present. Bouvet Space Entertainment chose the location to build the off-world base of operations for their cruise liner fleet, and chose Solar Engineering to build and administer the station. Since then, Bouvet's presence was reduced to a necessary minimum, and Solar used the station for a wide array of services, including short term off-world recreation, ship-to-ship transfers, and storage of valuable or hazardous cargo that is not allowed planetside. With the Crown-sanctioned merger of Solar's assets, newly administrating EFL Oil & Machinery used the station in much the same role.

This has changed with the advent of the Grand Duchy. The station has grown in importance as Grand Duke Valentin Trintignant pledged his support to the OREF, or Office Royal des Eaux et Forets, and their terraforming project on Metz. If the increased traffic to Saint-Exupery is any indication, the Grand Duke has kept his word. Supplies for the Metz Mirror Array arrive weekly, and Saint-Exupery is exclusively responsible for their assembly, a contract which EFL has made no effort to hide their pride in.

Following the invasion by Kusari, the base, while not directly assaulted, was forced to lock down all access to the facility, with the majority of the crew disembarked and landed on Metz. The station would subsequently be scuttled with all other bases in the system by Kusari.

1122854.text:
Montigny is a relatively large shipping platform built by IDF Shipping in 486 AGS. Montigny's location was previously occupied by a smaller station, serving as a transit point for shipments to the colonists on Metz and Vandoeuvres Space Colony. In about 480 AGS, trade lanes were built around Lorraine, and a new type of shipping station was necessary. IDF got the contract and built the station in less than eight months.

Montigny was refurbished several times, the last time in 677 AGS. Unlike some of the other shipping platforms, the amount of cargo handled by this facility did not decline due to the increased fuel capacity of modern transport vessels that usually do not need any refueling points between their port of origin and destination. A large share of the local shipments are processed by local companies and independent traders who often use Montigny to exchange goods and store large amounts of cargo delivered by larger companies, a role that has become more prominent now that ships from Kusari have also begun to use the facility as a transfer point.

The facility, following the occupation of Lorraine by the KNF in the early stages of the Gallic-Kusari War, suffered numerous strayordinance impacts, with several components of the station decoupling as a result. Kusari insists damage to the station was not intentional, and the station has been left alone. The crew of the base was subsequently evacuated and all docking ports locked down. The station would be scuttled following the evacuation of Kusari forces from the system.

1122856.text:
The Roanne facility was initially a prominent mining station built by Gallic Metal Service in 392 AGS. At that time it was the largest and most technologically advanced mining base in Gallic space. Over the space of a century however, the Longwy asteroid field was slowly mined out. In 594 AGS, mineable areas of the surrounding field were almost completely depleted, and GMS made the decision to convert Roanne into a large production center with habitats for numerous factories and workers. The construction was personally overseen by one of the most famed GMS directors, Eugene Arquette, who spent most of his life on the station. After Arquette's death, the class designation of the station was officially changed to his name. Over time, Roanne became the primary off-world headquarters of the Gallic Metal Service. It is a tradition that the chief executive of the company spends at least one third of each year onboard the station, personally overseeing the production process.

In the surprise invasion by Kusari, the base found itself in the firing line, its large vertical design proving vulnerable to explosives used in the fighting around the facility between the KNF and retreating Confederacy forces. In light of the damage the base received and the occupation of Lorraine by Kusari, the base, like many others in the system, was abandoned except for a small crew, and docking was removed. The station would like all others in the system, be scuttled by Kusari to increase the econmic damage inflicted on the rival house.

The LD-14 Uranium Processing Center (or LD-14 for short) was a vital supplier of MOX to the colonies of Sirius, and a significant source of revenue for the Bretonian government. Extremely harsh working conditions were ignored by many who went to work for the BMM operation, as the hazard pay offered was simply too good to ignore. LD-14 was eventually significantly damaged during the Gallic occupation of Leeds, and the minimally-operational facility was used as little more than a Gallic listening post.

LD-14 was scuttled by the retreating Gallic forces alongside Glasgow and Stokes, though its remote location and minimal crew meant that the effort was half-hearted in comparison. Its relatively good condition and economic importance to Bretonia made LD-14's reconstruction a top priority. The Uranium Processing Center reached operational capacity once more in 832 A.S., just in time to relieve Bretonia's extreme fuel pressures and budgetary woes.

1122875.text:
Gap Station, orbiting Planet Aude, served as the administrative capital for the Languedoc system, a role it was not designed to perform.

Its unremarkable exterior masked Gap's pivotal political role in contemporary Gallia. During the Second Gallic Civil War, it was the theatre of a violent ground battle between the defending Royal army and the attacking Council marines. The fight lead to a decisive, if costly, Royal victory. In a rare display of anger, the Council retreated and turned the heavy weapons of its orbiting warships on the station's various points of ingress to try and depressurise it. They were only partially successful due to the Guillestre battlegroup's timely arrival to chase the Council fleet as the station's engineers managed to weld the breaches shut.

This event scarred the Languedoc population, historically favourable to the otherwise publicly clean-handed Council. It was a rare act of violence against non-combatants on their part, and the matter has always been dodged by their authorities, putting the blame on misinterpreted orders. The truth remained unknown and Gap station remained in service for many more years.

Gap Station would later on become one of the casualties of the Kusari War, falling in the second battle of Languedoc.

1123014.text:
Station Glorious was once a Bretonia Mining & Manufacturing outpost, seized by dissident miners during the Founders Day Revolt of 752 AS. A furious Armed Forces response followed, as Bretonian destroyers pursued the newly formed Mollys into what would later become known as the Hood Asteroid Field. In their first major victory, the Destroyer Longfield was blown in half by a mining charge, establishing the movement as a credible threat. The Glorious was quickly abandoned by the Mollys in favor of more permanent arrangements elsewhere, however squatters took residence soon after.

The station changed hands several times over the decades, rotating between independent gangs and wildcat miners who would later repressurize The Hood under the flag of the Independent Miners Guild. The Glorious came under attack by Rheinland forces in 800 AS, during the chaos and confusion of the Colony Wars. Gutted by fire and explosions, the facility remained an abandoned husk until 831 AS. Since then, Corsairs have taken up position nearby and begun using the station's broken shell as a rallying point and a stockpile for imported supplies and stolen cargo.

1123016.text: The Palmyra Hole offers a large respite from an otherwise asteroid rich system. Due to the open nature of the area, the hole is frequented by both Order and Core ships looking to enter the deeper Nomad worlds, often resulting in violent encounters.

1123023.text:
Soon after the Hellfire Legion's formation it became clear that new pilots would need to be recruited from the Liberty population if the movement was to continue to conduct combat operations. A location was required to train these applicants and filter out the inevitable security risks posed by infiltrators.

The remote Kansas system was chosen as a destination for such an installation, resulting in the excavation of a large asteroid in the strategic field. Fort Riley's dense rocky shell serves as excellent protection for those living at the base. Fort Riley's primary facilities cater to the manufacturing and maintenance of fighters and other small craft, usually working independently of the production lines on Fort Leniex.

Long tasked with defending the Commonwealth's civilian assets in Kansas, Fort Riley, then named Monterrey, had a much stronger attachment to the Commonwealth than the forces in Vespucci. When the Insurgency arrived in Vespucci, Fort Riley quickly dispatched its squadrons to assist the Ravager in the defense of the Commonwealth. Ultimately they were too late to make a difference; Ravager had already fallen by the time Fort Riley's reinforcements arrived.

The Insurgency turned its guns on the remaining defenders of the Commonwealth, and fought them back to Fort Riley itself. Boarding action ensued, resulting in the Insurgency securing Monterrey and ending the uprising. Training operations aboard Fort Riley have since resumed at a frantic pace, with the Insurgency expediting field deployments to refill its depleted ranks.

In response to a sizable incursion of ships belonging to the Bretonian Armed Forces, Riley was ordered to have its garrison consolidate with Vespucci's defenders and fight them back. It followed through with these orders without delay, and as a result swayed the fight in the Insurgency's favor. It was however unable to prevent Mulvane's destruction, as fighting and logistical issues delayed any plans for relieving the besieged outpost.

With Mulvane destroyed, and its garrison battered, Riley faces a precarious situation - the Battleship Delaware

Despite its secluded reputation Fortaleza was frequently used by raiding parties striking targets in both Kansas and the nearby Texas system.

1123043.text: MANHATTAN -- 830 AS -- Derek Eska, a particularly infamous criminal whom at one point in Liberty's history held significant influence in the Rogues. His legacy of rampant plundering and extortion across the House ended abruptly over two decades ago, but now it appears as if the former pack leader has resurfaced, based on a recent press conference held by the LPI regarding the sharp rise in organized crime. The Bounty Hunters Guild listings also seem to cite the long-presumed dead man as a priority target, even above others whose warrants have remained outstanding. Despite this, the authorities have issued repeated assurances that there is no cause for alarm.

1123044.text: [831 AS] Core of an old problem

1123045.text: MANHATTAN -- 831 AS -- After a recent leak by an undisclosed source claiming to have loose ties to the Liberty Security Force, Congress has been sent into furious debate following intense public uproar, all in response to allegations that the Core has cooperated with the loathsome Outcasts. These allegations come as a shock and have significantly impacted the investment climate, leading many to reconsider Core stocks as an addition to their portfolios. While the investigation is as of yet inconclusive in its findings, analysts believe that values may not reach their historic peaks again as a consequence of this potential breach of trust.

1123047.text: ARRANMORE -- 832 AS -- Graves is now exactly what its namesake implies and we forced the last major element of the Armed Forces in Dublin all the way back to New London. Our brave fighters made sure that the gate can never serve as a means for Bretonia to come back and stomp around, not when this prize is ours. It seems the Corsairs are yet to realize that, and are actively trying to drive us out and take the spoils this place has to offer for themselves. It looks like our aces will be adding a lot more trophies to their collections.

1123051.text: The Lambda nebula found in Newcastle mirrors the barrier nebula present on the opposite end of the system. Lambda nebulae are notorious for unstable conditions and travelers are warned against extended stays within, and the one present in Newcastle is no exception. Planetform have set out to mine the gases trapped deep within the asteroids found in the field that has developed within the nebula for valuable terraforming gases, but the perilous conditions and attention of local Gaians makes for a difficult working conditions.

1123053.text:
Upon the discovery of Omega-55 by Rheinland explorers in 798 AS, the desire to unearth valuable artifacts, minerals, and other resources led the lawful forces to enlist Bounty Hunters as additional security for ventures into the vast, perilous unknown of the deeper Omegas. Financed by Rheinland, Rostock was constructed in 803 AS as a central hub for bounty hunters seeking high-risk, high-reward contracts far beyond the usual missions in House space.

As the hunters soon discovered, the presence of various criminal factions such as the Corsairs and the Red Hessians quickly made Rostock a vital gathering point for bounty hunters operating in the Omegas. However, in 820 AS, Rheinland abandoned the system due to financial strains and its ongoing war with Liberty. Without their primary financier, the Bounty Hunters Guild was forced to vacate Rostock. Before leaving, they dismantled the station to prevent it from becoming a safe haven for criminal factions.

1123059.text: The Hammersee Arch, nestled on the dark side of the Hammersee moon, demonstrates once again that Rheinland is unmatched in spacial engineering projects. Building on the experience and technology developed from the Ring project that surrounds New Berlin, was developed to counter the unique features of Sigma-15 and its overly active star. To avoid the blistering radiation, the Hammersee Arch constantly adjusts its position to maintain a favorable orbit. Aside from the docking ring and mooring fixtures, Mecklenburg Prison makes use of the close orbit position to transfer prisoners to and from the planet.

1123061.text:
>>>WARNING: SEVERE DANGER<<<
Halligen is the name given to the immediate vicinity of the Sigma-15 star. The solar radiation in this region is deadly, and without the protection of the thick asteroid fields and planets, Hammersee, Saigon, and the wider system would suffer from the negative effects of the radiation within Halligen.

1123063.text: Due to its location on the other side of Sigma-15's star, Pellworm field has yet to be charted. However, the field is plagued by significant radiation damage and the frequent raids staged by the Corsairs. Rheinland has not deployed any forces to Pellworm, considering it an unfruitful venture that is also in danger of destruction from either outlawed groups or the star's extreme radiation.

1123065.text: Norddorf is the smallest of the three asteroid fields in the system and has no valuable resources. However, its value lies in its positioning, as the dense asteroid field absorbs much of the radiation that would normally reach Saigon.

1123067.text:
Alesia gained importance during the early stages of Gallic development as a mining facility devoted to exploiting the Morvan Asteroid Field, however as the valuable resources found within dried out and the GMS focused their efforts to newly discovered systems, Alesia became a pointless station within Burgundy and was subsequently abandoned, what is left of the base decayed into the hulk of scrap metal that it is today.

The former location of the mining facility is often frequented by raiders looking to jump on unsuspecting traders using the junction.

1123068.text:
>>>WARNING: Docking Suspended<<<
In the early years of the Kusari Empire, foreign immigration was strictly controlled and permanent foreign settlements on New Tokyo were strictly forbidden. While the Kusari Shogunate was unwilling to bend these rules, it still accommodated foreign business interests by allowing Interspace Commerce to construct Roppongi Station in 318 AS Despite the restrictions placed on permanent residencies elsewhere in Kusari, and the outrage expressed by conservative Kusari politicians at the Hideyoshi controlled Shogunate for allowing foreigners into the New Tokyo system, Roppongi Station's business flourished, with many corporations opening offices onboard.

When Emperor Hideyoshi was deposed in 321 AS, Roppongi's future was plunged into doubt. Thankfully, even the conservatives had recognised the financial benefits of leaving it alone, and in any case they had no desire at the time to upset Interspace Commerce, who owned the rights to all the jump gates and trade lanes within Kusari. The conservatives were still reluctant to have too many foreigners in New Tokyo, however, and Deshima Station in Shikoku was eventually constructed in 350 AS with the aim of reducing the "outsider" population. Strict travel regulations were enforced for ships entering into New Tokyo.

Most of these restrictions have since been lifted in the interests of progress. Roppongi has become a busy trade centre, with Kusari and foreign companies arranging business deals on the station, almost around the clock. Most of the major houses have also established their embassies on Roppongi.

In 832 AS, a massive nuclear explosion initiated in the lower levels of the station hangars shook the station. Although the station bulkheads were able to prevent the complete disintegration of the station following this explosion, many of the station's systems were critically damaged or completely disabled by either the shock wave itself or the electromagnetic pulse accompanying it.

Despite the almost immediate response of the emergency services, many station sections have undergone explosive decompression and the loss of life and property is enormous. At present it is unclear when or if it will be possible to repair the station and reopen it to the public as the extensive fires at the station have still not exhausted all of the oxygen reserves and the station remains heavily contaminated with radioactive isotopes.

1123071.text: Named after the nebula found within Vespucci, which it shares its distinct hew, Guerrero spawns many visitors from the Independent Worlds looking for goods or sport at Bornholm.

1123073.text:
Kamchatka Base was a Coalition installation strategically situated in Omega-55. Originally constructed as a SIGINT listening post, the facility was expanded over the years to house small numbers of fighter wings for deep recon patrols and staffed with Coalition scientists to study the various stellar phenomena of the system, including the nearby Aarhus planetoid.

When the Core began to move their forces into Omega-55, Kamchatka was quickly expanded with larger hangars, thicker armor, mooring fixtures for Typhoons and Hurricanes. The base now serves as the Coalition's forward operating base for operations in the eastern Omegas, and her fighter compliment sees frequent skirmishes with Core forces in the area. The base would ultimately fall victim to the conflict within the System.

On the one hand I am relieved someone is helping us doing our job, on the other hand I am worried lest we get shot by this "someone" as well.

1123141.text: I don't even know what its supposed to be

1123142.text: When the Libertarians discovered a new fringe system I knew we, the Zoners, would come here. A new frontier with new opportunities! This feeling of adventure is what hooked me up to abandon my previous life as a clerk and join the pioneers. Any adventure comes in hand with danger, however. This power play of Liberty near their Jump Gate is raising concerns among the locals that Liberty will treat us in the same way as they did with Erie.

1123143.text: Have you already visited the Bikini Debris field? A gloomy place with all those pieces of ships long gone. Still, if you don't mind the desolate atmosphere you can find some interesting archeotech that Ageira will be ready to buy for a good price. Be careful of the Lane Hackers - they seem to be eager laying hands on any Ageira piece of technology, new or old, be those flying around as debris or being in your cargo hold.

1123144.text: I heard the Order has dispatched one of its ships here. It is hard to tell what they are doing here but their presence is as good for our business as for our safety. The Libertarians won't bat an eye if we are in trouble. I have also seen a few Lane Hackers around casually talking with the Order. Seems like they are on good terms with each other. Whatever, as long as they don't touch us I don't mind.

1123145.text: [827 AS] Unknown disease causing havoc in Nu

1123146.text:
Following a range of the local personnel falling ill after returning from the Bikini Debris Field and planet Marshall, the medical team attached to the exploration team in Omicron Nu requested the authorities to temporarily limit the traffic from and into the system and establish quarantine.

The first signs of the disease appeared soon after the planetfall on Marshall and since then the malaise spread to over 30 crew members. The cause of the illness is unknown and being researched by the medical scientists aboard "Oregon". According to the preliminary analysis, the disease is highly infectious and requires limitation of free travel in the area until the cause and/or appropriate treatment is found. One of the hypothesis blames the malaise on intensive solar flares of the three-star system and bursts of solar radiation, yet other scientists rebuke the assumption as incompetent due to the found infectious nature of the disease.

It is not the first case of xeno-disease encountered throughout the colonisation of Sirius. Many local bacteria and even viruses caused a lot of trouble for the early settlers yet have largely been subdued due to the advances in heuristic pharmacology. Cryer officials have issued a statement that a test medication is already underway and Omicron Nu restriction could be lifted soon. For now, Liberty authorities advise to avoid visiting the Omicron Nu system and remind of persecution under the Law of the Republic of Liberty in case of violation of the standing quarantine.

1123147.text: This abandoned Pilgrim class liner appears to have run into an unfortunate accident on its way through the Silverton Asteroid Field. Scans reveal the vessel belonged to ALG Waste Disposal and that it was in the process of cleaning up an area of the field filled with Toxic Waste. Unfortunately, most of its efforts appear to have been undone by the crash.

1123148.text: This Oasis class prison ship appears to have run into an unfortunate accident on their way to Attica Supermax, a prison facility rumored to be the most secure to exist in all of Liberty. The prisoner list mentions several high priority Xeno criminals as being onboard and in transit to the prison. It seems that the prison ship was assaulted by Xenos and crashed into the Reiner See after losing its navigation systems. There is no sign of the crew or passengers.

Nomad Eviscerator Bomb
